e.en: "Your coffee is ready, {ma'am}," the barista said politely.
e.zh: "女士,您的咖啡好了,"咖啡师礼貌地说。

e.en: "Yes {ma'am}, I'll have it on your desk by noon."
e.zh: "好的女士,中午前我会放到您桌上。"

maastricht.t: n. 马斯特里赫特（荷兰城市）

e.en: The {Maastricht} Treaty laid the foundation for the European Union.
e.zh: 《马斯特里赫特条约》为欧盟奠定了基础。

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring {Maastricht}'s old town.
e.zh: 我们用一个长周末逛了马斯特里赫特的老城。

mab.t: n. 单克隆抗体（monoclonal antibody 缩写）

e.en: Queen {Mab} appears in Mercutio's famous Shakespeare speech.
e.zh: 麦布女王出现在茂丘西奥那段莎士比亚名段中。

e.en: The fairy queen {Mab} brings dreams to sleeping mortals.
e.zh: 仙后麦布会把梦带给沉睡的凡人。

mac.t:
n. 苹果电脑（Macintosh）
n. 风衣（英口语）

e.en: I just bought a new {Mac} for video editing work.
e.zh: 我刚买了台新的Mac用来剪视频。

e.en: Grab your {mac} — it's pouring outside again.
e.zh: 拿上你的雨衣吧,外面又在下大雨了。

macabre.t: adj. 阴森恐怖的；死亡主题的

e.en: The novel has a strangely {macabre} sense of humor.
e.zh: 这本小说带着一种诡异阴森的幽默感。

e.en: Visitors find the catacombs both fascinating and {macabre}.
e.zh: 游客觉得地下墓穴既迷人又骇人。

e.en: The country lane was paved with rough {macadam}.
e.zh: 那条乡间小路铺着粗糙的碎石路面。

e.en: Hot {macadam} smelled like tar in the summer sun.
e.zh: 夏日阳光下,热碎石路面散发着柏油味。

macadamia.t: n. 夏威夷果；澳洲坚果

e.en: I tossed some {macadamia} nuts into the cookie dough.
e.zh: 我往饼干面团里加了一些夏威夷果。

e.en: Hawaii is famous for its creamy {macadamia} chocolates.
e.zh: 夏威夷以奶香味十足的夏威夷果巧克力闻名。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Macao} for the casinos and Portuguese egg tarts.
e.zh: 游客涌向澳门,只为赌场和葡式蛋挞。

e.en: {Macao} returned to Chinese sovereignty in 1999.
e.zh: 澳门于1999年回归中国主权。

e.en: A cheeky {macaque} stole a tourist's sandwich at the temple.
e.zh: 一只调皮的猕猴在寺庙偷走了游客的三明治。

e.en: Researchers study {macaque} behavior to understand primate societies.
e.zh: 研究人员通过观察猕猴行为来理解灵长类社会。

macarena.t: n. 玛卡蕾娜（一首歌/舞蹈）

e.en: Everyone at the wedding still remembers how to dance the {Macarena}.
e.zh: 婚礼上每个人都还记得怎么跳玛卡蕾娜。

e.en: The DJ played the {Macarena} and the dance floor exploded.
e.zh: DJ放了玛卡蕾娜,舞池瞬间炸开了。

e.en: The kids only want {macaroni} and cheese for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 孩子们今晚晚餐只想吃芝士通心粉。

e.en: She added cooked {macaroni} to the chilled summer salad.
e.zh: 她把煮好的通心粉拌进了冰镇夏日沙拉。

e.en: I bought a pistachio {macaroon} from the Parisian bakery.
e.zh: 我在那家巴黎面包店买了一颗开心果马卡龙。

e.en: The coconut {macaroon} was crisp outside and chewy inside.
e.zh: 这颗椰子马卡龙外脆内软。

e.en: We took the ferry from Hong Kong to {Macau} in an hour.
e.zh: 我们从香港坐渡轮一小时就到了澳门。

e.en: {Macau}'s skyline blends colonial churches with neon casinos.
e.zh: 澳门的天际线融合了殖民时期教堂和霓虹赌场。

e.en: A scarlet {macaw} screeched from the top of the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 一只猩红金刚鹦鹉在雨林树冠顶端尖叫。

e.en: The blue {macaw} can mimic human speech surprisingly well.
e.zh: 蓝色金刚鹦鹉模仿人类说话的能力惊人。

macbeth.t: n. 麦克白（莎士比亚剧作）

e.en: Our drama club is staging {Macbeth} this fall semester.
e.zh: 我们戏剧社这学期秋天要排《麦克白》。

e.en: Lady {Macbeth} is one of Shakespeare's most chilling characters.
e.zh: 麦克白夫人是莎士比亚笔下最令人毛骨悚然的角色之一。

macca.t: n. 麦卡（昵称，常指 McCartney）

e.en: Let's grab a quick burger at {Macca} on the way home.
e.zh: 我们回家路上去麦当劳快快吃个汉堡吧。

e.en: In Australia, everyone calls McDonald's {Macca}'s.
e.zh: 在澳大利亚,大家都把麦当劳叫"Macca's"。

macclesfield.t: n. 麦克尔斯菲尔德（英国城镇）

e.en: My uncle has lived in {Macclesfield} for over thirty years.
e.zh: 我叔叔在麦克尔斯菲尔德住了三十多年。

e.en: {Macclesfield} was once a major silk-weaving town in England.
e.zh: 麦克尔斯菲尔德曾是英国主要的丝织重镇。

e.en: Old {MacDonald} had a farm — every kid knows that song.
e.zh: 老麦克唐纳有一个农场——每个小孩都会唱这首歌。

e.en: The {MacDonald} clan once dominated much of western Scotland.
e.zh: 麦克唐纳家族曾统治苏格兰西部大片地区。

macduff.t: n. 麦克达夫（人名，《麦克白》角色）

e.en: In the play, {Macduff} avenges his murdered family.
e.zh: 剧中,麦克达夫为他被杀的家人复仇。

e.en: "Lay on, {Macduff}!" is one of Shakespeare's famous lines.
e.zh: "上前来,麦克达夫!"是莎士比亚的名句之一。

mace.t:
n. 权杖；狼牙棒
n. 防狼喷雾

e.en: She carries pepper {mace} in her bag for safety.
e.zh: 她包里随身带着防身用的胡椒喷雾。

e.en: A medieval knight could crush armor with a heavy {mace}.
e.zh: 中世纪骑士能用沉重的钉头锤砸碎铠甲。

e.en: Alexander of {Macedon} conquered most of the known world.
e.zh: 马其顿的亚历山大征服了当时已知世界的大部分。

e.en: Ancient {Macedon} rose from a small kingdom to a vast empire.
e.zh: 古马其顿从一个小王国发展为庞大的帝国。

e.en: We hiked through the mountains of northern {Macedonia} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天在北马其顿的山里徒步。

e.en: {Macedonia} is known for its lakes and Byzantine monasteries.
e.zh: 马其顿以湖泊和拜占庭修道院而闻名。

macedonian.t:
adj. 马其顿的
n. 马其顿人

e.en: Our guide spoke fluent {Macedonian} and a bit of English.
e.zh: 我们的导游说流利的马其顿语,还会一点英语。

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Macedonian} stuffed peppers.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的马其顿酿青椒。

e.en: Let the strawberries {macerate} in sugar for thirty minutes.
e.zh: 把草莓和糖一起腌渍三十分钟。

e.en: The recipe asks you to {macerate} the figs in red wine.
e.zh: 食谱要求把无花果浸泡在红酒里出汁。

e.en: The fighter jet broke {Mach} 2 over the desert.
e.zh: 那架战机在沙漠上空突破了2马赫。

e.en: Concorde could cruise comfortably above {Mach} 2 for hours.
e.zh: 协和式客机可以在2马赫以上持续巡航数小时。

machair.t: n. 苏格兰沿海低地草原

e.en: The Scottish {machair} bursts into wildflower bloom every summer.
e.zh: 苏格兰的玛克草原每年夏天都开满野花。

e.en: Rare bees thrive on the coastal {machair} of the Hebrides.
e.zh: 稀有蜜蜂在赫布里底群岛的滨海草地上繁衍。

e.en: She built the volcano model out of papier-{mache}.
e.zh: 她用纸浆做了一个火山模型。

e.en: The kids painted a papier-{mache} mask for the school play.
e.zh: 孩子们为校园剧涂画了一个纸浆面具。

e.en: The farmer used a {machete} to clear the dense brush.
e.zh: 农夫用砍刀清除浓密的灌木丛。

e.en: He sharpened his {machete} before heading into the jungle.
e.zh: 他在进入丛林前磨利了砍刀。

machiavelli.t: n. 马基雅维利（意大利政治思想家）

e.en: The professor lectured on {Machiavelli} and Renaissance political theory.
e.zh: 教授讲解了马基雅维利与文艺复兴时期的政治理论。

e.en: Critics compared the senator's tactics to those of {Machiavelli}.
e.zh: 评论人士将这位参议员的手段比作马基雅维利。

machiavellian.t:
adj. 不择手段的，权术的
n. 权谋者

e.en: The CEO's {Machiavellian} maneuvers ousted three rivals in months.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官以权谋手段在数月内挤走三个对手。

e.en: She admired the show's {Machiavellian} villain for his cunning.
e.zh: 她欣赏剧中那位老谋深算的反派的狡猾。

e.en: The novel exposes the political {machination} behind the coup.
e.zh: 小说揭露了政变背后的政治阴谋。

e.en: His clever {machination} fooled even his closest advisors.
e.zh: 他巧妙的诡计连最亲近的顾问也被骗过。

machine.t:
n. 机器，机械
v. 用机器加工

e.en: The new washing {machine} runs much quieter than the old one.
e.zh: 这台新洗衣机比旧的安静得多。

e.en: Modern {machine} learning models can generate surprisingly natural text.
e.zh: 现代机器学习模型能生成出奇自然的文本。

machined.t:
adj. 机器加工过的
v. machine 的过去式

e.en: The factory {machined} the parts to extremely tight tolerances.
e.zh: 工厂将零件加工到极严格的公差范围内。

e.en: Each component is precisely {machined} from a single aluminum block.
e.zh: 每个部件都由整块铝精密加工而成。

e.en: Heavy {machinery} rumbled across the construction site all morning.
e.zh: 重型机械整个上午在工地上隆隆作响。

e.en: The bureaucratic {machinery} moves slowly even for urgent cases.
e.zh: 官僚机器即便对紧急事务也运转缓慢。

machines.t:
n. 机器（复数）
v. 用机器加工

e.en: The factory's robotic {machines} run twenty-four hours a day.
e.zh: 工厂的机器人设备一天二十四小时运转。

e.en: Vending {machines} on this campus accept mobile payments now.
e.zh: 这个校园里的自动售货机现在支持手机支付。

machining.t:
n. 机械加工
v. 机加工（进行时）

e.en: Precision {machining} is essential for aerospace component manufacturing.
e.zh: 精密加工对航空零件制造至关重要。

e.en: He learned CNC {machining} at a local technical college.
e.zh: 他在当地的技术学院学习了数控加工。

machinist.t: n. 机械师，机床操作工

e.en: The veteran {machinist} could read blueprints at a glance.
e.zh: 这位资深机床工一眼就能看懂图纸。

e.en: She trained as a {machinist} after leaving the navy.
e.zh: 她从海军退役后接受了机床工培训。

e.en: The film critiques the {machismo} celebrated in old westerns.
e.zh: 这部电影批判了老式西部片中推崇的大男子主义。

e.en: His exaggerated {machismo} made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他夸张的男子气概让在座的人都很不自在。

macho.t:
adj. 大男子气概的
n. 硬汉

e.en: He drives that loud truck to look {macho} at parties.
e.zh: 他开那辆吵闹的卡车,在派对上显得很阳刚。

e.en: The advertisement plays on tired {macho} stereotypes about beer drinkers.
e.zh: 那则广告利用了关于啤酒消费者的陈旧大男子主义刻板印象。

macintosh.t: n. 胶布雨衣；苹果 Mac 电脑

e.en: He bought his first {Macintosh} computer back in 1984.
e.zh: 他在1984年买下了自己的第一台麦金塔电脑。

e.en: She wore a yellow {macintosh} during the heavy spring rain.
e.zh: 春雨倾盆时她穿着一件黄色雨衣。

mack.t: n. 雨衣（mackintosh 缩写）；人名

e.en: He pulled on his old green {mack} before stepping outside.
e.zh: 他穿上那件旧绿雨衣才走出门。

e.en: The truck driver hauled supplies in his battered {Mack}.
e.zh: 卡车司机开着他那辆破旧的Mack卡车运送物资。

e.en: Grilled {mackerel} with lemon makes a quick weeknight dinner.
e.zh: 烤鲭鱼配柠檬是简便的工作日晚餐。

e.en: The fishermen hauled in nets full of fresh {mackerel}.
e.zh: 渔民们拉起一网网新鲜的鲭鱼。

mackinaw.t: n. 厚呢短大衣；平底船

e.en: He wore a heavy plaid {mackinaw} during the logging season.
e.zh: 伐木季节里他穿着一件厚重的格子粗呢外套。

e.en: Her grandfather's red {mackinaw} still hangs by the cabin door.
e.zh: 她祖父那件红色粗呢外套还挂在小屋门旁。

e.en: She grabbed her {mackintosh} as the storm clouds rolled in.
e.zh: 暴风云压过来时她抓起雨衣。

e.en: A waterproof {mackintosh} kept the hikers dry on the trail.
e.zh: 一件防水雨衣让徒步者在路上保持干爽。

e.en: She hung a {macrame} plant holder in the sunny window.
e.zh: 她在阳光充足的窗边挂了个绳编植物吊篮。

e.en: Vintage {macrame} wall hangings are trending on home decor sites.
e.zh: 复古绳编挂饰在家居装饰网站上很流行。

macro.t:
n. 宏（命令）
adj. 宏观的

e.en: She wrote a {macro} to automate the spreadsheet calculations.
e.zh: 她写了一个宏来自动完成电子表格的计算。

e.en: The {macro} lens captured every detail of the tiny insect.
e.zh: 微距镜头捕捉到了那只小昆虫的每个细节。

macrobiotic.t: adj. 长寿饮食的（全谷素食）

e.en: He follows a strict {macrobiotic} diet of grains and vegetables.
e.zh: 他坚持以谷物和蔬菜为主的严格长寿饮食。

e.en: The cafe specializes in {macrobiotic} meals using local ingredients.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆专做用本地食材烹制的长寿饮食餐。

e.en: A single ant colony reflects the {macrocosm} of human society.
e.zh: 一个蚂蚁群体折射出人类社会这个大宇宙。

e.en: Philosophers see the universe as a vast interconnected {macrocosm}.
e.zh: 哲学家将宇宙视作一个相互联结的宏大整体。

e.en: The painting captures the {macrocosmic} sweep of galactic evolution.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘出星系演化的宏观全貌。

e.en: Her essay shifts from personal grief to {macrocosmic} themes.
e.zh: 她的散文从个人悲伤转向宏观主题。

e.en: Rising oil prices have major {macroeconomic} consequences for importers.
e.zh: 油价上涨对进口国有重大宏观经济影响。

e.en: The report analyzed {macroeconomic} trends across emerging Asian markets.
e.zh: 该报告分析了新兴亚洲市场的宏观经济趋势。

e.en: She is taking {macroeconomics} as part of her business degree.
e.zh: 她在攻读商科学位的同时修读宏观经济学。

e.en: {Macroeconomics} examines inflation, unemployment, and national output together.
e.zh: 宏观经济学综合研究通胀、失业和国民产出。

e.en: The {macroeconomist} predicted a mild recession by year's end.
e.zh: 这位宏观经济学家预测年底前会有轻度衰退。

e.en: As a {macroeconomist}, she advises the central bank on policy.
e.zh: 作为宏观经济学家,她为中央银行提供政策建议。

macromolecular.t: adj. 高分子的，大分子的

e.en: The lab studies {macromolecular} structures using advanced electron microscopy.
e.zh: 该实验室用先进的电子显微镜研究大分子结构。

e.en: Proteins are key {macromolecular} components of every living cell.
e.zh: 蛋白质是每个活细胞中关键的大分子成分。

e.en: DNA is a {macromolecule} that stores genetic information in cells.
e.zh: DNA是一种在细胞中储存遗传信息的大分子。

e.en: Each {macromolecule} folds into a unique three-dimensional shape.
e.zh: 每个大分子都会折叠成独特的三维形状。

e.en: A {macrophage} engulfs harmful bacteria as part of immune defense.
e.zh: 巨噬细胞吞噬有害细菌,是免疫防御的一部分。

e.en: Researchers tracked how each {macrophage} responded to the infection.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了每个巨噬细胞对感染的反应。

e.en: Each lake {macrophyte} provides shelter for small fish and insects.
e.zh: 湖中每种大型水生植物都为小鱼和昆虫提供庇护。

e.en: Excessive nutrients caused rapid {macrophyte} growth in the pond.
e.zh: 过多的养分导致池塘中大型水生植物迅速生长。

macroscopic.t: adj. 宏观的；肉眼可见的

e.en: The crystal's {macroscopic} structure is visible without a microscope.
e.zh: 这种晶体的宏观结构无需显微镜即可看到。

e.en: Quantum effects rarely show up at the {macroscopic} scale.
e.zh: 量子效应很少在宏观尺度上显现。

macroscopically.t: adv. 宏观地；从宏观上看

e.en: {Macroscopically}, the two samples appeared identical to the naked eye.
e.zh: 从宏观上看,这两个样本在肉眼下完全相同。

e.en: The tumor was {macroscopically} visible during the routine examination.
e.zh: 在常规检查中,肿瘤在宏观上清晰可见。

e.en: Damage to the {macula} can severely affect central vision.
e.zh: 黄斑受损会严重影响中心视力。

e.en: The eye doctor examined her {macula} for early signs of degeneration.
e.zh: 眼科医生检查她的黄斑是否有早期病变迹象。

e.en: The old manuscript's pages were {maculate} with ink stains and age.
e.zh: 那本古老手稿的纸页被墨迹和岁月弄得斑斑点点。

e.en: Her white apron grew {maculate} after a busy lunch shift.
e.zh: 忙完午餐班后,她的白围裙沾满了污渍。

maculated.t: adj. 有斑点的；被玷污的

e.en: The leopard's {maculated} coat blends perfectly into dappled sunlight.
e.zh: 豹子斑纹的皮毛与斑驳阳光完美融合。

e.en: Time had {maculated} the marble statue with greenish patches.
e.zh: 岁月在大理石雕像上留下斑驳的绿色斑点。

macy.t: n. 梅西（姓氏/人名，如梅西百货）

e.en: She bought new bedding during the holiday sale at {Macy's}.
e.zh: 她在梅西百货的假日促销期间买了新床品。

e.en: The Thanksgiving Day parade is hosted every year by {Macy's}.
e.zh: 感恩节大游行每年都由梅西百货主办。

e.en: She got really {mad} when he forgot her birthday again.
e.zh: 他又忘了她的生日,她真的很生气。

e.en: You'd be {mad} to drive through this snowstorm tonight.
e.zh: 今晚要在这场暴风雪中开车你就是疯了。

madagascar.t: n. 马达加斯加（非洲岛国）

e.en: Lemurs are found only in the wild on {Madagascar}.
e.zh: 狐猴在野外仅生活于马达加斯加。

e.en: They spent their honeymoon hiking through the rainforests of {Madagascar}.
e.zh: 他们在马达加斯加的雨林中徒步度过了蜜月。

e.en: The shopkeeper smiled and asked, 'Can I help you, {madam}?'
e.zh: 店主微笑着问:'女士,有什么可以为您效劳的?'

e.en: 'Right this way, {madam},' the host said politely.
e.zh: '女士,这边请,'迎宾礼貌地说道。

e.en: {Madame} Dubois greeted her guests warmly at the gallery opening.
e.zh: 杜布瓦夫人在画廊开幕式上热情地迎接客人。

e.en: The waiter bowed and said, 'Your table is ready, {Madame}.'
e.zh: 服务员鞠躬说道:'夫人,您的餐桌已经准备好了。'

madames.t: n. madame 的复数；夫人们

e.en: The French school addressed parents as messieurs and {madames}.
e.zh: 那所法语学校把家长们称为先生们和女士们。

e.en: Several elegant {madames} chatted quietly in the hotel lobby.
e.zh: 几位优雅的女士在酒店大堂安静地交谈。

madams.t: n. madam 的复数；女士们

e.en: The boutique caters to wealthy {madams} from across the city.
e.zh: 这家精品店服务来自全市各地的富有女士。

e.en: Two {madams} were arrested in the brothel investigation last week.
e.zh: 上周的妓院调查中两名鸨母被逮捕。

madcap.t:
adj. 鲁莽的；冲动的
n. 冒失鬼

e.en: The film follows a {madcap} road trip across rural America.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一段穿越美国乡村的疯狂公路之旅。

e.en: Her {madcap} schemes always somehow end up working out.
e.zh: 她那些荒唐的计划总能莫名其妙地成功。

e.en: Repeated traffic delays {madden} commuters on the bridge every morning.
e.zh: 反复的交通拥堵每天早晨让桥上的通勤者抓狂。

e.en: Small inconsistencies in the data {madden} careful researchers.
e.zh: 数据中的小矛盾会让严谨的研究人员发狂。

e.en: {Maddened} by the noise, she finally stormed next door to complain.
e.zh: 被噪音逼疯的她最终冲到隔壁去投诉。

e.en: The bull was {maddened} by the bright red cloth.
e.zh: 那头公牛被鲜红的布激怒了。

maddening.t: adj. 令人抓狂的；使人发疯的

e.en: The software's {maddening} bug crashed his work three times today.
e.zh: 这个软件令人抓狂的漏洞今天让他的工作崩溃了三次。

e.en: There's a {maddening} drip from the kitchen faucet at night.
e.zh: 夜里厨房水龙头有一种让人发狂的滴水声。

e.en: The website loads {maddeningly} slowly on hotel Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 在酒店Wi-Fi下,这个网站加载得让人抓狂地慢。

e.en: His instructions were {maddeningly} vague and impossible to follow.
e.zh: 他的指示模糊得令人抓狂,根本无法执行。

madder.t:
adj. mad 的比较级；更疯狂的
n. 茜草

e.en: He got even {madder} when no one apologized for the mistake.
e.zh: 没人为这个错误道歉,他更加生气了。

e.en: The dye was extracted from the roots of the {madder} plant.
e.zh: 这种染料是从茜草的根中提取的。

madding.t: adj. 狂乱的；发疯的（多用于文学）

e.en: They moved to the countryside, far from the {madding} crowd.
e.zh: 他们搬到乡下,远离喧嚣的人群。

e.en: The cabin offered peace away from the city's {madding} bustle.
e.zh: 这间小屋远离城市的喧嚣,宁静怡人。

made.t:
v. make 的过去式/分词；制造
adj. 做成的

e.en: She {made} a cake for her brother's birthday.
e.zh: 她为弟弟的生日做了一个蛋糕。

e.en: The decision was {made} after hours of debate.
e.zh: 经过数小时的辩论后才做出这个决定。

madeira.t: n. 马德拉群岛；马德拉白葡萄酒

e.en: He poured a glass of {madeira} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他倒了一杯马德拉酒。

e.en: We sailed past {madeira} on our way to Lisbon.
e.zh: 我们在前往里斯本的途中经过了马德拉群岛。

madeleine.t: n. 玛德琳（贝壳形小蛋糕）；人名

e.en: She dipped a {madeleine} into her tea.
e.zh: 她把一块玛德琳蛋糕浸入茶中。

e.en: The bakery sells fresh {madeleine} cookies every morning.
e.zh: 那家面包店每天早晨都卖新鲜的玛德琳小蛋糕。

madeley.t: n. 马德利（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: They drove through {madeley} on their way north.
e.zh: 他们在北上的途中开车穿过了马德利。

e.en: The village of {madeley} sits in rural Shropshire.
e.zh: 马德利村坐落在乡村什罗普郡。

mademoiselle.t: n. 小姐（法语对未婚女性的称呼）

e.en: The waiter politely greeted the young {mademoiselle}.
e.zh: 服务员礼貌地向那位年轻小姐打招呼。

e.en: Excuse me, {mademoiselle}, is this seat taken?
e.zh: 打扰一下,小姐,这个座位有人吗?

madhouse.t: n. 疯人院；乱哄哄的地方

e.en: The office turned into a {madhouse} before the deadline.
e.zh: 截止日期前办公室变成了一团糟。

e.en: With four kids home, the kitchen was a {madhouse}.
e.zh: 四个孩子都在家,厨房简直乱成一锅粥。

e.en: They moved to {madison} for grad school.
e.zh: 他们为了读研究生搬去了麦迪逊。

e.en: James {madison} helped draft the U.S. Constitution.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·麦迪逊参与起草了美国宪法。

e.en: He fell {madly} in love with his coworker.
e.zh: 他疯狂地爱上了自己的同事。

e.en: The dog barked {madly} at the mail carrier.
e.zh: 那只狗对着邮递员疯狂地吠叫。

e.en: He was driving like a {madman} in the rain.
e.zh: 他在雨中像疯子一样开车。

e.en: Only a {madman} would invest everything in one stock.
e.zh: 只有疯子才会把所有钱投入一只股票。

e.en: The traffic during rush hour is sheer {madness}.
e.zh: 高峰时段的交通简直是疯狂。

e.en: There's a method to her apparent {madness}.
e.zh: 她看似疯狂的行为其实自有道理。

madnesses.t: n. madness 的复数；种种疯狂行为

e.en: History records the strange {madnesses} of certain kings.
e.zh: 史书记载了某些国王奇怪的疯狂行径。

e.en: The novel explores the small daily {madnesses} of city life.
e.zh: 小说探讨了城市生活中那些日常的小疯狂。

madonna.t: n. 圣母玛利亚；圣母像

e.en: The chapel houses a famous painting of the {madonna}.
e.zh: 那座小教堂里藏有一幅著名的圣母像。

e.en: My mother grew up listening to {madonna} albums.
e.zh: 我妈妈是听着麦当娜的专辑长大的。

e.en: In Irish, {madra} simply means dog.
e.zh: 在爱尔兰语里,madra 就是狗的意思。

e.en: She taught the kids that {madra} is Gaelic for dog.
e.zh: 她教孩子们 madra 在盖尔语中意为狗。

madras.t: n. 马德拉斯（印度城市，今金奈）；马德拉斯布

e.en: He wore a bright {madras} shirt to the picnic.
e.zh: 他穿着一件鲜艳的马德拉斯格子衬衫去野餐。

e.en: The restaurant serves an excellent chicken {madras}.
e.zh: 那家餐厅做的马德拉斯咖喱鸡非常棒。

madrasa.t: n. 伊斯兰学校；经学院

e.en: He studied Arabic at the local {madrasa} as a boy.
e.zh: 他小时候在当地的伊斯兰学校学阿拉伯语。

e.en: The {madrasa} stands beside the old mosque.
e.zh: 那所伊斯兰学校就在老清真寺旁边。

e.en: In Spanish, {madre} is the word for mother.
e.zh: 在西班牙语里,madre 就是妈妈的意思。

e.en: She called out to her {madre} from the kitchen.
e.zh: 她从厨房里呼唤她的妈妈。

madrid.t: n. 马德里（西班牙首都）

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring {madrid}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个长周末游览马德里。

e.en: The flight to {madrid} takes about two hours.
e.zh: 飞往马德里的航班大约需要两个小时。

madrigal.t: n. 牧歌；无伴奏合唱小曲

e.en: The choir performed a Renaissance {madrigal} beautifully.
e.zh: 合唱团优美地演唱了一首文艺复兴时期的牧歌。

e.en: He composed a short {madrigal} for the wedding.
e.zh: 他为婚礼创作了一首短小的牧歌。

e.en: She was running through the rain like a {madwoman}.
e.zh: 她像个疯女人一样在雨中奔跑。

e.en: The novel features a mysterious {madwoman} in the attic.
e.zh: 小说中有一个神秘的阁楼疯女人。

maelstrom.t: n. 大漩涡；混乱动荡的局面

e.en: The startup was caught in a financial {maelstrom}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司陷入了一场金融漩涡。

e.en: Her mind was a {maelstrom} of conflicting emotions.
e.zh: 她的内心是一团矛盾情绪的漩涡。

maelstroms.t: n. maelstrom 的复数；大漩涡

e.en: Political {maelstroms} have shaken the region for decades.
e.zh: 政治动荡数十年来一直撼动着这个地区。

e.en: He has weathered many emotional {maelstroms} in his career.
e.zh: 他在职业生涯中经历过许多情绪上的风暴。

maestro.t: n. 大师（尤指音乐指挥、作曲家）

e.en: The {maestro} raised his baton and the orchestra began.
e.zh: 指挥大师举起指挥棒,乐团开始演奏。

e.en: She's a true {maestro} of digital design.
e.zh: 她是数字设计领域的真正大师。

maestroes.t: n. maestro 的复数（变体）；大师们

e.en: Two {maestroes} shared the conducting duties that evening.
e.zh: 那晚两位指挥大师轮流担任指挥。

e.en: The festival brought together {maestroes} from across Europe.
e.zh: 音乐节汇集了来自欧洲各地的指挥大师。

e.en: The siege of {mafeking} lasted over two hundred days.
e.zh: 马费金之围持续了两百多天。

e.en: News of the relief of {mafeking} sparked celebrations in London.
e.zh: 马费金解围的消息在伦敦引发了庆祝活动。

mafia.t: n. 黑手党；有组织犯罪集团

e.en: The film portrays the rise of an Italian {mafia} family.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了一个意大利黑手党家族的崛起。

e.en: Police arrested several {mafia} bosses in the raid.
e.zh: 警方在突袭中逮捕了几名黑手党头目。

e.en: He played a charming {mafioso} in the new series.
e.zh: 他在新剧中饰演一位魅力十足的黑手党成员。

e.en: The retired {mafioso} now writes his memoirs in Sicily.
e.zh: 那位退休的黑手党成员如今在西西里岛写回忆录。

e.en: She flipped through a fashion {mag} at the salon.
e.zh: 她在美发店翻看一本时尚杂志。

e.en: He bought a tech {mag} for the long flight.
e.zh: 他买了一本科技杂志在长途飞行中看。

magazine.t:
n. 杂志、期刊
n. (枪械) 弹匣

e.en: The {magazine} just published an interview with the CEO.
e.zh: 那本杂志刚刚发表了对这位首席执行官的采访。

e.en: He loaded a fresh {magazine} into the rifle.
e.zh: 他往步枪里装了一个新弹匣。

e.en: Old {magazines} were stacked beside the dentist's chair.
e.zh: 旧杂志堆在牙医诊椅旁边。

e.en: Fashion {magazines} have moved most content online.
e.zh: 时尚杂志已经把大部分内容转移到了网上。

e.en: He studied history at {magdalen} College, Oxford.
e.zh: 他在牛津大学莫德林学院学习历史。

e.en: The painting depicts Mary {magdalen} at the tomb.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了抹大拉的玛利亚在墓前的情景。

e.en: Mary {magdalene} appears in several Gospel passages.
e.zh: 抹大拉的玛利亚在多段福音书中出现。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on {magdalene} imagery in Renaissance art.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于文艺复兴艺术中抹大拉形象的论文。

magdeburg.t: n. 马格德堡（德国城市）

e.en: {magdeburg} is famous for its Gothic cathedral.
e.zh: 马格德堡以其哥特式大教堂而闻名。

e.en: The {magdeburg} hemispheres demonstrated atmospheric pressure dramatically.
e.zh: 马格德堡半球实验生动地展示了大气压。

e.en: The young {mage} cast a healing spell on the warrior.
e.zh: 那位年轻法师对战士施了治疗法术。

e.en: She picked the {mage} class in the new RPG.
e.zh: 她在新的角色扮演游戏中选了法师职业。

e.en: Ferdinand {magellan} led the first circumnavigation of the globe.
e.zh: 麦哲伦率领了首次环球航行。

e.en: The strait of {magellan} connects two great oceans.
e.zh: 麦哲伦海峡连接着两大洋。

magellanic.t: adj. 麦哲伦的（如麦哲伦星云）

e.en: The {magellanic} clouds are visible from the southern hemisphere.
e.zh: 麦哲伦云在南半球可以看到。

e.en: Astronomers study star formation in the {magellanic} galaxies.
e.zh: 天文学家研究麦哲伦星系中的恒星形成。

magenta.t:
n. 品红色、洋红色
adj. 品红色的

e.en: She painted the bedroom wall a bold {magenta}.
e.zh: 她把卧室墙面漆成了大胆的洋红色。

e.en: The sunset turned the clouds a brilliant {magenta}.
e.zh: 夕阳把云朵染成了绚丽的洋红色。

e.en: We rented a small villa on Lake {maggiore}.
e.zh: 我们在马焦雷湖边租了一栋小别墅。

e.en: Lake {maggiore} straddles the Italian-Swiss border.
e.zh: 马焦雷湖横跨意大利和瑞士边界。

e.en: A fat {maggot} wriggled out of the rotten apple.
e.zh: 一条肥蛆从烂苹果里钻了出来。

e.en: Anglers sometimes use a live {maggot} as bait.
e.zh: 垂钓者有时会用活蛆作为鱼饵。

e.en: The trash bin was crawling with {maggots} by morning.
e.zh: 到早上垃圾桶里已经爬满了蛆。

e.en: Fishermen keep {maggots} in cool sawdust to stay fresh.
e.zh: 渔民把蛆保存在凉爽的锯末里以保持新鲜。

maghreb.t: n. 马格里布（北非地区）

e.en: She wrote her dissertation on cinema in the {maghreb}.
e.zh: 她的博士论文研究的是马格里布地区的电影。

e.en: Couscous is a staple dish across the {maghreb}.
e.zh: 古斯古斯是整个马格里布地区的主食。

magi.t: n. 东方三博士、祭司（magus 复数）

e.en: The three {magi} brought gifts to the infant Jesus.
e.zh: 三位贤士为婴儿耶稣带来了礼物。

e.en: O. Henry's story "The Gift of the {magi}" is a classic.
e.zh: 欧·亨利的小说《麦琪的礼物》是经典之作。

magic.t:
n. 魔法、魔术
adj. 神奇的

e.en: The kids loved the street performer's {magic} tricks.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢街头艺人的魔术。

e.en: There's a certain {magic} to walking through Paris at night.
e.zh: 夜晚漫步巴黎自有一种魔力。

e.en: Their first date in Kyoto was simply {magical}.
e.zh: 他们在京都的第一次约会简直如梦如幻。

e.en: The forest looked {magical} after the fresh snowfall.
e.zh: 新雪过后的森林看起来如梦似幻。

e.en: The error {magically} disappeared after I restarted the app.
e.zh: 重启应用后,错误竟然神奇地消失了。

e.en: Stains don't just {magically} come out without scrubbing.
e.zh: 污渍不会不擦就神奇地自己消失。

e.en: The {magician} pulled a rabbit from his top hat.
e.zh: 魔术师从他的高顶礼帽里变出了一只兔子。

e.en: Our accountant is a {magician} with tax deductions.
e.zh: 我们的会计在税务减免方面简直是个魔术师。

e.en: Several {magicians} performed at the children's hospital fundraiser.
e.zh: 几位魔术师在儿童医院的筹款活动上表演了。

e.en: Stage {magicians} rely on misdirection more than tricks.
e.zh: 舞台魔术师靠的是引开注意力,而不是手法。

maginot.t: n. 马奇诺（如马奇诺防线）

e.en: The {maginot} Line failed to stop the German invasion.
e.zh: 马奇诺防线没能阻止德军的入侵。

e.en: Historians often cite the {maginot} Line as a costly mistake.
e.zh: 史学家常把马奇诺防线视为代价高昂的错误。

e.en: The {magister} addressed the students in formal Latin.
e.zh: 那位老师用正式的拉丁语向学生致辞。

e.en: He earned the title of {magister} after years of study.
e.zh: 经过多年学习,他获得了硕士学位称号。

e.en: She delivered a {magisterial} lecture on quantum physics.
e.zh: 她做了一场权威的量子物理讲座。

e.en: The judge spoke in a calm, {magisterial} tone.
e.zh: 法官以平静而威严的语气说话。

e.en: He {magisterially} dismissed every objection from the audience.
e.zh: 他以一副权威的姿态驳回了观众的每一个异议。

e.en: The professor surveyed the field {magisterially} in her keynote.
e.zh: 教授在主题演讲中权威地纵览了整个领域。

magisterium.t: n. 天主教会的教导权

e.en: The Catholic {magisterium} interprets church teaching for the faithful.
e.zh: 天主教训导权为信徒诠释教会的教义。

e.en: Critics questioned the {magisterium} of the academic establishment.
e.zh: 批评者质疑学术权威机构的话语权。

e.en: He served in the local {magistracy} for over a decade.
e.zh: 他在地方司法机构任职十多年。

e.en: The {magistracy} reviewed minor offenses every Tuesday.
e.zh: 治安法官系统每周二审理轻微违法案件。

e.en: The {magistrate} fined him fifty dollars for speeding.
e.zh: 地方法官因超速对他罚款五十美元。

e.en: A local {magistrate} signed the search warrant overnight.
e.zh: 一位当地法官连夜签发了搜查令。

e.en: The {magistrates} dismissed the case for lack of evidence.
e.zh: 几位法官因证据不足驳回了此案。

e.en: Local {magistrates} handle most minor traffic violations here.
e.zh: 当地法官处理这里大部分轻微交通违章。

e.en: Shanghai's {maglev} train reaches the airport in eight minutes.
e.zh: 上海磁悬浮列车八分钟就能抵达机场。

e.en: Engineers tested a new {maglev} prototype in the desert.
e.zh: 工程师在沙漠中测试了新款磁悬浮原型车。

e.en: Hot {magma} rose toward the volcano's summit overnight.
e.zh: 炽热的岩浆一夜之间涌向火山顶部。

e.en: Geologists study how {magma} cools to form granite.
e.zh: 地质学家研究岩浆如何冷却形成花岗岩。

magna.t: adj. 大的（拉丁语，如 Magna Carta 大宪章）

e.en: She graduated {magna} cum laude from Yale last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天以极优等成绩从耶鲁大学毕业。

e.en: The {magna} carta limited the king's absolute power.
e.zh: 《大宪章》限制了国王的绝对权力。

e.en: History remembers his many {magnanimities} toward defeated rivals.
e.zh: 历史铭记他对手下败将的种种宽宏大量。

e.en: The book catalogs the small {magnanimities} of ordinary people.
e.zh: 这本书记录了普通人那些细微的慷慨之举。

e.en: She showed great {magnanimity} by forgiving her former boss.
e.zh: 她原谅了前任老板,展现出极大的宽宏大量。

e.en: The winner's {magnanimity} in victory impressed the crowd.
e.zh: 获胜者胜不骄的气度让观众印象深刻。

magnanimous.t: adj. 宽宏大量的、慷慨的

e.en: He was {magnanimous} in defeat and congratulated the winner.
e.zh: 他败而不馁,大度地向胜者道贺。

e.en: The CEO made a {magnanimous} donation to the hospital.
e.zh: 首席执行官向医院慷慨地捐了一大笔钱。

e.en: She {magnanimously} offered to pay for everyone's dinner.
e.zh: 她大方地提出请大家吃晚饭。

e.en: The judge {magnanimously} reduced his sentence by two years.
e.zh: 法官宽宏大量地将他的刑期减少了两年。

e.en: The shipping {magnate} owns half the fleet in Greece.
e.zh: 这位航运巨头拥有希腊一半的船队。

e.en: A tech {magnate} bought the newspaper for one dollar.
e.zh: 一位科技大亨以一美元收购了那家报社。

e.en: Oil {magnates} gathered in Davos to discuss energy prices.
e.zh: 石油巨头们齐聚达沃斯讨论能源价格。

e.en: Several real estate {magnates} attended the charity gala.
e.zh: 几位房地产大亨出席了那场慈善晚宴。

e.en: Bananas contain a healthy amount of {magnesium} and potassium.
e.zh: 香蕉含有适量的镁和钾,有益健康。

e.en: The bike frame is made from lightweight {magnesium} alloy.
e.zh: 这辆自行车的车架由轻质镁合金制成。

magnet.t: n. 磁铁；有吸引力的人或物

e.en: She stuck the photo to the fridge with a {magnet}.
e.zh: 她用一块磁铁把照片贴在冰箱上。

e.en: The new café has become a {magnet} for tourists.
e.zh: 那家新咖啡馆已经成了游客的聚集地。

magnetar.t: n. 磁星（中子星的一种）

e.en: A {magnetar} has the strongest magnetic field in the universe.
e.zh: 磁星拥有宇宙中最强的磁场。

e.en: Astronomers detected a flare from a distant {magnetar} yesterday.
e.zh: 天文学家昨天探测到一颗遥远磁星的爆发。

magnetic.t: adj. 磁性的；有吸引力的

e.en: The compass needle responds to Earth's {magnetic} field.
e.zh: 指南针的指针会随地球磁场而偏转。

e.en: She has a {magnetic} personality that draws people in.
e.zh: 她有一种吸引人的迷人个性。

mahler.t: n. 马勒（奥地利作曲家）

e.en: The orchestra performed {Mahler}'s Fifth Symphony last night.
e.zh: 乐团昨晚演奏了马勒的第五交响曲。

e.en: She fell in love with classical music through {Mahler}.
e.zh: 她通过马勒的作品爱上了古典音乐。

mahogany.t:
n. 桃花心木
adj. 红褐色的

e.en: The desk was carved from polished {mahogany}.
e.zh: 这张书桌是用打磨过的桃花心木雕刻而成的。

e.en: Her hair shone with a deep {mahogany} color.
e.zh: 她的头发闪着深桃花心木般的色泽。

mahonia.t: n. 十大功劳（植物，小檗科）

e.en: The {mahonia} bush blooms with bright yellow flowers in winter.
e.zh: 十大功劳灌木在冬季开出鲜黄色的花朵。

e.en: Birds love eating berries from the {mahonia} in the garden.
e.zh: 鸟儿喜欢吃花园里十大功劳树的浆果。

e.en: The {mahout} guided the elephant through the forest path.
e.zh: 驯象人引导大象穿过森林小径。

e.en: Each {mahout} forms a lifelong bond with his elephant.
e.zh: 每位驯象人都与他的大象建立终生的羁绊。

e.en: The {maid} cleaned the hotel rooms every morning.
e.zh: 女服务员每天早上打扫酒店房间。

e.en: She hired a {maid} to help with the housework.
e.zh: 她雇了一位女佣帮忙做家务。

e.en: Indian flatbreads are often made from refined {maida} flour.
e.zh: 印度薄饼通常用精制的麦达面粉制作。

e.en: The recipe calls for two cups of {maida} and water.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要两杯麦达粉和水。

maiden.t:
n. 少女
adj. 首次的（航行、演讲等）

e.en: The ship completed its {maiden} voyage across the Atlantic.
e.zh: 那艘船完成了横跨大西洋的处女航。

e.en: In the tale, a young {maiden} rescued the wounded knight.
e.zh: 故事中，一位年轻的少女救了受伤的骑士。

e.en: A delicate {maidenhair} fern thrived near the bathroom window.
e.zh: 浴室窗边长着一丛娇嫩的铁线蕨。

e.en: She planted {maidenhair} ferns along the shaded garden path.
e.zh: 她沿着花园的阴凉小径种了铁线蕨。

e.en: The train from London stops at {Maidenhead} every twenty minutes.
e.zh: 从伦敦出发的火车每二十分钟在梅登黑德停一次。

e.en: Her family lived in {Maidenhead} for three generations.
e.zh: 她的家族在梅登黑德住了三代人。

e.en: She blushed in a {maidenly} way when he complimented her.
e.zh: 他赞美她时，她少女般地脸红了。

e.en: The painting captured her {maidenly} grace and innocence.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了她少女般的优雅与纯真。

e.en: A loyal {maidservant} attended to the queen each morning.
e.zh: 一位忠诚的侍女每天早上服侍王后。

e.en: The {maidservant} carried trays of tea to the guests.
e.zh: 侍女端着茶盘送给客人。

maidstone.t: n. 梅德斯通（英国城镇）

e.en: {Maidstone} is the county town of Kent in England.
e.zh: 梅德斯通是英格兰肯特郡的郡城。

e.en: They drove to {Maidstone} for the weekend market.
e.zh: 他们驱车去梅德斯通赶周末集市。

mail.t:
n. 邮件；电子邮件
v. 邮寄

e.en: I'll {mail} the package first thing tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我明天一早就把包裹寄出去。

e.en: The {mail} arrived late again because of the storm.
e.zh: 由于暴风雨，邮件又一次迟到了。

e.en: The postman lifted the heavy {mailbag} onto his shoulder.
e.zh: 邮递员把沉重的邮袋扛到了肩上。

e.en: Letters spilled out when the {mailbag} tipped over.
e.zh: 邮袋翻倒时信件散落了出来。

e.en: There were three bills waiting in the {mailbox}.
e.zh: 邮箱里有三张账单在等着。

e.en: My inbox {mailbox} is full of unread newsletters.
e.zh: 我的邮箱里塞满了未读的订阅邮件。

e.en: All the {mailboxes} on the street were painted blue.
e.zh: 街上所有的信箱都被漆成了蓝色。

e.en: Spam filled the {mailboxes} of nearly every employee.
e.zh: 垃圾邮件塞满了几乎每位员工的邮箱。

e.en: She {mailed} the contract to the lawyer yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天把合同寄给了律师。

e.en: I {mailed} you the photos last week — did they arrive?
e.zh: 我上周把照片寄给你了——收到了吗？

mailer.t: n. 邮件发送程序；邮寄者

e.en: The marketing team designed a colorful {mailer} for the campaign.
e.zh: 营销团队为这次活动设计了一份色彩鲜艳的邮件广告。

e.en: Use a padded {mailer} when shipping fragile items.
e.zh: 寄送易碎品时请使用气泡邮寄袋。

e.en: Please add me to your {mailing} list for updates.
e.zh: 请把我加入你们的邮件列表以接收更新。

e.en: The {mailing} of the invitations took most of the afternoon.
e.zh: 寄送请柬花了大半个下午。

e.en: The {mailman} dropped off a package at the front door.
e.zh: 邮递员把一个包裹放在了前门。

e.en: Our friendly {mailman} always greets the dog by name.
e.zh: 我们友好的邮递员总是叫着狗的名字打招呼。

e.en: He started his career sorting letters in the {mailroom}.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯始于在收发室分拣信件。

e.en: Pick up your packages from the {mailroom} on the first floor.
e.zh: 请到一楼收发室领取你的包裹。

mails.t:
n. 邮件（复数）
v. 邮寄（三单）

e.en: She {mails} a postcard to her grandmother every month.
e.zh: 她每个月都给奶奶寄一张明信片。

e.en: My inbox is flooded with promotional {mails} every morning.
e.zh: 我的收件箱每天早上都塞满了促销邮件。

e.en: The company sent a {mailshot} advertising its new product line.
e.zh: 公司发出群发邮件宣传其新产品线。

e.en: Many customers ignore {mailshot} promotions from unknown brands.
e.zh: 很多顾客会忽略陌生品牌的群发促销邮件。

e.en: Landmines can {maim} civilians long after wars end.
e.zh: 地雷在战争结束很久之后仍可能让平民致残。

e.en: The new safety guard prevents the machine from {maim}ing workers.
e.zh: 新的安全护罩防止机器使工人致残。

maimed.t:
adj. 致残的
v. maim 的过去式

e.en: The accident left him {maimed} but determined to recover.
e.zh: 那场事故使他致残，但他决心恢复。

e.en: Many soldiers returned home {maimed} from the long war.
e.zh: 许多士兵从漫长的战争中残疾归来。

maiming.t:
n. 致残
v. maim 的现在分词

e.en: The factory was fined for {maiming} workers with unsafe equipment.
e.zh: 那家工厂因不安全设备致使工人残疾而被罚款。

e.en: Activists protest the {maiming} of bears in illegal traps.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议非法陷阱使熊致残的行为。

main.t:
adj. 主要的
n. 总管道；干线

e.en: The {main} reason I came was to see you.
e.zh: 我来的主要原因就是为了见你。

e.en: Please use the {main} entrance after six o'clock.
e.zh: 六点之后请使用正门。

e.en: We spent the summer hiking along the coast of {Maine}.
e.zh: 我们整个夏天都在缅因州的海岸徒步。

e.en: {Maine} is famous for its lobsters and rugged scenery.
e.zh: 缅因州以龙虾和崎岖的风景闻名。

e.en: Banks still rely on {mainframe} computers for core transactions.
e.zh: 银行的核心交易仍然依赖于大型主机。

e.en: The legacy {mainframe} system processes millions of records nightly.
e.zh: 老旧的大型机系统每晚处理数百万条记录。

e.en: A ferry connects the island to the {mainland} every hour.
e.zh: 渡轮每小时往返于该岛和大陆之间。

e.en: She moved from Taiwan to the {mainland} for work.
e.zh: 她从台湾搬到了大陆工作。

e.en: Trade between the islands and their respective {mainlands} flourishes.
e.zh: 各岛屿与其本土之间的贸易十分繁荣。

e.en: Ferries link the archipelago to several Asian {mainlands}.
e.zh: 渡轮把这片群岛与几个亚洲大陆连接起来。

mainline.t:
adj. 主流的
v. 静脉注射（毒品）

e.en: This route is on the {mainline} from London to Edinburgh.
e.zh: 这条线路是伦敦到爱丁堡的主干线。

e.en: Her novels have crossed over into {mainline} popular fiction.
e.zh: 她的小说已经进入了主流通俗文学领域。

e.en: The audience was {mainly} students from nearby universities.
e.zh: 观众主要是来自附近大学的学生。

e.en: I drink coffee {mainly} for the caffeine boost.
e.zh: 我喝咖啡主要是为了提神。

e.en: Sailors climbed the {mainmast} to adjust the topmost sail.
e.zh: 水手们爬上主桅去调整最顶端的帆。

e.en: The ship's {mainmast} towered above the wooden deck.
e.zh: 船的主桅高耸于木制甲板之上。

mains.t: n. 总电源；自来水干管

e.en: Plug the heater into the {mains} and switch it on.
e.zh: 把加热器插入电源并打开开关。

e.en: A burst water {mains} flooded the entire street overnight.
e.zh: 主水管爆裂一夜之间淹没了整条街道。

e.en: They hoisted the {mainsail} as the wind picked up.
e.zh: 风渐渐变大，他们升起了主帆。

e.en: The torn {mainsail} flapped loudly in the storm.
e.zh: 撕裂的主帆在暴风雨中啪啪作响。

e.en: Curiosity was the {mainspring} of his scientific career.
e.zh: 好奇心是他科学生涯的主要动力。

e.en: The watchmaker carefully replaced the broken {mainspring}.
e.zh: 钟表匠小心地更换了损坏的主发条。

e.en: Tourism has long been the {mainstay} of the local economy.
e.zh: 旅游业长期以来一直是当地经济的支柱。

e.en: Rice remains a {mainstay} of the family's daily diet.
e.zh: 米饭仍是这家人日常饮食的主食。

mainstream.t:
n. 主流
adj. 主流的

e.en: The band's sound finally crossed over into the {mainstream}.
e.zh: 那支乐队的音乐风格终于打入了主流。

e.en: Electric vehicles have become {mainstream} in the past few years.
e.zh: 电动汽车在过去几年里已成为主流。

e.en: The school {mainstreamed} students with disabilities into regular classes.
e.zh: 学校把残障学生融入普通班级一起上课。

e.en: Streaming services have {mainstreamed} foreign-language dramas worldwide.
e.zh: 流媒体平台让外语剧集在全球走入了主流。

e.en: The district is {mainstreaming} special-needs kids this fall.
e.zh: 本学区这个秋季将让特殊需要的孩子融入普通班。

e.en: Brands are {mainstreaming} sustainable fashion through cheaper lines.
e.zh: 品牌正通过平价产品线让可持续时尚走向大众。

e.en: The policy {mainstreams} climate concerns into every department.
e.zh: 这项政策把气候议题纳入各部门的主流工作。

e.en: Pop culture eventually {mainstreams} ideas that began on the internet.
e.zh: 流行文化最终会把网络上的小众理念推向主流。

e.en: You should {maintain} eye contact during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时你应该保持眼神交流。

e.en: It costs a lot to {maintain} an old house.
e.zh: 维护一栋老房子要花很多钱。

maintainable.t: adj. 可维护的；可保持的

e.en: Clean code is much more {maintainable} in the long run.
e.zh: 整洁的代码从长远看更易于维护。

e.en: Choose a garden design that is easily {maintainable}.
e.zh: 选一种容易打理的花园设计。

e.en: She {maintained} that the report was completely accurate.
e.zh: 她坚持认为这份报告完全准确。

e.en: The library is well {maintained} despite its age.
e.zh: 这座图书馆虽然年代久远,但保养得很好。

magnetically.t: adv. 磁性地；有吸引力地

e.en: The phone case attaches {magnetically} to the wireless charger.
e.zh: 这款手机壳通过磁吸方式贴合无线充电器。

e.en: Audiences were {magnetically} drawn to her stage presence.
e.zh: 观众被她的舞台魅力深深吸引。

e.en: He studied {magnetics} as part of his physics major.
e.zh: 他在物理专业学习了磁学课程。

e.en: The lab specializes in {magnetics} for hard drive design.
e.zh: 该实验室专攻硬盘设计中的磁学技术。

e.en: You can {magnetise} a steel needle by rubbing it firmly.
e.zh: 用力摩擦钢针就可以使其磁化。

e.en: Her speeches always {magnetise} the younger voters in town.
e.zh: 她的演讲总能吸引镇上的年轻选民。

e.en: Physics class today covered electricity and {magnetism} basics.
e.zh: 今天的物理课讲了电与磁的基础知识。

e.en: The actor's personal {magnetism} made every scene memorable.
e.zh: 这位演员的个人魅力让每个场景都令人难忘。

e.en: Different {magnetisms} arise from various atomic spin arrangements.
e.zh: 不同的磁性源于各种原子自旋排列方式。

e.en: The textbook compares the {magnetisms} of iron and nickel.
e.zh: 教科书比较了铁与镍的不同磁性。

e.en: Ancient navigators used {magnetite} to make their first compasses.
e.zh: 古代航海者用磁铁矿制成了最早的指南针。

e.en: Miners found rich veins of {magnetite} beneath the hills.
e.zh: 矿工在山下发现了丰富的磁铁矿矿脉。

e.en: The {magnetization} of the disk stores your computer's data.
e.zh: 磁盘的磁化作用储存着你电脑里的数据。

e.en: Heat can reduce the {magnetization} of a permanent magnet.
e.zh: 高温会降低永磁体的磁化强度。

e.en: You can {magnetize} a screwdriver to pick up loose screws.
e.zh: 你可以给螺丝刀磁化,以便吸起松动的螺丝。

e.en: Great speakers {magnetize} an audience with their first sentence.
e.zh: 优秀的演讲者第一句话就能吸引住听众。

e.en: The {magnetized} strip on your credit card stores account data.
e.zh: 信用卡上的磁条储存着账户信息。

e.en: She was {magnetized} by the painting and stood there motionless.
e.zh: 她被那幅画吸引住,一动不动地站在那里。

e.en: Old motorcycles use a {magneto} to generate ignition spark.
e.zh: 老式摩托车用磁电机来产生点火火花。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the faulty {magneto} on the airplane.
e.zh: 机械师更换了飞机上故障的磁电机。

e.en: Geologists use a {magnetometer} to map underground iron deposits.
e.zh: 地质学家用磁力仪绘制地下铁矿分布图。

e.en: Your phone's {magnetometer} powers the built-in compass app.
e.zh: 手机里的磁力计为内置指南针应用提供支持。

e.en: Earth's {magnetosphere} shields us from harmful solar radiation.
e.zh: 地球磁层保护我们免受有害太阳辐射的伤害。

e.en: Solar storms can compress the planet's {magnetosphere} significantly.
e.zh: 太阳风暴可显著压缩行星的磁层。

e.en: The {magnetron} inside a microwave oven generates the cooking waves.
e.zh: 微波炉里的磁控管产生用于加热的微波。

e.en: Engineers replaced the broken {magnetron} to fix the radar.
e.zh: 工程师更换了损坏的磁控管以修复雷达。

e.en: The choir sang Bach's {magnificat} during the Christmas service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在圣诞礼拜上演唱了巴赫的尊主颂。

e.en: Mary's {magnificat} is recited during evening prayers.
e.zh: 晚祷时会诵念玛利亚的尊主颂。

e.en: This microscope offers up to 1000x {magnification} for cell research.
e.zh: 这台显微镜可提供高达一千倍的放大率,用于细胞研究。

e.en: Increase the {magnification} to see the text more clearly.
e.zh: 调高放大倍数就能更清楚地看到文字。

e.en: Tourists were stunned by the {magnificence} of the cathedral.
e.zh: 游客们被这座大教堂的宏伟壮丽所震撼。

e.en: The {magnificence} of the sunset left everyone speechless.
e.zh: 夕阳的壮美让每个人都说不出话来。

e.en: We had a {magnificent} view of the mountains from our hotel.
e.zh: 从我们酒店可以看到群山壮丽的景色。

e.en: She wore a {magnificent} red dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件华丽的红色礼服出席晚宴。

e.en: The orchestra performed Beethoven's symphony {magnificently} last night.
e.zh: 乐团昨晚出色地演奏了贝多芬的交响曲。

e.en: The garden was {magnificently} decorated for the wedding ceremony.
e.zh: 花园为这场婚礼布置得美轮美奂。

e.en: The Venetian {magnifico} hosted lavish parties in his palazzo.
e.zh: 那位威尼斯贵族在他的府邸举办奢华的宴会。

e.en: He strutted through the lobby like a Renaissance {magnifico}.
e.zh: 他像文艺复兴时期的贵族一样昂首走过大堂。

magnified.t:
adj. 被放大的
v. magnify 过去式

e.en: The image {magnified} every tiny crack in the painting.
e.zh: 放大后的图像显示出画作上每一道细小的裂纹。

e.en: Social media {magnified} the small scandal into national news.
e.zh: 社交媒体把这件小丑闻放大成了全国新闻。

e.en: Grandma uses a {magnifier} to read the newspaper headlines.
e.zh: 奶奶用放大镜看报纸的标题。

e.en: Turn on the screen {magnifier} to enlarge the small text.
e.zh: 打开屏幕放大镜就可以放大小字。

magnifies.t: v. magnify 第三人称单数

e.en: This lens {magnifies} objects up to fifty times their size.
e.zh: 这个镜头可将物体放大到原尺寸的五十倍。

e.en: Lack of sleep {magnifies} the effects of everyday stress.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会放大日常压力带来的影响。

e.en: Pinch the screen to {magnify} the map and find streets.
e.zh: 在屏幕上捏合就能放大地图查找街道。

e.en: Don't {magnify} small problems into major relationship issues.
e.zh: 不要把小问题放大成严重的感情危机。

magnifying.t:
adj. 放大的
v. magnify 现在分词

e.en: Sherlock examined the clue with a {magnifying} glass in hand.
e.zh: 夏洛克手持放大镜仔细查看那条线索。

e.en: The kids spent hours {magnifying} leaves and bugs outside.
e.zh: 孩子们在外面花了好几个小时放大观察树叶和虫子。

e.en: His {magniloquent} speech bored most of the audience to tears.
e.zh: 他那番夸夸其谈的演讲让大部分听众昏昏欲睡。

e.en: The senator's {magniloquent} promises rarely matched his actual record.
e.zh: 那位参议员浮夸的承诺很少与他的实际表现相符。

e.en: The earthquake measured 7.2 in {magnitude} on the Richter scale.
e.zh: 这次地震在里氏震级上为7.2级。

e.en: Few people grasped the {magnitude} of the climate crisis.
e.zh: 很少有人真正理解气候危机的严重程度。

e.en: The two stars differ in brightness by several {magnitudes}.
e.zh: 这两颗恒星的亮度相差好几个星等。

e.en: GPUs are orders of {magnitudes} faster than CPUs for training.
e.zh: GPU在训练任务上比CPU快好几个数量级。

e.en: A pink {magnolia} bloomed outside her bedroom window in April.
e.zh: 四月里,一棵粉色木兰花在她卧室窗外绽放。

e.en: They painted the living room a soft {magnolia} color.
e.zh: 他们把客厅刷成了柔和的木兰花色。

magnox.t: n. 镁诺克斯合金（核反应堆用）

e.en: Britain shut down its last {magnox} reactor several years ago.
e.zh: 英国几年前关闭了最后一座镁诺克斯反应堆。

e.en: Engineers are still decommissioning old {magnox} nuclear plants safely.
e.zh: 工程师仍在安全地拆除老旧的镁诺克斯核电站。

magnum.t: n. 大酒瓶；大口径手枪

e.en: He ordered a {magnum} of champagne for the celebration.
e.zh: 他为庆祝活动点了一大瓶香槟。

e.en: The director called this film his {magnum} opus finally.
e.zh: 导演终于宣称这部电影是他的代表作。

magpie.t: n. 喜鹊；爱收集杂物的人

e.en: A noisy {magpie} stole the shiny ring from the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只吵闹的喜鹊从窗台上叼走了那枚闪亮的戒指。

e.en: She's a {magpie} who collects every small souvenir she sees.
e.zh: 她像喜鹊一样,见到的小纪念品都要收藏起来。

e.en: Two {magpies} built their nest in the tall oak tree.
e.zh: 两只喜鹊在那棵高大的橡树上筑了巢。

e.en: Australian {magpies} sometimes swoop at cyclists during nesting season.
e.zh: 澳洲喜鹊在筑巢季节有时会俯冲攻击骑车人。

magritte.t: n. 马格里特（比利时画家）

e.en: The museum's new exhibit features twenty paintings by {magritte}.
e.zh: 博物馆的新展览展出了二十幅马格利特的画作。

e.en: Her surreal photo style clearly draws inspiration from {magritte}.
e.zh: 她超现实的摄影风格明显借鉴了马格利特。

e.en: Farmers harvest {maguey} to make traditional Mexican mezcal.
e.zh: 农民收割龙舌兰来酿造传统的墨西哥梅斯卡尔酒。

e.en: A field of {maguey} stretched across the dry hillside.
e.zh: 一片龙舌兰田延伸在干燥的山坡上。

magus.t: n. 术士；东方三博士之一

e.en: The ancient {magus} was said to read the stars.
e.zh: 据说那位古代术士能解读星象。

e.en: In the story, a wise {magus} guided the young prince.
e.zh: 故事中，一位睿智的术士指引着年轻的王子。

magyar.t: n. 马扎尔人（匈牙利人）

e.en: She speaks {Magyar} fluently after living in Budapest.
e.zh: 在布达佩斯生活后，她能流利地说匈牙利语。

e.en: The {Magyar} people have a rich cultural heritage.
e.zh: 马扎尔人拥有丰富的文化遗产。

e.en: "{Mah} bad," he texted after missing the meeting.
e.zh: 错过会议后他发短信说"我的错"。

e.en: She called out, "{Mah}, dinner's ready!" from the kitchen.
e.zh: 她从厨房喊道："妈，晚饭好了！"

mahal.t: n. 宫殿（如泰姬陵 Taj Mahal）

e.en: The Taj {Mahal} draws millions of visitors every year.
e.zh: 泰姬陵每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: They visited the marble {Mahal} at sunrise for photos.
e.zh: 他们在日出时去那座大理石宫殿拍照。

e.en: The {maharaja} ruled the kingdom from a grand palace.
e.zh: 那位大君从一座宏伟的宫殿统治着王国。

e.en: A {maharaja} once owned this collection of jeweled swords.
e.zh: 这套镶宝石的剑曾属于一位印度大君。

maharajah.t: n. 印度大君（maharaja 变体）

e.en: The {maharajah} hosted lavish banquets for foreign dignitaries.
e.zh: 那位大君为外国贵宾举办奢华的宴会。

e.en: Portraits of the {maharajah} lined the palace walls.
e.zh: 宫殿的墙上挂满了大君的画像。

maharashtra.t: n. 马哈拉施特拉邦（印度）

e.en: Mumbai is the capital of {Maharashtra}, India's wealthiest state.
e.zh: 孟买是印度最富裕的邦——马哈拉施特拉邦的首府。

e.en: She grew up in a small village in {Maharashtra}.
e.zh: 她在马哈拉施特拉邦的一个小村庄长大。

e.en: The {maharishi} taught meditation to thousands of followers.
e.zh: 那位大师向数千名弟子传授冥想。

e.en: A famous {maharishi} once visited the Beatles in India.
e.zh: 一位著名的大师曾在印度接见过披头士乐队。

e.en: {Mahatma} Gandhi led India's nonviolent independence movement.
e.zh: 圣雄甘地领导了印度的非暴力独立运动。

e.en: People called him a {mahatma} for his selfless wisdom.
e.zh: 人们因他无私的智慧而称他为圣雄。

mahdi.t: n. 马赫迪（伊斯兰救世主）

e.en: Some Muslims await the {Mahdi} to bring justice to the world.
e.zh: 一些穆斯林等待马赫迪降临，为世界带来正义。

e.en: The {Mahdi} is described as a redeemer in Islamic tradition.
e.zh: 马赫迪在伊斯兰传统中被描述为救世主。

e.en: The project {maintainer} merged my pull request overnight.
e.zh: 项目维护者一夜之间合并了我的拉取请求。

e.en: Every popular open-source library needs an active {maintainer}.
e.zh: 每个热门的开源库都需要一位活跃的维护者。

maintaining.t: v. 维护；保持（maintain 的现在分词）

e.en: He has trouble {maintaining} a healthy work-life balance.
e.zh: 他很难保持健康的工作与生活平衡。

e.en: {Maintaining} the servers takes about ten hours a week.
e.zh: 维护这些服务器每周大约需要十小时。

maintains.t: v. 维护；保持（maintain 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The witness still {maintains} that he saw nothing.
e.zh: 那位证人仍然坚称自己什么也没看到。

e.en: Our team {maintains} the company's internal tools.
e.zh: 我们团队负责维护公司的内部工具。

e.en: The website is down for scheduled {maintenance}.
e.zh: 网站正在进行例行维护,暂时无法访问。

e.en: Regular {maintenance} keeps your car running smoothly.
e.zh: 定期保养能让车子运行顺畅。

maintenances.t: n. 维护（maintenance 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The contract covers two free {maintenances} per year.
e.zh: 合同包含每年两次免费保养服务。

e.en: Routine {maintenances} are logged in the building's app.
e.zh: 日常维护记录都存在大楼的应用程序里。

mainwaring.t: n. 梅因沃林（英语姓氏）

e.en: Captain {Mainwaring} leads the platoon in the classic British sitcom.
e.zh: 梅因瓦林上尉是那部英国经典情景喜剧里的排长。

e.en: Fans still quote {Mainwaring} decades after the show ended.
e.zh: 剧集结束几十年后,粉丝仍在引用梅因瓦林的台词。

e.en: We took an afternoon train from Frankfurt to {Mainz}.
e.zh: 我们坐下午的火车从法兰克福去了美因茨。

e.en: Gutenberg printed his famous Bible in {Mainz}.
e.zh: 古腾堡是在美因茨印制了他著名的《圣经》。

mair.t:
n. 梅尔（姓氏）
adv. 更多（苏格兰方言）

e.en: The Scottish poet wrote, "I'll love thee {mair} each day."
e.zh: 那位苏格兰诗人写道:"我对你的爱将日益增多。"

e.en: Professor {Mair} translated several classical Chinese texts.
e.zh: 梅尔教授翻译过多部中国古代典籍。

e.en: The {maire} of the village welcomed us at the town hall.
e.zh: 村镇长在市政厅迎接了我们。

e.en: In France, the {maire} performs civil wedding ceremonies.
e.zh: 在法国,市镇长负责主持民事婚礼。

e.en: She wanted to come, {mais} her flight was cancelled.
e.zh: 她本想来的,但是航班被取消了。

e.en: The French phrase "oui, {mais}" means "yes, but."
e.zh: 法语"oui, mais"的意思是"是的,但是"。

e.en: We rented a small {maison} in the south of France.
e.zh: 我们在法国南部租了一栋小房子。

e.en: The bakery's {maison} specialty is almond croissants.
e.zh: 这家面包店的招牌是杏仁可颂。

e.en: They live in a two-floor {maisonette} above the shop.
e.zh: 他们住在店铺楼上的双层小公寓里。

e.en: The {maisonette} has its own private entrance from the street.
e.zh: 这套复式小公寓有独立的临街入口。

maister.t: n. 师傅（master 的古旧拼写）

e.en: In old Scots, a teacher was called the {maister}.
e.zh: 在古苏格兰语中,老师被称为"maister"。

e.en: The apprentice bowed before his {maister}.
e.zh: 学徒在他的师傅面前鞠了一躬。

e.en: We drove through {Maitland} on our way to Newcastle.
e.zh: 我们开车去纽卡斯尔的途中经过了梅特兰。

e.en: {Maitland} wrote influential essays on English legal history.
e.zh: 梅特兰撰写过有影响力的英国法律史论文。

e.en: Farmers in Iowa harvest tons of {maize} every fall.
e.zh: 爱荷华州的农民每年秋天会收割大量玉米。

e.en: {Maize} was first domesticated in ancient Mexico.
e.zh: 玉米最早是在古代墨西哥被驯化的。

e.en: {Maj}. Smith briefed the troops before the mission.
e.zh: 史密斯少校在任务前向部队作了简报。

e.en: The roster lists her rank as {Maj}. Johnson.
e.zh: 花名册上她的军衔写的是约翰逊少校。

e.en: The {majestic} mountains stretched as far as we could see.
e.zh: 雄伟的群山一直延伸到目力所及之处。

e.en: A {majestic} eagle soared above the canyon.
e.zh: 一只威严的雄鹰在峡谷上方翱翔。

e.en: The cruise ship sailed {majestically} into the harbor.
e.zh: 那艘游轮气势恢宏地驶入港口。

e.en: Snow fell {majestically} over the silent forest.
e.zh: 雪花庄严地飘落在寂静的森林上。

majesty.t:
n. 陛下（尊称）
n. 威严；庄严

e.en: Her {Majesty} the Queen will address the nation tonight.
e.zh: 女王陛下今晚将向全国发表讲话。

e.en: We were stunned by the sheer {majesty} of the waterfall.
e.zh: 瀑布的雄伟壮丽让我们惊叹不已。

majlis.t: n. (中东地区) 议会；会客厅

e.en: The Iranian {majlis} debated the new budget for hours.
e.zh: 伊朗议会就新预算辩论了好几个小时。

e.en: Guests gathered in the {majlis} to drink coffee and chat.
e.zh: 客人们聚在客厅喝咖啡聊天。

majolica.t: n. 马约利卡彩釉陶器

e.en: She collects colorful {majolica} plates from Italy.
e.zh: 她收藏来自意大利的彩色马约利卡陶盘。

e.en: The museum displayed Renaissance {majolica} in a glass case.
e.zh: 博物馆把文艺复兴时期的马约利卡陶器陈列在玻璃柜中。

major.t:
adj. 主要的；重大的
n. 专业；少校

e.en: Climate change is a {major} challenge for our generation.
e.zh: 气候变化是我们这一代人面临的重大挑战。

e.en: She decided to {major} in computer science next year.
e.zh: 她决定明年主修计算机科学。

e.en: We spent a week sunbathing on the beaches of {Majorca}.
e.zh: 我们在马略卡岛的海滩上晒了一周太阳。

e.en: {Majorca} is the largest island in the Balearic chain.
e.zh: 马略卡岛是巴利阿里群岛中最大的岛屿。

e.en: The {majordomo} ran the entire estate while the family traveled.
e.zh: 主人外出时,大管家打理着整个庄园。

e.en: Every detail of the banquet went through the {majordomo}.
e.zh: 宴会的每一个细节都要经过总管过目。

e.en: Italians sometimes say "in parte {majore}" to mean mostly.
e.zh: 意大利人有时会说"in parte majore"来表示"大部分"。

e.en: The Latin phrase "a {majore}" appears in legal arguments.
e.zh: 拉丁短语"a majore"会出现在法律论证中。

majorette.t: n. 女指挥；仪仗队女鼓手

e.en: The {majorette} twirled her baton at the front of the parade.
e.zh: 领队女队员在游行队伍前方旋转着指挥棒。

e.en: She joined the school's {majorette} squad in tenth grade.
e.zh: 她十年级时加入了学校的指挥棒队。

majoritarian.t:
adj. 多数主义的
n. 多数派支持者

e.en: Critics warn that {majoritarian} rule can ignore minority rights.
e.zh: 批评者警告多数主义统治可能忽视少数群体的权利。

e.en: The country adopted a {majoritarian} voting system.
e.zh: 该国采用了多数制选举制度。

e.en: Both parties won slim {majorities} in their respective districts.
e.zh: 两党分别在各自选区赢得了微弱多数。

e.en: Large {majorities} of voters support the new healthcare bill.
e.zh: 绝大多数选民支持这项新的医保法案。

e.en: The {majority} of students prefer online classes now.
e.zh: 现在大多数学生更喜欢上网课。

e.en: His party lost its {majority} in the latest election.
e.zh: 他的政党在最近的选举中失去了多数席位。

e.en: The new update {majorly} improved the app's performance.
e.zh: 这次更新大幅提升了应用的性能。

e.en: I'm {majorly} excited about the trip next week.
e.zh: 我对下周的旅行感到超级兴奋。

majors.t:
n. 专业；少校（复数）
v. 主修

e.en: Engineering and business are the most popular {majors} here.
e.zh: 工程和商科是这里最热门的专业。

e.en: He played in the {majors} for almost a decade.
e.zh: 他在职业棒球大联盟打了将近十年。

make.t:
v. 制作；使得
n. 品牌；型号

e.en: Can you {make} dinner while I finish this report?
e.zh: 我写完这份报告时,你能做晚饭吗?

e.en: What {make} of car does your sister drive?
e.zh: 你姐姐开的是什么牌子的车?

e.en: She rarely wears {make-up} to the office.
e.zh: 她去办公室时很少化妆。

e.en: The {make-up} of the committee changed after the election.
e.zh: 选举后委员会的组成发生了变化。

e.en: The teacher scheduled two {make-ups} for students who missed the test.
e.zh: 老师为缺考的学生安排了两场补考。

e.en: Different national {make-ups} make the team culturally rich.
e.zh: 不同的民族构成让这支团队文化丰富多元。

makeable.t: adj. 可制作的；可达成的

e.en: That three-foot putt is definitely {makeable}.
e.zh: 那个三英尺的推杆肯定能进。

e.en: With another week, the deadline becomes {makeable}.
e.zh: 再多一周时间,这个截止日期就能赶上了。

e.en: The kitchen got a complete {makeover} last summer.
e.zh: 厨房去年夏天彻底翻新了一遍。

e.en: She gave her resume a much-needed {makeover} before applying.
e.zh: 她在投简历前彻底改造了一下自己的履历。

e.en: William {Makepeace} Thackeray wrote the novel "Vanity Fair."
e.zh: 威廉·梅克皮斯·萨克雷写了小说《名利场》。

e.en: The street is named after the historian John {Makepeace}.
e.zh: 这条街以历史学家约翰·梅克皮斯命名。

e.en: This Italian {maker} produces the best espresso machines.
e.zh: 这家意大利制造商生产最好的浓缩咖啡机。

e.en: He's a serious decision-{maker} at the company.
e.zh: 他在公司是个举足轻重的决策者。

e.en: Independent film {makers} dominated this year's festival.
e.zh: 独立电影制作人在今年的电影节上大放异彩。

e.en: Policy {makers} are debating the new tax reform.
e.zh: 政策制定者正在讨论新的税制改革。

makes.t: v. 制作（make 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Her honesty is what {makes} her such a great friend.
e.zh: 她的诚实正是她成为好朋友的原因。

e.en: The dealer sells several different {makes} of trucks.
e.zh: 这家经销商销售多个不同品牌的卡车。

makeshift.t:
adj. 临时凑合的
n. 权宜之计

e.en: They built a {makeshift} shelter using branches and a tarp.
e.zh: 他们用树枝和防水布搭了一个临时的避难所。

e.en: The garage served as a {makeshift} office during lockdown.
e.zh: 封锁期间,车库被临时当作办公室使用。

e.en: She put on light {makeup} before the meeting.
e.zh: 她在开会前化了淡妆。

e.en: The genetic {makeup} of the species is unique.
e.zh: 该物种的基因构成十分独特。

e.en: The trade included a young pitcher as a {makeweight}.
e.zh: 这笔交易里搭了一名年轻投手作为补偿筹码。

e.en: Don't add ingredients just as a {makeweight} for the recipe.
e.zh: 不要只为了凑分量而往食谱里加配料。

e.en: I ordered salmon {maki} and miso soup for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了三文鱼卷和味噌汤。

e.en: The chef rolled the {maki} with practiced precision.
e.zh: 厨师以熟练的手法卷起寿司卷。

e.en: What are you {makin}' for dinner tonight?
e.zh: 你今晚做什么晚饭？

e.en: He's just {makin}' excuses to avoid the meeting.
e.zh: 他只是在找借口逃避会议。

making.t:
n. 制作；形成
v. make 的现在分词

e.en: She is {making} coffee for everyone in the office.
e.zh: 她正在为办公室每个人冲咖啡。

e.en: That young athlete is a champion in the {making}.
e.zh: 那位年轻运动员是未来的冠军。

e.en: He has the {makings} of a great leader.
e.zh: 他具备成为伟大领袖的潜质。

e.en: The fridge has all the {makings} of a salad.
e.zh: 冰箱里有做沙拉所需的全部食材。

e.en: A {mako} shark can swim faster than most fish.
e.zh: 灰鲭鲨的游速比大多数鱼都快。

e.en: Fishermen spotted a {mako} circling near the boat.
e.zh: 渔民发现一条灰鲭鲨在船边盘旋。

mal.t: 前缀. 表示"坏、恶"（如 malfunction）

e.en: The prefix {mal} usually means bad or wrong.
e.zh: 前缀 mal 通常表示坏或错误。

e.en: Words starting with {mal} often carry negative meanings.
e.zh: 以 mal 开头的单词往往带有负面含义。

e.en: She wore a wooden {mala} for her meditation practice.
e.zh: 她戴着木制念珠进行冥想练习。

e.en: He counted each bead on the {mala} carefully.
e.zh: 他仔细数着念珠上的每一颗珠子。

e.en: The patient suffers from chronic {malabsorption} of nutrients.
e.zh: 该病人长期患有营养吸收不良症。

e.en: Doctors tested her for {malabsorption} after the weight loss.
e.zh: 她体重下降后医生为她检查吸收不良。

e.en: She bought a polished {malachite} pendant at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一枚抛光的孔雀石吊坠。

e.en: The vase is carved from deep green {malachite}.
e.zh: 这只花瓶由深绿色的孔雀石雕成。

e.en: Therapy helps replace {maladaptive} habits with healthier ones.
e.zh: 治疗帮助用健康习惯取代不良适应行为。

e.en: Avoidance is often a {maladaptive} response to anxiety.
e.zh: 回避往往是面对焦虑的不良适应反应。

maladies.t: n. malady 的复数，疾病、弊病

e.en: Modern medicine has cured many ancient {maladies}.
e.zh: 现代医学治愈了许多古老的疾病。

e.en: Loneliness is one of the {maladies} of city life.
e.zh: 孤独是都市生活的弊病之一。

maladjusted.t: adj. 失调的；适应不良的

e.en: The {maladjusted} student struggled to make friends at school.
e.zh: 那个适应不良的学生在学校很难交到朋友。

e.en: He felt {maladjusted} after moving to a new country.
e.zh: 搬到新国家后他感到难以适应。

e.en: Her social {maladjustment} improved after counseling sessions.
e.zh: 接受咨询后她的社交适应不良得到改善。

e.en: Childhood trauma can lead to lasting {maladjustment}.
e.zh: 童年创伤可能导致长期的适应不良。

maladministration.t: n. 管理不善；行政失当

e.en: The mayor was accused of {maladministration} of public funds.
e.zh: 市长被指控滥用公共资金。

e.en: Years of {maladministration} left the agency in chaos.
e.zh: 多年的管理不善让该机构陷入混乱。

e.en: His {maladroit} apology only made the situation worse.
e.zh: 他笨拙的道歉只让情况变得更糟。

e.en: The minister gave a {maladroit} response to reporters.
e.zh: 部长对记者做出了笨拙的回应。

e.en: Loneliness has become a modern {malady} among teenagers.
e.zh: 孤独已成为青少年中的现代通病。

e.en: Doctors could not identify the strange {malady}.
e.zh: 医生们无法确诊这种奇怪的疾病。

malaga.t: n. 马拉加（西班牙港市）

e.en: We spent the weekend on the beaches of {Malaga}.
e.zh: 我们在马拉加的海滩上度过了周末。

e.en: He poured a glass of sweet {Malaga} wine.
e.zh: 他倒了一杯甜美的马拉加葡萄酒。

malagasy.t:
adj. 马达加斯加的
n. 马尔加什语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Malagasy} after living there for years.
e.zh: 在那里生活多年后她能说流利的马尔加什语。

e.en: {Malagasy} culture blends African and Asian influences beautifully.
e.zh: 马达加斯加文化优美地融合了非洲与亚洲元素。

e.en: She topped the dessert with fresh {malai} and pistachios.
e.zh: 她在甜点上铺了新鲜奶皮和开心果。

e.en: The chef made creamy {malai} kofta for dinner.
e.zh: 厨师晚餐做了奶香十足的马来咖喱丸子。

malaise.t: n. 身体不适；社会颓势

e.en: A general {malaise} hung over the office after layoffs.
e.zh: 裁员后办公室弥漫着一种普遍的低迷情绪。

e.en: She felt a strange {malaise} all weekend long.
e.zh: 整个周末她都感到一种莫名的不适。

e.en: Their fluffy {malamute} loves running through the snow.
e.zh: 他们毛茸茸的阿拉斯加雪橇犬喜欢在雪地里奔跑。

e.en: A {malamute} needs plenty of exercise and cold weather.
e.zh: 阿拉斯加雪橇犬需要大量运动和寒冷天气。

e.en: She boiled {malanga} root for a traditional Caribbean stew.
e.zh: 她煮了芋头根做传统的加勒比炖菜。

e.en: The market sells fresh {malanga} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 市场每周六早上都卖新鲜的芋头。

e.en: His funny {malapropism} had everyone laughing during the speech.
e.zh: 他演讲中滑稽的用词错误把大家逗笑了。

e.en: "Dance a flamingo" is a classic {malapropism}.
e.zh: "跳一支火烈鸟舞"是经典的用词错误。

e.en: Travelers take pills to prevent {malaria} in tropical regions.
e.zh: 旅行者在热带地区服药预防疟疾。

e.en: {Malaria} kills hundreds of thousands of people each year.
e.zh: 疟疾每年夺去数十万人的生命。

e.en: The team studies {malarial} parasites in their lab.
e.zh: 该团队在实验室里研究疟原虫。

e.en: Mosquitoes thrive in the {malarial} swamps of the region.
e.zh: 蚊子在该地区的疟疾沼泽中大量繁殖。

e.en: Researchers compared different {malarias} found across the continent.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了该大陆上发现的不同疟疾类型。

e.en: Several drug-resistant {malarias} have emerged in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来出现了多种耐药性疟疾。

e.en: Don't believe his stories — it's all {malarkey}.
e.zh: 别信他的故事，全是胡扯。

e.en: The politician dismissed the rumors as pure {malarkey}.
e.zh: 那位政客把传言斥为彻头彻尾的胡说。

e.en: Farmers sprayed {malathion} to protect crops from pests.
e.zh: 农民喷洒马拉硫磷以保护作物免受害虫侵害。

e.en: The city used {malathion} to control mosquito populations.
e.zh: 市政府使用马拉硫磷来控制蚊虫数量。

e.en: She volunteered at a school in northern {Malawi}.
e.zh: 她在马拉维北部的一所学校做志愿者。

e.en: Lake {Malawi} is famous for its colorful tropical fish.
e.zh: 马拉维湖以多彩的热带鱼闻名。

malawian.t:
adj. 马拉维的
n. 马拉维人

e.en: The {Malawian} delegation arrived for the climate summit yesterday.
e.zh: 马拉维代表团昨天抵达参加气候峰会。

e.en: He cooked a traditional {Malawian} dish for his guests.
e.zh: 他为客人做了一道传统的马拉维菜。

malay.t:
adj. 马来的
n. 马来人；马来语

e.en: She is learning {Malay} for her trip to Kuala Lumpur.
e.zh: 她正在学马来语，为去吉隆坡旅行做准备。

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Malay} curries and rice dishes.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的马来咖喱和米饭。

e.en: British {Malaya} declared independence in 1957.
e.zh: 英属马来亚于 1957 年宣布独立。

e.en: Her grandfather worked on rubber plantations in {Malaya}.
e.zh: 她的祖父曾在马来亚的橡胶园工作。

malayan.t:
adj. 马来亚的
n. 马来人

e.en: The {Malayan} tiger is critically endangered in the wild.
e.zh: 马来亚虎在野外已极度濒危。

e.en: He studied {Malayan} history at the university.
e.zh: 他在大学学习马来亚历史。

e.en: We flew to {Malaysia} for a two-week vacation.
e.zh: 我们飞往马来西亚度了两周假。

e.en: {Malaysia} is famous for its diverse food and culture.
e.zh: 马来西亚以多元的美食和文化闻名。

malaysian.t:
adj. 马来西亚的
n. 马来西亚人

e.en: The {Malaysian} restaurant downtown serves amazing nasi lemak.
e.zh: 市中心那家马来西亚餐厅的椰浆饭非常好吃。

e.en: My new colleague is {Malaysian} and speaks four languages.
e.zh: 我的新同事是马来西亚人，会说四种语言。

malcontent.t:
n. 不满分子
adj. 不满的

e.en: The {malcontent} employee complained about every new policy.
e.zh: 那位心怀不满的员工抱怨每一项新政策。

e.en: A few {malcontents} tried to disrupt the meeting.
e.zh: 几个不满分子试图扰乱会议。

e.en: She grew up in {Malden}, just outside Boston.
e.zh: 她在波士顿郊外的莫尔登长大。

e.en: The train to {Malden} runs every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 开往莫尔登的列车每十五分钟一班。

maldistribution.t: n. 分布不均；分配失衡

e.en: The report highlights the {maldistribution} of medical resources nationwide.
e.zh: 报告强调了全国医疗资源分配不均的问题。

e.en: Wealth {maldistribution} remains a serious challenge for the economy.
e.zh: 财富分配不均仍是经济面临的严峻挑战。

e.en: They booked a luxury resort in the {Maldives} for their honeymoon.
e.zh: 他们在马尔代夫预订了一家豪华度假村度蜜月。

e.en: Rising sea levels threaten the future of the {Maldives}.
e.zh: 海平面上升威胁着马尔代夫的未来。

e.en: Sprinkle some {Maldon} salt over the steak before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在牛排上撒一些马尔顿海盐。

e.en: Chefs love {Maldon} sea salt for its crunchy flakes.
e.zh: 厨师们喜爱马尔顿海盐酥脆的片状结晶。

male.t:
adj. 男性的；雄性的
n. 男子；雄性

e.en: The clinic is hiring a {male} nurse for night shifts.
e.zh: 这家诊所正在招聘一名男护士上夜班。

e.en: Only the {male} peacock has those bright tail feathers.
e.zh: 只有雄孔雀才有那些艳丽的尾羽。

e.en: The witch hurled a {malediction} at the foolish prince.
e.zh: 女巫向愚蠢的王子发出了一句诅咒。

e.en: He muttered a {malediction} under his breath.
e.zh: 他低声咒骂了一句。

e.en: The judge sentenced the {malefactor} to ten years in prison.
e.zh: 法官判处这名罪犯十年监禁。

e.en: Police are still searching for the {malefactor} behind the scam.
e.zh: 警方仍在搜寻这起骗局背后的作恶者。

e.en: The film features a {maleficent} sorceress as its villain.
e.zh: 这部电影以一位邪恶的女巫为反派。

e.en: His {maleficent} grin made the children back away.
e.zh: 他邪恶的笑容让孩子们直往后退。

e.en: The novel explores ideas of {maleness} in modern society.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了现代社会中男性气质的概念。

e.en: His {maleness} was tied to old-fashioned ideals of strength.
e.zh: 他的男性身份与传统的力量观念紧密相连。

males.t: n. male 的复数，男性；雄性

e.en: Adult {males} of this species grow up to two meters.
e.zh: 这种动物的成年雄性可长到两米高。

e.en: The survey included 500 {males} aged 18 to 35.
e.zh: 这项调查包括了 500 名 18 至 35 岁的男性。

e.en: There was a quiet {malevolence} in the stranger's eyes.
e.zh: 陌生人眼中流露出一种平静的恶意。

e.en: The villain's {malevolence} drives the whole plot forward.
e.zh: 反派的恶意推动着整个剧情发展。

e.en: The character has a {malevolent} smile that unsettles viewers.
e.zh: 这个角色带着令人不安的恶意微笑。

e.en: Hackers used the software for {malevolent} purposes.
e.zh: 黑客将这款软件用于恶意目的。

e.en: The cat stared {malevolently} at the new puppy.
e.zh: 那只猫恶狠狠地盯着新来的小狗。

e.en: He grinned {malevolently} as he announced the bad news.
e.zh: 他在宣布坏消息时阴险地笑了。

malfeasance.t: n. (尤指公职人员) 渎职行为

e.en: The CEO was charged with {malfeasance} after the audit.
e.zh: 审计后首席执行官被指控渎职。

e.en: Public officials face strict penalties for any {malfeasance}.
e.zh: 公职人员任何渎职行为都将受到严惩。

e.en: Doctors detected a heart {malformation} during the prenatal scan.
e.zh: 医生在产前检查中发现了心脏畸形。

e.en: The {malformation} can be corrected with early surgery.
e.zh: 这种畸形可以通过早期手术矫正。

malformed.t: adj. 畸形的；格式错误的

e.en: The parser rejected the {malformed} JSON request from the client.
e.zh: 解析器拒绝了客户端发来的格式错误的 JSON 请求。

e.en: Doctors discovered a {malformed} valve during the routine heart scan.
e.zh: 医生在常规心脏扫描中发现了一个畸形的瓣膜。

malfunction.t:
n. 故障
v. 出故障

e.en: A software {malfunction} grounded hundreds of flights this morning.
e.zh: 一次软件故障导致今早数百架航班停飞。

e.en: The printer began to {malfunction} right before the deadline.
e.zh: 打印机在截止时间前突然出故障了。

e.en: The airbag {malfunctioned} and failed to deploy during the crash.
e.zh: 安全气囊出现故障,在撞车时没有弹出。

e.en: Her smartwatch {malfunctioned} after the firmware update last night.
e.zh: 她的智能手表在昨晚固件更新后出了故障。

malfunctioning.t:
adj. 出故障的
v. 发生故障

e.en: Engineers replaced the {malfunctioning} sensor on the assembly line.
e.zh: 工程师更换了流水线上出故障的传感器。

e.en: A {malfunctioning} traffic light caused a long jam downtown.
e.zh: 一个失灵的红绿灯造成市中心严重堵车。

malfunctions.t:
n. 故障（复数）
v. 出故障

e.en: The app logs all hardware {malfunctions} for later diagnosis.
e.zh: 该应用会记录所有硬件故障以便日后诊断。

e.en: Sometimes the heater {malfunctions} when the temperature drops below freezing.
e.zh: 气温降到零下时,这台暖气有时会出故障。

e.en: {Mali} is a landlocked country in West Africa with rich musical traditions.
e.zh: 马里是西非的一个内陆国,有着丰富的音乐传统。

e.en: She spent two years teaching English in {Mali}.
e.zh: 她在马里教了两年英语。

malian.t:
adj. 马里的
n. 马里人

e.en: The {Malian} singer won an international Grammy last year.
e.zh: 那位马里歌手去年赢得了一项国际格莱美奖。

e.en: He studied traditional {Malian} music in Bamako for a summer.
e.zh: 他整个夏天都在巴马科学习传统的马里音乐。

malibu.t: n. 马里布（美国加州海滨城市）

e.en: They rented a beach house in {Malibu} for the summer.
e.zh: 他们在马里布租了一栋海滨别墅过暑假。

e.en: Wildfires forced thousands of {Malibu} residents to evacuate overnight.
e.zh: 野火迫使数千名马里布居民连夜撤离。

e.en: The judge said the act was committed without {malice}.
e.zh: 法官表示该行为并非出于恶意。

e.en: There was no {malice} in her teasing, only affection.
e.zh: 她的玩笑没有恶意,只是出于喜爱。

e.en: The old letters revealed the petty {malices} of the court.
e.zh: 那些旧信件揭露了宫廷里种种细小的恶意。

e.en: She forgave the small {malices} of her former coworkers.
e.zh: 她原谅了前同事们那些小小的恶意。

malicious.t: adj. 恶意的；怀恶意的（如恶意软件）

e.en: The antivirus blocked a {malicious} script hidden in the email.
e.zh: 杀毒软件拦截了藏在邮件里的恶意脚本。

e.en: He spread {malicious} rumors about his rival online.
e.zh: 他在网上散布有关对手的恶毒谣言。

e.en: Someone {maliciously} edited the Wikipedia article overnight.
e.zh: 有人在夜里恶意篡改了那篇维基百科条目。

e.en: She smiled {maliciously} after winning the argument.
e.zh: 赢了那场争论后,她不怀好意地笑了笑。

e.en: There was a hint of {maliciousness} in his tone.
e.zh: 他的语气里带着一丝恶意。

e.en: The judge condemned the sheer {maliciousness} of the attack.
e.zh: 法官谴责了这次袭击纯粹的恶意。

malign.t:
v. 诽谤，中伤
adj. 有害的

e.en: Critics often {malign} the new policy without reading it.
e.zh: 批评者常常没读过新政策就对它大肆诋毁。

e.en: The company suffered from a {malign} online smear campaign.
e.zh: 公司遭受了一场恶意的网络抹黑行动。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed a {malignancy} in the upper lung.
e.zh: 活检确认了上肺部存在恶性肿瘤。

e.en: Early screening greatly reduces the risk of undetected {malignancy}.
e.zh: 早期筛查能大大降低未发现恶性肿瘤的风险。

malignant.t: adj. 恶性的（肿瘤）；恶毒的

e.en: Doctors removed the {malignant} tumor during a four-hour surgery.
e.zh: 医生在四小时的手术中切除了恶性肿瘤。

e.en: He gave her a {malignant} stare across the room.
e.zh: 他从房间另一头投来恶毒的一瞥。

maligned.t:
v. 诽谤（过去式）
adj. 遭诋毁的

e.en: Pigeons are often {maligned}, but they're surprisingly intelligent birds.
e.zh: 鸽子常被人诟病,其实它们是相当聪明的鸟类。

e.en: The much-{maligned} sequel turned out to be a quiet hit.
e.zh: 那部备受批评的续集后来其实悄悄走红了。

e.en: He'd rather {malinger} at home than face Monday's meeting.
e.zh: 比起面对周一的会议,他宁可装病在家。

e.en: Some employees {malinger} when deadlines pile up.
e.zh: 有些员工在截止日期堆积时会装病请假。

e.en: His manager suspected he was a {malingerer} taking too many sick days.
e.zh: 他的经理怀疑他是个装病请太多病假的人。

e.en: The doctor quickly spotted the {malingerer} in the waiting room.
e.zh: 医生很快就认出了候诊室里那个装病的人。

e.en: The old farmer called his black cat {Malkin}.
e.zh: 那位老农管他的黑猫叫马尔金。

e.en: In folklore, a {malkin} often refers to an untidy woman or cat.
e.zh: 在民间传说中,malkin 常指邋遢的女人或猫。

e.en: We grabbed lunch at the food court in the {mall}.
e.zh: 我们在商场的美食广场吃了午饭。

e.en: Many old shopping {mall} buildings are being converted into apartments.
e.zh: 很多老旧的购物中心建筑正在被改造成公寓。

e.en: A {mallard} drake glided across the pond at sunset.
e.zh: 一只绿头公鸭在日落时滑过池塘。

e.en: The kids tossed bread crumbs to a hungry {mallard}.
e.zh: 孩子们把面包屑扔给一只饥饿的绿头鸭。

e.en: Metallurgists compare the {malleabilities} of different copper alloys.
e.zh: 冶金学家会比较不同铜合金的可锻性。

e.en: The textbook lists the {malleabilities} of common industrial metals.
e.zh: 教科书列出了常见工业金属的延展性数据。

e.en: Gold is prized for its color and remarkable {malleability}.
e.zh: 黄金因其色泽和极佳的延展性而备受推崇。

e.en: The {malleability} of children's habits makes early education crucial.
e.zh: 儿童习惯的可塑性使得早期教育至关重要。

malleable.t: adj. 可塑的；易受影响的

e.en: Copper is soft and {malleable} enough to shape by hand.
e.zh: 铜很软,可塑性强到可以用手塑形。

e.en: Young minds are highly {malleable} and absorb language quickly.
e.zh: 幼儿的头脑可塑性极强,能很快吸收语言。

e.en: She fractured her lateral {malleolus} skiing last weekend.
e.zh: 她上周末滑雪时摔断了外踝骨。

e.en: The doctor pressed gently on the swollen {malleolus}.
e.zh: 医生轻轻按压肿胀的踝骨。

e.en: He tapped the chisel with a wooden {mallet}.
e.zh: 他用一把木槌轻敲凿子。

e.en: The croquet {mallet} sent the ball through the hoop.
e.zh: 槌球棒把球击穿过铁环。

e.en: Sound travels from the eardrum through the tiny {malleus} bone.
e.zh: 声音从鼓膜通过微小的锤骨向内传递。

e.en: The {malleus} is one of three bones in the middle ear.
e.zh: 锤骨是中耳三块听小骨之一。

malling.t:
n. 逛商场
v. 在商场闲逛

e.en: Teenagers spent every Saturday {malling} with their friends.
e.zh: 青少年们每个星期六都和朋友一起逛商场。

e.en: The town of {Malling} sits quietly in the Kent countryside.
e.zh: 莫林镇静静地坐落在肯特郡的乡间。

e.en: We're flying to {Mallorca} for a week of beach time.
e.zh: 我们要飞去马略卡岛度一周海滩假期。

e.en: {Mallorca} is the largest of Spain's Balearic Islands.
e.zh: 马略卡岛是西班牙巴利阿里群岛中最大的岛。

e.en: Pink {mallow} flowers lined the country road in summer.
e.zh: 夏天乡间小路两旁开满了粉色的锦葵花。

e.en: Marshmallow was originally made from the root of the {mallow} plant.
e.zh: 棉花糖最初是用锦葵植物的根制作的。

e.en: Many American {malls} have closed since online shopping took over.
e.zh: 自从网购兴起,很多美国购物中心都关门了。

e.en: The city's largest {malls} stay open until ten on weekends.
e.zh: 该市最大的几家购物中心周末营业到晚上十点。

malmesbury.t: n. 马姆斯伯里（英国地名）

e.en: {Malmesbury} is a historic market town in Wiltshire, England.
e.zh: 马姆斯伯里是英格兰威尔特郡的一座历史悠久的集镇。

e.en: We visited the famous abbey ruins in {Malmesbury} last spring.
e.zh: 我们去年春天参观了马姆斯伯里著名的修道院遗址。

e.en: The bridge connects Copenhagen to {Malmo} in southern Sweden.
e.zh: 那座大桥连接哥本哈根和瑞典南部的马尔默。

e.en: {Malmo} has become a hub for Scandinavian tech startups.
e.zh: 马尔默已成为北欧科技创业公司的中心。

e.en: Aid workers found dozens of {malnourished} children in the camp.
e.zh: 救援人员在难民营里发现了数十名营养不良的儿童。

e.en: The rescued puppy was {malnourished} but quickly regained weight.
e.zh: 被救的小狗营养不良,但很快就恢复了体重。

e.en: Severe {malnutrition} still affects millions of children worldwide.
e.zh: 严重的营养不良仍困扰着全球数百万儿童。

e.en: The clinic screens new patients for signs of {malnutrition}.
e.zh: 诊所会为新病人筛查营养不良的迹象。

e.en: A faint {malodor} drifted from the abandoned refrigerator.
e.zh: 一股淡淡的恶臭从那台废弃的冰箱里飘出来。

e.en: The inspector noted a strong {malodor} in the basement.
e.zh: 检查员注意到地下室里有股浓烈的恶臭。

e.en: He tossed the {malodorous} sneakers into the laundry bin.
e.zh: 他把那双臭气熏天的运动鞋扔进了洗衣篮。

e.en: The alley behind the restaurant was dark and {malodorous}.
e.zh: 餐馆后面的小巷又黑又臭。

e.en: The surgeon faced a {malpractice} lawsuit after the failed operation.
e.zh: 那位外科医生在手术失败后被起诉医疗事故。

e.en: Hospitals carry insurance to cover potential {malpractice} claims.
e.zh: 医院会购买保险以应对可能的医疗失当索赔。

manatee.t: n. 海牛（海洋哺乳动物）

e.en: A gentle {manatee} drifted slowly past our kayak.
e.zh: 一只温顺的海牛缓缓从我们的皮划艇旁游过。

e.en: Florida's {manatee} population has finally started to recover.
e.zh: 佛罗里达的海牛数量终于开始回升。

e.en: {Manaus} sits deep in the Brazilian Amazon rainforest.
e.zh: 马瑙斯位于巴西亚马逊雨林深处。

e.en: We boarded a riverboat in {Manaus} for the jungle tour.
e.zh: 我们在马瑙斯登上一艘河船,开始丛林之旅。

e.en: You can tell he's a proper {Manc} from his accent.
e.zh: 从口音就能听出他是个地道的曼彻斯特人。

e.en: Most of his mates are {Manc} lads from school.
e.zh: 他大多数朋友都是学校里的曼彻斯特小伙子。

e.en: We took the ferry across La {Manche} to Calais.
e.zh: 我们乘渡轮横渡英吉利海峡到加来。

e.en: Our cottage is in the {Manche} department of Normandy.
e.zh: 我们的小屋位于诺曼底的芒什省。

manchester.t: n. 曼彻斯特（英国城市）

e.en: She moved to {Manchester} for a job in tech.
e.zh: 她为了一份科技行业的工作搬到了曼彻斯特。

e.en: {Manchester} has one of England's liveliest music scenes.
e.zh: 曼彻斯特拥有英格兰最活跃的音乐圈之一。

manchu.t:
n. 满族；满语
adj. 满族的

e.en: The {Manchu} rulers founded China's last imperial dynasty.
e.zh: 满族统治者建立了中国最后一个封建王朝。

e.en: Few people today still speak the {Manchu} language fluently.
e.zh: 如今能流利讲满语的人已经很少了。

manchuria.t: n. 满洲（中国东北旧称）

e.en: Japan invaded {Manchuria} in 1931, triggering international outrage.
e.zh: 日本于1931年入侵满洲,引发了国际社会的强烈愤慨。

e.en: Winters in {Manchuria} can be brutally cold and dry.
e.zh: 满洲的冬天可能极其寒冷干燥。

manchurian.t:
adj. 满洲的
n. 满洲人

e.en: He ordered chicken {Manchurian} from the Indo-Chinese menu.
e.zh: 他从印中菜单上点了一份满洲鸡。

e.en: The {Manchurian} crane is a symbol of longevity in Asia.
e.zh: 丹顶鹤在亚洲是长寿的象征。

mancunian.t:
n. 曼彻斯特人
adj. 曼彻斯特的

e.en: Her thick {Mancunian} accent gave away where she grew up.
e.zh: 她浓重的曼彻斯特口音暴露了她成长的地方。

e.en: He's a proud {Mancunian} who never misses a United match.
e.zh: 他是个骄傲的曼彻斯特人,曼联的比赛一场不落。

e.en: The monks spent days creating an intricate sand {mandala}.
e.zh: 僧侣们花了好几天制作一幅精致的沙制曼陀罗。

e.en: She finds coloring a {mandala} deeply relaxing after work.
e.zh: 她觉得下班后给曼陀罗图案上色非常放松。

e.en: {Mandalay} is the cultural heart of northern Myanmar.
e.zh: 曼德勒是缅甸北部的文化中心。

e.en: We took an overnight train from Yangon to {Mandalay}.
e.zh: 我们坐夜班火车从仰光到了曼德勒。

mandamus.t: n. 执行令（上级法院命令）

e.en: The court issued a writ of {mandamus} compelling the agency to act.
e.zh: 法院签发了一纸训令,强制该机构采取行动。

e.en: Her lawyer filed for {mandamus} to force the official's response.
e.zh: 她的律师申请了强制令,要求该官员作出回应。

mandarin.t:
n. 普通话；中国官员
n. 柑橘

e.en: She's been studying {Mandarin} for three years now.
e.zh: 她已经学普通话三年了。

e.en: He peeled a sweet {mandarin} and shared it with me.
e.zh: 他剥了一个甜橘子分给我吃。

mandate.t:
n. 授权；任期
v. 强制规定

e.en: Voters gave the new president a clear {mandate} for reform.
e.zh: 选民给予新总统明确的改革授权。

e.en: The law will {mandate} stricter safety checks at airports.
e.zh: 该法律将强制要求机场进行更严格的安全检查。

mandated.t:
adj. 强制规定的
v. 授权（过去式）

e.en: The company {mandated} masks for all office visitors.
e.zh: 公司规定所有访客必须戴口罩。

e.en: Annual training is {mandated} by federal regulations.
e.zh: 联邦法规规定必须进行年度培训。

mandates.t:
n. 授权；命令（复数）
v. 强制规定

e.en: The new policy {mandates} two-factor authentication for everyone.
e.zh: 新政策要求每个人都使用双因素认证。

e.en: The governor faces several conflicting public health {mandates}.
e.zh: 州长面临几项相互冲突的公共卫生指令。

e.en: Wearing a helmet is {mandatory} on the construction site.
e.zh: 在工地上必须佩戴安全帽。

e.en: The training session is {mandatory} for all new employees.
e.zh: 该培训对所有新员工都是强制性的。

e.en: Nelson {Mandela} spent 27 years in prison before becoming president.
e.zh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉在成为总统前坐了二十七年牢。

e.en: Many streets around the world are named after {Mandela}.
e.zh: 世界上许多街道都以曼德拉命名。

mandeville.t: n. 曼德维尔（地名/姓氏）

e.en: Bernard {Mandeville} wrote a famous fable about bees and society.
e.zh: 伯纳德·曼德维尔写了一则关于蜜蜂与社会的著名寓言。

e.en: We drove through {Mandeville} on our way to New Orleans.
e.zh: 我们去新奥尔良的路上经过了曼德维尔。

e.en: The X-ray showed a hairline fracture in his {mandible}.
e.zh: X 光显示他的下颌骨有一道细微骨折。

e.en: An ant uses its {mandible} to carry food back to the nest.
e.zh: 蚂蚁用它的下颚把食物搬回巢穴。

e.en: The dentist examined the patient's {mandibular} joint for clicking.
e.zh: 牙医检查了病人下颌关节是否有弹响。

e.en: Beetles have powerful {mandibular} muscles for crushing seeds.
e.zh: 甲虫拥有强劲的下颚肌肉来咬碎种子。

e.en: We removed our shoes before entering the {mandir}.
e.zh: 我们进入印度教神庙前先脱了鞋。

e.en: The new {mandir} in town hosts daily evening prayers.
e.zh: 镇上新建的印度神庙每晚都举行祈祷。

e.en: He played a cheerful tune on his {mandolin}.
e.zh: 他用曼陀林弹奏了一首欢快的曲子。

e.en: She bought a vintage {mandolin} at the antique shop.
e.zh: 她在古董店买了一把老式曼陀林。

mandoline.t: n. 蔬菜切片器；曼陀林琴

e.en: Use a {mandoline} to slice the potatoes paper-thin.
e.zh: 用切片器把土豆切成纸一样薄。

e.en: Be careful with the {mandoline} — the blade is razor sharp.
e.zh: 使用切片器时要小心,刀刃极其锋利。

e.en: In the novel, the wizard brewed a potion from {mandrake} root.
e.zh: 小说里巫师用曼德拉草根熬制了一种药水。

e.en: Ancient herbalists believed {mandrake} could cure infertility.
e.zh: 古代草药师相信曼德拉草能治不孕。

e.en: The machinist fitted the part onto a steel {mandrel} for shaping.
e.zh: 机械师把零件装到钢制心轴上以便成型。

e.en: Wind the copper wire tightly around the {mandrel}.
e.zh: 把铜线紧紧缠绕在心轴上。

e.en: The lion shook his thick golden {mane} in the sunlight.
e.zh: 狮子在阳光下抖动着浓密的金色鬃毛。

e.en: She tossed her long {mane} of curly hair behind her shoulder.
e.zh: 她把一头长长的卷发甩到肩后。

e.en: {Manet} shocked Parisian society with his painting Olympia.
e.zh: 马奈的画作《奥林匹亚》震惊了巴黎社会。

e.en: The museum just acquired an early sketch by {Manet}.
e.zh: 博物馆刚购入一幅马奈的早期素描。

maneuver.t:
n. 策略；机动动作
v. 操纵；设法

e.en: The pilot performed a tricky landing {maneuver} in heavy wind.
e.zh: 飞行员在大风中完成了一个高难度着陆动作。

e.en: It's hard to {maneuver} a big SUV in narrow alleys.
e.zh: 在窄巷子里很难操控大型 SUV。

e.en: This compact car offers excellent {maneuverability} in city traffic.
e.zh: 这款小型车在城市交通中非常灵活好开。

e.en: The drone's small size gives it amazing {maneuverability} indoors.
e.zh: 无人机小巧的体积让它在室内极其灵活。

e.en: Modern fighter jets are remarkably {maneuverable} at low altitudes.
e.zh: 现代战斗机在低空具有极高的机动性。

e.en: Folding scooters are lightweight and easily {maneuverable} on sidewalks.
e.zh: 折叠滑板车轻便,在人行道上很灵活。

e.en: She skillfully {maneuvered} the truck into the tight parking spot.
e.zh: 她熟练地把卡车停进了狭窄的车位。

e.en: He {maneuvered} his way to the top of the company.
e.zh: 他一路精明运作,爬到了公司高层。

maneuvering.t:
n. 策略运作
v. 操纵（进行时）

e.en: There's been a lot of political {maneuvering} ahead of the vote.
e.zh: 投票前出现了大量政治博弈。

e.en: She was {maneuvering} her bike through the crowded market.
e.zh: 她正骑着自行车在拥挤的市场中穿行。

maneuvers.t:
n. 军事演习；策略
v. 操纵

e.en: The army conducted joint {maneuvers} near the eastern border.
e.zh: 军队在东部边境附近进行联合演习。

e.en: His clever legal {maneuvers} delayed the trial for months.
e.zh: 他巧妙的法律手段让审判推迟了好几个月。

e.en: He made a {manful} effort to finish the marathon despite the injury.
e.zh: 尽管受伤,他仍坚毅地努力完成了马拉松。

e.en: She gave a {manful} defense of her team's controversial decision.
e.zh: 她坚定有力地为团队的争议决定辩护。

e.en: The goalkeeper {manfully} blocked shot after shot in the rain.
e.zh: 守门员在雨中坚毅地一次次挡出射门。

e.en: He fought {manfully} against the illness for over a year.
e.zh: 他坚强地与疾病抗争了一年多。

e.en: My daughter spends her allowance on Japanese {manga} every month.
e.zh: 我女儿每个月都把零花钱花在日本漫画上。

e.en: This {manga} series has been adapted into a hit anime.
e.zh: 这部漫画已被改编成热门动画。

e.en: Steel makers add {manganese} to improve hardness and durability.
e.zh: 炼钢厂加入锰以提高硬度和耐久性。

e.en: Brazil exports large quantities of {manganese} ore each year.
e.zh: 巴西每年出口大量锰矿石。

e.en: The stray dog was suffering from a bad case of {mange}.
e.zh: 那只流浪狗患上了严重的疥癣。

e.en: Foxes with {mange} often lose patches of their fur.
e.zh: 患疥癣的狐狸常常会大片掉毛。

e.en: The Christmas story tells of a baby laid in a {manger}.
e.zh: 圣诞故事讲述了婴儿被放在马槽里的情景。

e.en: The farmer filled the {manger} with fresh hay for the cows.
e.zh: 农夫往饲料槽里装满了新鲜的干草给牛吃。

mangle.t:
v. 撕裂；碾坏；糟蹋
n. 轧布机

e.en: Please don't {mangle} my name when you introduce me.
e.zh: 介绍我时请别把我的名字念错。

e.en: Cheap subtitles often {mangle} the meaning of the original lines.
e.zh: 劣质字幕常常会扭曲原台词的意思。

mangled.t:
adj. 被毁坏的
v. 撕烂（过去式）

e.en: Rescuers pulled the driver from the {mangled} wreck.
e.zh: 救援人员把司机从扭曲变形的车残骸中拉出来。

e.en: The translator badly {mangled} the speaker's joke.
e.zh: 翻译把演讲者的笑话译得乱七八糟。

mangles.t: v. 撕裂；糟蹋（第三人称）

e.en: My phone's autocorrect always {mangles} my friend's last name.
e.zh: 我手机的自动更正总是把朋友的姓改错。

e.en: That cheap blender {mangles} the fruit instead of blending it.
e.zh: 那台廉价搅拌机把水果搅烂而不是打匀。

e.en: Stop {mangling} the lyrics — you're ruining my favorite song!
e.zh: 别再瞎唱歌词了,你把我最爱的歌都毁了!

e.en: The compiler does name {mangling} to support function overloading.
e.zh: 编译器进行名称改编以支持函数重载。

e.en: I love a ripe {mango} sliced over vanilla ice cream.
e.zh: 我喜欢把成熟的芒果片放在香草冰淇淋上。

e.en: Thailand exports tons of fresh {mango} to China every summer.
e.zh: 泰国每年夏天向中国出口大量新鲜芒果。

e.en: The market was selling sweet Alphonso {mangoes} from India.
e.zh: 市场上卖着来自印度的甜阿方索芒果。

e.en: We picked ripe {mangoes} straight from the tree in the backyard.
e.zh: 我们从后院的树上直接摘下了熟透的芒果。

e.en: The {mangosteen} has soft white flesh inside a thick purple rind.
e.zh: 山竹厚厚的紫色外皮里包着柔软洁白的果肉。

e.en: Many tourists try fresh {mangosteen} for the first time in Bangkok.
e.zh: 许多游客第一次在曼谷尝到新鲜的山竹。

e.en: We kayaked through a dense {mangrove} forest in Florida.
e.zh: 我们在佛罗里达划皮艇穿过茂密的红树林。

e.en: {Mangrove} roots protect coastlines from storm erosion.
e.zh: 红树林的根能保护海岸免受风暴侵蚀。

mangy.t: adj. 肮脏破旧的；患疥癣的

e.en: A {mangy} old dog wandered into our campsite looking for food.
e.zh: 一只毛发脏乱的老狗走进我们营地找吃的。

e.en: He wore a {mangy} coat that had clearly seen better days.
e.zh: 他穿着一件破旧不堪、显然早已过时的外套。

manhandle.t: v. 粗暴对待；用人力搬运

e.en: Don't {manhandle} the antique vase — it's extremely fragile.
e.zh: 别粗暴地搬动那只古董花瓶,它非常易碎。

e.en: Security guards tried to {manhandle} the protester out of the room.
e.zh: 保安试图粗暴地把抗议者拖出房间。

e.en: We took the ferry across the river to {Manhattan} for dinner.
e.zh: 我们坐渡轮过河到曼哈顿吃晚饭。

e.en: He ordered a classic {Manhattan} with rye whiskey at the bar.
e.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯用黑麦威士忌调的经典曼哈顿鸡尾酒。

manhole.t: n. 检修孔；下水道入口

e.en: Steam was rising from the open {manhole} on the street.
e.zh: 街上敞开的井盖口冒着蒸汽。

e.en: Workers replaced the rusted {manhole} cover this morning.
e.zh: 工人今天上午更换了那块生锈的井盖。

e.en: The ceremony marks a boy's transition into {manhood}.
e.zh: 这一仪式标志着男孩步入成年。

e.en: He spent his early {manhood} traveling around South America.
e.zh: 他在成年初期到南美各地游历。

e.en: Police launched a nationwide {manhunt} for the escaped convict.
e.zh: 警方对逃犯展开了全国范围的追捕。

e.en: The {manhunt} ended peacefully when the suspect surrendered.
e.zh: 嫌犯投降后,这场追捕和平结束。

mania.t:
n. 狂热；热衷
n. 躁狂症

e.en: There's a real {mania} for sourdough baking on social media.
e.zh: 社交媒体上掀起了一股酸面包烘焙热潮。

e.en: During a {mania} episode, patients may not sleep for days.
e.zh: 躁狂发作期间,患者可能会数日不睡。
