e.en: Some {maniac} was driving 100 mph down a residential street.
e.zh: 某个疯子在居民区街道上以每小时一百英里的速度狂飙。

e.en: He's a total fitness {maniac} — he runs ten miles before work.
e.zh: 他是个十足的健身狂魔,上班前要跑十英里。

e.en: The villain let out a {maniacal} laugh as the trap closed.
e.zh: 陷阱合上时,反派发出一阵疯狂的大笑。

e.en: She has a {maniacal} obsession with keeping the kitchen spotless.
e.zh: 她对保持厨房一尘不染有一种近乎疯狂的执念。

e.en: He giggled {maniacally} as he hit send on the prank email.
e.zh: 他疯狂地咯咯笑着,按下了那封恶作剧邮件的发送键。

e.en: She typed {maniacally} to finish the report before midnight.
e.zh: 她疯狂打字,赶在午夜前完成报告。

manic.t: adj. 狂躁的；极度兴奋的

e.en: The office had a {manic} energy on the day before launch.
e.zh: 产品发布前一天,办公室充满了狂热的气氛。

e.en: His {manic} mood swings finally led him to seek a diagnosis.
e.zh: 他狂躁的情绪波动最终促使他去寻求诊断。

e.en: She was scrubbing the counters {manically} before the guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来前,她疯狂地擦洗着台面。

e.en: He laughed {manically} when he saw the surprise birthday cake.
e.zh: 看到生日惊喜蛋糕时,他狂笑不已。

manichaean.t: adj. 摩尼教的；善恶二元论的

e.en: The film offers a {Manichaean} view of pure good versus pure evil.
e.zh: 这部电影呈现出非善即恶的二元对立观。

e.en: His {Manichaean} worldview leaves no room for moral nuance.
e.zh: 他二元对立的世界观容不下任何道德模糊。

manichean.t: adj. 摩尼教的；善恶二元论的

e.en: Politics today often feels uncomfortably {Manichean} on social media.
e.zh: 如今的政治在社交媒体上常呈现出令人不安的善恶二分。

e.en: She rejected the {Manichean} framing of the debate.
e.zh: 她拒绝把这场辩论简化为善恶对立的框架。

manicotti.t: n. 意式卷心面（馅料意面）

e.en: My grandmother makes the best stuffed {manicotti} in the family.
e.zh: 我奶奶做的酿管面是全家最好吃的。

e.en: We ordered baked {manicotti} with marinara at the Italian place.
e.zh: 我们在那家意大利餐厅点了番茄酱烤酿管面。

e.en: She booked a {manicure} before her sister's wedding.
e.zh: 她在姐姐婚礼前预约了一次美甲。

e.en: The salon offers a quick lunchtime {manicure} for busy clients.
e.zh: 这家沙龙为忙碌的客人提供快速午间美甲。

manicured.t: adj. 修剪整齐的（指甲或草坪）

e.en: The hotel had beautifully {manicured} lawns out front.
e.zh: 酒店门前有修剪得很整齐的草坪。

e.en: She showed off her freshly {manicured} nails at the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会上展示了刚做好的指甲。

manicures.t:
n. 美甲（复数）
v. 修指甲

e.en: This salon {manicures} dozens of clients every weekend.
e.zh: 这家美甲店每个周末为几十位顾客做美甲。

e.en: She gets professional {manicures} twice a month.
e.zh: 她每月做两次专业美甲。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {manicuring} the front hedges.
e.zh: 他花了一下午修整前院的树篱。

e.en: The technician was carefully {manicuring} her client's nails.
e.zh: 美甲师正在仔细地为顾客修甲。

e.en: My {manicurist} recommended a gentler nail polish remover.
e.zh: 我的美甲师推荐了一款更温和的卸甲水。

e.en: She trained for years to become a licensed {manicurist}.
e.zh: 她经过多年培训才成为持证美甲师。

manifest.t:
v. 表明；显现
adj. 明显的

e.en: His talent was {manifest} from a very young age.
e.zh: 他的天赋从很小的时候就显露出来了。

e.en: The customs officer checked the ship's cargo {manifest}.
e.zh: 海关官员检查了船只的货物清单。

e.en: The protest was a {manifestation} of widespread frustration.
e.zh: 这场抗议是普遍不满情绪的体现。

e.en: Fever is a common {manifestation} of the infection.
e.zh: 发烧是这种感染的常见表现。

e.en: Her anxiety {manifested} as trouble sleeping at night.
e.zh: 她的焦虑表现为夜里难以入睡。

e.en: The bug only {manifested} after the latest update.
e.zh: 这个 bug 只在最新更新后才出现。

e.en: The patient is {manifesting} clear symptoms of the flu.
e.zh: 病人出现了明显的流感症状。

e.en: She's been {manifesting} her dream career on TikTok.
e.zh: 她在 TikTok 上一直在显化自己理想的职业。

manifestly.t: adv. 明显地；显而易见地

e.en: The new policy is {manifestly} unfair to part-time workers.
e.zh: 这项新政策对兼职员工显然不公平。

e.en: His answer was {manifestly} false to everyone in the room.
e.zh: 在场的每个人都看得出他的回答明显是假的。

e.en: The startup published a bold design {manifesto} on its blog.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在博客上发表了一份大胆的设计宣言。

e.en: Each party released its election {manifesto} last week.
e.zh: 各党派上周都发布了竞选纲领。

manifests.t:
v. 表明；显现
n. 货物清单

e.en: Stress often {manifests} as headaches or back pain.
e.zh: 压力常常以头痛或背痛的形式表现出来。

e.en: The shipping clerk files all cargo {manifests} digitally now.
e.zh: 货运员现在把所有货物清单都改为电子归档。

manifold.t:
adj. 多种多样的
n. 歧管

e.en: The benefits of regular exercise are {manifold}.
e.zh: 经常运动的好处是多方面的。

e.en: A cracked exhaust {manifold} can hurt engine performance.
e.zh: 排气歧管出现裂缝会影响发动机性能。

e.en: Medical students practice CPR on a rubber {manikin}.
e.zh: 医学生在橡胶人体模型上练习心肺复苏。

e.en: The art teacher posed the wooden {manikin} for sketching.
e.zh: 美术老师摆好木制人偶供学生写生。

manila.t: n. 马尼拉（菲律宾首都）

e.en: Please file the contract in a plain {manila} folder.
e.zh: 请把合同放进一个普通的牛皮纸文件夹里。

e.en: She mailed the documents in a large {manila} envelope.
e.zh: 她用一个大牛皮纸信封寄出了文件。

manilla.t: n. 马尼拉纸；马尼拉麻

e.en: The old letters were stored in a {manilla} envelope.
e.zh: 那些旧信件被放在一个牛皮纸信封里。

e.en: He labeled each {manilla} folder with a client's name.
e.zh: 他在每个牛皮纸文件夹上写上客户的名字。

e.en: In Brazil, {manioc} flour is a staple ingredient.
e.zh: 在巴西,木薯粉是一种主食原料。

e.en: The villagers harvested {manioc} roots for the evening meal.
e.zh: 村民们挖出木薯根准备晚饭。

manipulable.t: adj. 可操纵的；易被控制的

e.en: Soft clay is highly {manipulable} once it's warm.
e.zh: 软陶土加热后非常容易塑形。

e.en: Public opinion can be surprisingly {manipulable} during a crisis.
e.zh: 在危机时期,公众舆论可能出乎意料地容易被操纵。

e.en: Advertisers try to {manipulate} how we feel about ourselves.
e.zh: 广告商试图操纵我们对自己的看法。

e.en: You can {manipulate} the image using simple keyboard shortcuts.
e.zh: 你可以用简单的快捷键来调整这张图片。

manipulated.t: v. 操纵（过去式）；被操控

e.en: He {manipulated} the data to make the results look better.
e.zh: 他篡改了数据,让结果看起来更好。

e.en: She {manipulated} the joystick smoothly through the obstacle course.
e.zh: 她平稳地操控摇杆通过了障碍赛道。

manipulates.t: v. 操纵；操控（第三人称单数）

e.en: The algorithm {manipulates} what you see in your feed.
e.zh: 算法在操控你信息流里看到的内容。

e.en: A skilled potter {manipulates} the clay with practiced ease.
e.zh: 熟练的陶艺师能轻松自如地塑造陶土。

e.en: He's accused of {manipulating} stock prices through fake news.
e.zh: 他被指控通过假消息操纵股价。

e.en: The surgeon was carefully {manipulating} the tiny instruments inside.
e.zh: 外科医生在体内小心翼翼地操作着那些微小器械。

e.en: Critics accused the campaign of obvious media {manipulation}.
e.zh: 评论人士指责该活动明显在操纵媒体。

e.en: Photo {manipulation} software has become incredibly powerful lately.
e.zh: 图像处理软件近来变得非常强大。

e.en: Her clever {manipulations} convinced the board to approve the deal.
e.zh: 她巧妙的手段让董事会同意了这笔交易。

e.en: Simple mathematical {manipulations} can simplify the equation greatly.
e.zh: 简单的数学变换可以大大简化这个方程。

e.en: Her ex-boyfriend was charming but deeply {manipulative}.
e.zh: 她的前男友很迷人,但极具操控性。

e.en: That ad felt cheap and {manipulative} to most viewers.
e.zh: 那则广告对大多数观众来说显得廉价又操控人心。

e.en: Everyone eventually saw him as a cold {manipulator}.
e.zh: 最终大家都把他看作一个冷酷的操纵者。

e.en: The robotic {manipulator} assembles tiny parts on the line.
e.zh: 机械臂在生产线上组装微小的零件。

manitoba.t: n. 曼尼托巴（加拿大省份）

e.en: Winters in {Manitoba} can drop below minus thirty Celsius.
e.zh: 曼尼托巴的冬天气温能降到零下三十度以下。

e.en: She moved from Toronto to Winnipeg, {Manitoba}, last fall.
e.zh: 她去年秋天从多伦多搬到了曼尼托巴的温尼伯。

manitou.t: n. 曼尼托（北美原住民信仰中的神灵）

e.en: In Algonquian belief, the {manitou} is a powerful spiritual force.
e.zh: 在阿尔冈昆人的信仰中,曼尼图是一种强大的精神力量。

e.en: The lake is named after a local {manitou} legend.
e.zh: 这座湖以当地一个曼尼图传说命名。

e.en: Climate change is one of the greatest threats to {mankind}.
e.zh: 气候变化是人类面临的最大威胁之一。

e.en: That moon landing was a giant leap for {mankind}.
e.zh: 那次登月是人类的一大步。

malt.t:
n. 麦芽
v. 用麦芽处理

e.en: The brewery roasts its own {malt} for a richer flavor.
e.zh: 这家酒厂自己烘焙麦芽以获得更浓郁的风味。

e.en: He ordered a vanilla {malt} at the old-fashioned diner.
e.zh: 他在那家老式餐馆点了一杯香草麦芽奶昔。

e.en: We spent our honeymoon exploring the limestone cliffs of {Malta}.
e.zh: 我们的蜜月时光都在探索马耳他的石灰岩悬崖。

e.en: {Malta} joined the European Union back in 2004.
e.zh: 马耳他早在 2004 年就加入了欧盟。

malted.t:
adj. 加入麦芽的
n. 麦芽奶

e.en: She ordered a chocolate {malted} milkshake after the movie.
e.zh: 看完电影后,她点了一杯巧克力麦芽奶昔。

e.en: This whisky is made from carefully {malted} barley.
e.zh: 这款威士忌是用精心发芽的大麦酿造的。

maltese.t:
adj. 马耳他的
n. 马耳他人、马耳他语

e.en: Her tiny {Maltese} dog yapped at every passing stranger.
e.zh: 她那只小马耳他犬对每个路过的陌生人都汪汪叫。

e.en: He learned a few {Maltese} phrases before the trip.
e.zh: 出发前他学了几句马耳他语。

malthusian.t: adj. 马尔萨斯（人口论）的

e.en: Critics dismiss the warning as outdated {Malthusian} thinking.
e.zh: 批评者将这一警告斥为过时的马尔萨斯式思维。

e.en: Climate models echo {Malthusian} fears about resource limits.
e.zh: 气候模型呼应了马尔萨斯式对资源极限的担忧。

e.en: The {malting} process turns barley into the base for whisky.
e.zh: 麦芽制作工艺将大麦变成威士忌的原料。

e.en: Workers monitored temperature carefully during the {malting} stage.
e.zh: 工人们在麦芽发酵阶段严密监控温度。

e.en: The old {maltings} have been converted into a concert hall.
e.zh: 那座老麦芽厂已经被改造成了一座音乐厅。

e.en: Snape {Maltings} hosts a famous music festival every June.
e.zh: 斯内普麦芽厂每年六月都会举办著名的音乐节。

e.en: {Malton} is known as the food capital of Yorkshire.
e.zh: 莫尔顿被誉为约克郡的美食之都。

e.en: We stopped for lunch at a pub in {Malton}.
e.zh: 我们在莫尔顿的一家酒馆停下吃了午饭。

e.en: Laws exist to punish anyone who would {maltreat} an animal.
e.zh: 法律的存在就是为了惩罚任何虐待动物的人。

e.en: Guards were caught on video {maltreating} prisoners.
e.zh: 警卫被录像拍到正在虐待囚犯。

e.en: The shelter rescues dogs from years of {maltreatment}.
e.zh: 这家收容所专门救助长期遭受虐待的狗。

e.en: Inspectors documented widespread {maltreatment} at the facility.
e.zh: 检查人员记录了该机构内普遍存在的虐待行为。

e.en: The {maltster} carefully turned the germinating barley by hand.
e.zh: 麦芽师傅小心地用手翻动正在发芽的大麦。

e.en: Her grandfather was a {maltster} at the village brewery.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在村里的酒厂当麦芽工。

e.en: This beer has a rich, {malty} flavor with caramel notes.
e.zh: 这款啤酒带有浓郁的麦芽风味和焦糖香气。

e.en: She prefers {malty} whiskies over the smoky ones.
e.zh: 她比起烟熏味的威士忌更喜欢麦芽味浓的。

e.en: We hiked the {Malvern} Hills last weekend in the rain.
e.zh: 上周末我们冒雨徒步走了莫尔文山。

e.en: The festival is held in {Malvern} every summer.
e.zh: 这个节日每年夏天都在莫尔文举办。

malvinas.t: n. 马尔维纳斯群岛（福克兰群岛）

e.en: Argentina still claims the {Malvinas} as its territory.
e.zh: 阿根廷至今仍主张马尔维纳斯群岛属于其领土。

e.en: The 1982 war over the {Malvinas} lasted ten weeks.
e.zh: 1982年围绕马尔维纳斯群岛的战争持续了十周。

e.en: The antivirus blocked a piece of {malware} from installing.
e.zh: 杀毒软件阻止了一个恶意软件的安装。

e.en: Don't open suspicious email attachments — they often contain {malware}.
e.zh: 不要打开可疑的邮件附件,它们常常含有恶意软件。

e.en: Her {mam} still lives in the same village.
e.zh: 她妈妈还住在同一个村子里。

e.en: I'm going round to {mam}'s for tea tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚要去妈妈家吃晚饭。

e.en: The toddler ran crying to his {mama}.
e.zh: 小孩哭着跑向妈妈。

e.en: {Mama} always makes pancakes on Sunday mornings.
e.zh: 妈妈总是在周日早上做煎饼。

e.en: She called out '{maman}!' as she opened the door.
e.zh: 她推开门喊了一声“妈妈”。

e.en: In the novel, the narrator's {maman} dies in the opening line.
e.zh: 小说开篇就写到叙述者的母亲去世了。

e.en: The new café is popular with young {mamas} and their babies.
e.zh: 这家新咖啡馆很受年轻妈妈和宝宝们的欢迎。

e.en: Both {mamas} took turns rocking the newborn to sleep.
e.zh: 两位妈妈轮流哄新生儿入睡。

e.en: The black {mamba} is one of Africa's most feared snakes.
e.zh: 黑曼巴是非洲最令人闻风丧胆的蛇之一。

e.en: Fans still chant the '{mamba} mentality' at every game.
e.zh: 球迷在每场比赛中仍高呼“曼巴精神”。

mambo.t:
n. 曼波舞
v. 跳曼波舞

e.en: They learned to {mambo} at a class in Havana.
e.zh: 他们在哈瓦那的舞蹈课上学会了曼波舞。

e.en: The band finished the night with a lively {mambo}.
e.zh: 乐队以一曲热情的曼波结束了当晚演出。

mamluk.t: n. 马穆鲁克（中世纪埃及奴隶兵）

e.en: The {Mamluk} sultans ruled Egypt for over two centuries.
e.zh: 马穆鲁克苏丹统治埃及长达两个多世纪。

e.en: Cairo still has stunning {Mamluk} mosques worth visiting.
e.zh: 开罗仍保留着值得参观的精美马穆鲁克清真寺。

mamma.t:
n. 妈妈
n. 乳房（解剖学）

e.en: The little boy hugged his {mamma} tightly at the gate.
e.zh: 小男孩在门口紧紧抱住了妈妈。

e.en: {Mamma} mia, this pasta is incredible!
e.zh: 我的天,这意面太好吃了!

e.en: The blue whale is the largest {mammal} on Earth.
e.zh: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的哺乳动物。

e.en: Bats are the only {mammal} that can truly fly.
e.zh: 蝙蝠是唯一能真正飞行的哺乳动物。

mammalian.t:
adj. 哺乳动物的
n. 哺乳动物

e.en: Researchers study {mammalian} brains to understand human cognition.
e.zh: 研究人员通过研究哺乳动物的大脑来理解人类认知。

e.en: Sweat glands are a distinctly {mammalian} feature.
e.zh: 汗腺是哺乳动物特有的一种特征。

e.en: The vet examined the dog's {mammary} glands for lumps.
e.zh: 兽医检查了狗的乳腺有无肿块。

e.en: All female mammals have {mammary} tissue for nursing young.
e.zh: 所有雌性哺乳动物都有用于哺育幼崽的乳腺组织。

e.en: The {mammas} chatted while their kids played in the park.
e.zh: 妈妈们一边聊天,一边看孩子在公园里玩。

e.en: Both {mammas} cried during the graduation ceremony.
e.zh: 两位妈妈在毕业典礼上都哭了。

e.en: Doctors recommend an annual {mammogram} for women over forty.
e.zh: 医生建议四十岁以上女性每年做一次乳房X光检查。

e.en: Her {mammogram} came back completely clear this year.
e.zh: 她今年的乳腺X光检查结果完全正常。

e.en: Modern {mammography} can detect tumors years before symptoms appear.
e.zh: 现代乳腺X光检查能在症状出现前数年发现肿瘤。

e.en: The clinic offers free {mammography} screenings every October.
e.zh: 这家诊所每年十月提供免费的乳腺X光筛查。

e.en: The preacher warned against the worship of {mammon}.
e.zh: 牧师警告人们不要崇拜金钱财富。

e.en: He abandoned art to chase {mammon} on Wall Street.
e.zh: 他放弃了艺术,跑到华尔街追逐财富去了。

mammoth.t:
n. 猛犸象
adj. 庞大的

e.en: Renovating the old theater turned out to be a {mammoth} task.
e.zh: 翻修这座老剧院结果是一项浩大的工程。

e.en: Scientists found a frozen {mammoth} preserved in Siberian ice.
e.zh: 科学家在西伯利亚冰层中发现了一头冰冻的猛犸象。

e.en: The child wouldn't sleep without his {mammy} nearby.
e.zh: 那孩子身边没有妈妈就睡不着。

e.en: She sang an old lullaby her {mammy} taught her.
e.zh: 她唱起一首妈妈教过她的老摇篮曲。

man.t:
n. 男人；人类
v. 操纵；值守

e.en: The {man} at the counter asked for a refund.
e.zh: 柜台前的那位男士要求退款。

e.en: It takes three people to {man} the booth all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末看守这个展位需要三个人。

mana.t: n. 法力（游戏中魔法值）

e.en: Casting that spell drained most of his {mana}.
e.zh: 施放那个法术几乎耗尽了他的法力。

e.en: In Polynesian culture, chiefs were believed to possess great {mana}.
e.zh: 在波利尼西亚文化中,酋长被认为拥有强大的灵力。

manacle.t:
n. 手铐
v. 给…戴上手铐

e.en: The guard removed the iron {manacle} from the prisoner's wrist.
e.zh: 狱警从囚犯的手腕上取下铁镣铐。

e.en: Old debts can {manacle} you for years.
e.zh: 旧债可能会束缚你好多年。

e.en: Can you {manage} the project while I'm on leave?
e.zh: 我休假时你能管理这个项目吗?

e.en: Somehow we {manage} to finish dinner before the guests arrived.
e.zh: 我们竟然在客人到来之前赶上吃完了晚饭。

e.en: Breaking the task into smaller chunks improved its {manageability}.
e.zh: 把任务拆成小块提高了它的可管理性。

e.en: The new dashboard greatly increased the system's {manageability}.
e.zh: 新仪表盘大大提升了系统的可管理性。

manageable.t: adj. 易管理的；可控制的

e.en: Splitting the workload made the project much more {manageable}.
e.zh: 分摊工作量让这个项目变得容易处理多了。

e.en: Her hair is finally a {manageable} length again.
e.zh: 她的头发终于又长到方便打理的长度了。

managed.t:
adj. 受管理的；托管的
v. manage 的过去式

e.en: She {managed} to finish the report before midnight.
e.zh: 她设法在午夜前完成了报告。

e.en: The fund is {managed} by a team in Singapore.
e.zh: 该基金由新加坡的一个团队负责管理。

e.en: Senior {management} approved the new hiring plan yesterday.
e.zh: 高层管理人员昨天批准了新的招聘计划。

e.en: Time {management} is the hardest skill to teach interns.
e.zh: 时间管理是最难教给实习生的技能。

e.en: My {manager} approved the time off without any questions.
e.zh: 我的经理二话不说就批了我的假。

e.en: The restaurant {manager} apologized for the long wait.
e.zh: 餐厅经理为长时间的等待道了歉。

e.en: The hotel {manageress} greeted every guest by name.
e.zh: 酒店女经理叫得出每位客人的名字。

e.en: She was promoted to {manageress} of the new boutique.
e.zh: 她被提拔为这家新精品店的女经理。

managerial.t: adj. 经理的；管理方面的

e.en: He's looking for a {managerial} role with more responsibility.
e.zh: 他正在寻找一份责任更大的管理职位。

e.en: Strong {managerial} skills are essential for this position.
e.zh: 出色的管理能力对这个岗位至关重要。

e.en: {Managerially}, the company has been struggling for several quarters.
e.zh: 从管理层面来看,该公司已经苦撑了好几个季度。

e.en: The team is sound technically but weak {managerially}.
e.zh: 这支团队技术上不错,但管理上较薄弱。

e.en: All {managers} must attend the leadership training next Friday.
e.zh: 所有经理都必须参加下周五的领导力培训。

e.en: The best {managers} listen more than they talk.
e.zh: 最好的管理者倾听多于说话。

manages.t: v. manage 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {manages} a team of twelve engineers in Berlin.
e.zh: 她在柏林管理着一支十二人的工程师团队。

e.en: Somehow he always {manages} to arrive just in time.
e.zh: 不知怎的,他总能赶在最后一刻到达。

managing.t:
v. manage 的现在分词
adj. 主管的

e.en: {Managing} remote teams requires extra communication and trust.
e.zh: 管理远程团队需要更多的沟通与信任。

e.en: How are you {managing} since the move?
e.zh: 搬家以后你过得怎么样?

managua.t: n. 马那瓜（尼加拉瓜首都）

e.en: {Managua} is the capital and largest city of Nicaragua.
e.zh: 马那瓜是尼加拉瓜的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Our flight connects through {Managua} on the way to Costa Rica.
e.zh: 我们去哥斯达黎加的航班在马那瓜转机。

manliness.t: n. 男子气概；阳刚之气

e.en: He equated {manliness} with never showing any emotion.
e.zh: 他把男子气概等同于从不流露情绪。

e.en: Modern culture is rethinking what {manliness} really means.
e.zh: 现代文化正在重新思考男子气概到底意味着什么。

manly.t: adj. 有男子气概的；阳刚的

e.en: He grew a beard to look more {manly} on camera.
e.zh: 他留了胡子,让自己在镜头前显得更有男子气概。

e.en: Cooking dinner for your family is genuinely {manly}.
e.zh: 为家人做晚饭才是真正有男子气概的事。

manmade.t: adj. 人造的；人工合成的

e.en: This lake is actually {manmade}, built in the 1960s.
e.zh: 这个湖其实是人造的,建于上世纪六十年代。

e.en: Most of the pollution here is {manmade}, not natural.
e.zh: 这里大部分的污染是人为造成的,而非自然形成。

manna.t:
n. 吗哪（圣经中的天赐食物）
n. 意外收获

e.en: That tax refund felt like {manna} from heaven.
e.zh: 那笔退税就像是天降的甘露。

e.en: For struggling students, free coffee is pure {manna}.
e.zh: 对手头紧的学生来说,免费咖啡简直是天赐之物。

manned.t:
adj. 载人的（航天器等）
v. 为…配备人员

e.en: NASA hasn't conducted a {manned} mission to the moon since 1972.
e.zh: 自 1972 年以来,NASA 就没再执行过载人登月任务。

e.en: The booth was {manned} by two friendly volunteers.
e.zh: 展位由两名热情的志愿者负责。

mannequin.t: n. 人体模型；时装模特

e.en: The store dressed every {mannequin} in the new spring line.
e.zh: 商店给每个模特儿都穿上了新款春装。

e.en: She stood as still as a shop {mannequin} during the photo.
e.zh: 拍照时她像店里的人体模特一样一动不动。

manner.t:
n. 方式；方法
n. 态度；举止

e.en: He answered the question in a calm, professional {manner}.
e.zh: 他以一种冷静、专业的方式回答了问题。

e.en: All {manner} of strange creatures live in the deep sea.
e.zh: 深海里生活着各种各样的奇怪生物。

mannered.t: adj. 举止…的；矫揉造作的

e.en: The children were polite and well-{mannered} throughout dinner.
e.zh: 孩子们整顿晚饭都很有礼貌、举止得体。

e.en: His acting felt stiff and overly {mannered} in that scene.
e.zh: 他在那场戏里的表演显得僵硬又做作。

mannerism.t:
n. 个人习惯；怪癖
n. 矫饰主义

e.en: Tapping his pen is a {mannerism} he's had since college.
e.zh: 敲笔是他从大学起就有的小习惯。

e.en: The actor nailed every {mannerism} of the real politician.
e.zh: 那位演员把这位真实政客的每个小习惯都演得惟妙惟肖。

mannerist.t: n. 矫饰主义者；矫揉造作的人

e.en: The painting shows clear {mannerist} influences from sixteenth-century Italy.
e.zh: 这幅画明显受到十六世纪意大利样式主义的影响。

e.en: His later films became increasingly {mannerist} and self-indulgent.
e.zh: 他后期的电影变得越来越风格化、过于自我陶醉。

mannerly.t: adj. 有礼貌的；彬彬有礼的

e.en: She raised her sons to be {mannerly} at the table.
e.zh: 她把儿子们教育得在餐桌上很有礼貌。

e.en: He gave a {mannerly} nod and held the door open.
e.zh: 他礼貌地点了点头,把门扶住。

e.en: It's bad {manners} to scroll your phone during dinner.
e.zh: 吃饭时刷手机是不礼貌的。

e.en: His grandmother taught him impeccable table {manners}.
e.zh: 他祖母教会了他无可挑剔的餐桌礼仪。

e.en: She studied jazz piano in {Mannheim} for two years.
e.zh: 她在曼海姆学了两年爵士钢琴。

e.en: {Mannheim} sits where the Rhine meets the Neckar river.
e.zh: 曼海姆位于莱茵河与内卡河的交汇处。

manning.t:
n. 人员配备
v. 配备人手（man 的现在分词）

e.en: Two interns were {manning} the registration desk all afternoon.
e.zh: 两名实习生整个下午都守在登记台。

e.en: Volunteers took turns {manning} the phones during the telethon.
e.zh: 志愿者们在募捐电视马拉松期间轮流接电话。

mannish.t: adj. (女子) 男人气的；像男人的

e.en: She prefers a {mannish} blazer over anything too feminine.
e.zh: 她偏爱中性风的西装外套,不喜欢太女性化的衣服。

e.en: The model wore a {mannish} suit on the runway.
e.zh: 模特在 T 台上穿着一身中性风格的西装。

e.en: Doctors gave the patient {mannitol} to reduce brain swelling.
e.zh: 医生给病人使用甘露醇以减轻脑水肿。

e.en: Sugar-free gum often contains {mannitol} as a sweetener.
e.zh: 无糖口香糖里常含有甘露醇作为甜味剂。

e.en: This compact SUV is praised for its excellent {manoeuvrability}.
e.zh: 这款紧凑型 SUV 因其出色的操控性而备受好评。

e.en: The fighter jet's {manoeuvrability} gives it a real edge.
e.zh: 这架战斗机的机动性让它具有真正的优势。

manoeuvrable.t: adj. 机动灵活的；易操控的

e.en: Small kayaks are far more {manoeuvrable} than long sea kayaks.
e.zh: 小型皮划艇比长款海上皮划艇灵活得多。

e.en: The new electric scooter is light and highly {manoeuvrable}.
e.zh: 这款新电动滑板车又轻又灵活。

manoeuvre.t:
n. 策略；调动
v. 巧妙移动；设法

e.en: Parking in this narrow garage is a tricky {manoeuvre}.
e.zh: 在这么窄的车库里停车是个棘手的动作。

e.en: The general's clever political {manoeuvre} surprised everyone.
e.zh: 将军这一巧妙的政治手腕让所有人都很意外。

manoeuvred.t: v. 巧妙移动；操纵（过去式）

e.en: She {manoeuvred} the truck carefully into the loading dock.
e.zh: 她小心翼翼地把卡车倒进了装货区。

e.en: He cleverly {manoeuvred} himself into the CEO position.
e.zh: 他巧妙地运作,把自己推上了 CEO 的位置。

manoeuvres.t:
n. 演习；策略（复数）
v. 巧妙操作

e.en: The army holds joint {manoeuvres} with allies every spring.
e.zh: 军队每年春天都和盟友进行联合演习。

e.en: Her political {manoeuvres} kept her at the top for decades.
e.zh: 她的政治手腕让她在高位上稳坐了几十年。

manoeuvring.t:
n. 调遣；策略运用
v. 操纵（现在分词）

e.en: The pilot was {manoeuvring} the jet through heavy turbulence.
e.zh: 飞行员正驾驶喷气机穿过强烈的颠簸气流。

e.en: Political {manoeuvring} delayed the bill for months.
e.zh: 政治上的暗中较量让法案被搁置了数月。

e.en: The lab uses {manometric} sensors to track gas pressure.
e.zh: 实验室使用压力计传感器来监测气体压力。

e.en: Engineers logged {manometric} readings every five minutes.
e.zh: 工程师每五分钟记录一次压力计读数。

e.en: Esophageal {manometry} helps doctors diagnose swallowing disorders.
e.zh: 食管测压法帮助医生诊断吞咽障碍。

e.en: The course covers basic {manometry} and fluid dynamics.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖基本的测压学和流体力学。

e.en: The old {manor} sits at the end of a long drive.
e.zh: 那座古老的庄园坐落在长长车道的尽头。

e.en: Tourists can tour the {manor} every weekend.
e.zh: 游客每个周末都可以参观这座庄园。

e.en: The museum displays records of {manorial} life in medieval England.
e.zh: 博物馆展出中世纪英格兰庄园生活的档案。

e.en: He studies {manorial} courts and their legal authority.
e.zh: 他研究庄园法庭及其司法权限。

manova.t: n. 多元方差分析（统计）

e.en: We ran a {manova} to compare the three treatment groups.
e.zh: 我们做了多元方差分析来比较三个处理组。

e.en: The {manova} revealed significant differences between regions.
e.zh: 多元方差分析揭示了各地区之间的显著差异。

e.en: The factory simply doesn't have enough {manpower} this quarter.
e.zh: 这家工厂本季度的人力实在不够。

e.en: Disaster relief requires significant {manpower} on the ground.
e.zh: 救灾工作需要大量的现场人力。

mans.t: v. 操控；配备人员（man 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He {mans} the front desk every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 他每个周六早上都在前台值班。

e.en: A small crew {mans} the lighthouse year-round.
e.zh: 一支小队伍全年驻守这座灯塔。

mansard.t: n. 折线形屋顶；复折式屋顶

e.en: The hotel has a charming {mansard} roof in the French style.
e.zh: 这家酒店有一个迷人的法式孟莎屋顶。

e.en: Pigeons love nesting under the {mansard} eaves.
e.zh: 鸽子喜欢在孟莎屋顶的屋檐下筑巢。

e.en: The old {manse} next to the church is now a museum.
e.zh: 教堂旁的旧牧师住宅现在是一座博物馆。

e.en: They bought a small {manse} on the edge of town.
e.zh: 他们在城边买下了一栋小型牧师宅邸。

e.en: The duke's loyal {manservant} prepared his morning coffee.
e.zh: 公爵忠实的男仆为他准备了早晨的咖啡。

e.en: In old novels, every gentleman seems to have a {manservant}.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,每位绅士似乎都有一个男仆。

mansfield.t: n. 曼斯菲尔德（地名／姓氏）

e.en: Katherine {Mansfield} wrote some of the finest short stories ever published.
e.zh: 凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德写过一些史上最出色的短篇小说。

e.en: They drove through {Mansfield} on their way north.
e.zh: 他们北上途中开车穿过了曼斯菲尔德。

e.en: The tech billionaire just bought a beachfront {mansion}.
e.zh: 那位科技亿万富翁刚买下一栋海滨豪宅。

e.en: The {mansion} has twenty rooms and a private library.
e.zh: 这座豪宅有二十个房间和一间私人图书馆。

e.en: Old {mansions} line both sides of the river.
e.zh: 河的两岸都坐落着古老的豪宅。

e.en: Many of these {mansions} have been converted into hotels.
e.zh: 这些豪宅中有许多已被改造成酒店。

manslaughter.t: n. 过失杀人；非预谋杀人

e.en: The driver was charged with {manslaughter} after the crash.
e.zh: 司机在事故后被以过失杀人罪起诉。

e.en: The jury reduced the charge from murder to {manslaughter}.
e.zh: 陪审团将罪名从谋杀降为过失杀人。

manta.t:
n. 蝠鲼（魔鬼鱼）
n. 披肩布

e.en: A giant {manta} ray glided silently past our boat.
e.zh: 一只巨大的蝠鲼从我们船边悄无声息地滑过。

e.en: Divers often spot {manta} rays around these islands.
e.zh: 潜水员经常在这些岛屿附近看到蝠鲼。

e.en: She placed the family photos along the {mantel}.
e.zh: 她把全家福沿着壁炉台摆放好。

e.en: A clock ticked quietly on the marble {mantel}.
e.zh: 一座钟在大理石壁炉台上静静地走着。

e.en: His trophies are proudly displayed on the {mantelpiece}.
e.zh: 他的奖杯被自豪地陈列在壁炉架上。

e.en: A vase of lilies stood on the {mantelpiece}.
e.zh: 壁炉架上摆着一瓶百合花。

e.en: Christmas cards covered every inch of the {mantelshelf}.
e.zh: 圣诞贺卡铺满了壁炉架的每一寸。

e.en: She dusted the {mantelshelf} before the guests arrived.
e.zh: 她在客人到来前把壁炉架擦了一遍。

mantilla.t: n. (西班牙式) 蕾丝头纱

e.en: The bride wore a delicate lace {mantilla} to the ceremony.
e.zh: 新娘戴着一条精致的蕾丝头纱出席婚礼。

e.en: Her grandmother's black {mantilla} hung in the closet.
e.zh: 她祖母的黑色头纱挂在衣橱里。

e.en: A praying {mantis} sat motionless on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只螳螂一动不动地停在窗台上。

e.en: The {mantis} ambushed a fly with lightning speed.
e.zh: 螳螂以闪电般的速度伏击了一只苍蝇。

mantle.t:
n. 地幔；披风
n. 职责；衣钵

e.en: She took up the {mantle} of leadership after the founder retired.
e.zh: 创始人退休后,她接过了领导的重任。

e.en: Volcanoes are fed by molten rock from Earth's {mantle}.
e.zh: 火山由地球地幔中的熔岩供给岩浆。

e.en: "Ship early, iterate often" became the team's {mantra}.
e.zh: “尽早发布,持续迭代”成了团队的口头禅。

e.en: She repeats a calming {mantra} during meditation.
e.zh: 她在冥想时重复一句让人平静的咒语。

e.en: The exhibit features a silk {mantua} from the 1700s.
e.zh: 展览展出一件十八世纪的丝绸长袍。

e.en: Noblewomen once wore the {mantua} at formal occasions.
e.zh: 贵族女性曾在正式场合穿着这种长袍。

manual.t:
n. 使用手册
adj. 手动的

e.en: Check the user {manual} before resetting the router.
e.zh: 重置路由器前请先查看用户手册。

e.en: He prefers a {manual} transmission over an automatic one.
e.zh: 比起自动挡,他更喜欢手动挡。

e.en: You'll need to {manually} approve each pull request.
e.zh: 你需要手动批准每一个拉取请求。

e.en: The data was entered {manually} into the spreadsheet.
e.zh: 数据是手动录入到电子表格里的。

e.en: The shelf is full of old camera {manuals}.
e.zh: 架子上摆满了旧相机的说明书。

e.en: Software {manuals} are mostly online these days.
e.zh: 如今软件手册大多都放在网上了。

e.en: The historic {manufactory} once produced fine porcelain.
e.zh: 这座历史悠久的工厂曾经生产精美的瓷器。

e.en: Tourists can visit the old porcelain {manufactory} on weekends.
e.zh: 游客可以在周末参观那座古老的瓷器工厂。

manufacturable.t: adj. 可制造的；适于量产的

e.en: The prototype is clever but not yet {manufacturable} at scale.
e.zh: 这个原型设计巧妙,但还无法实现量产。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the part to make it {manufacturable}.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了这个部件,使它便于量产。

manufacture.t:
v. 制造；生产
n. 制造业

e.en: Several plants {manufacture} batteries for electric vehicles.
e.zh: 几家工厂为电动汽车生产电池。

e.en: The company plans to {manufacture} chips locally next year.
e.zh: 该公司计划明年在本地生产芯片。

manufactured.t:
adj. 制造的
v. manufacture 的过去式

e.en: These phones are {manufactured} in Vietnam.
e.zh: 这些手机是在越南生产的。

e.en: Critics called the controversy entirely {manufactured}.
e.zh: 评论人士称这场争议完全是人为制造的。

e.en: Contact the {manufacturer} if the warranty is still valid.
e.zh: 如果保修仍然有效,请联系生产商。

e.en: The car {manufacturer} recalled thousands of vehicles.
e.zh: 这家汽车制造商召回了数千辆汽车。

e.en: Chip {manufacturers} are racing to expand capacity.
e.zh: 芯片制造商正在竞相扩大产能。

e.en: Several {manufacturers} attended the trade show in Berlin.
e.zh: 几家制造商参加了在柏林举办的贸易展。

manufactures.t:
v. 制造（三单）
n. 制成品

e.en: The startup {manufactures} affordable solar panels.
e.zh: 这家初创公司生产价格亲民的太阳能板。

e.en: This factory {manufactures} parts for jet engines.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产喷气发动机的零部件。

manufacturing.t:
n. 制造业
adj. 制造的

e.en: {Manufacturing} costs have risen sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年的制造成本大幅上升。

e.en: The country is investing heavily in advanced {manufacturing}.
e.zh: 该国正在大力投资先进制造业。

manufacturings.t: n. 各类制造活动 (罕用)

e.en: Different {manufacturings} of the same drug can vary slightly.
e.zh: 同一种药的不同批次生产可能略有差异。

e.en: Auditors compared {manufacturings} from two separate plants.
e.zh: 审计人员比较了来自两家不同工厂的生产批次。

e.en: The document records the {manumission} of several enslaved people.
e.zh: 这份文件记录了若干被奴役者获得解放的过程。

e.en: Historians study {manumission} laws of the early republic.
e.zh: 历史学家研究共和国早期的解放奴隶法律。

e.en: In his will, he chose to {manumit} every enslaved worker.
e.zh: 他在遗嘱中选择释放每一位被奴役的劳动者。

e.en: Some owners refused to {manumit} their slaves even after the war.
e.zh: 一些主人甚至在战后仍拒绝释放他们的奴隶。

manure.t:
n. 粪肥
v. 施肥

e.en: Farmers spread {manure} across the fields each spring.
e.zh: 农民每年春天都会在田里撒粪肥。

e.en: Composted {manure} makes excellent garden fertilizer.
e.zh: 腐熟的粪肥是非常好的园艺肥料。

e.en: In Roman law, {manus} described a husband's authority over his wife.
e.zh: 在罗马法中,manus 指的是丈夫对妻子的支配权。

e.en: The Latin word {manus} simply means "hand."
e.zh: 拉丁语单词 manus 仅表示“手”。

e.en: She mailed the {manuscript} to her editor on Friday.
e.zh: 她周五把书稿寄给了她的编辑。

e.en: The library houses a medieval {manuscript} from the 1300s.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏了一份十四世纪的中世纪手稿。

e.en: Ancient {manuscripts} are stored in climate-controlled vaults.
e.zh: 古代手稿被保存在恒温恒湿的库房里。

e.en: Editors review hundreds of {manuscripts} every month.
e.zh: 编辑每月要审阅数百份书稿。

e.en: Johns {Manville} faced massive lawsuits over asbestos exposure.
e.zh: 约翰斯·曼维尔公司因石棉暴露问题面临大规模诉讼。

e.en: They drove past {Manville} on the way to the coast.
e.zh: 他们在前往海岸的路上经过了曼维尔。

manx.t:
adj. 马恩岛的
n. 马恩岛猫

e.en: A {Manx} cat has almost no tail at all.
e.zh: 曼岛猫几乎完全没有尾巴。

e.en: Few people still speak the {Manx} language fluently.
e.zh: 如今能流利讲曼岛语的人已经不多。

many.t:
adj. 许多的
pron. 许多人或物

e.en: {Many} users prefer dark mode on their phones.
e.zh: 许多用户更喜欢手机上的深色模式。

e.en: There weren't {many} seats left at the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会上剩下的座位已经不多了。

e.en: He poured a chilled glass of {manzanilla} before dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐前他倒了一杯冰镇的曼萨尼亚雪利酒。

e.en: {Manzanilla} pairs beautifully with salty tapas.
e.zh: 曼萨尼亚雪利酒与咸味小食非常般配。

e.en: Twisted {manzanita} branches lined the mountain trail.
e.zh: 扭曲的熊果木枝条沿着山间小径排开。

e.en: The {manzanita} blooms with tiny pink bells in spring.
e.zh: 熊果木在春天开出粉色的小铃铛形花朵。

e.en: The museum displays old portraits of Chairman {Mao}.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着毛主席的老照片。

e.en: He wore a classic {Mao} jacket to the costume party.
e.zh: 他穿着一件经典的中山装去了化装派对。

e.en: The professor lectured on the legacy of {Maoism} in modern China.
e.zh: 那位教授讲授毛主义在现代中国的遗产。

e.en: Some rural movements still draw inspiration from {Maoism}.
e.zh: 一些农村运动仍然从毛主义中汲取灵感。

maoist.t:
n. 毛派人士
adj. 毛派的

e.en: A small {Maoist} group held a rally in the capital.
e.zh: 一个小型毛派团体在首都举行了集会。

e.en: The novel explores life under a {Maoist} regime.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨毛派政权下的生活。

e.en: She studied {Maori} culture during her semester in New Zealand.
e.zh: 她在新西兰交换那学期研究了毛利文化。

e.en: The guide greeted us in {Maori} before the tour began.
e.zh: 导游在游览开始前用毛利语向我们问候。

e.en: The {Maoris} have lived in New Zealand for centuries.
e.zh: 毛利人已经在新西兰生活了数百年。

e.en: Several {Maoris} performed a traditional haka at the festival.
e.zh: 几位毛利人在节日上表演了传统的哈卡舞。

map.t:
n. 地图
v. 绘制；映射

e.en: Open the {map} app and search for the nearest cafe.
e.zh: 打开地图应用，搜索最近的咖啡馆。

e.en: The chart helps you {map} customer behavior across channels.
e.zh: 该图表帮助你梳理用户在各渠道的行为。

e.en: I poured {maple} syrup over my pancakes this morning.
e.zh: 今早我在煎饼上浇了枫糖浆。

e.en: A tall {maple} tree shades the front yard each summer.
e.zh: 一棵高大的枫树每年夏天为前院遮阴。

e.en: The {maples} along the street turn bright red in October.
e.zh: 街边的枫树十月里变得通红。

e.en: They planted three {maples} near the back fence last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他们在后院围栏旁种了三棵枫树。

mapmaker.t: n. 制图员；地图绘制者

e.en: The medieval {mapmaker} drew coastlines based on sailors' notes.
e.zh: 那位中世纪制图师根据水手笔记绘制海岸线。

e.en: Modern software lets any user become a digital {mapmaker}.
e.zh: 现代软件让任何人都能成为数字制图师。

e.en: Researchers {mapped} the coral reef using underwater drones.
e.zh: 研究人员用水下无人机绘制了珊瑚礁地图。

e.en: She {mapped} each requirement to a specific feature in the spec.
e.zh: 她把每条需求对应到规格书里的具体功能。

e.en: The {mapper} converts raw JSON into structured database rows.
e.zh: 该映射器把原始 JSON 转换成结构化的数据库行。

e.en: He works as a street {mapper} for an open-source project.
e.zh: 他在一个开源项目里担任街道测绘员。

mapping.t:
n. 映射；测绘
v. 绘制地图

e.en: The team is {mapping} bus routes across the entire city.
e.zh: 团队正在绘制全市的公交线路图。

e.en: There's a clear {mapping} between user roles and permissions.
e.zh: 用户角色和权限之间有清晰的对应关系。

maps.t:
n. 地图（复数）
v. 绘制（三单）

e.en: Google {Maps} rerouted us around the highway accident.
e.zh: 谷歌地图为我们绕开了高速上的事故路段。

e.en: The function {maps} each input to exactly one output.
e.zh: 该函数把每个输入精确对应到一个输出。

e.en: The sculptor built a small clay {maquette} before casting in bronze.
e.zh: 雕塑家在浇铸青铜前先做了一个粘土小样。

e.en: Her studio is filled with {maquette} models of public sculptures.
e.zh: 她的工作室摆满了公共雕塑的小型模型。

maquiladora.t: n. 墨西哥边境代工厂

e.en: Many electronics are assembled at a {maquiladora} near the border.
e.zh: 许多电子产品在边境附近的保税装配厂组装。

e.en: The {maquiladora} employs hundreds of workers from nearby towns.
e.zh: 这家保税厂雇用了附近城镇数百名工人。

maquis.t: n. 法国抵抗游击队；灌木丛

e.en: French {maquis} fighters resisted the occupation during World War II.
e.zh: 法国游击队在二战期间抵抗占领。

e.en: They hid weapons in the {maquis} on the hillside.
e.zh: 他们把武器藏在山坡的灌木丛里。

e.en: Don't let one bad review {mar} an otherwise great launch.
e.zh: 别让一条差评毁掉一场原本出色的发布。

e.en: Scratches on the screen {mar} the phone's resale value.
e.zh: 屏幕上的划痕会拉低手机的二手价值。

mara.t: n. 女子名 Mara；南美长耳豚

e.en: The {mara} is a large rodent native to the Argentine pampas.
e.zh: 长耳豚鼠是原产于阿根廷潘帕斯草原的大型啮齿动物。

e.en: We watched a {mara} hop across the dry grassland.
e.zh: 我们看着一只长耳豚鼠在干草原上跳跃而过。

e.en: The dancer wore a robe trimmed with white {marabou} feathers.
e.zh: 舞者身穿一件镶有白色秃鹳羽毛的长袍。

e.en: A massive {marabou} stork waded through the shallow lake.
e.zh: 一只巨大的秃鹳在浅湖中涉水而行。

marabout.t: n. 北非穆斯林隐修士

e.en: Pilgrims visit the {marabout} shrine to seek blessings.
e.zh: 朝圣者前往这位圣徒的陵祠祈求祝福。

e.en: The local {marabout} was respected for his wisdom and prayers.
e.zh: 当地的伊斯兰圣人因智慧和祷告而受人敬重。

e.en: He shook a {maraca} in time with the salsa beat.
e.zh: 他随着萨尔萨节拍摇着沙锤。

e.en: The toddler giggled while shaking a tiny {maraca}.
e.zh: 小孩边摇着小沙锤边咯咯地笑。

maradona.t: n. 马拉多纳（阿根廷球星）

e.en: Argentine fans still celebrate {Maradona}'s legendary 1986 goal.
e.zh: 阿根廷球迷至今仍在追忆马拉多纳1986年的传奇进球。

e.en: The mural depicts {Maradona} lifting the World Cup trophy.
e.zh: 这幅壁画描绘了马拉多纳高举世界杯奖杯的瞬间。

marais.t: n. 巴黎玛黑区（人名/地名）

e.en: We spent the afternoon wandering the trendy {Marais} district in Paris.
e.zh: 我们用一下午时间逛了巴黎潮流的玛黑区。

e.en: Boutique galleries fill the narrow streets of {Marais}.
e.zh: 精品画廊布满了玛黑区狭窄的街道。

maraschino.t: n. 马拉斯加樱桃酒；糖渍樱桃

e.en: She topped the sundae with a bright red {maraschino} cherry.
e.zh: 她在圣代上放了一颗鲜红的马拉斯奇诺樱桃。

e.en: The cocktail calls for a splash of {maraschino} liqueur.
e.zh: 这款鸡尾酒需要加一点马拉斯奇诺利口酒。

marathon.t: n. 马拉松；马拉松式活动

e.en: She trained for six months before running her first {marathon}.
e.zh: 她训练了六个月才参加自己的第一次马拉松。

e.en: We had a {marathon} debugging session that lasted all night.
e.zh: 我们通宵进行了一场马拉松式的调试。

e.en: The Kenyan {marathoner} broke the course record by two minutes.
e.zh: 那位肯尼亚马拉松选手把赛道纪录提高了两分钟。

e.en: As a casual {marathoner}, he runs two races every year.
e.zh: 作为业余马拉松爱好者，他每年参加两场比赛。

e.en: He's completed five {marathons} since taking up running.
e.zh: 自从开始跑步以来，他已完赛五场马拉松。

e.en: Major {marathons} like Boston attract runners from all over the world.
e.zh: 像波士顿这样的大型马拉松吸引着全球跑者。

e.en: Pirates would {maraud} coastal villages for food and gold.
e.zh: 海盗经常洗劫沿海村庄抢夺食物和黄金。

e.en: Wolves sometimes {maraud} the farms during harsh winters.
e.zh: 严冬时节狼群有时会袭扰这些农场。

e.en: A lone {marauder} broke into the warehouse last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一名劫匪闯入了仓库。

e.en: Villagers built tall walls to keep out any {marauder}.
e.zh: 村民修筑高墙来抵御任何劫掠者。

marauding.t:
adj. 四处劫掠的
n. 抢劫行为

e.en: {Marauding} bands of bandits terrorized the mountain passes.
e.zh: 四处劫掠的匪帮在山口横行霸道。

e.en: Farmers complained about a {marauding} bear raiding their orchards.
e.zh: 农民们抱怨一头到处觅食的熊袭击他们的果园。

e.en: The chef called his new dessert una {maravilla} of flavors.
e.zh: 主厨称他的新甜点是一场风味的奇迹。

e.en: Visitors describe the cathedral as a true {maravilla}.
e.zh: 游客们形容这座大教堂是真正的奇观。

marbella.t: n. 马贝拉（西班牙城市）

e.en: We spent a week sunbathing on the beaches of {Marbella}.
e.zh: 我们在马贝拉的海滩上晒了一周太阳。

e.en: {Marbella} is famous for its luxury resorts and nightlife.
e.zh: 马贝拉以豪华度假村和夜生活闻名。

e.en: The kitchen counter is made of polished white {marble}.
e.zh: 厨房台面是用抛光白色大理石做的。

e.en: The child rolled a glass {marble} across the floor.
e.zh: 小孩在地板上滚了一颗玻璃弹珠。

marbled.t: adj. 有大理石花纹的；(肉) 雪花的

e.en: The steak was beautifully {marbled} with thin streaks of fat.
e.zh: 这块牛排夹着细密漂亮的脂肪纹理。

e.en: She wrapped the gift in {marbled} blue paper.
e.zh: 她用大理石花纹的蓝色包装纸把礼物包了起来。

e.en: The cafe's tables have a {marbleized} green surface.
e.zh: 咖啡馆的桌子表面是仿大理石纹的绿色。

e.en: She painted the walls with a {marbleized} effect for elegance.
e.zh: 她把墙面刷成仿大理石效果，显得优雅。

marbles.t: n. 弹珠游戏；大理石制品

e.en: The boys played {marbles} in the dirt during recess.
e.zh: 男孩们课间在泥地里玩弹珠。

e.en: He joked that he was losing his {marbles} from the stress.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说压力大得他都快疯了。

marburg.t: n. 马尔堡（德国城市/病毒名）

e.en: Health officials reported a small {Marburg} virus outbreak in Rwanda.
e.zh: 卫生官员报告了卢旺达发生小规模马尔堡病毒疫情。

e.en: {Marburg} is a charming university town in central Germany.
e.zh: 马尔堡是德国中部一座迷人的大学城。

marc.t: n. 压榨后的果渣；果渣白兰地

e.en: After pressing wine, the {marc} can be distilled into brandy.
e.zh: 葡萄压榨之后，剩余的渣可以蒸馏成白兰地。

e.en: He poured a small glass of {marc} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他倒了一小杯葡萄渣白兰地。

marcel.t:
n. 马塞尔卷发
v. 烫波浪卷

e.en: She wore her hair in a glossy 1920s {marcel} wave.
e.zh: 她把头发烫成上世纪二十年代光亮的水波纹。

e.en: The stylist used a hot iron to {marcel} her hair.
e.zh: 造型师用电卷棒为她做出经典波纹卷发。

march.t:
v. 行进，游行
n. 三月；进行曲

e.en: Thousands plan to {march} downtown for the climate rally.
e.zh: 成千上万的人计划进城参加气候大游行。

e.en: My birthday falls in early {March} every year.
e.zh: 我的生日每年都在三月初。

marched.t: v. march 的过去式；列队前进

e.en: The soldiers {marched} across the parade ground in perfect lines.
e.zh: 士兵们以整齐的队列穿过阅兵场。

e.en: She {marched} into the boss's office demanding an explanation.
e.zh: 她径直走进老板办公室，要求一个解释。

marcher.t: n. 行进者，游行示威者

e.en: Every {marcher} carried a sign calling for fair wages.
e.zh: 每位游行者都举着呼吁公平工资的标语牌。

e.en: The veteran {marcher} has joined protests for over forty years.
e.zh: 这位老游行者已参加抗议四十多年了。

marches.t:
v. march 第三人称单数
n. 边境地区

e.en: The band {marches} down Main Street every Independence Day.
e.zh: 每逢独立日，乐队都会沿主街行进。

e.en: Several peaceful {marches} took place across the country yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天全国各地举行了几场和平游行。

e.en: The Italian {marchesa} hosted lavish parties at her villa.
e.zh: 这位意大利侯爵夫人在别墅里举办奢华派对。

e.en: She wore a stunning {Marchesa} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她身着一件惊艳的 Marchesa 礼服出席晚会。

e.en: The {marchese} inherited a vast estate in northern Italy.
e.zh: 这位侯爵继承了意大利北部一大片庄园。

e.en: A portrait of the old {marchese} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 一幅老侯爵的画像挂在壁炉上方。

marching.t:
adj. 行进的
n. 列队前进

e.en: The high school {marching} band practiced in the parking lot.
e.zh: 高中行进乐队在停车场排练。

e.en: Protesters were {marching} peacefully toward the city hall.
e.zh: 抗议者正和平地朝市政厅行进。

e.en: The {marchioness} attended the royal wedding wearing a diamond tiara.
e.zh: 那位侯爵夫人戴着钻石头冠出席了王室婚礼。

e.en: As a {marchioness}, she manages several charities and estates.
e.zh: 作为侯爵夫人，她负责管理多个慈善机构和庄园。

marconi.t: n. 马可尼（无线电发明者）

e.en: {Marconi} sent the first transatlantic radio signal in 1901.
e.zh: 马可尼于1901年发出了第一束跨大西洋的无线电信号。

e.en: The museum displays an original {Marconi} wireless transmitter.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着一台原版的马可尼无线发报机。

e.en: The sculptor Brice {Marden} influenced a generation of abstract painters.
e.zh: 雕塑家布莱斯·马登影响了一代抽象派画家。

e.en: We caught the train at {Marden} station on our way to Kent.
e.zh: 我们在前往肯特的途中在玛登站搭上了火车。

e.en: The brown {mare} galloped happily across the open field.
e.zh: 那匹棕色母马在开阔的田野上欢快地奔驰。

e.en: He bought a young {mare} to breed with his stallion.
e.zh: 他买了一匹年轻的母马用来与他的种马配种。

marg.t: n. 人造黄油（margarine 的缩写）

e.en: I'll have a frozen {marg} with extra salt on the rim.
e.zh: 给我来一杯冰沙玛格丽特，杯沿多加点盐。

e.en: Spread some {marg} on the toast instead of butter.
e.zh: 在吐司上抹点人造黄油，别用真黄油。

e.en: She uses {margarine} instead of butter in her cookies.
e.zh: 她做曲奇时用人造黄油代替黄油。

e.en: This brand of {margarine} contains no trans fats.
e.zh: 这个牌子的人造黄油不含反式脂肪。

e.en: I ordered a frozen {margarita} with a salted rim.
e.zh: 我点了一杯杯沿带盐的冰沙玛格丽特。

e.en: Her favorite cocktail is a spicy jalapeño {margarita}.
e.zh: 她最爱的鸡尾酒是辣味墨西哥椒玛格丽特。

margate.t: n. 马盖特（英国海滨城市）

e.en: We took the train to {Margate} for a seaside weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去马盖特度过海边周末。

e.en: {Margate} has become a trendy spot for young artists.
e.zh: 马盖特已成为年轻艺术家的潮流聚集地。

e.en: Spread some {marge} on the toast instead of butter.
e.zh: 在吐司上抹点人造黄油代替黄油。

e.en: My grandma always kept a tub of {marge} in the fridge.
e.zh: 我奶奶冰箱里总放着一盒人造黄油。

e.en: The company's profit {margin} dropped sharply last quarter.
e.zh: 公司上季度的利润率大幅下降。

e.en: She scribbled notes in the {margin} of the textbook.
e.zh: 她在课本的页边空白处随手写了笔记。

marginal.t: adj. 边缘的；微小的；非主流的

e.en: The new update brought only {marginal} improvements to performance.
e.zh: 新版本对性能的提升微乎其微。

e.en: Many {marginal} communities still lack reliable internet access.
e.zh: 许多边缘群体至今仍无法稳定上网。

e.en: His old books are full of fascinating {marginalia} in pencil.
e.zh: 他的旧书里满是用铅笔写的有趣旁注。

e.en: Scholars study the {marginalia} to understand the reader's thoughts.
e.zh: 学者通过研究旁注来了解读者的想法。

marginalisation.t: n. 边缘化（marginalization 英式拼写）

e.en: The report highlights the {marginalisation} of rural workers.
e.zh: 报告强调了农村工人遭受的边缘化。

e.en: Activists are fighting the {marginalisation} of minority languages.
e.zh: 活动人士正在对抗少数民族语言被边缘化的现象。

marginalise.t: v. 使边缘化，排斥（英式拼法）

e.en: New algorithms can {marginalise} smaller content creators online.
e.zh: 新算法可能让小型内容创作者在网上被边缘化。

e.en: Don't {marginalise} junior team members during meetings.
e.zh: 开会时不要冷落初级团队成员。

marginalised.t: adj. 被边缘化的，被排斥的

e.en: The charity supports {marginalised} youth in inner cities.
e.zh: 该慈善机构帮助城市贫民区中被边缘化的青少年。

e.en: Her novel gives voice to historically {marginalised} groups.
e.zh: 她的小说为历史上被边缘化的群体发声。

marginalising.t: v. 正在边缘化（marginalise 的现在分词）

e.en: Tech platforms risk {marginalising} users without smartphones.
e.zh: 科技平台有可能把没有智能手机的用户边缘化。

e.en: The policy ended up {marginalising} part-time workers.
e.zh: 这项政策最终让兼职员工被边缘化了。

e.en: The film explores themes of {marginality} and belonging.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了边缘处境与归属感的主题。

e.en: Her research focuses on the {marginality} of immigrant communities.
e.zh: 她的研究聚焦于移民群体的边缘地位。

marginalization.t: n. 边缘化，被排斥的过程

e.en: Social media can amplify the {marginalization} of dissenting voices.
e.zh: 社交媒体可能加剧对异见声音的边缘化。

e.en: The book examines economic {marginalization} in post-war Europe.
e.zh: 这本书考察了战后欧洲的经济边缘化现象。

marginalize.t: v. 使边缘化，使处于次要地位

e.en: Big chains often {marginalize} small local businesses.
e.zh: 大型连锁店常常把当地小商户挤到边缘。

e.en: We must not {marginalize} disabled employees in hiring decisions.
e.zh: 招聘时我们绝不能让残障员工被边缘化。

marginalized.t: adj. 被边缘化的，被忽视的

e.en: The app aims to empower {marginalized} freelancers worldwide.
e.zh: 该应用旨在赋能全球被边缘化的自由职业者。

e.en: She has spent years advocating for {marginalized} communities.
e.zh: 她多年来一直为弱势群体发声。

e.en: Sales were {marginally} higher than last month.
e.zh: 销售额比上个月略有增长。

e.en: This phone is only {marginally} better than the older model.
e.zh: 这款手机只比旧款稍微好一点。

e.en: Retail {margins} are shrinking due to rising shipping costs.
e.zh: 由于运费上涨,零售利润率正在缩水。

e.en: Please widen the {margins} before printing the document.
e.zh: 打印文档前请把页边距调宽一些。

marguerite.t: n. 玛格丽特（女名）；雏菊

e.en: She picked a white {marguerite} from the meadow.
e.zh: 她从草地上摘了一朵白色的雏菊。

e.en: The garden was dotted with cheerful yellow {marguerite} blooms.
e.zh: 花园里点缀着一朵朵明黄色的雏菊。

e.en: {Maria} sent me a message asking about the meeting.
e.zh: 玛丽亚给我发消息询问会议的事。

e.en: Astronomers can see dark {maria} on the surface of the Moon.
e.zh: 天文学家能在月球表面看到深色的月海。

mariachi.t: n. 墨西哥街头乐队（及其音乐）

e.en: A {mariachi} band played at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 婚礼招待会上有一支墨西哥街头乐队在演奏。

e.en: We danced all night to the lively {mariachi} music.
e.zh: 我们伴着热闹的玛利亚奇音乐跳了一整晚。

marian.t:
n. 玛丽安（人名）
adj. 圣母玛利亚的

e.en: The cathedral is famous for its medieval {Marian} statues.
e.zh: 这座大教堂以中世纪的圣母像而闻名。

e.en: {Marian} works at the bakery on the corner.
e.zh: 玛丽安在街角的那家面包店工作。

mariana.t: n. 玛丽安娜（女名／地名）

e.en: The {Mariana} Trench is the deepest part of the ocean.
e.zh: 马里亚纳海沟是海洋中最深的地方。

e.en: {Mariana} just moved here from Brazil last month.
e.zh: 玛丽安娜上个月刚从巴西搬来这里。

e.en: {Mariculture} provides jobs for many coastal villages.
e.zh: 海水养殖为许多沿海村庄提供了就业机会。

e.en: Sustainable {mariculture} could help feed a growing population.
e.zh: 可持续的海水养殖有助于养活不断增长的人口。

marietta.t: n. 玛丽埃塔（人名／地名）

e.en: We stopped in {Marietta} for lunch on our road trip.
e.zh: 我们公路旅行途中在玛丽埃塔停下来吃了午饭。

e.en: {Marietta} has a lovely historic town square.
e.zh: 玛丽埃塔有一个迷人的历史悠久的镇中心广场。

e.en: She planted bright orange {marigold} flowers along the path.
e.zh: 她沿着小路种了一排鲜橙色的万寿菊。

e.en: Indian weddings often feature garlands of {marigold} blossoms.
e.zh: 印度婚礼上常常悬挂着万寿菊花环。

e.en: Several states have legalized recreational {marijuana} use.
e.zh: 美国多个州已将娱乐用大麻合法化。

e.en: The smell of {marijuana} drifted from the apartment next door.
e.zh: 隔壁公寓飘出一阵大麻的味道。

e.en: He plays the {marimba} in a Latin jazz band.
e.zh: 他在一支拉丁爵士乐队里演奏马林巴琴。

e.en: The {marimba} solo brought the whole audience to its feet.
e.zh: 马林巴琴的独奏让全场观众起立鼓掌。

marin.t: n. 马林（人名／加州地名）

e.en: We hiked through {Marin} County on Saturday morning.
e.zh: 周六上午我们在马林县徒步。

e.en: Houses in {Marin} have stunning views of the bay.
e.zh: 马林县的房子能看到壮观的海湾景色。

marina.t: n. 游艇停泊港；玛丽娜（女名）

e.en: Yachts were docked all along the sunny {marina}.
e.zh: 游艇沿着阳光明媚的码头停了一长排。

e.en: We had dinner at a restaurant overlooking the {marina}.
e.zh: 我们在一家俯瞰游艇码头的餐厅吃了晚饭。

marinade.t:
n. 腌汁，腌泡调料
v. 腌制

e.en: Let the chicken sit in the {marinade} for two hours.
e.zh: 把鸡肉放在腌料里浸两个小时。

e.en: This soy and ginger {marinade} works great on beef.
e.zh: 这款酱油姜汁腌料配牛肉非常棒。

marinara.t: n. 意式番茄酱（意面酱）

e.en: I made spaghetti with homemade {marinara} sauce tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我做了配自制番茄酱的意大利面。

e.en: The mozzarella sticks come with a side of {marinara}.
e.zh: 炸奶酪条配有一份番茄蘸酱。

e.en: {Marinate} the steak overnight for the best flavor.
e.zh: 把牛排腌一晚上,味道最好。

e.en: Let the idea {marinate} for a few days before deciding.
e.zh: 让这个想法沉淀几天再做决定。

e.en: The {marinated} tofu turned out crispy and flavorful.
e.zh: 腌过的豆腐做出来又脆又入味。

e.en: She {marinated} the lamb in yogurt and spices.
e.zh: 她用酸奶和香料腌制了羊肉。

marine.t:
adj. 海洋的，海事的
n. 海军陆战队员

e.en: Plastic pollution is devastating {marine} ecosystems worldwide.
e.zh: 塑料污染正在重创全球海洋生态系统。

e.en: His brother served as a {marine} for eight years.
e.zh: 他哥哥当了八年海军陆战队员。

e.en: The old {mariner} told tales of storms at sea.
e.zh: 那位老水手讲述着海上风暴的故事。

e.en: NASA's {Mariner} probes explored Mars in the 1960s.
e.zh: 美国宇航局的水手号探测器在六十年代探测了火星。

mariners.t: n. 水手们；西雅图水手队

e.en: Ancient {mariners} navigated using the stars and currents.
e.zh: 古代水手依靠星星和洋流来航行。

e.en: The Seattle {Mariners} won last night's baseball game.
e.zh: 西雅图水手队赢了昨晚的棒球比赛。

e.en: Dan {Marino} is a legendary NFL quarterback.
e.zh: 丹·马里诺是一位传奇的橄榄球四分卫。

e.en: This sweater is made of soft {Marino} wool.
e.zh: 这件毛衣是用柔软的美利奴羊毛织成的。

e.en: Super {Mario} is one of the best-selling games ever.
e.zh: 《超级马里奥》是史上最畅销的游戏之一。

e.en: {Mario} from accounting will join the meeting at three.
e.zh: 会计部的马里奥三点会来参加会议。

e.en: {Marion} brought homemade cookies to the office.
e.zh: 玛丽昂带了自制饼干来办公室。

e.en: We drove past {Marion} on our way to the lake.
e.zh: 我们去湖边的路上经过了马里恩。

e.en: The kids loved the {marionette} show at the festival.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢节日上的提线木偶表演。

e.en: He carved a wooden {marionette} of a smiling clown.
e.zh: 他雕了一个微笑小丑的木制提线木偶。

mariposa.t: n. 马里波萨（地名）；蝴蝶百合

e.en: A bright {mariposa} fluttered across the meadow.
e.zh: 一只鲜艳的蝴蝶在草地上翩翩飞过。

e.en: We camped near {Mariposa} on our trip to Yosemite.
e.zh: 我们去优胜美地的路上在马里波萨附近露营。

e.en: {Maris} potatoes are popular for making creamy mash.
e.zh: 玛丽斯土豆很适合做奶香土豆泥。

e.en: Roger {Maris} held the home run record for decades.
e.zh: 罗杰·马里斯保持了几十年的本垒打纪录。

marist.t: n. 天主教圣母会修士

e.en: He attended a {Marist} high school in the city.
e.zh: 他在城里一所玛利亚修会的高中读书。

e.en: {Marist} College has a strong basketball program.
e.zh: 玛利斯特学院有很强的篮球项目。

e.en: They are going through some {marital} difficulties right now.
e.zh: 他们目前正经历一些婚姻问题。

e.en: Please indicate your {marital} status on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上注明您的婚姻状况。

maritima.t: adj. 滨海的（拉丁语，常用于物种名）

e.en: Pinus {maritima} grows along the Mediterranean coast.
e.zh: 海岸松生长在地中海沿岸。

e.en: Botanists studied the rare {maritima} plant near the cliffs.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了悬崖附近罕见的滨海植物。

maritime.t: adj. 海事的，海运的；沿海的

e.en: Singapore is one of the world's busiest {maritime} hubs.
e.zh: 新加坡是全球最繁忙的海运枢纽之一。

e.en: He studied {maritime} law before joining the shipping firm.
e.zh: 他加入航运公司前学过海事法。

e.en: Add a pinch of {marjoram} to the tomato sauce.
e.zh: 在番茄酱里加一小撮马郁兰。

e.en: Fresh {marjoram} pairs beautifully with roasted lamb.
e.zh: 新鲜马郁兰与烤羊肉是绝配。

mark.t:
v. 标记；标注
n. 记号；分数

e.en: Please {mark} the correct answer on your answer sheet.
e.zh: 请在答题卡上标出正确答案。

e.en: There's a small {mark} on the screen of my phone.
e.zh: 我手机屏幕上有一个小印记。

mark-up.t:
n. 加价；涨价幅度
n. 标记（代码标签）

e.en: The store charges a huge {mark-up} on imported wines.
e.zh: 那家店对进口红酒加价很高。

e.en: He added some HTML {mark-up} to format the page.
e.zh: 他加了一些 HTML 标记来排版这个页面。

mark-ups.t: n. 加价；涨价幅度（复数）

e.en: Luxury brands often have enormous {mark-ups} on basic items.
e.zh: 奢侈品牌的基础款往往加价幅度极大。

e.en: The editor sent back the document with several {mark-ups}.
e.zh: 编辑把文件改了几处批注后发回来了。

markdown.t:
n. Markdown 标记语言
n. 降价

e.en: I wrote my notes in {markdown} for easy formatting.
e.zh: 我用 Markdown 写笔记,方便排版。

e.en: The store offered a 30% {markdown} on winter coats.
e.zh: 那家店冬季外套打了七折。

marked.t:
adj. 明显的；显著的
v. 标记（mark 过去式）

e.en: There has been a {marked} improvement in air quality.
e.zh: 空气质量有了明显的改善。

e.en: She {marked} the important pages with sticky notes.
e.zh: 她用便利贴标出了重要的页面。

e.en: Sales have {markedly} improved since the new campaign launched.
e.zh: 自从新一轮营销活动启动以来，销售额显著提升。

e.en: Her tone was {markedly} different from yesterday's meeting.
e.zh: 她的语气与昨天会议上明显不同。

e.en: Please use a black {marker} to label the boxes clearly.
e.zh: 请用黑色记号笔在箱子上清楚地写好标签。

e.en: Rising sea levels are a {marker} of climate change.
e.zh: 海平面上升是气候变化的一个标志。

e.en: The kids left their {markers} all over the kitchen table.
e.zh: 孩子们把记号笔扔得餐桌上到处都是。

e.en: Doctors look for genetic {markers} linked to the disease.
e.zh: 医生在寻找与该疾病相关的基因标志物。

market.t:
n. 市场
v. 推销；营销

e.en: The stock {market} closed lower after the inflation report.
e.zh: 通胀数据公布后，股市收盘下跌。

e.en: I bought fresh fish at the morning {market}.
e.zh: 我在早市上买了新鲜的鱼。

marketabilities.t: n. 适销性；市场性（复数）

e.en: The report compared the {marketabilities} of three competing prototypes.
e.zh: 报告比较了三种竞品原型的市场适销性。

e.en: Investors weigh the {marketabilities} of different bond issues carefully.
e.zh: 投资者会仔细权衡不同债券的市场流通性。

marketability.t: n. 适销性；市场接受度

e.en: An MBA can boost your {marketability} in finance roles.
e.zh: MBA 学位可以提升你在金融岗位上的求职竞争力。

e.en: They tested the product's {marketability} with focus groups.
e.zh: 他们通过焦点小组测试了该产品的市场接受度。

e.en: Coding is a highly {marketable} skill these days.
e.zh: 如今编程是一项非常抢手的技能。

e.en: The startup pivoted to build a more {marketable} product.
e.zh: 这家初创公司转型，打造更有市场前景的产品。

e.en: The drink is {marketed} as a healthy energy booster.
e.zh: 这款饮料被宣传为健康的能量补充饮品。

e.en: They {marketed} the app aggressively on social media.
e.zh: 他们在社交媒体上大力推广这款应用。

marketeer.t: n. 营销人员；市场交易者

e.en: He works as a digital {marketeer} for a fashion brand.
e.zh: 他在一家时装品牌担任数字营销人员。

e.en: A skilled {marketeer} knows how to read consumer trends.
e.zh: 出色的营销人员懂得解读消费者趋势。

e.en: Every smart {marketer} tracks click-through rates closely.
e.zh: 聪明的营销人员都会密切关注点击率。

e.en: She is a freelance {marketer} working with several startups.
e.zh: 她是一名自由营销顾问，为多家初创公司服务。

e.en: The {marketing} team is launching a new ad campaign next week.
e.zh: 营销团队下周将推出一个新广告活动。

e.en: Influencer {marketing} now drives much of online retail.
e.zh: 网红营销如今推动了大量的线上零售业务。

marketings.t: n. 营销活动（复数，罕用）

e.en: The agency handles global {marketings} for several luxury brands.
e.zh: 这家代理商负责多个奢侈品牌的全球营销业务。

e.en: Their regional {marketings} target very different demographics.
e.zh: 他们各地区的营销活动针对的人群差异很大。

e.en: The {marketization} of healthcare remains a controversial topic.
e.zh: 医疗服务的市场化至今仍是一个有争议的话题。

e.en: Rapid {marketization} transformed the country's economy in a decade.
e.zh: 快速的市场化在十年间改变了这个国家的经济。

marketplace.t:
n. 市场；集市
n. 交易平台（线上）

e.en: Etsy is a popular online {marketplace} for handmade goods.
e.zh: Etsy 是一个很受欢迎的手工艺品在线市场。

e.en: New competitors are entering the {marketplace} every month.
e.zh: 每个月都有新的竞争者进入这个市场。

marketplaces.t: n. 市场；交易平台（复数）

e.en: Amazon and eBay are the largest online {marketplaces} worldwide.
e.zh: 亚马逊和 eBay 是全球最大的在线交易平台。

e.en: Local {marketplaces} still thrive in many small towns.
e.zh: 在许多小镇上，本地集市依然兴旺。

markets.t:
n. 市场（复数）
v. 推销（第三人称单数）

e.en: Asian {markets} opened higher after the policy announcement.
e.zh: 政策公布后，亚洲股市高开。

e.en: The company is expanding into emerging {markets} like Vietnam.
e.zh: 该公司正在拓展像越南这样的新兴市场。

e.en: {Markham} is a diverse city just north of Toronto.
e.zh: 万锦是位于多伦多以北、族裔多元的城市。

e.en: Beryl {Markham} was a pioneering aviator and writer.
e.zh: 贝丽尔·马卡姆是一位先驱性的飞行员和作家。

marking.t:
n. 标记；斑纹
v. 标记（mark 进行式）

e.en: The teacher spent the weekend {marking} exam papers.
e.zh: 老师整个周末都在批改考卷。

e.en: A faint {marking} on the map showed the buried treasure.
e.zh: 地图上一个淡淡的标记指出了埋藏宝藏的位置。

markov.t: n. 马尔可夫（姓氏，常指马尔可夫链）

e.en: A {Markov} chain models systems where each state depends only on the previous one.
e.zh: 马尔可夫链用于建模仅依赖于前一状态的系统。

e.en: The chatbot's early version used a simple {Markov} model.
e.zh: 这款聊天机器人的早期版本使用的是简单的马尔可夫模型。

marks.t:
n. 记号；分数（复数）
v. 标记（第三人称单数）

e.en: She got top {marks} in the math final this term.
e.zh: 她在本学期的数学期末考中拿到了最高分。

e.en: There are scratch {marks} all over the wooden floor.
e.zh: 木地板上到处都是划痕。

e.en: The army trained him to be an elite {marksman}.
e.zh: 军队把他训练成了一名顶尖的神枪手。

e.en: As a young {marksman}, she won several national competitions.
e.zh: 作为年轻的射击选手，她赢得了多项全国比赛。

e.en: His {marksmanship} improved after months of daily practice.
e.zh: 经过几个月的每日训练，他的射击技术大有提升。

e.en: Olympic biathletes need exceptional {marksmanship} under fatigue.
e.zh: 奥运冬两项选手需要在疲劳状态下保持出色的射击精度。

markup.t:
n. 标记语言（如 HTML）
n. 加价

e.en: HTML is the {markup} language used to build web pages.
e.zh: HTML 是用来构建网页的标记语言。

e.en: The retailer adds a 50% {markup} on most clothing items.
e.zh: 这家零售商在大多数服装上加价 50%。

e.en: Farmers once spread {marl} on fields to enrich the soil.
e.zh: 农民过去常把泥灰岩撒到田里以改良土壤。

e.en: The cliffs are made of soft, crumbling {marl}.
e.zh: 那些悬崖是由松软易碎的泥灰岩构成的。

e.en: Ernest {Marland} was an oil tycoon and Oklahoma governor.
e.zh: 欧内斯特·马兰是石油大亨，也曾任俄克拉荷马州州长。

e.en: The {Marland} mansion is a popular tourist site in Ponca City.
e.zh: 马兰庄园是庞卡市一处热门的旅游景点。

e.en: {Marlboro} cigarettes were once advertised by rugged cowboys.
e.zh: 万宝路香烟曾以粗犷的牛仔形象做广告。

e.en: He grew up in a small town near {Marlboro}, Massachusetts.
e.zh: 他在马萨诸塞州马尔伯勒附近的小镇长大。

e.en: {Marlborough} is famous for its crisp Sauvignon Blanc wines.
e.zh: 马尔堡以其清爽的长相思白葡萄酒而闻名。

e.en: The Duke of {Marlborough} won the Battle of Blenheim in 1704.
e.zh: 马尔伯勒公爵在 1704 年的布伦海姆战役中获胜。

marley.t: n. 马利（人名，如 Bob Marley）

e.en: Bob {Marley} brought reggae music to a global audience.
e.zh: 鲍勃·马利把雷鬼音乐带给了全世界的听众。

e.en: Their golden retriever, {Marley}, loves chasing tennis balls.
e.zh: 他们那只名叫马利的金毛猎犬最爱追网球。

e.en: He hooked a huge {marlin} off the coast of Hawaii.
e.zh: 他在夏威夷海岸外钓上了一条巨大的马林鱼。

e.en: The blue {marlin} is one of the fastest fish in the ocean.
e.zh: 蓝马林鱼是海洋中游速最快的鱼类之一。

e.en: {Marlow} is a charming riverside town in Buckinghamshire.
e.zh: 马洛是白金汉郡一座风景宜人的河畔小镇。

e.en: Philip {Marlow} narrates many of Chandler's detective novels.
e.zh: 菲利普·马洛是钱德勒许多侦探小说的叙述者。

marlowe.t: n. 马洛（姓氏，如剧作家 Marlowe）

e.en: Christopher {Marlowe} was a contemporary and rival of Shakespeare.
e.zh: 克里斯托弗·马洛是莎士比亚同时代的对手剧作家。

e.en: Detective Philip {Marlowe} is a classic noir character.
e.zh: 侦探菲利普·马洛是经典黑色小说中的人物。

e.en: I spread orange {marmalade} on my morning toast.
e.zh: 我在早餐吐司上抹了橙子果酱。

e.en: Paddington Bear is famously fond of {marmalade} sandwiches.
e.zh: 帕丁顿熊非常喜欢吃橘子酱三明治，这是出了名的。

marmite.t: n. 马麦酱（酵母抹酱品牌）

e.en: Brits either love {marmite} or absolutely hate it.
e.zh: 英国人对马麦酱要么深爱，要么彻底讨厌。

e.en: She spread a thin layer of {marmite} on hot buttered toast.
e.zh: 她在热乎乎的黄油吐司上薄薄涂了一层马麦酱。

e.en: A tiny {marmoset} clung to the branch above us.
e.zh: 一只小狨猴紧紧地抓着我们头顶的树枝。

e.en: The pygmy {marmoset} is the world's smallest monkey.
e.zh: 侏狨是世界上最小的猴子。

e.en: A fat {marmot} sunned itself on the alpine rock.
e.zh: 一只胖乎乎的土拨鼠在高山岩石上晒太阳。

e.en: Hikers often spot a {marmot} whistling near the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者常会在小径附近看到吹哨示警的土拨鼠。

e.en: The Battle of the {Marne} halted the German advance in 1914.
e.zh: 马恩河战役在 1914 年阻止了德军的推进。

e.en: We took a boat trip along the river {Marne}.
e.zh: 我们沿着马恩河乘船游览了一番。

marnier.t: n. 玛尼埃（如 Grand Marnier 香橙酒）

e.en: She added a splash of Grand {Marnier} to the chocolate sauce.
e.zh: 她往巧克力酱里加了一点干邑橙酒。

e.en: Crepes Suzette are flambéed with Grand {Marnier} at the table.
e.zh: 苏珊薄饼会在客人桌前用干邑橙酒燃烧调味。

maronite.t:
n. 马龙派（基督教教派）
adj. 马龙派的

e.en: The {Maronite} church has deep roots in Lebanon.
e.zh: 马龙派教会在黎巴嫩有着深厚的历史根基。

e.en: Many Lebanese immigrants brought {Maronite} traditions to Brazil.
e.zh: 许多黎巴嫩移民把马龙派的传统带到了巴西。

maroon.t:
n. 栗色；褐红色
v. 使困于荒岛

e.en: She wore a {maroon} sweater with dark jeans.
e.zh: 她穿了一件栗色毛衣，配深色牛仔裤。

e.en: The school's official color is a deep {maroon}.
e.zh: 这所学校的正式校色是深栗色。

marooned.t: adj. 被困的（尤指荒岛上）

e.en: The sailors were {marooned} on a tiny tropical island.
e.zh: 那些水手被困在一座小小的热带岛屿上。

e.en: A snowstorm left dozens of drivers {marooned} on the highway.
e.zh: 一场暴风雪让几十名司机被困在高速公路上。

e.en: Miss {Marple} solves crimes with quiet observation and gossip.
e.zh: 马普尔小姐靠静静观察和闲谈来破案。

e.en: Agatha Christie's Miss {Marple} lives in the village of St. Mary Mead.
e.zh: 阿加莎·克里斯蒂笔下的马普尔小姐住在圣玛丽米德村。

e.en: Ferrari is one of the most prestigious automotive {marque}s in the world.
e.zh: 法拉利是全球最负盛名的汽车品牌之一。

e.en: Collectors prize cars from this iconic British {marque}.
e.zh: 收藏家们珍视这一标志性英国车厂的车型。

marquee.t:
n. 大帐篷；（影院）遮檐招牌
adj. 一流的

e.en: Her name lit up the cinema's {marquee} downtown.
e.zh: 她的名字闪耀在市中心电影院的霓虹灯招牌上。

e.en: The wedding reception was held under a huge white {marquee}.
e.zh: 婚礼宴会在一座巨大的白色帐篷下举行。

e.en: Luxury {marques} like Bentley showed concept cars at the Geneva show.
e.zh: 宾利等豪华车品牌在日内瓦车展上展出了概念车。

e.en: The museum displays vintage models from forgotten Italian {marques}.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着已被遗忘的意大利车厂的老爷车。

e.en: The {marquess} inherited a sprawling estate in Scotland.
e.zh: 这位侯爵继承了苏格兰一座占地广阔的庄园。

e.en: A {marquess} ranks just below a duke in the British peerage.
e.zh: 在英国贵族体系中，侯爵的地位仅次于公爵。

e.en: The antique cabinet features intricate floral {marquetry}.
e.zh: 这件古董柜台上有精致的花卉镶嵌细工。

e.en: He learned {marquetry} from his grandfather, a master cabinetmaker.
e.zh: 他跟着身为细木工大师的祖父学习了镶嵌细工。

e.en: The young {marquis} hosted lavish parties at his château.
e.zh: 这位年轻的侯爵在他的城堡里举办奢华的派对。

e.en: A {marquis} diamond cut has an elegant pointed oval shape.
e.zh: 马眼形钻石切割呈优雅的尖头椭圆形。

marquise.t: n. 侯爵夫人；马眼形宝石

e.en: He proposed with a stunning {marquise}-cut diamond ring.
e.zh: 他用一枚惊艳的马眼形切割钻戒求了婚。

e.en: The {marquise} entertained guests in her Parisian salon.
e.zh: 侯爵夫人在她巴黎的沙龙里招待客人。

e.en: {Marram} grass helps stabilize the shifting sand dunes.
e.zh: 沙茅草有助于固定流动的沙丘。

e.en: We walked through tall {marram} on the way to the beach.
e.zh: 我们穿过高高的沙茅草走向海滩。

e.en: The festival was {marred} by heavy rain and traffic chaos.
e.zh: 这场音乐节被大雨和交通混乱搞得大煞风景。

e.en: A long scratch {marred} the surface of the new table.
e.zh: 一道长长的划痕破坏了这张新桌子的表面。

e.en: Their {marriage} has lasted over thirty happy years.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻已经幸福地持续了三十多年。

e.en: Same-sex {marriage} is now legal in many countries.
e.zh: 同性婚姻现在在许多国家是合法的。

marriageable.t: adj. 适婚的；到结婚年龄的

e.en: In some cultures, daughters marry once they reach {marriageable} age.
e.zh: 在某些文化中,女儿到了适婚年龄就会出嫁。

e.en: She had two {marriageable} sons living at home.
e.zh: 她家里有两个到了适婚年龄的儿子。

e.en: Arranged {marriages} are still common in parts of Asia.
e.zh: 包办婚姻在亚洲部分地区仍然很常见。

e.en: Roughly half of all {marriages} end in divorce nowadays.
e.zh: 如今大约一半的婚姻以离婚告终。

married.t:
adj. 已婚的
v. marry 的过去式

e.en: They got {married} on a beach in Bali.
e.zh: 他们在巴厘岛的海滩上结了婚。

e.en: My older sister has been {married} for ten years.
e.zh: 我姐姐结婚已经十年了。

marries.t: v. marry 的第三人称单数

e.en: This recipe {marries} sweet and spicy flavors perfectly.
e.zh: 这道食谱将甜味和辣味完美结合。

e.en: She {marries} her childhood sweetheart next month.
e.zh: 她下个月就要嫁给青梅竹马的恋人。

e.en: We booked a suite at the {Marriott} downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心的万豪酒店订了一间套房。

e.en: The conference will be held at the {Marriott} hotel.
e.zh: 会议将在万豪酒店举行。

e.en: The dessert was topped with sweet {marron} cream.
e.zh: 这款甜点上面铺着甜栗子奶油。

e.en: She wore a beautiful {marron} colored scarf.
e.zh: 她戴着一条漂亮的栗色围巾。

e.en: Doctors performed a bone {marrow} transplant on the patient.
e.zh: 医生为病人做了骨髓移植手术。

e.en: The cold chilled me to the {marrow}.
e.zh: 寒冷让我冻到了骨子里。

e.en: Will you {marry} me next spring?
e.zh: 明年春天你愿意嫁给我吗?

e.en: They decided to {marry} after dating for five years.
e.zh: 他们恋爱五年后决定结婚。

e.en: She is {marrying} her college boyfriend this summer.
e.zh: 她今年夏天要和大学男友结婚。

e.en: He spent years {marrying} technology with traditional craftsmanship.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间将科技与传统工艺融合在一起。

mars.t:
n. 火星
v. 损坏（mar 的第三人称单数）

e.en: NASA plans to send astronauts to {Mars} by 2040.
e.zh: 美国宇航局计划在2040年前将宇航员送上火星。

e.en: One careless comment can {mars} an otherwise great speech.
e.zh: 一句不慎的话就能毁掉一场原本精彩的演讲。

e.en: The crowd sang the {Marseillaise} before the football match.
e.zh: 足球赛开始前,人群高唱马赛曲。

e.en: The {Marseillaise} is the national anthem of France.
e.zh: 马赛曲是法国的国歌。

e.en: We took a ferry from {Marseille} to Corsica.
e.zh: 我们从马赛搭乘渡轮去科西嘉岛。

e.en: {Marseille} is France's oldest and second-largest city.
e.zh: 马赛是法国最古老、第二大的城市。

e.en: The ship docked at the port of {Marseilles}.
e.zh: 那艘船在马赛港靠岸了。

e.en: She studied French cuisine in {Marseilles} for two years.
e.zh: 她在马赛学习了两年法国菜。

e.en: Migrating birds rest in the {marsh} every autumn.
e.zh: 每年秋天,候鸟都会在沼泽地里休息。

e.en: Be careful walking through the {marsh} after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后走过沼泽地时要小心。

marshal.t:
n. 元帅；司仪
v. 整理；集结

e.en: The general was promoted to field {marshal} last year.
e.zh: 那位将军去年被晋升为陆军元帅。

e.en: She had to {marshal} her arguments for the debate.
e.zh: 她得为辩论整理好自己的论据。

e.en: The {Marshall} Plan helped rebuild Europe after the war.
e.zh: 马歇尔计划帮助欧洲在战后重建。

e.en: {Marshall} amplifiers are popular among rock guitarists.
e.zh: 马歇尔音箱在摇滚吉他手中很受欢迎。

e.en: The lawyer spent hours {marshalling} evidence for the trial.
e.zh: 律师花了几个小时为审判整理证据。

e.en: Trains were {marshalling} in the rail yard at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨火车正在调车场编组。

marshalsea.t: n. 马夏尔西（伦敦旧监狱）

e.en: Dickens's father was imprisoned in the {Marshalsea} for debt.
e.zh: 狄更斯的父亲曾因欠债被关进马夏尔西监狱。

e.en: The {Marshalsea} prison appears in several Victorian novels.
e.zh: 马夏尔西监狱出现在多部维多利亚时期的小说中。

e.en: The {marshland} provides crucial habitat for migrating waterbirds.
e.zh: 这片沼泽地为迁徙水鸟提供了重要的栖息地。

e.en: Developers wanted to drain the {marshland} for housing.
e.zh: 开发商想把那片沼泽地排干用来盖房子。

e.en: We roasted {marshmallow} sticks over the campfire last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们在篝火上烤棉花糖串。

e.en: She likes hot chocolate with extra {marshmallow} on top.
e.zh: 她喜欢热巧克力上多加一些棉花糖。

e.en: The {marshy} ground made hiking extremely difficult.
e.zh: 沼泽般的地面让徒步变得非常艰难。

e.en: Frogs thrive in the {marshy} areas near the lake.
e.zh: 青蛙在湖边沼泽地带繁衍兴旺。

marsupial.t:
n. 有袋动物
adj. 有袋类的

e.en: The kangaroo is Australia's most famous {marsupial}.
e.zh: 袋鼠是澳大利亚最著名的有袋类动物。

e.en: Baby {marsupial} animals develop inside their mother's pouch.
e.zh: 有袋类动物的幼崽在母亲的育儿袋里发育。

e.en: I bought snacks at the convenience {mart} downstairs.
e.zh: 我在楼下的便利店买了点零食。

e.en: The annual book {mart} attracts thousands of collectors.
e.zh: 一年一度的图书集市吸引了成千上万的收藏者。

martello.t: n. 马特洛塔（沿海圆形防御塔）

e.en: A stone {martello} tower guards the harbor entrance.
e.zh: 一座石砌的圆形碉堡守卫着港口入口。

e.en: The coast is dotted with old {martello} towers.
e.zh: 海岸边散布着许多古老的马泰洛碉堡。

e.en: The pine {marten} is a rare sight in British forests.
e.zh: 松貂在英国森林里难得一见。

e.en: A {marten} darted across the trail and vanished.
e.zh: 一只貂从小路上窜过,转眼就不见了。

martens.t: n. 貂（复数）；马汀（Dr. Martens 品牌）

e.en: Dr. {Martens} boots became a punk fashion icon.
e.zh: 马汀博士靴成了朋克时尚的标志。

e.en: Pine {martens} are slowly returning to Scottish woodlands.
e.zh: 松貂正慢慢回到苏格兰的林地。

e.en: My son practices {martial} arts three times a week.
e.zh: 我儿子每周练习三次武术。

e.en: The country was placed under {martial} law overnight.
e.zh: 这个国家一夜之间进入了戒严状态。

martian.t:
n. 火星人
adj. 火星的

e.en: Scientists found evidence of ancient water on the {Martian} surface.
e.zh: 科学家在火星表面发现了古代水的证据。

e.en: The novel features a friendly {Martian} who visits Earth.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位友好的火星人造访地球的故事。

e.en: A purple {martin} built its nest in our birdhouse.
e.zh: 一只紫崖燕在我们的鸟屋里筑了巢。

e.en: {Martin} Luther King Jr. inspired millions with his speeches.
e.zh: 马丁·路德·金的演讲鼓舞了数百万人。

martinet.t: n. 严格执行纪律的人

e.en: Our new boss is a real {martinet} about deadlines.
e.zh: 我们的新老板对截止日期非常严苛。

e.en: The drill sergeant was a notorious {martinet}.
e.zh: 那位训练士官是出了名的严格家伙。

e.en: He ordered a dry {martini} with two olives.
e.zh: 他点了一杯干马提尼,加两颗橄榄。

e.en: James Bond prefers his {martini} shaken, not stirred.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·邦德喜欢摇匀的马提尼,而不是搅拌的。

e.en: We spent our honeymoon on the island of {Martinique}.
e.zh: 我们在马提尼克岛度过了蜜月。

e.en: {Martinique} is a French overseas territory in the Caribbean.
e.zh: 马提尼克是法国在加勒比海的海外领地。

martyr.t:
n. 烈士，殉道者
v. 使殉难

e.en: She was hailed as a {martyr} for press freedom.
e.zh: 她被誉为捍卫新闻自由的烈士。

e.en: Stop playing the {martyr} and ask for help.
e.zh: 别再装受害者了,开口求助吧。

e.en: His {martyrdom} inspired generations of activists worldwide.
e.zh: 他的殉难精神激励了世界各地几代活动家。

e.en: The painting depicts the {martyrdom} of Saint Sebastian.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了圣塞巴斯蒂安的殉道场景。

martyred.t:
adj. 殉难的
v. 使殉难（过去式）

e.en: The priest was {martyred} for refusing to renounce his faith.
e.zh: 那位神父因拒绝放弃信仰而殉道。

e.en: She gave me a {martyred} look and washed the dishes.
e.zh: 她苦着脸看了我一眼,然后去洗碗了。

maru.t: n. 丸（日语，常用于船名）

e.en: Japanese ship names often end with the suffix {maru}.
e.zh: 日本船名经常以"丸"作为后缀。

e.en: The cargo ship Nippon {Maru} arrived in port today.
e.zh: 货船日本丸号今天抵达港口。

marvel.t:
v. 惊叹，惊奇
n. 奇迹；漫威

e.en: Tourists {marvel} at the beauty of the Grand Canyon.
e.zh: 游客们对大峡谷的壮丽美景赞叹不已。

e.en: The new smartphone is a technological {marvel}.
e.zh: 这款新智能手机是一个科技奇迹。

e.en: She {marveled} at how quickly her children had grown.
e.zh: 她惊叹于孩子们成长得如此之快。

e.en: Visitors {marveled} at the intricate carvings on the temple walls.
e.zh: 游客们对寺庙墙上精致的雕刻赞叹不已。

e.en: I stood there {marveling} at the northern lights for hours.
e.zh: 我站在那里看着北极光惊叹了好几个小时。

e.en: He kept {marveling} at how clean the new apartment was.
e.zh: 他一直惊叹于新公寓有多干净。

e.en: We had a {marvellous} time at the seaside last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在海边玩得棒极了。

e.en: The chef prepared a {marvellous} five-course dinner.
e.zh: 厨师准备了一顿超棒的五道菜晚餐。

e.en: Everything worked out {marvellously} despite the bad weather.
e.zh: 尽管天气不好,一切还是进展得非常顺利。

e.en: The new dress fit her {marvellously}.
e.zh: 那件新裙子非常合身,简直完美。

e.en: You did a {marvelous} job on the presentation.
e.zh: 你的演讲做得棒极了。

e.en: What a {marvelous} idea for a birthday surprise!
e.zh: 这个生日惊喜的点子真是太棒了!

e.en: The two flavors blend {marvelously} in this dish.
e.zh: 这道菜中两种味道融合得妙不可言。

e.en: She sang {marvelously} at the school concert last night.
e.zh: 昨晚学校的音乐会上她唱得非常出色。

marvels.t:
n. 奇迹（复数）
v. 惊叹（第三人称单数）

e.en: The pyramids are among the great {marvels} of antiquity.
e.zh: 金字塔是古代的伟大奇迹之一。

e.en: He never stops talking about the {marvels} of modern medicine.
e.zh: 他总是不停地谈论现代医学的奇迹。

e.en: Karl {Marx} wrote Das Kapital in the British Museum.
e.zh: 卡尔·马克思在大英博物馆里写了《资本论》。

e.en: Groucho {Marx} was famous for his quick-witted humor.
e.zh: 格劳乔·马克思以他机智的幽默而闻名。

e.en: The professor offered a {Marxian} analysis of global capitalism.
e.zh: 教授对全球资本主义做了马克思主义式的分析。

e.en: His essay applies {Marxian} theory to modern labor markets.
e.zh: 他的文章将马克思主义理论应用于现代劳动力市场。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on the influence of {Marxism} in Asia.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了马克思主义在亚洲的影响。

e.en: {Marxism} critiques the inequalities created by capitalism.
e.zh: 马克思主义批判资本主义所造成的不平等。

marxist.t:
n. 马克思主义者
adj. 马克思主义的

e.en: He identifies as a {Marxist} historian focused on labor.
e.zh: 他自称是一位专注于劳工史的马克思主义历史学家。

e.en: The party adopted a {Marxist} approach to economic policy.
e.zh: 该党在经济政策上采取了马克思主义的路线。

e.en: Crab cakes are a famous specialty of {Maryland}.
e.zh: 蟹饼是马里兰州著名的特色美食。

e.en: She moved to {Maryland} for a new tech job.
e.zh: 她为了一份新的科技工作搬到了马里兰州。

marylebone.t: n. 马里波恩（伦敦地名）

e.en: We met for coffee near {Marylebone} station last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在马里波恩车站附近见面喝咖啡。

e.en: {Marylebone} has some of London's most charming boutique shops.
e.zh: 马里波恩有伦敦一些最迷人的精品店。

e.en: The cake was covered in a thick layer of {marzipan}.
e.zh: 蛋糕表面覆盖着厚厚一层杏仁膏。

e.en: She shaped tiny fruits out of colored {marzipan}.
e.zh: 她用彩色杏仁膏捏出小小的水果造型。

mas.t: n. 妈（ma 的复数/口语）

e.en: They rented an old stone {mas} in Provence for the summer.
e.zh: 他们夏天在普罗旺斯租了一栋古老的石头农舍。

e.en: The Provençal {mas} had thick walls and shuttered windows.
e.zh: 那座普罗旺斯农舍有厚厚的墙和带百叶的窗户。

masa.t: n. 马萨（墨西哥玉米面团）

e.en: She kneaded the {masa} until it was soft and smooth.
e.zh: 她揉着玉米面团,直到变得柔软光滑。

e.en: Fresh {masa} is essential for making authentic tortillas.
e.zh: 做正宗玉米饼少不了新鲜的玉米面团。

e.en: The {Masai} warriors greeted us with a traditional jumping dance.
e.zh: 马赛族战士用传统的跳跃舞蹈欢迎我们。

e.en: We visited a {Masai} village on the edge of the Serengeti.
e.zh: 我们参观了塞伦盖蒂边上的一个马赛村庄。

masala.t: n. 马萨拉（印度混合香料）

e.en: He ordered chicken tikka {masala} with extra naan bread.
e.zh: 他点了一份玛萨拉鸡肉,还加了印度烤饼。

e.en: She blended her own {masala} from freshly toasted spices.
e.zh: 她用现烤的香料调配自己的玛萨拉粉。

e.en: She applied a coat of {mascara} before heading out.
e.zh: 她出门前刷了一层睫毛膏。

e.en: Waterproof {mascara} won't smudge during the wedding.
e.zh: 防水睫毛膏在婚礼上不会晕开。

e.en: Authentic tiramisu requires fresh {mascarpone} cheese.
e.zh: 正宗的提拉米苏要用新鲜的马斯卡彭奶酪。

e.en: He whipped {mascarpone} with sugar and vanilla for the dessert.
e.zh: 他把马斯卡彭奶酪和糖、香草一起打发做甜点。

e.en: The team's {mascot} danced along the sideline during halftime.
e.zh: 球队的吉祥物在中场时沿着边线跳舞。

e.en: A small stuffed bear became the office {mascot}.
e.zh: 一只小毛绒熊成了办公室的吉祥物。

masculine.t:
adj. 男性的，阳刚的
n. 阳性（语法）

e.en: The cologne has a strong, {masculine} scent.
e.zh: 这款古龙水有种浓郁的男性化香味。

e.en: In French, "livre" is a {masculine} noun.
e.zh: 在法语中,"livre"是一个阳性名词。

masculinity.t: n. 男子气概，阳刚之气

e.en: The film explores changing ideas of {masculinity} in modern society.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了现代社会中男性气质观念的变化。

e.en: Toxic {masculinity} discourages men from expressing emotion.
e.zh: 有毒的男子气概让男性不愿表达情感。

e.en: Hormone therapy can cause noticeable {masculinization} of the voice.
e.zh: 激素治疗可能让声音出现明显的男性化变化。

e.en: The study examined {masculinization} of certain professional fields.
e.zh: 该研究考察了某些职业领域的男性化现象。

e.en: Testosterone can {masculinize} facial features over time.
e.zh: 睾酮会随时间让面部特征变得更具男性化。

e.en: Critics say the dress code aims to {masculinize} female employees.
e.zh: 批评者认为该着装规定意在让女员工显得更男性化。

masculinized.t:
adj. 已男性化的
v. 男性化（过去式）

e.en: Years of training had {masculinized} her shoulders and arms.
e.zh: 多年的训练让她的肩膀和手臂变得更具男性轮廓。

e.en: The character's {masculinized} voice surprised the audience.
e.zh: 那个角色男性化的嗓音让观众感到意外。

maser.t: n. 微波激射器（受激辐射放大装置）

e.en: Scientists detected a powerful {maser} signal from the distant galaxy.
e.zh: 科学家从那个遥远的星系探测到强烈的微波激射信号。

e.en: The {maser} was invented before the laser.
e.zh: 微波激射器比激光器更早被发明出来。

maserati.t: n. 玛莎拉蒂（意大利豪华汽车品牌）

e.en: He pulled up to the hotel in a sleek black {Maserati}.
e.zh: 他开着一辆光亮的黑色玛莎拉蒂停在酒店门口。

e.en: The new {Maserati} accelerates from zero to sixty in three seconds.
e.zh: 这款新玛莎拉蒂从静止加速到六十英里只需三秒。

mash.t:
v. 捣成糊状
n. 土豆泥；麦芽浆

e.en: {Mash} the bananas before adding them to the batter.
e.zh: 先把香蕉捣成泥再加进面糊里。

e.en: The kids love sausages with creamy {mash} and gravy.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢香肠配奶香土豆泥和肉汁。

masham.t: n. 马沙姆（英国地名/绵羊品种）

e.en: The farmer keeps a small flock of {Masham} sheep on the hillside.
e.zh: 那位农夫在山坡上养着一小群马沙姆羊。

e.en: {Masham} wool is prized for its softness and durability.
e.zh: 马沙姆羊毛因柔软耐用而广受推崇。

mashed.t:
adj. 捣成糊状的
v. mash 的过去式

e.en: She served roast chicken with {mashed} potatoes and gravy.
e.zh: 她端上烤鸡配土豆泥和肉汁。

e.en: The toddler {mashed} his peas all over the high chair.
e.zh: 小家伙把豌豆捣得满餐椅都是。

masher.t: n. 捣碎器（如土豆压泥器）

e.en: Use a potato {masher} to get a smoother texture.
e.zh: 用土豆压泥器可以压得更细腻。

e.en: The metal {masher} hung above the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 那个金属压泥器挂在厨房台面上方。

mashes.t:
v. mash 的第三人称单数
n. 糊状物（复数）

e.en: He {mashes} avocado on toast almost every morning.
e.zh: 他几乎每天早上都把牛油果压在吐司上。

e.en: The brewery produces several different barley {mashes} each week.
e.zh: 这家酒厂每周会做几批不同的大麦麦芽浆。

mashing.t:
v. mash 的现在分词
n. 糖化（酿酒工艺）

e.en: She was {mashing} garlic with the back of a knife.
e.zh: 她正用刀背把大蒜压成泥。

e.en: The kid kept {mashing} buttons on the controller randomly.
e.zh: 那孩子一直在乱按手柄上的按钮。

mask.t:
n. 口罩；面具
v. 掩盖；遮蔽

e.en: Please wear a {mask} when entering the clinic.
e.zh: 进入诊所时请佩戴口罩。

e.en: Her smile couldn't {mask} how tired she really was.
e.zh: 她的微笑掩饰不住她有多疲惫。

masked.t: adj. 戴面具的；被掩盖的

e.en: A {masked} stranger appeared at the costume party.
e.zh: 一个戴面具的陌生人出现在化装舞会上。

e.en: The painkillers {masked} the symptoms but didn't cure anything.
e.zh: 止痛药掩盖了症状,但并没有治好任何问题。

masker.t: n. 戴面具的人；化装舞会者

e.en: Each {masker} at the carnival wore an elaborate feathered disguise.
e.zh: 狂欢节上每个戴面具的人都穿着精致的羽毛装扮。

e.en: A white-noise {masker} helps her sleep through city traffic.
e.zh: 白噪音掩蔽器让她能在城市交通声中入睡。

masking.t:
n. 遮蔽；掩码（处理）
v. mask 的现在分词

e.en: {Masking} tape protects the trim while you paint the wall.
e.zh: 刷墙时遮蔽胶带可以保护边线不被弄脏。

e.en: He was {masking} his anxiety with constant jokes.
e.zh: 他一直用玩笑掩饰自己的焦虑。

masks.t:
n. 口罩/面具（复数）
v. 掩盖

e.en: The pharmacy sells {masks} in packs of fifty.
e.zh: 这家药店出售五十只一包的口罩。

e.en: She {masks} her disappointment with polite small talk.
e.zh: 她用礼貌的闲聊掩饰自己的失望。

maslin.t: n. 混合谷物（小麦与黑麦的混种）

e.en: Medieval villagers baked bread from {maslin}, a wheat-rye blend.
e.zh: 中世纪的村民用麦黑混合的杂粮粉烤面包。

e.en: The old recipe called for coarse {maslin} flour.
e.zh: 这道古老的食谱需要用粗磨的杂粮粉。

e.en: Running a marathon in this heat feels like pure {masochism}.
e.zh: 在这种高温下跑马拉松简直就是自虐。

e.en: The novel explores themes of guilt and {masochism}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了内疚和受虐倾向的主题。

e.en: You'd have to be a {masochist} to enjoy three-hour meetings.
e.zh: 得是个自虐狂才会喜欢开三个小时的会。

e.en: He's a real {masochist} when it comes to spicy food.
e.zh: 一说到吃辣,他真是个十足的自虐狂。

masochistic.t: adj. 受虐倾向的；自虐的

e.en: Training in the rain has a slightly {masochistic} appeal for him.
e.zh: 雨中训练对他有种略带自虐的吸引力。

e.en: Her {masochistic} work schedule left no time for rest.
e.zh: 她那种近乎自虐的工作日程让她毫无休息时间。

e.en: He {masochistically} reread every harsh review of his book.
e.zh: 他自虐似地把书的每一篇恶评都重读了一遍。

e.en: She {masochistically} signed up for another all-nighter.
e.zh: 她自虐般地又报名了一次通宵加班。

mason.t:
n. 石匠；泥瓦匠
n. 共济会成员

e.en: The skilled {mason} repaired the cracked stone wall.
e.zh: 那位熟练的石匠修好了开裂的石墙。

e.en: My grandfather worked as a {mason} for over forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父做了四十多年的砌石匠。

masonic.t: adj. 共济会的；泥瓦匠的

e.en: The old {Masonic} lodge has been turned into a museum.
e.zh: 那座旧共济会会所已被改建成博物馆。

e.en: He inherited a ring with a {Masonic} symbol on it.
e.zh: 他继承了一枚带有共济会标志的戒指。

masonry.t: n. 砖石结构；砌筑工艺

e.en: The cathedral's intricate {masonry} took decades to complete.
e.zh: 那座大教堂精细的石砌工程花了数十年才完成。

e.en: Cracks in the {masonry} suggested the wall needed urgent repair.
e.zh: 砖石结构上的裂缝表明这面墙急需修缮。

masque.t: n. 假面剧（欧洲宫廷戏剧）

e.en: The court entertained guests with an elaborate Renaissance {masque}.
e.zh: 宫廷用一场精心编排的文艺复兴假面剧招待宾客。

e.en: Shakespeare's plays sometimes included a short {masque}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的戏剧有时会穿插一段简短的假面剧。

masquerade.t:
n. 化装舞会
v. 伪装；假扮

e.en: They attended a Venetian {masquerade} ball on New Year's Eve.
e.zh: 他们除夕去参加了一场威尼斯式的化装舞会。

e.en: His friendliness was just a {masquerade} for ambition.
e.zh: 他的友善不过是野心的伪装。

masquerader.t: n. 化装舞会参与者；伪装者

e.en: Every {masquerader} at the ball wore a feathered mask.
e.zh: 舞会上每位假面人都戴着羽毛面具。

e.en: The clever {masquerader} fooled even his closest friends.
e.zh: 那位聪明的伪装者连最亲近的朋友都骗过了。

mass.t:
n. 大量；质量；群众
adj. 大规模的

e.en: A huge {mass} of fans gathered outside the stadium.
e.zh: 大批球迷聚集在体育场外。

e.en: My grandmother attends {mass} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 我祖母每周日早上都去做弥撒。

massachusetts.t: n. 马萨诸塞州（美国东北部州）

e.en: She grew up in a small town in western {Massachusetts}.
e.zh: 她在马萨诸塞州西部的一个小镇长大。

e.en: {Massachusetts} is home to many world-renowned universities.
e.zh: 马萨诸塞州拥有许多世界知名的大学。

massacre.t:
n. 大屠杀
v. 屠杀

e.en: The {massacre} of innocent civilians shocked the world.
e.zh: 对无辜平民的屠杀震惊了世界。

e.en: Their team lost the final by an embarrassing {massacre}.
e.zh: 他们的队伍以惨败告终输掉了决赛。

massacred.t: v. massacre 的过去式；遭大屠杀

e.en: Invading forces {massacred} hundreds of villagers that night.
e.zh: 入侵部队那一夜屠杀了数百名村民。

e.en: The home team {massacred} their rivals seven to nothing.
e.zh: 主队以七比零血洗了对手。

massacres.t:
n. 大屠杀（复数）
v. 屠杀

e.en: The report documented several {massacres} during the civil war.
e.zh: 那份报告记录了内战期间发生的多起大屠杀。

e.en: That hockey team consistently {massacres} weaker opponents.
e.zh: 那支冰球队总是把弱队打得落花流水。

massage.t:
n./v. 按摩
v. 篡改（数据）

e.en: A deep tissue {massage} really helped my sore back.
e.zh: 一次深层组织按摩让我酸痛的背部舒服多了。

e.en: Don't try to {massage} the numbers to please the boss.
e.zh: 别为了讨好老板就去粉饰数据。

massaged.t: v. massage 的过去式；经按摩的

e.en: She {massaged} oil into her tired feet after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后,她把油按摩进酸痛的脚里。

e.en: The accountant {massaged} the figures to look more favorable.
e.zh: 那位会计师粉饰了数据,让它们看起来更漂亮。

e.en: He bought a handheld {massager} for his stiff shoulders.
e.zh: 他买了个手持按摩器来缓解僵硬的肩膀。

e.en: The electric foot {massager} was a great gift for mom.
e.zh: 这台电动足部按摩器作为送给妈妈的礼物很棒。

massages.t:
n. 按摩（复数）
v. 按摩

e.en: The spa offers couples {massages} at a discounted rate.
e.zh: 这家水疗中心以折扣价提供情侣按摩服务。

e.en: She {massages} her temples whenever a headache starts.
e.zh: 每次头痛一开始,她就按摩太阳穴。

massaging.t: v. massage 的现在分词；正在按摩

e.en: He sat on the couch {massaging} his aching knee.
e.zh: 他坐在沙发上按摩着酸痛的膝盖。

e.en: The PR team is {massaging} the message before the press release.
e.zh: 公关团队正在新闻稿发布前润色措辞。

masse.t: n. 台球中的曲线击球（马赛式）

e.en: Fans turned out en {masse} to welcome the team home.
e.zh: 球迷们成群结队地涌出来欢迎球队回家。

e.en: Voters showed up en {masse} for the historic election.
e.zh: 选民们大批涌向投票站,参加这场历史性的选举。

massed.t: adj. 聚集成群的；密集的

e.en: Thousands of protesters {massed} outside the parliament building.
e.zh: 数千名抗议者聚集在议会大楼外。

e.en: Dark clouds {massed} over the mountains before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前,乌云在群山上空聚集。

e.en: The new app appeals to the {masses}, not just experts.
e.zh: 这款新应用面向大众，而不仅仅是专家。

e.en: She received {masses} of emails after the interview aired.
e.zh: 采访播出后，她收到了大量邮件。

e.en: The hotel {masseur} eased the tension in my shoulders.
e.zh: 酒店的男按摩师缓解了我肩膀的酸痛。

e.en: He trained for two years to become a licensed {masseur}.
e.zh: 他经过两年培训才成为持证男按摩师。

e.en: The spa employs ten skilled {masseurs} from around the world.
e.zh: 这家水疗中心聘请了十位来自世界各地的男按摩师。

e.en: Top {masseurs} can charge over a hundred dollars per session.
e.zh: 顶级男按摩师每次收费可超过一百美元。

e.en: The {masseuse} worked the knots out of my lower back.
e.zh: 女按摩师帮我揉开了下背部的结块。

e.en: My favorite {masseuse} just opened her own studio downtown.
e.zh: 我最喜欢的女按摩师刚在市中心开了自己的工作室。

e.en: The hikers gazed up at the snowy {massif} above them.
e.zh: 徒步者抬头望着上方的雪白山群。

e.en: The Mont Blanc {massif} attracts climbers from across Europe.
e.zh: 勃朗峰山群吸引着来自欧洲各地的登山者。

massing.t:
v. mass 的现在分词
n. 体量（建筑）

e.en: Storm clouds were {massing} over the harbor by noon.
e.zh: 中午时分，乌云在港口上空聚集。

e.en: Troops are {massing} near the disputed border tonight.
e.zh: 今晚军队正在争议边界附近集结。

e.en: The startup just closed a {massive} funding round.
e.zh: 这家初创公司刚完成了一轮巨额融资。

e.en: There was a {massive} crowd outside the stadium.
e.zh: 体育场外聚集了一大群人。

e.en: This update {massively} improves the app's loading speed.
e.zh: 这次更新极大地提升了应用的加载速度。

e.en: Her latest video is {massively} popular among teenagers.
e.zh: 她最新的视频在青少年中非常受欢迎。

e.en: The {massiveness} of the cathedral leaves visitors speechless.
e.zh: 大教堂的宏伟令游客叹为观止。

e.en: You can't appreciate the iceberg's {massiveness} from photos alone.
e.zh: 光看照片无法体会冰山的巨大。

e.en: Photons are {massless} particles that travel at light speed.
e.zh: 光子是以光速运动的无质量粒子。

e.en: Physicists treat the rope as {massless} in this problem.
e.zh: 在这道题中，物理学家把绳子视为无质量的。

e.en: The sailor climbed the {mast} to fix the radar.
e.zh: 水手爬上桅杆去修理雷达。

e.en: Lightning struck the boat's tall {mast} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中闪电击中了船的高桅杆。

e.en: She wrote a memoir about her recovery after a {mastectomy}.
