e.zh: 她写了一本回忆录，讲述乳房切除手术后的康复经历。

e.en: Doctors recommended a double {mastectomy} to reduce her cancer risk.
e.zh: 医生建议她做双侧乳房切除术以降低患癌风险。

master.t:
v. 掌握；精通
n. 大师；硕士

e.en: It took years to {master} the violin properly.
e.zh: 花了好几年才真正掌握小提琴的演奏。

e.en: He's a {master} at negotiating tough business deals.
e.zh: 他是谈判棘手商务交易的高手。

mastercard.t: n. 万事达卡（信用卡品牌）

e.en: The shop accepts both Visa and {Mastercard} for payments.
e.zh: 这家店收 Visa 和万事达卡付款。

e.en: My new {Mastercard} offers two percent cash back on groceries.
e.zh: 我的新万事达卡买杂货可返现百分之二。

e.en: Her speech was a {masterclass} in clear communication.
e.zh: 她的演讲堪称清晰沟通的典范。

e.en: I signed up for a cooking {masterclass} taught by a famous chef.
e.zh: 我报名参加了一位名厨主讲的烹饪大师班。

mastered.t: v. 掌握（master 的过去式）

e.en: She finally {mastered} the basics of Python this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天她终于掌握了 Python 的基础。

e.en: He {mastered} three languages before turning twenty.
e.zh: 他二十岁前就精通了三门语言。

e.en: The director gave a {masterful} performance in the lead role.
e.zh: 导演在主角的演绎上展现了精湛的演技。

e.en: Her {masterful} handling of the crisis impressed the entire board.
e.zh: 她对危机的高超处理让整个董事会印象深刻。

e.en: The lawyer {masterfully} dismantled the opposing argument.
e.zh: 律师巧妙地驳倒了对方的论点。

e.en: She {masterfully} balanced humor and emotion in her speech.
e.zh: 她在演讲中巧妙地平衡了幽默与情感。

e.en: The video game tracks your weapon {masteries} across all characters.
e.zh: 这款游戏会记录你所有角色的武器精通度。

e.en: Her {masteries} in art and music made her admissions essay stand out.
e.zh: 她在艺术和音乐上的造诣让申请文书脱颖而出。

mastering.t:
n. 母带处理（音频）
v. 掌握中

e.en: He spent the weekend {mastering} the new editing software.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在钻研新的剪辑软件。

e.en: The studio is {mastering} her album for release next month.
e.zh: 工作室正在为她下个月发行的专辑做母带处理。

e.en: The pianist gave a {masterly} performance of the concerto.
e.zh: 钢琴家精湛地演奏了这首协奏曲。

e.en: She painted the portrait with {masterly} attention to light.
e.zh: 她以精湛的光影把握画出了这幅肖像。

mastermind.t:
n. 主谋；幕后策划者
v. 策划

e.en: Police arrested the {mastermind} behind the bank robbery.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了银行抢劫案的幕后主使。

e.en: She helped {mastermind} the company's wildly successful rebrand.
e.zh: 她协助策划了公司大获成功的品牌重塑。

e.en: This novel is widely considered her literary {masterpiece}.
e.zh: 这本小说被普遍视为她的文学杰作。

e.en: That sandwich was an absolute {masterpiece} of flavors.
e.zh: 那个三明治简直是味觉上的杰作。

e.en: The museum displays {masterpieces} from the Renaissance period.
e.zh: 博物馆展出文艺复兴时期的杰作。

e.en: Her early films are now considered {masterpieces} of indie cinema.
e.zh: 她早期的电影如今被视为独立电影的经典之作。

e.en: The city unveiled a {masterplan} for waterfront redevelopment.
e.zh: 市政府公布了滨水区再开发的总体规划。

e.en: His {masterplan} for retirement involves sailing around the world.
e.zh: 他的退休总规划是环球航行。

e.en: She earned her {masters} in computer science last year.
e.zh: 她去年拿到了计算机科学硕士学位。

e.en: Few people {masters} a second language as adults.
e.zh: 很少有人成年后能精通第二语言。

e.en: His {mastership} of the chess club lasted nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他担任国际象棋俱乐部主席近十年。

e.en: The young apprentice eventually earned {mastership} in the guild.
e.zh: 年轻的学徒最终在行会中获得了大师身份。

e.en: Hiring her as CEO turned out to be a {masterstroke}.
e.zh: 聘请她担任首席执行官事实证明是一招妙棋。

e.en: The marketing campaign was a genuine {masterstroke} for the brand.
e.zh: 那次营销活动对该品牌而言是真正的神来之笔。

e.en: This symphony is considered the composer's {masterwork}.
e.zh: 这部交响曲被认为是作曲家的代表作。

e.en: The architect retired after completing her final {masterwork}.
e.zh: 建筑师在完成最后的代表作后退休了。

e.en: His {mastery} of the guitar takes your breath away.
e.zh: 他对吉他的精湛掌握令人惊叹。

e.en: Real {mastery} of a language takes many years of practice.
e.zh: 真正精通一门语言需要多年练习。

masthead.t:
n. 刊头；报头
n. 桅顶

e.en: Her name finally appeared on the magazine's {masthead}.
e.zh: 她的名字终于出现在杂志的刊头上。

e.en: A flag fluttered from the ship's tall {masthead}.
e.zh: 一面旗帜在船的高桅顶上飘扬。

e.en: The tiles are held in place with a strong {mastic} adhesive.
e.zh: 这些瓷砖是用强力玛蹄脂胶粘剂固定的。

e.en: Greek cooks flavor desserts with a hint of {mastic}.
e.zh: 希腊厨师在甜点中加入一点乳香调味。

e.en: Doctors recommend that you {masticate} food thoroughly before swallowing.
e.zh: 医生建议在吞咽前充分咀嚼食物。

e.en: Cows {masticate} grass for hours each day.
e.zh: 奶牛每天要花数小时咀嚼牧草。

e.en: Proper {mastication} helps your stomach digest food more easily.
e.zh: 充分咀嚼有助于胃部更轻松地消化食物。

e.en: The dentist explained how braces affect {mastication} at first.
e.zh: 牙医解释了牙套起初会如何影响咀嚼。

e.en: Their giant {mastiff} barked at every passing delivery truck.
e.zh: 他们家巨大的獒犬对每辆经过的送货车都狂吠。

e.en: A {mastiff} can weigh over two hundred pounds when fully grown.
e.zh: 獒犬完全长大后体重可超过两百磅。

e.en: The new mother developed {mastitis} and needed antibiotics.
e.zh: 这位新妈妈得了乳腺炎，需要服用抗生素。

e.en: Dairy farmers watch carefully for signs of {mastitis} in cows.
e.zh: 奶农会仔细留意奶牛是否有乳腺炎的迹象。

e.en: Scientists discovered a {mastodon} skeleton buried in the riverbed.
e.zh: 科学家在河床中发现了一具乳齿象骨架。

e.en: Many users moved from Twitter to {Mastodon} after the takeover.
e.zh: 收购之后，许多用户从推特转到了 Mastodon。

mastoid.t:
n. 乳突（耳后骨）
adj. 乳突的

e.en: The doctor pressed gently behind my ear on the {mastoid} bone.
e.zh: 医生在我耳后的乳突骨上轻轻按了按。

e.en: An infection spread to the {mastoid} and required surgery.
e.zh: 感染扩散到乳突部位，需要手术治疗。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {mastoidectomy} to clear the chronic infection.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了乳突切除术，以清除慢性感染。

e.en: Recovery from a {mastoidectomy} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 乳突切除术后通常需要数周才能恢复。

e.en: Untreated ear infections can occasionally lead to {mastoiditis}.
e.zh: 未经治疗的耳部感染偶尔会引发乳突炎。

e.en: The child was hospitalized with severe {mastoiditis} last week.
e.zh: 那孩子上周因严重乳突炎住院。

e.en: Health classes teach that it's normal for teenagers to {masturbate}.
e.zh: 健康课上会讲，青少年自慰是正常现象。

e.en: The article discussed how often adults {masturbate} on average.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了成年人平均自慰的频率。

e.en: Most doctors agree that {masturbation} is a healthy, normal behavior.
e.zh: 大多数医生认为自慰是一种健康正常的行为。

e.en: The book addresses myths about {masturbation} in a frank way.
e.zh: 这本书坦率地探讨了关于自慰的种种迷思。

e.en: The novel's narrator is a chronic {masturbator} and unreliable storyteller.
e.zh: 小说的叙述者是个长期自慰者，叙述也不可靠。

e.en: Slang dictionaries note that {masturbator} is sometimes used as an insult.
e.zh: 俚语词典指出，masturbator 有时被用作侮辱性词语。

e.en: Critics called the film's long monologues purely {masturbatory}.
e.zh: 评论家称这部电影冗长的独白纯粹是自我陶醉。

e.en: His memoir was praised by some and dismissed as {masturbatory} by others.
e.zh: 他的回忆录有人赞赏，也有人认为不过是自我陶醉。

mat.t:
n. 垫子；席子
adj. 无光泽的

e.en: Please wipe your shoes on the {mat} before entering.
e.zh: 进门前请在脚垫上擦擦鞋。

e.en: She rolled out her yoga {mat} for morning practice.
e.zh: 她铺开瑜伽垫做早间练习。

e.en: Travelers to Spain often see {mata} brushland along the highways.
e.zh: 前往西班牙的旅行者常在公路边看到灌木丛。

e.en: The spy was nicknamed a modern Mata Hari for her {mata}-like charm.
e.zh: 那名间谍因其玛塔般的魅力被昵称为现代版玛塔·哈丽。

e.en: The {matador} bowed gracefully as the crowd cheered.
e.zh: 斗牛士在观众的欢呼声中优雅地鞠躬。

e.en: Becoming a top {matador} in Spain takes years of dangerous training.
e.zh: 在西班牙成为顶级斗牛士需要多年危险的训练。

match.t:
v. 匹配；相配
n. 比赛；火柴

e.en: The dating app found me a surprisingly good {match}.
e.zh: 那款交友软件给我配到了一个意外合适的对象。

e.en: Your shoes don't quite {match} the rest of your outfit.
e.zh: 你的鞋子和其他衣服不太搭。

e.en: He kept a {matchbook} from every bar he ever visited.
e.zh: 他保留着去过的每家酒吧的火柴本。

e.en: She scribbled her phone number on the back of a {matchbook}.
e.zh: 她把电话号码草草写在火柴本背面。

e.en: The toddler stacked his tiny {matchbox} cars into a tower.
e.zh: 小男孩把他的小火柴盒车堆成了一座塔。

e.en: Their first apartment was barely bigger than a {matchbox}.
e.zh: 他们的第一套公寓比火柴盒大不了多少。

e.en: Her shoes perfectly {matched} the color of her dress.
e.zh: 她的鞋子和裙子的颜色完美搭配。

e.en: The algorithm {matched} job seekers with suitable employers.
e.zh: 该算法把求职者与合适的雇主匹配起来。

matches.t:
n. 比赛；火柴（复数）
v. 匹配

e.en: This password {matches} the one we have on file.
e.zh: 这个密码与我们存档的一致。

e.en: He lit the candle with one of the {matches}.
e.zh: 他用其中一根火柴点燃了蜡烛。

matching.t:
adj. 相配的
n. 匹配

e.en: They wore {matching} sweaters in the family photo.
e.zh: 全家福里他们穿着相配的毛衣。

e.en: The app uses AI for {matching} resumes to jobs.
e.zh: 该应用使用人工智能匹配简历与职位。

matchless.t: adj. 无与伦比的；无敌的

e.en: Her {matchless} skill on the violin amazed the audience.
e.zh: 她无与伦比的小提琴技艺让观众惊叹。

e.en: The view from the summit was simply {matchless}.
e.zh: 山顶的景色简直无与伦比。

e.en: My aunt acted as a {matchmaker} for my parents.
e.zh: 我姑姑当了我父母的红娘。

e.en: The dating app calls itself a digital {matchmaker}.
e.zh: 这款约会应用自称是数字红娘。

matchmaking.t: n. 配对；（婚恋）撮合；比赛安排

e.en: The game uses skill-based {matchmaking} to balance teams.
e.zh: 游戏采用基于技术水平的匹配机制来平衡队伍。

e.en: Her grandmother loved {matchmaking} for young couples in the village.
e.zh: 她奶奶喜欢给村里的年轻人做媒。

e.en: He built a tiny ship from each {matchstick}.
e.zh: 他用一根根火柴棒搭出一艘小船。

e.en: The dry grass burned like a {matchstick} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天里干草像火柴一样一点就着。

e.en: Tonight's {matchup} between the two rivals should be exciting.
e.zh: 今晚两个对手的对决应该很精彩。

e.en: The coach studied the {matchup} before deciding the lineup.
e.zh: 教练研究了对位情况后才决定阵容。

mate.t:
n. 伙伴；配偶
v. 交配

e.en: Hey {mate}, can you pass me the salt?
e.zh: 哥们儿,能把盐递给我吗?

e.en: The female penguin chooses her {mate} for life.
e.zh: 雌企鹅会选择终身伴侣。

e.en: The pandas {mated} successfully at the wildlife reserve.
e.zh: 这两只熊猫在保护区成功交配。

e.en: Swans usually stay {mated} for many years.
e.zh: 天鹅通常会成对相伴多年。

e.en: He still calls his mother {mater} as a joke.
e.zh: 他还开玩笑地把妈妈叫做"老妈大人"。

e.en: The school song mentions our beloved alma {mater}.
e.zh: 校歌中提到了我们心爱的母校。

e.en: The pharmacist studied {materia} medica for years.
e.zh: 那位药剂师研究药物学多年。

e.en: Old textbooks still reference {materia} medica extensively.
e.zh: 旧教科书仍大量引用药物学的内容。

material.t:
n. 材料；素材
adj. 物质的；重要的

e.en: Cotton is a soft {material} ideal for summer clothing.
e.zh: 棉是一种柔软的面料,非常适合夏装。

e.en: The journalist gathered enough {material} for a long article.
e.zh: 那位记者收集了足够写一篇长文的素材。

materialisation.t: n. 实现；具体化（英式拼写）

e.en: The {materialisation} of the project took nearly five years.
e.zh: 该项目的落地实现花了将近五年。

e.en: Magicians often fake the {materialisation} of objects on stage.
e.zh: 魔术师常在台上假装让物体凭空出现。

e.en: The novel describes ghostly {materialisations} in old castles.
e.zh: 小说描写了古堡中幽灵的显形。

e.en: Several {materialisations} of the plan failed before success.
e.zh: 该计划经历多次落地尝试后才成功。

materialise.t: v. 实现；成真（英式拼写）

e.en: The promised funds never seemed to {materialise}.
e.zh: 承诺的资金似乎一直没到位。

e.en: A figure began to {materialise} from the thick fog.
e.zh: 一个身影开始从浓雾中显现出来。

e.en: The expected discount never {materialised} at checkout.
e.zh: 结账时预期的折扣并未出现。

e.en: A taxi finally {materialised} after we waited an hour.
e.zh: 我们等了一小时后,出租车终于出现了。

materialises.t: v. 实现（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her anxiety {materialises} as a tight feeling in her chest.
e.zh: 她的焦虑表现为胸口发紧。

e.en: If the deal {materialises}, we'll celebrate next week.
e.zh: 如果协议达成,我们下周就庆祝。

e.en: The rumored bonus is finally {materialising} this quarter.
e.zh: 传闻中的奖金终于在本季度落实了。

e.en: Storm clouds were quickly {materialising} over the mountains.
e.zh: 暴风云在山脉上空迅速形成。

materialism.t: n. 唯物主义；物质主义

e.en: He criticized the {materialism} of modern consumer culture.
e.zh: 他批评现代消费文化中的物质主义。

e.en: Philosophers debate {materialism} versus idealism endlessly.
e.zh: 哲学家们就唯物论与唯心论争论不休。

e.en: The book contrasts different {materialisms} across cultures.
e.zh: 这本书对比了不同文化中的物质主义观念。

e.en: Various {materialisms} have shaped modern philosophical debate.
e.zh: 各种唯物主义思想塑造了现代哲学辩论。

materialist.t: n. 唯物主义者；物质至上者

e.en: Critics called him a shallow {materialist} who valued only money.
e.zh: 评论家说他是只重金钱的肤浅物质主义者。

e.en: The philosopher took a strictly {materialist} view of consciousness.
e.zh: 那位哲学家对意识持严格的唯物主义观点。

materialistic.t: adj. 物质至上的；唯物的

e.en: Social media often makes teenagers more {materialistic}.
e.zh: 社交媒体常使青少年变得更物质化。

e.en: He grew up in a {materialistic} family obsessed with brands.
e.zh: 他在一个迷恋名牌的物质化家庭中长大。

e.en: Auditors check the {materiality} of any reporting errors.
e.zh: 审计师会核查报告中错误的重要性程度。

e.en: The artist explores the {materiality} of paint and canvas.
e.zh: 这位艺术家探索颜料与画布的物质性。

e.en: The {materialization} of her dream startup took ten years.
e.zh: 她梦想的创业公司花了十年才真正实现。

e.en: Witnesses described the sudden {materialization} of a strange light.
e.zh: 目击者描述了一道奇怪光芒的突然出现。

e.en: The séance reportedly produced several spooky {materializations}.
e.zh: 据说那场降神会出现了好几次诡异的显形。

e.en: Different {materializations} of the same idea appear across his films.
e.zh: 同一个理念以不同形式出现在他的多部电影中。

e.en: The promised raise didn't {materialize} this year.
e.zh: 承诺的加薪今年没有兑现。

e.en: A waiter seemed to {materialize} the moment we sat down.
e.zh: 我们一坐下,服务员就好像凭空出现了。

e.en: Their plan to travel abroad never really {materialized}.
e.zh: 他们出国旅行的计划一直没能实现。

e.en: A shadow {materialized} at the end of the hallway.
e.zh: 走廊尽头出现了一个人影。

materializes.t: v. 实现（第三人称单数）

e.en: If funding {materializes}, the museum will reopen next spring.
e.zh: 如果资金到位,博物馆将于明年春天重新开放。

e.en: His stress often {materializes} as headaches and insomnia.
e.zh: 他的压力常以头痛和失眠的形式表现出来。

e.en: The merger seems to be finally {materializing} after months of talks.
e.zh: 经过数月谈判,合并似乎终于要成真了。

e.en: New apps are constantly {materializing} in the crowded marketplace.
e.zh: 在拥挤的市场上不断有新应用涌现。

e.en: The new policy will {materially} affect our quarterly profits.
e.zh: 新政策将对我们的季度利润产生实质影响。

e.en: His life improved both spiritually and {materially} after the move.
e.zh: 搬家后他的生活在精神和物质上都有所改善。

e.en: Please bring all the study {materials} to tomorrow's class.
e.zh: 请把所有学习材料带到明天的课上。

e.en: Engineers are testing new {materials} for the spacecraft.
e.zh: 工程师正在为这艘宇宙飞船测试新材料。

e.en: The army shipped tons of {materiel} to the front lines.
e.zh: 军队向前线运送了数以吨计的军用物资。

e.en: Damaged {materiel} was sent back for repair and inspection.
e.zh: 受损的军用装备被送回检修。

e.en: She felt strong {maternal} instincts when holding the baby.
e.zh: 抱着婴儿时她感到强烈的母性本能。

e.en: My {maternal} grandmother taught me how to bake bread.
e.zh: 我外婆教我怎么烤面包。

maternalistic.t: adj. 母性化的；过度保护的

e.en: His boss had a slightly {maternalistic} way of managing the team.
e.zh: 他的上司带着一点母亲式的方式管理团队。

e.en: Critics called the policy overly {maternalistic} toward citizens.
e.zh: 批评者称这一政策对公民过于母亲式包办。

maternally.t: adv. 母亲般地；从母系方面

e.en: She smiled {maternally} at the worried young intern.
e.zh: 她像母亲一样朝那位担忧的年轻实习生微笑。

e.en: He's related to the famous singer {maternally}.
e.zh: 他从母亲那一边和那位著名歌手有亲戚关系。

e.en: She is currently on {maternity} leave for six months.
e.zh: 她目前正在休六个月的产假。

e.en: The store sells affordable {maternity} clothes online.
e.zh: 这家店在网上销售平价孕妇装。

mates.t:
n. 伙伴（复数）
v. 交配

e.en: He went out drinking with his {mates} after work.
e.zh: 下班后他和哥们儿一起出去喝酒了。

e.en: Many bird species find {mates} during the spring season.
e.zh: 许多鸟类在春季寻找配偶。

e.en: The new manager has a friendly, {matey} style with the team.
e.zh: 新经理对团队采用一种亲切随和的风格。

e.en: Alright {matey}, what'll you have to drink?
e.zh: 好啦兄弟,你想喝点什么?

e.en: My daughter loves {math} but struggles with history.
e.zh: 我女儿喜欢数学,但历史学得很吃力。

e.en: The {math} on this budget just doesn't add up.
e.zh: 这份预算的数算来算去对不上。

e.en: He approached the problem with {mathematic} precision.
e.zh: 他以数学般的精确度处理这个问题。

e.en: The painting follows almost {mathematic} rules of symmetry.
e.zh: 这幅画几乎遵循着数学般的对称规则。

e.en: Solving this puzzle requires advanced {mathematical} thinking.
e.zh: 解开这个谜题需要高级的数学思维。

e.en: The model uses {mathematical} formulas to predict weather.
e.zh: 该模型使用数学公式来预测天气。

e.en: It is {mathematically} impossible for them to win now.
e.zh: 从数学上讲他们现在已经不可能获胜。

e.en: The encryption is {mathematically} proven to be secure.
e.zh: 该加密在数学上被证明是安全的。

e.en: The famous {mathematician} won the Fields Medal last year.
e.zh: 那位著名的数学家去年获得了菲尔兹奖。

e.en: As a {mathematician}, she finds beauty in elegant proofs.
e.zh: 作为数学家,她在优雅的证明中发现美。

e.en: Many {mathematicians} collaborated on solving this ancient problem.
e.zh: 许多数学家合作解决了这个古老的难题。

e.en: The conference brought together {mathematicians} from twenty countries.
e.zh: 会议汇集了来自二十个国家的数学家。

e.en: She majored in {mathematics} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学主修数学。

e.en: Modern {mathematics} forms the foundation of computer science.
e.zh: 现代数学是计算机科学的基础。

e.en: British students typically study {maths} until age sixteen.
e.zh: 英国学生通常一直学数学到十六岁。

e.en: He helps his sister with her {maths} homework every evening.
e.zh: 他每天晚上帮妹妹做数学作业。

e.en: The monks gathered for {matin} prayers before sunrise.
e.zh: 修士们在日出前聚集做晨祷。

e.en: Her {matin} routine includes meditation and a long walk.
e.zh: 她的晨间习惯包括冥想和长时间散步。

matinee.t: n. 日场演出（白天的演出或电影）

e.en: We caught the Saturday {matinee} for half the price.
e.zh: 我们以半价看了周六的午后场电影。

e.en: The theatre offers a {matinee} performance every Wednesday.
e.zh: 该剧院每周三都有一场午后演出。

mating.t:
n. 交配；配对
v. mate 的现在分词

e.en: Peacocks display elaborate feathers during the {mating} season.
e.zh: 孔雀在交配季节会展开华丽的羽毛。

e.en: Scientists study the {mating} habits of deep-sea creatures.
e.zh: 科学家研究深海生物的交配习性。

e.en: The monks gathered before dawn to sing {matins}.
e.zh: 修士们在黎明前聚集起来唱晨祷。

e.en: Birds began their cheerful {matins} as the sun rose.
e.zh: 太阳升起时，鸟儿开始欢快的晨歌。

e.en: The museum's new wing displays several works by {Matisse}.
e.zh: 博物馆的新展厅陈列着几幅马蒂斯的作品。

e.en: She studied the bold colors in a {Matisse} painting.
e.zh: 她仔细研究马蒂斯画作中大胆的色彩。

matlock.t: n. 马特洛克（地名/人名）

e.en: My grandmother loves watching reruns of {Matlock} every afternoon.
e.zh: 我奶奶每天下午都爱重看《马特洛克》。

e.en: The lawyer reminded everyone of a clever {Matlock} episode.
e.zh: 那位律师让大家想起一集精彩的《马特洛克》。

matra.t: n. 马特拉（地名/品牌名）

e.en: In Sanskrit poetry, each {matra} represents a unit of time.
e.zh: 在梵语诗歌中，每个音律单位代表一段时长。

e.en: The teacher carefully counted every {matra} in the verse.
e.zh: 老师仔细数着诗句中的每个音律。

e.en: The family {matriarch} hosted dinner every Sunday night.
e.zh: 家中的女族长每周日晚都会主持晚餐。

e.en: An old elephant {matriarch} led the herd to water.
e.zh: 一头年长的母象族长带领象群去找水。

e.en: Some societies follow a strongly {matriarchal} tradition of inheritance.
e.zh: 有些社会遵循强烈的母系继承传统。

e.en: Their household has a clearly {matriarchal} decision-making structure.
e.zh: 他们家明显是由女性主导决策的结构。

e.en: Anthropologists debate whether a true {matriarchy} ever existed historically.
e.zh: 人类学家争论历史上是否真正存在过母权社会。

e.en: The novel imagines a future {matriarchy} ruling the planet.
e.zh: 这部小说设想未来由母权制统治整个星球。

e.en: The play centers on a son's guilt over {matricide}.
e.zh: 这部戏剧围绕一个儿子对弑母的愧疚展开。

e.en: Greek tragedy often explores themes of {matricide} and revenge.
e.zh: 希腊悲剧常常探讨弑母与复仇的主题。

e.en: Students must {matriculate} before attending their first lecture.
e.zh: 学生必须先注册入学才能参加第一节课。

e.en: She will {matriculate} at Yale this coming September.
e.zh: 她将在今年九月正式入学耶鲁大学。

e.en: The university held a formal {matriculation} ceremony for freshmen.
e.zh: 大学为新生举办了正式的入学典礼。

e.en: Her {matriculation} was delayed because of missing transcripts.
e.zh: 由于成绩单缺失，她的入学注册被推迟了。

e.en: Anthropologists noted strong {matrilateral} ties within the village.
e.zh: 人类学家注意到村里有很强的母方亲属联系。

e.en: The study examined {matrilateral} cousins in traditional kinship systems.
e.zh: 该研究考察了传统亲属制度中的母方表亲。

e.en: Property in this tribe passes through the {matrilineage} only.
e.zh: 这个部落的财产只通过母系世系传承。

e.en: Her family traces its {matrilineage} back six generations.
e.zh: 她家族的母系血统可以追溯到六代以前。

e.en: The Mosuo people are famous for their {matrilineal} customs.
e.zh: 摩梭人以其母系传承的习俗而闻名。

e.en: Inheritance in this culture follows a strictly {matrilineal} pattern.
e.zh: 这种文化的继承严格遵循母系制。

matrilocal.t: adj. 从母居的（婚后住女方家）

e.en: After marriage, couples live in {matrilocal} households with the bride's family.
e.zh: 婚后夫妻在新娘家庭中实行从妻居。

e.en: Some Indigenous communities still practice {matrilocal} residence today.
e.zh: 一些原住民社群至今仍实行从妻居。

e.en: They signed a {matrimonial} agreement before the wedding.
e.zh: 他们在婚礼前签署了一份婚前协议。

e.en: The lawyer specializes in {matrimonial} disputes and divorce cases.
e.zh: 这位律师专门处理婚姻纠纷和离婚案件。

e.en: They entered into holy {matrimony} on a sunny afternoon.
e.zh: 他们在一个阳光明媚的下午步入神圣的婚姻。

e.en: After ten years of {matrimony}, they remain happily devoted.
e.zh: 结婚十年后，他们依然恩爱如初。

matrix.t:
n. 矩阵；基质
n. 母体；发源地

e.en: The engineer multiplied two large numbers in a {matrix}.
e.zh: 工程师将一个矩阵中的两个大数相乘。

e.en: Cells grow within a protective extracellular {matrix}.
e.zh: 细胞在保护性的细胞外基质中生长。

matron.t: n. 已婚妇女；女护士长

e.en: The hospital {matron} oversees nursing schedules and patient care.
e.zh: 医院护士长负责护理排班和病人照护。

e.en: A kindly {matron} greeted us at the boarding school.
e.zh: 一位和蔼的女舍监在寄宿学校接待了我们。

matronly.t: adj. 成熟妇女般的；端庄的

e.en: She wore a {matronly} dress that reached her ankles.
e.zh: 她穿着一条端庄的及踝长裙。

e.en: His aunt had a calm, {matronly} air about her.
e.zh: 他姑妈身上有种沉稳端庄的气质。

matsushita.t: n. 松下（日本姓氏/品牌）

e.en: {Matsushita} founded the company that later became Panasonic.
e.zh: 松下创办了后来更名为松下电器的公司。

e.en: The book profiles {Matsushita} as a pioneering Japanese industrialist.
e.zh: 这本书将松下描绘为日本开创性的实业家。

e.en: She chose a {matt} finish for the bedroom walls.
e.zh: 她为卧室墙面选了哑光漆。

e.en: The photo was printed on thick {matt} paper.
e.zh: 照片印在厚厚的哑光纸上。

e.en: I prefer a {matte} lipstick over a glossy one.
e.zh: 比起亮泽款，我更喜欢哑光口红。

e.en: The new phone case has a smooth {matte} texture.
e.zh: 新手机壳是光滑的哑光质感。

matted.t: adj. 缠结的；纠缠成团的

e.en: The dog's fur was {matted} after weeks without grooming.
e.zh: 狗狗几周没梳毛，毛发都打结了。

e.en: Rain left her hair {matted} against her forehead.
e.zh: 雨水把她的头发紧贴在额头上。

matter.t:
v. 要紧；有关系
n. 事情；物质

e.en: Your opinion really does {matter} in this discussion.
e.zh: 在这场讨论中，你的意见真的很重要。

e.en: Scientists study how {matter} behaves at extreme temperatures.
e.zh: 科学家研究物质在极端温度下的行为。

mattered.t: v. matter 的过去式；要紧

e.en: Nothing else {mattered} once the baby arrived safely.
e.zh: 宝宝平安出生后，其他一切都不重要了。

e.en: His apology {mattered} more than any expensive gift.
e.zh: 他的道歉比任何昂贵礼物都更有意义。

matterhorn.t: n. 马特洪峰（阿尔卑斯山峰）

e.en: Climbing the {Matterhorn} remains a dream for many alpinists.
e.zh: 攀登马特洪峰仍是许多登山者的梦想。

e.en: We photographed the {Matterhorn} reflected in a quiet lake.
e.zh: 我们拍下了马特洪峰倒映在静谧湖面的景象。

mattering.t: v. matter 的现在分词；要紧

e.en: He spoke about feelings {mattering} more than achievements.
e.zh: 他谈到感受比成就更重要。

e.en: The sense of {mattering} to someone gives life meaning.
e.zh: 对某人而言有意义的感觉让生活有了意义。

matters.t:
n. 事情（复数）
v. matter 的第三人称单数

e.en: What truly {matters} is how we treat each other.
e.zh: 真正重要的是我们如何对待彼此。

e.en: The lawyer handles delicate financial {matters} for celebrities.
e.zh: 这位律师为名人处理敏感的财务事务。

matting.t: n. 席类铺垫物；编席材料

e.en: They laid bamboo {matting} across the cool tiled floor.
e.zh: 他们在凉爽的瓷砖地上铺了竹席。

e.en: The framer added cream {matting} around the watercolor painting.
e.zh: 装裱师在水彩画周围加了米色卡纸边。

e.en: The farmer swung a heavy {mattock} to break the soil.
e.zh: 农夫挥动沉重的鹤嘴锄翻土。

e.en: He used a {mattock} to dig out the tree roots.
e.zh: 他用鹤嘴锄挖出树根。

e.en: I bought a memory-foam {mattress} for better sleep.
e.zh: 我买了一张记忆棉床垫以改善睡眠。

e.en: The hotel {mattress} was surprisingly soft and comfortable.
e.zh: 酒店的床垫意外地柔软舒适。

e.en: Cheese develops complex flavors during its long {maturation} process.
e.zh: 奶酪在漫长的熟成过程中发展出复杂的风味。

e.en: Brain {maturation} continues well into a person's twenties.
e.zh: 大脑的成熟会持续到二十多岁。

e.en: Children pass through several predictable {maturational} stages of development.
e.zh: 儿童会经历几个可预测的成熟发展阶段。

e.en: Researchers identified clear {maturational} changes in adolescent brains.
e.zh: 研究人员在青少年大脑中发现了明显的成熟变化。

mature.t:
adj. 成熟的
v. 成熟；到期

e.en: She handled the criticism in a remarkably {mature} way.
e.zh: 她以极为成熟的方式处理了批评。

e.en: This whisky needs to {mature} for at least twelve years.
e.zh: 这款威士忌至少需要陈酿十二年。

matured.t:
adj. 成熟了的
v. mature 的过去式

e.en: He has really {matured} since starting his first job.
e.zh: 自从他开始第一份工作后，他真的成熟了很多。

e.en: The cheese {matured} in caves for over six months.
e.zh: 这种奶酪在洞穴中熟成了六个多月。

e.en: She responded {maturely} to the unfair feedback at work.
e.zh: 她对工作中不公平的反馈做出了成熟的回应。

e.en: The children behaved surprisingly {maturely} during the long flight.
e.zh: 孩子们在漫长的飞行中表现得出奇成熟。

matures.t: v. mature 的第三人称单数；成熟

e.en: The bond {matures} in five years and pays interest annually.
e.zh: 这只债券五年后到期，每年付息。

e.en: As a person {matures}, priorities naturally shift over time.
e.zh: 随着人的成熟，优先事项会自然地改变。

maturing.t: v. mature 的现在分词；走向成熟

e.en: The young apprentice is rapidly {maturing} into a skilled chef.
e.zh: 这位年轻学徒正迅速成长为一名技艺娴熟的厨师。

e.en: Wines kept {maturing} in oak barrels gain richer flavor.
e.zh: 在橡木桶中持续陈酿的葡萄酒会获得更浓郁的风味。

e.en: She showed great emotional {maturity} during the difficult conversation.
e.zh: 她在那次艰难对话中展现了极高的情绪成熟度。

e.en: The investment reaches {maturity} on December thirty-first.
e.zh: 该投资将于十二月三十一日到期。

matzah.t: n. 无酵饼（犹太逾越节食品）

e.en: Our family eats {matzah} every Passover seder.
e.zh: 我们家每年逾越节家宴都会吃无酵饼。

e.en: She spread butter on a crisp piece of {matzah}.
e.zh: 她在一片酥脆的无酵饼上抹了黄油。

matzo.t: n. 无酵饼（犹太逾越节食品）

e.en: He crumbled {matzo} into the chicken soup for texture.
e.zh: 他把无酵饼掰碎放入鸡汤增加口感。

e.en: The grocery store stocks {matzo} during the spring holidays.
e.zh: 杂货店在春季节日期间会备有无酵饼。

matzoh.t: n. 无酵饼（犹太逾越节食品）

e.en: Grandma always baked her own {matzoh} from scratch.
e.zh: 奶奶总是从头亲手烘烤无酵饼。

e.en: He dipped {matzoh} into the sweet charoset paste.
e.zh: 他把无酵饼蘸入甜甜的果泥酱中。

e.en: The Egyptian {Mau} is a rare spotted house cat.
e.zh: 埃及猫是一种稀有的有斑点家猫。

e.en: Her sleek {Mau} loves chasing laser pointers around the apartment.
e.zh: 她那只光滑的埃及猫喜欢在公寓里追激光笔。

maudlin.t: adj. 过于伤感的；多愁善感的

e.en: After two drinks, he became unbearably {maudlin} about his exes.
e.zh: 喝了两杯后，他对前任们伤感得让人受不了。

e.en: The film's ending felt overly {maudlin} and emotionally manipulative.
e.zh: 影片的结尾感觉过于煽情，刻意操控情绪。

maul.t:
v. 粗暴对待；撕咬
n. 大槌

e.en: A bear can easily {maul} an unprepared hiker in seconds.
e.zh: 一只熊几秒内就能轻易袭击毫无防备的徒步者。

e.en: Critics began to {maul} the film right after its release.
e.zh: 影评人在电影上映后立刻开始猛烈抨击。

mauling.t: v. 粗暴对待；撕咬（maul 的现在分词）

e.en: The puppy was happily {mauling} a stuffed toy on the rug.
e.zh: 小狗在地毯上开心地撕咬一只毛绒玩具。

e.en: The newspaper gave the politician's speech a brutal {mauling}.
e.zh: 报纸对那位政客的演讲进行了猛烈抨击。

maunder.t: v. 唠叨地说；漫无目的地走

e.en: He tends to {maunder} on about politics after dinner.
e.zh: 他晚饭后往往会漫无边际地谈论政治。

e.en: Don't let the speaker {maunder} through the entire meeting.
e.zh: 别让演讲者在整场会议中啰啰嗦嗦地讲个不停。

maundy.t: n. 濯足节（基督教节日）

e.en: The queen distributed {Maundy} money to elderly pensioners today.
e.zh: 今天女王向年长的退休者发放了濯足节钱币。

e.en: Christians observe {Maundy} Thursday before Good Friday each year.
e.zh: 基督徒每年在受难节前一天纪念濯足节星期四。

mauritania.t: n. 毛里塔尼亚（西非国家）

e.en: {Mauritania} sits along the Atlantic coast of West Africa.
e.zh: 毛里塔尼亚位于西非的大西洋沿岸。

e.en: We crossed the desert border into northern {Mauritania}.
e.zh: 我们越过沙漠边境进入毛里塔尼亚北部。

mauritius.t: n. 毛里求斯（非洲岛国）

e.en: {Mauritius} is famous for its turquoise lagoons and white beaches.
e.zh: 毛里求斯以其青绿色泻湖和白色沙滩闻名。

e.en: They honeymooned on the tropical island of {Mauritius}.
e.zh: 他们在热带岛屿毛里求斯度蜜月。

e.en: Tourists quietly entered the marble {mausoleum} at sunrise.
e.zh: 游客们在日出时分静静走进大理石陵墓。

e.en: His empty mansion felt like a {mausoleum} after the divorce.
e.zh: 离婚后他空荡的豪宅感觉像座陵墓。

e.en: Ancient {mausoleums} line the hillside outside the old city.
e.zh: 古老的陵墓沿着旧城外的山坡排列。

e.en: The cemetery contains several family {mausoleums} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 这座墓地有几座建于十九世纪的家族陵寝。

mauve.t:
n. 淡紫色
adj. 淡紫色的

e.en: She painted the bedroom walls a soft {mauve}.
e.zh: 她把卧室的墙刷成了柔和的淡紫色。

e.en: The dress came in {mauve}, navy, and cream.
e.zh: 这条裙子有淡紫、藏青和奶白三种颜色。

e.en: She's a social media {maven} with millions of followers.
e.zh: 她是拥有数百万粉丝的社交媒体达人。

e.en: Ask the coffee {maven} which beans to buy.
e.zh: 问问那位咖啡行家该买哪种豆子。

maverick.t:
n. 特立独行的人
adj. 标新立异的

e.en: The {maverick} senator often votes against her own party.
e.zh: 这位特立独行的参议员经常投票反对自己的党派。

e.en: He's a {maverick} designer who ignores industry trends.
e.zh: 他是个无视行业潮流的另类设计师。

e.en: The startup hires creative {mavericks} who challenge assumptions.
e.zh: 这家创业公司喜欢招敢于挑战常规的特立独行者。

e.en: Tech {mavericks} reshaped how we work from home.
e.zh: 科技界的异类们重塑了我们居家办公的方式。

e.en: A {mavis} sang sweetly from the apple tree.
e.zh: 一只画眉鸟在苹果树上婉转地歌唱。

e.en: The poet described the {mavis} at dawn.
e.zh: 诗人描写了黎明时分歌唱的画眉鸟。

e.en: The shark's gaping {maw} terrified the divers.
e.zh: 鲨鱼张开的血盆大口让潜水员们惊恐万分。

e.en: Data disappears into the {maw} of the algorithm.
e.zh: 数据消失在算法的巨口之中。

mawkish.t: adj. 过分伤感的；令人作呕的

e.en: The film's ending was overly {mawkish} and unconvincing.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局过于矫情,缺乏说服力。

e.en: She avoided {mawkish} romance novels at all costs.
e.zh: 她无论如何都不看那种煽情的言情小说。

max.t:
n. 最大值（maximum 的缩写）
adj. 最大的

e.en: I {max} out my retirement contributions every year.
e.zh: 我每年都把退休金缴款交到上限。

e.en: The flight takes three hours, {max}.
e.zh: 这趟航班最多三个小时。

maxes.t:
n. 最大值（复数）
v. 达到极限

e.en: He {maxes} his credit card every holiday season.
e.zh: 他每个假期都把信用卡刷爆。

e.en: She {maxes} out her gym workouts on Fridays.
e.zh: 她周五会把健身训练强度拉到极限。

maxi.t:
n. 超长款（如长裙）
adj. 特大的

e.en: She wore a flowing {maxi} dress to the beach party.
e.zh: 她穿着飘逸的长裙去海滩派对。

e.en: Floral {maxi} skirts are trending again this summer.
e.zh: 碎花长裙今年夏天又流行起来了。

e.en: The dentist examined a fracture in the upper {maxilla}.
e.zh: 牙医检查了上颌骨的骨折。

e.en: Surgeons reconstructed the patient's {maxilla} after the accident.
e.zh: 医生在事故后为病人重建了上颌骨。

maxillae.t: n. 上颌骨（maxilla 的复数）

e.en: Insects use their {maxillae} to manipulate food.
e.zh: 昆虫用它们的小颚来处理食物。

e.en: The fossil preserved both {maxillae} intact.
e.zh: 这块化石完整保留了两侧上颌骨。

e.en: The infection spread to the {maxillary} sinus.
e.zh: 感染蔓延到了上颌窦。

e.en: She needs surgery on her {maxillary} bone.
e.zh: 她的上颌骨需要做手术。

maxillofacial.t: adj. 颌面的；口腔颌面的

e.en: He sees a {maxillofacial} surgeon about his jaw pain.
e.zh: 他正在看口腔颌面外科医生治疗下巴疼痛。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {maxillofacial} clinic.
e.zh: 医院新开了一家颌面外科门诊。

e.en: My grandmother lived by the {maxim} "waste not, want not."
e.zh: 我祖母信奉"不浪费就不匮乏"这条格言。

e.en: "Measure twice, cut once" is a useful {maxim}.
e.zh: "量两次,切一次"是一句很实用的格言。

e.en: The team aims for {maximal} efficiency on every project.
e.zh: 团队在每个项目中都追求最大效率。

e.en: Athletes train for {maximal} oxygen uptake.
e.zh: 运动员训练以达到最大摄氧量。

maximalist.t: n. 极繁主义者；最高纲领派

e.en: Her {maximalist} living room is filled with bold patterns.
e.zh: 她的极繁主义客厅满是大胆的图案。

e.en: He prefers a {maximalist} approach to interior design.
e.zh: 他在室内设计上偏爱极繁主义风格。

e.en: Place the solar panels {maximally} to catch sunlight.
e.zh: 把太阳能板尽可能地朝向阳光摆放。

e.en: We want to {maximally} reduce shipping costs.
e.zh: 我们希望最大限度地降低运输成本。

mca.t: n. 多种机构缩写（如音乐学院、管理会计师）

e.en: The {MCA} regulates shipping safety in British waters.
e.zh: 海事和海岸警卫局负责监管英国水域的航运安全。

e.en: He worked at {MCA} Records during the nineties.
e.zh: 九十年代他在MCA唱片公司工作。

mcadam.t: n. 人名；碎石路面（以发明者命名）

e.en: The road was paved using {macadam} for durability.
e.zh: 这条路用碎石铺面以增加耐久性。

e.en: Old country lanes still have {macadam} surfaces.
e.zh: 乡村的老路还保留着碎石路面。

mcc.t: n. 多种组织缩写（如马里波恩板球俱乐部）

e.en: The {MCC} sets the official laws of cricket.
e.zh: 马里波恩板球俱乐部制定官方板球规则。

e.en: He became a member of the {MCC} last year.
e.zh: 他去年成为了马里波恩板球俱乐部的会员。

mccarthyism.t: n. 麦卡锡主义（反共政治迫害）

e.en: Critics warned that the policy resembled {McCarthyism}.
e.zh: 批评者警告说这项政策类似于麦卡锡主义。

e.en: Hollywood blacklists during {McCarthyism} ruined many careers.
e.zh: 麦卡锡主义时期的好莱坞黑名单毁了许多人的事业。

mccoy.t: n. 麦考伊（姓氏）；真货（the real McCoy）

e.en: This watch is the real {McCoy}, not a fake.
e.zh: 这块表是真货,不是仿冒品。

e.en: Trust me, his vintage guitar is the real {McCoy}.
e.zh: 相信我,他那把老式吉他是真品。

e.en: We grabbed breakfast at {McDonalds} before the flight.
e.zh: 我们登机前在麦当劳吃了早餐。

e.en: {McDonalds} opened its first store in Beijing decades ago.
e.zh: 麦当劳几十年前就在北京开了第一家店。

e.en: {MCI} was once a major US telecom company.
e.zh: MCI曾经是美国一家重要的电信公司。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed him with mild cognitive impairment, or {MCI}.
e.zh: 医生诊断他患有轻度认知障碍,简称MCI。

mcintosh.t: n. 麦金托什（姓氏／苹果电脑型号）

e.en: She picked a crisp {McIntosh} apple from the tree.
e.zh: 她从树上摘了一个脆甜的麦金托什苹果。

e.en: My grandfather still uses his vintage {McIntosh} amplifier.
e.zh: 我祖父还在用他那台老款的麦景图功放。

mckinley.t: n. 麦金利（姓氏／美国总统）

e.en: Climbers train for years before attempting Mount {McKinley}.
e.zh: 登山者要训练多年才会尝试攀登麦金利山。

e.en: President {McKinley} was assassinated in 1901.
e.zh: 麦金利总统于1901年遇刺身亡。

mckinsey.t: n. 麦肯锡（全球咨询公司）

e.en: She left {McKinsey} to join a tech startup.
e.zh: 她离开麦肯锡加入了一家科技初创公司。

e.en: {McKinsey} consultants advised the firm on restructuring.
e.zh: 麦肯锡的顾问为该公司提供了重组建议。

mclaren.t: n. 迈凯伦（姓氏／赛车品牌）

e.en: The {McLaren} crossed the finish line in first place.
e.zh: 那辆迈凯伦率先冲过终点线。

e.en: He dreams of owning a sleek {McLaren} sports car.
e.zh: 他梦想拥有一辆造型流畅的迈凯伦跑车。

e.en: Profit {maximisation} is the company's main goal.
e.zh: 利润最大化是这家公司的主要目标。

e.en: The strategy focuses on revenue {maximisation}.
e.zh: 该策略的重点在于收入最大化。

maximise.t: v. 使最大化（英式拼写）

e.en: Stretch daily to {maximise} your flexibility.
e.zh: 每天拉伸以最大化你的柔韧性。

e.en: The app helps users {maximise} their savings.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助用户最大化他们的储蓄。

e.en: The algorithm focuses on {maximization} of user engagement.
e.zh: 该算法专注于最大化用户参与度。

e.en: Profit {maximization} shouldn't come at workers' expense.
e.zh: 利润最大化不应以牺牲员工利益为代价。

maximize.t:
v. 最大化（窗口）
v. 使最大化

e.en: Tap the corner to {maximize} the video window.
e.zh: 点击角落可以把视频窗口放到最大。

e.en: Leaders should {maximize} every team member's potential.
e.zh: 领导者应当最大限度地发挥每位成员的潜力。

maximized.t:
adj. 已最大化的
v. maximize 的过去式

e.en: She {maximized} her browser to read the article.
e.zh: 她把浏览器窗口最大化以阅读文章。

e.en: The new layout {maximized} natural light in the kitchen.
e.zh: 新的布局让厨房的自然采光达到了最大。

maximizes.t: v. maximize 的第三人称单数

e.en: This routine {maximizes} muscle growth in minimal time.
e.zh: 这套训练法能在最短时间内最大化肌肉增长。

e.en: The seating plan {maximizes} space in small apartments.
e.zh: 这种家具摆放最大化地利用了小公寓的空间。

maximizing.t:
v. 正在最大化
adj. 最大化的

e.en: She's focused on {maximizing} returns from her investments.
e.zh: 她专注于让投资回报最大化。

e.en: The startup is {maximizing} growth before raising funds.
e.zh: 这家创业公司在融资前正全力扩大增长。

maximum.t:
n. 最大值
adj. 最大的

e.en: The elevator's {maximum} capacity is twelve people.
e.zh: 这部电梯的最大载客量是十二人。

e.en: Drink plenty of water for {maximum} hydration.
e.zh: 多喝水以达到最佳的补水效果。

e.en: Each plan has different daily withdrawal {maximums}.
e.zh: 每种套餐的每日取款上限各不相同。

e.en: The contract sets clear spending {maximums} per quarter.
e.zh: 合同明确规定了每季度的最高支出额度。

maximus.t: n. 人名；（拉丁语）最大的

e.en: Squats target the gluteus {maximus} effectively.
e.zh: 深蹲能有效锻炼臀大肌。

e.en: The trainer explained how to activate the gluteus {maximus}.
e.zh: 教练讲解了如何激活臀大肌。

maxwell.t: n. 人名；物理学家麦克斯韦

e.en: Physics class introduced {Maxwell}'s equations today.
e.zh: 今天的物理课介绍了麦克斯韦方程组。

e.en: The scientist built on {Maxwell}'s work in electromagnetism.
e.zh: 这位科学家在麦克斯韦的电磁学基础上继续研究。

may.t:
v. 可能；可以
n. 五月

e.en: You {may} leave early if your work is done.
e.zh: 工作做完的话你可以早点走。

e.en: It {may} rain later, so bring an umbrella.
e.zh: 待会儿可能会下雨,记得带把伞。

maya.t:
n. 玛雅（文明）
n. 人名（女）

e.en: Ancient {Maya} cities still hide deep in the jungle.
e.zh: 古玛雅城市至今仍隐藏在丛林深处。

e.en: The museum displays artifacts from the {Maya} civilization.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了玛雅文明的文物。

mayan.t:
adj. 玛雅的
n. 玛雅人

e.en: The {Mayan} calendar fascinated archaeologists for decades.
e.zh: 玛雅历法让考古学家着迷了数十年。

e.en: We toured the {Mayan} ruins at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出时游览了玛雅遗址。

e.en: {Maybe} we should order pizza tonight instead of cooking.
e.zh: 也许我们今晚该点披萨,而不是自己做饭。

e.en: "Are you coming?" "{Maybe}, I'll let you know."
e.zh: "你来吗?""也许吧,我再告诉你。"

mayday.t: n. 求救信号（国际通用）

e.en: The pilot sent a {mayday} call after losing engine power.
e.zh: 飞行员在失去发动机动力后发出了求救信号。

e.en: Coast guards responded immediately to the boat's {mayday}.
e.zh: 海岸警卫队立即回应了那艘船的求救信号。

e.en: They moved into a townhouse in {Mayfair} last spring.
e.zh: 他们去年春天搬进了梅菲尔区的一栋联排别墅。

e.en: {Mayfair} is known for luxury shops and galleries.
e.zh: 梅菲尔区以奢侈品店和画廊闻名。

e.en: She grew up on a quiet street in {Mayfield}.
e.zh: 她在梅菲尔德一条安静的街道上长大。

e.en: The {Mayfield} school district hired a new principal.
e.zh: 梅菲尔德学区聘请了一位新校长。

mayflower.t:
n. 五月花号（船名）
n. 山楂花

e.en: The {Mayflower} carried pilgrims to America in 1620.
e.zh: 五月花号在1620年载着清教徒抵达美洲。

e.en: Schoolchildren learn about the {Mayflower} every Thanksgiving.
e.zh: 每到感恩节,学生们都会学习五月花号的历史。

e.en: A {mayfly} lives only one day after emerging.
e.zh: 蜉蝣羽化后只能存活一天。

e.en: Trout eagerly snatched every {mayfly} from the surface.
e.zh: 鳟鱼急切地从水面上叼走每一只蜉蝣。

e.en: The surprise sale caused total {mayhem} in the store.
e.zh: 突如其来的促销让店里一片混乱。

e.en: Toddlers and puppies create joyful {mayhem} together.
e.zh: 小孩和小狗在一起总会闹得欢乐又疯狂。

mayo.t:
n. 蛋黄酱（mayonnaise 缩写）
n. 姓氏

e.en: Add a little {mayo} to make the sandwich creamier.
e.zh: 加一点蛋黄酱让三明治更顺滑。

e.en: He hates {mayo} but loves mustard on burgers.
e.zh: 他讨厌蛋黄酱,但喜欢汉堡里加芥末。

e.en: Homemade {mayonnaise} tastes much better than store-bought.
e.zh: 自制的蛋黄酱比店里买的好吃多了。

e.en: Mix tuna with {mayonnaise} for a quick lunch.
e.zh: 把金枪鱼和蛋黄酱拌一拌,午餐就有了。

e.en: The {mayor} announced a new public transit plan.
e.zh: 市长宣布了一项新的公共交通计划。

e.en: Residents petitioned the {mayor} to fix the potholes.
e.zh: 居民请愿要求市长修补坑洼路面。

e.en: She won the {mayoral} election by a narrow margin.
e.zh: 她以微弱优势赢得了市长选举。

e.en: His {mayoral} term begins in January.
e.zh: 他的市长任期将于一月开始。

mayoralty.t: n. 市长职位；市长任期

e.en: During his {mayoralty}, crime rates dropped significantly.
e.zh: 在他担任市长期间,犯罪率大幅下降。

e.en: She is seeking a second {mayoralty} term.
e.zh: 她正在争取连任市长。

e.en: The {mayoress} opened the charity gala with a speech.
e.zh: 女市长以一场演讲为慈善晚会揭幕。

e.en: A new {mayoress} took office last week.
e.zh: 上周一位新女市长就职。

e.en: Big-city {mayors} met to discuss housing shortages.
e.zh: 各大城市的市长齐聚一堂讨论住房短缺问题。

e.en: Several {mayors} signed the climate agreement.
e.zh: 多位市长签署了这份气候协议。

e.en: He resigned the {mayorship} after the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻曝光后他辞去了市长职务。

e.en: Her {mayorship} brought major investment to the city.
e.zh: 她的市长任期为这座城市带来了大量投资。

e.en: Children danced around the {maypole} with colorful ribbons.
e.zh: 孩子们拿着彩色丝带绕着五月柱跳舞。

e.en: The village raised a {maypole} for the spring festival.
e.zh: 村里为春季庆典立起了一根五月柱。

e.en: The calendar shows three {mays} in our anniversary photos.
e.zh: 日历上显示我们的纪念照里有三个五月。

e.en: Past {mays} have always been warm in this region.
e.zh: 这个地区过去的五月总是很温暖。

e.en: He bought a used {Mazda} for his daily commute.
e.zh: 他买了一辆二手马自达用于日常通勤。

e.en: The new {Mazda} model has impressive fuel efficiency.
e.zh: 新款马自达车型的燃油效率令人印象深刻。

e.en: The children got lost in the corn {maze}.
e.zh: 孩子们在玉米迷宫里迷路了。

e.en: Navigating the tax code feels like a {maze}.
e.zh: 研究税法就像在走迷宫。

e.en: The couple danced a lively {mazurka} at the wedding.
e.zh: 这对情侣在婚礼上跳了一支欢快的玛祖卡舞。

e.en: Chopin composed many beautiful pieces called {mazurkas}.
e.zh: 肖邦创作了许多美丽的玛祖卡舞曲。

e.en: The player made a {mazy} run past three defenders.
e.zh: 那名球员盘带过了三名防守球员。

e.en: We wandered through the {mazy} alleys of the old town.
e.zh: 我们在老城区曲折的小巷中漫步。

e.en: She earned her {MBA} from a top business school.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖商学院获得了工商管理硕士学位。

e.en: Many tech founders skip the {MBA} entirely.
e.zh: 许多科技创始人完全不读工商管理硕士。

mbe.t: n. 大英帝国员佐勋章

e.en: He was awarded an {MBE} for charity work.
e.zh: 他因慈善工作被授予大英帝国员佐勋章。

e.en: The Queen presented her {MBE} at Buckingham Palace.
e.zh: 女王在白金汉宫授予她大英帝国员佐勋章。

e.en: The company adopted {MBO} to align team goals.
e.zh: 公司采用目标管理法来统一团队目标。

e.en: Our quarterly {MBO} review starts next Monday.
e.zh: 我们的季度目标管理评审下周一开始。

mcmurdo.t: n. 麦克默多（姓氏/南极科考站名）

e.en: Researchers spent the winter at {McMurdo} Station in Antarctica.
e.zh: 研究人员在南极的麦克默多站度过了整个冬天。

e.en: Supplies are flown to {McMurdo} during summer months.
e.zh: 夏季会把物资空运到麦克默多站。

mdc.t: n. 映射诊断上下文（Mapped Diagnostic Context）

e.en: The {MDC} coordinates emergency response in the district.
e.zh: MDC负责协调该地区的应急响应工作。

e.en: Zimbabwe's opposition party {MDC} contested the election results.
e.zh: 津巴布韦反对党MDC对选举结果提出了异议。

mdf.t: n. 中密度纤维板（Medium-Density Fibreboard）

e.en: The bookshelf is made of cheap {MDF} board.
e.zh: 那个书架是用便宜的中密度纤维板做的。

e.en: {MDF} is easier to cut than solid wood.
e.zh: 中密度纤维板比实木更容易切割。

mea.t: (罕用) 拉丁语 mea culpa 中的"我的"

e.en: He offered a sincere {mea} culpa for the mistake.
e.zh: 他为这个错误真诚地认错。

e.en: The CEO's public {mea} culpa surprised the press.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官公开认错让媒体感到意外。

e.en: The Vikings drank {mead} at every great feast.
e.zh: 维京人在每次盛宴上都会喝蜂蜜酒。

e.en: This brewery makes traditional honey {mead}.
e.zh: 这家酿酒厂制作传统的蜂蜜酒。

e.en: Wildflowers bloomed across the sunny mountain {meadow}.
e.zh: 野花开遍了阳光明媚的山间草甸。

e.en: The cows grazed peacefully in the {meadow}.
e.zh: 牛群在草地上安静地吃草。

e.en: Developers want to build houses on the {meadowland}.
e.zh: 开发商想在这片草原上建造房屋。

e.en: The farm includes fifty acres of rich {meadowland}.
e.zh: 这个农场包含五十英亩肥沃的草地。

e.en: A {meadowlark} sang from the fence post at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,一只草地鹨在围栏柱上鸣叫。

e.en: The western {meadowlark} is Kansas's state bird.
e.zh: 西草地鹨是堪萨斯州的州鸟。

e.en: Sheep wandered freely across the green {meadows}.
e.zh: 羊群在绿色的草地上自由地漫步。

e.en: We hiked through alpine {meadows} dotted with flowers.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿过点缀着鲜花的高山草甸。

e.en: {Meadowsweet} grows wild along the riverbank in summer.
e.zh: 夏天绣线菊在河岸边野生生长。

e.en: Her tea included dried {meadowsweet} for its scent.
e.zh: 她的茶里加了干绣线菊以增添香气。

meads.t: n. 草地（mead 的复数，诗意用法）

e.en: The brewery samples five different {meads} on weekends.
e.zh: 这家酿酒厂周末提供五种不同的蜂蜜酒品尝。

e.en: Traditional {meads} are making a comeback among craft brewers.
e.zh: 传统蜂蜜酒在精酿酿酒师中重新流行起来。

e.en: His {meager} salary barely covered the rent.
e.zh: 他微薄的薪水勉强够付房租。

e.en: They survived on {meager} rations during the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长的冬天里,他们靠微薄的口粮维生。

e.en: The refugees were {meagerly} fed during the journey.
e.zh: 难民们在旅途中只能吃到很少的食物。

e.en: He {meagerly} tipped the waiter just one dollar.
e.zh: 他只给服务员小费一美元,显得很吝啬。

meagre.t: adj. 贫乏的（meager 英式拼写）

e.en: The charity received only {meagre} donations this year.
e.zh: 该慈善机构今年只收到微薄的捐款。

e.en: She earns a {meagre} living selling crafts online.
e.zh: 她靠在网上卖手工艺品勉强糊口。

meal.t:
n. 一餐；膳食
n. 谷物粗粉

e.en: We shared a delicious {meal} at the new restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在那家新餐厅享用了一顿美味的餐点。

e.en: Don't skip your morning {meal} before exercising.
e.zh: 运动前不要不吃早餐。

e.en: In South Africa, {mealie} is a staple food crop.
e.zh: 在南非,玉米是一种主要的食用作物。

e.en: She boiled fresh {mealie} cobs for dinner.
e.zh: 她煮了新鲜的玉米棒当晚餐。

e.en: The hotel offers three {meals} a day included.
e.zh: 酒店包含一日三餐。

e.en: Skipping {meals} is bad for your metabolism.
e.zh: 不吃饭对你的新陈代谢有害。

e.en: Phones are not allowed at {mealtime} in our family.
e.zh: 我们家吃饭时间是不允许玩手机的。

e.en: {Mealtime} should be relaxing, not rushed.
e.zh: 用餐时间应该是放松的,而不是匆忙的。

e.en: Lizards eat live {mealworm} larvae as protein.
e.zh: 蜥蜴吃活的面包虫幼虫来补充蛋白质。

e.en: Some startups farm {mealworms} as sustainable food.
e.zh: 一些初创公司养殖面包虫作为可持续食品。

e.en: This apple has gone soft and {mealy}.
e.zh: 这个苹果变得又软又粉。

e.en: Politicians often give {mealy} answers to direct questions.
e.zh: 政客们经常对直接的问题给出含糊其辞的回答。

e.en: A {mealybug} infestation killed her favorite houseplant.
e.zh: 粉蚧虫害毁了她最心爱的室内植物。

e.en: Wipe leaves with alcohol to remove {mealybugs}.
e.zh: 用酒精擦拭叶子可以去除粉蚧。

mean.t:
v. 意思是；意味着
adj. 吝啬的；刻薄的

e.en: What does this strange word actually {mean}?
e.zh: 这个奇怪的词究竟是什么意思?

e.en: Don't be {mean} to your little sister.
e.zh: 不要对你妹妹这么刻薄。

meander.t:
v. 蜿蜒而行；漫步
n. 河流的曲流

e.en: The river {meanders} slowly through the green valley.
e.zh: 那条河缓缓地蜿蜒流过绿色的山谷。

e.en: Tourists {meander} through the old market on weekends.
e.zh: 周末游客们在老市场里悠闲地漫步。

meandering.t: adj. 蜿蜒的；漫无目的的

e.en: Her {meandering} story took an hour to finish.
e.zh: 她那漫无边际的故事讲了一个小时才结束。

e.en: We followed a {meandering} path along the coast.
e.zh: 我们沿着海岸走了一条蜿蜒曲折的小路。

e.en: His blog is full of philosophical {meanderings}.
e.zh: 他的博客里满是哲学方面的漫谈。

e.en: The book records the author's {meanderings} through Europe.
e.zh: 这本书记录了作者在欧洲的漫游经历。

e.en: Don't be such a {meanie} to your brother.
e.zh: 别对你弟弟这么坏。

e.en: The kids called the strict teacher a {meanie}.
e.zh: 孩子们叫那位严厉的老师小气鬼。

e.en: What is the {meaning} of this odd symbol?
e.zh: 这个奇怪符号的含义是什么?

e.en: She found new {meaning} in volunteer work.
e.zh: 她在志愿服务中找到了新的人生意义。

meaningful.t: adj. 有意义的；意味深长的

e.en: They had a {meaningful} conversation about the future.
e.zh: 他们就未来进行了一次有意义的交谈。

e.en: Volunteering gives my retirement a {meaningful} purpose.
e.zh: 做志愿者让我的退休生活有了意义。

meaningfully.t: adv. 有意义地；意味深长地

e.en: She glanced {meaningfully} at the clock on the wall.
e.zh: 她意味深长地瞥了一眼墙上的钟。

e.en: Technology should {meaningfully} improve people's daily lives.
e.zh: 科技应该切实地改善人们的日常生活。

e.en: Studies link {meaningfulness} at work to higher happiness.
e.zh: 研究表明工作的意义感与更高的幸福感相关。

e.en: He questioned the {meaningfulness} of his daily routine.
e.zh: 他开始质疑日常生活的意义。

meaningless.t: adj. 无意义的；无目的的

e.en: Without context, these numbers are completely {meaningless}.
e.zh: 没有上下文,这些数字完全没有意义。

e.en: He felt his job had become {meaningless} over time.
e.zh: 他觉得自己的工作渐渐变得毫无意义。

e.en: He stared {meaninglessly} at the screen for hours.
e.zh: 他茫然地盯着屏幕看了好几个小时。

e.en: The words were repeated {meaninglessly} until they lost all sense.
e.zh: 这些词被毫无意义地重复着，直到失去所有含义。

e.en: The novel explores the {meaninglessness} of modern office life.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了现代办公室生活的无意义。

e.en: He felt a deep {meaninglessness} after losing his job.
e.zh: 失业后他感到一种深深的虚无感。

meanings.t: n. 含义；意思（meaning 的复数）

e.en: This word has several different {meanings} in English.
e.zh: 这个单词在英语中有好几种不同的含义。

e.en: Poets often hide deeper {meanings} in simple lines.
e.zh: 诗人常常在简单的诗句中藏着更深的含义。

e.en: She spoke {meanly} about her former coworker.
e.zh: 她刻薄地谈论她以前的同事。

e.en: Don't treat the new intern {meanly} on his first day.
e.zh: 别在新实习生第一天就对他不友好。

e.en: His {meanness} toward the waiter shocked everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他对服务员的刻薄让晚餐桌上的人都很震惊。

e.en: There's no excuse for that kind of {meanness} online.
e.zh: 网上那种恶意行为没有任何借口。

means.t:
n. 方法；手段
n. 财力；收入

e.en: Email is the fastest {means} of contacting the support team.
e.zh: 邮件是联系客服团队最快的方式。

e.en: This sign {means} you cannot park here after 6 PM.
e.zh: 这个标志表示晚上六点后不能在此停车。

meant.t: v. mean 的过去式和过去分词

e.en: I {meant} to call you yesterday but completely forgot.
e.zh: 我昨天本来想打电话给你，但完全忘了。

e.en: This package was {meant} for the office next door.
e.zh: 这个包裹本来是给隔壁办公室的。

meantime.t:
n. 其间
adv. 同时

e.en: Dinner is almost ready; in the {meantime}, please set the table.
e.zh: 晚饭快好了，在此期间请把桌子摆好。

e.en: The update arrives tomorrow; in the {meantime}, restart the app.
e.zh: 明天会有更新，与此同时请先重启应用。

e.en: Across several {meantimes} between meetings, she finished the report.
e.zh: 在几次会议之间的空档里，她完成了报告。

e.en: There are always quiet {meantimes} when projects are paused.
e.zh: 项目暂停时总会有一些安静的间隙时间。

meanwhile.t:
adv. 与此同时
n. 其间

e.en: I'll cook the pasta; {meanwhile}, you can chop the vegetables.
e.zh: 我来煮意面，与此同时你可以切菜。

e.en: {Meanwhile}, in another part of the city, protests began.
e.zh: 与此同时，在城市的另一端，抗议开始了。

e.en: Don't be such a {meany} and share your candy.
e.zh: 别这么小气，分点糖果给大家嘛。

e.en: The kids called the strict teacher a total {meany}.
e.zh: 孩子们说那位严厉的老师真是个坏家伙。

e.en: The vaccine protects children against {measles} and mumps.
e.zh: 这种疫苗可以保护儿童免患麻疹和腮腺炎。

e.en: Cases of {measles} have risen in several countries this year.
e.zh: 今年有几个国家的麻疹病例有所上升。

measly.t: adj. 少得可怜的；微不足道的

e.en: They paid him a {measly} ten dollars for the whole job.
e.zh: 整个活儿他们才付给他可怜的十美元。

e.en: The hotel breakfast was a {measly} slice of toast.
e.zh: 酒店早餐就只有一片可怜的吐司。

measurable.t: adj. 可测量的；可衡量的

e.en: The new policy had a {measurable} impact on employee retention.
e.zh: 新政策对员工留存率产生了可衡量的影响。

e.en: Set {measurable} goals so you can track your progress.
e.zh: 设定可量化的目标，这样你才能追踪进展。

e.en: Air quality has improved {measurably} since the factory closed.
e.zh: 自从工厂关闭后，空气质量有了明显的改善。

e.en: The team performed {measurably} better with the new coach.
e.zh: 换了新教练后，球队表现明显有所提升。

measure.t:
v. 测量
n. 措施；尺度

e.en: Use a ruler to {measure} the length of the desk.
e.zh: 用尺子量一下桌子的长度。

e.en: The government introduced a new {measure} to reduce pollution.
e.zh: 政府推出了一项减少污染的新措施。

measured.t:
adj. 慎重的；有节制的
v. measure 的过去式

e.en: She gave a {measured} response to the reporter's tough question.
e.zh: 她对记者的尖锐问题做出了审慎的回答。

e.en: He {measured} the room before ordering the new carpet.
e.zh: 他先量了房间尺寸，才订购新地毯。

measureless.t: adj. 无法衡量的；无限的

e.en: The ocean stretched out, {measureless} and dark, before us.
e.zh: 大海在我们面前延展开来，无边无际，幽暗深沉。

e.en: Her gratitude toward her parents was {measureless}.
e.zh: 她对父母的感激之情无以言表。

e.en: Take an accurate {measurement} before cutting the wood.
e.zh: 切木头之前先精确测量一下。

e.en: Body {measurement} is required when ordering a tailored suit.
e.zh: 定制西装需要量体裁衣。

e.en: Please send your {measurements} so we can tailor the dress.
e.zh: 请把你的尺寸发来，我们好定制这件礼服。

e.en: The lab took several {measurements} to ensure accuracy.
e.zh: 实验室进行了多次测量以确保准确性。

e.en: The {measurer} carefully recorded each dimension of the room.
e.zh: 测量员仔细记录了房间的每个尺寸。

e.en: This device is a precise {measurer} of indoor humidity.
e.zh: 这个设备是测量室内湿度的精密仪器。

measures.t:
n. 措施
v. 测量（第三人称单数）

e.en: The company has taken strict {measures} to protect user data.
e.zh: 公司已采取严格措施保护用户数据。

e.en: This room {measures} about twelve feet across.
e.zh: 这间房宽度大约有十二英尺。

measuring.t:
v. 测量（进行时）
adj. 测量用的

e.en: She is {measuring} the flour for the cake recipe.
e.zh: 她正在称量做蛋糕用的面粉。

e.en: We need a {measuring} tape to check the window size.
e.zh: 我们需要一把卷尺来量窗户的尺寸。

e.en: He doesn't eat {meat} but loves seafood.
e.zh: 他不吃肉，但很爱海鲜。

e.en: The real {meat} of the article is in the last section.
e.zh: 这篇文章真正的精华内容在最后一节。

e.en: She ordered spaghetti with one giant {meatball} on top.
e.zh: 她点了一份意面，上面放着一个超大的肉丸。

e.en: This Swedish {meatball} recipe has been in our family for years.
e.zh: 这道瑞典肉丸食谱在我们家传了很多年。

e.en: County {Meath} is known for its ancient Irish monuments.
e.zh: 米斯郡以其古老的爱尔兰遗迹而闻名。

e.en: They drove through {Meath} on their way to Dublin.
e.zh: 他们前往都柏林的途中经过了米斯郡。

e.en: Don't be such a {meathead} — read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别那么蠢，先看看说明书嘛。

e.en: The gym was full of muscular {meathead} types.
e.zh: 健身房里全是那种四肢发达头脑简单的肌肉男。

e.en: Many restaurants now offer {meatless} options on Mondays.
e.zh: 现在很多餐厅周一都提供素食选项。

e.en: This {meatless} burger tastes surprisingly close to the real thing.
e.zh: 这款无肉汉堡的味道意外地接近真肉。

e.en: Mom's {meatloaf} recipe is still my favorite comfort food.
e.zh: 妈妈做的肉糕至今仍是我最爱的慰藉美食。

e.en: He served {meatloaf} with mashed potatoes for dinner.
e.zh: 他做了肉糕配土豆泥当晚餐。

e.en: The doctor examined the ear {meatus} for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查了外耳道是否有感染迹象。

e.en: A blocked nasal {meatus} can make breathing difficult.
e.zh: 鼻道堵塞会让呼吸变得困难。

meaty.t:
adj. 多肉的
adj. 内容丰富的

e.en: This stew has a rich, {meaty} flavor that warms you up.
e.zh: 这锅炖菜肉香浓郁，吃了让人暖到心里。

e.en: The book offers some {meaty} ideas worth discussing.
e.zh: 这本书提出了一些值得深入讨论的实质内容。

e.en: The town of {Meaux} is famous for its creamy Brie cheese.
e.zh: 莫城以其奶香浓郁的布里奶酪而闻名。

e.en: They visited {Meaux} on a day trip from Paris.
e.zh: 他们从巴黎出发，到莫城进行了一日游。

mecca.t: n. 麦加；圣地；向往之地

e.en: Silicon Valley is a {mecca} for tech entrepreneurs worldwide.
e.zh: 硅谷是全球科技创业者向往的圣地。

e.en: This little town has become a {mecca} for street food lovers.
e.zh: 这个小镇已成为街头美食爱好者的圣地。

meccano.t: n. 麦卡诺（金属拼装玩具品牌）

e.en: He spent the afternoon building a crane from his {meccano} set.
e.zh: 他用麦卡诺金属组装玩具花了一下午搭了一台起重机。

e.en: My grandfather kept his old {meccano} pieces in a wooden box.
e.zh: 我爷爷把他旧的麦卡诺零件存放在一个木盒子里。

e.en: The {mechanic} fixed my brakes in less than an hour.
e.zh: 那位技师不到一个小时就修好了我的刹车。

e.en: This game has a clever stealth {mechanic} that rewards patience.
e.zh: 这款游戏有一个巧妙的潜行机制，奖励耐心的玩家。

e.en: The watch has a beautiful {mechanical} movement inside.
e.zh: 这只手表里面有一套精美的机械机芯。

e.en: Her smile felt {mechanical}, as if she had practiced it.
e.zh: 她的微笑显得很机械，好像是练过的一样。

e.en: He nodded {mechanically} while scrolling through his phone.
e.zh: 他一边刷手机一边机械地点头。

e.en: The door opens {mechanically} when you press the button.
e.zh: 按下按钮后，门会自动机械地打开。

mechanics.t:
n. 力学
n. 机制；运作方式

e.en: The {mechanics} of the new combat system take some practice.
e.zh: 新的战斗系统机制需要练一练才能上手。

e.en: She studied quantum {mechanics} during her physics degree.
e.zh: 她在攻读物理学位期间学过量子力学。

e.en: The {mechanisation} of farming changed rural life forever.
e.zh: 农业机械化永久地改变了农村生活。

e.en: Increased {mechanisation} reduced the need for manual labor.
e.zh: 机械化程度的提高减少了对人工劳动的需求。

mechanise.t: v. 使机械化（英式拼写）

e.en: The factory plans to {mechanise} its packaging line next year.
e.zh: 工厂计划明年将包装生产线机械化。

e.en: Small farms struggle to {mechanise} due to high equipment costs.
e.zh: 小农场因设备成本高而难以实现机械化。

mechanised.t: adj. 机械化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The army deployed a fully {mechanised} infantry unit.
e.zh: 军队部署了一支全机械化的步兵部队。

e.en: Modern bakeries are highly {mechanised} compared to traditional ones.
e.zh: 和传统面包房相比，现代面包房高度机械化。

mechanises.t: v. mechanise 的第三人称单数

e.en: This software {mechanises} repetitive tasks for office workers.
e.zh: 这款软件能将办公人员的重复性工作机械化处理。

e.en: The new system {mechanises} the entire sorting process.
e.zh: 新系统让整个分拣流程实现了机械化。

e.en: The company is {mechanising} its warehouse to speed up shipping.
e.zh: 公司正在将仓库机械化，以加快发货速度。

e.en: {Mechanising} agriculture helped feed a growing population.
e.zh: 农业机械化帮助养活了不断增长的人口。

mechanism.t:
n. 机制
n. 机械装置

e.en: The lock has a clever {mechanism} that prevents tampering.
e.zh: 这把锁有一个精巧的防撬机制。

e.en: Stress is the body's natural defense {mechanism}.
e.zh: 压力是身体天然的防御机制。

mechanisms.t: n. 机制；机械装置（复数）

e.en: The app uses several {mechanisms} to protect user privacy.
e.zh: 该应用使用多种机制来保护用户隐私。

e.en: Scientists are studying the {mechanisms} behind memory formation.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究记忆形成背后的机制。

mechanistic.t: adj. 机械论的；机械性的

e.en: His {mechanistic} view of human behavior leaves out emotion.
e.zh: 他对人类行为的机械论观点忽略了情感。

e.en: The paper offers a {mechanistic} explanation of how the drug works.
e.zh: 这篇论文从机制层面解释了这种药物的作用方式。

e.en: {Mechanization} transformed factories during the industrial revolution.
e.zh: 机械化在工业革命期间彻底改变了工厂面貌。

e.en: Increased {mechanization} cut harvest times in half.
e.zh: 机械化程度的提高使收割时间缩短了一半。

e.en: The company decided to {mechanize} its assembly line.
e.zh: 公司决定将装配线机械化。

e.en: It's expensive to fully {mechanize} a small bakery.
e.zh: 将一家小面包店完全机械化成本很高。

e.en: The army's {mechanized} units advanced quickly across the desert.
e.zh: 军队的机械化部队迅速穿越了沙漠。

e.en: Modern farms are heavily {mechanized} compared to fifty years ago.
e.zh: 现代农场与五十年前相比已高度机械化。

megadeal.t: n. 大宗交易；巨额合约

e.en: The studio signed a {megadeal} with the Oscar-winning director.
e.zh: 电影公司与那位奥斯卡得奖导演签下了一份巨额合约。

e.en: Investors cheered after the {megadeal} was announced yesterday.
e.zh: 巨额交易昨日宣布后,投资者欢呼雀跃。

e.en: Doctors warn against taking a {megadose} of vitamin C daily.
e.zh: 医生警告不要每日服用超大剂量的维生素 C。

e.en: The patient received a {megadose} of antibiotics after surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术后接受了大剂量的抗生素。

e.en: Ice Age {megafauna} like mammoths once roamed across Europe.
e.zh: 冰河时期的大型动物如猛犸象曾在欧洲各地漫游。

e.en: Australia's unique {megafauna} mostly went extinct thousands of years ago.
e.zh: 澳大利亚独特的大型动物大多在数千年前就灭绝了。

e.en: Each {megalith} at Stonehenge weighs several tons.
e.zh: 巨石阵中的每块巨石都重达数吨。

e.en: Archaeologists wonder how ancient people moved each massive {megalith}.
e.zh: 考古学家不解古人是如何搬动每一块巨型石碑的。

megalithic.t: adj. 巨石的；巨石文化的

e.en: The island is famous for its mysterious {megalithic} monuments.
e.zh: 这座岛屿以神秘的巨石建筑遗迹闻名。

e.en: Researchers are dating the {megalithic} structures using new techniques.
e.zh: 研究人员正用新技术对这些巨石结构进行年代测定。

megalomania.t: n. 狂妄自大；夸大妄想

e.en: His {megalomania} grew worse after the company went public.
e.zh: 公司上市后，他的自大狂倾向越发严重。

e.en: The dictator's {megalomania} drove the country into ruin.
e.zh: 独裁者的妄自尊大把国家推向了毁灭。

e.en: The villain is portrayed as a power-hungry {megalomaniac}.
e.zh: 反派被塑造成一个渴望权力的狂妄自大者。

e.en: Only a {megalomaniac} would believe he could rule the world.
e.zh: 只有狂妄自大的人才会相信自己能统治世界。

e.en: The CEO's {megalomaniacal} ambitions alarmed the board members.
e.zh: CEO狂妄的野心让董事会成员深感不安。

e.en: His {megalomaniacal} speeches turned voters away.
e.zh: 他自大狂式的演讲让选民纷纷离去。

megalopolis.t: n. 特大都市；大都会带

e.en: Tokyo is a sprawling {megalopolis} of over thirty million people.
e.zh: 东京是一个拥有三千多万人口的庞大都市群。

e.en: The Boston-Washington corridor forms one continuous {megalopolis}.
e.zh: 波士顿到华盛顿一带形成了一片连绵的超级都市带。

megaparsec.t: n. 兆秒差距（天文距离单位）

e.en: The galaxy lies about ten {megaparsec} from the Milky Way.
e.zh: 该星系距离银河系约十兆秒差距。

e.en: Astronomers measure cosmic distances in units of one {megaparsec}.
e.zh: 天文学家用兆秒差距作为宇宙距离的单位。

e.en: The coach shouted instructions through a {megaphone}.
e.zh: 教练用扩音喇叭大声喊出指令。

e.en: Social media has become a {megaphone} for ordinary citizens.
e.zh: 社交媒体已成为普通民众发声的扩音器。

e.en: The new phone has a forty-eight {megapixel} main camera.
e.zh: 这款新手机配备了四千八百万像素的主摄像头。

e.en: More {megapixel} count doesn't always mean better photos.
e.zh: 像素数更高并不总意味着照片更好。

e.en: We watched the new film at the downtown {megaplex}.
e.zh: 我们在市中心的大型影城看了那部新电影。

e.en: The {megaplex} has twenty screens and a huge food court.
e.zh: 这家大型影城有二十块银幕和一个巨大的美食广场。

e.en: She became a global {megastar} after her debut album.
e.zh: 出道专辑发行后，她成为了全球巨星。

e.en: The concert featured a lineup of pop {megastar} performers.
e.zh: 演唱会汇集了多位流行乐巨星登台献唱。

e.en: The new electronics {megastore} opened on the highway last week.
e.zh: 那家新的电子产品大卖场上周在公路边开业了。

e.en: Online shopping has hurt many traditional {megastore} chains.
e.zh: 网购重创了许多传统的大型连锁卖场。

e.en: The bomb had a yield of one {megaton} of TNT.
e.zh: 这枚炸弹的当量相当于一百万吨TNT。

e.en: A {megaton} explosion would devastate an entire city.
e.zh: 百万吨级的爆炸足以毁灭整座城市。

e.en: The solar farm generates over two hundred {megawatt} of power.
e.zh: 这座太阳能电站发电量超过两百兆瓦。

e.en: She greeted everyone with a {megawatt} smile.
e.zh: 她用灿烂耀眼的笑容向每个人打招呼。

mein.t: n. 面条（如 chow mein 炒面）

e.en: I ordered chicken chow {mein} at the Chinese restaurant.
e.zh: 我在中餐馆点了鸡肉炒面。

e.en: The takeout box was filled with steaming lo {mein}.
e.zh: 外卖盒里装着热气腾腾的捞面。

e.en: During {meiosis}, cells divide to produce sperm and eggs.
e.zh: 减数分裂过程中，细胞分裂产生精子和卵子。

e.en: The textbook explains {meiosis} with detailed diagrams.
e.zh: 课本用详细的图解说明了减数分裂。

e.en: The pilot climbed into the giant {mek} for battle.
e.zh: 飞行员爬进巨大的机甲准备战斗。

e.en: Players can customize each {mek} with different weapons.
e.zh: 玩家可以为每台机甲配备不同的武器。

e.en: The {Mekong} river flows through six countries in Asia.
e.zh: 湄公河流经亚洲六个国家。

e.en: Farmers along the {Mekong} depend on its seasonal floods.
e.zh: 湄公河沿岸的农民依赖其季节性洪水。

e.en: The {melaleuca} tree thrives in Australian wetlands.
e.zh: 白千层树在澳大利亚湿地生长茂盛。

e.en: She uses {melaleuca} oil to treat minor skin irritations.
e.zh: 她用茶树精油来缓解轻微的皮肤不适。

e.en: Cheap kitchenware is often made from durable {melamine}.
e.zh: 廉价的厨房用具常用耐用的密胺树脂制成。

e.en: The scandal revealed dangerous {melamine} contamination in milk.
e.zh: 丑闻揭露了牛奶中存在危险的三聚氰胺污染。

e.en: A deep {melancholia} settled over him after the loss.
e.zh: 失去亲人后，一种深深的忧郁笼罩着他。

e.en: The poet wrote beautifully about autumn {melancholia}.
e.zh: 那位诗人优美地描写了秋日的忧郁。

e.en: The film has a beautifully {melancholic} soundtrack.
e.zh: 这部电影有着优美而忧郁的配乐。

e.en: She gave a {melancholic} smile when remembering her childhood.
e.zh: 回忆童年时，她露出了忧伤的微笑。

e.en: The novel explores the quiet {melancholies} of suburban life.
e.zh: 小说探讨了郊区生活中静默的种种忧伤。

e.en: Autumn brings its familiar {melancholies} to the old town.
e.zh: 秋天给这座古老小镇带来熟悉的几缕忧愁。

melancholy.t:
n. 忧郁；愁思
adj. 忧郁的

e.en: A sense of {melancholy} filled the empty house.
e.zh: 一种忧郁感弥漫在空荡荡的房子里。

e.en: The old song always makes me feel {melancholy}.
e.zh: 这首老歌总让我感到忧伤。

melanesia.t: n. 美拉尼西亚（太平洋岛群）

e.en: Fiji is one of the largest island nations in {Melanesia}.
e.zh: 斐济是美拉尼西亚最大的岛国之一。

e.en: Researchers studied ancient migration patterns across {Melanesia}.
e.zh: 研究人员考察了古代横跨美拉尼西亚的迁徙路线。

melanesian.t:
adj. 美拉尼西亚的
n. 美拉尼西亚人

e.en: She studies traditional {Melanesian} art and culture.
e.zh: 她研究传统的美拉尼西亚艺术与文化。

e.en: The festival celebrated {Melanesian} music and dance.
e.zh: 该节庆活动展示了美拉尼西亚的音乐与舞蹈。

e.en: The novel is a {melange} of mystery and romance.
e.zh: 这部小说是悬疑与浪漫的混合体。

e.en: Her outfit was a colorful {melange} of vintage styles.
e.zh: 她的装扮融合了各种复古风格，色彩缤纷。

e.en: {Melanin} is the pigment that gives skin its color.
e.zh: 黑色素是赋予皮肤颜色的色素。

e.en: Sun exposure stimulates the body to produce more {melanin}.
e.zh: 阳光照射会刺激身体产生更多的黑色素。

e.en: Each {melanocyte} produces pigment that protects skin from UV rays.
e.zh: 每个黑色素细胞都会产生色素以保护皮肤免受紫外线伤害。

e.en: Researchers study how {melanocyte} cells respond to sunlight.
e.zh: 研究人员研究黑色素细胞对阳光的反应。

e.en: Early detection of {melanoma} greatly improves survival rates.
e.zh: 黑色素瘤的早期发现能大幅提高存活率。

e.en: The doctor removed a suspicious {melanoma} from her shoulder.
e.zh: 医生从她肩膀上切除了一颗可疑的黑色素瘤。

e.en: Many travelers take {melatonin} to help with jet lag.
e.zh: 许多旅客服用褪黑素来缓解时差反应。

e.en: Your body produces {melatonin} naturally as it gets dark.
e.zh: 天色变暗时，身体会自然分泌褪黑素。

melba.t: n. 梅尔巴（人名，如 peach Melba 蜜桃梅尔巴）

e.en: She served peach {Melba} for dessert at the dinner party.
e.zh: 晚宴上她用蜜桃梅尔巴作为甜点。

e.en: The cafe is famous for its crispy {Melba} toast.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆以脆脆的梅尔巴吐司而闻名。

melbourne.t: n. 墨尔本（澳大利亚城市）

e.en: {Melbourne} is known for its vibrant coffee culture.
e.zh: 墨尔本以其充满活力的咖啡文化而闻名。

e.en: They moved to {Melbourne} for better job opportunities.
e.zh: 他们为了更好的工作机会搬到了墨尔本。

meld.t:
v. 融合；合并
n. 融合

e.en: The chef knows how to {meld} flavors from different cuisines.
e.zh: 这位厨师懂得将不同菜系的风味融合在一起。

e.en: Their voices {meld} beautifully in the chorus.
e.zh: 他们的声音在合唱中完美地融合。

melding.t: v. 融合（meld 的现在分词）

e.en: The album is a {melding} of jazz and electronic music.
e.zh: 这张专辑是爵士与电子乐的融合。

e.en: Their partnership relies on {melding} two very different work styles.
e.zh: 他们的合作依赖于两种截然不同工作风格的融合。

e.en: Keep all {medicines} out of reach of small children.
e.zh: 将所有药品放在小孩拿不到的地方。

e.en: Traditional {medicines} are still used in many cultures.
e.zh: 传统药物在许多文化中仍被使用。

e.en: My cousin is a young {medico} working at the city hospital.
e.zh: 我表弟是在市医院工作的年轻医生。

e.en: The {medico} prescribed antibiotics for the stubborn infection.
e.zh: 那位医生为顽固的感染开了抗生素。

medieval.t:
adj. 中世纪的
adj. 过时老旧的

e.en: The castle is a stunning example of {medieval} architecture.
e.zh: 这座城堡是中世纪建筑的精彩典范。

e.en: Their office policies feel almost {medieval} compared to modern startups.
e.zh: 和现代创业公司相比,他们的办公制度简直像中世纪一样。

medievalism.t: n. 中世纪风格；中世纪研究

e.en: The novel's {medievalism} appeals to fantasy fans worldwide.
e.zh: 这部小说的中世纪风格吸引了全球的奇幻迷。

e.en: Victorian {medievalism} influenced art, literature, and architecture deeply.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的中世纪情怀深刻影响了艺术、文学和建筑。

medievalist.t: n. 中世纪历史研究者

e.en: The {medievalist} gave a fascinating lecture on Norman castles.
e.zh: 那位中世纪研究学者做了一场关于诺曼城堡的精彩讲座。

e.en: As a {medievalist}, she spends summers studying old manuscripts.
e.zh: 作为中世纪研究者,她整个夏天都在研究古老的手稿。

medigap.t: n. 美国联邦医保补充保险

e.en: Many retirees buy a {medigap} policy to cover extra costs.
e.zh: 许多退休人员购买医疗补充保险来支付额外费用。

e.en: Her {medigap} insurance paid for the hospital deductible.
e.zh: 她的医疗补充保险支付了住院免赔额。

medina.t: n. 北非城市的阿拉伯老城区

e.en: We got happily lost in the old {medina} of Marrakesh.
e.zh: 我们在马拉喀什的老城区开心地迷了路。

e.en: The {medina} is full of narrow alleys and busy markets.
e.zh: 老城区里到处是狭窄的小巷和热闹的集市。

e.en: The food was {mediocre}, but the view was incredible.
e.zh: 食物很一般,但景色非常震撼。

e.en: He's tired of writing {mediocre} code under tight deadlines.
e.zh: 他厌倦了在紧迫期限下写出平庸的代码。

mediocrities.t: n. 平庸之事；平庸之人（复数）

e.en: The boss surrounds himself with {mediocrities} who never challenge him.
e.zh: 老板身边都是些从不挑战他的庸才。

e.en: History often forgets the {mediocrities} but remembers the geniuses.
e.zh: 历史常常遗忘平庸之辈,却记住天才。

e.en: She refused to settle for {mediocrity} in her career.
e.zh: 她拒绝在职业生涯中安于平庸。

e.en: The team's {mediocrity} this season disappointed loyal fans.
e.zh: 球队本赛季的平庸表现让忠实球迷失望。

e.en: I try to {meditate} for ten minutes every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上都尽量冥想十分钟。

e.en: He sat quietly to {meditate} on his next career move.
e.zh: 他静静地坐着,思索下一步的职业方向。

e.en: She {meditated} on the mountain for an entire weekend.
e.zh: 她在山上整整冥想了一个周末。

e.en: He {meditated} carefully before answering the difficult question.
e.zh: 他在回答这个难题前仔细思考了一番。

meditates.t: v. 冥想；沉思（第三人称单数）

e.en: My roommate {meditates} every morning before checking her phone.
e.zh: 我的室友每天早上看手机前先冥想一会儿。

e.en: The monk {meditates} for hours under the old tree.
e.zh: 那位僧人在老树下打坐数小时。

meditating.t: v. 冥想；沉思（现在分词）

e.en: I found her {meditating} quietly on the balcony at dawn.
e.zh: 我发现她黎明时分在阳台上静静冥想。

e.en: He's been {meditating} on whether to accept the job offer.
e.zh: 他一直在考虑是否接受那份工作邀请。

e.en: Daily {meditation} has helped reduce my work anxiety significantly.
e.zh: 每天冥想大大缓解了我的工作焦虑。

e.en: The book is a quiet {meditation} on grief and memory.
e.zh: 这本书是对悲伤与记忆的静默沉思。

e.en: His {meditations} on technology and ethics filled three notebooks.
e.zh: 他对科技与伦理的沉思写满了三本笔记。

e.en: Morning {meditations} have become an essential part of her routine.
e.zh: 晨间冥想已成为她日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。

e.en: She entered a {meditative} state while painting the landscape.
e.zh: 她在画风景时进入了沉思的状态。

e.en: The film has a slow, {meditative} pace that rewards patience.
e.zh: 这部电影节奏舒缓而富有沉思感,值得耐心品味。

e.en: He stirred his tea {meditatively} while staring out the window.
e.zh: 他若有所思地搅着茶,望着窗外。

e.en: She walked {meditatively} along the empty beach at sunset.
e.zh: 夕阳下她若有所思地走在空荡的海滩上。

e.en: Even an experienced {meditator} can struggle with a noisy environment.
e.zh: 即使是经验丰富的冥想者,也难以应对嘈杂环境。

e.en: As a beginner {meditator}, she uses a guided app daily.
e.zh: 作为冥想新手,她每天都使用引导式应用。

mediterranean.t:
adj. 地中海的
n. 地中海

e.en: We're saving up for a {Mediterranean} cruise next summer.
e.zh: 我们正在攒钱,准备明年夏天去地中海邮轮旅行。

e.en: A {Mediterranean} diet is rich in olive oil and vegetables.
e.zh: 地中海饮食富含橄榄油和蔬菜。

mediterraneans.t: n. 地中海沿岸居民（复数）

e.en: Many {Mediterraneans} share a love for fresh seafood and olive oil.
e.zh: 许多地中海地区的人都热爱新鲜海产和橄榄油。

e.en: The festival celebrated cuisines from {Mediterraneans} across three continents.
e.zh: 这场节日庆祝来自三大洲地中海居民的美食。

medium.t:
n. 媒介；媒体
adj. 中等的

e.en: I'd like a {medium} latte with oat milk, please.
e.zh: 我想要一杯中杯燕麦奶拿铁,谢谢。

e.en: Video has become the dominant {medium} for online learning.
e.zh: 视频已成为在线学习的主流媒介。

e.en: The old garden has a gnarled {medlar} tree by the wall.
e.zh: 老花园的墙边有一棵盘根错节的欧楂树。

e.en: You eat a {medlar} only after it's gone soft and brown.
e.zh: 欧楂果只有变软发褐后才能食用。

e.en: The band closed with a {medley} of their biggest hits.
e.zh: 乐队以他们最热门歌曲的串烧作为压轴。

e.en: She ordered a {medley} of grilled vegetables as a side.
e.zh: 她点了一份烤蔬菜什锦作为配菜。

medoc.t: n. 法国波尔多梅多克产区红酒

e.en: He uncorked a fine {Medoc} to go with the steak.
e.zh: 他开了一瓶上好的梅多克红酒搭配牛排。

e.en: The vineyard produces some of the region's finest {Medoc} wines.
e.zh: 这家酒庄出产该地区最顶级的梅多克葡萄酒。

e.en: The {medulla} controls vital functions like breathing and heart rate.
e.zh: 延髓控制着呼吸和心率等重要功能。

e.en: Damage to the {medulla} can be life-threatening.
e.zh: 延髓受损可能危及生命。

e.en: Doctors discovered a small {medullary} lesion on the MRI scan.
e.zh: 医生在核磁共振扫描中发现了一处延髓小病灶。

e.en: The {medullary} cavity of the bone contains marrow.
e.zh: 骨骼的髓腔内含有骨髓。

medusa.t:
n. 水母
n. 美杜莎（希腊神话）

e.en: The {medusa} stage of the jellyfish drifts freely in the ocean.
e.zh: 水母的水母体阶段在海洋中自由漂浮。

e.en: In Greek myth, anyone who looked at {Medusa} turned to stone.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,凡是看美杜莎一眼的人都会变成石头。

medway.t: n. 梅德韦（英国河流、地名）

e.en: We took a boat trip down the {Medway} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们沿梅德韦河乘船游览。

e.en: The town of {Medway} has a long maritime history.
e.zh: 梅德韦镇有着悠久的航海历史。

e.en: For lunch I had a delicious bowl of fried {mee}.
e.zh: 午餐我吃了一碗美味的炒面。

e.en: The hawker stall is famous for its spicy curry {mee}.
e.zh: 那家小摊以辛辣的咖喱面闻名。

meek.t: adj. 温顺的；逆来顺受的

e.en: Despite his size, he's surprisingly {meek} in meetings.
e.zh: 尽管他个子大,在会议上却出奇地温顺。

e.en: She gave a {meek} apology and quickly left the room.
e.zh: 她怯怯地道了个歉,迅速离开了房间。

e.en: He {meekly} accepted the criticism without saying a word.
e.zh: 他默默地接受了批评,一句话也没说。

e.en: The puppy {meekly} followed its owner around the park.
e.zh: 小狗温顺地跟着主人在公园里转悠。

e.en: Her {meekness} hides a surprisingly sharp business mind.
e.zh: 她的温顺外表下藏着一颗出奇敏锐的商业头脑。

e.en: Don't mistake his {meekness} for weakness or lack of conviction.
e.zh: 别把他的温和当作软弱或缺乏信念。

meer.t: n. 湖（荷兰语借词，罕用）

e.en: German speakers use {meer} to mean sea or ocean.
e.zh: 德语使用者用 meer 这个词表示海洋。

e.en: The hotel sits right beside the sparkling blue {Meer}.
e.zh: 这家酒店就坐落在波光粼粼的蓝色海边。

e.en: A {meerkat} stood up tall to scan for predators.
e.zh: 一只猫鼬直立起身警惕地扫视着捕食者。

e.en: The zoo's {meerkat} enclosure is always packed with kids.
e.zh: 动物园的猫鼬展区总是挤满了孩子。

meerschaum.t: n. 海泡石；海泡石烟斗

e.en: Grandfather smoked a beautifully carved {meerschaum} pipe every evening.
e.zh: 祖父每晚都抽一支雕工精美的海泡石烟斗。

e.en: The antique shop displayed several {meerschaum} pipes from Turkey.
e.zh: 古玩店里陈列着几支来自土耳其的海泡石烟斗。

meet.t:
v. 见面；遇见
v. 满足（条件）

e.en: Let's {meet} for coffee tomorrow afternoon if you're free.
e.zh: 如果你明天下午有空,我们约着喝咖啡吧。

e.en: The new product doesn't quite {meet} our quality standards.
e.zh: 这款新产品还达不到我们的质量标准。

e.en: This {meeting} could honestly have been an email.
e.zh: 这场会议说实话发个邮件就够了。

e.en: I'm {meeting} an old friend for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚要和一位老朋友共进晚餐。

meetinghouse.t: n. 教友派礼拜堂；集会厅

e.en: The Quaker {meetinghouse} dates back to the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 这座贵格会聚会所可追溯到十八世纪。

e.en: Villagers gathered at the old {meetinghouse} to discuss the proposal.
e.zh: 村民们聚集在老聚会所讨论这项提议。

e.en: Back-to-back {meetings} have left me no time to code.
e.zh: 接连不断的会议让我根本没时间写代码。

e.en: Most of these {meetings} could be replaced by a Slack thread.
e.zh: 这些会议大多可以用一个 Slack 讨论串代替。

meets.t: v. 见面；遇见（第三人称单数）

e.en: This restaurant {meets} all the requirements for our team dinner.
e.zh: 这家餐厅满足我们团队聚餐的所有要求。

e.en: She {meets} her trainer at the gym every Tuesday.
e.zh: 她每周二都在健身房和教练见面。

mega.t:
adj. 超大的；极棒的
pref. 兆；百万

e.en: The startup just announced a {mega} funding round of two billion.
e.zh: 这家初创公司刚宣布了一轮二十亿的超级融资。

e.en: That concert was absolutely {mega} — best night of summer.
e.zh: 那场演唱会简直棒呆了——是整个夏天最棒的一晚。

e.en: He landed a {megabuck} contract with the streaming service.
e.zh: 他和那家流媒体平台签下了一份巨额合同。

e.en: The film's {megabuck} budget didn't guarantee box-office success.
e.zh: 这部电影的巨额预算并未保证票房成功。

e.en: This image is over a {megabyte}, too large to email.
e.zh: 这张图片超过一兆,太大没法用邮件发送。

e.en: Old phones could barely store one {megabyte} of data.
e.zh: 老式手机连一兆数据都几乎存不下。

e.en: The {megachurch} draws thousands of worshippers every Sunday.
e.zh: 这座大型教会每周日吸引数千名信徒前来礼拜。

e.en: Critics argue that the {megachurch} model commercializes religion.
e.zh: 批评者认为大型教会模式让宗教商业化了。

megacity.t: n. 特大城市（人口千万以上）

e.en: Tokyo remains the world's largest {megacity} by population.
e.zh: 按人口计算,东京仍是世界上最大的超级都市。

e.en: Living in a {megacity} can be exhausting but exciting.
e.zh: 生活在超级都市虽然累,但也很刺激。

mechanizes.t: v. 使机械化；用机器生产

e.en: This robot {mechanizes} a job that once required ten workers.
e.zh: 这台机器人取代了原本需要十个工人完成的工作。

e.en: The new platform {mechanizes} routine customer support tasks.
e.zh: 新平台将日常客户支持任务自动化处理。

e.en: The factory is {mechanizing} its assembly line to cut costs.
e.zh: 工厂正在将装配线机械化以降低成本。

e.en: Farmers resisted {mechanizing} their small rice fields.
e.zh: 农民们抵制将他们的小块稻田机械化。

mecklenburg.t: n. 梅克伦堡（德国地名）

e.en: She grew up in {Mecklenburg}, a region in northern Germany.
e.zh: 她在德国北部的梅克伦堡地区长大。

e.en: The {Mecklenburg} coast is famous for its sandy beaches.
e.zh: 梅克伦堡海岸以其沙滩而闻名。

meconium.t: n. 胎粪（新生儿首次排泄物）

e.en: The newborn passed {meconium} within hours of birth.
e.zh: 新生儿在出生后几小时内排出了胎便。

e.en: Doctors check for {meconium} staining during delivery.
e.zh: 医生在分娩过程中会检查胎便污染情况。

med.t:
adj. 医学的（medical 缩写）
n. 药（medicine 缩写）

e.en: My sister is in {med} school studying to be a surgeon.
e.zh: 我姐姐在医学院学习,准备成为一名外科医生。

e.en: He took his {med} every morning with breakfast.
e.zh: 他每天早上和早餐一起吃药。

e.en: She won a gold {medal} at the Olympics last year.
e.zh: 她去年在奥运会上赢得了金牌。

e.en: The veteran proudly wore his service {medal}.
e.zh: 那位老兵自豪地佩戴着他的服役勋章。

e.en: The Olympic {medalist} signed autographs for excited fans.
e.zh: 那位奥运奖牌得主为兴奋的粉丝签名。

e.en: She became the youngest gold {medalist} in her country's history.
e.zh: 她成为她国家历史上最年轻的金牌得主。

medallion.t: n. 大型奖章；圆形浮雕饰物

e.en: He wore a silver {medallion} on a thick chain.
e.zh: 他在粗链子上戴着一枚银质大奖章。

e.en: The taxi displayed its official {medallion} on the dashboard.
e.zh: 出租车在仪表板上展示着官方营运牌照。

medallist.t: n. 奖牌获得者（英式拼写）

e.en: The British {medallist} broke the world record in Tokyo.
e.zh: 那位英国奖牌得主在东京打破了世界纪录。

e.en: Three-time Olympic {medallist} Sarah retired this season.
e.zh: 三届奥运奖牌得主莎拉本赛季退役了。

e.en: Team USA collected dozens of {medals} at the games.
e.zh: 美国队在运动会上获得了数十枚奖牌。

e.en: He polished his old military {medals} every Sunday.
e.zh: 他每个星期天都会擦拭他的旧军功章。

e.en: Please don't {meddle} in my personal affairs.
e.zh: 请不要干涉我的私人事务。

e.en: Politicians shouldn't {meddle} with the central bank's decisions.
e.zh: 政客不应该干预中央银行的决定。

e.en: Everyone in the office considered him a nosy {meddler}.
e.zh: 办公室里每个人都认为他是个爱管闲事的人。

e.en: She has a reputation as a {meddler} in family disputes.
e.zh: 她以爱掺和家庭纠纷而闻名。

e.en: Her {meddlesome} aunt always asked invasive questions.
e.zh: 她那爱管闲事的姑妈总是问些侵犯隐私的问题。

e.en: The boss disliked his {meddlesome} new assistant.
e.zh: 老板不喜欢他那爱多管闲事的新助理。

meddling.t:
v. 干涉；多管闲事
n. 干涉行为

e.en: Stop {meddling} in things that don't concern you.
e.zh: 别再插手与你无关的事情了。

e.en: The report exposed foreign {meddling} in the election.
e.zh: 该报告揭露了外国对选举的干预。

e.en: The ancient {Mede} warriors fought alongside the Persians.
e.zh: 古代米底战士与波斯人并肩作战。

e.en: Historians study the {Mede} empire's rise and fall.
e.zh: 历史学家研究米底帝国的兴衰。

medea.t: n. 美狄亚（希腊神话人物）

e.en: The play {Medea} depicts a woman's terrible revenge.
e.zh: 《美狄亚》这部戏剧描绘了一个女人可怕的复仇。

e.en: In Greek myth, {Medea} helped Jason steal the Golden Fleece.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,美狄亚帮助伊阿宋偷走了金羊毛。

medellin.t: n. 麦德林（哥伦比亚城市）

e.en: {Medellin} is known as the city of eternal spring.
e.zh: 麦德林被誉为永恒春天之城。

e.en: She booked a flight to {Medellin} for her vacation.
e.zh: 她订了一张去麦德林度假的机票。

medevac.t:
n. 医疗救护运输
v. 用飞机送伤员

e.en: A helicopter {medevac} rushed the climber to the hospital.
e.zh: 一架医疗后送直升机将那位登山者送往医院。

e.en: The soldier was {medevac}'d out of the combat zone.
e.zh: 那名士兵被医疗后送出战区。

media.t: n. 媒体；媒介（medium 的复数）

e.en: Social {media} has changed how news spreads worldwide.
e.zh: 社交媒体改变了新闻在全球传播的方式。

e.en: The story dominated the {media} for several weeks.
e.zh: 这件事在媒体上持续报道了好几周。

mediaeval.t: adj. 中世纪的（medieval 的变体）

e.en: The museum displayed {mediaeval} swords and armor.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了中世纪的剑和盔甲。

e.en: She specializes in {mediaeval} European literature.
e.zh: 她专攻中世纪欧洲文学。

mediagenic.t: adj. 上镜的；适合媒体曝光的

e.en: The candidate's {mediagenic} smile won over voters.
e.zh: 那位候选人上镜的笑容赢得了选民的好感。

e.en: They chose a {mediagenic} spokesperson for the campaign.
e.zh: 他们为这场宣传活动选了一位适合上镜的发言人。

e.en: The injury affected the {medial} ligament of his knee.
e.zh: 伤势影响了他膝盖的内侧韧带。

e.en: In English, the {medial} sound differs by dialect.
e.zh: 在英语中,中间的发音因方言而异。

e.en: The nerve runs {medially} along the inner thigh.
e.zh: 这条神经沿着大腿内侧向内走行。

e.en: The tumor had spread {medially} toward the heart.
e.zh: 肿瘤已向内侧朝心脏方向扩散。

median.t:
n. 中位数；中线
adj. 中间的

e.en: The {median} household income rose slightly last year.
e.zh: 去年家庭收入中位数略有上升。

e.en: A car broke down on the highway {median}.
e.zh: 一辆车在高速公路中央分隔带上抛锚了。

e.en: The scan revealed enlarged {mediastinal} lymph nodes.
e.zh: 扫描显示纵隔淋巴结肿大。

e.en: Surgeons carefully avoided the {mediastinal} arteries.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地避开了纵隔动脉。

e.en: The heart sits within the chest cavity's {mediastinum}.
e.zh: 心脏位于胸腔的纵隔内。

e.en: A tumor was discovered in the patient's {mediastinum}.
e.zh: 在病人的纵隔中发现了一个肿瘤。

e.en: The UN sent a diplomat to {mediate} the conflict.
e.zh: 联合国派了一位外交官来调解冲突。

e.en: A counselor helped {mediate} the couple's disagreements.
e.zh: 一位咨询师帮助调解了这对夫妇的分歧。

mediated.t: v. 调解（过去式）；居中促成

e.en: Their teacher {mediated} the dispute between the two students.
e.zh: 老师调解了两个学生之间的争端。

e.en: Most modern relationships are {mediated} through screens.
e.zh: 现代大多数人际关系都是通过屏幕来维系的。

mediates.t: v. 调解（第三人称单数）

e.en: This protein {mediates} the body's immune response.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质介导身体的免疫反应。

e.en: The judge {mediates} disputes between the two companies.
e.zh: 法官调解这两家公司之间的纠纷。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {mediating} between the warring siblings.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在调解兄弟姐妹之间的争吵。

e.en: Hormones play a key role in {mediating} stress responses.
e.zh: 激素在调节压力反应中起着关键作用。

e.en: The couple chose {mediation} instead of going to court.
e.zh: 这对夫妇选择了调解而不是上法庭。

e.en: Successful {mediation} ended the long labor dispute.
e.zh: 成功的调解结束了长期的劳资纠纷。

e.en: Researchers tested the {mediational} role of self-esteem.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了自尊的中介作用。

e.en: The study used a {mediational} model to analyze behavior.
e.zh: 该研究使用中介模型来分析行为。

e.en: Several rounds of {mediations} failed to resolve the dispute.
e.zh: 几轮调解都未能解决这场纠纷。

e.en: Her {mediations} between rival gangs saved many lives.
e.zh: 她在敌对帮派之间的调解挽救了许多生命。

e.en: They hired a professional {mediator} to settle the divorce.
e.zh: 他们聘请了一位专业调解员来处理离婚事宜。

e.en: The senator served as {mediator} during the trade talks.
e.zh: 那位参议员在贸易谈判期间担任调解人。

e.en: The army {medic} treated soldiers under heavy fire.
e.zh: 那位军医在猛烈炮火下救治士兵。

e.en: Call a {medic} immediately—he's losing consciousness.
e.zh: 快叫医务人员——他要失去知觉了。

medica.t: n. 医学（常见于 materia medica 药物学）

e.en: Students study materia {medica} to learn about drug sources.
e.zh: 学生学习药物学以了解药物来源。

e.en: The ancient text on materia {medica} listed hundreds of herbs.
e.zh: 这本古代药物学典籍列出了数百种草药。

medicaid.t: n. 医疗补助（美国低收入者医保）

e.en: {Medicaid} provides health coverage for low-income Americans.
e.zh: 医疗补助为低收入美国人提供医疗保障。

e.en: The state expanded {Medicaid} eligibility this year.
e.zh: 该州今年扩大了医疗补助的资格范围。

e.en: He needs immediate {medical} attention after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后他需要立即接受医疗救治。

e.en: She enrolled in {medical} school after graduation.
e.zh: 她毕业后进入了医学院。

medicalization.t: n. 医疗化（将问题视为医学问题）

e.en: Critics warn against the {medicalization} of normal sadness.
e.zh: 批评者警告不要将正常的悲伤医学化。

e.en: The {medicalization} of childbirth has changed delivery practices.
e.zh: 分娩的医学化改变了接生的方式。

e.en: He was discharged from the army {medically} unfit.
e.zh: 他因医学上不适合服役而退伍。

e.en: The treatment is {medically} approved and widely used.
e.zh: 该疗法在医学上获得批准并被广泛使用。

e.en: The pharmacist prepared a soothing {medicament} for the rash.
e.zh: 药剂师为皮疹配制了一种舒缓的药剂。

e.en: Ancient texts describe each {medicament} and its uses.
e.zh: 古代典籍描述了每种药剂及其用途。

medicare.t: n. 联邦医保（美国老年医保）

e.en: {Medicare} covers most hospital costs for seniors.
e.zh: 医疗保险涵盖了老年人大部分的住院费用。

e.en: She enrolled in {Medicare} when she turned sixty-five.
e.zh: 她六十五岁时加入了医疗保险计划。

e.en: Doctors {medicate} the condition with daily pills.
e.zh: 医生用每日服用的药片来治疗这种病症。

e.en: Some people {medicate} anxiety with alcohol, which backfires.
e.zh: 有些人用酒精来缓解焦虑,但适得其反。

medicated.t:
adj. 含药的
v. 用药治疗（过去式）

e.en: She uses a {medicated} shampoo for her dandruff.
e.zh: 她使用药用洗发水治疗头皮屑。

e.en: The patient was heavily {medicated} after the surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术后服用了大量药物。

e.en: Don't forget to take your {medication} before bed.
e.zh: 睡前别忘了吃药。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a new {medication} for her blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生为她的血压开了一种新药。

e.en: Always tell your doctor about all current {medications}.
e.zh: 务必告诉医生你目前服用的所有药物。

e.en: Some {medications} cause drowsiness as a side effect.
e.zh: 有些药物会引起嗜睡的副作用。

medici.t: n. 美第奇家族（意大利）

e.en: The {Medici} family ruled Florence for centuries.
e.zh: 美第奇家族统治佛罗伦萨长达数个世纪。

e.en: Renaissance art flourished under {Medici} patronage.
e.zh: 文艺复兴艺术在美第奇家族的赞助下蓬勃发展。

e.en: Ginger has well-known {medicinal} properties for nausea.
e.zh: 姜有众所周知的缓解恶心的药用功效。

e.en: She grows {medicinal} herbs in her backyard garden.
e.zh: 她在后院花园里种植药用草药。

e.en: Honey has been used {medicinally} for thousands of years.
e.zh: 蜂蜜作为药物使用已有数千年历史。

e.en: This plant is valued {medicinally} for its antibacterial effects.
e.zh: 这种植物因其抗菌作用而具有药用价值。

e.en: Take this {medicine} twice a day with food.
e.zh: 这种药一天两次,随餐服用。

e.en: He decided to study {medicine} after volunteering at a clinic.
e.zh: 他在诊所做志愿者后决定学医。

e.en: Several fans were injured in the post-game {melee}.
e.zh: 赛后的混战中有几名球迷受伤。

e.en: The protest descended into a chaotic {melee} with police.
e.zh: 抗议活动演变成与警方的混乱冲突。

mellifluous.t: adj. （声音）悦耳动听的；甜美流畅的

e.en: The narrator has a {mellifluous} voice perfect for audiobooks.
e.zh: 这位旁白嗓音圆润悦耳，非常适合录制有声书。

e.en: Her {mellifluous} singing captivated the entire audience.
e.zh: 她甜美悦耳的歌声让全场观众为之倾倒。

mellitus.t: adj. 糖尿病的（多用于 diabetes mellitus）
