e.en: She studies traditional {Micronesian} navigation techniques.
e.zh: 她研究传统的密克罗尼西亚航海技术。

e.en: The festival showcased {Micronesian} dance and music.
e.zh: 这个节日展示了密克罗尼西亚的舞蹈和音乐。

micronutrient.t: n. 微量元素；微量营养素

e.en: Iron is an essential {micronutrient} for healthy blood.
e.zh: 铁是维持血液健康必需的微量营养素。

e.en: Leafy greens are packed with vitamins and {micronutrient} content.
e.zh: 绿叶蔬菜富含维生素和微量营养素。

e.en: A single {microorganism} can multiply rapidly in warm water.
e.zh: 一个微生物在温水中能迅速繁殖。

e.en: Soil contains every type of {microorganism} imaginable.
e.zh: 土壤里几乎包含各种你能想到的微生物。

e.en: Beneficial {microorganisms} help digest food in our gut.
e.zh: 有益的微生物帮助我们的肠道消化食物。

e.en: Scientists found {microorganisms} living deep beneath the ice.
e.zh: 科学家在冰层深处发现了微生物。

e.en: The app uses {micropayment} for tipping favorite creators.
e.zh: 这款应用通过微支付给喜欢的创作者打赏。

e.en: Each article unlocks with a small {micropayment}.
e.zh: 每篇文章通过一笔小额微支付即可解锁。

e.en: Please speak clearly into the {microphone}.
e.zh: 请对着麦克风清晰地讲话。

e.en: My laptop's {microphone} stopped working after the update.
e.zh: 我的笔记本麦克风在更新后就用不了了。

e.en: Studio {microphones} capture every detail of the singer's voice.
e.zh: 录音棚的麦克风能捕捉歌手嗓音的每一处细节。

e.en: Reporters held up their {microphones} as she spoke.
e.zh: 她讲话时记者们举起了各自的话筒。

e.en: The jacket uses a {microporous} membrane to stay breathable.
e.zh: 这件外套采用微孔膜以保持透气。

e.en: {Microporous} materials can filter pollutants from drinking water.
e.zh: 微孔材料能过滤饮用水中的污染物。

e.en: The lab used a {microprobe} to analyze the rock sample.
e.zh: 实验室用微探针分析了岩石样本。

e.en: An electron {microprobe} reveals chemical composition at tiny scales.
e.zh: 电子微探针能揭示极微小尺度上的化学组成。

e.en: The new phone runs on a faster {microprocessor}.
e.zh: 这款新手机搭载了更快的微处理器。

e.en: Every smart appliance has a tiny {microprocessor} inside.
e.zh: 每个智能家电里都有一个小小的微处理器。

e.en: Look through the {microscope} to see the cells clearly.
e.zh: 通过显微镜可以清楚地看到细胞。

e.en: The students adjusted the {microscope} to focus on the slide.
e.zh: 学生们调整显微镜对焦载玻片。

e.en: Modern {microscopes} can image individual atoms.
e.zh: 现代显微镜能拍到单个原子的影像。

e.en: The biology lab has a dozen new {microscopes}.
e.zh: 生物实验室添置了十几台新显微镜。

microscopic.t: adj. 极小的；显微镜下的

e.en: The scratch was so {microscopic} you couldn't see it.
e.zh: 那道划痕极其微小,肉眼根本看不见。

e.en: {Microscopic} dust mites live in nearly every mattress.
e.zh: 几乎每张床垫里都住着微小的尘螨。

e.en: The textbook describes {microscopical} examination of plant tissues.
e.zh: 这本教科书介绍了对植物组织的显微检查。

e.en: She published a paper on {microscopical} analysis of fibers.
e.zh: 她发表了一篇关于纤维显微分析的论文。

microscopically.t: adv. 在显微镜下；极细微地

e.en: The samples were {microscopically} examined for contamination.
e.zh: 这些样本经过显微镜仔细检查有无污染。

e.en: Each gemstone is {microscopically} different from the next.
e.zh: 每颗宝石在显微层面都与下一颗有所不同。

e.en: Different {microscopies} reveal different aspects of the same cell.
e.zh: 不同的显微技术揭示同一个细胞的不同方面。

e.en: The course compares electron and fluorescence {microscopies}.
e.zh: 这门课比较电子显微术和荧光显微术。

e.en: The {microscopist} carefully prepared the tissue slides.
e.zh: 那位显微镜专家小心地制备了组织切片。

e.en: As a forensic {microscopist}, she identifies fibers from crime scenes.
e.zh: 作为法医显微镜专家,她负责鉴定犯罪现场的纤维。

microscopy.t: n. 显微镜检查；显微技术

e.en: Electron {microscopy} revealed structures invisible to light microscopes.
e.zh: 电子显微术揭示了光学显微镜看不到的结构。

e.en: She specializes in fluorescence {microscopy} of living cells.
e.zh: 她专门研究活细胞的荧光显微术。

e.en: The signal traveled across the chip in one {microsecond}.
e.zh: 信号在一微秒内穿过了芯片。

e.en: High-frequency traders compete over every {microsecond} of latency.
e.zh: 高频交易者会为每一微秒的延迟而竞争。

e.en: {Microsoft} released a major update for Windows last week.
e.zh: 微软上周发布了Windows的一次重大更新。

e.en: She got an internship offer from {Microsoft}.
e.zh: 她拿到了微软的实习录用通知。

e.en: Each {microsphere} carries a small dose of the drug.
e.zh: 每一颗微球都携带少量的药物。

e.en: Glass {microsphere} beads make road signs reflective at night.
e.zh: 玻璃微球让路标在夜间能反光。

e.en: {Microstructural} changes in the metal weakened the bridge.
e.zh: 金属内部的微观结构变化使大桥的强度下降。

e.en: Engineers studied the {microstructural} differences between the two alloys.
e.zh: 工程师研究了这两种合金在微观结构上的差异。

e.en: Heating altered the steel's {microstructure} and made it harder.
e.zh: 加热改变了钢的微观结构,使它更硬。

e.en: The {microstructure} of bone gives it both strength and lightness.
e.zh: 骨骼的微观结构让它既坚固又轻盈。

e.en: Doctors used {microsurgery} to reattach the patient's finger.
e.zh: 医生通过显微外科手术为病人接回了手指。

e.en: Eye {microsurgery} requires extremely steady hands.
e.zh: 眼部显微外科手术需要极其稳定的双手。

e.en: The hospital invested in new {microsurgical} equipment.
e.zh: 这家医院引进了新的显微外科手术设备。

e.en: {Microsurgical} techniques have transformed nerve repair.
e.zh: 显微外科技术彻底改变了神经修复。

e.en: A tiny {microswitch} detects when the lid is closed.
e.zh: 一个微型开关用来检测盖子是否合上。

e.en: The keyboard's {microswitch} clicks with every keypress.
e.zh: 键盘的微动开关每次按键都会发出咔嗒声。

e.en: Each sensor is a complete {microsystem} on a single chip.
e.zh: 每个传感器都是集成在单一芯片上的完整微系统。

e.en: Engineers designed a {microsystem} to monitor blood pressure.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一个用于监测血压的微系统。

e.en: Each {microtubule} acts like a tiny track inside the cell.
e.zh: 每条微管在细胞内像一条小小的轨道。

e.en: The drug disrupts {microtubule} formation in cancer cells.
e.zh: 这种药物会扰乱癌细胞中微管的形成。

e.en: Diabetes can cause serious {microvascular} damage over time.
e.zh: 糖尿病久而久之会造成严重的微血管损伤。

e.en: The surgeon specializes in {microvascular} reconstruction after injury.
e.zh: 这位外科医生专精于伤后的微血管重建。

microwave.t:
n. 微波；微波炉
v. 用微波炉加热

e.en: Please {microwave} the soup for two minutes.
e.zh: 请把汤放微波炉里加热两分钟。

e.en: My {microwave} stopped working this morning.
e.zh: 我家的微波炉今早坏了。

microwaveable.t: adj. 可用微波炉加热的

e.en: This bowl is {microwaveable} and dishwasher safe.
e.zh: 这个碗可微波加热,也可放进洗碗机。

e.en: They sell {microwaveable} meals for busy office workers.
e.zh: 他们出售方便上班族的微波速食。

microwaved.t: v. 用微波炉加热（过去式）

e.en: I {microwaved} the leftovers for lunch.
e.zh: 我把剩菜放微波炉里热了当午饭。

e.en: She {microwaved} the popcorn until it stopped popping.
e.zh: 她把爆米花放进微波炉,直到不再爆裂。

e.en: Most modern {microwaves} have a sensor cooking feature.
e.zh: 现在大多数微波炉都带有感应烹饪功能。

e.en: The router transmits data using {microwaves}.
e.zh: 这个路由器用微波来传输数据。

e.en: A drop of pond water reveals a teeming {microworld}.
e.zh: 一滴池水里就藏着一个生机勃勃的微观世界。

e.en: The game lets kids explore a {microworld} of insects.
e.zh: 这款游戏让孩子们探索一个昆虫的微观世界。

mid.t:
adj. 中部的；中间的
prep. 在…之中

e.en: The meeting is scheduled for {mid} March.
e.zh: 会议定在三月中旬举行。

e.en: She paused {mid} sentence to take a sip of water.
e.zh: 她说到一半停下来喝了口水。

e.en: The acrobat flipped twice in {midair} before landing.
e.zh: 杂技演员在半空中翻了两个跟头才落地。

e.en: Two birds collided in {midair} above the lake.
e.zh: 两只鸟在湖面上空半空中相撞了。

midas.t: n. 迈达斯（点石成金的希腊神话国王）

e.en: That investor has a {Midas} touch with startups.
e.zh: 那位投资人在初创公司上有点石成金的本领。

e.en: The legend of King {Midas} warns against greed.
e.zh: 迈达斯国王的传说告诫人们不要贪婪。

e.en: The {midbrain} helps coordinate vision and hearing.
e.zh: 中脑帮助协调视觉和听觉。

e.en: Damage to the {midbrain} can affect movement and reflexes.
e.zh: 中脑受损会影响运动和反射功能。

e.en: Let's take a break at {midday} for lunch.
e.zh: 我们正午时分歇一下吃午饭吧。

e.en: The {midday} sun was almost too hot to bear.
e.zh: 正午的阳光几乎让人难以忍受。

e.en: Summer {middays} in the desert can be brutal.
e.zh: 沙漠夏天的正午会让人吃不消。

e.en: She enjoys quiet {middays} reading in the garden.
e.zh: 她喜欢在花园里安静地度过午间时光看书。

e.en: Archaeologists found old shells in the ancient {midden}.
e.zh: 考古学家在古代垃圾堆中发现了旧贝壳。

e.en: The kitchen {midden} revealed what villagers ate centuries ago.
e.zh: 这处厨房垃圾堆揭示了几百年前村民的饮食。

middle.t:
n. 中间，中部
adj. 中间的

e.en: She sat in the {middle} seat of the row.
e.zh: 她坐在那一排的中间位置。

e.en: The phone rang in the {middle} of dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭吃到一半电话响了。

e.en: A {middle-aged} couple moved into the apartment next door.
e.zh: 一对中年夫妇搬进了隔壁的公寓。

e.en: The class is popular with {middle-aged} runners.
e.zh: 这门课很受中年跑步者的欢迎。

middlebrow.t:
adj. 中等文化品味的
n. 普通品味的人

e.en: The novel is comfortable {middlebrow} entertainment for the beach.
e.zh: 这本小说是适合海滩阅读的轻松中产口味读物。

e.en: Critics dismissed the show as cozy {middlebrow} fare.
e.zh: 评论家把这部剧贬为温吞的中等品味之作。

e.en: Buying directly from the farm cuts out the {middleman}.
e.zh: 直接从农场购买能省去中间商。

e.en: He acted as the {middleman} between the two companies.
e.zh: 他在两家公司之间充当中间人。

middlemarch.t: n. 《米德尔马契》（英国小说名）

e.en: I'm finally reading {Middlemarch} this summer.
e.zh: 我今年夏天终于在读《米德尔马契》了。

e.en: {Middlemarch} is often called the greatest English novel.
e.zh: 《米德尔马契》常被誉为最伟大的英国小说。

middles.t: n. 中间部分（middle 的复数）

e.en: He always skips the {middles} of long books.
e.zh: 他读长篇书总会跳过中间部分。

e.en: The kids' shirts were stained around the {middles}.
e.zh: 孩子们的衣服中间部分都脏了。

middlesbrough.t: n. 米德尔斯堡（英国城市）

e.en: She grew up in {Middlesbrough} in the north of England.
e.zh: 她在英格兰北部的米德尔斯堡长大。

e.en: {Middlesbrough} won their match against Leeds last night.
e.zh: 米德尔斯堡队昨晚的比赛战胜了利兹队。

middlesex.t: n. 米德尔塞克斯（英国郡名）

e.en: She grew up in a small town in {Middlesex}, England.
e.zh: 她在英格兰米德尔塞克斯郡的一个小镇长大。

e.en: The cricket team from {Middlesex} won the championship last year.
e.zh: 米德尔塞克斯的板球队去年赢得了冠军。

e.en: The {middleware} handles authentication before requests reach the controller.
e.zh: 中间件在请求到达控制器之前处理身份验证。

e.en: We added logging {middleware} to track every API call.
e.zh: 我们添加了日志中间件来追踪每个 API 调用。

middleweight.t:
n. 中量级拳手
adj. 中量级的

e.en: He won the {middleweight} title after ten brutal rounds.
e.zh: 经过十回合的激烈较量,他赢得了中量级冠军。

e.en: The boxer dropped down to fight in the {middleweight} division.
e.zh: 这位拳手降级参加中量级比赛。

e.en: The restaurant got {middling} reviews from most critics.
e.zh: 这家餐厅收到大多数评论家的中等评价。

e.en: Her performance was only {middling}, nothing impressive.
e.zh: 她的表现只是中等水平,并不出彩。

e.en: The team's strength lies in their dominant {midfield}.
e.zh: 球队的优势在于他们强势的中场。

e.en: He passed the ball from {midfield} to the striker.
e.zh: 他从中场把球传给了前锋。

e.en: The Spanish {midfielder} signed a five-year contract with the club.
e.zh: 这名西班牙中场与俱乐部签下了一份五年合同。

e.en: As a defensive {midfielder}, he breaks up opposition attacks.
e.zh: 作为一名防守型中场,他负责瓦解对手的进攻。

e.en: A swarm of {midge} flies hovered above the pond at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时分一群蠓虫在池塘上方盘旋。

e.en: I got bitten by a {midge} during the lakeside hike.
e.zh: 我在湖边徒步时被一只蠓虫叮了。

midget.t:
n. 侏儒，极小的人/物
adj. 极小的

e.en: He drove a tiny {midget} car around the racetrack.
e.zh: 他驾驶一辆小型赛车在赛道上飞驰。

e.en: They sell a {midget} version of the popular toy online.
e.zh: 他们在网上出售这款热门玩具的迷你版。

midi.t:
n. MIDI（电子音乐接口）
n. 中长款（裙装）

e.en: She wore a stylish {midi} dress to the dinner party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条时尚的中长裙参加晚宴。

e.en: The producer connected the keyboard via {midi} cable.
e.zh: 制作人通过 MIDI 线连接了键盘。

midland.t:
n. 内陆地区
adj. 内陆的

e.en: The {midland} regions of the country experience cold winters.
e.zh: 该国的中部地区冬季寒冷。

e.en: He grew up on a {midland} farm in central England.
e.zh: 他在英格兰中部的一个农场长大。

e.en: The factory is located in the industrial {Midlands} of England.
e.zh: 工厂位于英格兰中部的工业区。

e.en: Many tech startups are now flourishing across the {Midlands}.
e.zh: 许多科技初创公司正在中部地区蓬勃发展。

e.en: He bought a sports car during his {midlife} crisis.
e.zh: 他在中年危机时买了一辆跑车。

e.en: Many people reassess their careers in {midlife}.
e.zh: 许多人会在中年时重新审视自己的职业。

e.en: The doctor noticed a slight shift in the brain's {midline}.
e.zh: 医生注意到大脑中线略有偏移。

e.en: Draw a {midline} down the page before sketching.
e.zh: 在画草图之前,先在页面上画一条中线。

midlothian.t: n. 中洛锡安（苏格兰地区）

e.en: She works as a teacher in {Midlothian}, just south of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 她在爱丁堡南面的中洛锡安担任教师。

e.en: The hills of {Midlothian} are beautiful in autumn.
e.zh: 中洛锡安的山丘在秋天非常美丽。

midmorning.t: n. 上午中段（约10点前后）

e.en: We took a coffee break around {midmorning}.
e.zh: 我们在上午十点左右休息了一会儿喝咖啡。

e.en: By {midmorning}, the meeting room was packed.
e.zh: 到了上午十点左右,会议室已经挤满了人。

e.en: The store stays open until {midnight} on weekends.
e.zh: 这家店周末营业到午夜。

e.en: She got a text message just after {midnight}.
e.zh: 她在午夜过后不久收到了一条短信。

e.en: Taylor Swift's album {Midnights} broke streaming records on release day.
e.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特的专辑《Midnights》发行当天打破了流媒体纪录。

e.en: He worked several {midnights} in a row to finish the project.
e.zh: 他连续值了好几个夜班才完成项目。

e.en: The {midocean} ridge is where new seafloor is constantly forming.
e.zh: 洋中脊是新海底不断形成的地方。

e.en: Scientists studied volcanic activity along the {midocean} ridge.
e.zh: 科学家研究了洋中脊沿线的火山活动。

e.en: We're at the {midpoint} of the project timeline.
e.zh: 我们正处于项目时间线的中点。

e.en: Mark the {midpoint} of the line segment with a dot.
e.zh: 用一个点标出线段的中点。

midrange.t:
n. 中端，中档
adj. 中档的

e.en: This {midrange} laptop offers great value for students.
e.zh: 这款中端笔记本电脑对学生来说性价比很高。

e.en: His {midrange} jump shot is one of the best in the league.
e.zh: 他的中距离跳投是联盟中最出色的之一。

e.en: The crop top exposed her {midriff} to the cool breeze.
e.zh: 短款上衣让她的腰腹部露在凉风中。

e.en: He felt a sharp pain in his {midriff} after running.
e.zh: 跑步后他感到腰腹部一阵刺痛。

e.en: He tightened his core to protect his {midsection} during the punch.
e.zh: 他收紧核心来保护腰腹部抵挡那一拳。

e.en: The book's {midsection} drags a bit before picking up again.
e.zh: 这本书的中间部分有点拖沓,之后才重新精彩起来。

e.en: The captain ordered the rudder to be held {midship}.
e.zh: 船长命令将舵保持在正中位置。

e.en: Cargo was stored in the {midship} hold for balance.
e.zh: 货物存放在船舯的货舱里以保持平衡。

e.en: The young {midshipman} saluted the captain on the bridge.
e.zh: 年轻的海军军校学员在舰桥上向船长敬礼。

e.en: He served as a {midshipman} before being commissioned as an officer.
e.zh: 他在被任命为军官之前曾担任海军军校学员。

e.en: The shoe's foam {midsole} provides excellent cushioning while running.
e.zh: 这双鞋的泡沫中底在跑步时能提供出色的缓震效果。

e.en: Nike's new {midsole} technology returns more energy with each step.
e.zh: 耐克的新中底技术能在每一步中回馈更多能量。

e.en: She remained calm in the {midst} of the chaos.
e.zh: 在一片混乱之中,她依然保持冷静。

e.en: We're in the {midst} of a major company reorganization.
e.zh: 我们正处于公司大规模重组之中。

e.en: It's risky to change horses {midstream} on this project.
e.zh: 在这个项目进行到一半时换方向是有风险的。

e.en: The boat capsized in the {midstream} of the rapid river.
e.zh: 船在湍急河流的中央翻了。

e.en: In the {midsts} of these various crises, leaders must stay focused.
e.zh: 在这些各种各样的危机当中,领导者必须保持专注。

e.en: They found peace within the {midsts} of life's many storms.
e.zh: 他们在人生诸多风暴之中找到了宁静。

e.en: We had a barbecue on a warm {midsummer} evening.
e.zh: 我们在一个温暖的仲夏夜晚举行了烧烤。

e.en: The festival takes place every {midsummer} in the village.
e.zh: 这个节日每年仲夏都会在村里举行。

midterm.t:
n. 期中考试
adj. 期中的，任期中段的

e.en: I stayed up all night studying for my {midterm} exam.
e.zh: 我熬了一整夜准备期中考试。

e.en: The party lost several seats in the {midterm} elections.
e.zh: 该党在中期选举中失去了几个席位。

e.en: Her office is in {midtown} Manhattan, near Times Square.
e.zh: 她的办公室在曼哈顿中城,靠近时代广场。

e.en: We grabbed lunch at a small cafe in {midtown}.
e.zh: 我们在中城的一家小咖啡馆吃了午饭。

e.en: Many strange creatures live in the {midwater} zone of the ocean.
e.zh: 许多奇异生物生活在海洋的中层水域。

e.en: The submarine cruised through the {midwater} layer searching for fish.
e.zh: 潜水艇在中层水域中巡航,寻找鱼群。

midway.t:
adv. 中途，在中间
adj. 中途的

e.en: We stopped {midway} through the hike to enjoy the view.
e.zh: 我们在徒步中途停下来欣赏风景。

e.en: The car broke down {midway} between the two cities.
e.zh: 车在两座城市之间的中途抛锚了。

midweek.t:
n. 一周中间
adj. 周中的

e.en: Hotel rates are usually cheaper {midweek} than on weekends.
e.zh: 酒店在周中通常比周末便宜。

e.en: They scheduled a {midweek} meeting to discuss the budget.
e.zh: 他们安排了一次周中会议来讨论预算。

e.en: Corn fields stretch for miles across the American {Midwest}.
e.zh: 玉米田绵延数英里遍布美国中西部。

e.en: She moved from the {Midwest} to California for work.
e.zh: 她为了工作从中西部搬到了加州。

e.en: He has a friendly {midwestern} accent that everyone loves.
e.zh: 他有着大家都喜欢的友好中西部口音。

e.en: The chain started as a small {midwestern} grocery store.
e.zh: 这家连锁店最初是中西部的一家小杂货店。

e.en: The {midwife} stayed with her throughout the long labor.
e.zh: 助产士在漫长的分娩过程中一直陪着她。

e.en: She decided to train as a {midwife} after volunteering at clinics.
e.zh: 在诊所做志愿者之后,她决定接受助产士培训。

e.en: Various {midwiferies} across the country offer different birthing approaches.
e.zh: 全国各地不同的助产服务机构提供不同的分娩方式。

e.en: Modern {midwiferies} combine traditional knowledge with medical science.
e.zh: 现代助产专业将传统知识与医学相结合。

e.en: She studied {midwifery} at the local nursing college.
e.zh: 她在当地的护理学院学习助产学。

e.en: {Midwifery} requires both compassion and medical expertise.
e.zh: 助产工作既需要同情心也需要医学专业知识。

e.en: The lake freezes solid by {midwinter} every year.
e.zh: 每年到了隆冬时节湖面就会完全冻结。

e.en: They held a small festival to celebrate {midwinter}.
e.zh: 他们举办了一个小型节日来庆祝隆冬。

midwives.t: n. 助产士（midwife 的复数）

e.en: Experienced {midwives} can handle most uncomplicated births at home.
e.zh: 经验丰富的助产士可以在家处理大多数简单的分娩。

e.en: The hospital employs ten certified {midwives} on its staff.
e.zh: 这家医院聘用了十名持证助产士。

e.en: She approached the stage with a confident {mien}.
e.zh: 她以自信的神态走上舞台。

e.en: His serious {mien} made everyone in the room quiet down.
e.zh: 他严肃的神情让屋里所有人都安静下来。

e.en: The two diplomats wore very different {miens} during the talks.
e.zh: 两位外交官在会谈中表现出截然不同的神态。

e.en: Their stern {miens} suggested the news was not good.
e.zh: 他们严厉的神情表明消息并不乐观。

e.en: The FDA approved {mifepristone} for medical abortion decades ago.
e.zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局几十年前就批准了米非司酮用于药物流产。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {mifepristone} along with another medication.
e.zh: 医生会将米非司酮与另一种药物一起开给患者。

miff.t:
n. 小争执，不快
v. 惹恼

e.en: Her late arrival was bound to {miff} the host.
e.zh: 她迟到肯定会让主人有些不悦。

e.en: Don't let small comments {miff} you at work.
e.zh: 别让一些小评论在工作中惹恼你。

e.en: He looked rather {miffed} when he wasn't invited to the meeting.
e.zh: 他没被邀请参加会议时看起来有些生气。

e.en: She got {miffed} at her friend for forgetting her birthday.
e.zh: 她因朋友忘了她的生日而恼火。

e.en: The Soviet {MiG} fighter jet was famous during the Cold War.
e.zh: 苏联的米格战斗机在冷战期间非常有名。

e.en: He welds steel pipes using a {MIG} welder in his workshop.
e.zh: 他在车间里用 MIG 焊机焊接钢管。

might.t:
v. 可能（may 的过去式）
n. 力量

e.en: It {might} rain later, so bring an umbrella.
e.zh: 待会儿可能会下雨,带把伞吧。

e.en: She pushed the door open with all her {might}.
e.zh: 她使出全身力气把门推开。

e.en: The team struggled {mightily} in the second half of the game.
e.zh: 球队在比赛下半场拼尽全力。

e.en: She labored {mightily} to finish the report before the deadline.
e.zh: 她奋力工作,赶在截止日期前完成了报告。

e.en: The {mighty} river flows for thousands of miles to the sea.
e.zh: 这条雄伟的河流流淌数千英里直至大海。

e.en: That's a {mighty} fine cup of coffee you brewed.
e.zh: 你泡的这杯咖啡真是好极了。

mignon.t: adj. 小巧精致的（多用于菲力牛排）

e.en: She ordered a filet {mignon} cooked medium rare.
e.zh: 她点了一份五分熟的菲力牛排。

e.en: The boutique sells {mignon} accessories for little girls.
e.zh: 这家精品店出售小女孩用的精致小饰品。

e.en: The oysters came with a classic {mignonette} sauce.
e.zh: 生蚝配上经典的米涅特酱汁一起上桌。

e.en: She wore a {mignonette} green dress to dinner.
e.zh: 她穿着一条木樨草绿的连衣裙去赴宴。

e.en: I get a terrible {migraine} whenever I skip lunch.
e.zh: 我一不吃午饭就会犯严重的偏头痛。

e.en: Bright screens often trigger her {migraine} attacks.
e.zh: 明亮的屏幕常常会引发她的偏头痛。

migrant.t:
n. 移民，迁徙者
adj. 迁徙的

e.en: The farm hires {migrant} workers during harvest season.
e.zh: 农场在收获季节会雇用外来务工人员。

e.en: Many {migrant} families settled along the coast.
e.zh: 许多移民家庭在沿海地区定居下来。

migrate.t: v. 迁移，迁徙；迁移（数据）

e.en: Birds {migrate} south every autumn to escape the cold.
e.zh: 鸟类每年秋天都会南迁以躲避寒冷。

e.en: We plan to {migrate} the database to the cloud.
e.zh: 我们打算把数据库迁移到云端。

migrating.t: v. 正在迁移（migrate 的进行式）

e.en: The team is {migrating} all users to the new app.
e.zh: 团队正在把所有用户迁移到新应用上。

e.en: Whales pass this coast while {migrating} north.
e.zh: 鲸鱼北迁时会经过这片海岸。

migration.t: n. 迁移；（数据）迁移脚本

e.en: The data {migration} took the engineers all weekend.
e.zh: 这次数据迁移让工程师们忙了整个周末。

e.en: Bird {migration} patterns have shifted with climate change.
e.zh: 气候变化使鸟类的迁徙模式发生了变化。

migrations.t: n. 迁移；迁移脚本（复数）

e.en: Run the database {migrations} before deploying the server.
e.zh: 部署服务器之前先运行数据库迁移脚本。

e.en: Ancient human {migrations} reshaped entire continents.
e.zh: 远古人类的迁徙重塑了整片大陆。

e.en: This wetland protects many {migratory} bird species.
e.zh: 这片湿地保护着许多候鸟物种。

e.en: The lake is a key stop on the {migratory} route.
e.zh: 这个湖是迁徙路线上的关键中转站。

e.en: The opera depicts the court of a fictional {mikado}.
e.zh: 这部歌剧描绘了一位虚构日本天皇的宫廷。

e.en: Children love stacking sticks in the game of {mikado}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢玩挑棍游戏。

mike.t: n. 麦克风（microphone 的缩写）

e.en: Please speak directly into the {mike} so everyone hears.
e.zh: 请对着话筒讲话,让大家都能听到。

e.en: The host adjusted the {mike} before starting the show.
e.zh: 主持人在节目开始前调整了麦克风。

mil.t: n. 密耳（千分之一英寸）

e.en: The plastic sheet is two {mil} thick.
e.zh: 这张塑料膜厚度为两密耳。

e.en: He served twenty years in the {mil} before retiring.
e.zh: 他在军中服役二十年后才退休。

e.en: The butler bowed and said, "Right away, {milady}."
e.zh: 管家鞠了一躬说:“夫人,马上就办。”

e.en: Shall I fetch your coat, {milady}?
e.zh: 夫人,要我去把您的外套拿来吗?

e.en: She studies fashion design in {Milan}.
e.zh: 她在米兰学习时装设计。

e.en: Our flight to {Milan} was delayed by fog.
e.zh: 我们飞往米兰的航班因雾延误了。

milanese.t:
adj. 米兰的
n. 米兰人

e.en: The chef served a crispy chicken {Milanese} with lemon.
e.zh: 主厨上了一道配柠檬的香脆米兰式炸鸡排。

e.en: She bought a {Milanese} mesh strap for her watch.
e.zh: 她为手表买了一条米兰编织表带。

milano.t: n. 米兰（意大利语拼写）

e.en: We boarded the train at {Milano} Centrale station.
e.zh: 我们在米兰中央车站登上了火车。

e.en: He grabbed a pack of {Milano} cookies from the shelf.
e.zh: 他从货架上拿了一包米兰饼干。

e.en: The weather has been unusually {mild} this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天的天气异常温和。

e.en: She prefers a {mild} curry over a spicy one.
e.zh: 比起辣的咖喱,她更喜欢温和的口味。

mildew.t:
n. 霉，霉菌
v. 发霉

e.en: There is {mildew} growing on the bathroom ceiling.
e.zh: 浴室天花板上长了霉斑。

e.en: Damp basements often smell of {mildew}.
e.zh: 潮湿的地下室常常有一股霉味。

e.en: He threw out the {mildewed} books from the flooded basement.
e.zh: 他把被淹地下室里发霉的书都扔了。

e.en: The shower curtain was {mildewed} and needed replacing.
e.zh: 浴帘已经发霉了,得换一条新的。

e.en: The old cabin had a {mildewy} smell after the rain.
e.zh: 那间老木屋雨后散发着一股霉味。

e.en: She tossed the {mildewy} towels straight into the wash.
e.zh: 她把那些发霉的毛巾直接扔进了洗衣机。

e.en: The review was, to put it {mildly}, disappointing.
e.zh: 客气地说,这条评价让人失望。

e.en: He felt {mildly} annoyed by the constant notifications.
e.zh: 不停的通知让他感到有点烦。

e.en: Tourists love the {mildness} of the island's climate.
e.zh: 游客们都喜欢这座岛屿温和的气候。

e.en: His {mildness} masked a surprisingly stubborn streak.
e.zh: 他温和的外表下藏着出人意料的固执。

e.en: The nearest gas station is about a {mile} away.
e.zh: 最近的加油站大约在一英里外。

e.en: She runs a {mile} every morning before work.
e.zh: 她每天上班前都会跑一英里。

e.en: Hybrid cars get much better {mileage} on the highway.
e.zh: 混合动力车在高速公路上的油耗表现要好得多。

e.en: You can still get plenty of {mileage} from that joke.
e.zh: 那个笑话还能让你笑上好一阵子。

e.en: We pulled over near {milepost} 42 to check the map.
e.zh: 我们在42号里程碑附近靠边停车查看地图。

e.en: Graduation felt like an important {milepost} in her life.
e.zh: 毕业对她的人生来说是一个重要的里程标。

miler.t: n. 擅跑一英里的选手

e.en: He is the fastest {miler} on the college team.
e.zh: 他是大学队里跑一英里最快的选手。

e.en: The veteran {miler} broke his own record yesterday.
e.zh: 那位老将一英里跑选手昨天打破了自己的纪录。

miles.t: n. 英里（复数）；迈尔斯（人名）

e.en: The trailhead is only three {miles} from our hotel.
e.zh: 登山口离我们的酒店只有三英里。

e.en: Her new laptop is {miles} better than the old one.
e.zh: 她的新笔记本电脑比旧的好太多了。

e.en: Reaching one million users was a huge {milestone}.
e.zh: 用户数达到一百万是一个巨大的里程碑。

e.en: Her first solo show marked a career {milestone}.
e.zh: 她的首次个人展览标志着事业上的一个里程碑。

e.en: Invasive {milfoil} is choking the lake's native plants.
e.zh: 入侵的狐尾藻正在挤压湖中的本土植物。

e.en: Volunteers spent the day pulling {milfoil} from the shallows.
e.zh: 志愿者们花了一天时间在浅水区清除狐尾藻。

e.en: We drove through {Milford} on the way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们去海边的路上经过了米尔福德。

e.en: She grew up on a small farm outside {Milford}.
e.zh: 她在米尔福德郊外的一个小农场长大。

e.en: She thrived in the creative {milieu} of the design studio.
e.zh: 她在设计工作室的创意氛围中如鱼得水。

e.en: The novel captures the {milieu} of 1920s Paris.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉到了1920年代巴黎的社会氛围。

e.en: He moved easily between very different social {milieus}.
e.zh: 他能在截然不同的社交圈子之间游刃有余。

e.en: Artists often draw inspiration from unfamiliar {milieus}.
e.zh: 艺术家常常从陌生的环境中汲取灵感。

milieux.t: n. 环境（milieu 的法语复数）

e.en: Her research compares literary {milieux} across two centuries.
e.zh: 她的研究比较了跨越两个世纪的文学环境。

e.en: The diplomat felt at home in foreign {milieux}.
e.zh: 那位外交官在异国的环境中也能怡然自得。

e.en: Pour 250 {millilitre} of milk into the saucepan.
e.zh: 把 250 毫升牛奶倒入小锅。

e.en: The bottle is labelled as 500 {millilitre}.
e.zh: 瓶子上标注为 500 毫升。

e.en: The screw is just one {millimeter} too long.
e.zh: 这颗螺丝正好长了一毫米。

e.en: Engineers measured the gap to the nearest {millimeter}.
e.zh: 工程师把缝隙精确测量到毫米。

e.en: The card is only two {millimeters} thick.
e.zh: 这张卡片只有两毫米厚。

e.en: Rainfall reached thirty {millimeters} in one hour.
e.zh: 一小时内降雨量达到了三十毫米。

e.en: The crack widened by one {millimetre} overnight.
e.zh: 这条裂缝一夜之间又扩大了一毫米。

e.en: Cut the strip to exactly five {millimetre} wide.
e.zh: 把这条料剪成正好五毫米宽。

e.en: The wall tilted just three {millimetres} from vertical.
e.zh: 这堵墙仅偏离垂直三毫米。

e.en: Snow accumulated to twenty {millimetres} by morning.
e.zh: 到清晨积雪已达二十毫米。

milliner.t: n. 女帽制造商；女帽店主

e.en: The royal {milliner} designed hats for the wedding.
e.zh: 皇家女帽匠为这场婚礼设计了帽子。

e.en: A skilled {milliner} can shape felt by hand.
e.zh: 熟练的女帽匠能用手工塑造毛毡帽。

e.en: Her boutique specializes in vintage {millinery} and gloves.
e.zh: 她的精品店专营复古女帽和手套。

e.en: The {millinery} department displayed feathered hats in rows.
e.zh: 女帽部成排陈列着插着羽毛的帽子。

milling.t:
n. 碾磨；铣削
v. 磨碎；铣（milled 原形）

e.en: Crowds were {milling} outside the stadium gates.
e.zh: 人群在体育场门外熙熙攘攘地走来走去。

e.en: The factory upgraded its grain {milling} equipment.
e.zh: 该工厂升级了粮食碾磨设备。

million.t:
n. 百万
adj. 无数的

e.en: The startup raised ten {million} dollars in funding.
e.zh: 这家初创公司融资一千万美元。

e.en: More than a {million} fans watched the livestream.
e.zh: 超过一百万粉丝观看了这场直播。

e.en: He became a {millionaire} before turning thirty.
e.zh: 他不到三十岁就成了百万富翁。

e.en: The lottery turned an ordinary cashier into a {millionaire}.
e.zh: 彩票让一名普通收银员变成了百万富翁。

e.en: Tech booms have created thousands of new {millionaires}.
e.zh: 科技繁荣造就了成千上万的新百万富翁。

e.en: Several {millionaires} attended the charity gala downtown.
e.zh: 几位百万富翁出席了市区的慈善晚会。

e.en: The reclusive {millionairess} rarely appeared at public events.
e.zh: 那位隐居的女富豪很少出席公开活动。

e.en: A young {millionairess} bought the entire seaside hotel.
e.zh: 一位年轻女富豪买下了整座海滨酒店。

millionth.t:
adj. 第一百万的
n. 百万分之一

e.en: The store celebrated its {millionth} customer with confetti.
e.zh: 这家店用彩纸庆祝第一百万位顾客光临。

e.en: For the {millionth} time, please close the door.
e.zh: 我都说一百万次了,请把门关上。

e.en: A {millipede} curled up under the damp log.
e.zh: 一只马陆蜷缩在潮湿的圆木下。

e.en: Despite its name, no {millipede} actually has a thousand legs.
e.zh: 尽管名字如此,马陆其实没有真的一千条腿。

e.en: The reaction took less than one {millisecond} to complete.
e.zh: 这个反应耗时不到一毫秒就完成了。

e.en: Trading systems compete on every {millisecond} of latency.
e.zh: 交易系统在每一毫秒的延迟上激烈竞争。

e.en: The sensor outputs only a few {millivolt} per degree.
e.zh: 该传感器每度仅输出几毫伏。

e.en: Brain signals are measured in tiny {millivolt} fluctuations.
e.zh: 脑电信号是以微小的毫伏波动来测量的。

millpond.t: n. 磨坊蓄水池；平静水面

e.en: The sea was as calm as a {millpond}.
e.zh: 大海平静得像一池磨坊塘水。

e.en: Ducks paddled lazily across the village {millpond}.
e.zh: 鸭子懒洋洋地在村里的磨坊塘里划水。

mills.t:
n. 磨坊；工厂（mill 复数）
v. 碾磨

e.en: Several abandoned textile {mills} line the riverbank.
e.zh: 几座废弃的纺织厂沿着河岸而立。

e.en: He {mills} flour fresh every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 他每周六早上现磨面粉。

e.en: The mortgage became a {millstone} around his neck.
e.zh: 那笔房贷成了压在他脖子上的沉重负担。

e.en: The ancient {millstone} weighed nearly half a ton.
e.zh: 这块古老的磨石重达近半吨。

millwall.t: n. 米尔沃尔（英国足球俱乐部）

e.en: {Millwall} fans packed the stadium for the derby.
e.zh: 米尔沃尔的球迷挤满了德比战的球场。

e.en: He has supported {Millwall} since he was eight.
e.zh: 他从八岁起就是米尔沃尔的球迷。

millwork.t: n. 建筑木构件；磨坊机械

e.en: Custom {millwork} adds character to the renovated kitchen.
e.zh: 定制木作给翻新的厨房增添了特色。

e.en: The carpenter specializes in interior {millwork} and trim.
e.zh: 这位木匠专攻室内木作和装饰线条。

millwright.t: n. 机械安装工；磨坊工匠

e.en: A skilled {millwright} repaired the factory's giant gears.
e.zh: 一位熟练的机修工修好了工厂的巨型齿轮。

e.en: The {millwright} aligned the new turbine perfectly.
e.zh: 机修工把新涡轮机校准得严丝合缝。

milo.t: n. 高粱（饲料作物）；米洛（人名）

e.en: Farmers harvest {milo} for both grain and livestock feed.
e.zh: 农民收割高粱既作粮食又作饲料。

e.en: She drank a warm cup of {milo} before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前喝了一杯热腾腾的美禄。

milord.t: n. 老爷；大人（对英国绅士的称呼）

e.en: The butler bowed and said, "Yes, {milord}."
e.zh: 管家鞠了一躬说:"遵命,老爷。"

e.en: "Your carriage awaits, {milord}," the footman announced.
e.zh: "您的马车已备好,老爷,"侍从禀报道。

e.en: The boss dismissed him as a {milquetoast} pushover.
e.zh: 老板把他视为软弱可欺的窝囊废。

e.en: Voters rejected the candidate's {milquetoast} response to the crisis.
e.zh: 选民拒绝了那位候选人对危机的软弱回应。

e.en: Salmon release {milt} to fertilize eggs in streams.
e.zh: 鲑鱼在溪流中释放鱼精以使卵受精。

e.en: Fishermen carefully collected {milt} from the male trout.
e.zh: 渔民小心地从雄性鳟鱼身上采集鱼精。

milton.t: n. 米尔顿（姓氏，如诗人弥尔顿）

e.en: {Milton} wrote Paradise Lost in the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 弥尔顿在十七世纪写下了《失乐园》。

e.en: My uncle {Milton} runs a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我的叔叔米尔顿在市中心经营一家小面包店。

milwaukee.t: n. 密尔沃基（美国城市）

e.en: She moved to {Milwaukee} for a new tech job.
e.zh: 她搬到密尔沃基去做一份新的科技工作。

e.en: {Milwaukee} is famous for its breweries and lakefront views.
e.zh: 密尔沃基以啤酒厂和湖滨风光闻名。

mime.t:
n. 哑剧；默剧演员
v. 用动作表演

e.en: A street {mime} pretended to be trapped in glass.
e.zh: 一位街头哑剧演员假装被困在玻璃箱里。

e.en: The kids tried to {mime} brushing their teeth.
e.zh: 孩子们试着用动作模仿刷牙。

mimeograph.t:
n. 油印机
v. 油印

e.en: The teacher used a {mimeograph} to copy old quizzes.
e.zh: 老师用油印机复印旧测验卷。

e.en: Schools replaced the {mimeograph} with photocopiers decades ago.
e.zh: 学校几十年前就用复印机取代了油印机。

mimeographed.t:
adj. 油印的
v. 油印（过去式）

e.en: He handed out {mimeographed} sheets smelling of fresh ink.
e.zh: 他发下油印的纸张,散发着新鲜油墨的味道。

e.en: Old activists {mimeographed} pamphlets in basement print rooms.
e.zh: 老一辈活动家在地下室用油印机印制传单。

mimesis.t: n. 模仿；摹仿（艺术/生物）

e.en: Aristotle viewed art as a form of {mimesis}.
e.zh: 亚里士多德将艺术视为一种模仿。

e.en: The novel's power lies in its careful {mimesis} of speech.
e.zh: 这部小说的力量在于对口语的细致模仿。

e.en: The insect's {mimetic} coloring helps it blend with leaves.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的拟态色让它能与叶子融为一体。

e.en: Children learn language through {mimetic} play with adults.
e.zh: 孩子通过与大人的模仿游戏学习语言。

mimetically.t: adv. 以模仿方式；拟态地

e.en: The actor {mimetically} captured every gesture of the politician.
e.zh: 那位演员惟妙惟肖地模仿了那位政客的每个动作。

e.en: Some moths {mimetically} resemble dangerous wasps to deter predators.
e.zh: 一些飞蛾通过拟态像危险的黄蜂以吓退捕食者。

mimic.t:
v. 模仿；仿效
n. 善于模仿的人

e.en: Parrots can {mimic} human voices with surprising accuracy.
e.zh: 鹦鹉能以惊人的准确度模仿人声。

e.en: The app tries to {mimic} a real conversation partner.
e.zh: 这款应用试图模拟真实的对话伙伴。

mimick.t: v. 模仿（mimic 的旧拼写）

e.en: Children {mimick} their parents' tone without realizing it.
e.zh: 孩子会不自觉地模仿父母的语气。

e.en: Modern materials {mimick} the warmth of natural wood.
e.zh: 现代材料能模仿天然木材的温暖质感。

e.en: Some butterflies use {mimicry} to avoid being eaten.
e.zh: 有些蝴蝶利用拟态来避免被吃掉。

e.en: His comedy relies on sharp {mimicry} of celebrities.
e.zh: 他的喜剧依赖于对名人的犀利模仿。

mimics.t:
v. 模仿（第三人称单数）
n. 模仿者（复数）

e.en: The chatbot {mimics} a customer service agent quite well.
e.zh: 这个聊天机器人很会模仿客服人员。

e.en: Stand-up comedy is full of skilled {mimics}.
e.zh: 脱口秀里有许多技艺高超的模仿者。

mimosa.t: n. 含羞草；含羞草鸡尾酒

e.en: She ordered a {mimosa} at brunch on Sunday.
e.zh: 她周日早午餐点了一杯含羞草鸡尾酒。

e.en: The {mimosa} tree bloomed with soft pink flowers.
e.zh: 那棵合欢树开出了柔和的粉色花朵。

min.t: n. 分钟（minute 缩写）；最小值（minimum 缩写）

e.en: The recipe says bake for fifteen {min} at most.
e.zh: 食谱说最多烘烤十五分钟。

e.en: Set the timer for one {min} and stir constantly.
e.zh: 把计时器设为一分钟,并不停搅拌。

e.en: A {mina} was an ancient unit of weight in Mesopotamia.
e.zh: 米那是古代美索不达米亚的一种重量单位。

e.en: The temple owed several {mina} of silver to the king.
e.zh: 神庙欠国王好几米那的白银。

e.en: Union {militancy} grew sharply after the wage cuts.
e.zh: 工资削减后,工会的斗争性迅速增强。

e.en: The party rejected {militancy} in favor of dialogue.
e.zh: 该党摒弃了激进路线,转而支持对话。

militant.t:
n. 激进分子
adj. 好斗的；激进的

e.en: She is a {militant} defender of free speech.
e.zh: 她是言论自由的激进捍卫者。

e.en: A {militant} group claimed responsibility for the attack.
e.zh: 一个武装组织声称对这次袭击负责。

e.en: He {militantly} opposed any cuts to public education.
e.zh: 他强烈反对任何对公共教育的削减。

e.en: The activists {militantly} pushed for stricter climate laws.
e.zh: 活动人士激进地推动制定更严格的气候法律。

e.en: The {militants} retreated into the mountains overnight.
e.zh: 武装分子连夜撤入山区。

e.en: Negotiators struggled to reach the hardline {militants}.
e.zh: 谈判代表很难与强硬派的激进分子达成共识。

e.en: Several national {militaries} took part in the joint drill.
e.zh: 几个国家的军队参加了这次联合演习。

e.en: Modern {militaries} rely heavily on satellite intelligence.
e.zh: 现代军队高度依赖卫星情报。

militarily.t: adv. 军事上；在军事方面

e.en: The country is too weak to respond {militarily}.
e.zh: 该国实力太弱,无法在军事上做出回应。

e.en: Both sides agreed not to intervene {militarily}.
e.zh: 双方一致同意不进行军事干预。

e.en: Historians blame rising {militarism} for the war.
e.zh: 历史学家将这场战争归咎于日益抬头的军国主义。

e.en: The textbook critiques twentieth-century {militarism} in Europe.
e.zh: 这本教科书批判了二十世纪欧洲的军国主义。

e.en: He was branded a dangerous {militarist} by the press.
e.zh: 他被媒体贴上了危险军国主义者的标签。

e.en: The general's {militarist} views alarmed his colleagues.
e.zh: 那位将军的军国主义观点让同僚们感到不安。

militaristic.t: adj. 军国主义的；好战的

e.en: The regime adopted an increasingly {militaristic} tone.
e.zh: 该政权的口吻变得越来越军国主义化。

e.en: Critics called the parade overly {militaristic}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这场阅兵过于军国主义化。

e.en: Activists protested the {militarization} of local police.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议地方警察的军事化。

e.en: The {militarization} of the border worried both governments.
e.zh: 边境的军事化让两国政府都感到担忧。

e.en: Lawmakers warned not to {militarize} domestic policing.
e.zh: 议员们警告不要让国内治安军事化。

e.en: Some fear the new policy will {militarize} the region.
e.zh: 有人担心这项新政策会让该地区军事化。

militarized.t:
adj. 军事化的
v. militarize 的过去式

e.en: Tourists are barred from the heavily {militarized} zone.
e.zh: 游客被禁止进入高度军事化的区域。

e.en: Critics say the campus has become overly {militarized}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这个校园已经过度军事化。

military.t:
adj. 军事的；军队的
n. 军队

e.en: He served in the {military} for eight years.
e.zh: 他在军队里服役了八年。

e.en: The country increased its {military} spending sharply.
e.zh: 该国大幅提高了军费开支。

militate.t: v. 产生影响；起作用（常与 against 连用）

e.en: Several factors {militate} against launching the product now.
e.zh: 有好几个因素都不利于现在推出这款产品。

e.en: High interest rates {militate} against new home buyers.
e.zh: 高利率对新购房者很不利。

e.en: A local {militia} guarded the village during the conflict.
e.zh: 冲突期间一支地方民兵守护着村庄。

e.en: The {militia} disbanded once peace was restored.
e.zh: 和平恢复后,这支民兵组织就解散了。

e.en: An armed {militiaman} stood watch at the gate.
e.zh: 一名武装民兵在大门口站岗。

e.en: The {militiaman} reluctantly handed over his rifle.
e.zh: 那名民兵不情愿地交出了自己的步枪。

e.en: Several private {militias} operate in the border region.
e.zh: 边境地区有几支私人民兵在活动。

e.en: The government banned all unauthorized {militias} last year.
e.zh: 政府去年取缔了所有未经授权的民兵组织。

milk.t:
n. 牛奶；奶
v. 挤奶；榨取

e.en: She poured cold {milk} over her cereal.
e.zh: 她把冷牛奶倒在麦片上。

e.en: Farmers {milk} the cows early every morning.
e.zh: 农民每天清晨给奶牛挤奶。

e.en: This cow is a reliable {milker} year-round.
e.zh: 这头母牛全年产奶都很稳定。

e.en: The {milker} arrived at the barn before dawn.
e.zh: 挤奶工天亮前就到了牛棚。

milking.t:
n. 挤奶
v. 挤奶；榨取

e.en: He is {milking} the goats in the shed.
e.zh: 他正在棚里给山羊挤奶。

e.en: The politician kept {milking} the scandal for attention.
e.zh: 那位政客不断借丑闻博取关注。

e.en: The {milkmaid} carried two heavy pails home.
e.zh: 挤奶女工提着两只沉甸甸的桶回家。

e.en: Vermeer painted a famous {milkmaid} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 维米尔画了一幅著名的厨房挤奶女工。

e.en: The {milkman} delivered fresh bottles before sunrise.
e.zh: 送奶工在日出前送来新鲜的瓶装牛奶。

e.en: Few neighborhoods still have a {milkman} today.
e.zh: 如今很少社区还有送奶工了。

e.en: I ordered a chocolate {milkshake} with extra cream.
e.zh: 我点了一杯加奶油的巧克力奶昔。

e.en: The diner's strawberry {milkshake} is famously thick.
e.zh: 那家小餐馆的草莓奶昔以浓稠出名。

e.en: Monarch butterflies lay eggs only on {milkweed} plants.
e.zh: 帝王蝶只在乳草属植物上产卵。

e.en: She planted {milkweed} to support local pollinators.
e.zh: 她种了乳草以支持本地授粉昆虫。

e.en: The tea turned {milky} after he added cream.
e.zh: 他加了奶油后,茶变得乳白。

e.en: A {milky} fog covered the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨乳白色的雾笼罩着山谷。

mill.t:
n. 磨坊；工厂
v. 碾磨

e.en: The old flour {mill} still grinds local wheat.
e.zh: 那座老磨坊仍在碾磨当地的小麦。

e.en: Tourists {mill} around the square taking photos.
e.zh: 游客在广场上闲逛拍照。

millage.t: n. 以千分之一计的税率

e.en: Voters approved a school {millage} for new buses.
e.zh: 选民通过了一项用于新校车的学校税率。

e.en: The county raised the {millage} to fund libraries.
e.zh: 该县提高了房产税率以资助图书馆。

millbank.t: n. 米尔班克（伦敦地名）

e.en: The party headquarters sit near {Millbank} in London.
e.zh: 该党总部位于伦敦米尔班克附近。

e.en: Tate Britain stands on {Millbank} along the Thames.
e.zh: 泰特英国美术馆坐落在泰晤士河畔的米尔班克。

mille.t: n. 千（法语借词，常见于 per mille）

e.en: She baked a classic {mille}-feuille for dessert.
e.zh: 她做了一款经典的千层酥作甜点。

e.en: The bakery's {mille}-feuille has crisp golden layers.
e.zh: 那家面包店的千层酥层层金黄酥脆。

milled.t:
adj. 碾磨过的；滚花的
v. mill 的过去式

e.en: Freshly {milled} flour makes the best sourdough bread.
e.zh: 新磨的面粉做出的酸面包最香。

e.en: The coin's {milled} edge prevents counterfeit shaving.
e.zh: 硬币的滚边设计防止被刮削伪造。

millenarian.t:
adj. 千禧年的
n. 千禧年信徒

e.en: The cult held strong {millenarian} beliefs about doomsday.
e.zh: 该教派坚信末日千禧的教义。

e.en: Many medieval {millenarian} movements predicted Christ's return.
e.zh: 许多中世纪千禧运动预言基督再临。

millenium.t: n. 千年（millennium 的常见误拼）

e.en: The {millenium} bug worried programmers in 1999.
e.zh: 千年虫问题在 1999 年让程序员忧心忡忡。

e.en: Note that {millenium} is a common misspelling of millennium.
e.zh: 注意 millenium 是 millennium 的常见拼写错误。

e.en: These ruins have stood for several {millennia}.
e.zh: 这些遗迹已矗立了数千年。

e.en: Glaciers carved the valley over many {millennia}.
e.zh: 冰川经过数千年雕刻出这条山谷。

millennial.t:
n. 千禧一代（约1981–1996出生者）
adj. 千年的

e.en: Many {millennial} workers prefer remote-first companies.
e.zh: 许多千禧一代员工更喜欢远程优先的公司。

e.en: The brand redesigned its logo to attract {millennial} buyers.
e.zh: 该品牌重新设计标志以吸引千禧一代买家。

millennialism.t: n. 千禧年说（宗教信仰）

e.en: Scholars trace {millennialism} back to early Christian writings.
e.zh: 学者将千禧年说追溯到早期基督教文献。

e.en: Apocalyptic movies often borrow themes from {millennialism}.
e.zh: 末日电影常常借用千禧年说的主题。

e.en: The new {millennium} began with massive fireworks worldwide.
e.zh: 新千年以全球盛大的烟花拉开序幕。

e.en: This temple has survived nearly a {millennium}.
e.zh: 这座庙宇已留存近一千年。

e.en: The village {miller} ground grain for every household.
e.zh: 村里的磨坊主为家家户户磨粮。

e.en: A dusty {miller} smiled from behind the sacks.
e.zh: 满身面粉的磨坊主从麻袋后面笑了笑。

e.en: Birds love the {millet} seeds in this feeder.
e.zh: 鸟儿很喜欢这个喂食器里的小米。

e.en: She cooked {millet} porridge with honey for breakfast.
e.zh: 她做了加蜂蜜的小米粥当早餐。

e.en: The pressure dropped one {millibar} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风来临前气压下降了一毫巴。

e.en: Hurricanes often have central pressures below 950 {millibar}.
e.zh: 飓风的中心气压常低于 950 毫巴。

e.en: Each tablet contains 200 {milligram} of caffeine.
e.zh: 每片含有 200 毫克咖啡因。

e.en: The lab scale measures down to one {milligram}.
e.zh: 实验室天平最小可测到一毫克。

e.en: Add five {milliliter} of vinegar to the mixture.
e.zh: 在混合物中加入五毫升醋。

e.en: The syringe holds up to ten {milliliter} of liquid.
e.zh: 这支注射器最多能装十毫升液体。

e.en: The call to prayer echoed from the tall {minaret}.
e.zh: 宣礼声从高高的尖塔上回荡开来。

e.en: Tourists photographed the mosque's slender white {minaret}.
e.zh: 游客们拍摄着清真寺那座纤细洁白的宣礼塔。

e.en: The boss shot him a {minatory} look across the table.
e.zh: 老板隔着桌子向他投来一个威胁的眼神。

e.en: Dark clouds gathered with a {minatory} rumble of thunder.
e.zh: 乌云聚集,伴着令人不安的雷声轰鸣。

mince.t:
v. 切碎（肉等）
n. 肉馅

e.en: Please {mince} the garlic finely before adding it.
e.zh: 请把蒜切成细末后再加进去。

e.en: She does not {mince} words when giving feedback.
e.zh: 她给反馈时从不拐弯抹角。

e.en: Stir the {minced} ginger into the hot oil quickly.
e.zh: 把切碎的姜末迅速倒入热油里。

e.en: The chef {minced} a handful of fresh parsley.
e.zh: 厨师把一把新鲜欧芹切碎了。

mincemeat.t: n. 百果馅（果干混合物）

e.en: Grandma bakes a traditional {mincemeat} pie every Christmas.
e.zh: 奶奶每年圣诞节都会烤传统的肉馅派。

e.en: The lawyer made {mincemeat} of the witness's story.
e.zh: 律师把证人的说辞驳得体无完肤。

e.en: Push the beef through the {mincer} for even texture.
e.zh: 把牛肉用绞肉机绞一遍,口感才会均匀。

e.en: My grandmother kept an old hand-cranked {mincer} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 我奶奶在厨房里放着一台老式手摇绞肉机。

e.en: Ferries cross the {Minch} between Scotland and the Hebrides.
e.zh: 渡轮往返于苏格兰和赫布里底群岛之间的明奇海峡。

e.en: Storms in the {Minch} can be dangerous for small boats.
e.zh: 明奇海峡的风暴对小船来说很危险。

mincing.t: adj. 装腔作势的；忸怩的

e.en: He walked across the stage with {mincing} little steps.
e.zh: 他迈着小碎步走过舞台。

e.en: Stop {mincing} words and tell me what really happened.
e.zh: 别再拐弯抹角了,告诉我到底发生了什么。

mind.t:
n. 心智；头脑
v. 介意；留意

e.en: Please {mind} the gap when boarding the train.
e.zh: 上车时请小心车厢与站台之间的空隙。

e.en: A clear {mind} helps you make better decisions.
e.zh: 清醒的头脑能帮你做出更好的决定。

e.en: {Mindanao} is the second-largest island in the Philippines.
e.zh: 棉兰老岛是菲律宾第二大岛。

e.en: They flew to {Mindanao} for a diving holiday.
e.zh: 他们飞到棉兰老岛去度假潜水。

e.en: She is open-{minded} about new technologies and trends.
e.zh: 她对新科技和潮流持开放态度。

e.en: He {minded} the kids while I went shopping.
e.zh: 我去购物时他帮忙照看孩子。

e.en: Her open-{mindedness} makes her a great team leader.
e.zh: 她的开放心态让她成为出色的团队领导。

e.en: Narrow-{mindedness} can hold an organization back for years.
e.zh: 心胸狭隘会让一个组织停滞多年。

e.en: The pop star travels with a personal {minder} for security.
e.zh: 那位流行歌星出行时都有一名贴身保镖。

e.en: We hired a {minder} to watch the toddlers at the party.
e.zh: 我们请了一位保姆在派对上照看小孩。

e.en: Be {mindful} of your tone when emailing clients.
e.zh: 给客户发邮件时要注意你的语气。

e.en: She tries to eat {mindful} meals without her phone.
e.zh: 她努力吃饭时专心,不看手机。

e.en: He sips his morning coffee {mindfully}, noticing every flavor.
e.zh: 他专注地品着早晨的咖啡,留意每一种味道。

e.en: Try to spend money {mindfully} rather than on impulse.
e.zh: 尽量用心花钱,而不是凭一时冲动。

e.en: Daily {mindfulness} practice has reduced her work stress.
e.zh: 每天的正念练习让她的工作压力减轻了。

e.en: The app teaches {mindfulness} through short guided meditations.
e.zh: 这款应用通过简短的引导冥想来教授正念。

e.en: She was just {minding} her own business at the cafe.
e.zh: 她当时只是在咖啡馆里忙自己的事。

e.en: Thanks for {minding} the dog while we were away.
e.zh: 谢谢你在我们外出时帮忙照看小狗。

e.en: Scrolling social media feels like a {mindless} habit.
e.zh: 刷社交媒体感觉是一种无脑的习惯。

e.en: He filled the afternoon with {mindless} video games.
e.zh: 他用毫无营养的电子游戏打发了整个下午。

mindlessly.t: adv. 盲目地；不假思索地

e.en: I {mindlessly} ate the whole bag of chips.
e.zh: 我不知不觉地把整袋薯片吃光了。

e.en: Don't {mindlessly} forward emails without reading them first.
e.zh: 别没看就随手转发邮件。

e.en: The {mindlessness} of modern commuting drains his energy.
e.zh: 现代通勤的麻木无趣让他精疲力尽。

e.en: She criticized the {mindlessness} of endless online shopping.
e.zh: 她批评无休止网购背后的麻木状态。

minds.t:
n. 头脑（复数）
v. 介意

e.en: Great {minds} often disagree on small details.
e.zh: 伟大的头脑常常在小细节上意见不合。

e.en: Nobody {minds} if you join the meeting late.
e.zh: 你晚点加入会议没人会介意。

e.en: A growth {mindset} helps employees handle setbacks better.
e.zh: 成长型思维让员工更好地应对挫折。

e.en: Switching to a customer-first {mindset} changed our product.
e.zh: 转向以客户为先的思维方式改变了我们的产品。

mine.t:
pron. 我的
n. 矿；地雷

e.en: That blue umbrella by the door is {mine}.
e.zh: 门口那把蓝色雨伞是我的。

e.en: Workers descended into the coal {mine} before dawn.
e.zh: 工人们在天亮前下到煤矿井下。

e.en: Gold has been {mined} in this valley for centuries.
e.zh: 几百年来人们一直在这个山谷里开采黄金。

e.en: Researchers {mined} the dataset for hidden patterns.
e.zh: 研究人员从数据集中挖掘隐藏的规律。

e.en: Office politics can be a real {minefield} for newcomers.
e.zh: 办公室政治对新人来说就是一片雷区。

e.en: Soldiers carefully cleared the {minefield} along the border.
e.zh: 士兵们小心地清除了边境沿线的雷区。

e.en: Old {minefields} still pose dangers years after the war.
e.zh: 战争结束多年后,旧雷区仍然存在危险。

e.en: Family dinners can feel like emotional {minefields}.
e.zh: 家庭聚餐有时像情感上的雷区。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a coal {miner} in Wales.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在威尔士当煤矿工人。

e.en: Each {miner} wore a helmet with a bright lamp.
e.zh: 每个矿工都戴着带强光灯的安全帽。

mineral.t:
n. 矿物
adj. 矿物的

e.en: Spinach is a great source of iron and other {mineral} nutrients.
e.zh: 菠菜是铁和其他矿物质营养的极佳来源。

e.en: She prefers sparkling {mineral} water with her meals.
e.zh: 她吃饭时喜欢配气泡矿泉水。

e.en: Heavy {mineralisation} of bone makes it hard and brittle.
e.zh: 骨骼的过度矿化会使其变硬变脆。

e.en: Geologists study {mineralisation} patterns to locate ore deposits.
e.zh: 地质学家研究矿化分布来寻找矿床。

e.en: Over time, the buried wood became {mineralized} into stone.
e.zh: 经过漫长岁月,埋藏的木头矿化成了石头。

e.en: Healthy enamel is highly {mineralized} and resists cavities.
e.zh: 健康的牙釉质矿化程度高,能防止蛀牙。

e.en: The lab ran a {mineralogical} analysis on the rock samples.
e.zh: 实验室对岩石样本进行了矿物学分析。

e.en: She earned a {mineralogical} degree before joining the mining firm.
e.zh: 她拿到矿物学学位后加入了那家矿业公司。

e.en: He teaches {mineralogy} at a small geology department.
e.zh: 他在一个小型地质学系教授矿物学。

e.en: Modern {mineralogy} uses X-rays to identify crystal structures.
e.zh: 现代矿物学利用X射线来识别晶体结构。

e.en: Leafy greens are packed with vitamins and {minerals}.
e.zh: 绿叶蔬菜富含维生素和矿物质。

e.en: Australia exports large quantities of {minerals} every year.
e.zh: 澳大利亚每年出口大量矿产。

e.en: The {miners} cheered when the rescue capsule reached them.
e.zh: 当救援舱抵达时,矿工们欢呼起来。

e.en: Bitcoin {miners} consume enormous amounts of electricity worldwide.
e.zh: 比特币矿工在全球消耗着巨大的电力。

minerva.t: n. 密涅瓦（罗马智慧女神）

e.en: Roman temples often honored {Minerva}, goddess of wisdom.
e.zh: 罗马的神庙常供奉智慧女神密涅瓦。

e.en: The university's logo features an owl beside {Minerva}.
e.zh: 这所大学的校徽上有一只猫头鹰立于密涅瓦旁边。

e.en: The company {mines} lithium for electric car batteries.
e.zh: 该公司开采锂矿用于制造电动汽车电池。

e.en: Soldiers carefully cleared the {mines} from the field.
e.zh: 士兵们小心翼翼地清除了田里的地雷。

e.en: Workers descended into the {mineshaft} at dawn.
e.zh: 工人们在黎明时分下到矿井里。

e.en: The old {mineshaft} was sealed off for safety.
e.zh: 出于安全考虑,那座旧矿井被封闭了。

e.en: I ordered a bowl of hot {minestrone} for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了一碗热腾腾的意式蔬菜汤。

e.en: Her grandmother makes the best {minestrone} in town.
e.zh: 她奶奶做的意式蔬菜汤是镇上最好喝的。

e.en: I used to play {minesweeper} on my dad's old PC.
e.zh: 我以前常在我爸的旧电脑上玩扫雷游戏。

e.en: The navy deployed a {minesweeper} to clear the harbor.
e.zh: 海军派出一艘扫雷舰清理港口。

e.en: Each {mineworker} wore a helmet with a bright headlamp.
e.zh: 每位矿工都戴着配有强光头灯的安全帽。

e.en: The union represents thousands of {mineworker} families.
e.zh: 工会代表着成千上万矿工家庭的利益。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {ming} vase from China.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自中国的珍贵明代花瓶。

e.en: Collectors pay millions for authentic {ming} porcelain.
e.zh: 收藏家愿出数百万购买真正的明代瓷器。

e.en: Guests began to {mingle} in the hotel lobby.
e.zh: 宾客们开始在酒店大堂里互相交流。

e.en: Sweet and salty flavors {mingle} nicely in this dish.
e.zh: 这道菜里甜味和咸味融合得很好。

mingled.t:
adj. 混合的
v. 混合（过去式）

e.en: She {mingled} with the crowd at the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她在画廊开幕式上与人群交谈应酬。

e.en: Joy and sadness {mingled} in his goodbye letter.
e.zh: 他的告别信中喜悦与悲伤交织在一起。

mingles.t: v. 混合；交际（第三人称）

e.en: The CEO {mingles} with employees at every annual party.
e.zh: 每年的派对上,首席执行官都会和员工们打成一片。

e.en: Fresh mint {mingles} with lime in this cocktail.
e.zh: 这款鸡尾酒里薄荷与青柠的香气相互交融。

e.en: After the talk, attendees enjoyed {mingling} over coffee.
e.zh: 演讲结束后,与会者一边喝咖啡一边交流。

e.en: The smell of pine was {mingling} with wood smoke.
e.zh: 松木的香气与木柴烟味交织在一起。

e.en: She bought a {mini} fridge for her dorm room.
e.zh: 她为宿舍买了一台迷你冰箱。

e.en: The store offers a {mini} version of the popular bag.
e.zh: 这家店推出了那款热门包包的迷你版本。

miniature.t:
adj. 微型的
n. 小模型

e.en: He paints {miniature} figures for his board game collection.
e.zh: 他为自己的桌游收藏绘制微缩人物模型。

e.en: The dollhouse contained {miniature} furniture in every room.
e.zh: 娃娃屋每个房间都摆放着微型家具。

e.en: The {miniaturisation} of chips made smartphones possible.
e.zh: 芯片的小型化使智能手机成为可能。

e.en: Engineers focus on {miniaturisation} to save device space.
e.zh: 工程师们专注于小型化以节省设备空间。

e.en: The {miniaturist} spent months painting one tiny portrait.
e.zh: 这位微型画家花了几个月画一幅小小的肖像。

e.en: As a {miniaturist}, she works under a magnifying lens.
e.zh: 作为微型艺术家,她在放大镜下进行创作。

minnow.t: n. 米诺鱼（小型淡水鱼）

e.en: A tiny {minnow} darted through the clear stream.
e.zh: 一条小米诺鱼飞快地穿过清澈的溪水。

e.en: The startup is just a {minnow} in the industry.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在业内只是一条小鱼。

minoan.t: adj. 米诺斯文明的（古克里特）

e.en: The {Minoan} civilization flourished on ancient Crete.
e.zh: 米诺斯文明曾在古代克里特岛兴盛一时。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered beautiful {Minoan} frescoes at the site.
e.zh: 考古学家在遗址中发现了精美的米诺斯壁画。

minor.t:
adj. 次要的；轻微的
n. 未成年人；辅修

e.en: The accident caused only {minor} damage to the car.
e.zh: 这次事故只对车辆造成了轻微损坏。

e.en: She's a {minor}, so she can't sign the contract.
e.zh: 她是未成年人,不能签合同。

minorities.t: n. 少数群体；少数民族（复数）

e.en: The policy aims to protect ethnic {minorities} from discrimination.
e.zh: 该政策旨在保护少数族裔免受歧视。

e.en: Several {minorities} are underrepresented in the tech industry.
e.zh: 科技行业中多个少数群体的代表性不足。

e.en: Only a {minority} of voters supported the proposal.
e.zh: 只有少数选民支持这项提案。

e.en: She advocates for {minority} rights in the workplace.
e.zh: 她为职场中的少数群体权益发声。

minos.t: n. 米诺斯（希腊神话克里特国王）

e.en: King {Minos} ruled ancient Crete according to Greek myth.
e.zh: 据希腊神话,弥诺斯王统治着古代克里特。

e.en: {Minos} ordered Daedalus to build the famous labyrinth.
e.zh: 弥诺斯命令代达罗斯建造了那座著名的迷宫。

minotaur.t: n. 米诺陶洛斯；牛头人身怪

e.en: Theseus slayed the {Minotaur} deep inside the labyrinth.
e.zh: 忒修斯在迷宫深处杀死了米诺陶洛斯。

e.en: The {Minotaur} had a bull's head and human body.
e.zh: 米诺陶洛斯有牛的头和人的身躯。

e.en: His doctor prescribed {minoxidil} for thinning hair.
e.zh: 医生给他开了米诺地尔来治疗脱发。

e.en: {Minoxidil} is sold over the counter in many countries.
e.zh: 米诺地尔在许多国家可以非处方购买。

minsk.t: n. 明斯克（白俄罗斯首都）

e.en: {Minsk} is the capital and largest city of Belarus.
e.zh: 明斯克是白俄罗斯的首都和最大城市。

e.en: He flew to {Minsk} for a business conference.
e.zh: 他飞往明斯克参加一个商务会议。

minster.t: n. 大教堂；修道院教堂

e.en: York {Minster} is a stunning Gothic cathedral.
e.zh: 约克大教堂是一座令人惊叹的哥特式建筑。

e.en: Tourists gathered outside the ancient {minster} to take photos.
e.zh: 游客们聚集在古老的大教堂外拍照。

e.en: The volunteers {minstered} to the wounded throughout the night.
e.zh: 志愿者们整夜照料着伤者。

e.en: She {minstered} comfort to the lonely elderly residents.
e.zh: 她为孤独的老人们送去慰藉。

e.en: He spent years {minstering} to the homeless community.
e.zh: 他多年来一直在照顾无家可归者群体。

e.en: The chaplain was {minstering} to soldiers on the front lines.
e.zh: 随军牧师正在前线照料士兵。

e.en: Several medieval {minsters} still stand across northern England.
e.zh: 英格兰北部仍保留着几座中世纪大教堂。

e.en: The town is known for its two ancient {minsters}.
e.zh: 这个小镇以两座古老的大教堂而闻名。

minstrel.t: n. 吟游诗人；游唱歌手

e.en: A wandering {minstrel} entertained guests at the festival.
e.zh: 一位流浪的吟游诗人在节庆上为宾客表演。

e.en: The medieval {minstrel} sang ballads of brave knights.
e.zh: 那位中世纪吟游诗人传唱着勇敢骑士的歌谣。

minstrelsy.t: n. 吟游诗人的艺术；游唱歌曲

e.en: The novel describes the rich tradition of medieval {minstrelsy}.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了中世纪吟游艺术的丰富传统。

e.en: Scholars have studied the history of American {minstrelsy} extensively.
e.zh: 学者们对美国吟游艺人表演的历史进行了深入研究。

mint.t:
n. 薄荷；造币厂
v. 铸造（硬币）

e.en: She added fresh {mint} leaves to the lemonade.
e.zh: 她在柠檬水里加了新鲜的薄荷叶。

e.en: This vintage comic book is in {mint} condition.
e.zh: 这本老漫画书保存得完好如新。

e.en: The royal {minter} produced coins for the kingdom.
e.zh: 皇家造币师为王国铸造钱币。

e.en: The startup is a leading {minter} of NFT artwork.
e.zh: 这家初创公司是NFT艺术品的领先铸造方。

e.en: Lord {Minto} served as Governor General of Canada.
e.zh: 明托勋爵曾担任加拿大总督。

e.en: The town of {Minto} hosts an annual summer festival.
e.zh: 明托镇每年都会举办夏季节庆活动。

minton.t: n. 明顿（英国瓷器品牌；姓氏）

e.en: She collects antique {Minton} porcelain from the Victorian era.
e.zh: 她收藏维多利亚时代的古董明顿瓷器。

e.en: This delicate {Minton} teacup belonged to my grandmother.
e.zh: 这只精致的明顿茶杯是我祖母的。

mints.t:
n. 薄荷糖（复数）
v. 铸造

e.en: He always carries breath {mints} in his pocket.
e.zh: 他口袋里总是装着清新口气的薄荷糖。

e.en: The artist {mints} a new digital collection each month.
e.zh: 这位艺术家每月铸造一个新的数字藏品系列。

minty.t: adj. 薄荷味的；带薄荷香的

e.en: The toothpaste has a refreshing {minty} flavor.
e.zh: 这款牙膏有一股清爽的薄荷味。

e.en: She loved the {minty} aftertaste of the gum.
e.zh: 她很喜欢这口香糖留下的薄荷余味。

e.en: The orchestra played a graceful {minuet} from Mozart.
e.zh: 乐团演奏了一首莫扎特优雅的小步舞曲。

e.en: Couples danced a slow {minuet} at the ball.
e.zh: 舞会上,情侣们跳着缓慢的小步舞。

minus.t:
prep. 减去
adj. 负的；不足的

e.en: Five {minus} two equals three.
e.zh: 五减二等于三。

e.en: The temperature dropped to {minus} ten degrees overnight.
e.zh: 夜里气温骤降到零下十度。

minuscule.t: adj. 极小的；微不足道的

e.en: The chances of winning the lottery are {minuscule}.
e.zh: 中彩票的几率微乎其微。

e.en: She wrote a note in {minuscule} handwriting.
e.zh: 她用极小的字迹写了一张便条。

minute.t:
n. 分钟；片刻
adj. 微小的

e.en: I'll be ready in just a {minute}.
e.zh: 我马上就好,稍等一下。

e.en: The scientist examined every {minute} detail of the sample.
e.zh: 科学家仔细检查了样本的每一个细节。

e.en: He {minutely} examined the contract before signing it.
e.zh: 他在签字之前仔细审查了合同。

e.en: The detective {minutely} inspected the crime scene for clues.
e.zh: 侦探仔细察看犯罪现场寻找线索。

minuteman.t: n. 美国独立战争民兵；义勇兵

e.en: The {Minuteman} statue commemorates American Revolutionary War heroes.
e.zh: 民兵雕像纪念着美国独立战争的英雄。

e.en: Each {Minuteman} could grab his musket and fight immediately.
e.zh: 每个民兵都能立刻抓起火枪投入战斗。

minutes.t: n. 分钟（复数）；会议记录

e.en: The meeting will start in fifteen {minutes}.
e.zh: 会议将在十五分钟后开始。

e.en: She took {minutes} during the board meeting.
e.zh: 她在董事会会议上做了会议记录。

minutia.t: n. 细枝末节；琐碎细节

e.en: He focused on every {minutia} of the legal document.
e.zh: 他关注法律文件的每一个细枝末节。

e.en: Don't worry about every tiny {minutia} of the plan.
e.zh: 不必担心计划中的每一个琐碎细节。

minutiae.t: n. 琐碎细节（minutia 复数）

e.en: She's obsessed with the {minutiae} of project management.
e.zh: 她对项目管理的种种细节十分痴迷。

e.en: Let's not get bogged down in {minutiae} right now.
e.zh: 我们现在别陷在那些琐碎细节里了。

minx.t: n. 刁蛮女孩；调皮姑娘

e.en: That little {minx} stole my dessert again.
e.zh: 那个调皮鬼又偷吃了我的甜点。

e.en: She gave him a playful smile, the cheeky {minx}.
e.zh: 她俏皮地朝他一笑,真是个机灵鬼。

minyan.t: n. 米尼安（犹太教祈祷所需十人法定人数）

e.en: They needed a tenth man to complete the {minyan}.
e.zh: 他们需要第十个人来凑齐祈祷所需的人数。

e.en: The synagogue gathered a {minyan} for morning prayers.
e.zh: 会堂凑齐了晨祷所需的十人法定人数。

miocene.t:
n. 中新世
adj. 中新世的

e.en: Many modern mammals first appeared during the {Miocene} epoch.
e.zh: 许多现代哺乳动物最早出现在中新世。

e.en: Scientists discovered {Miocene} fossils in the limestone cliffs.
e.zh: 科学家在石灰岩崖壁中发现了中新世化石。

mips.t: n. 每秒百万指令；MIPS 处理器架构

e.en: The processor delivers over a thousand {MIPS} of performance.
e.zh: 该处理器可提供超过一千MIPS的性能。

e.en: Engineers measured the chip's speed in {MIPS}.
e.zh: 工程师以每秒百万指令数来衡量芯片速度。

mir.t: n. 和平号空间站；俄语“和平”

e.en: The {Mir} space station orbited Earth for fifteen years.
e.zh: 和平号空间站绕地球运行了十五年。

e.en: Astronauts conducted countless experiments aboard {Mir}.
e.zh: 宇航员在和平号上进行了无数次实验。

mira.t: n. 米拉（鲸鱼座变星；女性名）

e.en: {Mira} is a famous variable star in Cetus.
e.zh: 米拉是鲸鱼座一颗著名的变星。

e.en: My friend {Mira} just moved to Tokyo last week.
e.zh: 我的朋友米拉上周刚搬到东京。

miracle.t: n. 奇迹；不可思议之事

e.en: Doctors called her recovery a medical {miracle}.
e.zh: 医生称她的康复是医学奇迹。

e.en: It's a {miracle} we made the flight on time.
e.zh: 我们能准时赶上航班简直是个奇迹。

e.en: She believes that small {miracles} happen every day.
e.zh: 她相信每天都会有小小的奇迹发生。

e.en: Modern medicine can perform amazing {miracles}.
e.zh: 现代医学能创造令人惊叹的奇迹。

miraculous.t: adj. 奇迹般的；不可思议的

e.en: Doctors called her recovery {miraculous} after the severe accident.
e.zh: 在那场严重事故后，医生称她的康复堪称奇迹。

e.en: The startup had a {miraculous} turnaround in just six months.
e.zh: 这家初创公司仅用六个月就奇迹般地扭转了局面。

miraculously.t: adv. 奇迹般地；不可思议地

e.en: Everyone {miraculously} survived the plane's emergency landing.
e.zh: 飞机紧急迫降后，所有人都奇迹般地生还了。

e.en: The old phone {miraculously} still works after twenty years.
e.zh: 这部旧手机用了二十年居然还能正常运行。

e.en: The lake in the desert turned out to be a {mirage}.
e.zh: 沙漠里的那片湖原来只是海市蜃楼。

e.en: His promise of quick wealth was just a {mirage}.
e.zh: 他关于快速致富的承诺不过是一种幻象。

miranda.t: n. 米兰达（女性名；米兰达警告）

e.en: The officer read him his {Miranda} rights before the arrest.
e.zh: 警官在逮捕前向他宣读了米兰达权利。

e.en: Failing to issue a {Miranda} warning can void a confession.
e.zh: 未宣读米兰达警告可能导致供词无效。

mire.t:
n. 泥潭；困境
v. 使陷入困境

e.en: The truck got stuck deep in the muddy {mire}.
e.zh: 卡车深陷在泥泞的沼泽里动弹不得。

e.en: The company fell into a {mire} of legal troubles.
e.zh: 这家公司陷入了一连串的法律困境。

mired.t: v. 深陷（泥潭/困境）；受困

e.en: The project is {mired} in bureaucratic delays.
e.zh: 这个项目深陷在官僚拖延之中。

e.en: She felt {mired} in self-doubt after the failed launch.
e.zh: 产品发布失败后，她陷入深深的自我怀疑。

e.en: Add a splash of {mirin} to balance the soy sauce.
e.zh: 加一点味淋来中和酱油的咸味。

e.en: Authentic teriyaki sauce always uses {mirin} for sweetness.
e.zh: 正宗的照烧酱总是用味淋来增加甜味。

miro.t: n. 米罗（西班牙画家 Joan Miró）

e.en: Our team brainstorms ideas on a shared {Miro} board.
e.zh: 我们团队在共享的 Miro 白板上集思广益。

e.en: She sketched the user flow in {Miro} during the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议中用 Miro 画出了用户流程图。

mirren.t: n. 米伦（姓氏，如 Helen Mirren）

e.en: Helen {Mirren} won an Oscar for The Queen.
e.zh: 海伦·米伦凭借《女王》获得了奥斯卡奖。

e.en: The audience applauded as {Mirren} stepped onto the stage.
e.zh: 米伦走上舞台时，观众报以热烈掌声。

e.en: {Miniaturization} of sensors enabled tiny medical implants.
e.zh: 传感器的小型化让微型医疗植入物成为可能。

e.en: Watchmakers achieved remarkable {miniaturization} of mechanical parts.
e.zh: 制表师在机械零件小型化方面取得了惊人成就。

miniaturize.t: v. 使小型化；使微型化

e.en: Engineers worked hard to {miniaturize} the wireless earbuds.
e.zh: 工程师们努力让无线耳机变得更小巧。

e.en: They plan to {miniaturize} the device for portable use.
e.zh: 他们计划把这款设备小型化以便携带使用。

miniaturized.t: adj. 微型化的；小型化的

e.en: The {miniaturized} camera fits inside a contact lens.
e.zh: 这种小型化的摄像头可装入隐形眼镜中。

e.en: Apple {miniaturized} the chip while doubling its speed.
e.zh: 苹果让这款芯片更小巧,速度却翻了一倍。

minibar.t: n. 酒店客房内的小型冰柜吧台

e.en: The hotel room's {minibar} was stocked with overpriced snacks.
e.zh: 酒店房间的迷你吧里塞满了价格虚高的零食。

e.en: Don't open the {minibar} unless you're ready to pay.
e.zh: 除非你准备好付钱,否则别打开迷你吧。

e.en: A {minibus} took us from the airport to the resort.
e.zh: 一辆小巴把我们从机场送到度假村。

e.en: The school hired a {minibus} for the field trip.
e.zh: 学校为这次实地考察租了一辆小巴。

minicab.t: n. 电话预约的小型出租车

e.en: We booked a {minicab} to get home after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后我们叫了一辆出租小车回家。

e.en: The {minicab} driver knew every shortcut in London.
e.zh: 这位出租小车司机熟悉伦敦的每一条捷径。

e.en: The reporter clipped a {minicam} to her jacket lapel.
e.zh: 记者把一台微型摄像机别在外套翻领上。

e.en: A hidden {minicam} captured the entire conversation.
e.zh: 一台隐藏的微型摄像机录下了整段对话。

e.en: She drives a {minicar} that easily fits any parking spot.
e.zh: 她开着一辆能轻松停进任何车位的微型车。

e.en: Japanese {minicar} models are popular in crowded cities.
e.zh: 日本的微型车款式在拥挤的城市里很受欢迎。

e.en: The lab still uses an old {minicomputer} for calculations.
e.zh: 实验室仍在使用一台老式小型计算机做运算。

e.en: In the seventies, every office wanted its own {minicomputer}.
e.zh: 七十年代,每个办公室都想拥有自己的小型计算机。

e.en: Dad still keeps his old {minidisc} player in the drawer.
e.zh: 爸爸至今还把那台旧的迷你光盘机收在抽屉里。

e.en: She recorded mixtapes onto a blank {minidisc} as a teen.
e.zh: 她少年时把混音带录到空白的迷你光盘上。

e.en: She wore a black {minidress} to the launch party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条黑色迷你连衣裙出席发布会。

e.en: The store's new {minidress} sold out within hours.
e.zh: 这家店的新款迷你连衣裙几小时内就售罄了。

e.en: The composer marked each {minim} clearly on the score.
e.zh: 作曲家在乐谱上清楚地标出了每个二分音符。

e.en: A {minim} is held for two beats in standard notation.
e.zh: 在标准记谱法中,二分音符占两拍。

minimal.t: adj. 极少的；最低限度的

e.en: The app has a {minimal} interface with just three buttons.
e.zh: 这款应用界面极简,只有三个按钮。

e.en: The change had {minimal} impact on overall performance.
e.zh: 这一改动对整体性能的影响微乎其微。

minimalism.t: n. 极简主义（艺术、设计风格）

e.en: Her apartment reflects her love of Japanese {minimalism}.
e.zh: 她的公寓体现了她对日式极简主义的喜爱。

e.en: {Minimalism} dominated graphic design in the 2010s.
e.zh: 极简主义在2010年代主导了平面设计。

minimalist.t:
n. 极简主义者
adj. 极简风格的

e.en: He prefers a {minimalist} wardrobe with just neutral colors.
e.zh: 他喜欢极简风衣橱,只穿中性色调。

e.en: The {minimalist} kitchen has no visible appliances at all.
e.zh: 这间极简主义厨房里看不到任何外露的电器。

e.en: Their website has a {minimalistic} design with lots of whitespace.
e.zh: 他们的网站采用极简设计,留白很多。

e.en: She decorated the studio in a {minimalistic} Scandinavian style.
e.zh: 她以极简的北欧风装饰了这间工作室。

minimally.t: adv. 最低限度地；极少地

e.en: The new policy {minimally} affects most existing customers.
e.zh: 新政策对大多数现有客户的影响极小。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {minimally} invasive procedure.
e.zh: 医生建议采用微创手术。

e.en: Risk {minimisation} is a key part of the strategy.
e.zh: 风险最小化是这项策略的关键部分。

e.en: The plan focuses on cost {minimisation} and efficiency.
e.zh: 该方案专注于成本最小化和效率提升。

minimise.t: v. 最小化；使降至最低（英式拼写）

e.en: Wear sunscreen to {minimise} damage from UV rays.
e.zh: 涂防晒霜可以将紫外线伤害降到最低。

e.en: The team worked overnight to {minimise} the system downtime.
e.zh: 团队连夜工作以尽量缩短系统停机时间。

minimised.t: adj. 已最小化的（英式拼写）

e.en: Good planning {minimised} the disruption during the move.
e.zh: 良好的规划把搬迁带来的干扰降到了最低。

e.en: She {minimised} the browser window to check her email.
e.zh: 她把浏览器窗口最小化以查看邮件。

minimises.t: v. minimise 的第三人称单数

e.en: This setting {minimises} battery drain when you're traveling.
e.zh: 这一设置可在你出行时尽量减少电量消耗。

e.en: Good insulation {minimises} heat loss during cold winters.
e.zh: 良好的保温层可以在寒冬中尽量减少热量流失。

e.en: The factory is focused on {minimising} its carbon footprint.
e.zh: 这家工厂正致力于尽量减少碳排放。

e.en: She kept {minimising} the chat window during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时她不停地把聊天窗口最小化。

e.en: Tax {minimization} is legal, but tax evasion is not.
e.zh: 避税是合法的,但偷税是违法的。

e.en: Data {minimization} means collecting only what you truly need.
e.zh: 数据最小化原则意味着只收集真正必要的信息。

minimize.t: v. 最小化（窗口）；使降至最低

e.en: Close unused tabs to {minimize} memory usage.
e.zh: 关闭无用的标签页以减少内存占用。

e.en: Click the dash icon to {minimize} the window.
e.zh: 点击短横图标即可最小化窗口。

e.en: He {minimized} the video call when his boss walked in.
e.zh: 老板走进来时,他把视频通话窗口最小化了。

e.en: Careful design {minimized} the app's data usage on mobile.
e.zh: 精心的设计将这款应用在手机上的流量消耗降到最低。

minimizes.t: v. minimize 的第三人称单数

e.en: This algorithm {minimizes} the time spent on each query.
e.zh: 这种算法能将每次查询的耗时降到最低。

e.en: Wearing a seatbelt {minimizes} the risk of serious injury.
e.zh: 系好安全带可以将重伤的风险降到最低。

e.en: The team is {minimizing} loading times for the homepage.
e.zh: 团队正在尽量缩短首页的加载时间。

e.en: He's good at {minimizing} his own contributions to the project.
e.zh: 他很擅长淡化自己对项目的贡献。

minimum.t:
n. 最小值；最低限度
adj. 最小的

e.en: The {minimum} order amount for free delivery is twenty dollars.
e.zh: 享受免运费的最低订单金额是二十美元。

e.en: Workers are demanding a higher {minimum} wage this year.
e.zh: 今年工人们要求提高最低工资标准。

e.en: Most credit cards require monthly payment {minimums}.
e.zh: 大多数信用卡都要求每月支付最低还款额。

e.en: The restaurant has spending {minimums} for private bookings.
e.zh: 这家餐厅对包间预订设有最低消费。

e.en: The doctor checked the baby's tiny digitus {minimus}.
e.zh: 医生检查了婴儿小小的小指。

e.en: In anatomy, {minimus} refers to the smallest of a group.
e.zh: 在解剖学中,minimus 指一组中最小的一个。

mining.t: n. 采矿；挖矿（加密货币）

e.en: Bitcoin {mining} consumes enormous amounts of electricity worldwide.
e.zh: 全球比特币挖矿消耗着惊人数量的电力。

e.en: Coal {mining} has declined sharply over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年间,煤炭开采业急剧萎缩。

e.en: The report compared various {minings} operations across three continents.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了三大洲的各类采矿作业。

e.en: Different data {minings} techniques yielded surprisingly similar results.
e.zh: 不同的数据挖掘方法得出了惊人相似的结果。

minion.t: n. 小喽啰；走狗；（《神偷奶爸》）小黄人

e.en: The villain ordered his loyal {minion} to steal the plans.
e.zh: 反派命令他忠心的小喽啰去偷走那些图纸。

e.en: My kid loves the yellow {minion} character from the movie.
e.zh: 我家孩子很喜欢电影里那个黄色的小黄人角色。

miniscule.t: adj. 极小的（minuscule 的非正式拼法）

e.en: The chance of winning the lottery is absolutely {miniscule}.
e.zh: 中彩票的几率简直微乎其微。

e.en: He left a {miniscule} tip that embarrassed the whole table.
e.zh: 他给了少得可怜的小费,让满桌人都觉得尴尬。

e.en: Netflix released a six-episode {miniseries} about the trial.
e.zh: 网飞推出了一部关于这场审判的六集迷你剧。

e.en: The historical {miniseries} won several major awards last year.
e.zh: 这部历史题材迷你剧去年赢得了几个重要奖项。

e.en: She paired the {miniskirt} with knee-high boots and a sweater.
e.zh: 她用迷你裙搭配过膝靴和一件毛衣。

e.en: The {miniskirt} became iconic during the swinging sixties.
e.zh: 迷你裙在摇摆的六十年代成了标志性单品。

e.en: The prime {minister} announced new climate policies today.
e.zh: 首相今天宣布了新的气候政策。

e.en: She works as a {minister} at the local church.
e.zh: 她在当地教堂担任牧师。

e.en: The {ministerial} meeting lasted over six hours.
e.zh: 部长级会议持续了六个多小时。

e.en: He spoke in a calm, {ministerial} tone.
e.zh: 他以平静、庄重的语气讲话。

e.en: Several {ministers} resigned after the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻爆发后,几位部长相继辞职。

e.en: The pastor {ministers} to families in need.
e.zh: 这位牧师为有需要的家庭提供帮助。

ministership.t: n. 部长职务；大臣之职

e.en: He held the {ministership} of finance for five years.
e.zh: 他担任财政部长一职长达五年。

e.en: Her {ministership} ended after the election loss.
e.zh: 她的部长任期在败选后结束。

ministration.t: n. 照料；协助；牧师职务

e.en: The patient recovered thanks to the nurse's gentle {ministration}.
e.zh: 多亏护士的悉心照料,病人康复了。

e.en: His {ministration} brought comfort to grieving families.
e.zh: 他的关怀给悲伤的家庭带来了安慰。

ministries.t: n. ministry 的复数；各部委

e.en: Three government {ministries} are involved in the project.
e.zh: 三个政府部门参与了这个项目。

e.en: Several Christian {ministries} sent aid to the region.
e.zh: 几个基督教组织向该地区送去了援助。

ministry.t: n. 政府部门；（集合）内阁

e.en: The {ministry} of education released new guidelines.
e.zh: 教育部发布了新的指导方针。

e.en: He felt called to a life of {ministry}.
e.zh: 他感到自己受召投身传教事业。

e.en: They packed the {minivan} for the family road trip.
e.zh: 他们把小型货车装满,准备全家自驾游。

e.en: Our old {minivan} still runs surprisingly well.
e.zh: 我们的旧面包车跑起来还出奇地稳。

e.en: She inherited her grandmother's vintage {mink} coat.
e.zh: 她继承了奶奶那件复古的貂皮大衣。

e.en: A wild {mink} darted across the riverbank.
e.zh: 一只野生水貂飞快地从河岸窜过。

e.en: We spotted a {minke} whale near the boat.
e.zh: 我们在船边看到了一头小须鲸。

e.en: The {minke} is one of the smallest baleen whales.
e.zh: 小须鲸是体型最小的须鲸之一。

minneapolis.t: n. 明尼阿波利斯（美国城市）

e.en: She moved to {Minneapolis} for a tech job.
e.zh: 她为了一份科技工作搬到了明尼阿波利斯。

e.en: Winters in {Minneapolis} can be brutally cold.
e.zh: 明尼阿波利斯的冬天可能极其寒冷。

minnesota.t: n. 明尼苏达（美国州名）

e.en: {Minnesota} is famous for its ten thousand lakes.
e.zh: 明尼苏达州以一万个湖泊而闻名。

e.en: He grew up on a farm in rural {Minnesota}.
e.zh: 他在明尼苏达乡下的一个农场长大。

mirror.t:
n. 镜子
v. 反映；镜像

e.en: She checked her hair in the bathroom {mirror}.
e.zh: 她对着浴室的镜子整理头发。

e.en: The lake's surface was a perfect {mirror} of the sky.
e.zh: 湖面像一面镜子般完美映出了天空。

e.en: The new app {mirrored} the design of its competitor.
e.zh: 这款新应用照搬了竞争对手的设计。

e.en: His expression {mirrored} the disappointment in the room.
e.zh: 他的表情映射出整个房间里的失望情绪。

mirroring.t:
n. 镜像；映射
v. 反映（mirror 的现在分词）

e.en: Screen {mirroring} lets you cast your phone to the TV.
e.zh: 屏幕镜像功能可以把手机画面投到电视上。

e.en: Her tone was subtly {mirroring} the interviewer's style.
e.zh: 她的语气在不经意间模仿着面试官的风格。

mirrors.t:
n. 镜子（复数）
v. 反映（第三人称单数）

e.en: The dance studio has {mirrors} on every wall.
e.zh: 舞蹈室的每面墙上都装有镜子。

e.en: His novel {mirrors} the political climate of the 1980s.
e.zh: 他的小说映射出1980年代的政治氛围。

e.en: The room filled with {mirth} when the cat fell off the shelf.
e.zh: 猫从架子上掉下来时，整个房间充满了欢笑。

e.en: His joke brought a moment of much-needed {mirth}.
e.zh: 他的笑话带来了急需的一刻欢乐。

mirthful.t: adj. 欢乐的；充满笑声的

e.en: Grandma's {mirthful} laugh echoed through the kitchen.
e.zh: 奶奶欢快的笑声在厨房里回荡。

e.en: The children's {mirthful} chatter filled the playground.
e.zh: 孩子们欢快的笑语充满了整个游乐场。

mirthless.t: adj. 无笑意的；不快乐的

e.en: He gave a {mirthless} smile and walked away.
e.zh: 他露出一丝毫无笑意的微笑，转身离去。

e.en: Her {mirthless} laugh made the room go silent.
e.zh: 她那毫无快乐的笑声让房间瞬间安静下来。

mirthlessly.t: adv. 无笑意地；不快乐地

e.en: He chuckled {mirthlessly} at the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息，他干笑了一声，毫无笑意。

e.en: She smiled {mirthlessly} when asked about the layoffs.
e.zh: 被问及裁员时，她苦涩地笑了笑。

mirza.t: n. 米尔扎（波斯语中的尊称）

e.en: The poet {Mirza} Ghalib remains beloved across South Asia.
e.zh: 诗人米尔扎·迦利布在南亚至今深受爱戴。

e.en: Mr. {Mirza} hosted the conference in Lahore last year.
e.zh: 米尔扎先生去年在拉合尔主持了那场会议。

mis.t: (罕用) 前缀，表示错误、不当

e.en: A school's {MIS} stores grades, attendance, and student records.
e.zh: 学校的管理信息系统存储成绩、出勤和学生档案。

e.en: She studied {MIS} to combine business and technology skills.
e.zh: 她攻读管理信息系统，将商业与技术结合起来。

e.en: The coroner ruled the death a {misadventure}, not a crime.
e.zh: 验尸官裁定此次死亡为意外，而非犯罪。

e.en: Their road trip became one long comic {misadventure}.
e.zh: 他们的公路旅行变成了一场漫长的滑稽冒险。

e.en: The car pulls left because the wheels are {misaligned}.
e.zh: 车辆向左偏，是因为车轮没有对正。

e.en: Our goals were {misaligned} from the start of the project.
e.zh: 从项目一开始，我们的目标就没有对齐。

e.en: The {misalignment} between teams slowed the product launch.
e.zh: 团队之间的目标错位拖慢了产品发布。

e.en: A small {misalignment} in the lens blurred every photo.
e.zh: 镜头一点轻微的偏差让每张照片都模糊了。

misallocation.t: n. 资源错配；分配不当

e.en: The audit revealed serious {misallocation} of public funds.
e.zh: 审计揭露了公共资金被严重错配的问题。

e.en: {Misallocation} of engineers slowed every team's progress.
e.zh: 工程师配置不当拖慢了每个团队的进度。

misanthrope.t: n. 厌世者；讨厌人类的人

e.en: He's a grumpy {misanthrope} who avoids all social gatherings.
e.zh: 他是个脾气古怪、厌恶人群、回避一切社交的人。

e.en: The novel's narrator is a witty but lonely {misanthrope}.
e.zh: 小说的叙述者是个机智却孤独的厌世者。

misanthropic.t: adj. 厌世的；憎恶人类的

e.en: His {misanthropic} attitude pushed even close friends away.
e.zh: 他厌世的态度连亲密朋友也给推远了。

e.en: The character grew more {misanthropic} after losing his job.
e.zh: 那个角色失业后变得越来越厌世。

misanthropy.t: n. 厌世；对人类的憎恶

e.en: Years of betrayal slowly turned his kindness into {misanthropy}.
e.zh: 多年的背叛把他的善良慢慢变成了厌世。

e.en: The essay explores the roots of modern online {misanthropy}.
e.zh: 这篇文章探讨了现代网络厌世情绪的根源。

e.en: The {misapplication} of the law led to a wrongful conviction.
e.zh: 法律的错误适用导致了一起冤案。

e.en: Her thesis criticizes the {misapplication} of AI in hiring.
e.zh: 她的论文批评了人工智能在招聘中的滥用。

e.en: Junior developers often {misapply} design patterns at first.
e.zh: 初级开发者起初常常误用设计模式。

e.en: Don't {misapply} this rule to cases it wasn't meant for.
e.zh: 别把这条规则套用到它并不适用的情况。

e.en: He was under the {misapprehension} that the meeting was canceled.
e.zh: 他误以为那场会议已经取消了。

e.en: Let me clear up a common {misapprehension} about the policy.
e.zh: 让我澄清一个关于这项政策的常见误解。

e.en: The CFO was caught trying to {misappropriate} company funds.
e.zh: 那位首席财务官被抓到企图挪用公司资金。

e.en: Employees who {misappropriate} resources face immediate dismissal.
e.zh: 挪用资源的员工将被立即解雇。

e.en: He was charged with {misappropriation} of charity donations.
e.zh: 他因挪用慈善捐款而被起诉。

e.en: The audit found clear evidence of {misappropriation} of assets.
e.zh: 审计发现了明确的资产挪用证据。

misattribution.t: n. 错误归因；张冠李戴

e.en: That famous quote is a common {misattribution} to Einstein.
e.zh: 那句名言常被错误地归于爱因斯坦。

e.en: Source {misattribution} is a frequent error in news articles.
e.zh: 来源误注是新闻报道中常见的错误。

misbegotten.t: adj. 糟糕的；构思拙劣的

e.en: The {misbegotten} plan collapsed within the first week.
e.zh: 那个考虑欠周的计划第一周就崩溃了。

e.en: He regretted his {misbegotten} attempt to flip the house.
e.zh: 他后悔自己那场草率的炒房尝试。

misbehave.t: v. 行为不端；调皮捣蛋

e.en: Toddlers often {misbehave} when they're tired or hungry.
e.zh: 幼儿在累或饿时常常会闹脾气。

e.en: The browser tends to {misbehave} after a system update.
e.zh: 系统更新后，浏览器经常会出现异常。

misbehaving.t: v. 行为不端（现在分词）

e.en: The printer has been {misbehaving} all morning.
e.zh: 打印机整个上午都在出毛病。

e.en: Two students were sent out for {misbehaving} during class.
e.zh: 两名学生因课堂上行为不当被请出教室。

misbehavior.t: n. 不端行为；品行不良

e.en: Repeated {misbehavior} can result in suspension from school.
e.zh: 反复违规行为可能导致被学校停课。

e.en: The app logs any unusual {misbehavior} from connected devices.
e.zh: 该应用会记录任何已连设备的异常行为。

misbehaviour.t: n. 不端行为（英式拼写）

e.en: The pupil was warned about his repeated {misbehaviour}.
e.zh: 那名学生因反复的不良行为而受到警告。

e.en: Online {misbehaviour} is increasingly tracked by moderators.
e.zh: 网络不当行为正越来越多地受到管理员的监控。

e.en: It's easy to {miscalculate} shipping costs for international orders.
e.zh: 国际订单的运费很容易算错。

e.en: Investors who {miscalculate} risk often lose everything.
e.zh: 错估风险的投资者往往会血本无归。

e.en: A small {miscalculation} cost the team the championship.
e.zh: 一个小小的失算让球队失去了冠军。

e.en: The budget overrun came from a basic {miscalculation}.
e.zh: 预算超支源于一个基本的核算错误。

miscarriage.t:
n. 流产
n. 失败；差错（如司法不公）

e.en: The case was overturned as a {miscarriage} of justice.
e.zh: 该案因司法不公而被推翻。

e.en: She took time off after suffering a {miscarriage}.
e.zh: 流产之后她请了一段时间的假。

miscarry.t:
v. 流产
v. 失败；失手

e.en: Best-laid plans sometimes {miscarry} despite careful preparation.
e.zh: 再周全的计划有时也会出岔子。

e.en: Doctors monitored her closely so the pregnancy wouldn't {miscarry}.
e.zh: 医生密切观察她，以防她流产。

miscast.t:
v. 角色分派不当
adj. 选角失误的

e.en: Critics felt the lead actor was badly {miscast} in the film.
e.zh: 评论家认为主演在这部电影中被严重选错了角色。

e.en: She was {miscast} as the villain and didn't enjoy the role.
e.zh: 她被错配成反派角色，并不喜欢这个角色。

miscegenation.t: n. 异族通婚；种族混合

e.en: Old {miscegenation} laws once banned interracial marriage.
e.zh: 旧时的异族通婚法曾禁止跨种族结婚。

e.en: The court struck down all remaining {miscegenation} statutes.
e.zh: 法院废除了所有残存的异族通婚法律。

miscellaneous.t: adj. 杂项的；各式各样的

e.en: Put any {miscellaneous} expenses under the 'Other' category.
e.zh: 把任何杂项支出归到“其他”类别下。

e.en: The drawer was full of {miscellaneous} cables and adapters.
e.zh: 那个抽屉里装满了各种杂七杂八的线材和转接头。

e.en: The book is a {miscellany} of essays, poems, and recipes.
e.zh: 这本书是一本杂集，收录了散文、诗歌和食谱。

e.en: Her shelf held a charming {miscellany} of travel souvenirs.
e.zh: 她的架子上摆着一堆可爱的旅行纪念品。

e.en: By sheer {mischance}, they missed the last train home.
e.zh: 纯属不巧，他们错过了回家的末班车。

e.en: A {mischance} on the highway delayed the entire convoy.
e.zh: 高速公路上的一场意外耽误了整个车队。

e.en: The kittens are always getting into some kind of {mischief}.
e.zh: 那些小猫总是惹些调皮的麻烦。

e.en: There's a glint of {mischief} in her eyes tonight.
e.zh: 今晚她的眼里闪着一丝调皮的光。

mischiefs.t: n. 淘气事；恶作剧（复数）

e.en: The novel recounts the small {mischiefs} of village children.
e.zh: 小说讲述了村里孩子们的种种小淘气。

e.en: Such {mischiefs} were common in the old boarding school.
e.zh: 这类恶作剧在那所老寄宿学校里司空见惯。

e.en: He gave her a {mischievous} grin before hiding her keys.
e.zh: 他露出一个调皮的笑容，然后把她的钥匙藏了起来。

e.en: The puppy has a {mischievous} habit of stealing socks.
e.zh: 那只小狗有个调皮的习惯，喜欢偷袜子。

e.en: She winked {mischievously} and slipped out of the room.
e.zh: 她调皮地眨了眨眼，悄悄溜出了房间。

e.en: The boy {mischievously} swapped the salt and the sugar.
e.zh: 那个男孩淘气地把盐和糖调换了位置。

e.en: The puppy's {mischievousness} kept the whole family laughing all weekend.
e.zh: 小狗的顽皮逗得全家整个周末都在笑。

e.en: There's a hint of {mischievousness} in her smile whenever she teases him.
e.zh: 她每次取笑他时,笑容里都带着一丝调皮。

e.en: The model's {misclassification} rate dropped after we cleaned the training data.
e.zh: 清洗训练数据后,模型的误分类率明显下降。

e.en: A simple {misclassification} of the email sent it straight to spam.
e.zh: 一次简单的分类错误就把那封邮件直接归入垃圾邮件。

miscommunication.t: n. 沟通失误；信息误传

e.en: A small {miscommunication} delayed the project by two whole weeks.
e.zh: 一次小小的沟通失误让项目延误了整整两周。

e.en: Most team conflicts come from {miscommunication}, not real disagreement.
e.zh: 团队矛盾大多源于沟通不畅,而非真正的分歧。

e.en: Many people {misconceive} freelancing as an easy path to freedom.
e.zh: 许多人误以为自由职业是通往自由的轻松之路。

e.en: Don't {misconceive} my silence as agreement with your plan.
e.zh: 别把我的沉默误解为对你计划的赞同。

misconceived.t: adj. 构思错误的；考虑不周的

e.en: The marketing campaign was {misconceived} from the very beginning.
e.zh: 这次营销活动从一开始构思就有问题。

e.en: Critics called the policy {misconceived} and impossible to enforce.
e.zh: 评论人士称这项政策构思失当,根本无法执行。

e.en: It's a common {misconception} that goldfish only have three-second memories.
e.zh: 金鱼只有三秒记忆是一种常见的误解。

e.en: This article aims to clear up one popular {misconception} about vaccines.
e.zh: 这篇文章旨在澄清关于疫苗的一个流行误解。

e.en: The teacher patiently corrected several {misconceptions} about climate change.
e.zh: 老师耐心地纠正了几个关于气候变化的误解。

e.en: Social media spreads {misconceptions} faster than facts can catch up.
e.zh: 社交媒体传播误解的速度比事实追赶的速度还快。

e.en: The CEO resigned after allegations of financial {misconduct} surfaced.
e.zh: 在财务不当行为的指控曝光后,首席执行官辞职了。

e.en: Police are investigating possible {misconduct} during the arrest.
e.zh: 警方正在调查逮捕过程中可能存在的不当行为。

e.en: Please don't {misconstrue} my advice as criticism of your work.
e.zh: 请别把我的建议误解为对你工作的批评。

e.en: Readers often {misconstrue} sarcasm in text messages without tone cues.
e.zh: 读者常常因缺少语气线索而误解短信里的讽刺。

misconstrued.t: v. 误解，曲解（misconstrue 的过去式）

e.en: His joke was {misconstrued} as a serious insult by the audience.
e.zh: 他的玩笑被观众误解成了严重的冒犯。

e.en: The email was {misconstrued} and sparked an unnecessary argument.
e.zh: 那封邮件被曲解后引发了一场没必要的争吵。

miscreant.t:
n. 恶棍，坏人
adj. 邪恶的

e.en: The guard chased the {miscreant} who had spray-painted the wall.
e.zh: 保安追赶那个在墙上喷漆的小坏蛋。

e.en: Some online {miscreant} keeps posting fake reviews on our page.
e.zh: 网上有个捣蛋鬼一直在我们的页面上发假评论。

miscue.t:
n. 失误，差错
v. 出错

e.en: A {miscue} from the goalkeeper let the other team score easily.
e.zh: 门将的一次失误让对方轻松得分。

e.en: The actor recovered quickly after a small {miscue} on stage.
e.zh: 演员在台上出现小失误后迅速恢复了状态。

e.en: He apologized publicly for every {misdeed} from his college years.
e.zh: 他公开为大学时期的每一桩过错道歉。

e.en: No {misdeed}, however small, escapes the watchful eyes of neighbors.
e.zh: 再小的过错也逃不过邻居们警觉的目光。

misdemanour.t: n. 轻罪，不端行为（misdemeanour 的误拼）

e.en: He was fined for a minor traffic {misdemanour} last weekend.
e.zh: 他上周末因一项轻微的交通违规被罚款。

e.en: The school treats every {misdemanour} as a chance to teach values.
e.zh: 学校把每次小过错都当作教导价值观的机会。

misdemanours.t: n. 轻罪，不端行为（复数，误拼）

e.en: Her childhood {misdemanours} now make for funny dinner-table stories.
e.zh: 她童年时的那些小过错如今成了餐桌上的趣事。

e.en: The judge dismissed the minor {misdemanours} with a stern warning.
e.zh: 法官只是严厉警告就驳回了那些轻微违规行为。

misdemeanor.t: n. 轻罪，行为不端（美式拼写）

e.en: Shoplifting is usually charged as a {misdemeanor} for first-time offenders.
e.zh: 对初犯者而言,入店行窃通常被定为轻罪。

e.en: He got off with a fine for the minor {misdemeanor}.
e.zh: 他因这项轻微违法行为只被罚了款就过关了。

misdemeanors.t: n. 轻罪，行为不端（复数）

e.en: Several {misdemeanors} on his record kept him from getting the job.
e.zh: 档案上几项轻罪记录让他没能拿到那份工作。

e.en: The app filters out applicants with recent {misdemeanors} automatically.
e.zh: 该应用会自动筛除近期有轻罪记录的申请人。

misdemeanour.t: n. 轻罪，行为不端（英式拼写）

e.en: She was charged with a {misdemeanour} for parking on the sidewalk.
e.zh: 她因在人行道上停车被指控犯有轻罪。

e.en: The boss treated lateness as a serious workplace {misdemeanour}.
e.zh: 老板把迟到视为严重的工作场所违纪行为。

e.en: Sellers who {misdescribe} their products on the site face account bans.
e.zh: 在网站上虚假描述商品的卖家会被封号。

e.en: Don't {misdescribe} the apartment — tenants will notice immediately.
e.zh: 不要把这套公寓描述得不实,租客会立刻发现。

misdiagnosed.t: v. 误诊（misdiagnose 的过去式）

e.en: The doctor {misdiagnosed} her allergy as a common cold.
e.zh: 医生把她的过敏误诊成了普通感冒。

e.en: He spent years being {misdiagnosed} before specialists found the real problem.
e.zh: 他被误诊了好几年,专家才查出真正的病因。

e.en: A {misdiagnosis} delayed her cancer treatment by almost six months.
e.zh: 一次误诊让她的癌症治疗推迟了将近六个月。

e.en: The lawsuit centered on a {misdiagnosis} that led to surgery complications.
e.zh: 这起诉讼的核心是一次导致手术并发症的误诊。

e.en: Magicians {misdirect} the audience's attention while doing the actual trick.
e.zh: 魔术师在真正变戏法时会转移观众的注意力。

e.en: Be careful not to {misdirect} the package to the wrong office.
e.zh: 小心别把包裹寄错到别的办公室去。

misdirected.t: adj. 被误导的，方向错误的

e.en: His anger was {misdirected} at the waiter, not the actual problem.
e.zh: 他把怒火错放到服务员身上,而不是真正的问题。

e.en: The {misdirected} email ended up in a stranger's inbox.
e.zh: 那封寄错的电子邮件落到了一个陌生人的收件箱里。

e.en: Good magic relies heavily on {misdirection} and timing.
e.zh: 好的魔术非常依赖障眼法和时机。

e.en: Critics accused the politician of using {misdirection} to dodge questions.
e.zh: 评论人士指责那位政客用转移话题来回避问题。

miseducation.t: n. 错误的教育，不当教育

e.en: The book argues that {miseducation} about money harms entire generations.
e.zh: 这本书认为关于金钱的错误教育会害苦几代人。

e.en: Years of {miseducation} left him deeply skeptical of school history.
e.zh: 多年的错误教育让他对学校的历史课深感怀疑。

e.en: Don't be such a {miser} — buy yourself a decent coffee.
e.zh: 别这么吝啬,给自己买杯像样的咖啡吧。

e.en: The old {miser} kept his fortune hidden under the floorboards.
e.zh: 那个老守财奴把财富藏在地板下面。

e.en: I had a {miserable} time waiting in the rain for two hours.
e.zh: 我在雨中等了两个小时,真是难受极了。

e.en: The hotel room was small, damp, and absolutely {miserable}.
e.zh: 那间酒店房间又小又潮,糟糕透顶。

miserables.t: n. 悲惨的人们（常指《悲惨世界》）

e.en: The local theater is staging "Les {Miserables}" again this winter.
e.zh: 当地剧院今年冬天又要上演《悲惨世界》。

e.en: She hummed songs from "Les {Miserables}" while doing the dishes.
e.zh: 她一边洗碗,一边哼着《悲惨世界》里的歌。

e.en: Their startup failed {miserably} within the first six months.
e.zh: 他们的初创公司在头六个月就惨败了。
