e.en: He shivered {miserably} on the bench, soaked through to the skin.
e.zh: 他浑身湿透,可怜兮兮地坐在长椅上发抖。

misericord.t: n. 教堂唱诗班的折叠座板

e.en: The carved {misericord} under the choir seat showed a tiny dragon.
e.zh: 唱诗班座位下雕刻的折叠座板上有一条小龙。

e.en: Tourists craned their necks to admire each medieval {misericord}.
e.zh: 游客们伸长脖子欣赏每一块中世纪折叠座板的雕刻。

e.en: The novel describes the daily {miseries} of life under the dictatorship.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了独裁统治下日常生活的种种苦难。

e.en: Hot tea and a warm blanket helped ease her winter {miseries}.
e.zh: 热茶和暖毯让她冬日的种种不适缓解了不少。

e.en: His {miserliness} became legendary among coworkers who shared lunch breaks.
e.zh: 他的吝啬在共进午餐的同事中已成传说。

e.en: The boss's {miserliness} eventually drove half the team to quit.
e.zh: 老板的吝啬最终逼走了团队里一半的人。

e.en: He left a surprisingly {miserly} tip after the long meal.
e.zh: 那顿大餐之后,他留下的小费少得惊人。

e.en: The company offered a {miserly} raise that barely covered inflation.
e.zh: 公司给的加薪少得可怜,几乎抵不上通胀。

e.en: Endless rain made the camping trip a complete {misery}.
e.zh: 连绵不断的雨让这次露营变成了彻头彻尾的苦差事。

e.en: Streaming a sad movie on a Sunday is my favorite kind of {misery}.
e.zh: 周日看一部悲伤的电影是我最爱的那种苦中作乐。

misfeasance.t: n. (法律) 不当履职行为

e.en: The mayor faces charges of {misfeasance} in handling city funds.
e.zh: 市长因处理市政资金不当而面临渎职指控。

e.en: The lawsuit accused the board of repeated {misfeasance}.
e.zh: 这起诉讼指控董事会一再玩忽职守。

misfire.t:
v. (枪、引擎) 不发火；计划失败
n. 失火，失效

e.en: The engine started to {misfire} as we climbed the steep hill.
e.zh: 我们爬上陡坡时,发动机开始出现失火现象。

e.en: His attempt at humor turned out to be a complete {misfire}.
e.zh: 他想搞笑的尝试结果成了彻底的失败。

misfit.t: n. 不合群的人，格格不入者

e.en: He always felt like a {misfit} at corporate networking events.
e.zh: 在公司的社交活动上,他总觉得自己格格不入。

e.en: The show celebrates {misfit} characters who don't follow the rules.
e.zh: 这部剧赞美那些不守规矩、与众不同的角色。

e.en: By sheer {misfortune}, his flight was canceled twice in one day.
e.zh: 纯属倒霉,他的航班一天之内被取消了两次。

e.en: She faced one {misfortune} after another but never lost her humor.
e.zh: 她接连遭遇不幸,却始终保持着幽默感。

misfortunes.t: n. 不幸的事，厄运（复数）

e.en: A string of {misfortunes} forced the small bakery to close.
e.zh: 接二连三的不幸迫使那家小面包店关门了。

e.en: He laughs about his past {misfortunes} now that life is stable.
e.zh: 如今生活安稳了,他能笑着谈起过去的种种不幸。

e.en: She signed the contract with a quiet {misgiving} about the deadline.
e.zh: 她签下合同时,对截止日期心里隐隐有些不安。

e.en: I have one serious {misgiving} about hiring him so quickly.
e.zh: 对于这么快雇他,我有一个很严重的疑虑。

misgovernment.t: n. 治理不善，管理失当

e.en: Years of {misgovernment} left the country's economy in ruins.
e.zh: 多年的失政让这个国家的经济陷入了崩溃。

e.en: Voters blamed widespread poverty on chronic {misgovernment}.
e.zh: 选民们把普遍的贫困归咎于长期的施政失误。

e.en: His {misguided} attempt to fix the printer made things much worse.
e.zh: 他想修打印机的错误尝试反而把事情弄得更糟。

e.en: The policy, though {misguided}, came from genuinely good intentions.
e.zh: 这项政策虽然方向错误,但出发点是真心好的。

e.en: He {misguidedly} believed honesty alone would win the election.
e.zh: 他错误地以为光靠诚实就能赢得选举。

e.en: She {misguidedly} trusted the email and clicked the suspicious link.
e.zh: 她误信了那封邮件,点开了可疑的链接。

mishandle.t: v. 处理不当，胡乱摆弄

e.en: Airlines that {mishandle} luggage can face hefty compensation claims.
e.zh: 野蛮搬运行李的航空公司可能面临高额赔偿要求。

e.en: Don't {mishandle} this delicate negotiation — one mistake ruins everything.
e.zh: 别把这次微妙的谈判搞砸了,一步错全盘皆输。

e.en: The company {mishandled} the data breach and lost customer trust.
e.zh: 公司处理数据泄露事件不当,失去了客户信任。

e.en: He admitted he had {mishandled} the situation with his coworker.
e.zh: 他承认自己在与同事相处时处理得很糟糕。

mishandling.t: n./v. 处理不当，操作失误

e.en: The CEO apologized for the {mishandling} of customer complaints last quarter.
e.zh: 首席执行官就上季度对客户投诉处理不当公开道歉。

e.en: {Mishandling} of fragile packages led to a flood of refund requests.
e.zh: 易碎包裹的不当搬运导致了大量退款请求。

e.en: A small kitchen {mishap} left the pasta completely inedible.
e.zh: 厨房里的一个小意外让那盘意面完全没法吃了。

e.en: Despite a few {mishap} moments, the road trip was unforgettable.
e.zh: 尽管中间有几次小插曲,这趟公路旅行还是难以忘怀。

e.en: I sometimes {mishear} song lyrics in really embarrassing ways.
e.zh: 我有时会把歌词听错,而且错得特别尴尬。

e.en: Did I {mishear}, or did the boss really cancel the meeting?
e.zh: 是我听错了吗,还是老板真的取消了会议?

misheard.t: v. 听错（mishear 的过去式）

e.en: She {misheard} his name and called him "Brian" all evening.
e.zh: 她把他的名字听错了,整晚都叫他"布莱恩"。

e.en: Half the funny lyrics online are just {misheard} versions of real songs.
e.zh: 网上一半搞笑歌词其实就是真歌的听岔版本。

e.en: The new app's design is a confusing {mishmash} of old styles.
e.zh: 这款新应用的设计是各种旧风格的混乱大杂烩。

e.en: Dinner was a {mishmash} of leftovers from the whole week.
e.zh: 晚餐就是把一整周剩菜凑成的大杂烩。

e.en: The witness's {misidentification} led to a wrongful arrest.
e.zh: 目击者的错误指认导致了一次错误的逮捕。

e.en: Facial recognition software has a high rate of {misidentification}.
e.zh: 人脸识别软件的误识率很高。

e.en: Tourists often {misidentify} this snake as harmless.
e.zh: 游客常常把这种蛇误认成无害的种类。

e.en: The app may {misidentify} plants in low light.
e.zh: 在光线不足时这个应用可能会错认植物。

e.en: I want to correct any {misimpression} about my comments.
e.zh: 我想澄清大家对我言论的任何错误印象。

e.en: The article gave readers a {misimpression} of the study.
e.zh: 那篇文章让读者对这项研究产生了错误印象。

misinform.t: v. 提供错误信息，误导

e.en: Don't {misinform} customers about the refund policy.
e.zh: 不要向顾客提供错误的退款政策信息。

e.en: Social media bots often {misinform} voters during elections.
e.zh: 社交媒体机器人在选举期间经常误导选民。

misinformation.t: n. 错误信息，不实消息

e.en: Health {misinformation} spreads quickly on social media.
e.zh: 健康类虚假信息在社交媒体上传播得很快。

e.en: Fact-checkers work hard to debunk online {misinformation}.
e.zh: 事实核查员努力揭穿网络上的虚假信息。

misinformed.t: adj. 获得错误信息的，被误导的

e.en: The reporter was clearly {misinformed} about the deal.
e.zh: 那位记者显然被误导了,得到的信息有误。

e.en: Many people are {misinformed} about how vaccines work.
e.zh: 很多人对疫苗的作用机制存在错误的认识。

e.en: Please don't {misinterpret} my silence as agreement.
e.zh: 请不要把我的沉默误解为同意。

e.en: Translation tools sometimes {misinterpret} idioms and slang.
e.zh: 翻译工具有时会误解习语和俚语。

e.en: That's a complete {misinterpretation} of what I said.
e.zh: 那完全是对我话语的曲解。

e.en: The lawsuit stemmed from a {misinterpretation} of the contract.
e.zh: 这起诉讼源于对合同的错误解读。

e.en: Don't {misjudge} someone based on their appearance alone.
e.zh: 不要仅凭外表就错判一个人。

e.en: New drivers often {misjudge} the distance between cars.
e.zh: 新手司机常常错估车与车之间的距离。

misjudged.t:
v. 误判（过去式）
adj. 判断错误的

e.en: I {misjudged} how long the meeting would last.
e.zh: 我错估了这次会议的持续时间。

e.en: The goalkeeper {misjudged} the ball and let it in.
e.zh: 门将判断失误,把球放进了网。

misjudgement.t: n. 误判；判断失误（英式拼写）

e.en: His career suffered after one serious {misjudgement}.
e.zh: 一次严重的判断失误让他的职业生涯受挫。

e.en: The crash was caused by the pilot's {misjudgement} of altitude.
e.zh: 这次坠机是因飞行员对高度判断失误所致。

e.en: Hiring him was a costly {misjudgment} on my part.
e.zh: 雇他是我代价高昂的一次判断失误。

e.en: The referee admitted his call was a {misjudgment}.
e.zh: 裁判承认他的判罚是一次误判。

mislabeled.t:
v. 贴错标签（过去式）
adj. 标签错误的

e.en: Several products were {mislabeled} and had to be recalled.
e.zh: 有几款产品因贴错标签而不得不召回。

e.en: The file was {mislabeled}, so we couldn't find it.
e.zh: 这份文件标签贴错了,所以我们一直找不到。

e.en: I always {mislay} my keys when I'm rushing.
e.zh: 我一着急就总是把钥匙放错地方。

e.en: Be careful not to {mislay} the original receipt.
e.zh: 小心别把原始收据放错地方弄丢了。

e.en: The advertisement was designed to {mislead} consumers.
e.zh: 这则广告的设计意在误导消费者。

e.en: Don't let the low price {mislead} you about quality.
e.zh: 不要让低价误导你对质量的判断。

misleading.t: adj. 误导性的；易让人误解的

e.en: The chart's labels were highly {misleading} to readers.
e.zh: 图表上的标签对读者具有很强的误导性。

e.en: That headline is {misleading} and needs to be corrected.
e.zh: 这个标题有误导性,需要更正。

misleadingly.t: adv. 误导性地；令人误解地

e.en: The product was {misleadingly} marketed as completely organic.
e.zh: 该产品被误导性地宣传为完全有机。

e.en: The graph was {misleadingly} scaled to exaggerate growth.
e.zh: 这张图表的比例设置具有误导性,夸大了增长。

misleads.t: v. 误导（第三人称单数）

e.en: The packaging {misleads} customers about the actual portion size.
e.zh: 包装在实际分量上误导了顾客。

e.en: A poorly worded headline often {misleads} readers.
e.zh: 措辞不当的标题往往会误导读者。

misled.t: v. 误导（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Investors felt {misled} by the company's optimistic forecasts.
e.zh: 投资者觉得被公司乐观的预测误导了。

e.en: The map {misled} us into the wrong neighborhood.
e.zh: 那张地图把我们误导到了错误的街区。

mismanage.t: v. 管理不善；处理不当

e.en: If you {mismanage} your time, deadlines will slip.
e.zh: 如果时间管理不当,截止日期就会延误。

e.en: Executives who {mismanage} budgets rarely keep their jobs.
e.zh: 管理预算不善的高管很少能保住职位。

mismanaged.t:
v. 管理不善（过去式）
adj. 被错误管理的

e.en: The project was badly {mismanaged} from the very start.
e.zh: 这个项目从一开始就被严重管理不善。

e.en: She {mismanaged} the team and morale collapsed.
e.zh: 她对团队管理失当,士气因此崩溃。

mismanagement.t: n. 管理不善；处置失当

e.en: Years of {mismanagement} drove the company into bankruptcy.
e.zh: 多年的管理不善把公司推向了破产。

e.en: Investigators found clear evidence of financial {mismanagement}.
e.zh: 调查人员发现了明显的财务管理不善证据。

mismatch.t:
n. 不匹配；不协调
v. 错配

e.en: There's a {mismatch} between the job description and reality.
e.zh: 职位描述与实际工作之间存在不匹配。

e.en: The color {mismatch} between the walls is obvious.
e.zh: 两面墙之间的颜色不一致非常明显。

mismatched.t: adj. 不匹配的；不相称的

e.en: He showed up wearing {mismatched} socks again.
e.zh: 他又穿着一双不成对的袜子出现了。

e.en: Their skill levels were badly {mismatched} for a fair game.
e.zh: 他们的水平差距太大,无法进行公平的比赛。

e.en: It would {misname} the file to call it a backup.
e.zh: 把这个文件称为备份是一种错误命名。

e.en: Critics argue the law's title {misname}s its real purpose.
e.zh: 批评人士认为这项法律的名称掩盖了其真实目的。

misnamed.t: adj. 名不副实的；被叫错名的

e.en: The dish is {misnamed}; it contains no chocolate at all.
e.zh: 这道菜名字起错了,里面根本没有巧克力。

e.en: Many folders were {misnamed} after the migration.
e.zh: 迁移之后许多文件夹的名称都弄错了。

misnomer.t: n. 用词不当；名称误用

e.en: Calling that tiny park a forest is a {misnomer}.
e.zh: 把那个小公园称作森林完全是用词不当。

e.en: "Smart TV" can feel like a {misnomer} sometimes.
e.zh: “智能电视”这个名字有时让人觉得名不副实。

miso.t: n. 味噌（日式发酵豆酱）

e.en: I added a spoonful of {miso} to the broth.
e.zh: 我在汤里加了一勺味噌。

e.en: This restaurant serves excellent {miso} soup with breakfast.
e.zh: 这家餐厅早餐供应非常好喝的味噌汤。

e.en: His {misogamy} kept him single well into his sixties.
e.zh: 他对婚姻的厌恶让他直到六十多岁仍然单身。

e.en: Some philosophers wrote essays defending {misogamy} as a lifestyle.
e.zh: 有些哲学家写文章为厌婚作为一种生活方式辩护。

misogynist.t: n. 厌女者；仇视女性的人

e.en: The columnist was widely criticized as a {misogynist}.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家被广泛批评为厌女者。

e.en: Her boss turned out to be a workplace {misogynist}.
e.zh: 她的老板原来是个职场上的厌女者。

misogynistic.t: adj. 厌女的；仇视女性的

e.en: The film's {misogynistic} jokes drew immediate backlash online.
e.zh: 这部电影的厌女笑话立刻在网上引起强烈反弹。

e.en: Many old advertisements now feel openly {misogynistic}.
e.zh: 许多旧广告现在看来公然带有厌女色彩。

misogynous.t: adj. 厌女的；憎恶女性的

e.en: The novel was attacked for its {misogynous} portrayal of women.
e.zh: 这部小说因对女性的厌女描写而遭到抨击。

e.en: His lyrics were dismissed as crude and {misogynous}.
e.zh: 他的歌词被认为粗俗且充满厌女色彩。

misogyny.t: n. 厌女；对女性的仇视

e.en: The campaign aims to confront everyday {misogyny} in workplaces.
e.zh: 这场运动旨在直面职场中的日常厌女现象。

e.en: Critics noted the casual {misogyny} woven into the script.
e.zh: 评论者指出剧本中夹杂着随处可见的厌女情绪。

e.en: People often {misperceive} risks during a financial panic.
e.zh: 在金融恐慌中,人们常常错判风险。

e.en: Tired drivers can {misperceive} distances on the highway.
e.zh: 疲劳的司机可能会错判高速公路上的距离。

e.en: There's a common {misperception} that introverts dislike people.
e.zh: 人们普遍误以为内向者不喜欢与人交往。

e.en: The survey aims to correct public {misperception} of the policy.
e.zh: 这项调查旨在纠正公众对该政策的错误看法。

e.en: Try not to {misplace} your passport while traveling.
e.zh: 旅行时尽量别把护照放错地方。

e.en: I always {misplace} my glasses around the house.
e.zh: 我总是把眼镜在家里随手乱放找不到。

misplaced.t: adj. 放错地方的；不合时宜的

e.en: Her trust in him turned out to be {misplaced}.
e.zh: 事实证明她对他的信任放错了地方。

e.en: I {misplaced} my charger somewhere in the office.
e.zh: 我把充电器忘在办公室某个地方了。

e.en: The {misplacement} of the comma changed the sentence's meaning.
e.zh: 逗号位置放错了,改变了整句话的意思。

e.en: Frequent {misplacement} of files annoyed the entire team.
e.zh: 文件经常放错位置让整个团队都很恼火。

misplaces.t: v. 放错位置（第三人称单数）

e.en: He constantly {misplaces} his phone before leaving home.
e.zh: 他每次出门前都会把手机放错地方。

e.en: The intern {misplaces} important documents almost every week.
e.zh: 这位实习生几乎每周都会把重要文件放错地方。

misplacing.t: v. 放错位置（现在分词）

e.en: I keep {misplacing} my AirPods all over the apartment.
e.zh: 我总是把耳机随手扔得满公寓都是。

e.en: {Misplacing} the decimal point can cost millions.
e.zh: 小数点放错位置可能损失上百万。

mispricing.t: n. 错误定价；定价偏差

e.en: Traders look for {mispricing} between related stocks.
e.zh: 交易员会寻找相关股票之间的定价偏差。

e.en: A small {mispricing} on the website caused chaos at checkout.
e.zh: 网站上一个小小的定价错误在结账时引发了混乱。

misprint.t:
n. 印刷错误
v. 印错

e.en: The book has a {misprint} on the very first page.
e.zh: 这本书的第一页就有一处印刷错误。

e.en: Collectors pay extra for stamps with a famous {misprint}.
e.zh: 收藏家愿意为有著名印刷错误的邮票多花钱。

e.en: Tourists often {mispronounce} the name of this city.
e.zh: 游客经常把这座城市的名字念错。

e.en: Don't worry if you {mispronounce} a few words at first.
e.zh: 刚开始读错几个单词不用担心。

e.en: His {mispronunciation} of "quinoa" became a running joke.
e.zh: 他把“quinoa”读错成了大家长期取笑的梗。

e.en: The teacher gently corrected each {mispronunciation} during class.
e.zh: 老师在课上温和地纠正了每一个发音错误。

misquote.t: v. 错误引用；曲解原话

e.en: Reporters sometimes {misquote} politicians to fit their narrative.
e.zh: 记者有时会曲解政客的话以符合他们的叙述。

e.en: Don't {misquote} me on this delicate subject.
e.zh: 在这个敏感话题上不要错误引用我的话。

e.en: I {misread} the room and made an awkward joke.
e.zh: 我没读懂气氛,开了个尴尬的玩笑。

e.en: The pharmacist {misread} the doctor's handwriting on the prescription.
e.zh: 药剂师看错了医生在处方上的字迹。

e.en: Her {misreading} of the contract caused legal trouble.
e.zh: 她对合同的错误理解引发了法律麻烦。

e.en: That's a serious {misreading} of the original poem.
e.zh: 那是对原诗的严重误读。

e.en: The face-unlock failed due to {misrecognition} in the dark.
e.zh: 由于黑暗中识别错误,面部解锁失败了。

e.en: Voice assistants suffer from {misrecognition} of accented speech.
e.zh: 语音助手在识别带口音的语音时常常出错。

e.en: People often {misremember} details from their childhood.
e.zh: 人们常常记错童年的细节。

e.en: I may {misremember} the exact date of the meeting.
e.zh: 会议的具体日期我可能记错了。

misreport.t:
v. 错误报道
n. 失实报道

e.en: News outlets sometimes {misreport} statistics during breaking events.
e.zh: 新闻媒体在突发事件中有时会错报数据。

e.en: Employees who {misreport} expenses can face serious consequences.
e.zh: 虚报开销的员工可能面临严重后果。

e.en: Critics say the ad {misrepresents} the product's actual battery life.
e.zh: 批评者称该广告歪曲了产品的实际电池续航。

e.en: Please don't {misrepresent} my views in your article.
e.zh: 请不要在你的文章里曲解我的观点。

e.en: The lawsuit alleges deliberate {misrepresentation} of the company's earnings.
e.zh: 诉讼指控公司故意虚报盈利数据。

e.en: That headline is a complete {misrepresentation} of the study.
e.zh: 那个标题完全歪曲了这项研究。

misrule.t:
n. 暴政；治理不善
v. 施行暴政

e.en: Years of {misrule} left the country deeply in debt.
e.zh: 多年的失政让这个国家深陷债务。

e.en: Historians blame the famine on royal {misrule}.
e.zh: 史学家将这场饥荒归咎于王室的暴政。

miss.t:
v. 错过；想念
n. 小姐

e.en: Don't {miss} the last train home tonight.
e.zh: 今晚别错过最后一班回家的火车。

e.en: I really {miss} my college friends these days.
e.zh: 这些日子我真的很想念大学时的朋友。

missa.t: n. 弥撒（拉丁语，天主教礼仪）

e.en: The choir performed Bach's {Missa} in B minor beautifully.
e.zh: 合唱团出色地演绎了巴赫的B小调弥撒曲。

e.en: Mozart's unfinished {Missa} remains a haunting masterpiece.
e.zh: 莫扎特未完成的弥撒曲至今仍是动人的杰作。

missal.t: n. 弥撒经书；天主教祈祷书

e.en: The priest opened the {missal} to begin the service.
e.zh: 神父翻开弥撒经书开始仪式。

e.en: She inherited a leather-bound {missal} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一本皮面弥撒经书。

e.en: I {missed} your call while I was in a meeting.
e.zh: 我开会时错过了你的来电。

e.en: She {missed} her family terribly during the trip abroad.
e.zh: 出国期间她非常想念家人。

misses.t:
v. 错过（第三人称单数）
n. 小姐们

e.en: He rarely {misses} a deadline at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中很少错过截止日期。

e.en: My daughter {misses} her best friend who moved away.
e.zh: 我女儿很想念那个搬走的好朋友。

misshapen.t: adj. 畸形的；形状怪异的

e.en: The bakery sells {misshapen} cookies at half price.
e.zh: 那家面包店半价出售形状不规整的饼干。

e.en: An old {misshapen} oak tree stood by the gate.
e.zh: 一棵歪歪扭扭的老橡树立在门旁。

e.en: The army tested a new long-range {missile} yesterday.
e.zh: 军方昨天试射了一种新型远程导弹。

e.en: A snowball {missile} flew past my ear.
e.zh: 一颗雪球从我耳边飞过。

e.en: The defense system intercepted three incoming {missiles}.
e.zh: 防御系统拦截了三枚来袭的导弹。

e.en: Children threw paper {missiles} across the classroom.
e.zh: 孩子们在教室里互掷纸团。

e.en: My keys have been {missing} since this morning.
e.zh: 我的钥匙从今早起就不见了。

e.en: There's a button {missing} from this shirt.
e.zh: 这件衬衫少了一颗扣子。

missiology.t: n. 宣教学（基督教传教研究）

e.en: He teaches {missiology} at a small theological seminary.
e.zh: 他在一所小型神学院教授宣教学。

e.en: Modern {missiology} explores cross-cultural communication of faith.
e.zh: 现代宣教学研究信仰的跨文化传播。

mission.t:
n. 任务；使命
n. 代表团

e.en: Our {mission} is to make clean water accessible worldwide.
e.zh: 我们的使命是让全世界都能用上洁净的水。

e.en: The astronauts completed their {mission} to the space station.
e.zh: 宇航员完成了前往空间站的任务。

missionary.t:
n. 传教士
adj. 传教的

e.en: Her grandfather was a {missionary} in rural China.
e.zh: 她的祖父曾在中国乡村做传教士。

e.en: He has a {missionary} zeal for promoting healthy eating.
e.zh: 他对推广健康饮食有种传教般的热情。

e.en: The {missioner} arrived in the village carrying medical supplies.
e.zh: 那位传教士带着医疗物资来到村里。

e.en: She trained as a {missioner} before joining the charity.
e.zh: 加入慈善机构前她接受过传教士培训。

e.en: The book examines the {missionization} of indigenous communities.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了原住民社区被传教化的过程。

e.en: {Missionization} dramatically reshaped local religious practices.
e.zh: 传教活动深刻改变了当地的宗教习俗。

e.en: NASA has announced two new {missions} to Mars.
e.zh: NASA宣布了两项新的火星任务。

e.en: Old Spanish {missions} dot the California coast.
e.zh: 古老的西班牙传教所散布在加州沿岸。

mississippi.t: n. 密西西比州；密西西比河

e.en: The {Mississippi} River runs through ten states.
e.zh: 密西西比河流经十个州。

e.en: She grew up on a small farm in {Mississippi}.
e.zh: 她在密西西比州的一个小农场长大。

mississippian.t:
adj. 密西西比州的
n. 密西西比州人

e.en: As a proud {Mississippian}, he loves blues music.
e.zh: 作为一个地道的密西西比人,他热爱蓝调音乐。

e.en: These fossils date to the {Mississippian} period.
e.zh: 这些化石可追溯到密西西比纪。

e.en: She received a lengthy {missive} from her lawyer.
e.zh: 她收到了律师寄来的一封长信。

e.en: His angry {missive} to the editor went viral online.
e.zh: 他写给编辑的愤怒信件在网上疯传。

missouri.t: n. 密苏里州；密苏里河

e.en: Kansas City sits on the border of {Missouri}.
e.zh: 堪萨斯城位于密苏里州的边界上。

e.en: The {Missouri} River joins the Mississippi near St. Louis.
e.zh: 密苏里河在圣路易斯附近汇入密西西比河。

e.en: Politicians often {misspeak} during live television interviews.
e.zh: 政客在电视直播采访中常常说错话。

e.en: I tend to {misspeak} when I'm extremely nervous.
e.zh: 我极度紧张时容易说错话。

e.en: Don't {misspell} the client's name in the email.
e.zh: 别把客户的名字在邮件里拼错了。

e.en: Many people {misspell} the word "separate" as "seperate".
e.zh: 很多人把单词"separate"误拼成"seperate"。

misspelled.t:
v. 拼错（过去式）
adj. 拼写错误的

e.en: He {misspelled} her name on the wedding invitation.
e.zh: 他把婚礼请柬上她的名字拼错了。

e.en: The sign had "Welcome" {misspelled} as "Wellcome".
e.zh: 招牌上把"Welcome"拼错成了"Wellcome"。

e.en: There's an obvious {misspelling} on the first slide.
e.zh: 第一张幻灯片上有个明显的拼写错误。

e.en: Spell check caught my {misspelling} of "accommodate".
e.zh: 拼写检查发现了我把"accommodate"拼错了。

e.en: Several names were {misspelt} on the printed program.
e.zh: 印好的节目单上有几个名字拼错了。

e.en: The shop sign had "fresh" {misspelt} as "frech".
e.zh: 店铺招牌把"fresh"拼错成了"frech"。

misspend.t: v. 滥用；挥霍（时间、金钱）

e.en: Don't {misspend} your savings on impulse purchases.
e.zh: 别把存款胡乱花在冲动消费上。

e.en: Critics say the council {misspends} taxpayer money.
e.zh: 批评人士称议会乱花纳税人的钱。

e.en: He regrets his {misspent} youth playing video games.
e.zh: 他后悔年轻时把光阴都浪费在打游戏上。

e.en: The audit revealed millions of {misspent} dollars.
e.zh: 审计发现了数百万美元被滥用的资金。

e.en: The witness may unintentionally {misstate} certain key facts.
e.zh: 证人可能会无意中错述某些关键事实。

e.en: Be careful not to {misstate} the company's revenue.
e.zh: 小心不要错报公司的收入。

misstatement.t: n. 错误陈述；失实声明

e.en: The CEO apologized for the financial {misstatement}.
e.zh: 首席执行官为财务报表的错误陈述道歉。

e.en: A single {misstatement} can damage public trust.
e.zh: 一句错误的陈述就可能损害公众信任。

e.en: That tweet was a major {misstep} for the brand.
e.zh: 那条推文是该品牌的一次重大失误。

e.en: One {misstep} on the icy path could be dangerous.
e.zh: 在结冰的小路上一步走错就可能很危险。

e.en: I'd better ask the {missus} before agreeing to that.
e.zh: 我得先问问太太再答应这事。

e.en: How's the {missus} doing these days?
e.zh: 你太太最近怎么样?

e.en: Watch your tone, {missy}, or you'll be grounded.
e.zh: 小姑娘,注意你的语气,不然就罚你禁足。

e.en: Slow down, {missy}, the cake isn't going anywhere.
e.zh: 小姑娘慢点吃,蛋糕又不会跑。

mist.t:
n. 薄雾
v. 起雾；蒙上水汽

e.en: A thick {mist} rolled in from the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,浓雾从港口涌来。

e.en: She sprayed a fine {mist} of perfume on her wrist.
e.zh: 她在手腕上喷了一层细细的香水雾。

mistake.t:
n. 错误
v. 弄错；误认

e.en: Everyone makes a {mistake} now and then at work.
e.zh: 人人在工作中都会偶尔犯错。

e.en: Don't {mistake} kindness for weakness.
e.zh: 别把善良误认为软弱。

e.en: You're {mistaken} if you think the meeting was canceled.
e.zh: 如果你以为会议取消了,那就错了。

e.en: The package was delivered to the wrong address by {mistaken} identity.
e.zh: 由于身份混淆,包裹被送到了错误的地址。

e.en: I {mistakenly} sent the email to the entire company.
e.zh: 我误把那封邮件发给了全公司。

e.en: She {mistakenly} believed the store opened at nine.
e.zh: 她误以为那家店九点开门。

mistakes.t:
n. 错误（复数）
v. 弄错

e.en: Learning from your {mistakes} is part of growing up.
e.zh: 从错误中学习是成长的一部分。

e.en: The report contains several factual {mistakes}.
e.zh: 这份报告里有好几处事实错误。

mistaking.t: v. 弄错；误认（现在分词）

e.en: There's no {mistaking} her laugh in a crowded room.
e.zh: 在拥挤的房间里也绝不会认错她的笑声。

e.en: He kept {mistaking} me for my twin brother.
e.zh: 他一直把我错认成我的双胞胎哥哥。

misted.t: v. 起雾；蒙上水汽（过去式）

e.en: The bathroom mirror {misted} over after my hot shower.
e.zh: 洗完热水澡后浴室的镜子蒙上了一层雾。

e.en: Her eyes {misted} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到那个消息她眼眶湿润了。

e.en: Excuse me, {mister}, you dropped your wallet.
e.zh: 先生,打扰一下,您的钱包掉了。

e.en: The kids call their neighbor {Mister} Johnson.
e.zh: 孩子们叫他们的邻居约翰逊先生。

e.en: The mountains rose {mistily} in the distance.
e.zh: 远处的群山在雾气中朦胧浮现。

e.en: She smiled {mistily} as she recalled her childhood.
e.zh: 回想起童年时,她眼含泪光地微笑着。

mistime.t: v. 时机不当；时间没掌握好

e.en: Don't {mistime} your jump or you'll miss the ball.
e.zh: 别把起跳时机算错,否则会接不到球。

e.en: Comedians who {mistime} their punchlines lose the audience.
e.zh: 抖包袱时机没掌握好的喜剧演员会失去观众。

e.en: His {mistimed} joke fell flat at the funeral.
e.zh: 他在葬礼上说的玩笑因时机不当而冷场。

e.en: The goalkeeper {mistimed} his dive and let in the goal.
e.zh: 门将扑救时机不准,被对方进了球。

misting.t:
v. 起雾
n. 喷雾

e.en: It's been {misting} lightly all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午都在飘着细细的雾雨。

e.en: The greenhouse uses an automatic {misting} system.
e.zh: 这间温室使用自动喷雾系统。

mistletoe.t: n. 槲寄生（圣诞装饰植物）

e.en: Couples traditionally kiss under the {mistletoe} at Christmas.
e.zh: 圣诞节情侣们传统上会在槲寄生下接吻。

e.en: She hung a sprig of {mistletoe} above the doorway.
e.zh: 她在门廊上方挂了一束槲寄生。

mistook.t: v. 弄错；误认（mistake 过去式）

e.en: I {mistook} him for an old college classmate.
e.zh: 我把他错认成了大学时的老同学。

e.en: She {mistook} my silence for agreement.
e.zh: 她把我的沉默错当成了同意。

mistral.t: n. 密史脱拉风（法国南部寒风）

e.en: The cold {mistral} swept down through the Rhône valley.
e.zh: 寒冷的密史脱拉风扫过罗讷河谷。

e.en: Provence is famous for its fierce {mistral} winds.
e.zh: 普罗旺斯以猛烈的密史脱拉风而闻名。

e.en: The diplomatic incident was caused by a simple {mistranslation}.
e.zh: 这起外交风波是由一次简单的误译引起的。

e.en: Fans pointed out an obvious {mistranslation} in the subtitles.
e.zh: 粉丝们指出字幕中有一处明显的误译。

e.en: It is wrong to {mistreat} animals in any way.
e.zh: 以任何方式虐待动物都是错误的。

e.en: Managers who {mistreat} staff often face high turnover.
e.zh: 虐待员工的经理往往面临高离职率。

mistreated.t:
v. 虐待（过去式）
adj. 受虐待的

e.en: She felt {mistreated} by her former employer.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被前雇主苛待了。

e.en: The rescued dog had clearly been {mistreated} for years.
e.zh: 那只获救的狗显然多年来一直被虐待。

e.en: The company was fined for {mistreating} its workers.
e.zh: 该公司因苛待员工而被罚款。

e.en: Stop {mistreating} your little brother right now.
e.zh: 立刻停止欺负你的小弟弟。

e.en: The report documented widespread {mistreatment} of prisoners.
e.zh: 该报告记录了对囚犯的普遍虐待。

e.en: She quit after years of {mistreatment} at work.
e.zh: 在工作中遭受多年虐待后她辞职了。

mistreats.t: v. 虐待（第三人称单数）

e.en: Anyone who {mistreats} a child should be reported.
e.zh: 任何虐待儿童的人都应被举报。

e.en: He {mistreats} his coworkers and blames them for mistakes.
e.zh: 他苛待同事,还把错误怪到他们头上。

mistress.t:
n. 情妇
n. 女主人

e.en: The {mistress} of the house greeted every guest warmly.
e.zh: 女主人热情地迎接每一位客人。

e.en: The scandal revealed the politician had a secret {mistress}.
e.zh: 丑闻揭露这位政客有一位秘密情妇。

mistrial.t: n. 无效审判；审判无效

e.en: The judge declared a {mistrial} after the jury deadlocked.
e.zh: 陪审团僵持不下后,法官宣布审判无效。

e.en: A juror's misconduct led to a {mistrial} in the case.
e.zh: 一名陪审员的不当行为导致此案无效审判。

mistrust.t:
n. 不信任
v. 怀疑；不信任

e.en: Years of broken promises bred deep {mistrust} between them.
e.zh: 多年的食言在他们之间滋生了深深的不信任。

e.en: Many users {mistrust} apps that demand too many permissions.
e.zh: 许多用户不信任索取过多权限的应用。

e.en: She remained {mistrustful} of strangers offering free advice online.
e.zh: 她对网上提供免费建议的陌生人始终心存戒备。

e.en: The cat is {mistrustful} of anyone wearing a hat.
e.zh: 那只猫对任何戴帽子的人都心存戒备。

mists.t:
n. 薄雾（复数）
v. 起雾

e.en: Morning {mists} drifted slowly across the quiet lake.
e.zh: 晨雾在寂静的湖面上缓缓飘过。

e.en: The legend is lost in the {mists} of time.
e.zh: 这个传说已湮没在时间的迷雾中。

e.en: We hiked through the {misty} forest at dawn.
e.zh: 我们在黎明时分穿过雾蒙蒙的森林徒步。

e.en: Her eyes went {misty} as she read the letter.
e.zh: 她读信时眼眶湿润了。

e.en: Don't {misunderstand} me — I really do appreciate your help.
e.zh: 别误会我,我真的很感激你的帮助。

e.en: Tourists often {misunderstand} the local tipping customs here.
e.zh: 游客常常误解这里的当地小费习俗。

e.en: The argument was just a silly {misunderstanding} between friends.
e.zh: 那场争吵只是朋友间一个愚蠢的误会。

e.en: There's a common {misunderstanding} about how vaccines actually work.
e.zh: 关于疫苗实际原理存在一个常见的误解。

e.en: Clear communication can prevent most workplace {misunderstandings}.
e.zh: 清晰的沟通能避免大多数职场误会。

e.en: Cultural differences sometimes lead to small {misunderstandings} abroad.
e.zh: 文化差异有时会在国外导致小误会。

misunderstands.t: v. 误解（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {misunderstands} jokes and takes them seriously.
e.zh: 他总是误解玩笑,把它们当真。

e.en: The article completely {misunderstands} the new tax policy.
e.zh: 这篇文章完全误解了新的税收政策。

misunderstood.t:
v. 误解（过去式）
adj. 被误解的

e.en: I think you {misunderstood} what I said yesterday.
e.zh: 我觉得你误解了我昨天说的话。

e.en: She felt {misunderstood} by everyone in her family.
e.zh: 她觉得家里没人理解她。

e.en: The {misuse} of antibiotics has created resistant bacteria.
e.zh: 抗生素的滥用造成了耐药细菌。

e.en: Please don't {misuse} the company credit card again.
e.zh: 请不要再滥用公司的信用卡了。

misused.t:
v. 滥用（过去式）
adj. 被误用的

e.en: He was fired for having {misused} confidential client data.
e.zh: 他因滥用客户机密资料而被解雇。

e.en: The word "literally" is often {misused} for emphasis.
e.zh: "literally"这个词常被滥用来加强语气。

e.en: The system flagged him as a frequent {misuser} of refunds.
e.zh: 系统将他标记为频繁滥用退款的用户。

e.en: Every {misuser} of the platform risks an immediate ban.
e.zh: 每个滥用平台的人都有被立即封禁的风险。

mit.t: n. 麻省理工学院（缩写）

e.en: She got accepted into {MIT}'s computer science program.
e.zh: 她被麻省理工学院的计算机系录取了。

e.en: Researchers at {MIT} developed a new battery technology.
e.zh: 麻省理工学院的研究人员开发了一种新型电池技术。

e.en: They moved to {Mitcham}, a suburb in south London.
e.zh: 他们搬到了米查姆,伦敦南部的一个郊区。

e.en: The bus to {Mitcham} runs every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 开往米查姆的公交车每十五分钟一班。

e.en: Mr. {Mitchell} will be teaching our chemistry class this semester.
e.zh: 米切尔老师本学期将教我们的化学课。

e.en: Joni {Mitchell} wrote some of the greatest folk songs ever.
e.zh: 琼尼·米切尔写过一些史上最伟大的民谣。

e.en: Dust {mite} allergies often cause sneezing every morning.
e.zh: 尘螨过敏经常导致每天早上打喷嚏。

e.en: The cookies were a {mite} too sweet for me.
e.zh: 这些饼干对我来说稍微有点太甜了。

miter.t:
n. 斜接；主教冠
v. 斜接（木工）

e.en: Cut a 45-degree {miter} on each end of the trim.
e.zh: 在装饰条的两端各切一个45度的斜接。

e.en: The bishop wore a tall white {miter} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 主教在仪式上戴着一顶高高的白色法冠。

e.en: The carpenter {mitered} the corners of the picture frame perfectly.
e.zh: 木匠把相框的四角斜接得非常完美。

e.en: Each {mitered} joint was sanded smooth before gluing.
e.zh: 每个斜接接头在粘合前都打磨得很光滑。

e.en: Japan's {MITI} once shaped postwar industrial policy.
e.zh: 日本通产省曾主导战后的产业政策。

e.en: The professor cited {MITI} reports throughout her lecture.
e.zh: 教授在整场讲座中都引用了通产省的报告。

e.en: Wearing a helmet helps {mitigate} head injuries in crashes.
e.zh: 戴头盔有助于减轻车祸中的头部受伤。

e.en: The company added safeguards to {mitigate} financial risks.
e.zh: 公司增加了保障措施以降低财务风险。

mitigating.t:
adj. 可减轻（罪责）的
v. 缓解（现在分词）

e.en: The judge considered several {mitigating} factors before sentencing.
e.zh: 法官在量刑前考虑了几项减轻情节。

e.en: Trees play a major role in {mitigating} urban heat.
e.zh: 树木在缓解城市高温方面起着重要作用。

e.en: Climate {mitigation} requires cutting emissions across every sector.
e.zh: 气候减缓需要各行业削减排放。

e.en: The team built a risk {mitigation} plan for the launch.
e.zh: 团队为产品发布制定了风险缓解计划。

e.en: The {mitochondria} are often called the powerhouses of the cell.
e.zh: 线粒体常被称为细胞的能量工厂。

e.en: Damaged {mitochondria} are linked to many aging-related diseases.
e.zh: 受损的线粒体与许多与衰老相关的疾病有关。

e.en: {Mitochondrial} DNA is inherited only from the mother.
e.zh: 线粒体DNA只从母亲那里遗传。

e.en: Scientists study {mitochondrial} dysfunction in Parkinson's patients.
e.zh: 科学家研究帕金森患者的线粒体功能障碍。

e.en: Each {mitochondrion} contains its own small ring of DNA.
e.zh: 每个线粒体都含有自己的一小环DNA。

e.en: The textbook diagrams a single {mitochondrion} in great detail.
e.zh: 教科书非常详细地图解了单个线粒体。

e.en: Doctors sometimes use {mitomycin} to treat certain bladder cancers.
e.zh: 医生有时用丝裂霉素治疗某些膀胱癌。

e.en: The drug {mitomycin} works by damaging tumor cell DNA.
e.zh: 丝裂霉素通过破坏肿瘤细胞DNA来起作用。

e.en: Cells divide through {mitosis} to repair damaged tissues.
e.zh: 细胞通过有丝分裂来修复受损组织。

e.en: We watched {mitosis} happen live under the microscope.
e.zh: 我们在显微镜下实时观察了有丝分裂的发生。

e.en: Cancer cells often show a high {mitotic} rate.
e.zh: 癌细胞通常表现出较高的有丝分裂率。

e.en: The textbook illustrates each {mitotic} phase with clear photos.
e.zh: 教科书用清晰的照片展示了每个有丝分裂阶段。

e.en: Dr. {Mitra} will present her research at the conference.
e.zh: 米特拉博士将在会议上展示她的研究。

e.en: The ancient god {Mitra} was worshipped across early Persia.
e.zh: 古神密特拉曾在早期波斯各地受到崇拜。

e.en: She had surgery to repair her leaky {mitral} valve.
e.zh: 她做了手术修复漏血的二尖瓣。

e.en: {Mitral} valve prolapse is fairly common and usually harmless.
e.zh: 二尖瓣脱垂相当常见,通常无害。

mitre.t:
n. 主教冠；斜接
v. 斜接

e.en: He cut a clean {mitre} for the picture frame corner.
e.zh: 他为相框角切出了一个干净的斜接。

e.en: The bishop's golden {mitre} gleamed in the candlelight.
e.zh: 主教的金色法冠在烛光下闪闪发光。

mitred.t: adj. 斜接的；戴主教冠的

e.en: The skilled joiner {mitred} every corner of the cabinet.
e.zh: 熟练的细木工把柜子的每个角都做了斜接。

e.en: All four {mitred} edges fit together without any gap.
e.zh: 四个斜接边完美贴合,没有一丝缝隙。

e.en: He drives an old {Mitsubishi} pickup truck to work.
e.zh: 他开着一辆旧三菱皮卡上班。

e.en: {Mitsubishi} announced a new line of electric vehicles yesterday.
e.zh: 三菱昨天发布了新一代电动车系列。

e.en: {Mitsui} is one of Japan's oldest trading conglomerates.
e.zh: 三井是日本最古老的贸易财团之一。

e.en: She works at {Mitsui}'s overseas investment division.
e.zh: 她在三井的海外投资部门工作。

mitt.t: n. 棒球手套；连指手套

e.en: He caught the fly ball easily in his {mitt}.
e.zh: 他用棒球手套轻松接住了飞球。

e.en: Grab the oven {mitt} before pulling out the tray.
e.zh: 在把烤盘拿出来之前先戴上烤箱手套。

e.en: She lost one {mitten} on the way home from school.
e.zh: 她在放学回家的路上弄丢了一只连指手套。

e.en: The tiny {mitten} was perfect for the toddler's hand.
e.zh: 那只小巧的连指手套正适合幼儿的小手。

e.en: Her {mittened} hands clutched the steaming mug of cocoa.
e.zh: 她戴着连指手套的双手紧握着冒着热气的可可马克杯。

e.en: The children waved their {mittened} hands at the parade.
e.zh: 孩子们戴着连指手套向游行队伍挥手。

e.en: Helping a stranger is considered a {mitzvah} in Jewish tradition.
e.zh: 帮助陌生人在犹太传统中被视为善行。

e.en: His bar {mitzvah} ceremony was held last Saturday morning.
e.zh: 他的成年礼仪式于上周六上午举行。

mix.t:
v. 混合；搅拌
n. 混合物

e.en: {Mix} the flour and sugar before adding the eggs.
e.zh: 加蛋之前先把面粉和糖搅拌均匀。

e.en: The playlist is a great {mix} of jazz and pop.
e.zh: 这个播放列表是爵士与流行的精彩混搭。

e.en: The new movie has received {mixed} reviews from critics.
e.zh: 这部新电影收到了影评人褒贬不一的评价。

e.en: She {mixed} the paint until the color was perfect.
e.zh: 她调和油漆,直到颜色刚刚好。

e.en: Use a stand {mixer} to whip the cream quickly.
e.zh: 用台式搅拌机可以快速打发奶油。

e.en: The DJ's {mixer} let her blend two tracks seamlessly.
e.zh: DJ的混音台让她能无缝衔接两首歌曲。

mixes.t:
v. 混合（第三人称单数）
n. 混合物（复数）

e.en: Oil never really {mixes} with water no matter what.
e.zh: 无论怎样,油都无法真正与水混合。

e.en: He posts new DJ {mixes} on SoundCloud every week.
e.zh: 他每周都在SoundCloud上发布新的DJ混音作品。

mixing.t:
n. 混合；混音
v. 混合（现在分词）

e.en: She is {mixing} cocktails for the party tonight.
e.zh: 她正在为今晚的派对调制鸡尾酒。

e.en: The producer is {mixing} the album in a Berlin studio.
e.zh: 制作人正在柏林的录音室里混音这张专辑。

e.en: Pour the cake {mixture} into a greased pan.
e.zh: 把蛋糕面糊倒入抹了油的烤盘中。

e.en: Her face showed a {mixture} of joy and relief.
e.zh: 她的脸上交织着喜悦与释然。

e.en: The lab tests dozens of paint {mixtures} each week.
e.zh: 实验室每周测试数十种油漆混合物。

e.en: Some cough {mixtures} can make you very drowsy.
e.zh: 有些止咳合剂会让人非常困倦。

e.en: MRI is a powerful imaging {modality} in modern hospitals.
e.zh: 核磁共振是现代医院里一种强大的成像方式。

e.en: The app supports voice as an input {modality}.
e.zh: 这款应用支持把语音作为一种输入方式。

e.en: Switch your phone to silent {mode} during the movie.
e.zh: 看电影时请把手机调到静音模式。

e.en: Cycling is her favorite {mode} of transport.
e.zh: 骑自行车是她最喜欢的出行方式。

model.t:
n. 模型；范本
v. 建模

e.en: This {model} of laptop comes in three colors.
e.zh: 这款笔记本电脑有三种颜色可选。

e.en: The new language {model} understands many regional dialects.
e.zh: 这款新的语言模型能听懂许多地方方言。

modeled.t:
v. 建模（过去式）
adj. 模型化的

e.en: The new library is {modeled} after a Roman temple.
e.zh: 这座新图书馆是仿照一座罗马神庙建造的。

e.en: She {modeled} dresses for several major fashion brands.
e.zh: 她为多个知名时装品牌走过秀。

e.en: She works as a 3D {modeler} at a game studio.
e.zh: 她在一家游戏工作室担任三维建模师。

e.en: The climate {modeler} predicted warmer winters ahead.
e.zh: 那位气候建模专家预测未来冬天会更暖。

modeling.t:
n. 建模
v. 塑造

e.en: He started {modeling} for fashion magazines last year.
e.zh: 他去年开始为时尚杂志做模特。

e.en: Financial {modeling} helps companies forecast future revenue.
e.zh: 财务建模帮助公司预测未来的收入。

e.en: The studio hired a skilled character {modeller} for the new game.
e.zh: 工作室为新游戏聘请了一位熟练的角色建模师。

e.en: As a data {modeller}, she designs database schemas daily.
e.zh: 作为数据建模师,她每天都在设计数据库结构。

e.en: She built a career in fashion {modelling} after college.
e.zh: 大学毕业后她在时装模特行业打拼。

e.en: 3D {modelling} software has become much more affordable.
e.zh: 三维建模软件已经变得便宜多了。

models.t:
n. 模型（复数）
v. 建模

e.en: Tesla released two new car {models} this spring.
e.zh: 特斯拉今春推出了两款新车型。

e.en: Language {models} can now write fluent essays.
e.zh: 语言模型现在已能写出流畅的文章。

e.en: Restart your {modem} when the internet stops working.
e.zh: 网络断了时重启一下调制解调器。

e.en: The old {modem} made a screeching sound when connecting.
e.zh: 那台旧调制解调器连线时会发出刺耳的声音。

e.en: The store sells {modems} compatible with most providers.
e.zh: 这家店出售兼容大多数运营商的调制解调器。

e.en: Cable {modems} replaced dial-up connections decades ago.
e.zh: 光纤调制解调器几十年前就取代了拨号上网。

modena.t: n. 摩德纳（意大利城市）

e.en: We tasted aged balsamic vinegar in {Modena}, Italy.
e.zh: 我们在意大利摩德纳品尝了陈年香醋。

e.en: Ferrari's headquarters is near {Modena} in northern Italy.
e.zh: 法拉利总部位于意大利北部的摩德纳附近。

moderate.t:
adj. 适度的；温和的
v. 缓和

e.en: The senator holds {moderate} views on most issues.
e.zh: 那位参议员对大多数议题持温和立场。

e.en: Try to {moderate} your sugar intake during the week.
e.zh: 工作日尽量控制糖分的摄入。

moderately.t: adv. 适度地；中等程度地

e.en: The film was {moderately} successful at the box office.
e.zh: 这部电影在票房上取得了中等的成绩。

e.en: Exercise {moderately} for thirty minutes most days.
e.zh: 大多数日子进行三十分钟的适度运动。

e.en: She's {moderating} the panel discussion this afternoon.
e.zh: 她下午将主持那场小组讨论。

e.en: Volunteers are {moderating} comments on the forum.
e.zh: 志愿者们正在审核论坛里的评论。

e.en: Drink coffee in {moderation} to avoid sleep problems.
e.zh: 喝咖啡要适量,以免影响睡眠。

e.en: Content {moderation} is a difficult job for social platforms.
e.zh: 内容审核对社交平台来说是项艰难的工作。

e.en: The {moderator} kept the debate civil and on topic.
e.zh: 主持人让辩论保持文明并紧扣主题。

e.en: A Reddit {moderator} removed the off-topic post.
e.zh: 一位 Reddit 版主删除了那条偏题的帖子。

e.en: {Modern} smartphones are basically tiny computers.
e.zh: 现代智能手机基本上就是小型电脑。

e.en: The museum showcases {modern} art from the 1960s.
e.zh: 该博物馆展出 1960 年代的现代艺术作品。

e.en: The hotel lobby features stunning {moderne} chandeliers from the 1930s.
e.zh: 酒店大堂陈列着 1930 年代精美的现代风格吊灯。

e.en: She collects {moderne} furniture with sleek chrome accents.
e.zh: 她收藏带有流线型镀铬装饰的现代风家具。

e.en: The factory's {modernisation} doubled its output.
e.zh: 工厂的现代化改造让产量翻了一番。

e.en: Rapid {modernisation} transformed the rural village.
e.zh: 快速的现代化改变了那个乡村。

modernisations.t: n. 现代化（英式拼写复数）

e.en: Several {modernisations} of the railway line are planned.
e.zh: 该铁路线计划进行多项现代化升级。

e.en: Recent {modernisations} have improved hospital efficiency.
e.zh: 近期的多项现代化改造提升了医院的效率。

modernise.t: v. 使现代化（英式拼写）

e.en: The company plans to {modernise} its outdated software.
e.zh: 公司计划升级其老旧的软件系统。

e.en: They want to {modernise} the kitchen before selling the house.
e.zh: 他们想在卖房前把厨房翻新一下。

modernised.t: v. 现代化（英式过去式）

e.en: The library was completely {modernised} last year.
e.zh: 图书馆去年进行了彻底的现代化改造。

e.en: They {modernised} the old factory with new robots.
e.zh: 他们用新机器人对旧工厂进行了现代化改造。

modernises.t: v. 使现代化（英式三单）

e.en: The new policy {modernises} our hiring process.
e.zh: 这项新政策让我们的招聘流程更加现代化。

e.en: Each update {modernises} the app's user interface.
e.zh: 每次更新都让应用的界面更加现代。

modernising.t: v. 使现代化（英式进行时）

e.en: The government is {modernising} the country's transport system.
e.zh: 政府正在对全国的交通系统进行现代化改造。

e.en: They are {modernising} the textbook with online resources.
e.zh: 他们正在用在线资源升级这本教材。

e.en: {Modernism} rejected traditional storytelling in favor of experimentation.
e.zh: 现代主义抛弃了传统叙事,转而追求实验性。

e.en: This building is a classic example of architectural {modernism}.
e.zh: 这座建筑是建筑现代主义的经典代表。

e.en: The course explores various European {modernisms} of the 1920s.
e.zh: 这门课程探讨 1920 年代欧洲各种现代主义流派。

e.en: Different national {modernisms} developed unique aesthetic styles.
e.zh: 不同国家的现代主义发展出独特的美学风格。

modernist.t:
n. 现代主义者
adj. 现代派的

e.en: Hemingway is considered a major {modernist} writer.
e.zh: 海明威被视为一位重要的现代主义作家。

e.en: The chair has a clean {modernist} design from the 1950s.
e.zh: 那把椅子是 1950 年代简洁的现代主义设计。

e.en: The cafe has a {modernistic} interior with bold geometric shapes.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的内饰具有大胆几何感的现代风格。

e.en: His {modernistic} paintings divided opinion among critics.
e.zh: 他的现代风格画作在评论界引发了争议。

e.en: Tokyo blends ancient tradition with cutting-edge {modernity}.
e.zh: 东京将古老传统与前沿现代性融为一体。

e.en: The novel explores the loneliness of urban {modernity}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨城市现代生活的孤独。

e.en: The hospital's {modernization} cost over fifty million dollars.
e.zh: 这家医院的现代化改造耗资逾五千万美元。

e.en: Rapid {modernization} reshaped China's coastal cities.
e.zh: 快速的现代化重塑了中国的沿海城市。

e.en: The school underwent two major {modernizations} this decade.
e.zh: 这所学校在过去十年经历了两次大型现代化改造。

e.en: Various {modernizations} of the codebase improved performance.
e.zh: 对代码库进行的多项现代化改造提升了性能。

e.en: We need to {modernize} our website with a fresh design.
e.zh: 我们需要用全新设计来翻新我们的网站。

e.en: The bank is spending billions to {modernize} its systems.
e.zh: 那家银行正花费数十亿美元升级其系统。

e.en: The team {modernized} the legacy code over six months.
e.zh: 团队用六个月时间对老旧代码进行了现代化改造。

e.en: The {modernized} train station opened to the public yesterday.
e.zh: 现代化改造后的火车站昨天向公众开放。

e.en: The new CEO is a bold {modernizer} of corporate culture.
e.zh: 新 CEO 是一位大胆推动企业文化现代化的人。

e.en: Peter the Great was a famous {modernizer} of Russia.
e.zh: 彼得大帝是俄国著名的现代化推动者。

e.en: Each release {modernizes} another part of the operating system.
e.zh: 每次发布都会对操作系统的另一部分进行现代化改造。

e.en: The mayor's plan {modernizes} aging public infrastructure.
e.zh: 市长的计划将老化的公共设施现代化。

e.en: They are {modernizing} the old factory with smart sensors.
e.zh: 他们正用智能传感器对旧工厂进行现代化改造。

e.en: {Modernizing} legacy software takes patience and planning.
e.zh: 对老旧软件进行现代化改造需要耐心和规划。

e.en: The camera offers several shooting {modes} for different scenes.
e.zh: 这款相机提供多种拍摄模式以适应不同场景。

e.en: Switch between dark and light {modes} in the settings.
e.zh: 在设置里可以切换深色和浅色模式。

e.en: He earned a {modest} salary as a starting teacher.
e.zh: 作为新手教师,他拿着不高的工资。

e.en: She's surprisingly {modest} about her achievements.
e.zh: 她对自己的成就出乎意料地谦虚。

e.en: He {modestly} downplayed his role in the project.
e.zh: 他谦虚地淡化了自己在项目中的作用。

e.en: The startup grew {modestly} during its first year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在第一年增长平稳。

e.en: Her {modesty} about her talent surprised everyone.
e.zh: 她对自身才华的谦逊让大家都感到意外。

e.en: In some cultures, {modesty} in dress is highly valued.
e.zh: 在某些文化中,着装的端庄被高度重视。

e.en: Prime Minister {Modi} addressed the United Nations General Assembly.
e.zh: 莫迪总理在联合国大会上发表了讲话。

e.en: The textbook lists various {modi} operandi used by detectives.
e.zh: 教科书列出了侦探们使用的各种作案手法。

e.en: Show a {modicum} of respect during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时请表现出最起码的尊重。

e.en: With a {modicum} of luck, we'll finish on time.
e.zh: 只要有那么一点点运气,我们就能按时完成。

e.en: The settings are easily {modifiable} from the main menu.
e.zh: 这些设置在主菜单里可以轻松修改。

e.en: Smoking is a {modifiable} risk factor for heart disease.
e.zh: 吸烟是心脏病一个可改变的风险因素。

e.en: The car needs one small {modification} before the race.
e.zh: 这辆赛车在比赛前需要做一处小改装。

e.en: Genetic {modification} of crops remains controversial.
e.zh: 农作物的基因改造依然存在争议。

e.en: We made several {modifications} to the original design.
e.zh: 我们对原设计做了几处修改。

e.en: The contract requires {modifications} before both parties sign.
e.zh: 这份合同需要修改后双方才能签字。

modified.t:
v. 修改（过去式）
adj. 改良的

e.en: She {modified} the recipe to make it vegan.
e.zh: 她对食谱做了改动,做成了纯素版本。

e.en: Genetically {modified} corn fills most American supermarkets.
e.zh: 转基因玉米充斥着大多数美国超市。

e.en: In English grammar, an adjective is a {modifier}.
e.zh: 在英语语法中,形容词是一种修饰语。

e.en: Hold the Shift key as a {modifier} to select multiple items.
e.zh: 按住 Shift 键作为修饰键可以选中多个项目。

e.en: The adverb 'quickly' {modifies} the verb 'run'.
e.zh: 副词 quickly 修饰动词 run。

e.en: This patch {modifies} how the app handles errors.
e.zh: 这个补丁修改了应用处理错误的方式。

e.en: You can {modify} your profile picture anytime in settings.
e.zh: 你随时可以在设置里修改头像。

e.en: Engineers had to {modify} the design to cut costs.
e.zh: 工程师不得不修改设计以削减成本。

mizuno.t: n. 美津浓（日本运动品牌）

e.en: He bought a new {Mizuno} baseball glove for practice.
e.zh: 他买了一只新的美津浓棒球手套用来训练。

e.en: Many runners swear by their {Mizuno} shoes.
e.zh: 许多跑者对美津浓的跑鞋赞不绝口。

e.en: The architect listed {MKM} as her former employer.
e.zh: 这位建筑师把MKM列为她之前的雇主。

e.en: He works at the {MKM} branch downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心的MKM分公司工作。

mlle.t: n. 小姐（法语 Mademoiselle 缩写）

e.en: The letter was addressed to {Mlle} Dupont.
e.zh: 那封信是写给杜邦小姐的。

e.en: In French, {Mlle} is short for Mademoiselle.
e.zh: 在法语中,Mlle是Mademoiselle小姐的缩写。

e.en: The report cites {MMB} as the regulating authority.
e.zh: 该报告将MMB列为监管机构。

e.en: She filed the form with the local {MMB} office.
e.zh: 她在当地的MMB办公室递交了表格。

mmc.t: n. 多媒体卡（MultiMediaCard 缩写）

e.en: The phone still supports old {MMC} memory cards.
e.zh: 这款手机仍然支持旧的MMC存储卡。

e.en: He renewed his license at the {MMC} center.
e.zh: 他在MMC中心续办了执照。

mmm.t: interj. 嗯（表示思考或满足）

e.en: "{Mmm}, this soup is amazing," she said.
e.zh: 她说:“嗯,这汤太好喝了。”

e.en: "{Mmm}, let me think about it," he replied.
e.zh: 他回答说:“嗯,让我想想吧。”

mmmm.t: interj. 嗯嗯（表示享受或思考）

e.en: "{Mmmm}, fresh bread!" the child exclaimed happily.
e.zh: 小孩开心地叫道:“嗯——刚出炉的面包!”

e.en: "{Mmmm}, that's a tough question," the teacher said.
e.zh: 老师说:“嗯——这个问题挺难的。”

mnemonic.t:
n. 助记符；记忆法
adj. 帮助记忆的

e.en: ROYGBIV is a {mnemonic} for the rainbow colors.
e.zh: ROYGBIV是记忆彩虹颜色的助记词。

e.en: She invented a {mnemonic} to remember her new password.
e.zh: 她想出一个口诀来记住新密码。

e.en: Medical students rely heavily on {mnemonics} during exams.
e.zh: 医学生在考试中非常依赖各种助记法。

e.en: Good {mnemonics} can turn dull facts into vivid images.
e.zh: 好的助记法能把枯燥的知识变成生动的画面。

mnp.t: n. 携号转网（Mobile Number Portability）

e.en: Carriers must process every {MNP} request within one day.
e.zh: 运营商必须在一天内处理每个携号转网申请。

e.en: She used {MNP} to keep her old number.
e.zh: 她办了携号转网,保留了旧号码。

e.en: The bird was tagged at the local {MNR} reserve.
e.zh: 那只鸟在当地的MNR保护区被环志。

e.en: He works as a ranger for the {MNR}.
e.zh: 他在MNR担任护林员。

moa.t: n. 恐鸟（新西兰已灭绝巨鸟）

e.en: The {moa} was a giant flightless bird of New Zealand.
e.zh: 恐鸟是新西兰一种巨大的不会飞的鸟。

e.en: Scientists found {moa} bones in a deep cave.
e.zh: 科学家在一个深洞里发现了恐鸟的骨头。

moan.t:
v. 呻吟；抱怨
n. 呻吟声

e.en: He let out a soft {moan} of pain.
e.zh: 他轻轻发出一声痛苦的呻吟。

e.en: Stop {moan}ing about the weather and grab an umbrella.
e.zh: 别再抱怨天气了,拿把伞吧。

moaner.t: n. 爱抱怨的人；呻吟者

e.en: My uncle is a real {moaner} at family dinners.
e.zh: 我叔叔在家庭聚餐时总爱发牢骚。

e.en: Don't be such a {moaner} every time it rains.
e.zh: 别一下雨就那么爱抱怨好不好。

moaning.t:
n. 呻吟声
v. 抱怨；哀号

e.en: The wind was {moaning} through the empty corridor.
e.zh: 风在空荡的走廊里呜呜作响。

e.en: Stop {moaning} and finish your homework already.
e.zh: 别再抱怨了,赶紧把作业写完。

e.en: A deep {moat} surrounded the medieval castle.
e.zh: 一条深深的护城河环绕着这座中世纪城堡。

e.en: Strong brands build a competitive {moat} over time.
e.zh: 强势品牌会逐渐建立起自己的竞争护城河。

e.en: They visited a {moated} manor house in the countryside.
e.zh: 他们参观了乡间一座带护城河的庄园。

e.en: The {moated} fortress had stood for six centuries.
e.zh: 这座带护城河的要塞已屹立六百年。

mob.t:
n. 暴民；乌合之众
v. 成群围住

e.en: An angry {mob} gathered outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 一群愤怒的人聚集在法院外。

e.en: Reporters {mob}bed the actress at the airport.
e.zh: 记者们在机场把那位女演员团团围住。

e.en: The new café was {mobbed} on opening day.
e.zh: 这家新咖啡馆开业当天被挤得水泄不通。

e.en: Fans {mobbed} the singer outside the hotel.
e.zh: 歌迷在酒店外把歌手围得水泄不通。

e.en: He filled up the tank at a {Mobil} station.
e.zh: 他在一家美孚加油站把油箱加满了。

e.en: {Mobil} merged with Exxon back in 1999.
e.zh: 美孚早在1999年就与埃克森合并了。

mobile.t:
n. 手机
adj. 移动的；可移动的

e.en: Most students check their {mobile} phones every few minutes.
e.zh: 大多数学生每隔几分钟就要看一次手机。

e.en: The clinic uses a {mobile} unit to reach villages.
e.zh: 诊所用流动医疗车前往各个村庄服务。

mobiles.t: n. 手机（复数）；移动设备

e.en: Please switch your {mobiles} to silent during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会期间请把手机调成静音。

e.en: She hangs colorful {mobiles} above the baby's crib.
e.zh: 她在婴儿床上方挂了几个彩色的风铃饰物。

mobilisation.t: n. 动员；调动（英式拼写）

e.en: The {mobilisation} of volunteers happened within hours of the quake.
e.zh: 地震发生几小时内就动员起了大批志愿者。

e.en: Wartime {mobilisation} transformed the country's economy overnight.
e.zh: 战时动员一夜之间改变了这个国家的经济。

mobilise.t: v. 动员；调动（英式拼写）

e.en: The charity hopes to {mobilise} students for the cleanup.
e.zh: 慈善机构希望能动员学生参加清理活动。

e.en: Activists {mobilise}d thousands to march through the capital.
e.zh: 活动人士动员了数千人在首都游行。

mobilities.t: n. 流动性；机动性（复数）

e.en: Researchers compare social {mobilities} across different countries.
e.zh: 研究人员比较不同国家之间的社会流动性。

e.en: Cities are testing new urban {mobilities} like e-scooters.
e.zh: 各城市正在试验电动滑板车等新型城市出行方式。

e.en: The injury limited her {mobility} for several months.
e.zh: 这次受伤让她有好几个月行动不便。

e.en: Education is a major driver of social {mobility}.
e.zh: 教育是推动社会流动的重要力量。

e.en: Rapid {mobilization} of relief teams saved many lives.
e.zh: 救援队的迅速动员挽救了许多人的生命。

e.en: Grassroots {mobilization} pushed the bill through congress.
e.zh: 基层动员推动这项法案在国会获得通过。

e.en: The campaign aims to {mobilize} young voters online.
e.zh: 该竞选活动旨在通过网络动员年轻选民。

e.en: Doctors must {mobilize} patients soon after surgery.
e.zh: 医生必须在术后尽早让病人活动起来。

e.en: The army was {mobilized} along the border overnight.
e.zh: 军队一夜之间被调动到了边境一带。

e.en: Neighbors quickly {mobilized} to help the flood victims.
e.zh: 邻居们迅速行动起来帮助受洪灾的居民。

mobilizes.t: v. 动员（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her speech always {mobilizes} the crowd into action.
e.zh: 她的演讲总能鼓动人群行动起来。

e.en: The app {mobilizes} volunteers within minutes of an emergency.
e.zh: 这款应用能在紧急情况发生几分钟内召集志愿者。

e.en: They are {mobilizing} resources to rebuild the school.
e.zh: 他们正在调动资源重建那所学校。

e.en: Activists are {mobilizing} support for stricter climate laws.
e.zh: 活动人士正在为更严格的气候法律争取支持。

e.en: Angry {mobs} burned cars throughout the night.
e.zh: 愤怒的人群整夜都在焚烧车辆。

e.en: In the game, hostile {mobs} spawn at night.
e.zh: 在这个游戏里,敌对怪物会在夜里刷新出来。

e.en: The film portrays a {mobster} struggling to leave the life.
e.zh: 这部电影刻画了一个想金盆洗手的黑帮分子。

e.en: Police arrested a notorious {mobster} at the airport.
e.zh: 警方在机场逮捕了一名臭名昭著的黑帮成员。

moby.t: n. 莫比（人名，也指《白鲸》Moby Dick）

e.en: Captain Ahab obsessively hunts the white whale {Moby} Dick.
e.zh: 亚哈船长疯狂地追猎白鲸莫比·迪克。

e.en: The DJ {Moby} released his most famous album in 1999.
e.zh: DJ莫比在1999年发行了他最著名的专辑。

e.en: She slipped on a soft leather {moccasin} by the fire.
e.zh: 她在火炉旁穿上一只柔软的鹿皮鞋。

e.en: A water {moccasin} slid silently across the swamp.
e.zh: 一条食鱼蝮无声地滑过沼泽。

e.en: I'll have a large {mocha} with extra whipped cream.
e.zh: 我要一杯大杯摩卡,多加奶油。

e.en: She painted the wall a warm {mocha} brown.
e.zh: 她把墙刷成了温暖的摩卡棕色。

e.en: We tried strawberry {mochi} ice cream at the night market.
e.zh: 我们在夜市尝了草莓麻薯冰淇淋。

e.en: Fresh {mochi} is soft, chewy, and slightly sweet.
e.zh: 新鲜的麻薯柔软有嚼劲,还带点甜味。

mock.t:
v. 嘲笑；模拟
adj. 模拟的；假的

e.en: Don't {mock} her accent; everyone makes mistakes.
e.zh: 别嘲笑她的口音,谁都会犯错。

e.en: We took a {mock} exam to prepare for finals.
e.zh: 我们做了一次模拟考试来备战期末。

e.en: The trial was a complete {mockery} of justice.
e.zh: 那场审判完全是对正义的嘲弄。

e.en: He endured years of {mockery} for his unusual hobby.
e.zh: 他因为这个怪嗜好被嘲笑了许多年。

mocking.t:
adj. 嘲讽的
n. 嘲弄

e.en: She gave him a {mocking} smile and walked away.
e.zh: 她对他露出嘲讽的微笑,然后转身走开。

e.en: Stop {mocking} my pronunciation, please.
e.zh: 别再嘲笑我的发音了,拜托。

e.en: A {mockingbird} can imitate dozens of other birdsongs.
e.zh: 知更鸟能模仿数十种其他鸟类的叫声。

e.en: "To Kill a {Mockingbird}" remains a classroom favorite.
e.zh: 《杀死一只知更鸟》一直是课堂上的经典读物。

e.en: He bowed {mockingly} as she entered the room.
e.zh: 她进屋时,他嘲讽地深鞠了一躬。

e.en: "Oh, brilliant idea," she said {mockingly}.
e.zh: 她带着嘲讽说道:“哦,真是个绝妙的主意。”

mod.t: n. 模组（游戏修改）；取模运算

e.en: He installed a popular {mod} that adds new weapons.
e.zh: 他安装了一个很受欢迎的、能加入新武器的模组。

e.en: The {mod} banned three users for spamming.
e.zh: 版主因为刷屏封禁了三个用户。

modal.t:
adj. 模态的（弹窗）
n. 情态动词

e.en: Click the button to open a confirmation {modal}.
e.zh: 点击按钮打开一个确认弹窗。

e.en: "Must" and "can" are common {modal} verbs.
e.zh: “must”和“can”都是常见的情态动词。

modifying.t: v. 修改；调整（modify 的现在分词）

e.en: He's {modifying} his car to make it faster.
e.zh: 他正在改装自己的车以提升速度。

e.en: Stop {modifying} the spreadsheet while I'm reviewing it.
e.zh: 我在审阅这份电子表格时别再改它了。

modigliani.t: n. 莫迪利亚尼（意大利画家）

e.en: The {Modigliani} portrait sold for over a hundred million dollars.
e.zh: 那幅莫迪利亚尼的肖像画拍出了上亿美元。

e.en: {Modigliani} is famous for his elongated faces and necks.
e.zh: 莫迪利亚尼以画拉长的脸和脖子而闻名。

e.en: She wore a {modish} outfit to the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她穿着时髦的装束出席画廊开幕式。

e.en: The cafe attracts a {modish} young crowd every weekend.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆每个周末都吸引时髦的年轻人。

modular.t: adj. 模块化的；组件式的

e.en: The sofa has a {modular} design you can rearrange.
e.zh: 这款沙发采用模块化设计,可以自由组合。

e.en: We rewrote the code to be more {modular} and testable.
e.zh: 我们重写了代码,使其更模块化、更易测试。

modulate.t:
v. 调节；调整（音量、语气）
v. 调制（信号）

e.en: Good speakers {modulate} their voice to keep listeners engaged.
e.zh: 优秀的演讲者会调节声调以吸引听众。

e.en: The thermostat helps {modulate} the room temperature throughout the day.
e.zh: 恒温器帮助全天调节室内温度。

modulated.t: v. 调节；调制（modulate 的过去式）

e.en: She {modulated} her tone when speaking to the child.
e.zh: 她对孩子说话时放柔了语气。

e.en: The signal is {modulated} before being transmitted over the air.
e.zh: 信号在通过空中传输前会先被调制。

e.en: Voice {modulation} is essential for engaging podcast hosts.
e.zh: 声音的抑扬顿挫对播客主持人来说至关重要。

e.en: FM radio uses frequency {modulation} to transmit audio signals.
e.zh: 调频广播使用频率调制来传输音频信号。

e.en: The {modulator} converts the digital input into a radio signal.
e.zh: 调制器将数字输入转换为无线电信号。

e.en: Caffeine acts as a {modulator} of brain activity in many people.
e.zh: 咖啡因对许多人的大脑活动起调节作用。

module.t:
n. 模块；单元
n. (课程) 单元

e.en: I just finished the first {module} of the online course.
e.zh: 我刚完成了网课的第一个模块。

e.en: Each {module} can be tested independently before integration.
e.zh: 每个模块都可以在集成前独立测试。

e.en: In math, the {modulus} operator returns the remainder of a division.
e.zh: 在数学中,取模运算符返回除法的余数。

e.en: Steel has a much higher Young's {modulus} than rubber.
e.zh: 钢的杨氏模量远高于橡胶。

modus.t: n. 方式（拉丁语，常见于 modus operandi）

e.en: Working late at night is his usual {modus} operandi.
e.zh: 深夜工作是他一贯的做事方式。

e.en: The detective recognized the burglar's familiar {modus} operandi.
e.zh: 侦探认出了那个窃贼熟悉的作案手法。

moet.t: n. 酩悦（香槟品牌 Moët）

e.en: They opened a bottle of {Moet} to celebrate the engagement.
e.zh: 他们开了一瓶酩悦香槟庆祝订婚。

e.en: {Moet} champagne is often served at upscale weddings.
e.zh: 高档婚礼上常会供应酩悦香槟。

mogadishu.t: n. 摩加迪沙（索马里首都）

e.en: {Mogadishu} is the capital and largest city of Somalia.
e.zh: 摩加迪沙是索马里的首都和最大城市。

e.en: The journalist filed reports from {Mogadishu} for several years.
e.zh: 那位记者在摩加迪沙发回报道多年。

mogadon.t: n. 硝基安定（安眠药品牌）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {Mogadon} to help with her insomnia.
e.zh: 医生开了硝西泮帮助她治疗失眠。

e.en: {Mogadon} is a brand name for the sleeping pill nitrazepam.
e.zh: Mogadon是安眠药硝西泮的商品名。

e.en: Our old {moggie} loves sleeping in the sunny window.
e.zh: 我们家那只老猫最爱在阳光窗台上睡觉。

e.en: She adopted a stray {moggie} from the local shelter.
e.zh: 她从当地收容所领养了一只流浪猫。

mogul.t:
n. 大亨；巨头
n. 滑雪场雪包

e.en: The media {mogul} owns several major newspapers and TV stations.
e.zh: 这位传媒大亨拥有多家大型报社和电视台。

e.en: He became a tech {mogul} after his startup went public.
e.zh: 他的创业公司上市后,他成了科技大亨。

moguls.t: n. 大亨们；雪包（mogul 复数）

e.en: Hollywood {moguls} gathered to discuss the future of streaming.
e.zh: 好莱坞大亨们聚在一起讨论流媒体的未来。

e.en: The skier carved smoothly through the {moguls} on the slope.
e.zh: 那位滑雪者在雪坡的雪包间灵巧地穿梭。

mohair.t: n. 马海毛（安哥拉山羊毛）

e.en: She wrapped herself in a soft {mohair} sweater for warmth.
e.zh: 她裹上一件柔软的马海毛毛衣御寒。

e.en: The blanket is woven from pure {mohair} wool.
e.zh: 这条毯子是用纯马海毛织成的。

mohammedan.t: n. 穆斯林（旧称，现多用 Muslim）

e.en: The term {Mohammedan} is now considered outdated and offensive.
e.zh: “穆罕默德教徒”这个词如今被认为过时且具冒犯性。

e.en: Older books sometimes refer to Muslims as {Mohammedan} followers.
e.zh: 旧书籍有时把穆斯林称作穆罕默德教徒。

mohawk.t:
n. 莫霍克（印第安部族）
n. 莫霍克发型

e.en: He shaved the sides of his head and styled a {mohawk}.
e.zh: 他把头两侧剃掉,留了个莫霍克发型。

e.en: The punk rocker dyed his {mohawk} bright pink for the show.
e.zh: 那位朋克摇滚歌手为演出把莫霍克头染成亮粉色。

mohican.t:
n. 莫西干人
n. 莫西干发型

e.en: He sported a bright green {mohican} at the music festival.
e.zh: 他在音乐节上顶着一头亮绿色的莫西干头。

e.en: The Last of the {Mohican} is a famous historical novel.
e.zh: 《最后一个莫西干人》是一部著名的历史小说。

moi.t: pron. 我（法语，口语玩笑用）

e.en: Who ate the last cookie? {Moi}, I confess.
e.zh: 谁吃了最后一块饼干?是我,我承认。

e.en: She raised an eyebrow and said, "{Moi}? Never!"
e.zh: 她挑了挑眉说:“我吗?才不会!”

moiety.t:
n. 一半；部分
n. (化学) 基团

e.en: He inherited a {moiety} of his uncle's estate.
e.zh: 他继承了叔叔遗产的一半。

e.en: The chemist identified the active {moiety} in the new drug.
e.zh: 化学家在这款新药中确定了活性基团。

moire.t:
n. 云纹；摩尔纹
n. 波纹绸

e.en: The camera screen shows a {moire} pattern when filming a TV.
e.zh: 拍摄电视画面时,相机屏幕会出现摩尔纹。

e.en: Her wedding dress was made of shimmering {moire} silk.
e.zh: 她的婚纱由闪亮的波纹绸制成。

e.en: This chocolate cake is incredibly {moist} and rich.
e.zh: 这款巧克力蛋糕非常湿润浓郁。

e.en: Keep the soil {moist} but not waterlogged for best growth.
e.zh: 保持土壤湿润但不要积水,植物长得最好。

e.en: {Moisten} the edges of the dough before sealing the dumpling.
e.zh: 封口前先把面皮边缘沾湿。

e.en: A few drops of water will {moisten} the dry sponge.
e.zh: 几滴水就能把干海绵润湿。

moistened.t: v. 沾湿（moisten 的过去式）

e.en: She {moistened} her lips before starting to speak.
e.zh: 她在开口讲话前舔湿了嘴唇。

e.en: He {moistened} the cloth and gently wiped the wound.
e.zh: 他把布弄湿,轻轻擦拭伤口。

e.en: Her eyes shone {moistly} as she watched her son graduate.
e.zh: 看着儿子毕业,她的眼睛湿润地闪着光。

e.en: The cave walls glistened {moistly} in the lamplight.
e.zh: 洞壁在灯光下湿漉漉地闪着光。

e.en: The {moistness} of the cake makes it irresistible.
e.zh: 这款蛋糕的湿润口感让人欲罢不能。

e.en: You can feel the {moistness} of the air after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后能感受到空气中的潮湿。

e.en: This cream locks in {moisture} for up to 24 hours.
e.zh: 这款面霜可锁住水分长达24小时。

e.en: Too much {moisture} in the basement can cause mold.
e.zh: 地下室湿气过重会导致发霉。

moistures.t: n. 水分（moisture 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The lab measured the various {moistures} found in different soils.
e.zh: 实验室测量了不同土壤中的各种水分含量。

e.en: Different fabric {moistures} were tested for breathability.
e.zh: 不同织物的含水量被用于测试透气性。

moisturise.t: v. 保湿；滋润（英式拼写）

e.en: Remember to {moisturise} your skin every morning after washing.
e.zh: 记得每天早上洗脸后给皮肤补水。

e.en: This lotion will {moisturise} dry hands within minutes.
e.zh: 这款乳液能在几分钟内滋润干燥的双手。

e.en: She applied a light {moisturiser} before putting on makeup.
e.zh: 她化妆前涂了一层清爽的保湿霜。

e.en: A good {moisturiser} can make a huge difference for dry skin.
e.zh: 一款好的保湿霜对干性皮肤效果显著。

moisturising.t: adj. 保湿的；滋润的（英式）

e.en: The {moisturising} mask leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth.
e.zh: 这款保湿面膜让我的皮肤变得柔软光滑。

e.en: He uses a {moisturising} shampoo for his dry hair.
e.zh: 他用保湿洗发水来护理干燥的头发。

e.en: Dermatologists recommend you {moisturize} twice daily for best results.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生建议每天保湿两次,效果最佳。

e.en: This serum will {moisturize} and brighten your complexion.
e.zh: 这款精华可以保湿并提亮肤色。

e.en: I never leave the house without sunscreen and {moisturizer}.
e.zh: 我出门一定要涂防晒霜和保湿霜。

e.en: This {moisturizer} works well even on sensitive skin.
e.zh: 这款保湿霜即使是敏感肌肤也很适用。

e.en: Try this {moisturizing} cream for your dry winter skin.
e.zh: 试试这款保湿霜,改善冬季干燥肌肤。

e.en: The new shampoo has extra {moisturizing} ingredients for damaged hair.
e.zh: 这款新洗发水含有额外保湿成分,适合受损发质。

mojave.t: n. 莫哈维沙漠（美国加州）

e.en: The {Mojave} desert can reach scorching temperatures during summer.
e.zh: 莫哈韦沙漠夏季气温可高得灼人。

e.en: They drove across the {Mojave} on their way to Las Vegas.
e.zh: 他们开车穿越莫哈韦沙漠去拉斯维加斯。

e.en: After the long break, the team finally got their {mojo} back.
e.zh: 经过长时间休整,球队终于找回了状态。

e.en: He lost his creative {mojo} after the project failed.
e.zh: 项目失败后,他失去了创作的灵感。

mol.t: n. 摩尔（物质的量单位）

e.en: One {mol} of water weighs about 18 grams.
e.zh: 一摩尔水大约重18克。

e.en: The reaction requires exactly two {mol} of hydrogen gas.
e.zh: 该反应需要恰好两摩尔氢气。

molar.t:
n. 臼齿
adj. 摩尔的

e.en: The dentist had to extract my back {molar} yesterday.
e.zh: 牙医昨天不得不拔掉我的后磨牙。

e.en: Calculate the {molar} mass of sodium chloride for this experiment.
e.zh: 为这个实验计算氯化钠的摩尔质量。

e.en: The cookies get their dark color from {molasses} in the recipe.
e.zh: 配方中的糖蜜让饼干呈现深色。

e.en: Traffic was moving as slow as {molasses} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上的交通慢得像糖蜜一样。

mold.t:
n. 模具；霉菌
v. 塑造

e.en: There's some green {mold} growing on the bread.
e.zh: 面包上长了一些绿色霉菌。

e.en: Pour the melted chocolate into the heart-shaped {mold}.
e.zh: 把融化的巧克力倒入心形模具中。

e.en: Clay is highly {moldable} when slightly damp.
e.zh: 黏土在微湿时具有很强的可塑性。

e.en: Children's brains are remarkably {moldable} during early years.
e.zh: 儿童的大脑在幼年时期具有极强的可塑性。

moldavia.t: n. 摩尔达维亚（旧地名）

e.en: Historical {Moldavia} once stretched across parts of modern Romania.
e.zh: 历史上的摩尔达维亚曾横跨今天罗马尼亚的部分地区。

e.en: The principality of {Moldavia} existed from the 14th century onward.
e.zh: 摩尔达维亚公国自14世纪起便已存在。

moldavian.t:
adj. 摩尔达维亚的
n. 摩尔达维亚人

e.en: She studied {Moldavian} folk songs as part of her thesis.
e.zh: 她在论文中研究了摩尔达维亚民间歌曲。

e.en: The museum displayed traditional {Moldavian} costumes from the 1800s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了19世纪的传统摩尔达维亚服装。

e.en: The artist {molded} the clay into a graceful figure.
e.zh: 艺术家把黏土塑造成一个优雅的人像。

e.en: His childhood experiences {molded} him into a compassionate adult.
e.zh: 童年经历将他塑造成一个富有同情心的大人。

molder.t:
v. 腐朽；崩解
n. 造型工

e.en: Old letters {molder} in the attic if no one reads them.
e.zh: 如果没人翻阅,旧信件会在阁楼里发霉腐烂。

e.en: The factory hired a skilled {molder} to make the new parts.
e.zh: 工厂聘请了一位熟练的造型工来制作新零件。

e.en: The {moldering} ruins stood silent at the edge of the forest.
e.zh: 那片腐朽的废墟静静矗立在森林边缘。

e.en: Stacks of {moldering} books filled the abandoned library.
e.zh: 一摞摞发霉腐烂的书堆满了那座废弃的图书馆。

molding.t: n. 造型；模制；装饰线条

e.en: The carpenter installed white {molding} along the ceiling edge.
e.zh: 木匠沿天花板边缘装上了白色装饰线条。

e.en: Teachers play a key role in {molding} young minds.
e.zh: 老师在塑造年轻人的思想方面起着关键作用。

e.en: {Moldova} is a small landlocked country in Eastern Europe.
e.zh: 摩尔多瓦是东欧的一个小型内陆国家。

e.en: Wine production is a major industry in {Moldova}.
e.zh: 葡萄酒生产是摩尔多瓦的主要产业之一。

moldovan.t:
adj. 摩尔多瓦的
n. 摩尔多瓦人

e.en: She spoke fluent {Moldovan} after living there for years.
e.zh: 她在那里住了多年,能说一口流利的摩尔多瓦语。

e.en: The {Moldovan} delegation arrived for the trade conference.
e.zh: 摩尔多瓦代表团抵达参加贸易会议。

e.en: She uses silicone {molds} to make homemade chocolates.
e.zh: 她用硅胶模具制作自制巧克力。

e.en: Some {molds} can produce toxins that are harmful to humans.
e.zh: 有些霉菌会产生对人体有害的毒素。

e.en: Throw away that {moldy} cheese in the back of the fridge.
e.zh: 把冰箱深处那块发霉的奶酪扔掉吧。

e.en: The basement smelled {moldy} after weeks of heavy rain.
e.zh: 连续几周大雨后,地下室散发出霉味。

e.en: She has a small {mole} on her left cheek.
e.zh: 她左脸颊上有一颗小痣。

e.en: The {mole} dug tunnels all across the backyard.
e.zh: 那只鼹鼠在后院到处挖洞。

e.en: Scientists study the {molecular} structure of new drugs.
e.zh: 科学家研究新药的分子结构。

e.en: Water has a simple {molecular} formula.
e.zh: 水的分子式很简单。

e.en: Every water {molecule} contains two hydrogen atoms.
e.zh: 每个水分子都含有两个氢原子。

e.en: A single {molecule} can be imaged with electron microscopes.
e.zh: 用电子显微镜可以观察单个分子。

e.en: Sugar {molecules} dissolve quickly in hot tea.
e.zh: 糖分子在热茶中很快溶解。

e.en: Oxygen {molecules} are essential for breathing.
e.zh: 氧分子是呼吸所必需的。

molehill.t: n. 鼹鼠丘；小题大做之事

e.en: Don't make a mountain out of a {molehill}.
e.zh: 别小题大做。

e.en: The lawn was dotted with tiny {molehill} mounds.
e.zh: 草坪上点缀着一个个小鼹鼠丘。

moleskin.t: n. 鼹鼠皮；仿鼹鼠皮棉布

e.en: He wore soft {moleskin} trousers to the countryside.
e.zh: 他穿着柔软的鼹鼠皮裤去乡下。

e.en: Hikers cover blisters with {moleskin} patches.
e.zh: 徒步者用鼹鼠皮贴片来覆盖水泡。

e.en: The law strictly punishes anyone who would {molest} a child.
e.zh: 法律严厉惩罚任何猥亵儿童的人。

e.en: Wild animals rarely {molest} hikers who keep their distance.
e.zh: 野生动物很少袭扰保持距离的徒步者。

e.en: The charity supports survivors of childhood {molestation}.
e.zh: 该慈善机构帮助童年遭受性侵的幸存者。

e.en: He was convicted of {molestation} and sentenced to prison.
e.zh: 他被判猥亵罪并入狱服刑。

e.en: She bravely reported the coach who {molested} her.
e.zh: 她勇敢地举报了猥亵她的教练。

e.en: The sleeping cat refused to be {molested} by the toddler.
e.zh: 睡着的猫不愿被那个小孩打扰。

e.en: Police arrested the child {molester} after a long investigation.
e.zh: 警方经过长期调查逮捕了那名猥亵儿童者。

e.en: Neighbors were shocked to learn a {molester} lived nearby.
e.zh: 邻居们震惊地得知附近住着一名性侵者。

e.en: In old gangster films, the {moll} always wore furs.
e.zh: 在老式黑帮片里,黑帮女友总是穿着皮草。

e.en: The detective interviewed the gangster's {moll} for clues.
e.zh: 侦探询问了那名黑帮分子的女友以寻找线索。

e.en: He brought flowers to {mollify} his angry partner.
e.zh: 他买花来安抚生气的伴侣。

e.en: The CEO's apology did little to {mollify} the protesters.
e.zh: 首席执行官的道歉几乎没能安抚抗议者。

e.en: An octopus is a remarkably intelligent {mollusc}.
e.zh: 章鱼是一种非常聪明的软体动物。

e.en: This {mollusc} produces beautiful pearls inside its shell.
e.zh: 这种软体动物在壳内会产出美丽的珍珠。

e.en: The museum has an impressive {molluscan} fossil collection.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了大量令人印象深刻的软体动物化石。

e.en: Researchers study {molluscan} nervous systems to learn about memory.
e.zh: 研究人员通过研究软体动物神经系统来了解记忆。

e.en: A clam is a common edible {mollusk}.
e.zh: 蛤蜊是一种常见的可食用软体动物。

e.en: This {mollusk} can change color to match its surroundings.
e.zh: 这种软体动物能变色以融入周围环境。

e.en: My friend named her goldfish {Molly}.
e.zh: 我朋友给她的金鱼取名叫莫莉。

e.en: A bright orange {molly} swam around the aquarium.
e.zh: 一条鲜橙色的茉莉鱼在鱼缸里游来游去。

e.en: Don't {mollycoddle} the kids—let them solve their own problems.
e.zh: 别太宠孩子,让他们自己解决问题。

e.en: His parents tend to {mollycoddle} him whenever he's sick.
e.zh: 他一生病,父母就过分溺爱他。

molotov.t: n. 莫洛托夫（苏联政治家）

e.en: Protesters threw a {Molotov} cocktail at the armored vehicle.
e.zh: 抗议者向装甲车投掷了一枚燃烧瓶。

e.en: Possessing a {Molotov} cocktail is a serious crime.
e.zh: 持有燃烧瓶是严重的犯罪行为。

molt.t:
v. 蜕皮；换毛
n. 蜕皮期

e.en: Snakes regularly {molt} to grow larger.
e.zh: 蛇会定期蜕皮以便长大。

e.en: My parrot starts to {molt} every spring.
e.zh: 我的鹦鹉每年春天开始换羽。

e.en: The volcano spewed rivers of {molten} lava.
e.zh: 火山喷出了一道道熔岩流。

e.en: The chef poured {molten} chocolate over the cake.
e.zh: 厨师把融化的巧克力浇在蛋糕上。

e.en: The crab is {molting} and very vulnerable right now.
e.zh: 这只螃蟹正在蜕壳,现在非常脆弱。

e.en: My dog keeps {molting} all over the sofa in summer.
e.zh: 夏天我的狗在沙发上到处掉毛。

e.en: The {Molucca} Islands were once famous for spices.
e.zh: 摩鹿加群岛曾以盛产香料而闻名。

e.en: Traders sailed to {Molucca} for cloves and nutmeg.
e.zh: 商人们航行到摩鹿加去购买丁香和肉豆蔻。

e.en: Steel containing {molybdenum} resists high temperatures very well.
e.zh: 含钼的钢材具有出色的耐高温性能。

e.en: Trace amounts of {molybdenum} are essential for plant growth.
e.zh: 微量的钼对植物生长至关重要。

e.en: My {mom} sends me dumplings every weekend.
e.zh: 我妈妈每周末都给我寄饺子。

e.en: Being a working {mom} requires juggling many roles.
e.zh: 做一个职场妈妈需要兼顾多种角色。

moma.t: n. 纽约现代艺术博物馆（缩写）

e.en: We saw a Picasso exhibit at {MoMA} yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在现代艺术博物馆看了一场毕加索展。

e.en: {MoMA} is one of New York's most visited museums.
e.zh: 现代艺术博物馆是纽约参观人数最多的博物馆之一。

mombasa.t: n. 蒙巴萨（肯尼亚城市）

e.en: {Mombasa} is Kenya's largest port city on the coast.
e.zh: 蒙巴萨是肯尼亚海岸最大的港口城市。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Mombasa} for its white sandy beaches.
e.zh: 游客们涌向蒙巴萨欣赏那里的白沙滩。

e.en: Give me a {moment} to find my keys.
e.zh: 等我一下,我找一下钥匙。

e.en: That goal was the defining {moment} of the match.
e.zh: 那个进球是这场比赛的决定性时刻。

momentarily.t:
adv. 短暂地，片刻地
adv. 立刻（美式）

e.en: The page will load {momentarily}—please wait.
e.zh: 页面马上就会加载,请稍候。

e.en: She paused {momentarily} before answering the question.
e.zh: 她在回答问题前稍稍停顿了一下。

e.en: There was a {momentary} silence after the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布之后出现了短暂的沉默。

e.en: She felt a {momentary} doubt before signing the contract.
e.zh: 在签合同前她产生了一瞬间的犹豫。

momentous.t: adj. 重大的，意义深远的

e.en: Graduation day was a {momentous} occasion for the family.
e.zh: 毕业典礼对这家人来说是个重大的日子。

e.en: The treaty marked a {momentous} turning point in history.
e.zh: 该条约标志着历史上一个重要的转折点。

moments.t: n. 时刻，瞬间（moment 复数）

e.en: Some {moments} in life are worth remembering forever.
e.zh: 人生中有些时刻值得永远铭记。

e.en: Just {moments} before kickoff, the rain finally stopped.
e.zh: 开球前几分钟,雨终于停了。

momentum.t:
n. 势头，动力
n. 动量（物理）

e.en: The campaign is gaining {momentum} on social media.
e.zh: 该活动在社交媒体上势头越来越猛。

e.en: The truck rolled downhill, building dangerous {momentum}.
e.zh: 卡车顺坡滑下,积累了危险的动能。

e.en: Physics problems often involve calculating different {momentums} of objects.
e.zh: 物理题经常需要计算物体的不同动量。

e.en: The two startups had very different growth {momentums}.
e.zh: 这两家初创公司的增长势头截然不同。

e.en: The little girl ran crying to her {momma}.
e.zh: 小女孩哭着跑向她妈妈。

e.en: {Momma} always made the best apple pie.
e.zh: 妈妈总是做最好吃的苹果派。

e.en: The toddler whispered, "I love you, {mommie}."
e.zh: 小孩轻声说:"我爱你,妈咪。"

e.en: She still calls her mother "{mommie}" as an adult.
e.zh: 她长大成人后仍叫母亲"妈咪"。

e.en: The new {mommies} group meets every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 新妈妈互助小组每周二上午聚会。

e.en: All the {mommies} watched their kids at the playground.
e.zh: 所有妈妈都在游乐场看着自己的孩子。

e.en: "{Mommy}, can I have a snack?" asked the boy.
e.zh: "妈咪,我能吃零食吗?"小男孩问道。

e.en: She became a {mommy} blogger after her twins were born.
e.zh: 她在生下双胞胎后成为了一名妈妈博主。

e.en: Working {moms} often juggle careers and childcare.
e.zh: 职场妈妈常常要兼顾事业与育儿。

e.en: All the {moms} brought homemade snacks to the picnic.
e.zh: 所有妈妈都带了自制零食来野餐。

e.en: "No worries, {mon}," the Jamaican guide said warmly.
e.zh: "别担心,老兄,"那位牙买加导游热情地说。

e.en: The schedule shows class on {Mon} at nine.
e.zh: 课表显示周一上午九点上课。

e.en: {Monaco} hosts one of Formula 1's most famous races.
e.zh: 摩纳哥举办着一级方程式赛车最著名的比赛之一。

e.en: Yachts crowd the harbor of {Monaco} every summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天游艇都挤满了摩纳哥的港口。

e.en: In Haskell, the {monad} is a fundamental design pattern.
e.zh: 在 Haskell 中,单子是一种基本的设计模式。

e.en: Leibniz believed each {monad} reflects the entire universe.
e.zh: 莱布尼茨相信每个单子都映照着整个宇宙。

e.en: The {monarch} addressed the nation on television.
e.zh: 君主通过电视向全国发表讲话。

e.en: A bright orange {monarch} butterfly landed on the flower.
e.zh: 一只鲜橙色的帝王蝶停在花朵上。

e.en: The country still preserves many {monarchic} traditions today.
e.zh: 这个国家至今仍保留着许多君主制传统。

e.en: Critics argued the constitution was too {monarchic} in tone.
e.zh: 批评人士认为宪法的基调过于君主制色彩。

e.en: Britain has a {monarchical} system with a ceremonial queen.
e.zh: 英国实行君主制,有一位象征性的女王。

e.en: The reform abolished centuries of {monarchical} rule.
e.zh: 这场改革废除了延续数百年的君主统治。

e.en: He's a staunch {monarchist} who defends the royal family.
e.zh: 他是一位坚定的君主主义者,维护王室。

e.en: The {monarchist} party lost most seats in parliament.
e.zh: 保皇党在议会中失去了大部分席位。

e.en: The United Kingdom is a constitutional {monarchy}.
e.zh: 英国是一个君主立宪制国家。

e.en: The revolution overthrew the centuries-old {monarchy}.
e.zh: 革命推翻了延续数百年的君主制。

e.en: Tibetan {monasteries} are perched high in the mountains.
e.zh: 西藏的寺院坐落在高山之上。

e.en: Medieval {monasteries} preserved many ancient manuscripts.
e.zh: 中世纪的修道院保存了许多古代手稿。

e.en: He spent a year living in a Buddhist {monastery}.
e.zh: 他在一座佛教寺院里住了一年。

e.en: The old {monastery} now serves as a museum.
e.zh: 这座古老的修道院如今被用作博物馆。

e.en: He prefers a {monastic} lifestyle without distractions.
e.zh: 他喜欢清心寡欲、远离干扰的修道式生活。

e.en: The book describes daily {monastic} routines in detail.
e.zh: 这本书详细描述了修道院的日常作息。

monasticism.t: n. 修道制度，禁欲生活

e.en: Christian {monasticism} began in the deserts of Egypt.
e.zh: 基督教修道主义起源于埃及的沙漠。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on medieval {monasticism}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于中世纪修道主义的论文。

e.en: The team meeting happens every {Monday} at nine.
e.zh: 团队会议每周一上午九点举行。

e.en: I'll send the report by next {Monday} morning.
e.zh: 我下周一早上之前会把报告发出去。

mondays.t:
n. 每逢周一
adv. 在周一

e.en: I always feel sluggish on {Mondays}.
e.zh: 我每个星期一都觉得没精神。

e.en: The café is closed on {Mondays} for cleaning.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆每周一闭店打扫。

e.en: She moved easily through the Parisian beau {monde}.
e.zh: 她在巴黎上流社会中游刃有余。

e.en: The novel satirizes the idle beau {monde} of the era.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了那个时代游手好闲的上流社会。

e.en: He drives an old Ford {Mondeo} to work.
e.zh: 他开着一辆旧福特蒙迪欧去上班。

e.en: The {Mondeo} was discontinued in several markets recently.
e.zh: 蒙迪欧近期已在若干市场停产。

mondrian.t: n. 蒙德里安（荷兰画家）

e.en: The dress had a bold {Mondrian}-style grid pattern.
e.zh: 这条裙子有醒目的蒙德里安风格方格图案。

e.en: A {Mondrian} painting hung in the museum's main hall.
e.zh: 博物馆主厅里挂着一幅蒙德里安的画作。

e.en: The exhibition features several water lily paintings by {Monet}.
e.zh: 这次展览展出了莫奈的几幅睡莲作品。

e.en: She bought a print of a {Monet} for her bedroom.
e.zh: 她买了一幅莫奈作品的复制画挂在卧室。

e.en: The project was {monetarily} successful but creatively disappointing.
e.zh: 这个项目在金钱上很成功,但在创意上令人失望。

e.en: Volunteers aren't compensated {monetarily} for their time.
e.zh: 志愿者付出的时间不会得到金钱补偿。

monetarism.t: n. 货币主义（经济学派）

e.en: {Monetarism} dominated economic policy in the 1980s.
e.zh: 货币主义在二十世纪八十年代主导了经济政策。

e.en: Critics argue {monetarism} ignores fiscal realities.
e.zh: 批评者认为货币主义忽视了财政现实。

monetarist.t:
n. 货币主义者
adj. 货币主义的

e.en: He's a strict {monetarist} who distrusts government spending.
e.zh: 他是个严格的货币主义者,不信任政府开支。

e.en: The {monetarist} approach focuses on controlling money supply.
e.zh: 货币主义方法侧重于控制货币供应量。

e.en: The central bank tightened {monetary} policy last week.
e.zh: 央行上周收紧了货币政策。

e.en: There's no {monetary} reward for finishing first.
e.zh: 率先完成并没有金钱奖励。

e.en: The app's {monetization} relies on in-game purchases.
e.zh: 这款应用的变现主要靠游戏内购。

e.en: YouTube's {monetization} rules changed again this year.
e.zh: YouTube的变现规则今年又有了变化。

e.en: They struggled to {monetize} their popular podcast.
e.zh: 他们一直难以将自己火爆的播客变现。

e.en: Many creators {monetize} content through paid subscriptions.
e.zh: 许多创作者通过付费订阅来实现内容变现。

e.en: I don't have enough {money} to pay rent.
e.zh: 我没有足够的钱付房租。

e.en: He saves most of the {money} he earns.
e.zh: 他把挣来的钱大部分都存起来了。

e.en: The robber dropped his {moneybag} while fleeing.
e.zh: 劫匪逃跑时把钱袋掉在了地上。

e.en: A leather {moneybag} sat on the merchant's counter.
e.zh: 商人柜台上放着一个皮制钱袋。

e.en: Hey {moneybags}, you're paying for dinner tonight!
e.zh: 喂,大富翁,今晚晚餐你请客!

e.en: Some {moneybags} bought the entire apartment building.
e.zh: 某个有钱人把整栋公寓楼都买下来了。

e.en: The neighborhood attracts {moneyed} families from abroad.
e.zh: 这个街区吸引了来自国外的富裕家庭。

e.en: She married into a {moneyed} old family.
e.zh: 她嫁入了一个富有的世家。

e.en: Each medieval coin was stamped with the {moneyer}'s name.
e.zh: 每枚中世纪硬币上都印有铸币官的名字。

e.en: The royal {moneyer} controlled the kingdom's coin production.
e.zh: 王室铸币官掌管着王国的铸币生产。

e.en: Desperate farmers borrowed from the village {moneylender}.
e.zh: 走投无路的农民向村里的放贷人借钱。

e.en: The {moneylender} charged outrageous interest rates.
e.zh: 那个放贷人收取高得离谱的利息。

e.en: Subscriptions turned out to be the company's biggest {moneymaker}.
e.zh: 订阅业务成了公司最赚钱的部分。

e.en: This little app is a real {moneymaker}.
e.zh: 这款小应用真是个赚钱利器。

e.en: Every startup needs a sharp {moneyman} on the team.
e.zh: 每家初创公司都需要一位精明的财务主管。

e.en: The campaign's {moneyman} arranged most of the donations.
e.zh: 竞选活动的金主安排了大部分捐款。

e.en: Don't trust him; he's a known rumor {monger}.
e.zh: 别相信他,他是个有名的造谣者。

e.en: The fish {monger} sold fresh salmon by the pound.
e.zh: 那位鱼贩按磅出售新鲜三文鱼。

mongol.t:
n. 蒙古人
adj. 蒙古的

e.en: The {Mongol} empire stretched across most of Asia.
e.zh: 蒙古帝国曾横跨亚洲大部分地区。

e.en: Genghis Khan led the {Mongol} armies to victory.
e.zh: 成吉思汗带领蒙古大军取得胜利。

e.en: They traveled through {Mongolia} on horseback last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天骑马穿越了蒙古。

e.en: Winters in {Mongolia} can be brutally cold.
e.zh: 蒙古的冬天会冷得令人难以忍受。

mongolian.t:
adj. 蒙古的
n. 蒙古人/蒙古语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Mongolian} and Mandarin.
e.zh: 她能说一口流利的蒙古语和普通话。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Mongolian} hot pot.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的蒙古火锅。

mongoloid.t:
n. 蒙古人种（旧称，现多避用）
adj. 蒙古人种的

e.en: The term {mongoloid} is now considered offensive and outdated.
e.zh: "蒙古人种"一词如今被视为冒犯且过时。

e.en: Old anthropology textbooks used the label {mongoloid}.
e.zh: 旧的人类学教科书曾使用"蒙古人种"这一标签。

mongoose.t: n. 猫鼬（一种小型食肉动物）

e.en: A {mongoose} can fight and kill venomous snakes.
e.zh: 猫鼬能与毒蛇搏斗并将其咬死。

e.en: We spotted a {mongoose} darting through the bushes.
e.zh: 我们看见一只猫鼬从灌木丛中窜过。

mongrel.t:
n. 杂种狗；混血儿
adj. 杂交的

e.en: Our {mongrel} is friendlier than any purebred I've met.
e.zh: 我家这只串串比我见过的任何纯种狗都友好。

e.en: The shelter was full of lovable {mongrel} puppies.
e.zh: 收容所里满是惹人喜爱的杂种小狗。

e.en: The club caters to a {monied} international clientele.
e.zh: 这家俱乐部专门接待富裕的国际客户。

e.en: He came from a {monied} but emotionally distant family.
e.zh: 他出身于一个富有但感情疏离的家庭。

e.en: His online {moniker} is "NightOwl".
e.zh: 他的网名叫"夜猫子"。

e.en: The pitcher earned the {moniker} "The Wizard" early on.
e.zh: 这位投手很早就赢得了"魔法师"的绰号。

e.en: Spinoza's philosophy is often associated with {monism}.
e.zh: 斯宾诺莎的哲学常被归为一元论。

e.en: {Monism} holds that reality is fundamentally one substance.
e.zh: 一元论认为现实从根本上是同一种实体。

e.en: The professor outlined a {monistic} view of consciousness.
e.zh: 教授阐述了一种一元论的意识观。

e.en: Hindu Vedanta offers a famously {monistic} worldview.
e.zh: 印度教吠檀多哲学提供了著名的一元论世界观。

monitor.t:
n. 显示器；监视器
v. 监控；监测

e.en: Doctors {monitor} the patient's heart rate overnight.
e.zh: 医生整夜监测病人的心率。

e.en: I bought a second {monitor} for my desk.
e.zh: 我给桌子又添了一台显示器。

monitored.t: v. 监控（monitor 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: All chat messages are {monitored} for safety.
e.zh: 所有聊天消息都会出于安全考虑被监控。

e.en: Nurses {monitored} her condition closely after surgery.
e.zh: 术后护士密切监测了她的状况。

monitoring.t:
n. 监控；监测
v. 监控中

e.en: The team is {monitoring} server load in real time.
e.zh: 团队正在实时监控服务器负载。

e.en: Continuous {monitoring} caught the bug before launch.
e.zh: 持续监控在上线前就发现了这个漏洞。

monitors.t:
n. 显示器（复数）
v. 监控（第三人称单数）

e.en: My setup uses three curved {monitors} for coding.
e.zh: 我的工位用三块曲面显示器来写代码。

e.en: The system {monitors} every transaction for fraud.
e.zh: 该系统会对每笔交易进行欺诈监控。

e.en: The {monk} rose at dawn to begin meditation.
e.zh: 那位僧人黎明时起身开始冥想。

e.en: He lived like a {monk} during exam season.
e.zh: 考试季他过得像个苦行僧一样。

monkey.t:
n. 猴子
v. 胡闹；瞎弄

e.en: A curious {monkey} stole my sunglasses at the temple.
e.zh: 在寺庙里,一只好奇的猴子偷走了我的墨镜。

e.en: Stop {monkey}-ing around and finish your homework.
e.zh: 别再瞎胡闹了,赶快把作业做完。

e.en: The {monkeys} swung through the jungle canopy.
e.zh: 猴子们在丛林树冠间荡来荡去。

e.en: Tourists were warned not to feed the {monkeys}.
e.zh: 游客被警告不要喂食猴子。

e.en: The chef grilled {monkfish} with lemon and garlic.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和大蒜烤了鮟鱇鱼。

e.en: {Monkfish} has a firm texture similar to lobster.
e.zh: 鮟鱇鱼肉质紧实,口感类似龙虾。

e.en: He led a quiet, almost {monkish} life of study.
e.zh: 他过着安静的、近乎僧侣般的治学生活。

e.en: Her {monkish} dedication to writing impressed everyone.
e.zh: 她对写作苦行僧般的投入让所有人折服。

e.en: The {monks} chant prayers three times each day.
e.zh: 僧侣们每天诵经三次。

e.en: Tibetan {monks} created intricate sand mandalas.
e.zh: 藏传僧侣绘制了精美的沙画曼陀罗。

e.en: We stopped in {Monmouth} on our drive through Wales.
e.zh: 我们驾车穿越威尔士时在蒙茅斯停了一下。

e.en: The Battle of {Monmouth} was fought in 1778.
e.zh: 蒙茅斯战役发生在1778年。

monmouthshire.t: n. 蒙茅斯郡（英国威尔士郡名）

e.en: {Monmouthshire} sits along the border between Wales and England.
e.zh: 蒙茅斯郡坐落在威尔士与英格兰的交界处。

e.en: The hills of {Monmouthshire} are popular with hikers.
e.zh: 蒙茅斯郡的山丘深受徒步爱好者欢迎。

mono.t:
adj. 单声道的；单一的
n. 单核细胞增多症（口语）

e.en: He caught {mono} from sharing a drink at the party.
e.zh: 他在聚会上跟人共喝一杯而染上了单核细胞增多症。

e.en: The recording sounds better in stereo than {mono}.
e.zh: 这段录音用立体声听比单声道效果更好。

e.en: Many antidepressants target {monoamine} neurotransmitters.
e.zh: 许多抗抑郁药作用于单胺类神经递质。

e.en: Serotonin is a well-known {monoamine} in the brain.
e.zh: 血清素是大脑中一种众所周知的单胺类物质。

e.en: She wore a {monochromatic} beige outfit to the gallery.
e.zh: 她穿着一身米色的单色搭配去画廊。

e.en: The room's {monochromatic} palette felt calm and modern.
e.zh: 房间的单色调色板让人感觉宁静又现代。

monochrome.t:
adj. 黑白的；单色的
n. 单色画

e.en: He prefers shooting street photos in {monochrome}.
e.zh: 他更喜欢用黑白拍摄街头照片。

e.en: The film was shot entirely in {monochrome}.
e.zh: 这部电影完全是用黑白拍摄的。

e.en: The old detective adjusted his {monocle} and squinted.
e.zh: 老侦探调了调单片眼镜,眯起了眼睛。

e.en: He wore a {monocle} for dramatic effect at parties.
e.zh: 他在派对上戴单片眼镜是为了制造戏剧效果。

e.en: The hospital is using {monoclonal} antibodies to treat patients.
e.zh: 医院正在使用单克隆抗体治疗病人。

e.en: Researchers developed a new {monoclonal} therapy for cancer.
e.zh: 研究人员开发出一种新的单克隆抗癌疗法。

monocoque.t: n. 硬壳式结构；承载式车身

e.en: Modern race cars use a carbon fiber {monocoque} chassis.
e.zh: 现代赛车采用碳纤维一体式车身底盘。

e.en: The aircraft's {monocoque} design saves significant weight.
e.zh: 这架飞机的单壳式构造大大减轻了重量。

monocular.t:
adj. 单眼的
n. 单筒望远镜

e.en: The hiker used a {monocular} to spot birds across the valley.
e.zh: 徒步者用单筒望远镜观察山谷对岸的鸟。

e.en: Patients with {monocular} vision often struggle with depth perception.
e.zh: 单眼视觉的人常常难以判断距离。

monocultural.t: adj. 单一文化的；单一作物的

e.en: Critics say the town has a {monocultural} school system.
e.zh: 批评者认为这个镇的学校体系过于单一文化。

e.en: Large {monocultural} farms are vulnerable to a single pest.
e.zh: 大规模单一作物农场很容易被一种害虫摧毁。

monoculture.t: n. 单一栽培；单一文化

e.en: Corn {monoculture} has depleted the soil in many regions.
e.zh: 玉米单一种植已使许多地区的土壤退化。

e.en: Tech offices can develop a stifling {monoculture}.
e.zh: 科技公司办公室可能形成令人窒息的单一文化。

e.en: Cucumbers are {monoecious}, with male and female flowers on one plant.
e.zh: 黄瓜是雌雄同株植物,一棵上同时开雄花和雌花。

e.en: Botanists classified the tree as {monoecious} after careful study.
e.zh: 植物学家经仔细研究将这种树归类为雌雄同株。

e.en: Anglers prefer {monofilament} line for its stretch and strength.
e.zh: 垂钓者偏爱单丝鱼线,因其有弹性又结实。

e.en: The surgeon stitched the wound with fine {monofilament} thread.
e.zh: 外科医生用细单丝缝线缝合了伤口。

e.en: Swans are famously {monogamous} and mate for life.
e.zh: 天鹅以一夫一妻著称,终生只配一次。

e.en: They agreed to keep their relationship strictly {monogamous}.
e.zh: 他们约定彼此严格保持一夫一妻的关系。

e.en: Many cultures still hold {monogamy} as the marital ideal.
e.zh: 许多文化仍把一夫一妻视为婚姻的理想。

e.en: The couple openly discussed whether {monogamy} suited them.
e.zh: 这对情侣坦率讨论一夫一妻制是否适合他们。

monogram.t: n. 花押字（由姓名首字母组成的图案）

e.en: Her towels were embroidered with a gold {monogram}.
e.zh: 她的毛巾上绣着金色字母组合图案。

e.en: The luggage bore his {monogram} in elegant script.
e.zh: 行李上印着他用花体字写成的姓名缩写。

monogrammed.t: adj. 印有姓名首字母图案的

e.en: He gave his father a {monogrammed} leather wallet for Christmas.
e.zh: 他送给父亲一只刻有姓名缩写的皮夹作圣诞礼物。

e.en: The hotel offered {monogrammed} bathrobes to VIP guests.
e.zh: 酒店为贵宾提供绣有姓名缩写的浴袍。

monograph.t: n. 专著（专题研究著作）

e.en: She published a detailed {monograph} on Renaissance painting.
e.zh: 她出版了一部关于文艺复兴绘画的详尽专著。

e.en: His {monograph} became required reading in graduate seminars.
e.zh: 他的专著成为研究生研讨课的必读书。

monographic.t: adj. 专著的；专题论文的
