e.en: The library has a strong {monographic} collection on early cinema.
e.zh: 该图书馆收藏有大量关于早期电影的专题著作。

e.en: He prefers {monographic} studies over short journal articles.
e.zh: 他更喜欢专题研究著作,而非短篇期刊论文。

e.en: Graphene is a {monolayer} of carbon atoms arranged in a lattice.
e.zh: 石墨烯是排列成晶格的单层碳原子。

e.en: The cells formed a uniform {monolayer} in the petri dish.
e.zh: 细胞在培养皿中形成均匀的单层。

monolingual.t: adj. 单语的；只讲一种语言的

e.en: Most American kids grow up {monolingual} in English.
e.zh: 大多数美国孩子从小只会说英语。

e.en: A purely {monolingual} dictionary helps advanced learners think in English.
e.zh: 纯英英词典能帮助高阶学习者用英语思考。

monolith.t: n. 独块巨石；庞大单一体

e.en: The ancient stone {monolith} towers over the desert plain.
e.zh: 那座古老的巨石矗立在沙漠平原上。

e.en: Critics claim the company has become a tech {monolith}.
e.zh: 批评者称这家公司已变成科技巨头垄断者。

monolithic.t: adj. 单体的；庞大单一的（常指系统架构）

e.en: Don't treat young voters as a {monolithic} group.
e.zh: 不要把年轻选民当作铁板一块的群体。

e.en: The app was built as one {monolithic} codebase.
e.zh: 这款应用是作为一个庞大整体的代码库构建的。

e.en: His teaching style felt {monologic} and discouraged student questions.
e.zh: 他的教学风格像独白,不鼓励学生提问。

e.en: The report adopts a {monologic} tone with no opposing voices.
e.zh: 该报告采取单一独白式语气,没有反方声音。

monological.t: adj. 独白式的；单向叙述的

e.en: The lecture was {monological}, leaving no room for debate.
e.zh: 那场讲座完全是独白式的,没有讨论空间。

e.en: Critics dismissed the essay as a {monological} rant.
e.zh: 评论者认为这篇文章只是一段独白式的咆哮。

monologist.t: n. 独白表演者；爱自说自话的人

e.en: The {monologist} held the audience spellbound for ninety minutes.
e.zh: 这位独角戏演员让观众入迷了九十分钟。

e.en: At dinner parties he becomes a tiresome {monologist}.
e.zh: 在晚宴上他总变成一个令人厌烦的独白者。

e.en: Her opening {monologue} on the late show went viral overnight.
e.zh: 她在深夜秀上的开场独白一夜走红。

e.en: He launched into a long {monologue} about his startup.
e.zh: 他开始就自己的创业项目滔滔不绝地独白。

e.en: His {monomania} for crypto cost him most of his friends.
e.zh: 他对加密货币的偏执让他失去了大部分朋友。

e.en: The captain's {monomania} drove the entire crew toward disaster.
e.zh: 船长的偏执狂使整个船员走向了灾难。

monomaniacal.t: adj. 偏执狂的；专注于一念的

e.en: She has a {monomaniacal} focus on shipping the product.
e.zh: 她对发布产品有一种近乎偏执的专注。

e.en: His {monomaniacal} pursuit of revenge ruined his career.
e.zh: 他对复仇的偏执追求毁掉了自己的事业。

e.en: Each {monomer} links up to form a long polymer chain.
e.zh: 每个单体相互连接形成长长的聚合物链。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new {monomer} for stronger plastics.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种新单体以制造更坚固的塑料。

e.en: The blood sample contained many {mononuclear} white cells.
e.zh: 血样中含有许多单核白细胞。

e.en: Researchers isolated {mononuclear} cells for the immunity study.
e.zh: 研究人员分离出单核细胞用于免疫研究。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her exhaustion as {mononucleosis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的极度疲劳是单核细胞增多症。

e.en: College students often catch {mononucleosis} from shared drinks.
e.zh: 大学生常因共用饮料而染上传染性单核细胞增多症。

e.en: Birds form a {monophyletic} group descended from one common ancestor.
e.zh: 鸟类构成一个源自共同祖先的单系类群。

e.en: DNA evidence confirmed the family is {monophyletic}.
e.zh: DNA 证据证实该科属于单系群。

e.en: The Spirit of St. Louis was a single-engine {monoplane}.
e.zh: 圣路易斯精神号是一架单引擎单翼飞机。

e.en: Early aviators replaced biplanes with the lighter {monoplane}.
e.zh: 早期飞行员用更轻便的单翼机取代了双翼机。

e.en: Physicists have long searched for an isolated magnetic {monopole}.
e.zh: 物理学家长期寻找孤立的磁单极子。

e.en: The antenna is mounted on a tall steel {monopole}.
e.zh: 天线安装在一根高高的单极钢柱上。

e.en: Regulators are cracking down on tech {monopolies} this year.
e.zh: 监管机构今年正在严打科技巨头的垄断行为。

e.en: Antitrust laws were designed to break up harmful {monopolies}.
e.zh: 反垄断法旨在拆分有害的垄断企业。

monopolise.t: v. 垄断；独占（英式拼写）

e.en: Don't let one speaker {monopolise} the entire meeting.
e.zh: 别让一个人独占整场会议的发言时间。

e.en: A few firms {monopolise} the country's mobile market.
e.zh: 少数几家公司垄断了该国的移动通信市场。

e.en: The court ruled the cable company an illegal {monopolist}.
e.zh: 法院裁定该有线电视公司是非法垄断者。

e.en: Every {monopolist} eventually attracts regulatory scrutiny.
e.zh: 任何垄断者最终都会引起监管的关注。

e.en: The startup accused the giant of {monopolistic} pricing tactics.
e.zh: 这家初创公司指控那家巨头采用垄断性定价手段。

e.en: Regulators frown on {monopolistic} behavior in app stores.
e.zh: 监管机构反对应用商店中的垄断行为。

e.en: The lawsuit alleges {monopolization} of the search-ad market.
e.zh: 诉讼指控其垄断了搜索广告市场。

e.en: Critics warn against the {monopolization} of online news.
e.zh: 批评者警告网络新闻正被垄断。

e.en: Please don't {monopolize} the conversation at dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭时请别一个人霸占整场谈话。

e.en: A handful of firms {monopolize} cloud computing worldwide.
e.zh: 少数几家公司垄断了全球的云计算市场。

e.en: The new CEO {monopolized} every meeting with his ideas.
e.zh: 新任 CEO 在每次会议上都独占发言宣讲自己的想法。

e.en: For decades one carrier {monopolized} long-distance phone service.
e.zh: 几十年来,一家运营商垄断了长途电话业务。

e.en: No single company should have a {monopoly} on online search.
e.zh: 任何一家公司都不应垄断在线搜索市场。

e.en: We played {monopoly} until well past midnight.
e.zh: 我们玩大富翁玩到了深夜。

monopsony.t: n. 买方垄断（仅一个买家的市场）

e.en: In a company town the employer becomes a {monopsony}.
e.zh: 在公司城里,雇主就成了唯一买方,即买方垄断者。

e.en: Economists worry that Amazon acts as a {monopsony} for authors.
e.zh: 经济学家担心亚马逊对作者形成了买方垄断。

monorail.t: n. 单轨铁路；单轨列车

e.en: A sleek {monorail} carries visitors between the theme park gates.
e.zh: 一辆光滑的单轨列车在主题公园各入口之间运送游客。

e.en: The city is studying a downtown {monorail} system.
e.zh: 该市正在研究市中心的单轨交通系统。

monosodium.t: adj. 一钠的（如味精 MSG）

e.en: Some diners avoid dishes containing {monosodium} glutamate.
e.zh: 有些食客会避开含味精的菜肴。

e.en: The label warned that the snack contained {monosodium} glutamate.
e.zh: 标签警告该零食含有味精。

monosyllabic.t: adj. 单音节的；说话简短的

e.en: Teenagers often give {monosyllabic} answers to their parents.
e.zh: 青少年回答父母时常常只用单音节词。

e.en: His {monosyllabic} replies made the interview feel awkward.
e.zh: 他单音节的回答让那场采访显得很尴尬。

e.en: She answered every question with a single {monosyllable}.
e.zh: 她每个问题都只用一个单音节词作答。

e.en: "Yes" is the most common {monosyllable} in casual speech.
e.zh: "yes" 是日常口语中最常见的单音节词。

e.en: Judaism, Christianity, and Islam all teach strict {monotheism}.
e.zh: 犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教都坚持严格的一神论。

e.en: The lecture traced the historical roots of {monotheism}.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了一神教的历史根源。

e.en: As a devout {monotheist}, she prays to one God daily.
e.zh: 作为虔诚的一神论者,她每天向唯一的神祈祷。

e.en: The author identifies as a philosophical {monotheist}.
e.zh: 该作者自认为是哲学意义上的一神论者。

monotheistic.t: adj. 一神论的；一神教的

e.en: Islam is a strictly {monotheistic} religion.
e.zh: 伊斯兰教是一种严格的一神教。

e.en: The professor compared {monotheistic} and polytheistic worldviews.
e.zh: 教授比较了一神论和多神论的世界观。

monotone.t:
n. 单调的声音
adj. 单调的；单色的

e.en: The lecturer spoke in a dull {monotone} for an hour.
e.zh: 演讲者用单调的语调讲了整整一个小时。

e.en: His voice rarely rose above a tired {monotone}.
e.zh: 他的声音很少高过那种疲惫的单调。

monotonic.t: adj. 单调的（数学：递增或递减）

e.en: The function is {monotonic} and never decreases on this interval.
e.zh: 该函数在此区间内是单调的,从不下降。

e.en: User growth has been {monotonic} since the relaunch.
e.zh: 自重新上线以来,用户增长一直保持单调上升。

e.en: Server load increased {monotonically} throughout the morning.
e.zh: 服务器负载整个上午都在单调地上升。

e.en: Temperature dropped {monotonically} as we climbed the mountain.
e.zh: 我们爬山时气温单调地下降。

e.en: She escaped the daily {monotonies} of office life by traveling.
e.zh: 她通过旅行逃离办公室生活中各种单调乏味的事。

e.en: Long road trips are filled with small {monotonies}.
e.zh: 漫长的公路旅行充满了各种小小的单调。

e.en: Packing boxes all day became unbearably {monotonous}.
e.zh: 整天装箱的工作变得令人无法忍受地单调。

e.en: His {monotonous} voice nearly put me to sleep.
e.zh: 他单调的嗓音几乎把我催眠了。

e.en: The rain fell {monotonously} on the tin roof all night.
e.zh: 整夜雨水单调地敲打着铁皮屋顶。

e.en: He repeated the same warning {monotonously} at every meeting.
e.zh: 他在每次会议上都单调地重复同样的警告。

e.en: A weekend trip broke the {monotony} of working from home.
e.zh: 一次周末旅行打破了居家办公的单调。

e.en: She listens to podcasts to ease the {monotony} of her commute.
e.zh: 她靠听播客来缓解通勤的单调。

e.en: The poster was printed using a {monotype} technique for unique texture.
e.zh: 这张海报采用单刷版画技术印制，纹理独一无二。

e.en: She designed a typeface for {Monotype} early in her career.
e.zh: 她职业生涯早期为蒙纳公司设计过一款字体。

monounsaturated.t: adj. 单不饱和的（脂肪酸）

e.en: Olive oil is rich in {monounsaturated} fats and good for the heart.
e.zh: 橄榄油富含单不饱和脂肪，对心脏有益。

e.en: Avocados contain healthy {monounsaturated} fatty acids.
e.zh: 牛油果含有健康的单不饱和脂肪酸。

e.en: Carbon {monoxide} detectors saved the family during the gas leak.
e.zh: 一氧化碳探测器在燃气泄漏时救了一家人。

e.en: Faulty heaters can release deadly carbon {monoxide} indoors.
e.zh: 故障的取暖器会在室内释放致命的一氧化碳。

monozygotic.t: adj. 单卵的（同卵双胞胎）

e.en: {Monozygotic} twins share virtually identical DNA from one fertilized egg.
e.zh: 同卵双胞胎来自同一个受精卵，DNA几乎完全相同。

e.en: Researchers studied {monozygotic} twins raised apart to explore nature versus nurture.
e.zh: 研究人员研究分开抚养的同卵双胞胎，以探讨先天与后天。

e.en: Marilyn {Monroe} remains an icon of mid-century Hollywood glamour.
e.zh: 玛丽莲·梦露至今仍是二十世纪中期好莱坞魅力的象征。

e.en: President {Monroe} declared the Americas closed to European colonization.
e.zh: 门罗总统宣布美洲不再接受欧洲殖民。

monrovia.t: n. 蒙罗维亚（利比里亚首都）

e.en: {Monrovia} is the capital and largest city of Liberia.
e.zh: 蒙罗维亚是利比里亚的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Heavy rains flooded several neighborhoods in {Monrovia} last week.
e.zh: 上周的暴雨淹没了蒙罗维亚的几个社区。

mons.t: n. 阜（解剖学：隆起部位）

e.en: Anatomy textbooks describe the {mons} as a fatty pad above the pubic bone.
e.zh: 解剖学教科书将耻丘描述为耻骨上方的脂肪垫。

e.en: Olympus {Mons} on Mars is the largest volcano in the solar system.
e.zh: 火星上的奥林帕斯山是太阳系中最大的火山。

e.en: The waiter greeted us with a polite "Bonjour, {monsieur}."
e.zh: 服务员礼貌地向我们说了声"先生您好"。

e.en: {Monsieur} Dupont owns the little bakery on the corner.
e.zh: 杜邦先生在街角开着那家小面包店。

monsignor.t: n. 蒙席（天主教神职头衔）

e.en: The {monsignor} blessed the congregation at the end of the mass.
e.zh: 蒙席在弥撒结束时为会众祝福。

e.en: Pope Francis appointed a new {monsignor} to oversee the diocese.
e.zh: 教宗方济各任命了一位新蒙席来管理该教区。

e.en: The {monsoon} season brings heavy rain and flooding to South Asia.
e.zh: 季风季节为南亚带来暴雨和洪水。

e.en: Farmers depend on the summer {monsoon} to water their rice paddies.
e.zh: 农民依靠夏季季风为稻田灌溉。

e.en: The kid was afraid a {monster} was hiding under the bed.
e.zh: 那孩子害怕床底下藏着怪物。

e.en: That new GPU is an absolute {monster} for gaming.
e.zh: 那块新显卡玩游戏简直是性能怪兽。

e.en: Children love cartoons about friendly {monsters} who go to school.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢看友善怪物上学的动画片。

e.en: Online trolls can be real {monsters} when they feel anonymous.
e.zh: 网络喷子在觉得匿名时真能像怪物一样可怕。

monstrance.t: n. 圣体光座（天主教圣器）

e.en: The priest carried the gold {monstrance} during the procession.
e.zh: 神父在游行中捧着金质圣体光座。

e.en: A jeweled {monstrance} sat on display in the cathedral treasury.
e.zh: 大教堂宝库里展出着一座镶嵌珠宝的圣体光座。

monstrosity.t: n. 畸形物；丑陋庞大之物

e.en: Critics called the new skyscraper a concrete {monstrosity}.
e.zh: 评论家把这座新摩天大楼称作混凝土怪物。

e.en: That gaudy sofa is an absolute {monstrosity} in the living room.
e.zh: 那张俗气的沙发摆在客厅里简直是个丑陋怪物。

monstrous.t: adj. 骇人的；巨大的；可怕的

e.en: The dictator was accused of {monstrous} crimes against civilians.
e.zh: 那位独裁者被指控对平民犯下了滔天罪行。

e.en: They built a {monstrous} mansion that dwarfs every neighbor.
e.zh: 他们建了一座庞大的豪宅，让每个邻居都相形见绌。

e.en: The CEO was {monstrously} overpaid compared to the average worker.
e.zh: 与普通员工相比，这位CEO的薪酬高得离谱。

e.en: Traffic was {monstrously} bad after the concert ended.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后交通堵得吓人。

e.en: We hiked up {Mont} Blanc during our trip to the Alps.
e.zh: 我们在阿尔卑斯之旅中徒步攀登了勃朗峰。

e.en: {Mont} Saint-Michel rises dramatically from the Normandy tide.
e.zh: 圣米歇尔山在诺曼底的潮水中拔地而起，气势磅礴。

e.en: The film opens with a {montage} of childhood memories.
e.zh: 影片以一段童年回忆的蒙太奇开场。

e.en: She made a photo {montage} for her parents' anniversary.
e.zh: 她为父母的结婚纪念日做了一张照片拼贴。

e.en: The French phrase "la {montagne}" simply means "the mountain."
e.zh: 法语"la montagne"就是"山"的意思。

e.en: We rented a chalet near the {montagne} for the winter holiday.
e.zh: 我们在山附近租了一间小木屋过冬假。

e.en: Romeo {Montague} falls in love with Juliet at the masked ball.
e.zh: 罗密欧·蒙太古在化装舞会上爱上了朱丽叶。

e.en: The {Montague} family feuded with the Capulets for generations.
e.zh: 蒙太古家族与凯普莱特家族世代为仇。

e.en: {Montaigne} essentially invented the modern personal essay form.
e.zh: 蒙田基本上开创了现代随笔的形式。

e.en: Her philosophy class spent two weeks reading {Montaigne}.
e.zh: 她的哲学课花了两周时间研读蒙田。

e.en: We drove through {Montana} on our way to Yellowstone.
e.zh: 我们前往黄石公园途中开车穿越了蒙大拿州。

e.en: {Montana} is famous for its big skies and open prairies.
e.zh: 蒙大拿以辽阔的天空和广袤的草原闻名。

e.en: {Montane} forests support unique wildlife at higher elevations.
e.zh: 山地森林在高海拔地区孕育着独特的野生动物。

e.en: Researchers tracked rare birds across the {montane} ecosystem.
e.zh: 研究人员在山地生态系统中追踪稀有鸟类。

monte.t:
n. 蒙特（人名）
n. 一种纸牌赌博

e.en: They lost a small fortune at the casinos in {Monte} Carlo.
e.zh: 他们在蒙特卡洛的赌场输掉了一笔不小的钱。

e.en: He grew up in a quiet town near {Monte} Cassino.
e.zh: 他在卡西诺山附近的一个安静小镇长大。

e.en: {Montebello} is a small city east of Los Angeles.
e.zh: 蒙特贝罗是洛杉矶以东的一座小城。

e.en: We stopped for tacos in {Montebello} on the way home.
e.zh: 我们在回家路上去蒙特贝罗吃了塔可。

e.en: The antique silver {monteith} once cooled wine glasses at banquets.
e.zh: 这只古董银制蒙提斯曾在宴会上为酒杯降温。

e.en: A scalloped {monteith} sits on display in the museum's silver gallery.
e.zh: 博物馆的银器展厅里陈列着一只扇形边的蒙提斯。

montenegrin.t:
adj. 黑山的
n. 黑山人

e.en: The {Montenegrin} coastline draws thousands of tourists each summer.
e.zh: 黑山的海岸线每年夏天吸引成千上万的游客。

e.en: He speaks fluent {Montenegrin} and works as a translator.
e.zh: 他能说流利的黑山语，从事翻译工作。

e.en: {Montenegro} declared independence from Serbia in 2006.
e.zh: 黑山于2006年宣布从塞尔维亚独立。

e.en: We sailed along the rugged coast of {Montenegro} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿着黑山崎岖的海岸航行。

monterey.t: n. 蒙特雷（美国加州城市）

e.en: The {Monterey} Bay Aquarium is famous for its kelp forest exhibit.
e.zh: 蒙特雷湾水族馆以其海藻林展览而闻名。

e.en: We ate fresh seafood on the wharf in {Monterey}.
e.zh: 我们在蒙特雷的码头吃了新鲜海鲜。

montesquieu.t: n. 孟德斯鸠（法国思想家）

e.en: {Montesquieu} argued for the separation of governmental powers.
e.zh: 孟德斯鸠主张政府权力的分立。

e.en: American founders drew heavily on {Montesquieu}'s political theory.
e.zh: 美国开国先贤大量借鉴了孟德斯鸠的政治理论。

monteverdi.t: n. 蒙特威尔第（意大利作曲家）

e.en: {Monteverdi} composed some of the earliest operas still performed today.
e.zh: 蒙特威尔第创作了一些至今仍在上演的最早歌剧。

e.en: The choir rehearsed a {Monteverdi} madrigal for the spring concert.
e.zh: 合唱团为春季音乐会排练了一首蒙特威尔第的牧歌。

montevideo.t: n. 蒙得维的亚（乌拉圭首都）

e.en: {Montevideo} is the capital and largest city of Uruguay.
e.zh: 蒙得维的亚是乌拉圭的首都和最大城市。

e.en: We watched the sunset from a beach in {Montevideo}.
e.zh: 我们在蒙得维的亚的一处海滩看了日落。

montezuma.t: n. 蒙特祖玛（阿兹特克皇帝）

e.en: {Montezuma} ruled the Aztec empire when the Spanish arrived.
e.zh: 西班牙人到来时，蒙特祖玛正统治着阿兹特克帝国。

e.en: Travelers joke about catching "{Montezuma}'s revenge" in Mexico.
e.zh: 游客们开玩笑说在墨西哥会得"蒙特祖玛的复仇"（拉肚子）。

e.en: Simon de {Montfort} led a famous rebellion against King Henry III.
e.zh: 西蒙·德·孟福尔领导了反抗亨利三世的著名叛乱。

e.en: {Montfort} is often credited with summoning an early English parliament.
e.zh: 孟福尔常被认为召集了早期的英格兰议会。

montgomery.t: n. 蒙哥马利（姓氏/地名）

e.en: {Montgomery} is the capital of Alabama and a civil rights landmark.
e.zh: 蒙哥马利是阿拉巴马州首府，也是民权运动的标志性城市。

e.en: Field Marshal {Montgomery} commanded Allied forces at El Alamein.
e.zh: 蒙哥马利元帅在阿拉曼战役中指挥了盟军。

montgomeryshire.t: n. 蒙哥马利郡（威尔士旧郡）

e.en: {Montgomeryshire} is a historic county in mid-Wales.
e.zh: 蒙哥马利郡是威尔士中部的一个历史悠久的郡。

e.en: Sheep farms still cover much of rural {Montgomeryshire}.
e.zh: 绵羊牧场至今仍覆盖着蒙哥马利郡的大部分乡村。

e.en: I started a new job last {month} and love it.
e.zh: 我上个月开始了一份新工作，非常喜欢。

e.en: The subscription costs ten dollars per {month}.
e.zh: 这项订阅每月十美元。

monthly.t:
adj. 每月的
adv. 每月一次

e.en: My {monthly} rent went up by two hundred dollars this year.
e.zh: 今年我的月租上涨了两百美元。

e.en: The team holds a {monthly} review meeting on Fridays.
e.zh: 团队在每月一个周五召开月度回顾会议。

e.en: It took six {months} to finish renovating the kitchen.
e.zh: 厨房装修花了六个月才完工。

e.en: The baby smiled for the first time at three {months}.
e.zh: 宝宝在三个月大时第一次露出笑容。

e.en: Tourists climb the steps of {Montmartre} to see Sacré-Cœur.
e.zh: 游客爬上蒙马特的台阶去看圣心大教堂。

e.en: Picasso once lived and painted in {Montmartre}.
e.zh: 毕加索曾在蒙马特居住和作画。

montparnasse.t: n. 蒙帕纳斯（巴黎街区）

e.en: {Montparnasse} was a hub for artists and writers in the 1920s.
e.zh: 蒙帕纳斯曾是1920年代艺术家与作家的聚集地。

e.en: We caught the high-speed train from Gare {Montparnasse}.
e.zh: 我们从蒙帕纳斯火车站搭乘了高铁。

montpelier.t: n. 蒙彼利埃（美国佛蒙特州首府）

e.en: {Montpelier} is the small but charming capital of Vermont.
e.zh: 蒙彼利埃是佛蒙特州迷人的小型州府。

e.en: Snow blanketed the streets of {Montpelier} all winter.
e.zh: 整个冬天蒙彼利埃的街道都被积雪覆盖。

montpellier.t: n. 蒙彼利埃（法国城市）

e.en: {Montpellier} has one of the oldest medical schools in Europe.
e.zh: 蒙彼利埃拥有欧洲最古老的医学院之一。

e.en: We spent a sunny afternoon strolling through {Montpellier}'s old town.
e.zh: 我们在蒙彼利埃的老城区度过了一个阳光明媚的下午。

montreal.t: n. 蒙特利尔（加拿大城市）

e.en: {Montreal} hosts a famous jazz festival every summer.
e.zh: 蒙特利尔每年夏天都举办著名的爵士音乐节。

e.en: Many people in {Montreal} speak both French and English fluently.
e.zh: 蒙特利尔很多人能流利地讲法语和英语。

e.en: The {Montreux} Jazz Festival draws music fans from around the world.
e.zh: 蒙特勒爵士音乐节吸引了来自世界各地的乐迷。

e.en: {Montreux} sits on the shores of beautiful Lake Geneva.
e.zh: 蒙特勒坐落在美丽的日内瓦湖畔。

montrose.t: n. 蒙特罗斯（地名/姓氏）

e.en: {Montrose} is a coastal town in eastern Scotland.
e.zh: 蒙特罗斯是苏格兰东部的一个沿海小镇。

e.en: We hiked the trails outside {Montrose}, Colorado last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在科罗拉多州蒙特罗斯郊外徒步了几条小径。

montserrat.t: n. 蒙特塞拉特（加勒比岛屿）

e.en: The volcano on {Montserrat} forced thousands to evacuate the island.
e.zh: 蒙特塞拉特岛上的火山迫使数千人撤离该岛。

e.en: Many websites use the {Montserrat} font for clean modern headings.
e.zh: 许多网站使用Montserrat字体作为简洁现代的标题字体。

monument.t: n. 纪念碑；纪念物；遗迹

e.en: A bronze {monument} honors the soldiers who died in the war.
e.zh: 一座青铜纪念碑悼念那些在战争中牺牲的士兵。

e.en: The Lincoln {Monument} attracts millions of visitors each year.
e.zh: 林肯纪念堂每年吸引数百万游客。

monumental.t: adj. 不朽的；巨大的；纪念碑式的

e.en: Finishing the marathon was a {monumental} achievement for her.
e.zh: 完成马拉松对她来说是一项了不起的成就。

e.en: The team faced a {monumental} task rebuilding after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾之后，团队面临着艰巨的重建任务。

e.en: The cathedral's sheer {monumentality} leaves every visitor speechless.
e.zh: 大教堂的宏伟气势让每个访客都为之惊叹。

e.en: Critics praised the sculpture's quiet {monumentality} and restraint.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这件雕塑沉静而宏伟、克制有度。

e.en: The new policy is {monumentally} important for climate action.
e.zh: 这项新政策对气候行动来说意义极为重大。

e.en: He {monumentally} failed the test despite weeks of study.
e.zh: 尽管学了好几周，他还是考得一塌糊涂。

monuments.t: n. 纪念碑（monument 的复数）

e.en: Tourists photographed the ancient {monuments} near the river.
e.zh: 游客们在河边拍摄那些古老的纪念碑。

e.en: These buildings are {monuments} to the city's industrial past.
e.zh: 这些建筑是这座城市工业历史的见证。

mony.t: adj. 许多（苏格兰方言，罕用）

e.en: In Scots dialect, {mony} simply means many or much.
e.zh: 在苏格兰方言中，mony就是many或much的意思。

e.en: The old ballad uses {mony} where modern English uses many.
e.zh: 这首古老民谣里用mony代替现代英语的many。

monza.t: n. 蒙扎（意大利城市，著名赛道）

e.en: The Formula 1 race at {Monza} drew thousands of fans.
e.zh: 在蒙扎举行的一级方程式比赛吸引了数千车迷。

e.en: Ferrari has a long history of winning at {Monza}.
e.zh: 法拉利在蒙扎赛道有着悠久的夺冠历史。

moo.t:
v. (牛) 哞哞叫
n. 牛叫声

e.en: The cows {moo} loudly when they want to be fed.
e.zh: 奶牛饿了的时候会大声地哞哞叫。

e.en: My toddler imitated the {moo} of every cow we saw.
e.zh: 我家小孩模仿了我们看到的每头牛的叫声。

e.en: He likes to {mooch} free coffee from his coworkers.
e.zh: 他喜欢蹭同事的免费咖啡。

e.en: Stop trying to {mooch} off your friends every weekend.
e.zh: 别再每个周末都去蹭朋友的吃喝了。

e.en: Everyone in the office knows he's a shameless {moocher}.
e.zh: 办公室里人人都知道他是个无耻的揩油党。

e.en: Don't be a {moocher} — pay for your own lunch.
e.zh: 别再当蹭饭的了，自己买午餐吧。

mood.t:
n. 心情；情绪
n. (语法) 语气

e.en: She's been in a great {mood} since landing the job.
e.zh: 自从拿到那份工作，她心情一直很好。

e.en: The lighting sets a romantic {mood} for the dinner.
e.zh: 灯光为这顿晚餐营造出浪漫的氛围。

moodily.t: adv. 忧郁地；闷闷不乐地

e.en: He stared {moodily} out the window during the long drive.
e.zh: 长途开车时他闷闷不乐地盯着窗外。

e.en: She picked {moodily} at her food without saying a word.
e.zh: 她一言不发，闷闷地拨弄着盘里的食物。

e.en: Teenage {moodiness} can be exhausting for parents.
e.zh: 青少年的喜怒无常会让家长精疲力尽。

e.en: His sudden {moodiness} worried his close friends.
e.zh: 他突然的情绪起伏让好友们很担心。

e.en: Her {moods} change quickly throughout the day.
e.zh: 她的情绪一天里变化很快。

e.en: The app tracks your {moods} and sleep patterns.
e.zh: 这款应用会记录你的情绪和睡眠模式。

moody.t: adj. 喜怒无常的；闷闷不乐的

e.en: He's been {moody} ever since the breakup last month.
e.zh: 自从上个月分手，他就一直情绪低落。

e.en: The film has a beautifully {moody} soundtrack.
e.zh: 这部电影的配乐氛围感十足，非常出色。

e.en: That side hustle brings in some serious {moolah}.
e.zh: 那个副业能赚不少钱。

e.en: He spent all his {moolah} on concert tickets.
e.zh: 他把所有的钱都花在演唱会门票上了。

moon.t:
n. 月亮；卫星
v. 闲逛；发呆

e.en: A full {moon} lit up the entire campsite last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一轮满月把整个营地照得通亮。

e.en: NASA plans to send astronauts back to the {moon}.
e.zh: 美国航空航天局计划再次把宇航员送上月球。

e.en: A single {moonbeam} slipped through the curtains.
e.zh: 一缕月光从窗帘缝里溜了进来。

e.en: She watched the {moonbeam} dance on the lake's surface.
e.zh: 她看着月光在湖面上闪闪跳动。

e.en: The project sank into a {morass} of paperwork.
e.zh: 这个项目陷入了文件堆积的泥潭。

e.en: He waded through a {morass} of legal disputes.
e.zh: 他在一堆法律纠纷的泥沼中艰难前行。

e.en: The city placed a {moratorium} on new construction.
e.zh: 该市暂停了新建筑的建设。

e.en: They called for a {moratorium} on executions.
e.zh: 他们呼吁暂停执行死刑。

moravia.t: n. 摩拉维亚（捷克地区）

e.en: They drove through the wine country of {Moravia}.
e.zh: 他们驱车穿越摩拉维亚的葡萄酒产区。

e.en: {Moravia} is known for its rolling green hills.
e.zh: 摩拉维亚以连绵起伏的绿色山丘而闻名。

moravian.t:
adj. 摩拉维亚的
n. 摩拉维亚人

e.en: The {Moravian} church has a long missionary tradition.
e.zh: 摩拉维亚教会有悠久的传教传统。

e.en: She speaks a distinct {Moravian} dialect of Czech.
e.zh: 她说一种独特的摩拉维亚方言捷克语。

e.en: A {moray} eel peeked out from the coral.
e.zh: 一条海鳝从珊瑚中探出头来。

e.en: Divers spotted a giant {moray} near the wreck.
e.zh: 潜水员在沉船附近发现了一条巨型海鳝。

e.en: He has a {morbid} fascination with true crime.
e.zh: 他对真实犯罪案件有种病态的迷恋。

e.en: Stop telling such {morbid} jokes at dinner.
e.zh: 吃饭时别讲那些病态的笑话。

e.en: The drug significantly reduced patient {morbidity}.
e.zh: 这种药物显著降低了患者的发病率。

e.en: Researchers tracked {morbidity} rates across regions.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了各地区的发病率。

e.en: He was {morbidly} curious about the accident.
e.zh: 他对那场事故有种病态的好奇。

e.en: The patient is classified as {morbidly} obese.
e.zh: 这位病人被归类为病态肥胖。

mordant.t:
adj. 尖刻的
n. 媒染剂

e.en: Her {mordant} wit kept the room laughing nervously.
e.zh: 她尖刻的幽默让全场紧张地笑了起来。

e.en: The review offered a {mordant} take on the film.
e.zh: 这篇评论对该影片给出了辛辣的评价。

e.en: She lives near {Morden} station in south London.
e.zh: 她住在伦敦南部的莫登站附近。

e.en: The Northern line terminates at {Morden}.
e.zh: 北线地铁的终点站是莫登。

more.t:
adj. 更多的
adv. 更加

e.en: Could I have {more} coffee, please?
e.zh: 可以再给我加点咖啡吗?

e.en: This phone has {more} storage than the older model.
e.zh: 这款手机比旧款储存空间更大。

e.en: We spent a windy weekend in {Morecambe}.
e.zh: 我们在莫克姆度过了一个大风的周末。

e.en: {Morecambe} Bay is famous for its tidal flats.
e.zh: 莫克姆湾以其潮间滩涂而闻名。

e.en: She found a {morel} mushroom in the woods.
e.zh: 她在林子里找到了一朵羊肚菌。

e.en: The chef sautéed fresh {morel} in butter.
e.zh: 厨师用黄油煎了新鲜的羊肚菌。

e.en: The plan is risky; {moreover}, it's expensive.
e.zh: 这个方案有风险;此外,还很昂贵。

e.en: She speaks French; {moreover}, she writes it well.
e.zh: 她会说法语,而且写得也很好。

e.en: Social {mores} have changed since the 1950s.
e.zh: 自20世纪50年代以来,社会习俗已发生改变。

e.en: The novel examines small-town {mores} and gossip.
e.zh: 这部小说审视了小镇的风俗与流言。

e.en: Port {Moresby} is the capital of Papua New Guinea.
e.zh: 莫尔兹比港是巴布亚新几内亚的首都。

e.en: Their flight landed in Port {Moresby} at dawn.
e.zh: 他们的航班在黎明时分降落在莫尔兹比港。

e.en: They visited {Moreton} Bay during their holiday.
e.zh: 他们度假期间游览了摩尔顿湾。

e.en: {Moreton} Island is popular for its sand dunes.
e.zh: 摩尔顿岛以其沙丘而广受欢迎。

e.en: {Morgan} just got promoted at the bank.
e.zh: 摩根刚刚在银行获得了晋升。

e.en: She drives a vintage {Morgan} sports car.
e.zh: 她开着一辆老式的摩根跑车。

morgans.t: n. 摩根家族；Morgan 的复数

e.en: The {Morgans} invited us over for dinner.
e.zh: 摩根一家邀请我们过去吃晚饭。

e.en: Both {Morgans} on the team play defense.
e.zh: 队里两个叫摩根的都打防守位置。

e.en: The body was taken to the city {morgue}.
e.zh: 尸体被送到了市停尸房。

e.en: It was so quiet the office felt like a {morgue}.
e.zh: 办公室安静得像太平间。

e.en: The painting is a classic memento {mori}.
e.zh: 这幅画是经典的死亡警示作品。

e.en: Skull imagery serves as memento {mori} in the poem.
e.zh: 诗中的骷髅意象起到了死亡警示的作用。

e.en: Sherlock Holmes finally confronted Professor {Moriarty}.
e.zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯终于与莫里亚蒂教授对峙。

e.en: {Moriarty} is fiction's most famous criminal mastermind.
e.zh: 莫里亚蒂是虚构作品中最著名的犯罪天才。

e.en: The {moribund} industry needs urgent reform.
e.zh: 这个濒临衰败的行业急需改革。

e.en: Critics called the project {moribund} by spring.
e.zh: 评论家在春天就称这个项目已奄奄一息。

e.en: They went skiing in St. {Moritz} last winter.
e.zh: 他们去年冬天在圣莫里茨滑雪。

e.en: St. {Moritz} hosted the Winter Olympics twice.
e.zh: 圣莫里茨曾两次举办冬季奥运会。

e.en: Catherine {Morland} is the heroine of Northanger Abbey.
e.zh: 凯瑟琳·莫兰是《诺桑觉寺》的女主角。

e.en: George {Morland} painted rural English scenes.
e.zh: 乔治·莫兰描绘了英国乡村风光。

e.en: {Morley} is a market town in West Yorkshire.
e.zh: 莫利是西约克郡的一个集镇。

e.en: The Michelson-{Morley} experiment changed physics.
e.zh: 迈克尔逊-莫雷实验改变了物理学。

mormon.t:
n. 摩门教徒
adj. 摩门教的

e.en: His family is {Mormon} and lives in Utah.
e.zh: 他的家人是摩门教徒,住在犹他州。

e.en: The {Mormon} temple in Salt Lake City is iconic.
e.zh: 盐湖城的摩门教圣殿是标志性建筑。

e.en: The poet welcomed the bright spring {morn}.
e.zh: 诗人迎接着明媚的春日清晨。

e.en: On Christmas {morn}, the children rushed downstairs.
e.zh: 圣诞节早晨,孩子们冲下了楼。

e.en: I drink coffee every {morning} before work.
e.zh: 我每天早上上班前都喝咖啡。

e.en: Good {morning}! How did you sleep?
e.zh: 早上好!睡得怎么样?

mornings.t:
n. 早晨（复数）
adv. 每天早上

e.en: Cold {mornings} make it hard to leave bed.
e.zh: 寒冷的早晨让人难以起床。

e.en: She teaches yoga on Saturday {mornings}.
e.zh: 她每周六上午教瑜伽。

e.en: Columbia University sits in {Morningside} Heights.
e.zh: 哥伦比亚大学坐落在晨边高地。

e.en: They moved to a quiet street in {Morningside}.
e.zh: 他们搬到了晨边的一条安静街道。

e.en: The {Mornington} Peninsula is famous for wineries.
e.zh: 莫宁顿半岛以酒庄闻名。

e.en: We caught the train from {Mornington} Crescent.
e.zh: 我们从莫宁顿新月站搭乘了火车。

moroccan.t:
adj. 摩洛哥的
n. 摩洛哥人

e.en: We had a delicious {Moroccan} tagine for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐吃了美味的摩洛哥塔吉锅。

e.en: She bought a colorful {Moroccan} rug online.
e.zh: 她在网上买了一块色彩鲜艳的摩洛哥地毯。

e.en: We're flying to {Morocco} next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要飞往摩洛哥。

e.en: The bazaars in {Morocco} are full of spices.
e.zh: 摩洛哥的集市里满是各种香料。

e.en: Don't be such a {moron} on the highway.
e.zh: 在高速公路上别这么犯傻。

e.en: Only a {moron} would click that suspicious link.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会点那种可疑的链接。

e.en: That was a {moronic} thing to post online.
e.zh: 在网上发那种东西真是太蠢了。

e.en: The plan struck everyone as completely {moronic}.
e.zh: 大家都觉得这个计划简直愚蠢透顶。

morose.t: adj. 郁闷的；愁眉苦脸的

e.en: He's been {morose} ever since the breakup.
e.zh: 分手之后他一直闷闷不乐。

e.en: The rainy weather left her feeling {morose}.
e.zh: 阴雨天气让她感到郁郁寡欢。

e.en: He stared {morosely} out the rainy window.
e.zh: 他闷闷不乐地凝视着雨中的窗外。

e.en: She nodded {morosely} and left without speaking.
e.zh: 她忧郁地点了点头,一言不发地离开了。

e.en: We stopped in {Morpeth} for tea on the way north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中在莫佩斯停下来喝茶。

e.en: The train from Newcastle to {Morpeth} takes fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 从纽卡斯尔到莫佩斯的火车只需十五分钟。

morph.t:
v. 变形；渐变
n. 变体

e.en: The app can {morph} your selfie into a cartoon character.
e.zh: 这个应用能把你的自拍变成卡通人物。

e.en: Their startup slowly {morphed} into a consulting firm.
e.zh: 他们的初创公司慢慢转型成了咨询公司。

e.en: The suffix "-ing" is a common English {morpheme}.
e.zh: 后缀"-ing"是英语中常见的语素。

e.en: Linguistics students learn to break words into each {morpheme}.
e.zh: 语言学学生要学会把单词拆分成每个语素。

e.en: The doctor administered {morphia} to ease the soldier's pain.
e.zh: 医生给士兵注射了吗啡以缓解疼痛。

e.en: Old novels often mention {morphia} as a powerful sedative.
e.zh: 旧小说里常把吗啡描述成一种强效镇静剂。

e.en: Nurses gave him {morphine} after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后护士给他注射了吗啡。

e.en: Hospitals strictly control access to {morphine} and other opioids.
e.zh: 医院对吗啡等阿片类药物管控非常严格。

morphing.t:
n. 图像变形
v. 变形（morph 的现在分词）

e.en: The video shows a caterpillar {morphing} into a butterfly.
e.zh: 视频展示了毛毛虫蜕变成蝴蝶的过程。

e.en: Her style keeps {morphing} with every new album.
e.zh: 她的风格随着每张新专辑不断变化。

morpho.t: n. 大闪蝶（南美热带蝴蝶）

e.en: The blue {morpho} butterfly is famous for its iridescent wings.
e.zh: 蓝闪蝶以其闪亮的翅膀而闻名。

e.en: Tourists in the rainforest hope to spot a {morpho}.
e.zh: 雨林里的游客都希望能看到一只闪蝶。

morphogenesis.t: n. 形态发生（生物体形态形成过程）

e.en: Biologists study {morphogenesis} to understand how organs take shape.
e.zh: 生物学家研究形态发生以了解器官如何形成。

e.en: Turing's paper on {morphogenesis} influenced modern developmental biology.
e.zh: 图灵关于形态发生的论文影响了现代发育生物学。

e.en: The scan revealed clear {morphologic} changes in the tissue.
e.zh: 扫描显示组织出现了明显的形态学变化。

e.en: Pathologists rely on {morphologic} features to diagnose tumors.
e.zh: 病理学家依靠形态学特征来诊断肿瘤。

morphological.t: adj. 形态学的；形态上的

e.en: The two species show striking {morphological} differences.
e.zh: 这两个物种在形态上有显著差异。

e.en: Chinese has fewer {morphological} inflections than Latin.
e.zh: 汉语的形态变化比拉丁语少得多。

morphologically.t: adv. 形态学上；从形态上看

e.en: These fish are {morphologically} similar but genetically distinct.
e.zh: 这些鱼在形态上相似,但基因上差异很大。

e.en: English is {morphologically} simpler than many Slavic languages.
e.zh: 英语在形态上比许多斯拉夫语言要简单。

e.en: The {morphologist} examined the skull's bone structure carefully.
e.zh: 那位形态学家仔细检查了颅骨的骨骼结构。

e.en: As a {morphologist}, she studies how plants form their leaves.
e.zh: 作为形态学家,她研究植物如何形成叶片。

e.en: Japanese {morphology} relies heavily on agglutinative suffixes.
e.zh: 日语的形态学很大程度上依赖于黏着后缀。

e.en: The {morphology} of these crystals depends on temperature.
e.zh: 这些晶体的形态取决于温度。

morpurgo.t: n. 莫波格（姓氏，英国作家 Michael Morpurgo）

e.en: Michael {Morpurgo} wrote the novel that became War Horse.
e.zh: 迈克尔·莫珀戈写了被改编成《战马》的小说。

e.en: My daughter loves every book by {Morpurgo}.
e.zh: 我女儿喜欢莫珀戈的每一本书。

e.en: William {Morris} designed many iconic floral wallpapers.
e.zh: 威廉·莫里斯设计了许多经典的花卉壁纸。

e.en: The village hosts a traditional {Morris} dance every May.
e.zh: 那个村子每年五月都会举办传统的莫里斯舞。

e.en: Toni {Morrison} won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1993.
e.zh: 托妮·莫里森于1993年荣获诺贝尔文学奖。

e.en: Jim {Morrison} remains one of rock's most legendary frontmen.
e.zh: 吉姆·莫里森至今仍是摇滚乐最传奇的主唱之一。

morro.t: n. 圆丘；岬角（地名常用）

e.en: The lighthouse stands on a rocky {morro} above the bay.
e.zh: 灯塔矗立在海湾上方的一座岩石小山上。

e.en: We hiked up the {morro} for a sunset view.
e.zh: 我们爬上小山去看日落。

e.en: On the {morrow} we shall ride at dawn.
e.zh: 明日我们将在黎明时分启程。

e.en: Good night, and I'll see you on the {morrow}.
e.zh: 晚安,明天再见。

e.en: Sailors once used {Morse} code to send urgent messages.
e.zh: 水手们曾用摩尔斯电码发送紧急信息。

e.en: Inspector {Morse} solved crimes in the streets of Oxford.
e.zh: 摩斯探长在牛津的街道上破获各种案件。

morsel.t: n. 一小口；一小块（食物）

e.en: He tossed a {morsel} of bread to the pigeons.
e.zh: 他扔了一小块面包给鸽子。

e.en: Reporters were desperate for any {morsel} of new information.
e.zh: 记者们急切地想要任何一点新消息。

e.en: The hunter blew a {mort} on his horn after the kill.
e.zh: 猎人在猎物倒下后吹响了报丧号。

e.en: In old hunting tradition, the {mort} signaled the deer's death.
e.zh: 在古老的狩猎传统中,报丧号宣告鹿的死亡。

mortadella.t: n. 摩塔德拉香肠（意式大肉肠）

e.en: I ordered a sandwich with {mortadella} and provolone.
e.zh: 我点了一个夹意式肉肠和波罗伏洛奶酪的三明治。

e.en: Bologna is famous for its pink, pistachio-studded {mortadella}.
e.zh: 博洛尼亚以镶嵌着开心果的粉色摩泰台拉香肠而闻名。

mortal.t:
adj. 致命的；终有一死的
n. 凡人

e.en: Even kings are {mortal} and must one day die.
e.zh: 即使是国王也是凡人,终有一天会死去。

e.en: He suffered a {mortal} wound during the battle.
e.zh: 他在战斗中受了致命伤。

e.en: Vaccines have dramatically reduced child {mortality} worldwide.
e.zh: 疫苗大大降低了全球儿童的死亡率。

e.en: Turning fifty made him think about his own {mortality}.
e.zh: 五十岁让他开始思考自己生命的有限。

e.en: The general was {mortally} wounded at Gettysburg.
e.zh: 那位将军在葛底斯堡战役中受了致命伤。

e.en: She felt {mortally} embarrassed by the public mistake.
e.zh: 她对当众犯的错误感到无地自容。

e.en: The bricklayer spread {mortar} between each row of bricks.
e.zh: 砌砖工人在每排砖之间抹上灰浆。

e.en: Enemy {mortar} fire forced the troops to retreat.
e.zh: 敌方迫击炮火力迫使部队撤退。

e.en: She tossed her {mortarboard} into the air at graduation.
e.zh: 毕业典礼上她把学士帽抛向空中。

e.en: Every graduate wore a black gown and {mortarboard}.
e.zh: 每位毕业生都穿着黑袍、戴着学士方帽。

e.en: The mason carefully {mortared} the stones into place.
e.zh: 石匠小心地用灰浆把石头砌好。

e.en: Old castle walls are {mortared} with a lime-based mix.
e.zh: 古老的城堡墙是用石灰砂浆砌成的。

e.en: The army positioned several {mortars} on the hilltop.
e.zh: 军队在山顶部署了几门迫击炮。

e.en: Pharmacists once ground herbs in stone {mortars} by hand.
e.zh: 药剂师过去常常用石臼手工研磨草药。

mortgage.t:
n. 按揭；抵押贷款
v. 抵押

e.en: They took out a thirty-year {mortgage} on their first home.
e.zh: 他们为第一套房子办了三十年的按揭贷款。

e.en: Rising interest rates make a new {mortgage} expensive.
e.zh: 利率上升使新的房贷变得很昂贵。

mortgaged.t:
adj. 已抵押的
v. 抵押（过去式）

e.en: They {mortgaged} the farm to pay for their daughter's tuition.
e.zh: 他们抵押了农场来支付女儿的学费。

e.en: The house has been {mortgaged} twice over the years.
e.zh: 这所房子多年来已被抵押过两次。

e.en: The {mortgagee} can foreclose if payments stop for too long.
e.zh: 如果停付时间过长,贷款方可以取消赎回权。

e.en: Banks act as the {mortgagee} in most home loans.
e.zh: 在大多数房贷中,银行是抵押权人。

mortgages.t:
n. 按揭（复数）
v. 抵押（三单）

e.en: Many {mortgages} now come with adjustable interest rates.
e.zh: 现在许多按揭贷款都采用浮动利率。

e.en: The bank offers {mortgages} for both houses and apartments.
e.zh: 该银行为住宅和公寓都提供按揭贷款。

e.en: As the {mortgagor}, she must keep the property insured.
e.zh: 作为抵押人,她必须为该房产投保。

e.en: The {mortgagor} signed the loan documents at closing.
e.zh: 抵押人在交易完成时签署了贷款文件。

e.en: He cut a {mortice} into the wood for the joint.
e.zh: 他在木头上凿了一个榫眼用于接合。

e.en: The carpenter prefers a traditional {mortice} and tenon joint.
e.zh: 那位木匠偏爱传统的榫卯接合方式。

e.en: The {mortician} prepared the body for the funeral service.
e.zh: 殡葬师为葬礼准备了遗体。

e.en: His grandfather was a small-town {mortician} for forty years.
e.zh: 他祖父在小镇上当了四十年的殡葬师。

e.en: To her {mortification}, her microphone was still on.
e.zh: 令她极为尴尬的是,她的麦克风还开着。

e.en: Some monks practiced {mortification} of the flesh as devotion.
e.zh: 一些修士以肉体苦行作为虔诚的修行。

e.en: She was {mortified} when her parents started dancing at the party.
e.zh: 父母在派对上跳起舞来,她尴尬得无地自容。

e.en: He felt utterly {mortified} after forgetting his speech.
e.zh: 忘了演讲稿后,他感到极其难堪。

e.en: It {mortifies} him whenever his mother shows baby photos.
e.zh: 每次妈妈拿出婴儿照片,他都尴尬得要命。

e.en: Public criticism really {mortifies} the young performer.
e.zh: 公开批评让那位年轻演员感到非常难堪。

e.en: Don't {mortify} your kids by singing loudly in public.
e.zh: 别在公共场合大声唱歌让孩子们难堪。

e.en: A single typo can {mortify} a perfectionist writer.
e.zh: 一个错别字就能让完美主义作家羞愧难当。

e.en: It was {mortifying} to trip on stage in front of everyone.
e.zh: 在台上当众绊倒真是令人尴尬至极。

e.en: She found the whole interview deeply {mortifying}.
e.zh: 她觉得整场面试都让她无地自容。

mortise.t:
n. 榫眼
v. 开榫眼接合

e.en: The carpenter chiseled a clean {mortise} for the door hinge.
e.zh: 木匠为门铰链凿出了一个干净的榫眼。

e.en: A {mortise} lock is more secure than a simple latch.
e.zh: 嵌入式锁比简单的门闩更安全。

mortlake.t: n. 莫特莱克（伦敦地名）

e.en: We rowed past {Mortlake} during the boat race.
e.zh: 赛艇比赛途中我们划过了莫特莱克。

e.en: {Mortlake} is a riverside village in southwest London.
e.zh: 莫特莱克是伦敦西南的一个河边村庄。

mortuary.t:
n. 停尸房；太平间
adj. 丧葬的

e.en: The body was taken to the hospital {mortuary} overnight.
e.zh: 遗体连夜被送往医院的太平间。

e.en: She works as a technician at the city {mortuary}.
e.zh: 她在市殡仪馆担任技术员。

mosaic.t:
n. 马赛克；镶嵌画
adj. 拼接的

e.en: The Roman villa featured a stunning floor {mosaic}.
e.zh: 那座罗马别墅有一幅令人惊叹的地板马赛克。

e.en: The city is a {mosaic} of cultures and languages.
e.zh: 这座城市是多种文化与语言的拼合。

e.en: The {mosaicist} carefully placed each tiny tile by hand.
e.zh: 马赛克艺术家亲手小心地拼放每一块小瓷片。

e.en: A skilled {mosaicist} can recreate ancient Byzantine designs.
e.zh: 技艺精湛的镶嵌艺术家能够重现古拜占庭风格的图案。

moscow.t: n. 莫斯科（俄罗斯首都）

e.en: Red Square sits at the heart of {Moscow}.
e.zh: 红场坐落在莫斯科的中心。

e.en: Winter in {Moscow} can be brutally cold.
e.zh: 莫斯科的冬天可以冷得让人难以忍受。

moselle.t: n. 摩泽尔河；摩泽尔白葡萄酒

e.en: We toured vineyards along the {Moselle} river last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿摩泽尔河参观了葡萄园。

e.en: A chilled glass of {Moselle} pairs nicely with seafood.
e.zh: 一杯冰镇的摩泽尔白葡萄酒与海鲜很搭。

moonflower.t: n. 月光花（夜间开放的白色花卉）

e.en: The {moonflower} only opens its petals at night.
e.zh: 月光花只在夜里绽放花瓣。

e.en: She planted a {moonflower} vine along the back fence.
e.zh: 她沿着后篱笆种了一株月光花藤。

moonglow.t: n. 月光；月晕般的柔光

e.en: The pale {moonglow} bathed the meadow in silver.
e.zh: 淡淡的月光把草地染成银色。

e.en: They danced together in the soft {moonglow}.
e.zh: 他们在柔和的月光中相拥起舞。

e.en: He was raised in a {Moonie} household before leaving the church.
e.zh: 他在统一教家庭长大，后来离开了教会。

e.en: The documentary explored how the {Moonie} movement recruits members.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了统一教如何招募信徒。

moonless.t: adj. 无月的；没有月光的

e.en: On a {moonless} night the stars looked impossibly bright.
e.zh: 在没有月亮的夜里，星星显得格外明亮。

e.en: Sailors avoided the reef on {moonless} nights.
e.zh: 水手们在无月之夜会避开那片暗礁。

e.en: Astronomers discovered a tiny {moonlet} orbiting the asteroid.
e.zh: 天文学家发现一颗小卫星绕着这颗小行星运行。

e.en: Saturn's rings contain countless icy {moonlet} fragments.
e.zh: 土星环中含有无数冰质小卫星碎片。

moonlight.t:
n. 月光
v. 兼职（尤指夜间）

e.en: They walked along the beach in the {moonlight}.
e.zh: 他们在月光下沿着海滩散步。

e.en: Many teachers {moonlight} as tutors to earn extra income.
e.zh: 许多老师兼职做家教来贴补收入。

moonlighting.t: n. 兼职（常指夜间副业）

e.en: He's been {moonlighting} as a graphic designer on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末一直在兼职做平面设计。

e.en: Her boss discovered she was {moonlighting} for a competitor.
e.zh: 老板发现她在为竞争对手兼职工作。

moonlights.t:
v. 兼差（第三人称单数）
n. 月光（复数）

e.en: She {moonlights} as a dog walker after her office hours.
e.zh: 她下班后兼职遛狗赚外快。

e.en: He {moonlights} writing code for indie game studios.
e.zh: 他业余时间为独立游戏工作室写代码。

e.en: They shared a kiss on the {moonlit} balcony.
e.zh: 他们在月光照耀的阳台上接了个吻。

e.en: The {moonlit} lake looked like polished silver.
e.zh: 月光下的湖面宛如打磨过的银子。

moonrise.t: n. 月出；月亮升起的时刻

e.en: We timed our hike to catch the {moonrise} over the canyon.
e.zh: 我们特意安排徒步时间去看峡谷上空的月升。

e.en: Photographers gathered on the cliff to shoot the {moonrise}.
e.zh: 摄影师们聚集在悬崖上拍摄月升景象。

e.en: Jupiter has dozens of known {moons} circling it.
e.zh: 木星已知有几十颗卫星绕其运行。

e.en: Two full {moons} appear in the sky this month.
e.zh: 这个月天空中将出现两次满月。

moonscape.t: n. 月面景观；荒凉地貌

e.en: The desert looked like an alien {moonscape} at sunset.
e.zh: 夕阳下的沙漠看起来像外星月球表面。

e.en: Volcanic eruptions left behind a barren {moonscape}.
e.zh: 火山爆发留下一片荒凉的月球般地貌。

e.en: Iceland's lava fields create stunning otherworldly {moonscapes}.
e.zh: 冰岛的熔岩原形成了震撼的异世界般地貌。

e.en: The artist paints surreal {moonscapes} in muted tones.
e.zh: 这位艺术家用低饱和色调绘制超现实月球地貌。

moonshine.t:
n. 私酿烈酒
n. 空话；月光

e.en: His grandfather used to brew {moonshine} in the woods.
e.zh: 他爷爷以前在林子里私酿烈酒。

e.en: Selling {moonshine} was illegal during Prohibition.
e.zh: 禁酒令时期，贩卖私酿酒是违法的。

moonshiner.t: n. 私酿或贩卖烈酒的人

e.en: The old {moonshiner} hid his still in a mountain cave.
e.zh: 那个老私酒贩把蒸馏器藏在山洞里。

e.en: Police arrested a {moonshiner} operating in the backwoods.
e.zh: 警察逮捕了一名在偏远林区私酿酒的人。

moonshot.t: n. 登月计划；雄心勃勃的目标

e.en: Curing aging is the company's ambitious {moonshot}.
e.zh: 攻克衰老是这家公司雄心勃勃的登月计划。

e.en: Investors love startups chasing a true {moonshot} idea.
e.zh: 投资人喜欢追逐真正颠覆性愿景的初创公司。

e.en: She wore a silver ring set with a glowing {moonstone}.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚镶着闪亮月光石的银戒指。

e.en: The {moonstone} pendant shimmered under the spotlight.
e.zh: 那枚月光石吊坠在聚光灯下闪闪发亮。

e.en: He learned to {moonwalk} by watching old Michael Jackson videos.
e.zh: 他通过看迈克尔·杰克逊的老视频学会了太空步。

e.en: The first lunar {moonwalk} happened in July 1969.
e.zh: 人类首次月面行走发生在1969年7月。

moony.t: adj. 恍惚的；心不在焉的

e.en: She gave him a {moony} look across the dinner table.
e.zh: 她在餐桌对面对他投去痴痴的一瞥。

e.en: He's been all {moony} since meeting his new girlfriend.
e.zh: 自从认识新女友，他就一直神情恍惚。

moor.t:
n. 荒野；沼泽地
v. 停泊（船只）

e.en: They hiked across the windswept {moor} all afternoon.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都在风大的荒原上徒步。

e.en: Sailors {moor} the boat to the dock before leaving.
e.zh: 水手们离开前会把船系在码头上。

e.en: The cottage sat alone at the edge of the {moorfield}.
e.zh: 那间小屋孤零零地坐落在荒原边缘。

e.en: Sheep grazed peacefully across the open {moorfield}.
e.zh: 羊群在开阔的荒野上安静地吃草。

e.en: A {moorhen} darted across the pond into the reeds.
e.zh: 一只黑水鸡迅速穿过池塘钻进了芦苇丛。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a {moorhen} nesting by the canal.
e.zh: 观鸟者发现一只黑水鸡在运河边筑巢。

mooring.t:
n. 停泊处；系泊缆
v. 停泊（现在分词）

e.en: The yacht slipped its {mooring} during the overnight storm.
e.zh: 游艇在夜里的暴风雨中脱离了系泊位。

e.en: He paid extra for a sheltered {mooring} in the harbor.
e.zh: 他多付了钱以获得港内一个避风的泊位。

moorish.t: adj. 摩尔人的；摩尔式的

e.en: The palace features stunning {Moorish} arches and tilework.
e.zh: 这座宫殿有令人惊叹的摩尔式拱门和瓷砖装饰。

e.en: Granada is famous for its {Moorish} architectural heritage.
e.zh: 格拉纳达以其摩尔式建筑遗产而闻名。

e.en: Heather covers the {moorland} in purple every August.
e.zh: 每年八月，石楠花把荒原染成一片紫色。

e.en: The novel is set on a windswept Yorkshire {moorland}.
e.zh: 这部小说的背景设定在风大的约克郡荒原。

moors.t:
n. 荒野（复数）
v. 停泊（第三人称单数）

e.en: Wuthering Heights takes place on the bleak Yorkshire {moors}.
e.zh: 《呼啸山庄》的故事发生在荒凉的约克郡旷野。

e.en: Hunters tramped across the heather-covered {moors} at dawn.
e.zh: 猎人们破晓时分穿过长满石楠的荒原。

e.en: A massive {moose} wandered onto the highway last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一只巨大的驼鹿走上了高速公路。

e.en: Tourists in Alaska hope to spot a wild {moose}.
e.zh: 在阿拉斯加的游客都希望能见到一只野生驼鹿。

moot.t:
adj. 有争议的；无实际意义的
v. 提出讨论

e.en: Whether to repaint is now {moot} since we're moving.
e.zh: 既然我们要搬家，重新刷漆已经没意义了。

e.en: Law students argued the case in {moot} court.
e.zh: 法学生在模拟法庭上就该案进行了辩论。

mop.t:
n. 拖把
v. 擦拭；拖地

e.en: Please {mop} the kitchen floor after dinner tonight.
e.zh: 今晚晚饭后请把厨房地板拖一下。

e.en: He grabbed a {mop} to clean up the spilled juice.
e.zh: 他抓起拖把去清理洒出来的果汁。

mope.t: v. 闷闷不乐；郁郁寡欢

e.en: Don't just {mope} around the house all weekend.
e.zh: 别整个周末都在家里闷闷不乐地晃悠。

e.en: He tends to {mope} whenever his team loses badly.
e.zh: 每当自己球队惨败，他都会闷闷不乐。

moped.t:
n. 轻便摩托车
v. 郁闷（过去式）

e.en: She rides her {moped} to work to avoid traffic.
e.zh: 她骑助力车上班以避开交通拥堵。

e.en: He {moped} around the apartment after losing his job.
e.zh: 丢了工作之后，他在公寓里闷闷不乐地晃来晃去。

e.en: The little {moppet} giggled while chasing the puppy.
e.zh: 那个小不点一边追着小狗一边咯咯笑。

e.en: She dressed her {moppet} in a tiny pumpkin costume.
e.zh: 她给小宝贝穿上小小的南瓜装。

mopping.t: v. 拖地；擦拭（现在分词）

e.en: He spent the morning {mopping} up after the leak.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在拖地清理漏水的痕迹。

e.en: She kept {mopping} sweat from her forehead during the run.
e.zh: 跑步时她不停地擦着额头上的汗。

mor.t: n. 粗腐殖质（林地表层）

e.en: Soil scientists call this acidic forest layer {mor} humus.
e.zh: 土壤学家把这种酸性森林土层称为粗腐殖质。

e.en: Pine forests typically produce a thick {mor} layer.
e.zh: 松林通常会形成厚厚的粗腐殖质层。

e.en: The glacier left a rocky {moraine} stretching across the valley.
e.zh: 冰川在山谷中留下了一道绵延的乱石冰碛。

e.en: Geologists studied the ancient {moraine} for climate clues.
e.zh: 地质学家研究这片古老的冰碛以寻找气候线索。

moral.t:
adj. 道德的
n. 寓意；道德准则

e.en: She faced a difficult {moral} dilemma at work.
e.zh: 她在工作中面临一个艰难的道德困境。

e.en: The {moral} of the story is to never give up.
e.zh: 这个故事的寓意是永不放弃。

e.en: Team {morale} dropped sharply after the layoffs.
e.zh: 裁员之后团队士气大幅下降。

e.en: Free lunches helped boost office {morale}.
e.zh: 免费午餐帮助提升了办公室士气。

e.en: Stop trying to {moralise} every casual conversation.
e.zh: 别动不动就把闲聊变成说教。

e.en: The columnist tends to {moralise} about modern life.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家喜欢对现代生活进行说教。

moralism.t: n. 道德说教；道德主义

e.en: His speech was full of empty {moralism}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了空洞的道德说教。

e.en: The film rejects easy {moralism} in favor of nuance.
e.zh: 这部电影拒绝简单的道德说教,倾向于呈现复杂性。

e.en: He's a strict {moralist} who judges everyone.
e.zh: 他是个严格的道德家,对每个人都评头论足。

e.en: The author writes as a thoughtful {moralist}.
e.zh: 这位作者以一位深思的道德家身份写作。

moralistic.t: adj. 说教的；好讲道德的

e.en: Her tone became {moralistic} and preachy.
e.zh: 她的语气变得说教而道貌岸然。

e.en: The novel avoids a {moralistic} ending.
e.zh: 这部小说避免了说教式的结局。

e.en: Different cultures have different {moralities}.
e.zh: 不同的文化有不同的道德观。

e.en: The book compares the {moralities} of two eras.
e.zh: 这本书比较了两个时代的道德观。

e.en: The debate centers on the {morality} of war.
e.zh: 辩论的焦点是战争的道德性。

e.en: Public {morality} has shifted in recent decades.
e.zh: 近几十年来公众的道德观念发生了变化。

e.en: Please don't {moralize} about my life choices.
e.zh: 请不要对我的人生选择说教。

e.en: He likes to {moralize} after a few drinks.
e.zh: 他喝了几杯之后就喜欢讲大道理。

moralizing.t:
n. 说教
adj. 爱说教的

e.en: I'm tired of his constant {moralizing}.
e.zh: 我受够了他没完没了的说教。

e.en: The essay slips into {moralizing} near the end.
e.zh: 这篇文章接近结尾时陷入了说教。

e.en: Cheating is {morally} wrong, plain and simple.
e.zh: 作弊在道德上就是错的,很简单。

e.en: She felt {morally} obligated to report the issue.
e.zh: 她觉得自己在道义上有责任举报此事。

e.en: He has strong {morals} and refuses to lie.
e.zh: 他道德观念很强,不愿说谎。

e.en: The scandal raised questions about company {morals}.
e.zh: 这场丑闻让人对公司的道德操守产生了质疑。

e.en: Let's {mosey} down to the cafe and grab a coffee.
e.zh: 咱们溜达到咖啡馆喝杯咖啡吧。

e.en: He likes to {mosey} through the park on weekends.
e.zh: 他喜欢周末在公园里慢慢闲逛。

mosh.t: v. 摇滚乐中激烈碰撞式舞蹈

e.en: Fans began to {mosh} as soon as the band started playing.
e.zh: 乐队一开始演奏,粉丝们就开始狂躁地相互冲撞。

e.en: The {mosh} pit at the metal concert was wild.
e.zh: 金属演唱会上的莫什坑场面非常疯狂。

e.en: She grew up on a {moshav} in northern Israel.
e.zh: 她在以色列北部的一个莫沙夫合作村长大。

e.en: The {moshav} sells fresh produce to nearby cities.
e.zh: 这个莫沙夫向附近城市出售新鲜农产品。

moslem.t: n. 穆斯林（Muslim 旧拼法）

e.en: The old text refers to a {moslem} traveler from Spain.
e.zh: 这本旧书提到一位来自西班牙的穆斯林旅行者。

e.en: Most modern style guides prefer Muslim over {moslem}.
e.zh: 现代写作规范多倾向使用Muslim而非moslem。

e.en: The blue {mosque} attracts thousands of tourists each year.
e.zh: 这座蓝色清真寺每年吸引数千名游客。

e.en: He stops by the {mosque} for evening prayers.
e.zh: 他顺路去清真寺做晚祷。

e.en: Istanbul has hundreds of historic {mosques}.
e.zh: 伊斯坦布尔有数百座历史悠久的清真寺。

e.en: Many {mosques} opened their doors during the festival.
e.zh: 许多清真寺在节日期间向公众开放。

e.en: A {mosquito} bit my ankle while I was reading outside.
e.zh: 我在外面看书时被蚊子咬了脚踝。

e.en: Use repellent to keep {mosquito} bites away.
e.zh: 用驱蚊剂可以避免被蚊子叮咬。

e.en: The swamp is full of {mosquitoes} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天沼泽里满是蚊子。

e.en: {Mosquitoes} can spread serious diseases like dengue.
e.zh: 蚊子会传播登革热等严重疾病。

e.en: Soft green {moss} covered the old stone wall.
e.zh: 柔软的绿色苔藓覆盖着古老的石墙。

e.en: A rolling stone gathers no {moss}, as the saying goes.
e.zh: 俗话说,滚石不生苔。

e.en: The novel features a former {mossad} agent turned consultant.
e.zh: 这本小说讲述一名前摩萨德特工转行做顾问的故事。

e.en: {Mossad} is Israel's national intelligence agency.
e.zh: 摩萨德是以色列的国家情报机构。

e.en: Different {mosses} grow on the shaded forest floor.
e.zh: 林荫地面上长着各种各样的苔藓。

e.en: Botanists study how {mosses} survive harsh winters.
e.zh: 植物学家研究苔藓如何熬过严冬。

e.en: We crossed a {mossy} log over the stream.
e.zh: 我们踩着一根长满青苔的木头过了溪流。

e.en: The cottage roof had turned dark and {mossy}.
e.zh: 小屋的屋顶已经变得又暗又长满青苔。

most.t:
adj. 大多数的
adv. 最

e.en: {Most} students finished the exam before time was up.
e.zh: 大多数学生在时间结束前就做完了考试。

e.en: This is the {most} useful app I've installed all year.
e.zh: 这是我今年装过最有用的应用。

mostar.t: n. 波黑城市莫斯塔尔

e.en: The famous bridge in {Mostar} was rebuilt after the war.
e.zh: 莫斯塔尔那座著名的桥在战后被重建。

e.en: We spent two days exploring the old town of {Mostar}.
e.zh: 我们花了两天时间游览莫斯塔尔老城。

e.en: My weekends are {mostly} spent reading and hiking.
e.zh: 我的周末大多用来看书和远足。

e.en: The audience was {mostly} students from the local college.
e.zh: 观众大多是当地大学的学生。

e.en: She ended her speech with a clever {mot} about politics.
e.zh: 她以一句关于政治的妙语结束了演讲。

e.en: His best {mot} that night had everyone laughing.
e.zh: 他那晚最妙的一句俏皮话把大家都逗笑了。

e.en: A tiny {mote} of dust floated through the sunbeam.
e.zh: 一粒微尘在阳光中飘过。

e.en: Not a single {mote} of doubt crossed her mind.
e.zh: 她心中没有丝毫怀疑。

e.en: We stayed at a roadside {motel} on the way to Vegas.
e.zh: 去拉斯维加斯的路上,我们住了一家路边汽车旅馆。

e.en: The {motel} sign flickered all night long.
e.zh: 汽车旅馆的招牌闪烁了一整夜。

motet.t: n. 经文歌（宗教合唱曲）

e.en: The choir performed a Renaissance {motet} beautifully.
e.zh: 合唱团动人地演唱了一首文艺复兴时期的经文歌。

e.en: He composed a short {motet} for the chapel service.
e.zh: 他为教堂礼拜创作了一首短小的经文歌。

e.en: A large {moth} fluttered around the porch light.
e.zh: 一只大飞蛾绕着门廊的灯飞舞。

e.en: She found a {moth} hole in her favorite sweater.
e.zh: 她在最爱的毛衣上发现了一个虫蛀的洞。

mothball.t:
v. 封存；搁置
n. 樟脑丸

e.en: The company decided to {mothball} the old factory indefinitely.
e.zh: 公司决定无限期封存这家老工厂。

e.en: Officials may {mothball} the project until funding returns.
e.zh: 官员们可能会暂停该项目,直到资金到位。

e.en: The navy {mothballed} several ships after the budget cuts.
e.zh: 预算削减后,海军封存了好几艘军舰。

e.en: That feature was {mothballed} when the team pivoted.
e.zh: 团队转型时这个功能就被搁置了。

mother.t:
n. 母亲
v. 抚育

e.en: My {mother} taught me how to bake bread from scratch.
e.zh: 我妈妈教我从头开始烤面包。

e.en: She became a {mother} for the first time last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天第一次当妈妈。

e.en: My {mother-in-law} brought homemade dumplings for dinner.
e.zh: 我婆婆带了自己做的饺子来吃晚饭。

e.en: He gets along surprisingly well with his {mother-in-law}.
e.zh: 他和岳母相处得出奇地好。

e.en: Both {mother-in-laws} attended the wedding rehearsal dinner.
e.zh: 两位婆婆都出席了婚礼彩排晚宴。

e.en: The sitcom features two competitive {mother-in-laws}.
e.zh: 这部情景喜剧讲了两个互相较劲的婆婆。

e.en: The new {motherboard} supports the latest generation of CPUs.
e.zh: 这块新主板支持最新一代的CPU。

e.en: A faulty {motherboard} can cause random system crashes.
e.zh: 主板出问题会导致系统随机崩溃。

e.en: That {motherfucker} cut me off in traffic again.
e.zh: 那个混蛋开车又抢我的道。

e.en: In the film, the hero shouts at the villain, you {motherfucker}.
e.zh: 电影里主角对反派大喊:你这个混蛋。

e.en: Get this {motherfucking} suitcase off my foot.
e.zh: 把这个该死的行李箱从我脚上挪开。

e.en: He spent the whole {motherfucking} day stuck in traffic.
e.zh: 他他妈的一整天都堵在路上。

e.en: {Motherhood} changed her priorities almost overnight.
e.zh: 为人母几乎一夜之间改变了她的优先顺序。

e.en: The book explores the joys and challenges of {motherhood}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了为人母的喜悦与挑战。

e.en: She has a gentle {mothering} style with her toddlers.
e.zh: 她对孩子的教养方式很温柔。

e.en: Stop {mothering} me—I can pack my own lunch.
e.zh: 别再婆婆妈妈了,我自己能装午餐。

e.en: After twenty years abroad, he finally returned to his {motherland}.
e.zh: 在国外二十年后,他终于回到了祖国。

e.en: The song is a heartfelt tribute to the {motherland}.
e.zh: 这首歌是对祖国深情的致敬。

e.en: Immigrants often miss the foods of their {motherlands}.
e.zh: 移民常常怀念祖国的味道。

e.en: The exhibit honors writers exiled from their {motherlands}.
e.zh: 展览致敬那些被迫离开祖国的作家。

e.en: The shelter takes in {motherless} kittens every spring.
e.zh: 这家庇护所每年春天都会收留失去母亲的小猫。

e.en: He grew up {motherless} after a tragic accident.
e.zh: 一场悲剧事故后,他从小就失去了母亲。

e.en: She gave me a {motherly} hug before I left.
e.zh: 我离开前她给了我一个慈母般的拥抱。

e.en: The nurse spoke in a warm, {motherly} tone.
e.zh: 护士用温暖慈爱的语气说话。

e.en: Working {mothers} often juggle careers and childcare.
e.zh: 职场妈妈常常要兼顾事业和带娃。

e.en: The app connects new {mothers} for support and advice.
e.zh: 这款应用让新手妈妈互相支持、交流经验。

e.en: The drones returned to the {mothership} after the mission.
e.zh: 任务结束后无人机返回了母舰。

e.en: Apple fans treat the Cupertino headquarters as the {mothership}.
e.zh: 苹果粉丝把库比蒂诺总部当作精神母舰。

motherwell.t: n. 苏格兰城镇马瑟韦尔

e.en: {Motherwell} is a town in Scotland near Glasgow.
e.zh: 马瑟韦尔是苏格兰格拉斯哥附近的一座城镇。

e.en: He's a lifelong supporter of {Motherwell} football club.
e.zh: 他一辈子都是马瑟韦尔足球俱乐部的球迷。

motif.t: n. 主题；母题；装饰图案

e.en: Loneliness is a recurring {motif} in her novels.
e.zh: 孤独是她小说中反复出现的主题。

e.en: The wallpaper has a delicate floral {motif}.
e.zh: 墙纸上有精致的花卉图案。

motile.t: adj. 能自行移动的（细胞等）

e.en: Healthy sperm cells are highly {motile} under the microscope.
e.zh: 健康的精子在显微镜下活动力很强。

e.en: Many bacteria are {motile} thanks to whip-like flagella.
e.zh: 许多细菌靠鞭毛获得运动能力。

motility.t: n. (细胞、生物体) 运动能力

e.en: The test measures the {motility} of the patient's sperm.
e.zh: 这项检测测量患者精子的活动力。

e.en: Reduced gut {motility} can cause uncomfortable bloating.
e.zh: 肠道蠕动减弱会引起难受的腹胀。

motion.t:
n. 运动；动作
v. 打手势示意

e.en: She made a quick {motion} for me to be quiet.
e.zh: 她迅速做了个手势让我安静。

e.en: The committee passed a {motion} to extend the deadline.
e.zh: 委员会通过了一项延长截止日期的动议。

motionless.t: adj. 静止的；一动不动的

e.en: The deer stood {motionless} as we passed on the trail.
e.zh: 我们走过小路时,那只鹿一动不动地站着。

e.en: He lay {motionless} on the couch, fast asleep.
e.zh: 他一动不动地躺在沙发上,睡得很熟。

e.en: The cat watched the bird {motionlessly} from the window.
e.zh: 那只猫一动不动地从窗户盯着鸟。

e.en: She sat {motionlessly} during the entire meditation session.
e.zh: 整场冥想她都纹丝不动地坐着。

e.en: He went through the {motions} of cooking without much enthusiasm.
e.zh: 他做饭时只是走过场,没什么热情。

e.en: The lawyer filed several {motions} before the trial.
e.zh: 律师在审判前提交了几份动议。

e.en: Good managers know how to {motivate} their teams.
e.zh: 好的管理者懂得如何激励团队。

e.en: Small daily wins can {motivate} you to keep going.
e.zh: 每天的小成就能激励你坚持下去。

motivated.t: adj. 有动力的；积极主动的

e.en: She's highly {motivated} to finish the project before vacation.
e.zh: 她非常有动力在休假前完成项目。

e.en: The students seemed more {motivated} after the field trip.
e.zh: 实地考察后学生们看起来更有干劲了。

motivates.t: v. 激励（第三人称单数）

e.en: What really {motivates} him is solving hard problems.
e.zh: 真正激励他的是解决难题。

e.en: A good coach {motivates} players without yelling.
e.zh: 好教练不靠吼叫就能激励球员。

motivating.t: adj. 激励人的，激发动力的

e.en: Her speech was surprisingly {motivating} for a Monday morning.
e.zh: 对于周一早上来说,她的演讲意外地鼓舞人心。

e.en: Tracking my steps is a {motivating} way to stay active.
e.zh: 记录步数是一种激励我保持运动的好方法。

e.en: I've lost all {motivation} to go to the gym lately.
e.zh: 我最近完全没有去健身房的动力了。

e.en: Her main {motivation} for learning Chinese is travel.
e.zh: 她学中文的主要动力是旅行。

motivational.t: adj. 激励的，鼓舞人心的

e.en: He listens to {motivational} podcasts during his morning run.
e.zh: 他晨跑时听励志播客。

e.en: The poster had a cheesy {motivational} quote about teamwork.
e.zh: 海报上写着一句俗套的团队励志名言。

e.en: For many people, money is a powerful {motivator}.
e.zh: 对许多人来说,金钱是强大的动力来源。

e.en: Fear of failure can be a surprisingly effective {motivator}.
e.zh: 对失败的恐惧有时是出奇有效的动力。

motive.t:
n. 动机，目的
adj. 推动的

e.en: Detectives are still searching for a clear {motive}.
e.zh: 侦探们仍在寻找明确的作案动机。

e.en: Her {motive} for helping wasn't entirely selfless.
e.zh: 她帮忙的动机并不完全出于无私。

motiveless.t: adj. 无缘无故的，无动机的

e.en: The detective called it a {motiveless} crime with no clear suspect.
e.zh: 侦探称这是一起没有明显动机的犯罪。

e.en: Her sudden anger seemed completely {motiveless} to everyone present.
e.zh: 在场所有人都觉得她突然发火毫无缘由。

e.en: Police are still investigating the suspect's {motives} for the attack.
e.zh: 警方仍在调查嫌疑人发动袭击的动机。

e.en: I question the company's {motives} behind this sudden donation.
e.zh: 我对该公司这次突然捐款背后的动机存疑。

e.en: The composer uses {motivic} development throughout the symphony's first movement.
e.zh: 作曲家在交响曲第一乐章中使用了主题动机的发展手法。

e.en: Scholars analyzed the {motivic} patterns in Beethoven's late quartets.
e.zh: 学者们分析了贝多芬晚期四重奏中的动机模式。

motley.t: adj. 混杂的，五花八门的

e.en: A {motley} crew of volunteers gathered to clean up the beach.
e.zh: 一群形形色色的志愿者聚在一起清理海滩。

e.en: The shop sold a {motley} collection of antiques and curiosities.
e.zh: 这家店出售各式各样的古董和奇珍异品。

moto.t: n. 摩托车；（音乐）快速的乐章

e.en: He ordered a {moto} taxi to beat the morning traffic.
e.zh: 他叫了一辆摩的来避开早高峰。

e.en: The pianist played the finale {moto} perpetuo with stunning energy.
e.zh: 钢琴家以惊人的活力演奏了无穷动般的终曲。

e.en: My brother competes in {motocross} races every weekend during summer.
e.zh: 我哥哥夏天每个周末都参加越野摩托车赛。

e.en: The {motocross} track was muddy after the heavy overnight rain.
e.zh: 经过一夜大雨,越野摩托车赛道变得泥泞不堪。

motor.t:
n. 马达，发动机
adj. 机动的

e.en: The electric {motor} hummed quietly as the elevator descended.
e.zh: 电梯下行时电动机发出轻微的嗡嗡声。

e.en: Children develop fine {motor} skills through drawing and play.
e.zh: 孩子们通过画画和玩耍发展精细动作技能。

e.en: He rode his {motorbike} along the coastal highway last weekend.
e.zh: 他上周末骑着摩托车沿着海滨公路兜风。

e.en: My {motorbike} broke down on the way to work today.
e.zh: 我的摩托车今天上班路上抛锚了。

e.en: Several {motorbikes} were parked outside the busy café downtown.
e.zh: 几辆摩托车停在市中心那家热闹咖啡馆外面。

e.en: Modern electric {motorbikes} are quieter than traditional gasoline ones.
e.zh: 现代电动摩托车比传统燃油摩托车安静得多。

e.en: They rented a small {motorboat} for fishing on the lake.
e.zh: 他们租了一艘小汽艇在湖上钓鱼。

e.en: The {motorboat} sped across the bay leaving a white wake.
e.zh: 汽艇飞驰过海湾,留下一道白色的航迹。

e.en: The president's {motorcade} drove slowly through the cheering crowd.
e.zh: 总统的车队缓缓驶过欢呼的人群。

e.en: Police closed several streets to make way for the {motorcade}.
e.zh: 警方封锁了几条街道为车队让路。

e.en: His grandfather restored a vintage {motorcar} from the 1920s.
e.zh: 他爷爷修复了一辆20世纪20年代的老爷车。

e.en: Early {motorcar} owners had to crank the engine by hand.
e.zh: 早期的汽车车主必须用手摇启动发动机。

e.en: The tour group traveled by {motorcoach} from Paris to Amsterdam.
e.zh: 旅行团乘坐大巴从巴黎前往阿姆斯特丹。

e.en: Our luxury {motorcoach} had reclining seats and onboard Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 我们的豪华大巴配有可斜躺座椅和车载无线网络。

e.en: He rides his {motorcycle} to work every morning, rain or shine.
e.zh: 无论晴雨,他每天早上都骑摩托车上班。

e.en: Wearing a helmet on a {motorcycle} can save your life.
e.zh: 骑摩托车戴头盔可以救你一命。

e.en: Vintage {motorcycles} can sell for tens of thousands of dollars.
e.zh: 古董摩托车可以卖到几万美元。

e.en: The street was lined with shiny new {motorcycles} for sale.
e.zh: 街边停满了一排排崭新闪亮的待售摩托车。

e.en: He took up {motorcycling} after retiring from his desk job.
e.zh: 他从办公室工作退休后开始迷上骑摩托车。

e.en: {Motorcycling} through the mountain passes was an unforgettable experience.
e.zh: 骑摩托车穿越山口是一次难忘的经历。

e.en: A {motorcyclist} was injured in the accident on the highway.
e.zh: 一名摩托车手在高速公路事故中受伤。

e.en: The {motorcyclist} waved cheerfully as he passed our car.
e.zh: 摩托车手经过我们车旁时愉快地挥了挥手。

e.en: They bought a {motorhome} and toured the country last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天买了一辆房车环游全国。

e.en: Our {motorhome} has a kitchen, bathroom, and sleeps six people.
e.zh: 我们的房车有厨房、卫生间,可以睡六个人。

e.en: The therapy targets {motoric} delays in young children with autism.
e.zh: 该疗法针对自闭症幼儿的运动发育迟缓。

e.en: His {motoric} responses slowed noticeably after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后他的运动反应明显变慢了。

e.en: He writes a weekly column for a popular {motoring} magazine.
e.zh: 他为一本热门汽车杂志撰写每周专栏。

e.en: We spent the afternoon {motoring} along the scenic coastal road.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都开车沿着风景优美的海岸公路兜风。

e.en: The factory uses {motorised} conveyor belts to move heavy parts.
e.zh: 工厂使用电动传送带搬运重型零件。

e.en: Elderly residents often rely on {motorised} scooters for mobility.
e.zh: 老年居民出行常常依赖电动代步车。

motorist.t: n. 开汽车的人，驾车者

e.en: A passing {motorist} stopped to help change my flat tire.
e.zh: 一位路过的司机停下来帮我换爆胎。

e.en: Every {motorist} must carry valid insurance and a driver's license.
e.zh: 每位驾车者都必须携带有效的保险和驾照。

e.en: Heavy fog forced {motorists} to slow down on the highway.
e.zh: 浓雾迫使司机们在高速公路上减速行驶。

e.en: Local {motorists} complain about the worsening traffic congestion downtown.
e.zh: 当地司机抱怨市中心的交通拥堵日益恶化。

motorized.t: adj. 装有发动机的；机动化的

e.en: He uses a {motorized} wheelchair to get around the campus.
e.zh: 他使用电动轮椅在校园里活动。

e.en: The blinds are fully {motorized} and controlled by a smartphone.
e.zh: 百叶窗完全电动化,可通过智能手机控制。

e.en: The subway {motorman} announced the next station over the intercom.
e.zh: 地铁司机通过对讲机报出下一站的站名。

e.en: An experienced {motorman} can stop the train within meters.
e.zh: 经验丰富的电车司机可以在几米内将列车停稳。

motormouth.t: n. 话多的人，喋喋不休者

e.en: My cousin is such a {motormouth} that nobody else can speak.
e.zh: 我表弟话太多,别人根本插不上嘴。

e.en: The radio host is a charming {motormouth} who never pauses.
e.zh: 这位电台主持人是个迷人的话痨,从不停顿。

motorola.t: n. 摩托罗拉（公司/品牌）

e.en: My first cell phone was a flip {Motorola} from 2004.
e.zh: 我的第一部手机是2004年的摩托罗拉翻盖机。

e.en: {Motorola} once dominated the global mobile phone market entirely.
e.zh: 摩托罗拉曾一度完全主导全球手机市场。

e.en: Electric {motors} are far more efficient than gasoline engines.
e.zh: 电动机比汽油发动机效率高得多。

e.en: General {Motors} announced plans to release several new electric vehicles.
e.zh: 通用汽车宣布了发布多款新型电动车的计划。

e.en: Formula One remains the most prestigious {motorsport} in the world.
e.zh: 一级方程式仍是世界上最负盛名的赛车运动。

e.en: He has been a {motorsport} fan since he was eight.
e.zh: 他从八岁起就是个赛车运动迷。

e.en: There was a major accident on the {motorway} this morning.
e.zh: 今早高速公路上发生了一起严重事故。

e.en: We took the {motorway} to save time on our trip.
e.zh: 为了节省时间,我们走了高速公路。

e.en: British {motorways} are usually toll-free, unlike many in Europe.
e.zh: 与欧洲许多国家不同,英国的高速公路通常不收费。

e.en: Heavy snow has closed several {motorways} across northern England.
e.zh: 大雪导致英格兰北部多条高速公路关闭。

motown.t: n. 摩城（底特律；摩城唱片风格）

e.en: My parents grew up dancing to classic {Motown} hits together.
e.zh: 我父母从小一起跟着经典的摩城金曲跳舞。

e.en: The band covered several {Motown} songs at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 乐队在婚礼上翻唱了好几首摩城金曲。

motte.t: n. 城堡土丘（中世纪城堡地基）

e.en: The Norman castle stood atop an artificial earthen {motte}.
e.zh: 那座诺曼城堡矗立在一座人工土丘之上。

e.en: Archaeologists excavated the medieval {motte} and bailey site last summer.
e.zh: 考古学家去年夏天发掘了那座中世纪的城堡土丘遗址。

mottle.t:
n. 斑点
v. 使呈斑驳状

e.en: Sunlight through the leaves {mottle} the forest floor with patterns.
e.zh: 阳光透过树叶,在林地上洒下斑驳的图案。

e.en: Age and humidity began to {mottle} the old paper photographs.
e.zh: 岁月和潮气开始让那些旧照片出现斑驳的色块。

e.en: The {mottled} gray cat blended perfectly with the stone wall.
e.zh: 那只灰色斑纹猫和石墙完美地融为一体。

e.en: Her skin looked {mottled} and red from the cold wind.
e.zh: 她的皮肤被寒风吹得红一块白一块。

mottling.t:
n. 斑驳花纹
v. 使起斑点

e.en: The {mottling} on the leaves indicates a possible fungal infection.
e.zh: 叶子上的斑驳可能表明感染了真菌。

e.en: Decorators created subtle {mottling} on the wall using sponges.
e.zh: 装饰师用海绵在墙上做出了微妙的斑驳效果。

e.en: Her personal {motto} is "progress, not perfection."
e.zh: 她的个人座右铭是"求进步,不求完美"。

e.en: The school's {motto} is engraved above the main entrance.
e.zh: 学校的校训刻在正门上方。

e.en: Each scout troop has its own colorful banner and {mottoes}.
e.zh: 每个童子军小队都有自己彩色的旗帜和格言。

e.en: Old family {mottoes} were often written in Latin.
e.zh: 古老的家族箴言通常是用拉丁文写的。

e.en: She made a small {moue} of disappointment when dessert ended.
e.zh: 甜点结束时,她略带失望地撅了撅嘴。

e.en: He answered with a {moue} of distaste at the suggestion.
e.zh: 他对这个提议做了个嫌恶的撇嘴回应。

mould.t:
n. 霉；模具
v. 塑造

e.en: There's black {mould} growing in the bathroom corner again.
e.zh: 浴室角落里又长出了黑霉。

e.en: The chef poured the chocolate into a heart-shaped {mould}.
e.zh: 厨师把巧克力倒入一个心形模具中。

moulded.t:
adj. 模制的
v. 塑造（过去式）

e.en: His childhood experiences {moulded} him into a compassionate doctor.
e.zh: 童年经历把他塑造成了一位富有同情心的医生。

e.en: The artist {moulded} the clay into a graceful figure.
e.zh: 艺术家把黏土捏成了一个优雅的人形。

moulder.t:
v. 渐渐腐朽
n. 造型工

e.en: Old letters {moulder} in boxes in the damp attic.
e.zh: 旧信件在潮湿的阁楼箱子里慢慢发霉腐烂。

e.en: Forgotten manuscripts {moulder} away on the library's lowest shelves.
e.zh: 被遗忘的手稿在图书馆最底层的书架上慢慢腐朽。

mouldering.t: adj. 正在腐朽的，发霉的

e.en: We found a {mouldering} pile of newspapers in the basement.
e.zh: 我们在地下室发现了一堆发霉腐烂的报纸。

e.en: The {mouldering} barn was finally torn down last spring.
e.zh: 那座破旧腐朽的谷仓终于在去年春天被拆除了。

moulding.t:
n. (建筑) 线脚、装饰线条
v. 塑造 (mould 的变形)

e.en: Decorative {moulding} runs along the top of every room's walls.
e.zh: 装饰线条沿着每个房间的墙顶延伸。

e.en: Good teachers play a vital role in {moulding} young minds.
e.zh: 好老师在塑造青少年心灵方面起着至关重要的作用。

moulds.t:
n. 模具；霉菌
v. 塑造

e.en: She uses silicone {moulds} to make homemade chocolate truffles.
e.zh: 她用硅胶模具制作自制的巧克力松露。

e.en: Several {moulds} grow naturally on damp bread within days.
e.zh: 几种霉菌会在几天内自然地长在潮湿的面包上。

e.en: I threw out the {mouldy} bread I forgot in the cupboard.
e.zh: 我把忘在橱柜里发霉的面包扔了。

e.en: The basement smelled damp and {mouldy} after the recent flooding.
e.zh: 最近发洪水后,地下室闻起来又潮又霉。

e.en: We ordered {moule} frites at the small Belgian bistro.
e.zh: 我们在那家比利时小餐馆点了贻贝配薯条。

e.en: Fresh {moule} from the coast taste incredible with white wine.
e.zh: 沿海地区的新鲜贻贝配白葡萄酒味道好极了。

moulin.t: n. 冰川竖井（冰川学术语）

e.en: The famous Paris cabaret {Moulin} Rouge attracts tourists every night.
e.zh: 巴黎著名的红磨坊夜总会每晚都吸引着大批游客。

e.en: A deep glacial {moulin} carried meltwater down through the ice.
e.zh: 一个深深的冰川竖井把融水向下输送到冰层之中。

moult.t:
v. 换毛、蜕皮
n. 换羽期

e.en: Snakes {moult} their skin several times each year as they grow.
e.zh: 蛇在生长过程中每年要蜕皮好几次。

e.en: Our parrot begins to {moult} feathers every autumn without fail.
e.zh: 我们家鹦鹉每年秋天都会准时开始换羽。

mound.t:
n. 土堆、小丘
v. 堆成堆

e.en: She placed a generous {mound} of mashed potatoes on his plate.
e.zh: 她在他盘里堆了一大团土豆泥。

e.en: Archaeologists are excavating an ancient burial {mound} near the river.
e.zh: 考古学家正在河边发掘一座古代墓葬土丘。

mounded.t: v. 堆积成丘状 (mound 过去式)

e.en: The chef {mounded} mashed potatoes onto each plate.
e.zh: 厨师把土豆泥堆在每个盘子上。

e.en: Snow {mounded} against the side of the garage overnight.
e.zh: 雪一夜之间在车库旁边堆成了一堆。

mounding.t:
v. 堆成丘状
n. 筑丘

e.en: She is {mounding} soil around the tomato plants.
e.zh: 她正在番茄植株周围培土。

e.en: The shrub has a nice {mounding} shape in summer.
e.zh: 这种灌木在夏天呈现出漂亮的圆丘形。

mount.t:
v. 挂载（磁盘）；安装；登上
n. 山；支架

e.en: Tensions {mount} as the deadline approaches.
e.zh: 随着截止日期临近,紧张气氛不断加剧。

e.en: You can {mount} the camera on a tripod.
e.zh: 你可以把相机装到三脚架上。

e.en: We hiked up the {mountain} before sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出前徒步登上了那座山。

e.en: I have a {mountain} of laundry to do today.
e.zh: 我今天有堆积如山的衣服要洗。

e.en: The {mountaineer} reached the summit just before dark.
e.zh: 那位登山者在天黑前登上了山顶。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {mountaineer}.
e.zh: 她训练了多年才成为一名职业登山家。

e.en: He took up {mountaineering} after college.
e.zh: 他大学毕业后开始迷上登山。

e.en: {Mountaineering} requires careful planning and good gear.
e.zh: 登山需要周密的计划和好的装备。

e.en: Several {mountaineers} were rescued from the storm.
e.zh: 几名登山者从暴风雪中获救。

e.en: Experienced {mountaineers} always check the weather forecast.
e.zh: 有经验的登山者总会查看天气预报。

e.en: The northern region is cold and {mountainous}.
e.zh: 北部地区寒冷且多山。

e.en: She faced a {mountainous} pile of paperwork on Monday.
e.zh: 周一她面对的是堆积如山的文件。

e.en: The {mountains} look beautiful in the morning light.
e.zh: 清晨的阳光下,群山显得格外美丽。

e.en: We're driving to the {mountains} this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末我们要开车去山里。

e.en: Wildflowers covered the entire {mountainside} in spring.
e.zh: 春天的时候,野花开满了整个山坡。

e.en: A small village clings to the steep {mountainside}.
e.zh: 一个小村庄依附在陡峭的山坡上。

e.en: From the {mountaintop} you can see three countries.
e.zh: 从山顶上可以看到三个国家。

e.en: They built a tiny chapel on the {mountaintop}.
e.zh: 他们在山顶上建了一座小教堂。

e.en: Snow still covers the distant {mountaintops} in May.
e.zh: 五月时,远处的山顶上仍覆盖着积雪。

e.en: The drone flew between the cloud-wrapped {mountaintops}.
e.zh: 无人机在云雾缭绕的山顶之间飞行。

mountebank.t: n. 江湖郎中、招摇撞骗者

e.en: Critics called the self-help guru a shameless {mountebank}.
e.zh: 批评者称那位励志大师是个无耻的江湖骗子。

e.en: The old {mountebank} sold fake medicine in every town.
e.zh: 那个老江湖术士在每个镇上都卖假药。

mounted.t:
adj. 已安装的；骑马的
v. 登上 (mount 过去式)

e.en: He {mounted} the new TV above the fireplace.
e.zh: 他把新电视安装在了壁炉上方。

e.en: Pressure {mounted} on the CEO to resign.
e.zh: 要求首席执行官辞职的压力越来越大。

mounting.t:
n. 安装、支架
adj. 不断增加的

e.en: There is {mounting} evidence that the drug works.
e.zh: 越来越多的证据表明这种药物是有效的。

e.en: The technician is {mounting} a camera on the wall.
e.zh: 技术员正在把摄像头安装到墙上。

mountjoy.t: n. 蒙特乔伊（姓氏/地名）

e.en: They drove past {Mountjoy} prison on the way home.
e.zh: 他们回家路上经过了蒙乔伊监狱。

e.en: The poet was once held in {Mountjoy} for protesting.
e.zh: 那位诗人曾因抗议被关在蒙乔伊监狱。

mounts.t:
v. 安装、登上
n. 支架

e.en: Excitement {mounts} as the concert begins.
e.zh: 演唱会开始时,激动的情绪不断高涨。

e.en: This bracket {mounts} easily on any wall.
e.zh: 这个支架可以轻松安装在任何墙上。

e.en: The whole country paused to {mourn} the late president.
e.zh: 全国上下都停下来悼念已故的总统。

e.en: It's natural to {mourn} the loss of an old friend.
e.zh: 为失去老朋友而悲伤是很自然的。

mourne.t: n. 莫恩（北爱尔兰山脉名）

e.en: The {Mourne} Mountains are a popular hiking destination.
e.zh: 莫恩山脉是热门的徒步旅行胜地。

e.en: We rented a cottage near the {Mourne} coast.
e.zh: 我们在莫恩海岸附近租了一间小屋。

e.en: Fans around the world {mourned} the singer's sudden death.
e.zh: 全世界的歌迷都为这位歌手的突然去世感到悲痛。

e.en: She quietly {mourned} her childhood dog for weeks.
e.zh: 她默默地为儿时的爱犬伤心了好几周。

e.en: Each {mourner} placed a white rose on the casket.
e.zh: 每位送葬者在棺木上放了一朵白玫瑰。

e.en: A lone {mourner} stood beside the grave in the rain.
e.zh: 一位孤独的送葬者站在雨中的墓旁。

e.en: The dog gave a {mournful} look as we left.
e.zh: 我们离开时,狗用哀伤的眼神望着我们。

e.en: A {mournful} melody drifted from the old piano.
e.zh: 一段哀伤的旋律从那架旧钢琴上飘出。

e.en: The wind howled {mournfully} through the empty streets.
e.zh: 风在空荡的街道上凄凉地呼啸着。

e.en: He {mournfully} packed up his late father's books.
e.zh: 他悲伤地收拾起亡父留下的书籍。

mourning.t:
n. 哀悼、服丧
v. 悲痛

e.en: The family is still in {mourning} a year later.
e.zh: 一年过去了,这家人仍处在哀悼之中。

e.en: She wore black, {mourning} the loss of her grandmother.
e.zh: 她身着黑衣,为祖母的去世哀悼。

mourns.t: v. 哀悼 (mourn 第三人称单数)

e.en: The community {mourns} the loss of its beloved teacher.
e.zh: 整个社区都在悼念他们敬爱的老师。

e.en: He still {mourns} the dog he had as a child.
e.zh: 他至今仍怀念童年时养的那只狗。

e.en: My wireless {mouse} ran out of battery again.
e.zh: 我的无线鼠标又没电了。

e.en: A small {mouse} darted across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 一只小老鼠从厨房地板上飞快地窜过。

e.en: He set a {mousetrap} behind the refrigerator.
e.zh: 他在冰箱后面放了一个捕鼠器。

e.en: The deal turned out to be a clever {mousetrap}.
e.zh: 这笔交易结果是一个精心设计的陷阱。

moussaka.t: n. 慕沙卡（希腊茄子肉末菜）

e.en: Her grandmother makes the best {moussaka} in the village.
e.zh: 她奶奶做的慕沙卡是全村最好吃的。

e.en: We ordered {moussaka} and a Greek salad for dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐点了慕沙卡和一份希腊沙拉。

mousse.t: n. 慕斯（甜品）；摩丝（发胶）

e.en: Save room for the chocolate {mousse} for dessert.
e.zh: 留点肚子吃甜点的巧克力慕斯。

e.en: He uses a little {mousse} to style his hair.
e.zh: 他用一点定型摩丝来打理头发。

e.en: He grew a thick {moustache} during the lockdown.
e.zh: 封锁期间他留了一撮浓密的胡子。

e.en: The waiter had a perfectly curled {moustache}.
e.zh: 那位服务员留着两撇卷得整整齐齐的胡子。

e.en: A {moustached} officer checked our passports at the border.
e.zh: 一位留着胡子的警官在边境检查了我们的护照。

e.en: The portrait shows a {moustached} man in uniform.
e.zh: 肖像中是一位身着制服、留着胡子的男士。

e.en: Both brothers grew matching {moustaches} for charity.
e.zh: 两兄弟为了慈善活动都留起了一样的胡子。

e.en: Old photos show soldiers with elaborate {moustaches}.
e.zh: 老照片里的士兵都留着精心修饰的胡子。

e.en: She dyed her {mousy} brown hair a bright red.
e.zh: 她把那头暗淡的棕发染成了亮红色。

e.en: He was a quiet, {mousy} kid in high school.
e.zh: 他在高中时是个安静、怯懦的小孩。

mouth.t:
n. 嘴、口；河口
v. 口型说话

e.en: Open your {mouth} wide and say ah.
e.zh: 把嘴张大,说"啊"。

e.en: They camped near the {mouth} of the river.
e.zh: 他们在河口附近露营。

mouthful.t: n. 一口（的量）；拗口的词

e.en: He took a big {mouthful} of soup and smiled.
e.zh: 他大口喝了一勺汤,笑了起来。

e.en: That scientific name is quite a {mouthful}.
e.zh: 那个科学名称可真是拗口。

mouthing.t: v. 用口型说；假意说出

e.en: She was {mouthing} the words to the song silently.
e.zh: 她无声地跟着歌曲对口型。

e.en: Stop {mouthing} off to your sister at dinner.
e.zh: 吃饭时别对你妹妹顶嘴了。

e.en: The mosquito's {mouthpart} pierces skin like a tiny needle.
e.zh: 蚊子的口器像细针一样刺入皮肤。

e.en: Each {mouthpart} of the beetle has a different function.
e.zh: 甲虫的每一个口器部件都有不同的功能。

mouthpiece.t: n. 代言人；（乐器）吹口；话筒

e.en: He cleaned the saxophone {mouthpiece} after every practice.
e.zh: 每次练习后他都会清洁萨克斯的吹嘴。

e.en: The newspaper became a {mouthpiece} for the ruling party.
e.zh: 那份报纸成了执政党的喉舌。

mouths.t:
n. 嘴 (复数)
v. 做口型

e.en: The children covered their {mouths} when they laughed.
e.zh: 孩子们笑的时候用手捂住嘴。

e.en: She has three hungry {mouths} to feed at home.
e.zh: 她家里有三张嗷嗷待哺的嘴。

e.en: I rinse with {mouthwash} every night before bed.
e.zh: 我每晚睡前都会用漱口水漱口。

e.en: The dentist recommended a fluoride {mouthwash}.
e.zh: 牙医推荐了一款含氟漱口水。

mouthwatering.t: adj. 令人垂涎的；美味诱人的

e.en: The bakery had a {mouthwatering} display of fresh pastries.
e.zh: 那家面包店摆满了让人垂涎欲滴的新鲜糕点。

e.en: She posted a {mouthwatering} photo of her steak dinner.
e.zh: 她发了一张令人垂涎的牛排晚餐照片。

e.en: His {mouthy} little brother got him into trouble.
e.zh: 他那爱顶嘴的弟弟害他惹上了麻烦。

e.en: The coach benched the {mouthy} player for one game.
e.zh: 教练把那个嘴贱的球员罚下场一场比赛。

mouton.t: n. 加工过的绵羊毛皮

e.en: Her vintage coat was lined with soft {mouton} fur.
e.zh: 她那件复古大衣内衬着柔软的羊羔毛。

e.en: The auction featured a rare bottle of Château {Mouton}.
e.zh: 拍卖会上有一瓶稀有的木桐酒庄葡萄酒。

e.en: All the furniture in the office is {movable}.
e.zh: 办公室里所有的家具都是可移动的。

e.en: Easter is a {movable} holiday on the calendar.
e.zh: 复活节在日历上是个不固定的节日。

move.t:
v. 移动；搬家
n. 举动；步骤

e.en: We plan to {move} to Berlin next summer.
e.zh: 我们打算明年夏天搬去柏林。

e.en: That speech really did {move} the audience to tears.
e.zh: 那场演讲真的把观众感动得落泪。

moveable.t: adj. 可移动的（movable 的异体）

e.en: The desk has a {moveable} drawer for hidden storage.
e.zh: 这张桌子有一个可移动的抽屉作为隐藏储物空间。

e.en: Set up a {moveable} feast in the garden tonight.
e.zh: 今晚在花园里办一场流动的盛宴吧。

moved.t:
adj. 受感动的
v. 移动（过去式）

e.en: I was deeply {moved} by her acceptance speech.
e.zh: 她的获奖感言让我深受感动。

e.en: They {moved} into the new apartment last weekend.
e.zh: 他们上周末搬进了新公寓。

movement.t: n. 运动；动作；（社会）运动

e.en: The civil rights {movement} changed American history forever.
e.zh: 民权运动永远改变了美国历史。

e.en: Any sudden {movement} might scare the deer away.
e.zh: 任何突然的动作都可能把鹿吓跑。

movements.t: n. 动向；举动；运动（复数）

e.en: Yoga teaches you to control your breathing and {movements}.
e.zh: 瑜伽教你控制呼吸和身体动作。

e.en: Several political {movements} emerged from that decade.
e.zh: 那十年间涌现出多个政治运动。

e.en: We hired a professional {mover} to handle the piano.
e.zh: 我们请了专业的搬运工来搬钢琴。

e.en: She's a real shaker and {mover} in the tech industry.
e.zh: 她在科技行业里是个真正的活跃人物。

movers.t: n. 搬家公司；搬运工（复数）

e.en: The {movers} arrived early to load the truck.
e.zh: 搬家工人一大早就到了开始装车。

e.en: Tech startups are the real {movers} in this market.
e.zh: 科技初创公司才是这个市场的真正推动者。

moves.t:
n. 动作；招数（复数）
v. 移动（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {moves} to a new city every two years.
e.zh: 她每两年就搬到一个新城市。

e.en: His chess {moves} surprised even the grandmaster.
e.zh: 他的下棋走法连大师都感到意外。

e.en: We watched a horror {movie} last night at home.
e.zh: 我们昨晚在家看了一部恐怖电影。

e.en: The {movie} broke box office records this weekend.
e.zh: 这部电影本周末打破了票房纪录。

e.en: The average {moviegoer} prefers action films over dramas.
e.zh: 普通观众更喜欢动作片而不是文艺片。

e.en: Every dedicated {moviegoer} knows that theater downtown.
e.zh: 每个忠实影迷都知道市中心那家影院。

e.en: She became a successful {moviemaker} after film school.
e.zh: 她从电影学院毕业后成了一名成功的电影制作人。

e.en: The young {moviemaker} won an award at Sundance.
e.zh: 这位年轻的电影人在圣丹斯电影节获奖。

e.en: Streaming services have changed how we watch {movies}.
e.zh: 流媒体服务改变了我们看电影的方式。

e.en: Let's go to the {movies} this Friday night.
e.zh: 我们这周五晚上去看电影吧。

moving.t:
adj. 感人的；移动的
n. 搬家

e.en: Her speech was deeply {moving} and brought tears.
e.zh: 她的演讲非常感人,让人热泪盈眶。

e.en: We're {moving} to Shanghai next month for work.
e.zh: 我们下个月因为工作要搬去上海。

e.en: He spoke {movingly} about his late grandmother.
e.zh: 他动情地谈起了已故的祖母。

e.en: The author writes {movingly} about wartime childhood.
e.zh: 作者深情地描写了战时的童年生活。

e.en: I need to {mow} the lawn this weekend.
e.zh: 这周末我得把草坪割一下。

e.en: He uses an electric machine to {mow} the grass.
e.zh: 他用电动割草机修剪草坪。

mowed.t: v. 割草（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Dad {mowed} the backyard before the barbecue started.
e.zh: 烧烤开始前爸爸把后院的草割了。

e.en: She {mowed} down obstacles on her way to victory.
e.zh: 她一路扫除障碍,最终获得胜利。

e.en: The {mower} broke down halfway through the yard.
e.zh: 割草机割到一半就坏了。

e.en: He bought a robotic {mower} to save time.
e.zh: 他买了一台机器人割草机来节省时间。

mowing.t:
v. 割草（进行时）
n. 刈草

e.en: He spent Saturday morning {mowing} the front lawn.
e.zh: 他周六上午一直在割前院的草。

e.en: The sound of {mowing} woke me up early.
e.zh: 割草的声音一大早就把我吵醒了。

mown.t: v. 割（mow 的过去分词）

e.en: The freshly {mown} grass smelled amazing.
e.zh: 刚割过的青草闻起来真香。

e.en: She walked across the newly {mown} field.
e.zh: 她走过那片刚刚修整过的草地。

e.en: That kid has real {moxie} standing up to bullies.
e.zh: 那孩子敢和恶霸对抗,真有勇气。

e.en: It takes {moxie} to launch a startup alone.
e.zh: 独自创业需要十足的胆识。

mozambican.t:
adj. 莫桑比克的
n. 莫桑比克人

e.en: She's a {mozambican} chef famous for seafood dishes.
e.zh: 她是一位以海鲜菜闻名的莫桑比克厨师。

e.en: The {mozambican} coastline attracts divers from everywhere.
e.zh: 莫桑比克的海岸线吸引着各地的潜水爱好者。

e.en: {Mozambique} has beautiful beaches along the Indian Ocean.
e.zh: 莫桑比克沿印度洋有着美丽的海滩。

e.en: Portuguese is the official language of {Mozambique}.
e.zh: 葡萄牙语是莫桑比克的官方语言。

e.en: {Mozart} composed his first symphony at age eight.
e.zh: 莫扎特八岁时就创作了他的第一部交响曲。

e.en: The pianist played a {Mozart} sonata beautifully.
e.zh: 钢琴家将莫扎特的奏鸣曲演奏得十分动人。

e.en: Fresh {mozzarella} makes the best Caprese salad.
e.zh: 新鲜的马苏里拉奶酪能做出最美味的卡布里沙拉。

e.en: He sprinkled {mozzarella} on top of the pizza.
e.zh: 他在披萨上撒了一层马苏里拉奶酪。

mpa.t: n. 兆帕斯卡（压强单位）

e.en: The steel beam can withstand 400 {MPa} of stress.
e.zh: 这根钢梁能承受400兆帕的应力。

e.en: Concrete strength is usually measured in {MPa}.
e.zh: 混凝土强度通常以兆帕为单位。

mpg.t: n. 每加仑英里数（油耗单位）

e.en: My new hybrid gets fifty {mpg} on the highway.
e.zh: 我的新混合动力车在高速上每加仑能跑五十英里。

e.en: Compact cars usually have higher {mpg} than SUVs.
e.zh: 紧凑型车的油耗表现通常比SUV更好。

mph.t: n. 英里每小时（速度单位）

e.en: The speed limit here is sixty-five {mph}.
e.zh: 这里的限速是每小时65英里。

e.en: He was driving ninety {mph} when police stopped him.
e.zh: 警察拦下他时,他正以每小时90英里的速度行驶。

e.en: She finished her {MPhil} at Cambridge last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天在剑桥完成了哲学硕士学位。

e.en: The {MPhil} program usually takes two years to complete.
e.zh: 哲学硕士项目通常需要两年才能完成。

e.en: British {MPs} debated the new bill for hours.
e.zh: 英国议员们就新法案辩论了好几个小时。

e.en: Several {MPs} voted against the prime minister's plan.
e.zh: 多名议员投票反对首相的计划。

mrc.t: n. 医学研究理事会（Medical Research Council）

e.en: The {MRC} funded her cancer research project.
e.zh: 医学研究委员会资助了她的癌症研究项目。

e.en: She received an {MRC} grant for clinical trials.
e.zh: 她获得了医学研究委员会的临床试验资助。

mrd.t: n. 微小残留病灶（医学）

e.en: Doctors test for {MRD} after leukemia treatment.
e.zh: 医生在白血病治疗后会检测微小残留病灶。

e.en: Lower {MRD} levels indicate a better prognosis.
e.zh: 微小残留病灶水平越低,预后越好。

e.en: The doctor ordered an {MRI} scan of his knee.
e.zh: 医生给他的膝盖开了核磁共振检查。

e.en: An {MRI} can detect tumors that x-rays miss.
e.zh: 核磁共振可以发现X光检测不到的肿瘤。

e.en: {mRNA} vaccines proved highly effective against the virus.
e.zh: 信使RNA疫苗对该病毒展现出极高的效果。

e.en: Scientists study how {mRNA} carries genetic instructions.
e.zh: 科学家研究信使RNA如何传递遗传指令。

mrp.t: n. 物料需求计划（Material Requirements Planning）

e.en: The product's {MRP} is printed on the back.
e.zh: 产品的最高零售价印在包装背面。

e.en: Retailers cannot legally charge above the {MRP}.
e.zh: 零售商不得依法超过最高零售价销售。

e.en: {Mrs.} Chen teaches math at the local high school.
e.zh: 陈太太在当地高中教数学。

e.en: Please address the letter to {Mrs.} Johnson.
e.zh: 请把信寄给约翰逊夫人。

e.en: He earned an {MSc} in computer science last year.
e.zh: 他去年取得了计算机科学的理学硕士学位。

e.en: The {MSc} program requires a thesis defense.
e.zh: 理学硕士项目要求进行论文答辩。

e.en: The system responds in under fifty {msec}.
e.zh: 系统的响应时间在五十毫秒以内。

e.en: Network latency rose to two hundred {msec}.
e.zh: 网络延迟上升到了两百毫秒。

msf.t: n. 多国部队；无国界医生（缩写，依语境）

e.en: {MSF} doctors work in dangerous conflict zones worldwide.
e.zh: 无国界医生在全球各危险冲突地区开展工作。

e.en: She volunteered with {MSF} in South Sudan.
e.zh: 她在南苏丹做了无国界医生组织的志愿者。

e.en: The library archives many medieval {MSS} from Europe.
e.zh: 该图书馆收藏了许多来自欧洲的中世纪手稿。

e.en: Scholars examined the {MSS} for historical clues.
e.zh: 学者们研究这些手稿以寻找历史线索。

e.en: Rent is due on the first of each {mth}.
e.zh: 房租每月一号到期。

e.en: The subscription costs ten dollars per {mth}.
e.zh: 订阅费用为每月十美元。

mtm.t: n. 按市值计价（mark-to-market 的缩写）

e.en: Traders calculate {MTM} value at market close daily.
e.zh: 交易员每天在收盘时计算按市价计值。

e.en: The {MTM} loss hit the fund's quarterly report.
e.zh: 按市价计值的亏损反映在该基金的季报中。

e.en: {MTV} aired its first music video in 1981.
e.zh: MTV电视台于1981年播出了首支音乐录影带。

e.en: He grew up watching {MTV} all afternoon.
e.zh: 他是看着MTV电视台度过整个下午长大的。

much.t:
adv. 非常，很多
adj. 大量的

e.en: There isn't {much} time left before the deadline.
e.zh: 距离截止日期没剩下多少时间了。

e.en: Thanks so {much} for helping me move yesterday.
e.zh: 非常感谢你昨天帮我搬家。

muchacha.t: n. 女孩，小姑娘（西班牙语）

e.en: The young {muchacha} sold flowers in the plaza.
e.zh: 那位年轻姑娘在广场上卖花。

e.en: That {muchacha} speaks three languages fluently.
e.zh: 那位姑娘能流利地说三种语言。

muchacho.t: n. 男孩，小伙子（西班牙语）

e.en: The {muchacho} kicked the soccer ball into the goal.
e.zh: 那个小伙子一脚把足球踢进了球门。

e.en: Hey {muchacho}, can you give me a hand?
e.zh: 嘿,小伙子,能搭把手吗?

e.en: Aloe vera contains {mucilage} that soothes burns.
e.zh: 芦荟中含有能舒缓烧伤的黏液。

e.en: She used {mucilage} to glue the labels on.
e.zh: 她用胶水把标签粘了上去。

e.en: {Mucin} keeps the lining of your stomach protected.
e.zh: 黏蛋白能保护你的胃黏膜。

e.en: K-beauty products often advertise snail {mucin} extract.
e.zh: 韩国美妆产品常常宣传含有蜗牛黏蛋白提取物。

muck.t:
n. 粪肥；污物
v. 弄脏

e.en: The kids tracked {muck} all over the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 孩子们把厨房地板踩得到处都是泥。

e.en: He had to clean the {muck} out of the gutter.
e.zh: 他得把排水沟里的污泥清理干净。

mucking.t: v. muck 的动名词；清理污物

e.en: Stop {mucking} around and finish your homework.
e.zh: 别再瞎闹了,赶紧把作业做完。

e.en: She spent the morning {mucking} out the stables.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在清理马厩里的污物。

muckraker.t: n. 揭丑记者；揭黑幕者

e.en: The journalist became known as a fearless {muckraker}.
e.zh: 这位记者以无畏的揭丑者闻名。
