e.en: Every {muckraker} eventually faces lawsuits from powerful targets.
e.zh: 每位揭丑记者最终都会面临权贵的诉讼。

e.en: Her {muckraking} exposed corruption in city hall.
e.zh: 她的揭黑报道揭露了市政厅的腐败。

e.en: The magazine has a long history of {muckraking} journalism.
e.zh: 这本杂志有着长期的揭黑新闻传统。

e.en: My boots got {mucky} after the hike in rain.
e.zh: 雨中徒步后我的靴子沾满了泥。

e.en: The toddler's hands were {mucky} from playing outside.
e.zh: 小家伙在外面玩得双手脏兮兮的。

e.en: Smoking damages the {mucociliary} clearance in your airways.
e.zh: 吸烟会损害呼吸道的黏液纤毛清除功能。

e.en: The {mucociliary} system traps inhaled dust and germs.
e.zh: 黏液纤毛系统能捕捉吸入的灰尘和病菌。

e.en: {Mucormycosis} cases surged during the COVID pandemic in India.
e.zh: 印度新冠疫情期间毛霉菌病病例激增。

e.en: Doctors treat {mucormycosis} with antifungal drugs and surgery.
e.zh: 医生用抗真菌药和手术来治疗毛霉菌病。

e.en: The stomach {mucosa} produces acid for digestion.
e.zh: 胃黏膜会分泌帮助消化的胃酸。

e.en: Inflammation of the nasal {mucosa} causes a runny nose.
e.zh: 鼻黏膜发炎会导致流鼻涕。

e.en: The vaccine triggers a strong {mucosal} immune response.
e.zh: 该疫苗能引发强烈的黏膜免疫反应。

e.en: Doctors examined the {mucosal} lining for early lesions.
e.zh: 医生检查了黏膜层是否有早期病变。

mucous.t: adj. 黏液的，分泌黏液的

e.en: The {mucous} membrane in the nose helps trap dust particles.
e.zh: 鼻腔的黏膜有助于阻挡灰尘颗粒。

e.en: Doctors examined the {mucous} lining for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查了黏膜内层是否有感染迹象。

e.en: A cold causes your nose to produce extra {mucus}.
e.zh: 感冒会让鼻子分泌更多黏液。

e.en: The frog's skin secretes a slippery {mucus} for protection.
e.zh: 青蛙的皮肤会分泌滑滑的黏液以自保。

e.en: The kids came home covered in {mud} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后孩子们浑身是泥地回了家。

e.en: Her boots got stuck deep in the thick {mud}.
e.zh: 她的靴子陷在厚厚的泥里拔不出来。

e.en: The boat ran aground on a {mudbank} near the river mouth.
e.zh: 船在河口附近的泥岸上搁浅了。

e.en: Crabs scuttled across the exposed {mudbank} at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时螃蟹在裸露的泥滩上爬来爬去。

muddied.t: v. muddy 的过去式；弄浑，搅乱

e.en: His clean shoes got {muddied} on the hiking trail.
e.zh: 他干净的鞋在徒步路上被泥弄脏了。

e.en: That comment {muddied} the meaning of the entire proposal.
e.zh: 那句话把整份提案的意思搞混了。

muddle.t:
n. 混乱，糊涂
v. 使混乱

e.en: My notes are in a complete {muddle} after the long meeting.
e.zh: 开完长会后我的笔记一团乱。

e.en: Try not to {muddle} the two project deadlines together.
e.zh: 别把两个项目的截止日期搞混了。

e.en: His explanation was so {muddled} that nobody understood it.
e.zh: 他的解释太混乱了,没人听得懂。

e.en: She felt {muddled} after taking the strong cold medicine.
e.zh: 吃了强效感冒药后她头脑昏沉。

muddy.t:
adj. 泥泞的
v. 弄脏，搅浑

e.en: Please take off your {muddy} boots before coming inside.
e.zh: 进屋前请脱掉沾满泥的靴子。

e.en: The river water turned {muddy} after the heavy storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后河水变得浑浊。

e.en: Migratory birds feed on the {mudflat} during low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时候鸟在泥滩上觅食。

e.en: The vast {mudflat} stretched out toward the distant sea.
e.zh: 广阔的泥滩一直延伸到远处的海边。

e.en: A massive {mudflow} buried several houses after the typhoon.
e.zh: 台风过后一场大泥流掩埋了几栋房屋。

e.en: Geologists tracked the {mudflow} down the volcano's slope.
e.zh: 地质学家追踪了沿火山坡而下的泥流。

e.en: The bike's rear {mudguard} keeps mud off your back.
e.zh: 自行车的后挡泥板能防止泥溅到背上。

e.en: He installed a new {mudguard} on his mountain bike.
e.zh: 他给自己的山地车装了新挡泥板。

e.en: The truck's tire sank deep into a {mudhole} on the trail.
e.zh: 卡车的轮胎陷进了路上的一个泥坑。

e.en: Pigs love rolling around in a cool {mudhole}.
e.zh: 猪喜欢在凉爽的泥坑里打滚。

mudroom.t: n. 玄关杂物间（进门换鞋处）

e.en: We hang our wet coats in the {mudroom} by the door.
e.zh: 我们把湿外套挂在门边的玄关室。

e.en: The {mudroom} keeps dirt from spreading into the rest of the house.
e.zh: 玄关室能防止泥土带进屋内其他地方。

e.en: Heavy rains triggered a deadly {mudslide} in the village.
e.zh: 暴雨在村庄引发了一场致命的泥石流。

e.en: The highway was closed because of a recent {mudslide}.
e.zh: 公路因最近一场泥石流而封闭。

e.en: Geologists found ancient fossils embedded in the {mudstone}.
e.zh: 地质学家在泥岩中发现了远古化石。

e.en: The cliff is mostly soft {mudstone} that erodes quickly.
e.zh: 那座悬崖主要是容易风化的软泥岩。

e.en: I usually have {muesli} with yogurt for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐通常吃什锦麦片配酸奶。

e.en: This {muesli} contains oats, nuts, and dried fruit.
e.zh: 这款什锦麦片含燕麦、坚果和果干。

e.en: The {muezzin} called the faithful to prayer at dawn.
e.zh: 宣礼员在黎明时召唤信徒礼拜。

e.en: You can hear the {muezzin} from the tall minaret nearby.
e.zh: 你能听到附近高塔上宣礼员的声音。

muff.t:
v. 搞砸，失误
n. 手筒（保暖用）

e.en: Don't {muff} this chance to speak with the CEO.
e.zh: 别错过和首席执行官交谈的这个机会。

e.en: She warmed her hands inside a fluffy fur {muff}.
e.zh: 她把手放进毛茸茸的皮手筒里取暖。

e.en: I grabbed a blueberry {muffin} on my way to work.
e.zh: 我上班路上买了个蓝莓松饼。

e.en: This bakery makes the best banana {muffin} in town.
e.zh: 这家面包店做的香蕉松饼是镇上最好的。

e.en: Thick curtains help {muffle} traffic noise from the street.
e.zh: 厚窗帘能帮助减弱街上的车流声。

e.en: He tried to {muffle} his cough during the quiet meeting.
e.zh: 他在安静的会议上努力压住咳嗽声。

muffled.t: adj. 低沉的，压抑的（声音）

e.en: I heard {muffled} voices coming from the next room.
e.zh: 我听到隔壁房间传来低沉的说话声。

e.en: Her {muffled} laughter was barely audible behind the mask.
e.zh: 她在口罩后的笑声几乎听不见。

e.en: The car's broken {muffler} made the engine extremely loud.
e.zh: 汽车的消音器坏了,发动机声音特别响。

e.en: He wrapped a wool {muffler} around his neck in winter.
e.zh: 冬天他在脖子上围了一条羊毛围巾。

mufti.t: n. 伊斯兰教法学家；便服

e.en: The soldiers attended the wedding in {mufti} rather than uniform.
e.zh: 士兵们穿便服而非军装出席婚礼。

e.en: The grand {mufti} issued a religious ruling on the matter.
e.zh: 大穆夫提就此事发布了一项宗教裁决。

mug.t:
n. 马克杯
v. 行凶抢劫

e.en: I drink coffee from my favorite ceramic {mug} every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上都用我最喜欢的陶瓷马克杯喝咖啡。

e.en: Someone tried to {mug} him on the dark street last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有人在黑暗的街上试图抢劫他。

mugged.t: v. 行凶抢劫（mug 的过去式）

e.en: She was {mugged} near the subway station after midnight.
e.zh: 她午夜后在地铁站附近被抢劫了。

e.en: He {mugged} for the camera, making everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他对着镜头扮鬼脸,逗得大家哈哈大笑。

e.en: The {mugger} grabbed her phone and ran down the alley.
e.zh: 劫匪抢了她的手机就往小巷里跑。

e.en: Police arrested the {mugger} who attacked tourists downtown.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了在市中心袭击游客的劫匪。

mugging.t:
n. 街头抢劫
v. 扮鬼脸

e.en: There has been a rise in {mugging} cases in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 这个街区的抢劫案有所增加。

e.en: He reported the {mugging} to the police immediately.
e.zh: 他立刻把抢劫一事报告给了警方。

e.en: It's hot and {muggy} outside, so drink plenty of water.
e.zh: 外面又热又闷,要多喝水。

e.en: Summer nights here are uncomfortably {muggy} and still.
e.zh: 这里的夏夜又闷又静,让人不舒服。

e.en: The {Mughal} emperors built the magnificent Taj Mahal.
e.zh: 莫卧儿皇帝建造了宏伟的泰姬陵。

e.en: This museum displays artifacts from the {Mughal} era.
e.zh: 这家博物馆展出莫卧儿时代的文物。

mugs.t:
n. 马克杯（复数）
v. 抢劫

e.en: She collects coffee {mugs} from every city she visits.
e.zh: 她每去一个城市就收藏当地的马克杯。

e.en: The cabinet is full of mismatched {mugs} from years past.
e.zh: 柜子里堆满了多年来不成套的马克杯。

e.en: The suspect's {mugshot} appeared on the evening news.
e.zh: 嫌疑人的入狱照片出现在了晚间新闻上。

e.en: Police released the {mugshot} to help identify the criminal.
e.zh: 警方公布了嫌犯照片以协助辨认罪犯。

e.en: The {mujaheddin} fought against Soviet forces in the 1980s.
e.zh: 圣战者们在1980年代对抗苏联军队。

e.en: Foreign journalists interviewed several {mujaheddin} in the mountains.
e.zh: 外国记者在山区采访了几位圣战者。

e.en: The {mujahedeen} received support from various foreign governments.
e.zh: 圣战者们得到了多个外国政府的支持。

e.en: Historians still debate the legacy of the {mujahedeen}.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在争论圣战者的历史遗产。

e.en: The {mujahedin} controlled vast areas of the rural countryside.
e.zh: 圣战者控制着广大的乡村地区。

e.en: Her grandfather joined the {mujahedin} during the long war.
e.zh: 她的祖父在那场漫长的战争中加入了圣战者。

e.en: Many {mujahideen} fighters returned home after the war ended.
e.zh: 许多圣战者在战争结束后返回了家乡。

e.en: The documentary explored the origins of the {mujahideen} movement.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了圣战者运动的起源。

e.en: The {mujahidin} used the rugged terrain to their advantage.
e.zh: 圣战者利用崎岖地形为己方争取优势。

e.en: Old photographs show {mujahidin} crossing the snowy mountain passes.
e.zh: 老照片显示圣战者们正穿越雪山山口。

e.en: The novel's {mulatto} protagonist navigates a divided society.
e.zh: 小说中的混血主人公在分裂的社会中艰难前行。

e.en: The term {mulatto} is now considered outdated and offensive.
e.zh: "mulatto"一词如今被视为过时且冒犯的说法。

e.en: Silkworms feed exclusively on fresh {mulberry} leaves.
e.zh: 蚕只吃新鲜的桑叶。

e.en: We picked sweet {mulberry} fruit from the tree in the yard.
e.zh: 我们从院子里的树上摘了甜甜的桑葚。

mulch.t:
n. 地膜；护根覆盖物
v. 铺设覆盖物

e.en: Spread a thick layer of {mulch} around the rose bushes.
e.zh: 在玫瑰丛周围铺一层厚厚的覆盖物。

e.en: Wood chips make excellent {mulch} for vegetable gardens.
e.zh: 木屑是菜园很好的覆盖物。

e.en: {Mulching} helps retain soil moisture during hot summers.
e.zh: 覆盖地表有助于在炎热夏天保持土壤水分。

e.en: He spent the weekend {mulching} the flower beds.
e.zh: 他周末都在给花圃铺覆盖物。

e.en: Corrupt officials tried to {mulct} small business owners.
e.zh: 腐败官员试图敲诈小企业主的钱财。

e.en: The court can {mulct} the company for environmental damage.
e.zh: 法院可以因环境破坏对该公司处以罚款。

mule.t:
n. 骡子
n. 毒品运送者

e.en: The farmer used a stubborn {mule} to plow the field.
e.zh: 农夫用一头倔强的骡子犁地。

e.en: Police arrested a drug {mule} at the international airport.
e.zh: 警方在国际机场逮捕了一名毒品运送者。

e.en: A team of {mules} carried supplies up the mountain trail.
e.zh: 一队骡子驮着物资走上山路。

e.en: She slipped on her favorite leather {mules} and went out.
e.zh: 她穿上最爱的皮拖鞋就出门了。

e.en: The bullfighter waved his red {muleta} to provoke the bull.
e.zh: 斗牛士挥动红色斗篷激怒公牛。

e.en: He held the {muleta} steady as the bull charged forward.
e.zh: 公牛冲过来时他稳稳地握着斗牛布。

muley.t:
adj. 无角的
n. 无角牛

e.en: The hunters spotted a {muley} buck on the distant ridge.
e.zh: 猎人们在远处的山脊上发现了一只黑尾鹿。

e.en: A {muley} cow has no horns and is easier to handle.
e.zh: 无角的牛没有犄角,更容易管理。

e.en: His {mulish} refusal to compromise frustrated the whole team.
e.zh: 他像骡子般固执不肯让步,让整个团队很沮丧。

e.en: She gave him a {mulish} look and walked away silently.
e.zh: 她固执地瞪了他一眼,默默走开了。

mull.t: v. 反复思考；加热调味

e.en: Let me {mull} over your offer for a few days.
e.zh: 让我把你的提议再考虑几天。

e.en: She likes to {mull} wine with cinnamon during the holidays.
e.zh: 假期里她喜欢用肉桂煮热红酒。

mullah.t: n. 毛拉（伊斯兰教学者）

e.en: The local {mullah} led prayers at the village mosque.
e.zh: 当地毛拉在村里的清真寺主持祷告。

e.en: A respected {mullah} addressed the crowd outside the building.
e.zh: 一位德高望重的毛拉在楼外向人群讲话。

mulled.t:
adj. 加糖香料热饮的
v. 细想

e.en: We drank hot {mulled} wine at the Christmas market.
e.zh: 我们在圣诞市集上喝了热腾腾的香料红酒。

e.en: She {mulled} the decision before finally accepting the job.
e.zh: 她仔细考虑后才最终接受了这份工作。

e.en: Tall {mullein} plants grew along the dusty roadside.
e.zh: 高高的毛蕊花沿着尘土飞扬的路边生长。

e.en: Herbalists use {mullein} leaves to make a soothing tea.
e.zh: 草药师用毛蕊花叶子泡舒缓的茶。

e.en: The chef used a stone {muller} to grind the spices.
e.zh: 厨师用石磨碾碎香料。

e.en: An old paint {muller} sat on the artist's workbench.
e.zh: 画家的工作台上放着一只旧颜料研磨器。

mullet.t:
n. 鲻鱼
n. 前短后长发型

e.en: He showed up to the reunion sporting a vintage {mullet}.
e.zh: 他顶着一头复古的鲻鱼头出现在同学聚会上。

e.en: We grilled fresh {mullet} caught off the coast that morning.
e.zh: 我们烤了当天早上从海边捕来的新鲜鲻鱼。

e.en: He took a {mulligan} after slicing his first drive into the trees.
e.zh: 第一杆切到树林里后,他重新打了一杆。

e.en: Life rarely gives you a {mulligan} on big decisions.
e.zh: 在重大决定上,生活很少给你重来的机会。

e.en: A wooden {mullion} divides the tall arched window.
e.zh: 一根木制窗棂将这扇高大的拱形窗户分隔开。

e.en: The architect specified a slim metal {mullion} between panes.
e.zh: 建筑师指定窗格之间使用细金属窗棂。

e.en: The cottage had charming {mullioned} windows overlooking the garden.
e.zh: 小屋有迷人的格条窗,正对着花园。

e.en: Stained glass filled the chapel's tall {mullioned} windows.
e.zh: 彩色玻璃装满了礼拜堂高大的格条窗。

e.en: The phone supports {multi}-touch gestures on its screen.
e.zh: 这款手机的屏幕支持多点触控手势。

e.en: She runs a {multi}-million-dollar tech startup in Berlin.
e.zh: 她在柏林经营着一家市值数百万美元的科技初创公司。

e.en: Sponges are among the simplest {multicellular} animals on Earth.
e.zh: 海绵是地球上最简单的多细胞动物之一。

e.en: Life evolved from single cells into complex {multicellular} organisms.
e.zh: 生命从单细胞演化为复杂的多细胞生物。

e.en: The drug was tested in a large {multicenter} clinical trial.
e.zh: 该药物在一项大型多中心临床试验中接受了检验。

e.en: Researchers launched a {multicenter} study across five hospitals.
e.zh: 研究人员在五家医院启动了一项多中心研究。

multichannel.t: adj. 多通道的；多频道的

e.en: Our {multichannel} marketing reaches customers on email, app, and social.
e.zh: 我们的多渠道营销通过邮件、应用和社媒触达客户。

e.en: The receiver supports true {multichannel} surround sound.
e.zh: 这台功放支持真正的多声道环绕声。

e.en: She wore a {multicolored} scarf knitted by her grandmother.
e.zh: 她围着一条祖母织的彩色围巾。

e.en: The festival lit the sky with {multicolored} lanterns.
e.zh: 节日里五彩灯笼点亮了天空。

multicoloured.t: adj. 多种颜色的（英式拼写）

e.en: The market stalls displayed {multicoloured} fabrics from across India.
e.zh: 市场摊位上摆满了来自印度各地的彩色布料。

e.en: Children painted the wall with {multicoloured} handprints.
e.zh: 孩子们用五彩手印把墙画了个遍。

multicomponent.t: adj. 多组分的；多成分的

e.en: The therapy is a {multicomponent} program combining diet and exercise.
e.zh: 该疗法是结合饮食和运动的多组分方案。

e.en: Engineers designed a {multicomponent} adhesive for aerospace use.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一种用于航空航天的多组分胶粘剂。

e.en: Toronto is celebrated as a vibrant {multicultural} city.
e.zh: 多伦多以充满活力的多元文化都市而闻名。

e.en: The school promotes a {multicultural} curriculum from kindergarten.
e.zh: 这所学校从幼儿园起就推行多元文化课程。

e.en: Physicists detected a {muon} passing through the underground sensor.
e.zh: 物理学家探测到一个μ介子穿过地下传感器。

e.en: A cosmic ray often produces a short-lived {muon}.
e.zh: 宇宙射线常常会产生一个寿命极短的μ介子。

muppet.t:
n. 布偶（木偶剧角色）
n. 笨蛋（俚语）

e.en: Don't be such a {muppet} — read the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么糊涂,先把说明书看一遍。

e.en: My kids love watching the green {muppet} sing on TV.
e.zh: 我的孩子们喜欢看电视上那个绿色木偶唱歌。

mural.t:
n. 壁画
adj. 墙壁的

e.en: A colorful {mural} covers the wall of the cafe.
e.zh: 一幅色彩鲜艳的壁画覆盖了咖啡馆的墙面。

e.en: The school commissioned a {mural} for its main hallway.
e.zh: 学校委托人为主走廊绘制了一幅壁画。

e.en: The {muralist} spent three weeks painting the library wall.
e.zh: 那位壁画家花了三周时间在图书馆墙上作画。

e.en: Diego Rivera was a famous Mexican {muralist}.
e.zh: 迭戈·里维拉是一位著名的墨西哥壁画家。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Murchison} Falls to see the wildlife.
e.zh: 游客们涌向默奇森瀑布观赏野生动物。

e.en: The {Murchison} meteorite contains many organic compounds.
e.zh: 默奇森陨石中含有许多有机化合物。

murder.t:
n. 谋杀；凶杀
v. 谋杀；杀害

e.en: Police are investigating the {murder} of a local shopkeeper.
e.zh: 警方正在调查一名本地店主被谋杀的案件。

e.en: The traffic this morning was absolute {murder}.
e.zh: 今天早上的交通真是要命。

murdered.t: v. 谋杀（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The novel opens with a wealthy banker being {murdered}.
e.zh: 小说开篇就是一位富有的银行家被谋杀。

e.en: Witnesses claimed they saw who {murdered} the shopkeeper.
e.zh: 目击者声称他们看到了是谁谋杀了店主。

e.en: The detective finally caught the {murderer} after months of work.
e.zh: 几个月的努力后,警探终于抓住了凶手。

e.en: The jury found the {murderer} guilty on all counts.
e.zh: 陪审团裁定凶手所有罪名成立。

e.en: Two convicted {murderers} escaped from the maximum-security prison.
e.zh: 两名被定罪的凶手从最高戒备的监狱中逃脱。

e.en: History remembers some dictators as mass {murderers}.
e.zh: 历史将一些独裁者铭记为大规模屠杀者。

e.en: The play tells the story of a notorious Victorian {murderess}.
e.zh: 该剧讲述了一位臭名昭著的维多利亚时代女凶手的故事。

e.en: In the novel, the quiet maid is revealed as the {murderess}.
e.zh: 小说中,那个安静的女仆最终被揭穿是女凶手。

e.en: He was charged with {murdering} his business partner.
e.zh: 他被指控谋杀了自己的生意伙伴。

e.en: This summer heat is {murdering} my electricity bill.
e.zh: 这个夏天的酷热把我的电费账单整惨了。

murderous.t: adj. 凶残的；杀气腾腾的

e.en: She gave him a {murderous} look across the dinner table.
e.zh: 她隔着餐桌向他投去杀气腾腾的一瞥。

e.en: The hike up the mountain was absolutely {murderous}.
e.zh: 爬上那座山的徒步实在是要命。

murderously.t: adv. 凶残地；杀气腾腾地

e.en: He glared {murderously} at the driver who cut him off.
e.zh: 他凶狠地瞪着那个抢他道的司机。

e.en: The sun beat down {murderously} on the desert hikers.
e.zh: 烈日凶猛地炙烤着沙漠中的徒步者。

murders.t:
n. 谋杀（复数）
v. 谋杀（第三人称单数）

e.en: The city reported fewer {murders} this year than last.
e.zh: 今年该市报告的谋杀案比去年少了。

e.en: This podcast covers unsolved {murders} from the 1980s.
e.zh: 这个播客讲述了1980年代未破的谋杀案。

e.en: Researchers studied the disease using a {murine} model.
e.zh: 研究人员使用小鼠模型研究这种疾病。

e.en: The lab tests new drugs on {murine} subjects first.
e.zh: 实验室先在小鼠身上测试新药。

e.en: A small light glimmered through the {murk} of the cave.
e.zh: 一束微光在洞穴的昏暗中闪烁。

e.en: Divers struggled to see anything in the river's {murk}.
e.zh: 潜水员在河水的浑浊中几乎什么都看不见。

e.en: The pond water flowed {murkily} after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 暴雨过后,池塘的水浑浊地流淌着。

e.en: His memory of that night returned only {murkily}.
e.zh: 他对那晚的记忆只是模糊地浮现。

e.en: The {murkiness} of the lake made swimming unappealing.
e.zh: 湖水的浑浊让人不想下去游泳。

e.en: There's a certain {murkiness} surrounding the company's finances.
e.zh: 这家公司的财务状况笼罩着某种不透明感。

e.en: The pond water was too {murky} to see the fish.
e.zh: 池水太浑浊,看不见里面的鱼。

e.en: His past in the industry remains rather {murky}.
e.zh: 他在这个行业的过去仍然相当不清不楚。

murmansk.t: n. 摩尔曼斯克（俄罗斯港口）

e.en: The cargo ship docked in {Murmansk} despite the freezing weather.
e.zh: 尽管天气严寒,那艘货船还是在摩尔曼斯克靠岸了。

e.en: {Murmansk} is one of the largest cities above the Arctic Circle.
e.zh: 摩尔曼斯克是北极圈以北最大的城市之一。

murmur.t:
v. 低语；私语
n. 低语声

e.en: A soft {murmur} of voices came from the next room.
e.zh: 隔壁房间传来轻柔的低语声。

e.en: The doctor heard a heart {murmur} during the checkup.
e.zh: 医生在体检时听到了心脏杂音。

e.en: She {murmured} an apology and slipped out of the meeting.
e.zh: 她低声道歉,然后悄悄溜出了会议。

e.en: The crowd {murmured} when the verdict was announced.
e.zh: 宣布判决时,人群中传来一阵低语。

murmuring.t:
v. 低语（现在分词）
n. 低语声

e.en: I could hear students {murmuring} during the long lecture.
e.zh: 漫长的讲座中,我能听见学生们在窃窃私语。

e.en: The {murmuring} stream made the hike feel peaceful.
e.zh: 潺潺的小溪让这次徒步显得格外宁静。

e.en: A {murmurous} breeze rustled through the pine trees.
e.zh: 一阵簌簌作响的微风穿过松树林。

e.en: The cafe filled with the {murmurous} chatter of regulars.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里充满了常客们低低的闲谈声。

murmurs.t:
n. 低语（复数）
v. 低语（第三人称单数）

e.en: Quiet {murmurs} spread through the audience after the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布之后,观众中传开了低低的议论声。

e.en: There are {murmurs} of a possible merger between the two firms.
e.zh: 有传闻说两家公司可能合并。

e.en: As {Murphy}'s law predicts, my toast landed butter-side down.
e.zh: 正如墨菲定律所预言,我的吐司黄油那面朝下掉了。

e.en: The apartment had a clever {Murphy} bed that folded into the wall.
e.zh: 这套公寓有一张巧妙的墨菲折叠床,可以收进墙里。

e.en: The {Murray} River is the longest river in Australia.
e.zh: 墨累河是澳大利亚最长的河流。

e.en: Andy {Murray} won his first Wimbledon title in 2013.
e.zh: 安迪·穆雷于2013年赢得了他的首个温网冠军。

e.en: A {murre} dove deep into the cold water for fish.
e.zh: 一只海鸦潜入冰冷的海水中觅鱼。

e.en: Thousands of {murre} chicks hatch on the cliff each summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天,悬崖上孵化出成千上万只小海鸦。

e.en: The marbled {murrelet} nests high in old-growth forest trees.
e.zh: 斑海雀在原始森林的高大树木上筑巢。

e.en: Biologists tagged a {murrelet} to track its migration.
e.zh: 生物学家给一只海雀做了标记以追踪其迁徙。

e.en: The genus {Musa} includes bananas and plantains.
e.zh: 芭蕉属包括香蕉和大蕉。

e.en: Gardeners grow ornamental {Musa} plants for their large leaves.
e.zh: 园艺爱好者种植观赏芭蕉是为了它的大叶子。

e.en: Southern farmers grow {muscadine} grapes for sweet wine.
e.zh: 南方农民种植麝香葡萄用来酿造甜葡萄酒。

e.en: She picked a basket of ripe {muscadine} from the vine.
e.zh: 她从藤上摘了一篮成熟的麝香葡萄。

muscat.t:
n. 麝香葡萄
n. 马斯喀特（阿曼首都）

e.en: We toured the old harbor in {Muscat} during our vacation.
e.zh: 度假期间我们参观了马斯喀特的老港口。

e.en: The dessert wine was a sweet golden {muscat}.
e.zh: 那款甜点酒是一款甘甜的金色麝香葡萄酒。

e.en: Grandma poured a small glass of {muscatel} after dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶在晚饭后倒了一小杯麝香葡萄酒。

e.en: The vineyard is famous for its rich {muscatel}.
e.zh: 这家酒庄以其浓郁的麝香葡萄酒而闻名。

muscle.t:
n. 肌肉；力量
v. 强行挤入

e.en: Lifting weights helps you build {muscle} over time.
e.zh: 举重能帮助你逐渐增长肌肉。

e.en: The startup lacks the financial {muscle} to compete with giants.
e.zh: 这家初创公司缺乏与巨头竞争的财力实力。

muscle-bound.t: adj. 肌肉发达但僵硬的

e.en: The {muscle-bound} bouncer stood at the club's entrance.
e.zh: 那个肌肉发达的保镖站在俱乐部门口。

e.en: He looked {muscle-bound} but moved surprisingly gracefully.
e.zh: 他看起来肌肉鼓鼓的,动作却出奇地优雅。

e.en: The {muscled} dancer performed a stunning solo onstage.
e.zh: 那位肌肉结实的舞者在台上表演了惊艳的独舞。

e.en: A bigger company {muscled} its way into the local market.
e.zh: 一家更大的公司强行挤入了本地市场。

e.en: The mob boss hired a {muscleman} to collect debts.
e.zh: 那个黑帮老大雇了一个打手去讨债。

e.en: A tattooed {muscleman} guarded the back door of the club.
e.zh: 一个纹身的彪形大汉守在俱乐部的后门口。

e.en: My {muscles} were sore for days after the marathon.
e.zh: 马拉松之后我的肌肉酸痛了好几天。

e.en: Stretching helps your {muscles} recover faster after exercise.
e.zh: 拉伸有助于运动后肌肉更快恢复。

e.en: A {muscly} arm reached out to lift the heavy box.
e.zh: 一只肌肉发达的手臂伸出来抬起了沉重的箱子。

e.en: The trainer was short but surprisingly {muscly}.
e.zh: 那位教练个子不高,却出奇地肌肉结实。

muscovite.t:
n. 白云母
n. 莫斯科人

e.en: The rock sample contained shiny flakes of {muscovite}.
e.zh: 岩石样本中含有闪亮的白云母薄片。

e.en: A proud {Muscovite} showed us around Red Square.
e.zh: 一位自豪的莫斯科人带我们参观了红场。

e.en: A pair of {Muscovy} ducks waddled across the farmyard.
e.zh: 一对疣鼻栖鸭摇摇摆摆地穿过农场院子。

e.en: Ivan the Terrible ruled the Grand Duchy of {Muscovy}.
e.zh: 伊凡雷帝统治过莫斯科大公国。

e.en: The swimmer had a tall, {muscular} build.
e.zh: 那位游泳运动员个子高大,体格健美。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the boy with {muscular} dystrophy.
e.zh: 医生诊断这名男孩患有肌肉萎缩症。

e.en: The athlete's {muscularity} was clearly visible under his shirt.
e.zh: 那位运动员的肌肉线条在衬衫下清晰可见。

e.en: Her prose has a {muscularity} that captivates readers.
e.zh: 她的文笔有一种刚劲有力的风格,深深吸引读者。

musculature.t: n. 肌肉组织；肌肉系统

e.en: The horse's {musculature} rippled as it galloped across the field.
e.zh: 骏马奔驰时,肌肉一波波地起伏。

e.en: Yoga helps strengthen the deep {musculature} of the back.
e.zh: 瑜伽有助于强化背部的深层肌肉群。

e.en: Office workers often suffer from {musculoskeletal} pain.
e.zh: 上班族常常受肌肉骨骼疼痛困扰。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {musculoskeletal} injuries and rehabilitation.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门治疗肌肉骨骼损伤和康复。

muse.t:
v. 沉思，冥想
n. 缪斯，灵感女神

e.en: The painter called his wife his lifelong {muse}.
e.zh: 画家称妻子为他一生的灵感缪斯。

e.en: I often {muse} about what life would be like abroad.
e.zh: 我常常思索国外的生活会是什么样子。

mused.t: v. 沉思（muse 的过去式）

e.en: "Maybe I should quit my job," she {mused} aloud.
e.zh: 她出声沉思:“也许我该辞职。”

e.en: He {mused} on the meaning of the strange dream.
e.zh: 他细细琢磨那个奇怪梦境的含义。

museo.t: n. 博物馆（西班牙语/意大利语）

e.en: We visited the {museo} of modern art in Madrid.
e.zh: 我们参观了马德里的现代艺术博物馆。

e.en: The {museo} houses an impressive collection of Roman sculptures.
e.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量令人惊叹的罗马雕塑。

e.en: She studied {museology} before becoming a curator.
e.zh: 她在成为策展人之前研习了博物馆学。

e.en: Modern {museology} emphasizes interactive visitor experiences.
e.zh: 现代博物馆学强调与观众的互动体验。

muses.t:
n. 缪斯女神们
v. 沉思

e.en: The poet thanked the {muses} for his inspiration.
e.zh: 诗人感谢缪斯女神赐予他灵感。

e.en: She often {muses} about moving to the countryside.
e.zh: 她经常幻想着搬到乡下去住。

e.en: The {museum} opens at nine on weekdays.
e.zh: 这家博物馆工作日上午九点开门。

e.en: We spent the whole afternoon at the science {museum}.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都泡在科学博物馆里。

e.en: London has some of the best {museums} in the world.
e.zh: 伦敦拥有世界上最棒的一些博物馆。

e.en: Many {museums} now offer virtual tours online.
e.zh: 许多博物馆现在都提供线上虚拟参观。

musgrave.t: n. 马斯格雷夫（人名/地名）

e.en: Sherlock Holmes solved the mystery in "The {Musgrave} Ritual."
e.zh: 福尔摩斯破解了《马斯格雷夫礼典》中的谜团。

e.en: Composer Thea {Musgrave} is known for her bold operas.
e.zh: 作曲家西娅·马斯格雷夫以其大胆的歌剧作品闻名。

e.en: In Austen's novel, the {Musgrove} family lives at Uppercross.
e.zh: 在奥斯汀的小说中,马斯格罗夫一家住在阿珀克罗斯。

e.en: Mr. {Musgrove} welcomed all the guests warmly to dinner.
e.zh: 马斯格罗夫先生热情地欢迎所有客人共进晚餐。

mush.t:
n. 糊状物，玉米糊
adj. 软烂的

e.en: The overcooked rice turned into a sticky {mush}.
e.zh: 米饭煮过头变成了一团黏糊糊的稀粥。

e.en: His brain felt like {mush} after the long meeting.
e.zh: 开完那场漫长的会议后,他的脑子像浆糊一样。

e.en: The {musher} guided his sled team across the frozen lake.
e.zh: 驾雪橇人驱赶着犬队穿越冰封的湖面。

e.en: Every {musher} bonds closely with their lead dog.
e.zh: 每一位雪橇手都与领头犬建立着深厚的感情。

mushroom.t:
n. 蘑菇
v. 迅速增长

e.en: I added a sliced {mushroom} to the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 我往意面酱里加了一片切好的蘑菇。

e.en: Tech startups began to {mushroom} across the city.
e.zh: 科技创业公司开始在城里如雨后春笋般涌现。

e.en: Online shopping is {mushrooming} in rural areas.
e.zh: 网购在农村地区正迅速普及。

e.en: The city is dealing with {mushrooming} traffic problems.
e.zh: 这座城市正在应对日益严重的交通问题。

e.en: Wild {mushrooms} can be dangerous if you can't identify them.
e.zh: 如果不会辨认,野生蘑菇可能很危险。

e.en: She sautéed the {mushrooms} with garlic and butter.
e.zh: 她用大蒜和黄油把蘑菇煎香。

e.en: The bananas had gone {mushy} in the bottom of my bag.
e.zh: 包底的香蕉已经压得软烂了。

e.en: He hates {mushy} romantic movies on date night.
e.zh: 约会之夜他最讨厌看肉麻的爱情片。

e.en: I listen to {music} while I work from home.
e.zh: 我在家工作时喜欢听音乐。

e.en: Her laughter was like {music} to his ears.
e.zh: 她的笑声对他来说就像悦耳的音乐。

e.en: The festival celebrated {musica} antiqua from medieval Europe.
e.zh: 这个音乐节庆祝来自中世纪欧洲的古乐。

e.en: His album is titled "{Musica} del Alma."
e.zh: 他的专辑名叫《灵魂之乐》。

musical.t:
adj. 音乐的
n. 音乐剧

e.en: We saw a {musical} on Broadway last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在百老汇看了一场音乐剧。

e.en: She has been {musical} since she was a toddler.
e.zh: 她从蹒跚学步起就很有音乐天赋。

e.en: The neighbors hosted a charming {musicale} in their garden.
e.zh: 邻居在花园里举办了一场温馨的小型音乐会。

e.en: Tickets to the chamber {musicale} sold out quickly.
e.zh: 那场室内小型音乐会的门票很快就售罄了。

e.en: The pianist's {musicality} moved the entire audience.
e.zh: 那位钢琴家的乐感打动了全场观众。

e.en: There's a real {musicality} in the way she reads poetry.
e.zh: 她朗诵诗歌的方式自有一种音乐般的韵味。

e.en: He's the most {musically} gifted student in the class.
e.zh: 他是班上音乐天赋最高的学生。

e.en: The film is {musically} brilliant but visually dull.
e.zh: 这部电影音乐出色,但画面平淡。

e.en: My mom loves classic Broadway {musicals} from the fifties.
e.zh: 我妈妈很喜欢五十年代的经典百老汇音乐剧。

e.en: Disney has produced many successful animated {musicals}.
e.zh: 迪士尼制作过许多成功的动画音乐片。

e.en: She became a professional {musician} at the age of nineteen.
e.zh: 她十九岁便成为了一名职业音乐家。

e.en: Every street {musician} in the square deserves some applause.
e.zh: 广场上每一位街头艺人都值得一些掌声。

e.en: The studio hired session {musicians} for the recording.
e.zh: 录音棚为这次录音雇了些棚虫乐手。

e.en: Many young {musicians} share their work on TikTok.
e.zh: 许多年轻音乐人在抖音上分享自己的作品。

e.en: The band is known for its tight ensemble {musicianship}.
e.zh: 这支乐队以紧密配合的演奏功力著称。

e.en: Her {musicianship} improved dramatically after years of practice.
e.zh: 经过多年练习,她的音乐素养有了显著提升。

e.en: The journal publishes {musicological} research from around the world.
e.zh: 该期刊发表来自世界各地的音乐学研究。

e.en: His {musicological} analysis of Bach is widely cited.
e.zh: 他对巴赫的音乐学分析被广泛引用。

e.en: The {musicologist} traced the song back to a medieval hymn.
e.zh: 那位音乐学家把这首歌追溯到一首中世纪圣歌。

e.en: She works as a {musicologist} at the national archive.
e.zh: 她在国家档案馆担任音乐学研究员。

e.en: He earned a doctorate in {musicology} from Yale.
e.zh: 他在耶鲁取得了音乐学博士学位。

e.en: {Musicology} explores how culture shapes musical traditions.
e.zh: 音乐学研究文化如何塑造音乐传统。

musing.t:
n. 沉思
adj. 沉思的

e.en: She sat by the window, {musing} about her future.
e.zh: 她坐在窗边,思索着自己的未来。

e.en: His blog is full of quiet {musing} on everyday life.
e.zh: 他的博客里满是对日常生活的静静沉思。

e.en: "Perhaps we were wrong," he said {musingly}.
e.zh: “也许我们错了,”他若有所思地说。

e.en: She gazed {musingly} out at the falling snow.
e.zh: 她若有所思地望着窗外飘落的雪花。

e.en: The cologne has notes of {musk} and sandalwood.
e.zh: 这款古龙水带有麝香和檀木的气息。

e.en: A faint smell of {musk} lingered in the old room.
e.zh: 老屋里飘散着一丝淡淡的麝香味。

e.en: The trail crossed a stretch of soggy {muskeg}.
e.zh: 小径穿过一片湿软的泥炭沼泽地。

e.en: Caribou often graze near the northern {muskeg}.
e.zh: 驯鹿经常在北方的泥沼附近觅食。

e.en: The soldier loaded his {musket} before the battle.
e.zh: 战斗开始前,士兵给他的火枪装上弹药。

e.en: A rusty {musket} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 一支生锈的火枪挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: D'Artagnan dreamed of becoming a royal {musketeer}.
e.zh: 达达尼昂梦想成为一名皇家火枪手。

e.en: Every {musketeer} swore loyalty to the king.
e.zh: 每一位火枪手都向国王宣誓效忠。

musketry.t: n. 火枪射击术；火枪队

e.en: The sound of {musketry} echoed across the battlefield.
e.zh: 火枪齐射的声音在战场上回荡。

e.en: Soldiers practiced {musketry} drills every morning.
e.zh: 士兵们每天早晨都要进行火枪训练。

e.en: He caught a huge {muskie} on the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在湖里钓到一条大马斯基鱼。

e.en: The {muskie} is one of the toughest freshwater fish to land.
e.zh: 马斯基鱼是最难钓上岸的淡水鱼之一。

e.en: A chilled slice of {muskmelon} is perfect on a hot day.
e.zh: 炎炎夏日来一片冰镇香瓜再合适不过了。

e.en: The market sells fresh {muskmelon} from local farms.
e.zh: 市场上有本地农场出产的新鲜香瓜。

e.en: A {muskrat} swam quietly across the pond at dusk.
e.zh: 一只麝鼠在黄昏时分悄悄游过池塘。

e.en: Trappers once hunted the {muskrat} for its fur.
e.zh: 以前猎人为了毛皮而猎捕麝鼠。

e.en: The perfume had a warm, {musky} scent.
e.zh: 这款香水有一种温暖的麝香气息。

e.en: A {musky} smell drifted from the old leather chair.
e.zh: 一股麝香味从那把旧皮椅上飘出来。

muslim.t:
n. 穆斯林
adj. 伊斯兰教的

e.en: My {Muslim} colleague is fasting during Ramadan.
e.zh: 我的穆斯林同事正在斋月里禁食。

e.en: The mosque welcomes {Muslim} worshippers every Friday.
e.zh: 清真寺每周五迎接穆斯林信徒前来礼拜。

e.en: She wrapped the cheese in a piece of {muslin}.
e.zh: 她用一块平纹细布把奶酪包起来。

e.en: The baby slept under a soft {muslin} blanket.
e.zh: 宝宝盖着一条柔软的纱布毯睡着了。

e.en: My brother is a total {muso} who collects vinyl records.
e.zh: 我哥是个十足的乐迷,专门收藏黑胶唱片。

e.en: Every {muso} in town came to the jazz festival.
e.zh: 城里每一位音乐迷都来参加了爵士音乐节。

muss.t:
v. 弄乱，弄皱
n. 混乱

e.en: Try not to {muss} your hair before the photo.
e.zh: 拍照前别把头发弄乱了。

e.en: The wind began to {muss} the carefully arranged flowers.
e.zh: 风开始吹乱那些精心摆放的花束。

mussed.t: v. 弄乱（muss 的过去式）

e.en: His hair was charmingly {mussed} after the nap.
e.zh: 午睡过后,他的头发凌乱得很可爱。

e.en: The toddler {mussed} the freshly made bed in seconds.
e.zh: 小孩几秒钟就把刚铺好的床弄乱了。

e.en: I ordered a bowl of steamed {mussel} stew.
e.zh: 我点了一碗清蒸贻贝汤。

e.en: Each {mussel} should open up after cooking.
e.zh: 每一只贻贝煮熟后都应该开口。

e.en: We had {mussels} and fries at a Belgian restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在一家比利时餐厅吃了贻贝配薯条。

e.en: Fresh {mussels} should smell like the ocean.
e.zh: 新鲜的贻贝应该带有海洋的气息。

e.en: {Mussolini} ruled Italy as a fascist dictator for decades.
e.zh: 墨索里尼以法西斯独裁者的身份统治意大利数十年。

e.en: History students study {Mussolini}'s rise to power.
e.zh: 历史专业的学生会研究墨索里尼的崛起过程。

must.t:
v. 必须，一定
n. 必须做的事

e.en: You {must} wear a helmet when riding the bike.
e.zh: 骑这辆自行车时你必须戴头盔。

e.en: Trying the local food is a {must} for tourists.
e.zh: 品尝当地美食是游客必做的事。

e.en: She is a {multitalented} artist who paints, sings, and dances.
e.zh: 她是一位多才多艺的艺术家,会画画、唱歌和跳舞。

e.en: The team hired a {multitalented} engineer with design skills.
e.zh: 团队聘用了一位兼具设计能力的多才工程师。

multitasking.t:
n. 多任务处理
adj. 多任务的

e.en: Studies show {multitasking} actually reduces overall productivity.
e.zh: 研究表明多任务处理实际上会降低整体效率。

e.en: This phone handles {multitasking} smoothly even with many apps open.
e.zh: 即使开很多应用,这台手机也能流畅地多任务处理。

e.en: The festival drew a {multitude} of fans from across Asia.
e.zh: 音乐节吸引了来自亚洲各地的众多乐迷。

e.en: There are a {multitude} of reasons to learn Python.
e.zh: 学习Python的理由有很多。

e.en: The library holds {multitudinous} volumes on ancient history.
e.zh: 该图书馆藏有大量古代史方面的书籍。

e.en: She faced {multitudinous} challenges starting her own company.
e.zh: 她在创业过程中面临众多挑战。

e.en: Carbon is a {multivalent} element fundamental to organic chemistry.
e.zh: 碳是一种多价元素,是有机化学的基础。

e.en: The poem has a {multivalent} meaning open to interpretation.
e.zh: 这首诗含义多重,留有解读空间。

e.en: We ran a {multivariate} analysis to find the key factors.
e.zh: 我们做了多变量分析以找出关键因素。

e.en: Marketers use {multivariate} testing to optimize landing pages.
e.zh: 营销人员用多变量测试来优化落地页。

e.en: Marvel films explore the idea of a vast {multiverse}.
e.zh: 漫威电影探讨了广阔多元宇宙的概念。

e.en: Some physicists seriously debate whether the {multiverse} exists.
e.zh: 一些物理学家认真讨论多元宇宙是否真的存在。

e.en: My doctor recommends taking a {multivitamin} every morning.
e.zh: 医生建议我每天早上吃一片复合维生素。

e.en: This {multivitamin} contains iron, zinc, and vitamin D.
e.zh: 这款复合维生素含有铁、锌和维生素D。

multivocal.t: adj. 多义的；含义不明确的

e.en: The novel is {multivocal}, with each chapter narrated differently.
e.zh: 这部小说是多声部叙事,每章由不同视角讲述。

e.en: Critics praised the film's {multivocal} portrayal of the city.
e.zh: 影评人称赞该片对这座城市的多声部刻画。

mum.t:
n. 妈妈
adj. 沉默的

e.en: My {mum} bakes the best chocolate cake in town.
e.zh: 我妈妈做的巧克力蛋糕是镇上最好吃的。

e.en: He stayed {mum} about the surprise party plans.
e.zh: 他对惊喜派对的安排守口如瓶。

mumble.t:
v. 含糊地说
n. 咕哝

e.en: Please don't {mumble} when you give your presentation.
e.zh: 做演讲时请不要含糊不清地说话。

e.en: I heard him {mumble} something about being tired.
e.zh: 我听见他含糊地嘟囔说累了。

e.en: She {mumbled} an apology and quickly left the room.
e.zh: 她含糊地道了个歉,匆匆离开了房间。

e.en: The boy {mumbled} his answer so no one could hear.
e.zh: 那男孩含糊地回答,没人能听清楚。

mumbles.t: v. 含糊地说（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {mumbles} when he's nervous in interviews.
e.zh: 他面试紧张时总是含糊不清地说话。

e.en: Grandpa {mumbles} to himself while reading the newspaper.
e.zh: 爷爷一边看报一边自言自语地嘟囔。

e.en: Stop {mumbling} and speak clearly, please.
e.zh: 请别再嘟囔了,说清楚一点。

e.en: She kept {mumbling} complaints under her breath.
e.zh: 她不停地小声嘟囔着抱怨。

mumm.t: n. 玛姆（香槟品牌/姓氏）

e.en: Villagers {mumm} through the streets in colorful costumes each winter.
e.zh: 每年冬天村民们身穿彩装在街上扮演哑剧巡游。

e.en: Children love to {mumm} during the holiday parade.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在节日游行中扮演哑剧角色。

mummer.t: n. 哑剧演员；假面演员

e.en: A masked {mummer} danced through the cobbled village square.
e.zh: 一位戴面具的哑剧演员在鹅卵石村广场上起舞。

e.en: Each {mummer} wore an elaborate costume for the parade.
e.zh: 每位哑剧演员都为游行穿上了精致的戏服。

mummery.t: n. 哑剧表演；装模作样

e.en: The whole ceremony felt like pointless {mummery} to him.
e.zh: 整个仪式在他看来都像是毫无意义的装腔作势。

e.en: Critics dismissed the speech as political {mummery}.
e.zh: 评论家斥责那场演讲不过是政治表演。

e.en: Egyptian {mummification} could take up to seventy days.
e.zh: 古埃及的木乃伊制作过程可长达七十天。

e.en: The museum displays the tools used for ancient {mummification}.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着古代制作木乃伊所用的工具。

mummified.t: v. 制成木乃伊（过去式）

e.en: Archaeologists discovered a {mummified} cat in the tomb.
e.zh: 考古学家在墓中发现了一只木乃伊化的猫。

e.en: The dry desert air had {mummified} the body naturally.
e.zh: 干燥的沙漠空气将尸体自然风干成了木乃伊。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians knew how to {mummify} bodies for the afterlife.
e.zh: 古埃及人懂得如何把尸体制成木乃伊以备来世。

e.en: Cold and dryness can naturally {mummify} animal remains.
e.zh: 寒冷与干燥能将动物遗骸自然风干成木乃伊。

mummy.t:
n. 木乃伊
n. 妈妈（英式口语）

e.en: The kids saw a real Egyptian {mummy} at the museum.
e.zh: 孩子们在博物馆看到了一具真正的埃及木乃伊。

e.en: My little sister ran to {mummy} when she fell.
e.zh: 我小妹妹摔倒时跑去找妈咪。

e.en: Vaccines have made {mumps} much rarer in children today.
e.zh: 疫苗已让如今儿童患腮腺炎的情况大为减少。

e.en: He missed school for a week with the {mumps}.
e.zh: 他因得了腮腺炎请了一周的假。

e.en: Many {mums} juggle work and school pickups every day.
e.zh: 许多妈妈每天都要兼顾工作和接送孩子。

e.en: She planted yellow {mums} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她在花园小径旁种了黄色的菊花。

e.en: Kids love to {munch} on popcorn during movies.
e.zh: 孩子们看电影时喜欢嚼爆米花。

e.en: I always {munch} carrots when I'm studying late.
e.zh: 我熬夜学习时总爱嚼胡萝卜。

e.en: She {munched} happily on a fresh apple after lunch.
e.zh: 她午饭后开心地嚼着一个新鲜苹果。

e.en: The horse {munched} hay quietly in its stall.
e.zh: 那匹马在马厩里安静地嚼着干草。

e.en: My dog is a serious carrot {muncher} at dinnertime.
e.zh: 我的狗在晚饭时是个超级胡萝卜小馋鬼。

e.en: He's known as a popcorn {muncher} at every movie night.
e.zh: 每次电影之夜他都被称为爆米花大胃王。

munches.t: v. 大声咀嚼（第三人称单数）

e.en: My rabbit {munches} on lettuce all afternoon.
e.zh: 我的兔子整个下午都在嚼生菜。

e.en: She quietly {munches} cookies while reading her novel.
e.zh: 她一边看小说一边静静地嚼饼干。

e.en: The kids were {munching} chips during the whole movie.
e.zh: 孩子们整场电影都在嚼薯片。

e.en: I found him {munching} cereal straight from the box.
e.zh: 我发现他直接从盒子里抓麦片吃。

munchkin.t: n. 小矮人；小不点（对小孩的昵称）

e.en: Come here, little {munchkin}, and give grandma a hug.
e.zh: 过来吧小宝贝,给奶奶一个拥抱。

e.en: That tiny {munchkin} cat barely weighs three pounds.
e.zh: 那只小短腿猫体重还不到三磅。

e.en: AI is taking over many {mundane} office tasks.
e.zh: 人工智能正在接手许多平凡的办公室工作。

e.en: She finds joy even in the most {mundane} chores.
e.zh: 她甚至在最平凡的家务中也能找到乐趣。

e.en: His blog focuses on the small {mundanities} of daily life.
e.zh: 他的博客专注于日常生活中的琐碎小事。

e.en: She escaped the {mundanities} of office work by traveling.
e.zh: 她通过旅行逃离办公室工作的琐碎日常。

e.en: There's a strange beauty in the {mundanity} of morning routines.
e.zh: 晨间日常的平凡之中有一种奇特的美。

e.en: He complained about the {mundanity} of his suburban life.
e.zh: 他抱怨郊区生活的平淡无奇。

mundi.t: adj. 世界的（拉丁语词根）

e.en: The medieval mappa {mundi} shows the world as flat.
e.zh: 中世纪的世界地图把世界描绘成平的。

e.en: Latin phrases like axis {mundi} appear in mythology studies.
e.zh: 像“世界之轴”这样的拉丁词常出现在神话研究中。

mungo.t: n. 再生呢绒；粗劣再生毛

e.en: The mill recycled wool fibers to produce cheap {mungo} cloth.
e.zh: 那家工厂回收羊毛纤维制成廉价的再生毛呢。

e.en: Victorian factories used {mungo} to make affordable winter coats.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的工厂用再生毛料制作平价冬装。

e.en: We drank beer at the famous Oktoberfest in {Munich}.
e.zh: 我们在慕尼黑著名的啤酒节上喝了啤酒。

e.en: {Munich} is the capital of the German state of Bavaria.
e.zh: 慕尼黑是德国巴伐利亚州的首府。

e.en: The {municipal} library offers free coding classes for teens.
e.zh: 市立图书馆为青少年提供免费的编程课程。

e.en: Residents complained about poor {municipal} waste collection.
e.zh: 居民们抱怨市政垃圾收集服务太差。

e.en: Each {municipality} sets its own recycling rules.
e.zh: 每个市政当局都制定自己的回收规定。

e.en: The {municipality} announced new bike lanes downtown.
e.zh: 市政府宣布在市中心增设新的自行车道。

e.en: The park is {municipally} owned and maintained by the city.
e.zh: 这座公园归市政所有并由市政维护。

e.en: Bus services here are {municipally} funded through local taxes.
e.zh: 这里的公交服务由地方税收提供市政资金。

e.en: The library was built thanks to the donor's {munificence}.
e.zh: 这座图书馆得以建成,全靠捐赠者的慷慨。

e.en: Her {munificence} toward charity surprised everyone in town.
e.zh: 她对慈善事业的慷慨让镇上所有人都很惊讶。

e.en: The museum still benefits from many {munificences} of past patrons.
e.zh: 博物馆至今仍受益于过去赞助人的诸多慷慨捐赠。

e.en: Annual reports list the {munificences} that funded the new wing.
e.zh: 年报列出了资助新展厅的各项慷慨捐赠。

e.en: He left a {munificent} tip after the wonderful meal.
e.zh: 那顿美餐之后,他留下了一笔慷慨的小费。

e.en: The foundation made a {munificent} donation to the school.
e.zh: 该基金会向学校做出了慷慨的捐赠。

e.en: Old family {muniments} prove ownership of the estate.
e.zh: 古老的家族产权证书证明了对庄园的所有权。

e.en: The lawyer stored the {muniments} in a fireproof safe.
e.zh: 律师将这些产权文件存放在防火保险柜中。

e.en: The factory produced {munition} during the war years.
e.zh: 这家工厂在战争年代生产军火。

e.en: Soldiers checked every {munition} crate before loading the truck.
e.zh: 士兵在装车前检查了每一个弹药箱。

e.en: The army stored {munitions} in heavily guarded bunkers.
e.zh: 军队将弹药储存在重兵把守的地堡中。

e.en: Workers at the {munitions} plant earned higher wages.
e.zh: 军工厂的工人挣到了更高的工资。

munster.t: n. 芒斯特（爱尔兰省份）

e.en: She ordered a sandwich with sliced {munster} cheese.
e.zh: 她点了一份夹有蒙斯特奶酪片的三明治。

e.en: The team from {Munster} won the rugby final last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末来自蒙斯特的球队赢得了橄榄球决赛。

e.en: He grew a thick {mustache} during the lockdown.
e.zh: 封城期间他留了一撮浓密的胡子。

e.en: The barber trimmed his {mustache} into a neat shape.
e.zh: 理发师把他的小胡子修剪得很整齐。

e.en: A {mustached} waiter greeted us at the door.
e.zh: 一位留着小胡子的服务员在门口迎接我们。

e.en: The {mustached} detective lit his pipe slowly.
e.zh: 那位留着胡子的侦探慢慢点燃了烟斗。

e.en: Both brothers sport identical curly {mustaches}.
e.zh: 两兄弟都留着一模一样的卷胡子。

e.en: Fake {mustaches} were handed out at the costume party.
e.zh: 化装派对上分发了假胡子。

e.en: A {mustachioed} chef welcomed us into the Italian restaurant.
e.zh: 一位蓄着大胡子的厨师把我们迎进意大利餐厅。

e.en: The villain was a tall, {mustachioed} gentleman in black.
e.zh: 那反派是个身穿黑衣、留着夸张胡子的高个绅士。

e.en: Wild {mustang} herds still roam the Nevada plains.
e.zh: 野生野马群仍在内华达的平原上奔跑。

e.en: He restored a 1967 Ford {mustang} in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修复了一辆1967年的福特野马。

e.en: I always add Dijon {mustard} to my sandwich.
e.zh: 我做三明治时总会加点第戎芥末酱。

e.en: She wore a {mustard} sweater with blue jeans.
e.zh: 她穿着芥末黄毛衣配蓝色牛仔裤。

e.en: The deli stocks dozens of artisanal {mustards}.
e.zh: 这家熟食店有几十种手工芥末酱。

e.en: German {mustards} tend to be sweeter than French ones.
e.zh: 德国芥末酱通常比法国的更甜一些。

mustardy.t: adj. 带芥末味的；芥黄色的

e.en: The dressing had a sharp, {mustardy} kick.
e.zh: 这款调味汁带着浓烈的芥末味。

e.en: She painted the wall a warm, {mustardy} yellow.
e.zh: 她把墙刷成了温暖的芥末黄。

e.en: The otter is a playful {mustelid} found along rivers.
e.zh: 水獭是一种生活在河边的活泼鼬科动物。

e.en: Badgers belong to the {mustelid} family of mammals.
e.zh: 獾属于哺乳动物中的鼬科。

muster.t:
v. 召集，鼓起（勇气）
n. 集合

e.en: She tried to {muster} the courage to speak up.
e.zh: 她努力鼓起勇气开口说话。

e.en: The general called a {muster} of all troops at dawn.
e.zh: 将军在黎明时召集全体部队集合。

e.en: The {mustiness} of the old basement made me sneeze.
e.zh: 旧地下室的霉味让我打了个喷嚏。

e.en: Open the windows to clear the {mustiness} from the room.
e.zh: 打开窗户散散屋里的霉味吧。

e.en: The attic smelled {musty} after years of being closed.
e.zh: 阁楼关了好多年,闻起来一股霉味。

e.en: She found a {musty} old novel in the secondhand shop.
e.zh: 她在二手店里找到一本散发霉味的旧小说。

e.en: The poet wrote about the {mutabilities} of human emotion.
e.zh: 诗人写下了人类情感的种种无常。

e.en: Genetic {mutabilities} vary widely among species.
e.zh: 不同物种的基因可变性差异很大。

e.en: The {mutability} of language fascinates linguists.
e.zh: 语言的可变性令语言学家着迷。

e.en: Python lists are known for their {mutability}.
e.zh: Python列表以其可变性而著称。

e.en: In Python, lists are {mutable} but tuples are not.
e.zh: 在Python中,列表是可变的,而元组不是。

e.en: Fashion trends are highly {mutable} from year to year.
e.zh: 时尚潮流年年变化,非常善变。

e.en: UV radiation is a common {mutagen} that damages DNA.
e.zh: 紫外线是一种常见的能损伤DNA的诱变剂。

e.en: The lab tested whether the chemical was a {mutagen}.
e.zh: 实验室检测了这种化学品是否为诱变剂。

e.en: Scientists use {mutagenesis} to study gene function.
e.zh: 科学家利用诱变技术来研究基因功能。

e.en: Site-directed {mutagenesis} allows precise DNA changes.
e.zh: 定点诱变可以对DNA进行精确改造。

e.en: Some pesticides have proven {mutagenic} in lab tests.
e.zh: 一些农药在实验室测试中显示出诱变性。

e.en: The compound was flagged as potentially {mutagenic}.
e.zh: 该化合物被标记为可能具有诱变性。

mutant.t:
n. 变种，突变体
adj. 突变的

e.en: The film features a {mutant} hero with healing powers.
e.zh: 这部电影主角是一位拥有治愈能力的变种人。

e.en: Researchers identified a {mutant} strain of the virus.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了该病毒的一种变异株。

e.en: Viruses {mutate} quickly to evade the immune system.
e.zh: 病毒会快速变异以躲避免疫系统。

e.en: Avoid functions that {mutate} the original array directly.
e.zh: 避免使用会直接修改原数组的函数。

e.en: The virus has {mutated} into a more contagious form.
e.zh: 该病毒已变异为传染性更强的形式。

e.en: The function accidentally {mutated} the input object.
e.zh: 这个函数不小心修改了传入的对象。

e.en: A single {mutation} can change a protein's behavior.
e.zh: 单个突变就能改变蛋白质的行为。

e.en: React warns against direct state {mutation} in components.
e.zh: React警告不要在组件中直接修改状态。

e.en: The old portrait shows a woman in a white linen {mutch}.
e.zh: 那幅旧画像里的女子戴着白色亚麻软帽。

e.en: Her grandmother kept her hair tucked under a {mutch}.
e.zh: 她奶奶总把头发塞进一顶软帽里。

mute.t:
v. 静音，消音
adj. 无声的，哑的

e.en: Please {mute} your microphone during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时请把你的麦克风静音。

e.en: He stood {mute} when the teacher asked the question.
e.zh: 老师提问时,他默不作声地站着。

e.en: I {muted} the loud notifications on my phone.
e.zh: 我把手机上吵人的通知都静音了。

e.en: She decorated the room in {muted} earth tones.
e.zh: 她用柔和的大地色调装饰了这个房间。

e.en: He nodded {mutely} and walked out of the room.
e.zh: 他默默地点了点头,走出了房间。

e.en: The child stared {mutely} at the broken vase.
e.zh: 那孩子默默地盯着摔碎的花瓶。

e.en: Her sudden {muteness} surprised everyone at the table.
e.zh: 她突如其来的沉默让在座的人都很惊讶。

e.en: The film's {muteness} made the visuals more powerful.
e.zh: 这部电影的无声让画面更具冲击力。

e.en: Vandals tried to {mutilate} the ancient statue.
e.zh: 破坏者试图毁损那尊古老的雕像。

e.en: Please don't {mutilate} the library books with notes.
e.zh: 请不要在图书馆的书上乱写乱画。

e.en: The {mutilated} document was barely readable.
e.zh: 这份被损毁的文件几乎无法辨认。

e.en: Rescuers found the car badly {mutilated} after the crash.
e.zh: 事故后救援人员发现那辆车被严重撞毁。

e.en: The painting suffered serious {mutilation} during the war.
e.zh: 这幅画在战争中遭受了严重损毁。

e.en: Animal {mutilation} in factory farms sparked protests.
e.zh: 工厂化农场对动物的残害引发了抗议。

e.en: The captain ordered every {mutineer} below deck.
e.zh: 船长下令把每一个叛乱者都关到甲板下。

e.en: He was branded a {mutineer} for refusing the order.
e.zh: 他因拒绝命令而被定为哗变者。

e.en: The crew grew {mutinous} after weeks without pay.
e.zh: 几周没领到工资,船员们开始有了哗变之意。

e.en: She gave her boss a {mutinous} glare across the room.
e.zh: 她隔着房间狠狠瞪了老板一眼,满脸不服。

e.en: The teenager glared {mutinously} at her parents.
e.zh: 那个少女满脸叛逆地瞪着父母。

e.en: The soldiers muttered {mutinously} about the orders.
e.zh: 士兵们带着不满低声议论着命令。

mutiny.t:
n. 哗变，兵变
v. 叛变

e.en: The sailors staged a {mutiny} against the cruel captain.
e.zh: 水手们对残暴的船长发动了哗变。

e.en: There was a near {mutiny} when the team's bonus was cut.
e.zh: 团队奖金被砍时,差点闹起了哗变。

e.en: Selective {mutism} can make school very stressful for kids.
e.zh: 选择性缄默症会让孩子在学校倍感压力。

e.en: Therapy gradually helped him overcome his {mutism}.
e.zh: 治疗渐渐帮他克服了缄默症。

e.en: We adopted a friendly {mutt} from the local shelter.
e.zh: 我们从当地收容所领养了一只友善的杂种狗。

e.en: That little {mutt} chases every squirrel in the park.
e.zh: 那只小杂种狗追着公园里每一只松鼠跑。

e.en: I heard him {mutter} something rude under his breath.
e.zh: 我听见他低声嘟囔了一句很难听的话。

e.en: She likes to {mutter} to herself while cooking dinner.
e.zh: 她做晚饭时喜欢自言自语地嘟囔。

e.en: He {muttered} an apology and left the meeting room.
e.zh: 他咕哝着道了个歉,离开了会议室。

e.en: She {muttered} the password as she typed it in.
e.zh: 她一边输入密码,一边小声念出来。

e.en: He kept {muttering} about the slow internet connection.
e.zh: 他一直在抱怨网速太慢。

e.en: Stop {muttering} and tell me what's actually wrong.
e.zh: 别再嘟囔了,告诉我到底怎么了。

mutters.t: v. 咕哝（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {mutters} complaints whenever the printer jams.
e.zh: 打印机一卡纸,他就嘟囔着抱怨。

e.en: She always {mutters} the answer before raising her hand.
e.zh: 她举手前总是先小声把答案念出来。

e.en: The pub serves a hearty {mutton} stew on Sundays.
e.zh: 这家酒吧周日供应一份丰盛的炖羊肉。

e.en: Slow-roasted {mutton} is a classic British dish.
e.zh: 慢烤羊肉是经典的英式菜肴。

e.en: Let's get back to our {muttons} and finish the agenda.
e.zh: 咱们言归正传,把议程过完吧。

e.en: The butcher hung several {muttons} in the cold storage.
e.zh: 屠夫在冷库里挂了好几只羊肉。

e.en: We have a {mutual} friend who introduced us last year.
e.zh: 我们有个共同的朋友,去年介绍我们认识的。

e.en: The deal was based on {mutual} trust between the partners.
e.zh: 这笔交易建立在合伙人之间的相互信任上。

e.en: Bees and flowers are a classic example of {mutualism}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂和花朵是互利共生的典型例子。

e.en: Coral reefs depend on {mutualism} between algae and polyps.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁依赖藻类与珊瑚虫之间的互利共生关系。

e.en: Clownfish and anemones share a {mutualistic} relationship.
e.zh: 小丑鱼和海葵之间是互利共生的关系。

e.en: Many fungi form {mutualistic} bonds with tree roots.
e.zh: 许多真菌与树根形成互利共生的关系。

e.en: A healthy friendship requires {mutuality} of effort.
e.zh: 健康的友谊需要双方共同付出。

e.en: The contract emphasized {mutuality} of obligations.
e.zh: 合同强调了双方义务的对等性。

e.en: We reached a {mutually} beneficial agreement after talks.
e.zh: 经过协商,我们达成了互利共赢的协议。

e.en: Honesty and manipulation are {mutually} exclusive.
e.zh: 诚实与操纵是互不相容的。

e.en: She lounged on the porch in a colorful {muumuu}.
e.zh: 她穿着一件花色鲜艳的宽松长裙在门廊上闲坐。

e.en: Tourists bought matching {muumuu} dresses in Hawaii.
e.zh: 游客们在夏威夷买了情侣款的宽松长裙。

e.en: Canada has long embraced {multiculturalism} as official policy.
e.zh: 加拿大长期将多元文化主义作为官方政策。

e.en: The professor lectured on {multiculturalism} in modern Europe.
e.zh: 教授就现代欧洲的多元文化主义作了讲座。

multiculturalist.t:
n. 多元文化主义者
adj. 多元文化主义的

e.en: She is a vocal {multiculturalist} advocating for immigrant rights.
e.zh: 她是直言不讳的多元文化主义者,为移民权益发声。

e.en: The author takes a {multiculturalist} approach to history.
e.zh: 作者以多元文化主义的视角看待历史。

e.en: Poverty is a {multidimensional} problem requiring complex solutions.
e.zh: 贫困是一个需要复杂方案的多维度问题。

e.en: The character felt remarkably {multidimensional} and real.
e.zh: 这个角色显得非常立体而真实。

e.en: The study explores the {multidimensionality} of human well-being.
e.zh: 该研究探讨了人类福祉的多维性。

e.en: Critics praised the {multidimensionality} of the novel's heroine.
e.zh: 评论家称赞小说女主角的多面性。

e.en: The microphone has a {multidirectional} pickup pattern for podcasts.
e.zh: 这款麦克风采用多向拾音模式,适合播客录制。

e.en: Soccer demands quick {multidirectional} movement and balance.
e.zh: 足球要求快速的多方向移动与平衡。

multidisciplinary.t: adj. 多学科的；跨学科的

e.en: A {multidisciplinary} team treats each cancer patient at the clinic.
e.zh: 诊所由多学科团队为每位癌症患者制定治疗方案。

e.en: Climate change requires a {multidisciplinary} research approach.
e.zh: 气候变化需要多学科的研究方法。

multifaceted.t: adj. 多层面的；多才多艺的

e.en: Her career has been long and {multifaceted}.
e.zh: 她的职业生涯漫长且涉猎广泛。

e.en: The crisis is {multifaceted}, with economic and social roots.
e.zh: 这场危机涉及多个方面,根源既有经济也有社会因素。

multifactor.t: adj. 多因素的（如多因素认证）

e.en: Always enable {multifactor} authentication on your bank account.
e.zh: 务必为你的银行账户启用多因素身份验证。

e.en: Heart disease is a {multifactor} condition influenced by lifestyle.
e.zh: 心脏病是受生活方式影响的多因素疾病。

e.en: Obesity is a {multifactorial} disease, not just about willpower.
e.zh: 肥胖是多因素疾病,不仅仅关乎意志力。

e.en: The accident's cause was {multifactorial}, the report concluded.
e.zh: 报告认为事故是多重因素造成的。

multifarious.t: adj. 多种多样的；繁杂的

e.en: The CEO juggles {multifarious} duties across global offices.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官在全球办公室间处理着各式各样的职务。

e.en: Tokyo offers {multifarious} attractions for every visitor.
e.zh: 东京为每位游客提供五花八门的景点。

multiform.t: adj. 多种形式的；多样的

e.en: The disease has {multiform} symptoms that vary by patient.
e.zh: 该疾病症状多样,因人而异。

e.en: Cloud computing supports {multiform} workloads at scale.
e.zh: 云计算可以大规模支持各种形态的工作负载。

e.en: This {multifunctional} printer scans, copies, and faxes documents.
e.zh: 这台多功能打印机可扫描、复印和传真文件。

e.en: She bought a {multifunctional} sofa that converts into a bed.
e.zh: 她买了一张可变床的多功能沙发。

e.en: Traffic crawled along the {multilane} highway during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段车辆在多车道高速公路上缓慢行驶。

e.en: Construction widened the road into a {multilane} expressway.
e.zh: 施工将这条道路拓宽为多车道高速公路。

e.en: The countries signed a {multilateral} trade agreement on Tuesday.
e.zh: 这些国家于周二签署了一项多边贸易协定。

e.en: The UN encourages {multilateral} solutions to global problems.
e.zh: 联合国鼓励通过多边方式解决全球问题。

e.en: She championed {multilateralism} as the path to lasting peace.
e.zh: 她主张多边主义是通往持久和平的道路。

e.en: Critics warn that {multilateralism} is eroding in current diplomacy.
e.zh: 批评者警告称,当前外交中的多边主义正在削弱。

e.en: The novel is a {multilayered} story of love and revenge.
e.zh: 这部小说是一个层次丰富的爱与复仇的故事。

e.en: Security relies on a {multilayered} defense against attacks.
e.zh: 安全防御依赖于多层次的防护体系。

e.en: The garage uses a {multilevel} parking system to save space.
e.zh: 这个车库采用多层停车系统以节省空间。

e.en: Researchers ran a {multilevel} regression on the survey data.
e.zh: 研究人员对调查数据进行了多层回归分析。

e.en: The mall is a {multileveled} complex with shops and restaurants.
e.zh: 这家商场是一座多层综合体,内有商店和餐厅。

e.en: Their argument was {multileveled}, blending logic and emotion.
e.zh: 他们的论点是多层次的,兼具逻辑与情感。

multilingual.t: adj. 多语言的；使用多种语言的

e.en: Our customer support team is fully {multilingual}.
e.zh: 我们的客服团队能够提供多语种服务。

e.en: The app's interface is available in {multilingual} versions.
e.zh: 该应用的界面提供多语种版本。

multimedia.t:
n. 多媒体
adj. 多媒体的

e.en: Students created a {multimedia} presentation with video and audio.
e.zh: 学生们制作了一份包含视频和音频的多媒体演示。

e.en: The museum opened an interactive {multimedia} exhibit yesterday.
e.zh: 博物馆昨日开设了一场互动多媒体展览。

e.en: He signed a {multimillion}-dollar contract with the basketball team.
e.zh: 他与那支篮球队签下了数百万美元的合同。

e.en: The startup secured {multimillion}-dollar funding from investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司从投资者那里获得了数百万美元融资。

e.en: By thirty, the founder had become a {multimillionaire}.
e.zh: 这位创始人三十岁时已成为千万富翁。

e.en: The {multimillionaire} donated heavily to children's hospitals.
e.zh: 这位千万富翁向儿童医院慷慨捐赠。

multimodal.t: adj. 多模态的（AI 可处理文本、图像等）

e.en: Modern AI models are {multimodal}, handling text, images, and audio.
e.zh: 现代 AI 模型是多模态的,可处理文本、图像和音频。

e.en: The city built a {multimodal} transit hub linking trains and buses.
e.zh: 该市建造了一个连接火车与公交的多式联运枢纽。

e.en: The router supports {multimode} fiber for high-speed connections.
e.zh: 该路由器支持多模光纤,可实现高速连接。

e.en: This camera offers a {multimode} dial for different lighting.
e.zh: 这台相机提供多模式拨盘以适应不同光线。

multinational.t:
adj. 跨国的
n. 跨国公司

e.en: She works for a {multinational} corporation based in Singapore.
e.zh: 她就职于一家总部位于新加坡的跨国公司。

e.en: The {multinational} task force tackled the cybercrime ring together.
e.zh: 这支跨国特别行动组联手打击了网络犯罪团伙。

multinomial.t:
n. 多项式
adj. 多项的

e.en: We fitted a {multinomial} logistic regression to the categorical data.
e.zh: 我们对分类数据拟合了多项逻辑回归。

e.en: Rolling a die follows a {multinomial} distribution over six outcomes.
e.zh: 掷骰子在六种结果上服从多项分布。

multiparty.t: adj. 多党的；多方参与的

e.en: The country held its first {multiparty} election since the war.
e.zh: 该国举行了战后首次多党选举。

e.en: Negotiations involved a complex {multiparty} agreement on emissions.
e.zh: 谈判涉及一项复杂的多方减排协议。

multiple.t:
adj. 多个的；多种的
n. 倍数

e.en: She received {multiple} job offers after the conference.
e.zh: 会议结束后她收到了多份工作邀请。

e.en: The error happened on {multiple} devices, not just mine.
e.zh: 这个错误在多台设备上都出现了,不只是我的。

multiplex.t:
adj. 多重的；多路复用的
n. 多厅影院

e.en: We caught the late show at the downtown {multiplex}.
e.zh: 我们在市中心的多厅影院看了夜场电影。

e.en: Fiber-optic systems {multiplex} many signals onto one cable.
e.zh: 光纤系统将多路信号复用到一根光缆上。

e.en: The {multiplexer} combines several inputs into a single output line.
e.zh: 多路复用器将多个输入合并为单一输出线路。

e.en: Engineers added a {multiplexer} to share the bandwidth efficiently.
e.zh: 工程师加装了多路复用器以高效共享带宽。

e.en: Kids learn {multiplication} tables in second or third grade.
e.zh: 孩子们在二三年级学习乘法表。

e.en: Bacterial {multiplication} accelerates in warm, moist conditions.
e.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的环境下繁殖加快。

e.en: The bonus has a {multiplicative} effect on overall earnings.
e.zh: 该奖金对整体收入产生倍增效应。

e.en: In algebra, one is the {multiplicative} identity element.
e.zh: 在代数中,一是乘法的单位元。

e.en: The festival celebrates the {multiplicity} of Asian cuisines.
e.zh: 该节庆庆祝亚洲菜肴的多样性。

e.en: There is a {multiplicity} of opinions on this controversial topic.
e.zh: 对这一争议话题众说纷纭。

multiplied.t: v. 相乘；倍增（multiply 过去式）

e.en: His problems {multiplied} after he lost his passport abroad.
e.zh: 在国外丢了护照后,他的麻烦接踵而至。

e.en: She {multiplied} the recipe by four to feed the whole team.
e.zh: 她把食谱用量乘以四,以供整个团队享用。

e.en: Education acts as a powerful {multiplier} for economic growth.
e.zh: 教育是经济增长的强大倍增器。

e.en: Hit the target enemy for a damage {multiplier} bonus.
e.zh: 击中目标敌人即可获得伤害倍率加成。

multiplies.t: v. 使相乘；倍增（multiply 第三人称单数）

e.en: Stress {multiplies} the risk of heart disease over time.
e.zh: 压力会随时间不断加大患心脏病的风险。

e.en: The function {multiplies} two numbers and returns the product.
e.zh: 该函数将两个数字相乘并返回乘积。

e.en: You can {multiply} any number by zero to get zero.
e.zh: 任何数乘以零都得零。

e.en: Rumors tend to {multiply} quickly on social media.
e.zh: 谣言在社交媒体上往往迅速扩散。

multiplying.t: v. 使相乘；大量增加（multiply 现在分词）

e.en: The rabbits keep {multiplying} in our backyard each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天兔子在我们后院不断繁殖。

e.en: She is {multiplying} two large numbers in her head.
e.zh: 她正在心算两个大数字相乘。

multipoint.t: adj. 多点的（如多点触控）

e.en: The app supports {multipoint} touch gestures on tablets.
e.zh: 该应用在平板上支持多点触控手势。

e.en: My headphones use a {multipoint} connection for two devices.
e.zh: 我的耳机用多点连接同时连两台设备。

e.en: Analysts say the world has become more {multipolar} since 2010.
e.zh: 分析人士称世界自2010年以来日益多极化。

e.en: The neuron is a typical {multipolar} cell with many dendrites.
e.zh: 该神经元是典型的多极细胞,有许多树突。

e.en: Modern browsers use a {multiprocess} architecture for safety.
e.zh: 现代浏览器采用多进程架构以保证安全。

e.en: Python's library makes {multiprocess} programming much easier.
e.zh: Python的库让多进程编程变得容易许多。

multiprocessing.t: n. 多进程处理；多重处理

e.en: We use {multiprocessing} to speed up the data pipeline.
e.zh: 我们用多进程来加速数据处理流水线。

e.en: The chip supports symmetric {multiprocessing} across eight cores.
e.zh: 该芯片支持八核对称多处理。

e.en: The server runs on a {multiprocessor} system with 64 cores.
e.zh: 这台服务器运行在64核的多处理器系统上。

e.en: Modern phones now ship with powerful {multiprocessor} chips.
e.zh: 现代手机如今都搭载强大的多处理器芯片。

multipurpose.t: adj. 多用途的；多功能的

e.en: This {multipurpose} room serves as gym, office, and lounge.
e.zh: 这个多功能房间兼作健身房、办公室和休息室。

e.en: She bought a {multipurpose} cleaner for the whole kitchen.
e.zh: 她买了一瓶多用途清洁剂用于整个厨房。

e.en: Singapore is a vibrant {multiracial} society with four official languages.
e.zh: 新加坡是一个有四种官方语言的多元种族社会。

e.en: The school celebrates its {multiracial} student body every year.
e.zh: 学校每年都庆祝其多种族的学生群体。

e.en: VR headsets create a {multisensory} experience for gamers.
e.zh: VR头显为玩家带来多感官体验。

e.en: Teachers use {multisensory} methods to help kids read.
e.zh: 老师们用多感官教学法帮助孩子学习阅读。

e.en: The satellite captures {multispectral} images of crops weekly.
e.zh: 该卫星每周拍摄农作物的多光谱图像。

e.en: Drones with {multispectral} cameras detect plant disease early.
e.zh: 装有多光谱相机的无人机能及早发现植物病害。

e.en: The rocket uses a {multistage} design to reach orbit.
e.zh: 火箭采用多级设计以进入轨道。

e.en: Hiring at the company is a {multistage} interview process.
e.zh: 该公司的招聘是一个多阶段面试流程。

e.en: We parked the car in the {multistorey} garage downtown.
e.zh: 我们把车停在市中心的多层停车场。

e.en: A new {multistorey} apartment block opened next to the school.
e.zh: 学校旁新开了一栋多层公寓楼。

e.en: The campus added a {multistory} library last semester.
e.zh: 校园上学期增建了一座多层图书馆。

e.en: Fire crews struggled with the {multistory} office blaze.
e.zh: 消防队员奋力扑救那座多层办公楼的大火。

muzak.t: n. 商场、电梯里的背景音乐

e.en: Bland {muzak} played softly in the elevator.
e.zh: 电梯里轻轻播放着平淡无奇的背景音乐。

e.en: The dentist's office filled the wait with cheesy {muzak}.
e.zh: 牙医诊所候诊时放着俗气的背景音乐。

muzzle.t:
n. 动物口鼻；防咬口套
v. 钳制言论

e.en: The vet placed a soft {muzzle} on the nervous dog.
e.zh: 兽医给紧张的狗狗戴上了软口罩。

e.en: Critics say the new law will {muzzle} the press.
e.zh: 批评人士称这项新法律会压制新闻自由。

e.en: He hunts deer with an old-fashioned {muzzleloader} every fall.
e.zh: 他每年秋天都用老式前装枪打鹿。

e.en: The museum displayed a polished antique {muzzleloader} from 1820.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一支1820年的擦亮古董前装枪。

muzzy.t: adj. 头脑迷糊、模糊不清

e.en: I felt {muzzy} after taking the cold medicine.
e.zh: 吃了感冒药后我感觉头昏脑胀。

e.en: His explanation was {muzzy} and hard to follow.
e.zh: 他的解释含糊不清,让人难以跟上。

mvs.t: n. IBM 大型机操作系统 (Multiple Virtual Storage)

e.en: The bank still runs payroll on an old IBM {mvs} mainframe.
e.zh: 那家银行的工资系统还在老旧的IBM MVS大型机上运行。

e.en: Legacy {mvs} systems require specialized COBOL programmers to maintain.
e.zh: 老旧的MVS系统需要专门的COBOL程序员来维护。

e.en: Patients often report fever and {myalgia} during the flu.
e.zh: 流感患者常报告发烧和肌肉疼痛。

e.en: Chronic {myalgia} can severely affect a person's daily life.
e.zh: 慢性肌痛会严重影响一个人的日常生活。

e.en: She traveled through {Myanmar} to visit ancient temples in Bagan.
e.zh: 她游历缅甸,参观了蒲甘的古老寺庙。

e.en: {Myanmar} shares borders with India, China, and Thailand.
e.zh: 缅甸与印度、中国和泰国接壤。

e.en: {Myasthenia} gravis causes weakness in the voluntary muscles.
e.zh: 重症肌无力会导致随意肌无力。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {myasthenia} after months of fatigue.
e.zh: 这位病人在数月疲劳后被诊断为肌无力。

myc.t: n. 一类原癌基因 / 转录因子

e.en: The {MYC} gene plays a key role in cell growth and cancer.
e.zh: MYC基因在细胞生长和癌症中起关键作用。

e.en: Researchers are developing drugs that target the {MYC} protein.
e.zh: 研究人员正在开发针对MYC蛋白的药物。

e.en: A vast {mycelium} network connects trees beneath the forest floor.
e.zh: 庞大的菌丝体网络在森林地下连接着树木。

e.en: Scientists are using {mycelium} to make biodegradable packaging.
e.zh: 科学家正利用菌丝体制造可降解包装。

e.en: Tourists climb the lion gate of ancient {Mycenae} every summer.
e.zh: 游客们每年夏天都会攀登古迈锡尼的狮子门。

e.en: {Mycenae} was a powerful Greek city in the Bronze Age.
e.zh: 迈锡尼是青铜时代希腊的一座强大城市。

mycenaean.t:
adj. 迈锡尼文明的
n. 迈锡尼人

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {Mycenaean} tomb filled with gold artifacts.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一座装满黄金文物的迈锡尼墓葬。

e.en: {Mycenaean} civilization collapsed around 1100 BC.
e.zh: 迈锡尼文明大约在公元前1100年崩溃。

e.en: {Mycobacteria} cause diseases like tuberculosis and leprosy.
e.zh: 分枝杆菌可引起结核病和麻风病等疾病。

e.en: These {mycobacteria} have unusually thick, waxy cell walls.
e.zh: 这些分枝杆菌有异常厚的蜡质细胞壁。

e.en: The lab confirmed a {mycobacterial} infection in the patient's lungs.
e.zh: 实验室确认患者肺部有分枝杆菌感染。

e.en: {Mycobacterial} diseases require long courses of antibiotics.
e.zh: 分枝杆菌疾病需要长期使用抗生素。

mycobacterium.t: n. 分枝杆菌（结核菌属）

e.en: {Mycobacterium} tuberculosis still infects millions of people each year.
e.zh: 结核分枝杆菌每年仍感染数百万人。

e.en: The slide showed a single rod-shaped {mycobacterium}.
e.zh: 载玻片上显示出一个杆状的分枝杆菌。

mycologist.t: n. 研究真菌的科学家

e.en: The {mycologist} identified over twenty mushroom species in one walk.
e.zh: 那位真菌学家一次徒步就辨认出二十多种蘑菇。

e.en: She works as a {mycologist} studying medicinal fungi.
e.zh: 她是一名研究药用真菌的真菌学家。

e.en: He took a {mycology} course to learn about wild mushrooms.
e.zh: 他选修了一门真菌学课程,学习野生蘑菇知识。

e.en: {Mycology} has gained popularity thanks to recent fungi documentaries.
e.zh: 得益于近期的真菌纪录片,真菌学越来越受欢迎。

e.en: Moldy peanuts can contain a dangerous {mycotoxin} called aflatoxin.
e.zh: 发霉的花生可能含有一种叫黄曲霉素的危险霉菌毒素。

e.en: Farmers test grain for {mycotoxin} contamination before selling it.
e.zh: 农民在出售谷物前会检测霉菌毒素污染。

myelin.t: n. 神经髓鞘的髓磷脂

e.en: Multiple sclerosis damages the {myelin} sheath around nerves.
e.zh: 多发性硬化症会损害神经周围的髓鞘。

e.en: {Myelin} helps electrical signals travel faster along nerve fibers.
e.zh: 髓磷脂帮助电信号沿神经纤维传得更快。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed her with chronic {myelogenous} leukemia last year.
e.zh: 医生去年诊断她患有慢性骨髓性白血病。

e.en: Acute {myelogenous} leukemia progresses rapidly without treatment.
e.zh: 急性髓系白血病若不治疗会迅速恶化。

e.en: Multiple {myeloma} affects plasma cells in the bone marrow.
e.zh: 多发性骨髓瘤会影响骨髓中的浆细胞。

e.en: His father is undergoing chemotherapy for {myeloma}.
e.zh: 他父亲正在为骨髓瘤接受化疗。

e.en: She wrapped the gift with shiny {mylar} balloons.
e.zh: 她用闪亮的聚酯薄膜气球装饰礼物。

e.en: Emergency blankets are made of thin reflective {mylar}.
e.zh: 应急保温毯由薄薄的反光聚酯薄膜制成。

e.en: The {mynah} bird in the cage greeted every visitor loudly.
e.zh: 笼子里的八哥大声地向每位访客打招呼。

e.en: A {mynah} can mimic human speech surprisingly well.
e.zh: 八哥模仿人类讲话的能力出奇地好。

myocardial.t: adj. 心肌的（如心肌梗死）

e.en: He survived a serious {myocardial} infarction last winter.
e.zh: 他去年冬天挺过了一次严重的心肌梗塞。

e.en: The scan showed signs of {myocardial} damage after the attack.
e.zh: 扫描显示心脏病发作后心肌有受损迹象。

e.en: Oxygen deprivation can quickly damage the {myocardium}.
e.zh: 缺氧会迅速损伤心肌。

e.en: The {myocardium} is the thick muscular wall of the heart.
e.zh: 心肌是心脏厚实的肌肉壁。

e.en: Sleep {myoclonus} causes those sudden jerks as you drift off.
e.zh: 睡眠肌阵挛会引起入睡时那种突然的抽动。

e.en: Severe {myoclonus} can interfere with walking and eating.
e.zh: 严重的肌阵挛会影响行走和进食。

e.en: Each cardiac {myocyte} contracts in sync to pump blood.
e.zh: 每个心肌细胞同步收缩以泵送血液。

e.en: Researchers grew {myocyte} cells in a lab dish.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室培养皿中培育了肌细胞。

myoelectric.t: adj. 利用肌电信号的（如假肢）

e.en: He received a {myoelectric} prosthetic hand controlled by muscle signals.
e.zh: 他装上了一只由肌肉信号控制的肌电假手。

e.en: Modern {myoelectric} arms can grip objects with surprising precision.
e.zh: 现代肌电假肢能以惊人的精度抓握物品。

e.en: {Myoglobin} gives red meat its characteristic dark color.
e.zh: 肌红蛋白赋予红肉其特有的深色。

e.en: Diving mammals have high levels of {myoglobin} in their muscles.
e.zh: 潜水哺乳动物的肌肉中含有大量肌红蛋白。

myopia.t:
n. 近视
n. 目光短浅

e.en: Childhood {myopia} rates have soared with increased screen time.
e.zh: 随着屏幕使用时间增加,儿童近视率激增。

e.en: Critics blamed corporate {myopia} for ignoring long-term risks.
e.zh: 批评者将忽视长期风险归咎于企业的短视。

myopic.t: adj. 近视的；目光短浅的

e.en: Cutting research funding now would be incredibly {myopic}.
e.zh: 现在削减科研经费会是极其短视的做法。

e.en: She wears thick glasses because she's severely {myopic}.
e.zh: 她戴着厚厚的眼镜,因为她近视很严重。

myopically.t: adv. 近视地；目光短浅地

e.en: The company {myopically} focused on quarterly profits and lost market share.
e.zh: 该公司短视地只盯着季度利润,结果失去了市场份额。

e.en: Politicians often act {myopically}, ignoring problems beyond the next election.
e.zh: 政客往往目光短浅,无视下次选举之外的问题。

e.en: Muscle contraction depends on actin sliding past {myosin} filaments.
e.zh: 肌肉收缩依赖于肌动蛋白沿肌球蛋白丝滑动。

e.en: {Myosin} is one of the most abundant proteins in muscle tissue.
e.zh: 肌球蛋白是肌肉组织中含量最丰富的蛋白质之一。

myriad.t:
adj. 无数的、大量的
n. 无数

e.en: The app offers a {myriad} of customization options.
e.zh: 这款应用提供了无数种自定义选项。

e.en: There are {myriad} reasons to learn a second language.
e.zh: 学习第二语言的理由数不胜数。

e.en: The toddler had a {myringotomy} to drain fluid from his ears.
e.zh: 那名幼儿做了鼓膜切开术以排出耳内积液。

e.en: A {myringotomy} is a quick procedure to relieve ear pressure.
e.zh: 鼓膜切开术是缓解耳压的快速手术。

e.en: The wise men brought gold, frankincense, and {myrrh}.
e.zh: 智者们带来了黄金、乳香和没药。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians used {myrrh} as an embalming ingredient.
e.zh: 古埃及人将没药用作防腐成分。

e.en: A fragrant {myrtle} bush grew beside the garden path.
e.zh: 一丛芬芳的桃金娘灌木长在花园小径旁。

e.en: Crepe {myrtle} trees bloom with bright pink flowers in summer.
e.zh: 紫薇树在夏天开出鲜艳的粉红色花朵。

e.en: I made the entire dinner by {myself} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚整顿晚餐都是我自己做的。

e.en: I treated {myself} to a new pair of headphones.
e.zh: 我给自己买了一副新耳机犒劳自己。

mysteries.t: n. mystery 的复数；谜团、悬疑作品

e.en: She loves reading detective {mysteries} on rainy weekends.
e.zh: 她喜欢在下雨的周末阅读侦探推理小说。

e.en: Science continues to unravel the {mysteries} of the universe.
e.zh: 科学不断揭开宇宙的奥秘。

mysterious.t: adj. 神秘的、难以理解的

e.en: A {mysterious} package appeared on her doorstep this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上她家门口出现了一个神秘的包裹。

e.en: He gave a {mysterious} smile but refused to explain.
e.zh: 他露出神秘的微笑,却拒绝解释。

mysteriously.t: adv. 神秘地、不可思议地

e.en: All my socks have {mysteriously} disappeared from the dryer.
e.zh: 我所有的袜子都神秘地从烘干机里消失了。

e.en: The website {mysteriously} crashed right before the product launch.
e.zh: 产品发布前网站神秘地崩溃了。

mystery.t:
n. 谜、未解之事
n. 悬疑类作品

e.en: How the cat got out remains a complete {mystery}.
e.zh: 那只猫是怎么跑出去的至今仍是个谜。

e.en: She's writing a murder {mystery} set in 1920s Shanghai.
e.zh: 她正在写一部以1920年代上海为背景的谋杀悬疑小说。

mystic.t:
n. 神秘主义者
adj. 神秘的

e.en: The medieval {mystic} claimed to have visions of angels.
e.zh: 那位中世纪神秘主义者声称见到了天使的异象。

e.en: Tibetan monks practice ancient {mystic} traditions in remote monasteries.
e.zh: 藏族僧侣在偏远寺院里修习古老的神秘传统。

e.en: The forest had a {mystical} quality at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时分,森林透着一种神秘的气息。

e.en: She had a {mystical} experience during the meditation retreat.
e.zh: 她在禅修期间经历了一次神秘的体验。

e.en: The lake glowed {mystically} under the full moon.
e.zh: 湖水在满月下神秘地闪着光。

e.en: He spoke {mystically} about messages he received in dreams.
e.zh: 他神秘地谈起自己在梦中收到的讯息。

e.en: Sufi {mysticism} emphasizes a personal connection with the divine.
e.zh: 苏菲神秘主义强调与神的个人联结。

e.en: She studied Eastern {mysticism} during her year in India.
e.zh: 她在印度的那一年里研究东方神秘主义。

e.en: The audience watched the magic trick in total {mystification}.
e.zh: 观众完全困惑地看着那个魔术表演。

e.en: His sudden resignation caused widespread {mystification} among colleagues.
e.zh: 他突然辞职让同事们普遍感到困惑不解。

mystified.t:
adj. 困惑的
v. 使迷惑（过去式）

e.en: Engineers were {mystified} by the rocket's unexpected failure.
e.zh: 工程师们对火箭意外失败感到困惑不解。

e.en: She looked {mystified} when he proposed in the supermarket.
e.zh: 当他在超市里求婚时,她看上去一脸茫然。

mystifies.t: v. 使困惑（第三人称单数）

e.en: His sudden change of mood always {mystifies} his friends.
e.zh: 他情绪的突然转变总让朋友们百思不解。

e.en: The disappearance of the painting still {mystifies} investigators.
e.zh: 那幅画的失踪至今仍让调查人员困惑不解。

e.en: Quantum physics continues to {mystify} even seasoned researchers.
e.zh: 量子物理学连资深研究人员都仍感困惑。

e.en: The error message seems designed to {mystify} ordinary users.
e.zh: 那条错误信息似乎就是为了让普通用户摸不着头脑。

mystifying.t: adj. 令人费解的；神秘的

e.en: The app's sudden popularity in Brazil is genuinely {mystifying}.
e.zh: 这款应用在巴西突然走红实在让人费解。

e.en: She gave a {mystifying} answer that raised more questions.
e.zh: 她给出了一个令人费解的回答,引发了更多疑问。

e.en: The brand has a certain {mystique} that competitors can't copy.
e.zh: 这个品牌有一种竞争对手无法复制的神秘魅力。

e.en: Old Hollywood stars cultivated an air of {mystique} offscreen.
e.zh: 老好莱坞明星在镜头外刻意营造神秘感。

e.en: Different cultures build different {mystiques} around their royal families.
e.zh: 不同文化围绕王室塑造出不同的神秘光环。

e.en: Luxury labels carefully protect the {mystiques} surrounding their founders.
e.zh: 奢侈品牌精心维护围绕其创始人的神秘色彩。

e.en: It's a common {myth} that you only use ten percent of your brain.
e.zh: 人只用大脑百分之十是个常见的误解。

e.en: Every culture has its own creation {myth} explaining the world.
e.zh: 每种文化都有自己解释世界起源的神话。

e.en: That comeback game has reached {mythic} status among fans.
e.zh: 那场逆转比赛在球迷中已被传为神话。

e.en: The novel mixes everyday life with {mythic} imagery.
e.zh: 这部小说把日常生活与神话意象交织在一起。

e.en: Dragons are {mythical} creatures that appear across many cultures.
e.zh: 龙是出现在许多文化中的神话生物。

e.en: He chased the {mythical} perfect work-life balance for years.
e.zh: 他多年来追求所谓完美的工作生活平衡。

mythological.t: adj. 神话的；与神话相关的

e.en: The painting depicts a scene from Greek {mythological} stories.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了希腊神话故事中的一个场景。

e.en: The game features heroes and monsters from {mythological} traditions.
e.zh: 这款游戏取材于神话传说中的英雄和怪物。

e.en: Ancient {mythologies} often share surprisingly similar themes.
e.zh: 古代各种神话体系常常有惊人相似的主题。

e.en: Marvel built sprawling {mythologies} around its superhero universe.
e.zh: 漫威围绕其超级英雄宇宙构建了庞大的神话体系。

mythologist.t: n. 神话学家；神话研究者

e.en: The {mythologist} compared flood stories from twenty different cultures.
e.zh: 这位神话学者比较了二十种不同文化中的洪水故事。

e.en: As a {mythologist}, she travels to record oral traditions.
e.zh: 作为一位神话学家,她到处记录口传故事。

mythologize.t: v. 使神话化；编造神话

e.en: Fans tend to {mythologize} the band's early club years.
e.zh: 歌迷们倾向于把乐队早期的酒吧岁月神话化。

e.en: Biographers often {mythologize} their subjects beyond recognition.
e.zh: 传记作家常把传主神化得面目全非。

e.en: Norse {mythology} has inspired countless movies and games.
e.zh: 北欧神话激发了无数电影和游戏的灵感。

e.en: There's a whole {mythology} around how the company was founded.
e.zh: 关于这家公司创立过程有一整套传说。

mythopoeic.t: adj. 创造神话的；神话式的

e.en: Tolkien's {mythopoeic} imagination created entire languages and histories.
e.zh: 托尔金的神话创造力孕育了完整的语言和历史。

e.en: The novel has a deeply {mythopoeic} feel from page one.
e.zh: 这部小说从第一页起就充满神话创作的气息。

e.en: The Star Wars {mythos} keeps expanding with every new series.
e.zh: 《星球大战》的神话体系随每部新剧不断扩展。

e.en: Lovecraft's {mythos} influences horror writers to this day.
e.zh: 洛夫克拉夫特的神话体系至今仍影响着恐怖作家。

e.en: Let's bust a few common {myths} about healthy eating.
e.zh: 我们来破除几个关于健康饮食的常见误区。

e.en: Many ancient {myths} attempt to explain natural disasters.
e.zh: 许多古老神话试图解释自然灾害。

e.en: The pathology report described a {myxoid} tumor in the soft tissue.
e.zh: 病理报告描述软组织中有一处黏液样肿瘤。

e.en: {Myxoid} liposarcomas usually respond well to radiation therapy.
e.zh: 黏液样脂肪肉瘤通常对放疗反应良好。

maddest.t: a. 疯狂的, 发疯的, 生气的, 愚蠢的, 狂欢的\nn. 狂怒

madmen.t: n. 疯子, 精神病患者\n[法] 疯子, 狂人

manliest.t: a. 象男人的, 强壮的, 适于男人的

manlier.t: a. 象男人的, 强壮的, 适于男人的

marksmen.t: n. 射手, 狙击兵, 神射手\n[法] 按手印者, 不能用笔署名者

matrices.t: n. 母体, 子宫, 基质, 脉石, 模型, 矩阵\n[计] 矩阵

maxima.t: n. 极点, 最大量, 极大\na. 最高的, 最大的, 最大极限的\n[计] 最大值

meatier.t: a. 肉的, 似肉的, 多肉的

meekest.t: a. 温顺的, 逆来顺受的

memoranda.t: n. 备忘录, 外交备忘录, 交易备忘录\n[经] 备忘录, 便笺, 便函

merchantmen.t: n. 商船, 商人\n[经] 远洋或沿海客货轮

merest.t: n. 小湖, 池塘\na. 仅仅的, 只不过的

mermen.t: n. 男性人鱼, 善泳的男子

merrier.t: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 嬉戏作乐的

merriest.t: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 嬉戏作乐的

messier.t: a. 散乱的, 污秽的, 麻烦的

middlemen.t: n. 中间人\n[法] 调解人, 中间人, 中人

mightiest.t: n. 有势力的人\na. 有势力的, 强大的, 有力的\nadv. 很, 极

mightier.t: n. 有势力的人\na. 有势力的, 强大的, 有力的\nadv. 很, 极

mildest.t: a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的\n[医] 轻的, 缓和的

milkmen.t: n. 牛奶商, 送奶工, 挤奶的男人

minima.t: a. 最小的, 最低的\nn. 最小值\n[计] 最小值

minutemen.t: n. (美国独立战争时的)民兵

miscarried.t: vi. 失败, 被误送, 流产\n[医] 流产

mislaid.t: vt. 放错地方, 遗忘, 丢弃

mistier.t: a. 有雾的, 模糊的, 笼罩着雾的

moduli.t: n. 标准, 系数, 模数\n[化] 模量

mollified.t: vt. 平息, 缓和, 减轻, 使变软

moodier.t: a. 心情不稳的, 郁郁寡欢的, 喜怒无常的

moodiest.t: a. 心情不稳的, 郁郁寡欢的, 喜怒无常的

mouldiest.t: a. 发霉的, 陈腐的, 乏味的

muddier.t: a. 泥泞的, 浑浊的, 模糊的\nvt. 使污浊, 使沾上泥污

muddiest.t: a. 泥泞的, 浑浊的, 模糊的\nvt. 使污浊, 使沾上泥污

murkiest.t: a. 黝暗的, 阴沉的, 朦胧的

murkier.t: a. 黝暗的, 阴沉的, 朦胧的

mustiest.t: a. 发霉的, 霉臭的, 落伍的

mutinied.t: n. 叛变, 兵变\nvi. 叛变, 反抗, 暴动

e.en: Many small shops now rely on {m-commerce} for daily sales.
e.zh: 许多小店现在依靠移动电子商务来完成日常销售。

e.en: The report compares desktop shopping with {m-commerce} trends.
e.zh: 这份报告比较了桌面购物和移动电商趋势。

e.en: The headset uses an {m-display} to project images near the eye.
e.zh: 这款头显使用微显示器在眼睛附近投射图像。

e.en: An {m-display} can make phone notifications visible on a watch.
e.zh: 移动显示屏可以让手机通知显示在手表上。

e.en: The technician used an {m-scan} to measure the heart valve motion.
e.zh: 技术员使用M型扫描来测量心脏瓣膜的运动。

e.en: An {m-scan} shows movement along one ultrasound line over time.
e.zh: M型扫描显示一条超声线随时间变化的运动情况。

e.en: The catalog labels this connector as an {m-type} fitting.
e.zh: 目录把这种连接件标为M型配件。

e.en: Astronomers identified the star as an {m-type} dwarf.
e.zh: 天文学家把这颗恒星认定为M型矮星。

e.en: The neurologist measured the {m-wave} after stimulating the nerve.
e.zh: 神经科医生刺激神经后测量了M波。

e.en: A weak {m-wave} may indicate impaired muscle response.
e.zh: M波较弱可能表明肌肉反应受损。

e.en: They bought bread from a {ma-and-pa} grocery on the corner.
e.zh: 他们在街角一家家庭式小杂货店买面包。

e.en: The chain store replaced several {ma-and-pa} businesses downtown.
e.zh: 那家连锁店取代了市中心几家家庭经营的小店。

e.en: A quiet lake filled the ancient {maar}.
e.zh: 一片平静的湖水填满了古老的低平火山口。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {maar} formed by a violent steam explosion.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了由剧烈蒸汽爆炸形成的低平火山口。

e.en: She added powdered {maca} to her morning smoothie.
e.zh: 她在早晨的冰沙里加入了玛咖粉。

e.en: Farmers grow {maca} high in the Andes.
e.zh: 农民在安第斯高地种植玛咖。

e.en: The play ended with a strangely {macaber} dance.
e.zh: 那出戏以一段怪异阴森的舞蹈收场。

e.en: His humor had a {macaber} edge that unsettled the guests.
e.zh: 他的幽默带着恐怖意味，让客人们感到不安。

e.en: The old travel book described a {macaco} in the forest.
e.zh: 那本旧旅行书描述了森林里的一只美洲猴。

e.en: A {macaco} appeared in the naturalist's notes.
e.zh: 一只卷尾猴类动物出现在那位博物学家的笔记中。

e.en: The council voted to {macadamise} the muddy lane.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定用碎石铺那条泥泞小路。

e.en: Workers began to {macadamise} the road before winter.
e.zh: 工人们在冬天前开始用碎石铺这条路。

macadamization.t: 碎石铺路法；碎石路面施工

e.en: The report praised the {macadamization} of rural roads.
e.zh: 报告称赞了乡村道路的碎石铺设工程。

e.en: Early {macadamization} made travel faster in wet weather.
e.zh: 早期的碎石铺路让雨天出行更快。

e.en: They planned to {macadamize} the main street.
e.zh: 他们计划用碎石铺设主街。

e.en: The estate owner paid to {macadamize} the driveway.
e.zh: 庄园主出钱把车道铺成碎石路面。

e.en: The carriage rolled smoothly along the {macadamized} road.
e.zh: 马车沿着铺好的碎石路平稳前行。

e.en: A {macadamized} surface replaced the old dirt track.
e.zh: 碎石路面取代了原来的土路。

e.en: The town {macadamizes} lanes that flood each spring.
e.zh: 镇上把每年春天会淹水的小巷铺成碎石路。

e.en: This method {macadamizes} a road with compacted stone layers.
e.zh: 这种方法用压实的石层来铺设道路。

macadamizing.t: 正在用碎石铺路；碎石铺路

e.en: Crews are {macadamizing} the road near the mill.
e.zh: 施工队正在给磨坊附近的道路铺碎石。

e.en: The book explains {macadamizing} as a modern road technique.
e.zh: 这本书把碎石铺路解释为一种现代筑路技术。

macana.t: 木棍武器；美洲土著棍棒

e.en: The warrior carried a heavy {macana} into battle.
e.zh: 那名战士带着沉重的木制棍棒上阵。

e.en: A carved {macana} was displayed in the museum case.
e.zh: 一根雕刻过的美洲土著棍棒陈列在博物馆展柜里。

macaroni-eating.t: 吃通心粉的；意大利式的

e.en: The cartoon mocked a {macaroni-eating} foreigner.
e.zh: 那幅漫画嘲笑了一个吃通心粉的外国人。

e.en: He used {macaroni-eating} as a crude insult.
e.zh: 他把“吃通心粉的”当作粗鲁的侮辱语。

macaronic.t: 混用多种语言的；夹杂外语的

e.en: The poem uses a {macaronic} mix of Latin and English.
e.zh: 这首诗混用了拉丁语和英语。

e.en: Students laughed at his {macaronic} classroom jokes.
e.zh: 学生们被他夹杂外语的课堂笑话逗笑了。

e.en: The gentleman kept {maccaboy} in a silver box.
e.zh: 那位绅士把马卡巴鼻烟装在银盒里。

e.en: She recognized the sharp scent of {maccaboy}.
e.zh: 她认出了马卡巴鼻烟刺鼻的气味。

maccaroni.t: 通心粉的旧拼法；纨绔青年

e.en: The recipe spells {maccaroni} in the old style.
e.zh: 这份食谱用旧拼法写通心粉。

e.en: An eighteenth-century {maccaroni} dressed with exaggerated elegance.
e.zh: 十八世纪的纨绔青年穿着夸张而讲究。

e.en: She ordered a caramel {macchiato} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后她点了一杯焦糖玛奇朵。

e.en: A traditional {macchiato} has espresso marked with milk.
e.zh: 传统玛奇朵是在浓缩咖啡中点入少量牛奶。

e.en: He offered his guest a pinch of {maccoboy}.
e.zh: 他请客人闻一点马卡巴鼻烟。

e.en: The diary mentions {maccoboy} among household luxuries.
e.zh: 日记把马卡巴鼻烟列为家中的奢侈品之一。

mace-bearer.t: 权杖持有人；仪仗执杖者

e.en: The {mace-bearer} walked before the mayor.
e.zh: 执权杖者走在市长前面。

e.en: A ceremonial {mace-bearer} led the procession into the hall.
e.zh: 一名仪仗执杖者带领队伍进入大厅。

e.en: The chef served a chilled {macedoine} with dessert.
e.zh: 厨师随甜点端上了一份冰镇什锦水果丁。

e.en: Her salad included a neat {macedoine} of vegetables.
e.zh: 她的沙拉里有切得整齐的什锦蔬菜丁。

e.en: Each {maceral} reflects different plant material in the coal.
e.zh: 每一种煤岩显微组分都反映煤中不同的植物材料。

e.en: The geologist identified a bright {maceral} under the microscope.
e.zh: 地质学家在显微镜下识别出一种明亮的煤岩组分。

e.en: The berries undergo {maceration} before fermentation begins.
e.zh: 浆果在发酵开始前会先经过浸渍处理。

e.en: Prolonged {maceration} softened the skin around the wound.
e.zh: 长时间浸湿使伤口周围的皮肤变软。

e.en: She {MacGyvered} a phone stand from two clips.
e.zh: 她用两个夹子临时巧妙做了个手机支架。

e.en: We had to {MacGyver} a solution before the guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来前，我们只好就地想办法凑出一个解决方案。

e.en: The museum displayed a bronze {machaira} beside the shield.
e.zh: 博物馆把一把青铜古希腊短刀陈列在盾牌旁。

e.en: In the epic, the warrior drew his {machaira} quietly.
e.zh: 在史诗中，那名武士悄悄拔出了他的古希腊短刀。

e.en: The hunters waited on a bamboo {machan} above the trail.
e.zh: 猎人们在小路上方的竹制高台上等待。

e.en: A small {machan} gave the guards a clear view of the field.
e.zh: 一个小高台让守卫能清楚看见整片田地。

e.en: The builders planned to {machicolate} the gate tower.
e.zh: 工匠们计划给城门塔楼加设雉堞射孔。

e.en: A castle wall can {machicolate} above its main entrance.
e.zh: 城堡墙体可以在正门上方设置防御射孔。

e.en: A {machicolated} parapet crowned the old fortress.
e.zh: 一道带雉堞射孔的胸墙立在古堡顶端。

e.en: The guide pointed to the {machicolated} balcony over the gate.
e.zh: 导游指向城门上方那个带防御孔的凸廊。

e.en: The tower {machicolates} over the narrow stone bridge.
e.zh: 那座塔在狭窄石桥上方设有雉堞射孔。

e.en: This design {machicolates} the wall without weakening it.
e.zh: 这种设计给墙体加了防御射孔，却没有削弱墙身。

e.en: Workers were {machicolating} the restored castle entrance.
e.zh: 工人们正在给修复后的城堡入口设置雉堞射孔。

e.en: The architect avoided {machicolating} the modern facade.
e.zh: 建筑师避免在现代外墙上加入仿古防御射孔。

e.en: The castle's {machicolation} allowed defenders to drop stones.
e.zh: 城堡的雉堞射孔让守军可以往下投石。

e.en: Restorers repaired the damaged {machicolation} above the archway.
e.zh: 修复人员修好了拱门上方受损的突堞结构。

e.en: The alloy has excellent {machinability} at high speeds.
e.zh: 这种合金在高速加工时具有出色的可加工性。

e.en: Engineers tested the steel's {machinability} before production.
e.zh: 工程师在投产前测试了这种钢材的切削性能。

e.en: The new plastic is strong but easily {machinable}.
e.zh: 这种新塑料很结实，但也容易机械加工。

e.en: They chose a {machinable} grade of aluminum for the part.
e.zh: 他们为这个零件选择了可机械加工的铝材等级。

e.en: Her {machinal} movements showed how tired she was.
e.zh: 她机械般的动作显出她有多疲惫。

e.en: The poem describes a cold, {machinal} city.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一座冰冷而机器般运转的城市。

e.en: The rebels began to {machinate} against the king.
e.zh: 叛乱者开始密谋反对国王。

e.en: He preferred to {machinate} quietly behind polite smiles.
e.zh: 他更喜欢在礼貌微笑背后暗中策划。

e.en: They {machinated} for months before the coup.
e.zh: 政变前他们密谋策划了好几个月。

e.en: The villain had {machinated} every detail of the betrayal.
e.zh: 那个反派早已策划好了背叛的每个细节。

e.en: She {machinates} while pretending to support the committee.
e.zh: 她一边假装支持委员会，一边暗中密谋。

e.en: The minister {machinates} against his rivals at court.
e.zh: 那位大臣在宫廷中密谋对付政敌。

e.en: The general was {machinating} a quiet seizure of power.
e.zh: 那位将军正在秘密策划夺取权力。

e.en: I suspected them of {machinating} behind closed doors.
e.zh: 我怀疑他们在闭门密谋。

e.en: The court feared him as a skilled {machinator}.
e.zh: 宫廷里的人都忌惮他这个老练的阴谋策划者。

e.en: Every thriller needs a convincing {machinator} behind the plot.
e.zh: 每部惊悚片都需要一个可信的幕后策划者。

e.en: The factory adopted {machine-casting} to improve consistency.
e.zh: 工厂采用机器铸造来提高产品一致性。

e.en: Traditional casting was slower than {machine-casting} for small parts.
e.zh: 对小零件来说，传统铸造比机器铸造更慢。

e.en: The {machine-cut} panels fit perfectly together.
e.zh: 这些机器切割的板材拼合得非常严密。

e.en: She preferred hand-cut gems to {machine-cut} stones.
e.zh: 相比机器切割的宝石，她更喜欢手工切割的。

e.en: The soldiers carried a heavy {machine-gun}.
e.zh: 士兵们抬着一挺沉重的机枪。

e.en: The attackers tried to {machine-gun} the convoy.
e.zh: 袭击者试图用机枪扫射车队。

e.en: The {machine-gunner} guarded the ridge at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，机枪手守在山脊上。

e.en: A trained {machine-gunner} must control short bursts.
e.zh: 受过训练的机枪手必须控制短点射。

e.en: The report described {machine-gunning} from the hill.
e.zh: 报告描述了来自山上的机枪扫射。

e.en: He was accused of {machine-gunning} civilians during the attack.
e.zh: 他被指控在袭击中用机枪扫射平民。

e.en: The factory calculated costs per {machine-hour}.
e.zh: 工厂按每个机器工时计算成本。

e.en: Each {machine-hour} was logged for the maintenance report.
e.zh: 每个机器工时都被记录进维护报告。

e.en: The shop sells both handmade and {machine-made} carpets.
e.zh: 这家店既卖手工地毯，也卖机器制造的地毯。

e.en: The {machine-made} parts were cheaper but less distinctive.
e.zh: 这些机器制造的零件更便宜，但没那么有特色。

e.en: The company improved its {machine-molding} process.
e.zh: 公司改进了机器模塑工艺。

e.en: {Machine-molding} gives the casing a consistent shape.
e.zh: 机械成型让外壳保持一致的形状。

e.en: The passport contains a {machine-readable} code.
e.zh: 护照上有一段机器可读的代码。

e.en: Researchers released the data in a {machine-readable} format.
e.zh: 研究人员以机器可读的格式发布了数据。

e.en: The labels must be {machine-recognizable} at checkout.
e.zh: 这些标签在结账时必须能被机器识别。

e.en: They converted handwritten marks into {machine-recognizable} symbols.
e.zh: 他们把手写标记转换成机器可识别的符号。

e.en: The shipyard adopted {machine-riveting} for faster assembly.
