e.zh: 旧文献用微微米表示很小的长度。

e.en: One {micromicron} is now commonly called one nanometer.
e.zh: 一微微米现在通常称为一纳米。

e.en: The sensor used less than a {micromicrowatt} of power.
e.zh: 这个传感器耗电不到一微微瓦。

e.en: The paper reported signal strength in {micromicrowatts}.
e.zh: 论文以微微瓦报告信号强度。

e.en: Zinc is an important {micromineral} in human nutrition.
e.zh: 锌是人体营养中重要的微量矿物质。

e.en: The feed was tested for {micromineral} content.
e.zh: 这种饲料检测了微量矿物质含量。

e.en: She wore a silver {micromini} to the concert.
e.zh: 她穿了一条银色超短迷你裙去听演唱会。

e.en: The company advertised a {micromini} recorder for travelers.
e.zh: 公司宣传了一款面向旅行者的极小型录音机。

e.en: {Microminiaturization} made modern hearing aids less visible.
e.zh: 微型化让现代助听器变得不那么显眼。

e.en: The project focused on {microminiaturization} of medical sensors.
e.zh: 该项目专注于医疗传感器的超小型化。

e.en: Engineers worked to {microminiaturize} the navigation module.
e.zh: 工程师努力把导航模块微型化。

e.en: The company hopes to {microminiaturize} the device further.
e.zh: 公司希望进一步使该设备超小型化。

e.en: The probe contains {microminiaturized} sensors and a battery.
e.zh: 探针内含微型化传感器和一块电池。

e.en: A {microminiaturized} camera was hidden inside the tube.
e.zh: 一台超小型化摄像机藏在管内。

e.en: The drug worked at {micromolar} concentrations in cells.
e.zh: 这种药物在细胞中的微摩尔浓度下起效。

e.en: They prepared a {micromolar} solution for the assay.
e.zh: 他们为检测配制了微摩尔浓度的溶液。

e.en: Each vial contained one {micromole} of the compound.
e.zh: 每个小瓶含有一微摩尔这种化合物。

e.en: The reaction released several {micromoles} of gas.
e.zh: 该反应释放了数微摩尔气体。

e.en: The soil showed {micromorphological} signs of ancient flooding.
e.zh: 土壤显示出古代洪水留下的微形态迹象。

e.en: Her {micromorphological} analysis compared tiny bone structures.
e.zh: 她的微形态分析比较了细小的骨骼结构。

e.en: A {micromotor} powered the tiny surgical tool.
e.zh: 一个微型电机驱动了这件微小的手术工具。

e.en: Researchers built a chemical {micromotor} that swims in liquid.
e.zh: 研究人员制造了一种能在液体中游动的化学微马达。

e.en: The {micronephelometer} measured particles in the water sample.
e.zh: 微量浊度计测量了水样中的颗粒。

e.en: Clinicians used a {micronephelometer} for the protein assay.
e.zh: 临床人员用微量浊度计进行蛋白检测。

e.en: The filter traps {micronic} dust from the air.
e.zh: 这种过滤器能截留空气中的微米级粉尘。

e.en: They inspected the chip for {micronic} defects.
e.zh: 他们检查芯片是否存在极细微缺陷。

e.en: The lab used a {micropump} to deliver tiny doses of medicine.
e.zh: 实验室用微型泵输送极小剂量的药物。

e.en: A faulty {micropump} stopped the cooling liquid from circulating.
e.zh: 一个故障的微型泵使冷却液无法循环。

e.en: The researcher used {micropuncture} to sample fluid from a single tubule.
e.zh: 研究人员用微穿刺从单个小管中取样液体。

e.en: Kidney function can be studied through careful {micropuncture} experiments.
e.zh: 肾功能可以通过谨慎的显微穿刺实验来研究。

e.en: A {micropyrometer} measured the temperature of the glowing wire.
e.zh: 微型高温计测量了发光金属丝的温度。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {micropyrometer} before testing the tiny furnace.
e.zh: 技术员在测试小型炉子前校准了微型高温计。

e.en: Sensors recorded a {microquake} beneath the geothermal field.
e.zh: 传感器记录到地热区地下的一次微震。

e.en: The miners ignored the first {microquake}, but engineers grew worried.
e.zh: 矿工忽略了第一次小型地震，但工程师开始担心。

e.en: The dentist examined a {microradiograph} of the thin enamel sample.
e.zh: 牙医查看了一张薄牙釉质样本的显微射线照片。

e.en: Each {microradiograph} revealed cracks invisible to ordinary imaging.
e.zh: 每张显微射线照片都显示出普通成像看不到的裂纹。

e.en: The team used {microradiography} to study mineral loss in bone.
e.zh: 团队用显微放射照相术研究骨骼中的矿物质流失。

e.en: Industrial {microradiography} can expose defects in very small parts.
e.zh: 工业显微放射照相术能显示极小零件中的缺陷。

e.en: Her thesis focused on {microradiology} of developing teeth.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于发育中牙齿的显微放射学。

e.en: Advances in {microradiology} improved the analysis of tiny bone samples.
e.zh: 显微放射学的进步改善了微小骨样本的分析。

e.en: The satellite carried a {microradiometer} for measuring faint heat signals.
e.zh: 卫星搭载了微辐射计，用来测量微弱的热信号。

e.en: A sensitive {microradiometer} detected radiation changes across the sample.
e.zh: 一台灵敏的微辐射计检测到样本中的辐射变化。

e.en: She used a {microreader} to examine old newspaper archives.
e.zh: 她用缩微胶片阅读器查看旧报纸档案。

e.en: The library replaced its broken {microreader} with a digital scanner.
e.zh: 图书馆用数字扫描仪替换了坏掉的缩微胶片阅读器。

e.en: Rainwater collected in the {microrelief} of the field surface.
e.zh: 雨水积在田地表面的微地形凹处。

e.en: The coin's {microrelief} was visible only under strong magnification.
e.zh: 硬币上的细微浮雕只有在高倍放大下才看得见。

e.en: The archive chose {microreproduction} to preserve fragile manuscripts.
e.zh: 档案馆选择缩微复制来保存脆弱的手稿。

e.en: Early {microreproduction} made large document collections easier to store.
e.zh: 早期的缩微复制让大型文献收藏更容易保存。

e.en: The chemist analyzed a {microsample} taken from the painting.
e.zh: 化学家分析了从画作上取下的微量样本。

e.en: Only a {microsample} was needed to identify the contaminant.
e.zh: 只需一个微量样本就能识别污染物。

e.en: The reaction was performed at {microscale} to reduce waste.
e.zh: 这项反应以微型规模进行，以减少废物。

e.en: At the {microscale}, surface forces can dominate gravity.
e.zh: 在微尺度下，表面力可能会超过重力的影响。

e.en: The dentist selected a {microscaler} for the delicate cleaning work.
e.zh: 牙医选用微型洁牙器进行精细清洁。

e.en: A {microscaler} helped the technician reduce measurements precisely.
e.zh: 微缩器帮助技术员精确缩小测量值。

e.en: The surgeon fixed the tiny bone fragment with a {microscrew}.
e.zh: 外科医生用微型螺钉固定了细小的骨片。

e.en: Do not lose the {microscrew} when opening the camera housing.
e.zh: 打开相机外壳时不要弄丢那颗微型螺钉。

e.en: The pathologist stained the {microsection} before viewing it.
e.zh: 病理学家在观察前给显微切片染色。

e.en: A thin {microsection} showed the metal's internal grain structure.
e.zh: 一片薄薄的显微切片显示出金属内部的晶粒结构。

e.en: Each {microsegment} of the market responded differently to the campaign.
e.zh: 市场中的每个微小细分群体对这次活动反应不同。

e.en: The image was divided into a {microsegment} for closer analysis.
e.zh: 图像被分成微小片段以便更仔细地分析。

e.en: The instrument detected a distant {microseism} during the night.
e.zh: 仪器在夜间探测到远处的一次微震。

e.en: Ocean waves can generate a continuous {microseism} in the ground.
e.zh: 海浪会在地面中产生持续的微地震。

e.en: Engineers monitored {microseismic} activity near the injection well.
e.zh: 工程师监测注入井附近的微震活动。

e.en: The {microseismic} data helped map fractures deep underground.
e.zh: 这些微地震数据帮助绘制了地下深处裂缝的分布。

e.en: A {microseismograph} recorded vibrations too small to feel.
e.zh: 微震记录仪记录下了人体感觉不到的振动。

e.en: The station installed a new {microseismograph} beside the coast.
e.zh: 观测站在海岸旁安装了一台新的微震记录仪。

e.en: She studies {microseismology} to understand subtle ground vibrations.
e.zh: 她研究微震学，以理解细微的地面振动。

e.en: Modern {microseismology} is useful in oil and geothermal exploration.
e.zh: 现代微震学在石油和地热勘探中很有用。

e.en: The cave housed a {microseismometer} protected from surface noise.
e.zh: 洞穴里放置了一台微震仪，以避开地表噪声。

e.en: A portable {microseismometer} helped survey the unstable slope.
e.zh: 便携式微震仪帮助勘测了不稳定的山坡。

e.en: A {microsensor} inside the pipe tracked pressure changes.
e.zh: 管道内的微型传感器跟踪压力变化。

e.en: The wearable patch uses a {microsensor} to monitor sweat chemistry.
e.zh: 这款可穿戴贴片使用微型传感器监测汗液化学成分。

e.en: The casting showed {microshrinkage} near the center of the metal.
e.zh: 铸件在金属中心附近出现了微收缩。

e.en: Engineers adjusted the cooling rate to prevent {microshrinkage}.
e.zh: 工程师调整冷却速度，以防止微收缩。

microlepidopterous.t: 小鳞翅目昆虫的；小蛾类的微小鳞翅目蛾类

e.en: The drawer held several {microlepidopterous} specimens from the survey.
e.zh: 抽屉里放着这次调查采集的几件小鳞翅目昆虫标本。

e.en: Her paper described {microlepidopterous} damage on the orchard leaves.
e.zh: 她的论文描述了果园叶片上由小蛾类造成的损害。

microlinguistics.t: 微观语言学；语言微观结构研究

e.en: The course introduces {microlinguistics} before discussing social language use.
e.zh: 这门课先介绍微观语言学，再讨论语言的社会使用。

e.en: His research in {microlinguistics} focuses on sounds and sentence structure.
e.zh: 他的微观语言学研究侧重语音和句子结构。

e.en: A thin section revealed a tiny {microlite} in the volcanic glass.
e.zh: 薄片显示火山玻璃中有一颗微小矿物晶体。

e.en: The gemologist identified the dark speck as a {microlite} inclusion.
e.zh: 宝石学家把那个黑色小点鉴定为微晶包裹体。

e.en: The archaeologist found a {microlith} beside the ancient hearth.
e.zh: 考古学家在古代炉址旁发现了一件细石器。

e.en: Each {microlith} was once fitted into a wooden handle.
e.zh: 每件微型石器过去都曾嵌入木柄中使用。

microlithic.t: 细石器的；微石器文化的

e.en: The museum displayed {microlithic} tools from a prehistoric camp.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了史前营地出土的细石器工具。

e.en: A {microlithic} tradition spread across the region after the ice age.
e.zh: 冰期之后，一种微石器文化传统在该地区传播开来。

e.en: Modern chips depend on {microlithography} to define their circuits.
e.zh: 现代芯片依靠微影技术来刻画电路。

e.en: The lab improved its {microlithography} process for smaller sensors.
e.zh: 实验室改进了微细光刻工艺，以制造更小的传感器。

microlithology.t: 微岩石学；岩石微观结构研究

e.en: The report used {microlithology} to classify the reservoir rocks.
e.zh: 报告利用微岩石学对储层岩石进行分类。

e.en: Students learned {microlithology} by examining slices under a microscope.
e.zh: 学生通过显微镜观察薄片来学习岩石微观结构研究。

e.en: Add one {microlitre} of dye to each sample.
e.zh: 给每个样本加入一微升染料。

e.en: The pipette can measure less than a {microlitre} accurately.
e.zh: 这支移液器能准确量取不到一微升的液体。

e.en: The connector uses a {microlock} to keep the cable in place.
e.zh: 这个接头使用微型锁来固定电缆。

e.en: A damaged {microlock} made the surgical tool hard to adjust.
e.zh: 一个损坏的细小锁定装置让这件手术工具难以调节。

e.en: The device stores a {microlog} of every temperature change.
e.zh: 这台设备会保存每次温度变化的微型记录。

e.en: She kept a daily {microlog} of symptoms on her phone.
e.zh: 她每天在手机上简短记录自己的症状。

micrological.t: 微观研究的；过分琐细的

e.en: His {micrological} analysis noted every change in the manuscript.
e.zh: 他的微观分析记录了手稿中的每一处变化。

e.en: The debate became {micrological} and lost sight of the main issue.
e.zh: 这场辩论变得过分琐细，反而忽略了主要问题。

e.en: Early {micrology} depended on careful use of simple microscopes.
e.zh: 早期微观学依赖对简易显微镜的细致使用。

e.en: The editor cut pages of {micrology} from the argument.
e.zh: 编辑从论证中删去了好几页琐细论述。

e.en: Solder the wire to the {microlug} on the board.
e.zh: 把导线焊到电路板上的微型接线片上。

e.en: The tiny {microlug} helps align the watch component.
e.zh: 这个小凸耳有助于对准手表部件。

e.en: Embryo research often requires precise {micromanipulation} under a microscope.
e.zh: 胚胎研究常常需要在显微镜下进行精确的显微操作。

e.en: The experiment used {micromanipulation} to move a single cell.
e.zh: 实验采用微量操控来移动单个细胞。

micromanipulator.t: 显微操作器；微操纵装置

e.en: The scientist adjusted the {micromanipulator} with a steady hand.
e.zh: 科学家用稳定的手调节显微操作器。

e.en: A robotic {micromanipulator} placed the probe inside the cell.
e.zh: 一台机器人微操纵装置把探针放入细胞内。

e.en: The therapy uses {micromassage} to stimulate the skin gently.
e.zh: 这种疗法用微按摩轻柔刺激皮肤。

e.en: Some toothbrushes claim to provide {micromassage} for the gums.
e.zh: 有些牙刷宣称能为牙龈提供轻微振动按摩。

e.en: The sensor contains several {micromechanical} moving parts.
e.zh: 这个传感器含有几个微机械运动部件。

e.en: Their model explains the {micromechanical} behavior of cracked concrete.
e.zh: 他们的模型解释了开裂混凝土的微观力学行为。

e.en: The paper proposes a {micromechanism} for fatigue in the alloy.
e.zh: 论文提出了这种合金疲劳的一个微机制。

e.en: A hidden {micromechanism} opens the tiny valve automatically.
e.zh: 一个隐藏的微型机械装置会自动打开小阀门。

e.en: Each {micromere} divided rapidly during early development.
e.zh: 在早期发育中，每个小卵裂球都迅速分裂。

e.en: The diagram labels the upper cell as a {micromere}.
e.zh: 图中把上方的细胞标为小卵裂球。

e.en: The drug's {micromeritic} properties affected how it dissolved.
e.zh: 这种药物的粉体微粒性质影响了它的溶解方式。

e.en: Engineers measured {micromeritic} changes after milling the powder.
e.zh: 工程师测量了粉末研磨后的微粒性质变化。

e.en: Pharmacists use {micromeritics} to improve tablet formulation.
e.zh: 药剂师利用微粒学来改进片剂配方。

e.en: The course covers {micromeritics}, including particle size and surface area.
e.zh: 这门课讲授粉体性质研究，包括粒径和表面积。

e.en: The filter uses a stainless {micromesh} to trap fine particles.
e.zh: 这个过滤器使用不锈钢微网来截留细小颗粒。

e.en: A {micromesh} screen protected the delicate speaker opening.
e.zh: 一层极细网格材料保护着精密的扬声器开口。

e.en: The biopsy revealed a {micrometastasis} in one lymph node.
e.zh: 活检显示一个淋巴结内有微小癌转移灶。

e.en: Early treatment aims to destroy any hidden {micrometastasis}.
e.zh: 早期治疗旨在消灭任何隐藏的微转移。

e.en: A {micrometeor} can pit the surface of a spacecraft.
e.zh: 一颗微流星可能会在航天器表面打出小坑。

e.en: The detector recorded a {micrometeor} striking the shield.
e.zh: 探测器记录到一颗微小陨星体撞击护盾。

e.en: The panel showed tiny {micrometeoritic} impact marks.
e.zh: 面板上有微陨石撞击留下的细小痕迹。

e.en: Engineers tested the material against {micrometeoritic} dust in orbit.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种材料抵御轨道中微流星体尘埃的能力。

e.en: The lab identified a {microfungus} on the leaf sample.
e.zh: 实验室在叶片样本上鉴定出一种微小真菌。

e.en: This {microfungus} can damage stored grain.
e.zh: 这种微小真菌会损害储存的谷物。

e.en: A {microgamete} fuses with a larger cell during reproduction.
e.zh: 在繁殖过程中，小配子会与较大的细胞融合。

e.en: The parasite releases a motile {microgamete} in the host.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫会在宿主体内释放可运动的小配子。

e.en: Each {microgametocyte} later forms several male gametes.
e.zh: 每个小配子母细胞之后会形成几个雄性配子。

e.en: The blood smear showed a developing {microgametocyte}.
e.zh: 血涂片显示出一个正在发育的小配子母细胞。

microgauss.t: 微高斯；磁感应强度单位

e.en: The sensor detected a change of one {microgauss}.
e.zh: 传感器检测到一微高斯的变化。

e.en: Background magnetic noise was measured in {microgauss}.
e.zh: 背景磁噪声以微高斯为单位测量。

e.en: The dose was only one {microgramme} per kilogram.
e.zh: 剂量只有每公斤一微克。

e.en: British labels may write {microgramme} instead of microgram.
e.zh: 英国标签上可能写 microgramme，而不是 microgram。

e.en: The quarry exposed a pale band of {microgranite}.
e.zh: 采石场露出了一条浅色的细晶花岗岩带。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {microgranite} beside the older rocks.
e.zh: 地质学家绘出了较老岩层旁的微花岗岩分布。

e.en: The dyke has a {microgranitic} texture.
e.zh: 这条岩脉具有细晶花岗岩质结构。

e.en: They found {microgranitic} fragments in the volcanic deposit.
e.zh: 他们在火山沉积物中发现了细晶花岗岩质碎片。

micrographic.t: 显微照相的；缩微书写的

e.en: The report included a {micrographic} image of the alloy.
e.zh: 报告中包含一张该合金的显微照片。

e.en: Her notebook was filled with {micrographic} writing.
e.zh: 她的笔记本里写满了极小的字。

e.en: The institute teaches {micrography} to materials students.
e.zh: 该研究所向材料专业学生教授显微摄影。

e.en: His old diary used {micrography} to hide private notes.
e.zh: 他的旧日记用缩微书写隐藏私人笔记。

e.en: Each {microgroove} guides fluid through the chip.
e.zh: 每条微槽都会引导液体穿过芯片。

e.en: The stylus follows the {microgroove} on the record.
e.zh: 唱针沿着唱片上的密纹沟槽移动。

e.en: We measured the coating's {microhardness} after heating.
e.zh: 加热后，我们测量了涂层的显微硬度。

e.en: Higher {microhardness} made the surface resist scratches.
e.zh: 较高的微硬度使表面更耐刮擦。

e.en: The nurse prepared a {microhematocrit} tube for testing.
e.zh: 护士准备了一根微量血细胞比容管用于检测。

e.en: A {microhematocrit} result can reveal severe dehydration.
e.zh: 微量血细胞比容结果可以显示严重脱水。

microheterogeneity.t: 微观异质性；细微不均一性

e.en: Protein {microheterogeneity} complicated the analysis.
e.zh: 蛋白质的微观异质性使分析变得复杂。

e.en: The alloy shows {microheterogeneity} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这种合金在显微镜下呈现细微不均一性。

e.en: The contact resistance was below one {microhm}.
e.zh: 接触电阻低于一微欧姆。

e.en: Engineers recorded the reading in {microhm}.
e.zh: 工程师用微欧姆记录了读数。

e.en: A tiny {microinclusion} weakened the crystal.
e.zh: 一个微小包裹体削弱了这块晶体。

e.en: The steel sample contained a harmful {microinclusion}.
e.zh: 钢样中含有一个有害的微夹杂物。

e.en: Researchers {microinject} DNA into the embryo.
e.zh: 研究人员将 DNA 显微注射进胚胎。

e.en: The machine can {microinject} medicine into single cells.
e.zh: 这台机器能把药物微量注入单个细胞。

e.en: The embryo survived the {microinjection} procedure.
e.zh: 胚胎在显微注射操作后存活了下来。

e.en: Drug {microinjection} helped target one brain region.
e.zh: 药物微量注射有助于精准作用于一个脑区。

microinstability.t: 微观不稳定性；细微失稳

e.en: The plasma developed a dangerous {microinstability}.
e.zh: 等离子体产生了一种危险的微观不稳定性。

e.en: Small cracks can cause {microinstability} in the structure.
e.zh: 细小裂纹可能导致结构出现细微失稳。

e.en: A fast {microjet} pierced the liquid surface.
e.zh: 一股高速微射流穿透了液体表面。

e.en: The device uses a {microjet} to deliver ink precisely.
e.zh: 该设备利用微喷流精确输送墨水。

e.en: The singer underwent {microlaryngoscopy} after losing her voice.
e.zh: 这位歌手失声后接受了显微喉镜检查。

e.en: Doctors used {microlaryngoscopy} to remove a small lesion.
e.zh: 医生用显微喉镜检查术切除了一个小病灶。

e.en: The charity supports farmers through {microlending}.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构通过小额贷款支持农民。

e.en: Online {microlending} can help very small businesses grow.
e.zh: 线上微型借贷可以帮助小企业成长。

e.en: Each {microlens} focuses light onto a sensor.
e.zh: 每个微透镜都会把光聚焦到传感器上。

e.en: Astronomers detected a planet through a {microlens} effect.
e.zh: 天文学家通过微透镜效应探测到一颗行星。

e.en: She studies {microlepidoptera} in tropical forests.
e.zh: 她研究热带森林中的小型鳞翅目昆虫。

e.en: Many {microlepidoptera} are difficult to identify without a microscope.
e.zh: 许多小型鳞翅目昆虫不用显微镜很难鉴定。

e.en: The specimen was a rare {microlepidopteron}.
e.zh: 这个标本是一只罕见的小型鳞翅目昆虫。

e.en: A single {microlepidopteron} emerged from the leaf mine.
e.zh: 一只小型鳞翅目昆虫从叶潜道中羽化出来。

e.en: She chose a {mid-iron} for the approach shot.
e.zh: 她为这次攻果岭击球选了一支中铁杆。

e.en: A {mid-iron} is harder to control in strong wind.
e.zh: 在大风中，中铁杆更难控制。

e.en: The festival usually begins in {mid-July}.
e.zh: 这个节日通常在七月中旬开始。

e.en: By {mid-July}, the garden was full of tomatoes.
e.zh: 到七月中旬，花园里已经结满了番茄。

e.en: Many storms form in {mid-latitude} regions.
e.zh: 许多风暴形成于中纬度地区。

e.en: The city has a typical {mid-latitude} climate.
e.zh: 这座城市属于典型的中纬度气候。

e.en: He changed careers during {mid-life}.
e.zh: 他在人到中年时换了职业。

e.en: The machine reached its {mid-life} service check.
e.zh: 这台机器到了使用寿命中期的检修阶段。

e.en: The roses usually bloom in {mid-May}.
e.zh: 玫瑰通常在五月中旬开花。

e.en: We moved into the house around {mid-May}.
e.zh: 我们大约在五月中旬搬进了这所房子。

mid-morning.t: 上午十点左右；上午中段

e.en: They stopped for coffee in {mid-morning}.
e.zh: 他们在上午中段停下来喝咖啡。

e.en: By {mid-morning}, the streets were already busy.
e.zh: 到上午十点左右，街上已经很热闹了。

mid-ocean.t: 大洋中部；远离陆地的海上

e.en: The ship lost radio contact in {mid-ocean}.
e.zh: 那艘船在大洋中部失去了无线电联系。

e.en: A {mid-ocean} ridge runs along the sea floor.
e.zh: 一条大洋中脊沿着海底延伸。

mid-off.t: 板球中前方外侧防守位置

e.en: The captain placed a fielder at {mid-off}.
e.zh: 队长把一名防守队员安排在中前方外侧位置。

e.en: He drove the ball past {mid-off} for four runs.
e.zh: 他把球击过中前方外侧防守区，得了四分。

mid-on.t: 板球中前方腿侧防守位置

e.en: The coach moved him to {mid-on}.
e.zh: 教练把他调到中前方腿侧防守位置。

e.en: She lofted the ball over {mid-on}.
e.zh: 她把球高高击过中前方腿侧防守区。

e.en: They bought a {mid-range} laptop for school.
e.zh: 他们买了一台中档笔记本电脑供上学使用。

e.en: The camera performs well at {mid-range} distances.
e.zh: 这台相机在中等距离拍摄时表现很好。

e.en: The team changed its coach in {mid-season}.
e.zh: 球队在赛季中期换了教练。

e.en: Prices often drop during the {mid-season} sales.
e.zh: 季中促销期间价格常常会下降。

e.en: They rented a {mid-size} car for the trip.
e.zh: 他们为这次旅行租了一辆中型车。

e.en: The company serves {mid-size} businesses across Asia.
e.zh: 这家公司服务亚洲各地的中型企业。

e.en: She works for a {mid-sized} law firm.
e.zh: 她在一家中型律师事务所工作。

e.en: A {mid-sized} backpack is enough for one night.
e.zh: 一个中等大小的背包足够过一晚使用。

e.en: The shoe has a soft {mid-sole} for comfort.
e.zh: 这双鞋有柔软的中底，穿起来更舒服。

e.en: Runners often prefer a thicker {mid-sole}.
e.zh: 跑步者通常更喜欢较厚的鞋底中层。

e.en: The house has a {mid-Victorian} brick facade.
e.zh: 这所房子的砖砌外墙带有维多利亚时代中期风格。

e.en: Her research focuses on {mid-Victorian} novels.
e.zh: 她的研究重点是维多利亚时代中期的小说。

e.en: The company will review salaries at {mid-year}.
e.zh: 公司会在年中审查薪资。

e.en: He joined the class in {mid-year}.
e.zh: 他在学年中期加入了这个班。

midafternoon.t: 下午三点左右；下午中段

e.en: Rain began falling in {midafternoon}.
e.zh: 下午中段开始下雨。

e.en: By {midafternoon}, everyone wanted another coffee.
e.zh: 到下午三点左右，大家都想再喝一杯咖啡。

e.en: The fields turn golden in {midautumn}.
e.zh: 到了中秋时节，田野会变成金黄色。

e.en: A cool wind arrived by {midautumn}.
e.zh: 到秋季中段，凉风已经吹来。

e.en: The doctor checked swelling in the {midaxilla}.
e.zh: 医生检查了腋窝中部是否有肿胀。

e.en: Pain near the {midaxilla} can follow shoulder injury.
e.zh: 肩部受伤后，腋窝中部附近可能会疼痛。

e.en: The antenna was aligned to the {midazimuth}.
e.zh: 天线被调到中方位角位置。

e.en: Engineers recorded the {midazimuth} during calibration.
e.zh: 工程师在校准过程中记录了中间方位。

e.en: A {midchain} defect changed the polymer's strength.
e.zh: 链中部缺陷改变了聚合物的强度。

e.en: The reaction occurs at a {midchain} position.
e.zh: 该反应发生在链段中间的位置。

e.en: The boat stayed in {midchannel} to avoid rocks.
e.zh: 船保持在水道中央，以避开岩石。

e.en: A sandbar formed near {midchannel}.
e.zh: 通道中部附近形成了一处沙洲。

e.en: The rocket made a {midcourse} correction.
e.zh: 火箭进行了中途修正。

e.en: Students receive {midcourse} feedback from the instructor.
e.zh: 学生会收到老师在课程中段给出的反馈。

e.en: The sensor detected a {microvortex} in the fluid channel.
e.zh: 传感器在流体通道中检测到一个微小涡旋。

e.en: Engineers used a {microvortex} to mix the sample evenly.
e.zh: 工程师利用微涡流把样品混合均匀。

e.en: The lab tested each {microwafer} under a microscope.
e.zh: 实验室在显微镜下检测每片微型晶圆。

e.en: A damaged {microwafer} can ruin the whole sensor array.
e.zh: 一片受损的小晶片可能毁掉整个传感器阵列。

e.en: The device consumes only one {microwatt} while sleeping.
e.zh: 这个设备在休眠时只消耗一微瓦电力。

e.en: Signal strength was measured in {microwatts} during the test.
e.zh: 测试期间，信号强度以微瓦为单位测量。

e.en: Technicians must {microweld} the tiny contacts by hand.
e.zh: 技术人员必须手工微焊这些细小触点。

e.en: A clean {microweld} keeps the circuit stable.
e.zh: 干净的微型焊接能让电路保持稳定。

e.en: The implant uses a flexible {microwire} to record signals.
e.zh: 这个植入装置使用柔性微细导线记录信号。

e.en: A single {microwire} snapped during assembly.
e.zh: 装配过程中有一根微丝断了。

e.en: The old theory described disease as caused by a {microzyme}.
e.zh: 这个旧理论认为疾病是由一种微生体引起的。

e.en: Modern biology no longer uses {microzyme} as a standard term.
e.zh: 现代生物学已不再把微小酵素作为标准术语。

e.en: Early cell research relied on careful {micrurgy}.
e.zh: 早期细胞研究依赖精细的显微操作。

e.en: The surgeon compared the technique to biological {micrurgy}.
e.zh: 外科医生把这种技术比作生物微体手术。

mictium.t: 古罗马合金；黄铜类金属

e.en: The museum label identified the vessel as {mictium}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这件器皿标为古罗马黄铜类金属。

e.en: Scholars debate whether {mictium} was brass or another alloy.
e.zh: 学者们争论mictium究竟是黄铜还是另一种合金。

e.en: Patients may need to {micturate} before the scan.
e.zh: 患者可能需要在扫描前排尿。

e.en: The doctor asked whether he could {micturate} without pain.
e.zh: 医生问他小便时是否没有疼痛。

e.en: The patient had {micturated} shortly before the examination.
e.zh: 患者在检查前不久已经排过尿。

e.en: She reported that she {micturated} more often at night.
e.zh: 她说自己夜里小便的次数更多。

e.en: The infant {micturates} several times after feeding.
e.zh: 婴儿喂奶后会小便好几次。

e.en: A nurse records how often the patient {micturates}.
e.zh: 护士会记录病人排尿的频率。

e.en: He felt pain while {micturating}.
e.zh: 他排尿时感到疼痛。

e.en: The study measured bladder pressure during {micturating}.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了小便过程中的膀胱压力。

e.en: Frequent {micturition} can be a symptom of infection.
e.zh: 频繁排尿可能是感染的症状。

e.en: The clinic treats disorders of {micturition}.
e.zh: 这家诊所治疗排尿功能障碍。

e.en: We arrived in Paris by {mid-afternoon}.
e.zh: 我们下午三四点左右到了巴黎。

e.en: A {mid-afternoon} snack helped everyone stay focused.
e.zh: 下午三四点的小点心让大家保持了注意力。

e.en: The two birds collided in {mid-air}.
e.zh: 两只鸟在半空中相撞。

e.en: She caught the ball in {mid-air}.
e.zh: 她在空中接住了球。

mid-atlantic.t: 大西洋中部的；英美混合口音

e.en: A storm formed over the {mid-Atlantic} overnight.
e.zh: 一场风暴夜间在大西洋中部形成。

e.en: His {mid-Atlantic} accent sounded neither fully British nor American.
e.zh: 他的英美混合口音听起来既不完全像英国口音，也不完全像美国口音。

e.en: The scan showed damage near the {mid-brain}.
e.zh: 扫描显示中脑附近有损伤。

e.en: Certain reflexes are controlled by the {mid-brain}.
e.zh: 某些反射由中脑控制。

mid-calf.t: 小腿中部；及小腿中部的

e.en: Her boots reached {mid-calf}.
e.zh: 她的靴子到小腿中部。

e.en: He wore {mid-calf} socks with his uniform.
e.zh: 他穿着及小腿中部的袜子配制服。

e.en: The fund invests mainly in {mid-cap} companies.
e.zh: 这只基金主要投资中等市值公司。

e.en: Several {mid-cap} stocks outperformed the market this year.
e.zh: 今年有几只中型股表现超过大盘。

e.en: He stole the ball near {mid-court}.
e.zh: 他在球场中线附近抢断了球。

e.en: The coach shouted instructions from {mid-court}.
e.zh: 教练在中场位置大声下达指示。

e.en: These {mid-cut} shoes support the ankle well.
e.zh: 这双中帮鞋能很好地支撑脚踝。

e.en: She chose a {mid-cut} jacket for the mild weather.
e.zh: 天气不冷不热，她选了一件中等剪裁的夹克。

e.en: The shop will reopen in {mid-December}.
e.zh: 这家店将在十二月中旬重新开业。

e.en: By {mid-December}, the streets were full of lights.
e.zh: 到十二月中旬，街上已经挂满了灯饰。

e.en: The company revealed a {mid-engined} sports car.
e.zh: 这家公司发布了一款中置发动机跑车。

e.en: A {mid-engined} layout can improve handling.
e.zh: 中置发动机布局可以改善操控性。

e.en: The {mid-fielder} passed the ball to the striker.
e.zh: 这名中场球员把球传给了前锋。

e.en: A good {mid-fielder} controls the pace of the match.
e.zh: 优秀的中场球员能控制比赛节奏。

microtomist.t: 切片技术员；显微切片员

e.en: The {microtomist} prepared thin tissue sections for the pathologist.
e.zh: 显微切片员为病理医生制备了很薄的组织切片。

e.en: A skilled {microtomist} can preserve fragile samples during cutting.
e.zh: 熟练的切片技术员能在切割时保护脆弱样本。

e.en: The lab teaches {microtomy} to new histology students.
e.zh: 实验室向新的组织学学生教授显微切片术。

e.en: Good {microtomy} requires a sharp blade and steady hands.
e.zh: 好的显微切片术需要锋利刀片和稳定的手法。

e.en: The composer wrote a {microtonal} passage for strings.
e.zh: 作曲家为弦乐写了一段微分音乐段。

e.en: Some {microtonal} music uses intervals smaller than a semitone.
e.zh: 一些微分音音乐会使用小于半音的音程。

e.en: Her research explores {microtonality} in modern jazz.
e.zh: 她的研究探讨现代爵士乐中的微分音体系。

e.en: Listeners may need time to adjust to {microtonality}.
e.zh: 听众可能需要时间适应微分音性。

e.en: The melody shifts {microtonally} between familiar notes.
e.zh: 这段旋律以微分音方式在熟悉的音之间移动。

e.en: The instrument can be tuned {microtonally} for experimental pieces.
e.zh: 这种乐器可为实验作品按微分音方式调音。

e.en: A {microtone} is smaller than a standard semitone.
e.zh: 微分音比标准半音更小。

e.en: The singer bent the note by a subtle {microtone}.
e.zh: 歌手把那个音微妙地弯成一个微分音。

e.en: The microscope revealed the {microtopography} of the metal surface.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出金属表面的微形貌。

e.en: Soil {microtopography} affects how water collects after rain.
e.zh: 土壤微地形会影响雨后积水方式。

e.en: The chamber pressure fell below one {microtorr}.
e.zh: 腔室压力降到一微托以下。

e.en: Vacuum engineers often measure leaks in {microtorr} ranges.
e.zh: 真空工程师常用微托范围来测量泄漏。

e.en: The bird carried a tiny {microtransmitter} on its back.
e.zh: 这只鸟背上带着一个微型发射器。

e.en: A {microtransmitter} sent the sensor data every minute.
e.zh: 微型发射器每分钟发送一次传感器数据。

e.en: The film's {microtransparency} allowed light to pass unevenly.
e.zh: 薄膜的微观透明性使光线不均匀地通过。

e.en: Researchers measured {microtransparency} across the sample surface.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了样品表面的微观透明性。

e.en: The laboratory installed a {microtron} for electron-beam experiments.
e.zh: 实验室安装了一台微电子回旋加速器用于电子束实验。

e.en: A {microtron} can accelerate particles in repeated circular paths.
e.zh: 微电子回旋加速器能让粒子沿重复圆形路径加速。

microtronics.t: 微电子学；微型电子技术

e.en: The course introduced {microtronics} for compact device design.
e.zh: 这门课介绍了用于紧凑设备设计的微型电子技术。

e.en: Advances in {microtronics} made the sensor much smaller.
e.zh: 微电子学的进步让这种传感器小了许多。

e.en: The material forms a {microtubular} structure under heat.
e.zh: 这种材料受热后形成微管状结构。

e.en: Cells rely on {microtubular} networks for internal transport.
e.zh: 细胞依靠微管状网络进行内部运输。

e.en: The aircraft encountered {microturbulence} near the mountain ridge.
e.zh: 飞机在山脊附近遇到了微湍流。

e.en: Plasma {microturbulence} can reduce confinement in a reactor.
e.zh: 等离子体微湍流会降低反应堆中的约束效果。

e.en: The dosage was recorded in each {microunit}.
e.zh: 剂量以每个微单位记录。

e.en: The device divides the sample into a separate {microunit}.
e.zh: 该设备把样品分成独立的微小单元。

e.en: Diabetes can damage the eye's {microvasculature}.
e.zh: 糖尿病可能损伤眼部的微血管系统。

e.en: The scan showed abnormal {microvasculature} around the tumor.
e.zh: 扫描显示肿瘤周围的微血管系统异常。

e.en: Each {microvessel} carries blood through delicate tissue.
e.zh: 每条微血管都把血液输送过脆弱组织。

e.en: The drug improved {microvessel} growth after injury.
e.zh: 这种药物促进了损伤后的微血管生长。

e.en: The engineer used a {microvibrograph} to record tiny machine vibrations.
e.zh: 工程师用微振动记录仪记录机器的细微振动。

e.en: A sensitive {microvibrograph} detected movement in the bridge cable.
e.zh: 灵敏的微振动记录仪检测到桥索中的运动。

e.en: The cell surface showed dense {microvillar} projections.
e.zh: 细胞表面显示出密集的微绒毛突起。

e.en: The disease altered the intestine's {microvillar} structure.
e.zh: 这种疾病改变了肠道的微绒毛结构。

e.en: Intestinal {microvilli} increase the surface area for absorption.
e.zh: 肠道微绒毛增加了吸收所需的表面积。

e.en: The microscope image showed damaged {microvilli} on the cells.
e.zh: 显微镜图像显示细胞上的微绒毛受损。

e.en: The biopsy revealed a {microvillous} surface pattern.
e.zh: 活检显示出微绒毛状的表面模式。

e.en: Some epithelial cells have a {microvillous} border.
e.zh: 一些上皮细胞具有微绒毛状边缘。

e.en: A single {microvillus} extends from the cell membrane.
e.zh: 一根微绒毛从细胞膜伸出。

e.en: Damage to each {microvillus} can reduce nutrient absorption.
e.zh: 每根微绒毛受损都可能降低营养吸收。

e.en: A {microvoid} formed inside the stretched plastic.
e.zh: 拉伸后的塑料内部形成了一个微孔洞。

e.en: Engineers studied how each {microvoid} weakens the alloy.
e.zh: 工程师研究每个微空隙如何削弱合金。

e.en: The sensor detected a signal of one {microvolt}.
e.zh: 传感器检测到一微伏的信号。

e.en: Brain recordings often measure changes in {microvolts}.
e.zh: 脑部记录常以微伏测量变化。

e.en: The technician connected a {microvoltmeter} to the circuit.
e.zh: 技术员把微伏计接到电路上。

e.en: A calibrated {microvoltmeter} can measure extremely weak voltages.
e.zh: 校准过的微伏计能测量极弱的电压。

e.en: Monaco is often described as a European {microstate}.
e.zh: 摩纳哥常被称为欧洲的微型国家。

e.en: The physicist calculated the probability of each {microstate}.
e.zh: 物理学家计算了每个微观状态的概率。

e.en: The specimen was classified as {microstomatous} because of its tiny mouth opening.
e.zh: 由于口部开口很小，这个标本被归为小口型。

e.en: A {microstomatous} fish may need specially sized food.
e.zh: 小口鱼可能需要尺寸特别合适的饵料。

e.en: The doctor noted the patient's {microstomous} facial structure.
e.zh: 医生记录了患者口部狭小的面部结构。

e.en: Some {microstomous} species feed only on very small prey.
e.zh: 一些小口物种只捕食很小的猎物。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with {microstrabismus} during an eye exam.
e.zh: 孩子在眼科检查中被诊断为微小斜视。

e.en: Untreated {microstrabismus} can sometimes affect depth perception.
e.zh: 微小斜视若不处理，有时会影响深度知觉。

e.en: The sensor measured {microstrain} in the bridge cable.
e.zh: 传感器测量了桥缆中的微应变。

e.en: Engineers tracked {microstrain} changes during the load test.
e.zh: 工程师在载荷测试期间跟踪微应变变化。

e.en: The laboratory used a {microstrainer} to remove tiny particles.
e.zh: 实验室用微滤器去除细小颗粒。

e.en: A rotating {microstrainer} can help clean wastewater efficiently.
e.zh: 旋转式微滤器能帮助高效净化废水。

e.en: Researchers tested the {microstrength} of the ceramic coating.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了陶瓷涂层的微观强度。

e.en: The alloy's {microstrength} improved after heat treatment.
e.zh: 热处理后，这种合金的微观强度提高了。

e.en: Her {microstudy} focused on three families in one neighborhood.
e.zh: 她的小规模研究聚焦于同一社区的三个家庭。

e.en: A careful {microstudy} can reveal patterns that surveys miss.
e.zh: 细致的微观研究能揭示问卷调查遗漏的模式。

e.en: A skilled {microsurgeon} repaired the damaged nerve.
e.zh: 一位熟练的显微外科医生修复了受损神经。

e.en: The hospital hired a {microsurgeon} for complex hand injuries.
e.zh: 医院聘请了一名显微外科医生处理复杂手部损伤。

e.en: The geologist identified the dark sample as {microsyenite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这块深色样本鉴定为微晶正长岩。

e.en: Thin sections of {microsyenite} showed fine mineral grains.
e.zh: 微晶正长岩的薄片显示出细小矿物颗粒。

microsyn.t: 微同步装置；微型同步器

e.en: The engineer adjusted the {microsyn} in the control system.
e.zh: 工程师调整了控制系统中的微型同步器。

e.en: A faulty {microsyn} caused small errors in the instrument reading.
e.zh: 一个有故障的微同步装置导致仪表读数出现小误差。

e.en: She injected the sample with a glass {microsyringe}.
e.zh: 她用玻璃微量注射器注入样品。

e.en: The chemist cleaned the {microsyringe} before the next measurement.
e.zh: 化学家在下一次测量前清洁了微量注射器。

e.en: Old recorders stored data on narrow {microtape}.
e.zh: 老式记录器把数据存储在窄小的微型磁带上。

e.en: The technician applied {microtape} to mask the tiny circuit area.
e.zh: 技术员贴上微带材遮住那片细小电路区域。

microteaching.t: 微格教学；微型教学训练

e.en: The trainees practiced classroom skills through {microteaching}.
e.zh: 受训者通过微格教学练习课堂技能。

e.en: A {microteaching} session usually focuses on one short lesson.
e.zh: 一次微型教学训练通常聚焦于一节短课。

e.en: The lab course introduced basic {microtechnic} for tissue slides.
e.zh: 实验课介绍了制作组织切片的基本显微技术。

e.en: Her {microtechnic} skills improved with repeated staining practice.
e.zh: 反复练习染色后，她的显微技术水平提高了。

e.en: This {microtechnique} preserves delicate cells during preparation.
e.zh: 这种显微技术能在制备过程中保存脆弱细胞。

e.en: The assay requires a precise {microtechnique} and steady hands.
e.zh: 这项检测需要精确的微量操作法和稳定的手。

e.en: Modern sensors rely heavily on {microtechnology}.
e.zh: 现代传感器在很大程度上依赖微技术。

e.en: The company develops {microtechnology} for medical implants.
e.zh: 这家公司为医疗植入物开发微型技术。

e.en: The sediment contained a tiny {microtektite} from an ancient impact.
e.zh: 沉积物中含有一颗来自古老撞击事件的微玻陨石。

e.en: Scientists dated the {microtektite} layer in the ocean core.
e.zh: 科学家测定了海洋岩芯中微玻陨石层的年代。

e.en: The botanist observed a {microtelium} on the infected leaf.
e.zh: 植物学家在受感染的叶片上观察到小冬孢子堆。

e.en: Each {microtelium} contained spores visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 每个小冬孢子堆都含有显微镜下可见的孢子。

e.en: The banknote includes {microtext} to prevent counterfeiting.
e.zh: 这张钞票含有微缩文字以防伪。

e.en: Readers struggled with the dense {microtext} on the old label.
e.zh: 读者很难看清旧标签上密密麻麻的微型文本。

e.en: The microscope revealed the stone's complex {microtexture}.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出这块石头复杂的微观纹理。

e.en: Surface {microtexture} affects how the tire grips wet roads.
e.zh: 表面微观纹理会影响轮胎在湿路上的抓地力。

e.en: The experiment detected a {microthermic} reaction in the sample.
e.zh: 实验检测到样品中发生了微热反应。

e.en: Some alpine plants survive in {microthermic} climate zones.
e.zh: 一些高山植物能在低热量气候带中生存。

e.en: The polymer was examined using {microthermogravimetry}.
e.zh: 这种聚合物采用微量热重分析法进行了检测。

e.en: {Microthermogravimetry} can track tiny mass changes during heating.
e.zh: 微量热重分析法可以跟踪加热过程中的微小质量变化。

e.en: The satellite used a {microthruster} to adjust its orbit.
e.zh: 卫星用微型推进器调整轨道。

e.en: Engineers tested the {microthruster} in a vacuum chamber.
e.zh: 工程师在真空舱中测试了微型推进器。

e.en: The technician cut thin tissue slices with a {microtome}.
e.zh: 技术员用显微切片机切出很薄的组织片。

e.en: A sharp {microtome} blade is essential for clean sections.
e.zh: 锋利的切片机刀片对切出整洁切片很重要。

e.en: She wore a {microskirt} with heavy boots.
e.zh: 她穿着一条超短迷你裙，配了厚重的靴子。

e.en: The designer sent several {microskirts} down the runway.
e.zh: 设计师让几条超短迷你裙登上了秀场。

e.en: A brief {microsleep} can be dangerous while driving.
e.zh: 开车时一次短暂的微睡眠可能很危险。

e.en: He had several {microsleeps} during the night shift.
e.zh: 他上夜班时出现了好几次短暂打盹。

microslide.t: 显微镜载玻片；微型幻灯片

e.en: The technician labeled each {microslide} before staining it.
e.zh: 技术员在染色前给每片显微镜载玻片贴上标签。

e.en: The lecture used a {microslide} to show cell structure.
e.zh: 讲座用一张微型幻灯片展示细胞结构。

e.en: The enzyme was found in the liver {microsome}.
e.zh: 这种酶在肝脏微粒体中被发现。

e.en: Researchers isolated each {microsome} by centrifugation.
e.zh: 研究人员通过离心分离出每个微粒体。

e.en: Liver {microsomes} are often used in drug metabolism studies.
e.zh: 肝微粒体常用于药物代谢研究。

e.en: The sample contained broken membranes and {microsomes}.
e.zh: 样本中含有破碎的膜和微粒体。

e.en: Botanists described the plant as a distinct {microspecies}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种植物描述为一个独立的微种。

e.en: Several {microspecies} can look identical to nonexperts.
e.zh: 几个微种在非专业人士看来可能完全一样。

e.en: The {microspecimen} was mounted under a glass cover.
e.zh: 这个微小标本被固定在玻璃盖片下面。

e.en: A single {microspecimen} revealed the mineral's structure.
e.zh: 一个显微标本揭示了这种矿物的结构。

e.en: The lab bought a {microspectrofluorimeter} for protein imaging.
e.zh: 实验室购买了一台显微光谱荧光计用于蛋白成像。

e.en: A {microspectrofluorimeter} measures fluorescence from tiny samples.
e.zh: 显微光谱荧光计可测量微小样品发出的荧光。

e.en: They used {microspectrometry} to analyze the pigment grain.
e.zh: 他们用显微光谱测定法分析这颗颜料颗粒。

e.en: Modern {microspectrometry} can examine very small inclusions.
e.zh: 现代显微光谱测定法能检查极小的包裹体。

e.en: The {microspectrophotometer} measured light absorption in one cell.
e.zh: 显微分光光度计测量了单个细胞的吸光情况。

e.en: She calibrated the {microspectrophotometer} before testing the dye.
e.zh: 测试染料前，她校准了显微分光光度计。

e.en: The team reported a {microspectrophotometric} analysis of the fibers.
e.zh: 团队报告了对这些纤维的显微分光光度分析。

e.en: A {microspectrophotometric} method detected changes in the crystal.
e.zh: 一种显微分光光度方法检测到了晶体变化。

e.en: They studied the stained cells with {microspectrophotometry}.
e.zh: 他们用显微分光光度法研究染色细胞。

e.en: {Microspectrophotometry} can quantify color in a tiny fiber.
e.zh: 显微分光光度法可以量化微小纤维中的颜色。

e.en: He examined the crystal through a {microspectroscope}.
e.zh: 他通过显微分光镜观察这块晶体。

e.en: The old {microspectroscope} still produced clear spectra.
e.zh: 那台旧显微分光镜仍能产生清晰的光谱。

microspectroscopy.t: 显微光谱学；显微光谱法

e.en: The painting was examined using {microspectroscopy}.
e.zh: 这幅画通过显微光谱法进行了检查。

e.en: {Microspectroscopy} links microscopic images with spectral data.
e.zh: 显微光谱学把显微图像与光谱数据联系起来。

e.en: The powder contained {microspherical} particles of glass.
e.zh: 这种粉末含有微球形的玻璃颗粒。

e.en: Engineers tested a {microspherical} coating for drug delivery.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一种用于给药的微球形涂层。

e.en: The dividing cell formed a clear {microspindle}.
e.zh: 正在分裂的细胞形成了清晰的微小纺锤体。

e.en: A damaged {microspindle} can disrupt chromosome movement.
e.zh: 受损的微小纺锤体会干扰染色体移动。

e.en: The {microsporangiate} cones released pollen in spring.
e.zh: 这些具小孢子囊的球果在春天释放花粉。

e.en: A {microsporangiate} structure produces male spores in the plant.
e.zh: 具小孢子囊的结构会在植物中产生雄性孢子。

e.en: Each {microspore} can develop into a pollen grain.
e.zh: 每个小孢子都可能发育成一粒花粉。

e.en: The microscope showed a single {microspore} inside the sac.
e.zh: 显微镜显示囊内有一个小孢子。

e.en: The paper described the plant's {microsporic} stage.
e.zh: 论文描述了这种植物的小孢子阶段。

e.en: A {microsporic} cell was visible in the sample.
e.zh: 样本中可以看到一个小孢子细胞。

e.en: The shrimp showed signs of a {microsporidian} infection.
e.zh: 这只虾表现出微孢子虫感染的迹象。

e.en: A {microsporidian} can live as a parasite inside cells.
e.zh: 微孢子虫可以作为寄生生物生活在细胞内。

e.en: The {microsporocyte} divides to form four microspores.
e.zh: 小孢子母细胞分裂形成四个小孢子。

e.en: Researchers observed the {microsporocyte} during meiosis.
e.zh: 研究人员观察了减数分裂中的小孢子母细胞。

microsporogenesis.t: 小孢子发生；小孢子形成

e.en: Temperature stress can affect {microsporogenesis} in wheat.
e.zh: 温度胁迫会影响小麦的小孢子发生。

e.en: The study traced {microsporogenesis} from mother cell to pollen.
e.zh: 这项研究追踪了从母细胞到花粉的小孢子形成过程。

e.en: Each {microsporophyll} bears several pollen sacs.
e.zh: 每片小孢子叶都带有几个花粉囊。

e.en: The fossil preserved the shape of a {microsporophyll}.
e.zh: 这块化石保存了一片小孢子叶的形状。

microsporous.t: 有小孢子的；产生小孢子的

e.en: The {microsporous} tissue matured before the ovules.
e.zh: 产生小孢子的组织比胚珠更早成熟。

e.en: A {microsporous} plant structure is linked to pollen formation.
e.zh: 有小孢子的植物结构与花粉形成有关。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {microstandard} for calibration.
e.zh: 化学师制备了一个用于校准的微量标准。

e.en: A reliable {microstandard} helps compare tiny measurements.
e.zh: 可靠的微量标准有助于比较微小测量结果。

midcult.t: 迎合中等文化品味的作品或风格

e.en: The critic dismissed the novel as {midcult} comfort reading.
e.zh: 那位评论家把这本小说贬为迎合中等文化品味的安慰读物。

e.en: His lectures attacked {midcult} magazines for flattering anxious readers.
e.zh: 他的讲座批评那些中等文化杂志迎合焦虑读者。

e.zh: 该政权以军国主义口吻谈论国家复兴。

e.en: He viewed every problem {militaristically}, as a battle.
e.zh: 他把每个问题都当成战斗来军事化地看待。

e.en: The proposal was too {milk-and-water} to satisfy voters.
e.zh: 这项提案太软弱无力，无法让选民满意。

e.en: Critics dismissed the speech as {milk-and-water} liberalism.
e.zh: 批评者把这场演讲斥为软弱乏味的自由主义。

e.en: A quiet {milk-float} rolled down the street at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，一辆安静的送奶电动车驶过街道。

e.en: The museum displayed an old electric {milk-float}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一辆老式电动送奶车。

e.en: He called the cautious officer {milk-livered} and weak.
e.zh: 他称那名谨慎的军官胆小软弱。

e.en: The insult {milk-livered} sounds old-fashioned today.
e.zh: “胆小怯懦的”这个骂法如今听起来很老派。

e.en: The bully mocked him as a {milk-sop}.
e.zh: 那个恶霸嘲笑他是个软弱的人。

e.en: In old novels, a {milk-sop} often lacks courage.
e.zh: 在旧小说里，懦夫往往缺乏勇气。

e.en: The columnist called the mayor a {milk-toast} leader.
e.zh: 专栏作家称市长是个软弱的领导者。

e.en: He was no {milk-toast} when negotiations became tense.
e.zh: 谈判紧张起来时，他可不是胆小鬼。

e.en: Purple {milk-vetch} grew along the dry hillside.
e.zh: 紫色的黄芪属植物长在干燥的山坡上。

e.en: The botanist identified the plant as {milk-vetch}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种植物鉴定为乳黄芪。

e.en: The old {milldam} held back the stream.
e.zh: 那座旧磨坊水坝拦住了溪水。

e.en: Repairs to the {milldam} saved the pond.
e.zh: 修好磨坊水坝后，池塘保住了。

e.en: She ordered a {mille-feuille} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她点了一份千层酥。

e.en: The bakery's {mille-feuille} was crisp and creamy.
e.zh: 那家面包店的千层酥又脆又有奶香。

e.en: The tapestry used a {millefleur} background.
e.zh: 那幅挂毯用了满花纹样作背景。

e.en: Her dress had a delicate {millefleur} print.
e.zh: 她的裙子印着精致的千花图案。

e.en: The museum displayed a {millefleurs} tapestry.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅满花图案挂毯。

e.en: Tiny blossoms created the {millefleurs} effect.
e.zh: 细小花朵营造出千花纹样的效果。

e.en: The sect's {millenarianism} shaped its rituals.
e.zh: 这个教派的千禧年信仰影响了它的仪式。

e.en: Scholars studied {millenarianism} in the movement.
e.zh: 学者研究了这场运动中的末世论思想。

e.en: The town celebrated its {millenary} with concerts.
e.zh: 小镇用音乐会庆祝建镇千周年。

e.en: They imagined a {millenary} age of peace.
e.zh: 他们想象一个持续千年的和平时代。

e.en: A {millennialist} preacher warned of judgment.
e.zh: 一位千禧年论传教士警告审判将至。

e.en: The group followed a {millennialist} reading of history.
e.zh: 这个团体按末世论方式解读历史。

e.en: A {millepede} curled under the stone.
e.zh: 一只千足虫在石头下蜷成一团。

e.en: The child watched the {millepede} cross the path.
e.zh: 孩子看着马陆爬过小路。

e.en: Divers avoided touching the {millepore}.
e.zh: 潜水者避免碰到火珊瑚。

e.en: The reef contained patches of {millepore}.
e.zh: 那片礁石上有几处多孔珊瑚。

e.en: A {miller's-thumb} hid beneath the gravel.
e.zh: 一条杜父鱼藏在碎石下面。

e.en: The stream still supports {miller's-thumb}.
e.zh: 这条溪流仍能养活杜父鱼。

e.en: The farmer paid the {millerayes} after grinding.
e.zh: 农夫磨完谷物后付了磨坊费用。

e.en: Old records list {millerayes} among village dues.
e.zh: 旧档案把磨坊税列在村庄应缴费用中。

e.en: The sample contained grains of {millerite}.
e.zh: 样本中含有镍黄铁矿颗粒。

e.en: A {millerite} expected the world to end soon.
e.zh: 一名米勒派信徒预期世界很快终结。

e.en: The assay used a {millesimal} scale for purity.
e.zh: 这项检验用千分制衡量纯度。

e.en: A {millesimal} error can matter in dosing.
e.zh: 千分之一的误差在剂量上也可能重要。

e.en: The pressure changed {millesimally} overnight.
e.zh: 气压一夜之间只发生了极微小的变化。

e.en: Each setting was adjusted {millesimally} by hand.
e.zh: 每个设置都由人工按千分级微调。

e.en: The {millhand} started work before dawn.
e.zh: 那名工厂工人天亮前就开始干活。

e.en: Her grandfather was a {millhand} in Lancashire.
e.zh: 她祖父曾是兰开夏的纺织厂工人。

e.en: The {millhands} demanded safer machines.
e.zh: 工厂工人要求机器更安全。

e.en: Many {millhands} lived near the river.
e.zh: 许多磨坊工人住在河边附近。

e.en: The technician checked the circuit with a {milliammeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用毫安表检查电路。

e.en: A sensitive {milliammeter} showed a tiny current.
e.zh: 灵敏的毫安计显示出微弱电流。

e.en: The sensor draws one {milliamp} at rest.
e.zh: 传感器待机时耗电一毫安。

e.en: Increase the current by a {milliamp}.
e.zh: 把电流增加一毫安。

e.en: The device uses a five-{milliampere} fuse.
e.zh: 这台设备使用五毫安保险丝。

e.en: One {milliampere} equals one thousandth of an ampere.
e.zh: 一毫安等于千分之一安培。

e.en: A {milliard} is a thousand million.
e.zh: milliard 指十亿，也就是一千个百万。

e.en: Older British reports used {milliard} for billion.
e.zh: 较早的英国报告用 milliard 表示十亿。

e.en: The doctor noted tiny {milliaries} on the skin.
e.zh: 医生注意到皮肤上有细小粟疹。

e.en: Heat can sometimes cause {milliaries} in infants.
e.zh: 炎热有时会让婴儿出现粟粒状小疹。

e.en: The excavators found a Roman {milliarium}.
e.zh: 考古人员发现了一块古罗马里程碑。

e.en: The rash was described as a {milliarium}.
e.zh: 这种皮疹被描述为粟粒疹。

e.en: The X-ray showed {milliary} spots in the lungs.
e.zh: X光片显示肺部有粟粒状斑点。

e.en: The account used a {milliary} subdivision of units.
e.zh: 这个账目采用了单位的千分细分。

milliatom.t: 毫原子；千分之一克原子

e.en: The chemist calculated one {milliatom} of carbon.
e.zh: 化学家计算出一毫原子的碳。

e.en: This reagent contains half a {milliatom} of sulfur.
e.zh: 这种试剂含有半毫原子的硫。

e.en: The pilot read the {millibar-barometer} before takeoff.
e.zh: 飞行员起飞前读取了毫巴气压计。

e.en: A {millibar-barometer} records pressure in millibars.
e.zh: 毫巴气压计以毫巴为单位记录气压。

milk-walk.t: 挤奶时的来回走动或路线；奶道

e.en: The farmer took the {milk-walk} before dawn.
e.zh: 农夫天亮前走上挤奶时的固定路线。

e.en: An old {milk-walk} crossed the wet pasture.
e.zh: 一条旧奶道穿过潮湿的牧场。

e.en: The vase was {milk-white} and smooth.
e.zh: 这个花瓶呈乳白色，表面很光滑。

e.en: A {milk-white} mist covered the valley.
e.zh: 一层奶白色的雾笼罩着山谷。

e.en: The herd's {milk-yield} rose in spring.
e.zh: 这群奶牛的产奶量在春天上升了。

e.en: Poor feed can reduce {milk-yield} quickly.
e.zh: 饲料差会很快降低产奶量。

e.en: Grilled {milkfish} is popular in Manila.
e.zh: 烤虱目鱼在马尼拉很受欢迎。

e.en: The farm raises {milkfish} in brackish ponds.
e.zh: 这家养殖场在半咸水池塘里养虱目鱼。

e.en: Add cream for a {milkier} sauce.
e.zh: 加些奶油可以让酱汁更有奶味。

e.en: The sky turned {milkier} near the horizon.
e.zh: 靠近地平线的天空变得更乳白。

e.en: This brand makes the {milkiest} tea.
e.zh: 这个牌子泡出的茶奶味最浓。

e.en: The {milkiest} glass hid the room beyond.
e.zh: 那块最乳白的玻璃遮住了后面的房间。

e.en: The liquid swirled {milkily} in the cup.
e.zh: 杯中的液体呈乳白色打着旋。

e.en: She smiled {milkily} through the fogged window.
e.zh: 她隔着起雾的窗子露出朦胧而柔和的笑。

e.en: The soup's {milkiness} comes from coconut.
e.zh: 这汤的奶味来自椰奶。

e.en: The painter liked the {milkiness} of the light.
e.zh: 画家喜欢那种乳白色的光感。

e.en: The {milko} left bottles at the gate.
e.zh: 送奶工把奶瓶放在门口。

e.en: Everyone in town knew the cheerful {milko}.
e.zh: 镇上的人都认识那位开朗的送奶人。

e.en: He called the coward a {milksop}.
e.zh: 他把那个胆小鬼叫作没骨气的人。

e.en: The old novel mocks him as a {milksop}.
e.zh: 那本老小说嘲笑他是个软弱的人。

e.en: The boss dismissed him as a {milktoast}.
e.zh: 老板轻蔑地说他是个软弱温顺的人。

e.en: She refused to play the {milktoast} in meetings.
e.zh: 她不愿在会议上扮演唯唯诺诺的人。

e.en: Purple {milkwort} grew beside the path.
e.zh: 小路边长着紫色的远志属植物。

e.en: The herbalist dried {milkwort} for medicine.
e.zh: 草药师把远志草晒干入药。

e.en: The {mill-owner} hired twenty new workers.
e.zh: 那位工厂老板雇了二十名新工人。

e.en: A local {mill-owner} controlled the grain trade.
e.zh: 当地一名磨坊主控制着粮食买卖。

mill-pond.t: 磨坊蓄水池；极平静的水面

e.en: Ducks floated on the old {mill-pond}.
e.zh: 鸭子漂在旧磨坊的蓄水池上。

e.en: The lake was calm as a {mill-pond}.
e.zh: 湖面平静得像磨坊池塘一样。

e.en: Water rushed through the {mill-race}.
e.zh: 水从磨坊水道中奔流而过。

e.en: They repaired the stone {mill-race} in summer.
e.zh: 他们夏天修好了石砌的水轮槽。

mill-run.t: 未经挑选的一批；普通出厂品

e.en: The store bought a {mill-run} of cloth.
e.zh: 商店买进了一批未经挑选的布料。

e.en: These boards are just {mill-run} lumber.
e.zh: 这些木板只是普通出厂木材。

e.en: The old {mill-stone} lay by the door.
e.zh: 那块旧磨石躺在门边。

e.en: The debt became a {mill-stone} around him.
e.zh: 那笔债成了压在他身上的沉重负担。

e.en: The {mill-wheel} turned in the stream.
e.zh: 水车轮在溪流中转动。

e.en: Moss covered the broken {mill-wheel}.
e.zh: 破旧的磨坊轮上长满了青苔。

e.en: The {mill-worker} started before sunrise.
e.zh: 那名工厂工人在日出前开始上班。

e.en: A retired {mill-worker} showed us the machines.
e.zh: 一位退休磨坊工人给我们看那些机器。

e.en: Engineers tested the alloy's {millability}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这种合金的可铣削性。

e.en: Good {millability} reduces tool wear.
e.zh: 良好的可加工研磨性会减少刀具磨损。

e.en: The material is hard but {millable}.
e.zh: 这种材料很硬，但可以铣削。

e.en: Only dry grain is {millable} in this machine.
e.zh: 这台机器只能研磨干燥的谷物。

e.en: The model was built from {millboard}.
e.zh: 这个模型是用厚纸板做成的。

e.en: Bookbinders often use {millboard} for covers.
e.zh: 装订工常用压制纸板做封面。

e.en: Farmers fed the cattle {millcake}.
e.zh: 农民把榨油饼喂给牛吃。

e.en: The press left {millcake} after the oil was drawn.
e.zh: 油榨出后，压榨机留下了油饼。

e.en: The technician checked the sensor with a {millivoltmeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用毫伏计检查传感器。

e.en: A sensitive {millivoltmeter} can detect tiny voltage changes.
e.zh: 灵敏的毫伏表能检测很小的电压变化。

e.en: The laser outputs five {milliwatts} of power.
e.zh: 这台激光器输出五毫瓦功率。

e.en: The receiver works with signals below one {milliwatt}.
e.zh: 接收器能处理低于一毫瓦的信号。

e.en: Water rushed through the old {millrace}.
e.zh: 水急速流过那条旧磨坊水道。

e.en: They restored the {millrace} beside the historic mill.
e.zh: 他们修复了历史磨坊旁的水车引水渠。

e.en: The workers removed {millscale} before painting the steel.
e.zh: 工人们在给钢材上漆前去除了氧化皮。

e.en: Fine {millscale} collected under the rolling machine.
e.zh: 细小的轧钢铁鳞积在轧机下面。

e.en: Ducks floated quietly on the {millstream}.
e.zh: 鸭子静静地漂在磨坊溪流上。

e.en: The {millstream} once powered several village mills.
e.zh: 这条水车水流过去曾驱动村里的几座磨坊。

e.en: The company stored {milltailings} behind a dam.
e.zh: 公司把磨选尾矿储存在坝后。

e.en: Old {milltailings} can leak metals into nearby streams.
e.zh: 旧尾矿可能把金属渗入附近溪流。

e.en: The wooden {millwheel} turned slowly in the stream.
e.zh: 木制水车轮在溪水中缓慢转动。

e.en: Tourists photographed the restored {millwheel}.
e.zh: 游客拍下了修复后的磨坊轮。

e.en: The old car's {milometer} stopped at 90,000 miles.
e.zh: 那辆旧车的里程表停在九万英里。

e.en: Check the {milometer} before buying a used vehicle.
e.zh: 买二手车前要查看里程表。

e.en: They danced a lively {milonga} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们跳了一支欢快的米隆加舞。

e.en: The club hosts a {milonga} every Friday night.
e.zh: 这家俱乐部每周五晚上举办探戈舞会。

e.en: The specimen was identified as {miloschite}.
e.zh: 这件标本被鉴定为米洛石。

e.en: Collectors rarely find good crystals of {miloschite}.
e.zh: 收藏者很少找到品质好的米洛石晶体。

e.en: The antique coin was worth one {milreis}.
e.zh: 那枚古币面值为一密尔雷斯。

e.en: Prices in the diary were listed in {milreis}.
e.zh: 日记里的价格用密尔雷斯标注。

miltonian.t: 弥尔顿式的；弥尔顿研究者

e.en: The poem has a grand {Miltonian} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗有一种宏大的弥尔顿式节奏。

e.en: A devoted {Miltonian} lectured on Paradise Lost.
e.zh: 一位弥尔顿研究者讲解了《失乐园》。

e.en: The imam spoke from the {mimbar}.
e.zh: 伊玛目在清真寺讲坛上讲话。

e.en: The carved wooden {mimbar} stood near the prayer niche.
e.zh: 雕花木制讲坛立在礼拜龛旁边。

e.en: The school printed notices on a {mimeo}.
e.zh: 学校用油印机印通知。

e.en: She handed out a faded {mimeo} of the song lyrics.
e.zh: 她发了一份褪色的歌词油印副本。

e.en: The museum displayed yellow crystals of {mimetesite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了黄色的砷铅矿晶体。

e.en: Miners found {mimetesite} in the oxidized lead deposit.
e.zh: 矿工在氧化铅矿床中发现了砷铅矿。

e.en: The sensor detected only one {millicoulomb} of charge.
e.zh: 传感器只检测到一毫库仑的电荷。

e.en: The lab report converted each {millicoulomb} into coulombs.
e.zh: 实验报告把每个毫库仑都换算成库仑。

e.en: The old paper measured the film in {millicrons}.
e.zh: 那篇旧论文用毫微米来测量薄膜厚度。

e.en: One {millicron} is better known as a nanometer.
e.zh: 一毫微米更常被称为一纳米。

e.en: The sample contained three {millicuries} of activity.
e.zh: 这个样品含有三毫居里的放射性活度。

e.en: Doctors handled the {millicurie} dose with care.
e.zh: 医生小心处理这份毫居里级剂量。

millicycle.t: 千分之一周；旧频率单位

e.en: The engineer described the drift as a {millicycle}.
e.zh: 工程师把这种漂移描述为一个毫周。

e.en: Older manuals sometimes list frequency in {millicycles}.
e.zh: 旧手册有时用毫周来标示频率。

e.en: The thermometer records changes of one {millidegree}.
e.zh: 温度计能记录一毫度的变化。

e.en: A {millidegree} error mattered in the calibration.
e.zh: 校准中一毫度的误差也很重要。

e.en: The account was rounded to the nearest {millieme}.
e.zh: 账目被四舍五入到最接近的米利姆。

e.en: In old prices, one {millieme} was a tiny amount.
e.zh: 在旧价格中，一米利姆只是很小的金额。

e.en: The archive counted stamps by the {millier}.
e.zh: 档案馆按千枚一组来清点邮票。

e.en: A {millier} of sheets arrived from the printer.
e.zh: 印刷厂送来了一千张纸。

e.en: The survey measured gravity differences in {milligals}.
e.zh: 这次测量用毫伽表示重力差异。

e.en: A one-{milligal} anomaly appeared near the fault.
e.zh: 断层附近出现了一毫伽的异常。

e.en: The chemist noted a {milligamma} of residue.
e.zh: 化学家记录到一毫伽马的残留物。

e.en: Old tables used {milligamma} values for tiny masses.
e.zh: 旧表格用毫伽马数值表示极小质量。

milligauss.t: 毫高斯，磁感应强度单位

e.en: The meter showed five {milligauss} near the wire.
e.zh: 仪表显示电线附近有五毫高斯。

e.en: Background fields are often reported in {milligauss}.
e.zh: 背景磁场常用毫高斯来报告。

milligoat.t: 玩笑用单位，千分之一山羊

e.en: The forum joked about measuring rent in {milligoats}.
e.zh: 论坛上开玩笑说用毫山羊来衡量租金。

e.en: One {milligoat} is not a serious scientific unit.
e.zh: 一毫山羊并不是严肃的科学单位。

e.en: The antique label said one {milligrame} of powder.
e.zh: 那张古旧标签写着一毫克粉末。

e.en: Modern English usually spells {milligrame} as milligram.
e.zh: 现代英语通常把milligrame拼作milligram。

e.en: The medicine contains ten {milligrammes} of iron.
e.zh: 这种药含有十毫克铁。

e.en: British labels once often used {milligramme}.
e.zh: 英国标签过去常使用milligramme这个拼法。

e.en: The coil has an inductance of one {millihenry}.
e.zh: 这个线圈的电感为一毫亨。

e.en: Choose a {millihenry} value that suits the circuit.
e.zh: 选择适合电路的毫亨数值。

e.en: The signal varied by only two {millihertz}.
e.zh: 信号只变化了两毫赫兹。

e.en: Geologists track slow oscillations in {millihertz}.
e.zh: 地质学家用毫赫兹追踪缓慢振荡。

e.en: The laser pulse delivered five {millijoules}.
e.zh: 激光脉冲释放了五毫焦耳能量。

e.en: Each {millijoule} was recorded during the test.
e.zh: 测试期间每一毫焦耳都被记录下来。

e.en: The screen brightness was listed in {millilamberts}.
e.zh: 屏幕亮度以毫朗伯列出。

e.en: A {millilambert} reading helped compare the panels.
e.zh: 毫朗伯读数有助于比较这些面板。

e.en: The cave sensor registered three {millilux}.
e.zh: 洞穴传感器记录到三毫勒克斯。

e.en: Low-light studies may use {millilux} measurements.
e.zh: 弱光研究可能会使用毫勒克斯测量值。

millimaxwell.t: 毫麦克斯韦，磁通量单位

e.en: The flux was reported as one {millimaxwell}.
e.zh: 磁通量被报告为一毫麦克斯韦。

e.en: Old instruments displayed values in {millimaxwells}.
e.zh: 旧仪器用毫麦克斯韦显示数值。

millime.t: 千分之一；旧货币小单位

e.en: The fare once cost a single {millime}.
e.zh: 这笔车费过去只要一个米利姆。

e.en: Collectors still discuss coins worth a {millime}.
e.zh: 收藏者仍会谈到面值一米利姆的硬币。

e.en: The solution measured two {millimhos} of conductance.
e.zh: 该溶液的电导为两毫姆欧。

e.en: Older texts use {millimho} where siemens is now common.
e.zh: 旧文献会用毫姆欧，而现在常用西门子。

e.en: The wavelengths were listed in {millimicra}.
e.zh: 这些波长以毫微米列出。

e.en: Scientists later replaced {millimicra} with nanometers.
e.zh: 科学家后来用纳米取代毫微米这个说法。

e.en: The prefix {millimicro} meant one billionth.
e.zh: 前缀millimicro表示十亿分之一。

e.en: Older instruments used {millimicro} notation for tiny scales.
e.zh: 旧仪器用millimicro记法表示微小尺度。

e.en: The particle was about ten {millimicrons} wide.
e.zh: 这个粒子大约宽十毫微米。

e.en: A {millimicron} is now usually called a nanometer.
e.zh: 一毫微米现在通常叫作一纳米。

e.en: The pulse lasted only a {millimicrosecond}.
e.zh: 这个脉冲只持续了十亿分之一秒。

e.en: Older papers sometimes used {millimicrosecond} for a nanosecond.
e.zh: 旧论文有时用毫微秒表示纳秒。

e.en: The sample contained one {millimole} of glucose.
e.zh: 这个样品含有一毫摩尔葡萄糖。

e.en: Doctors measured potassium in {millimoles} per liter.
e.zh: 医生以每升毫摩尔为单位测量钾含量。

milline.t: 千分之一达因的力单位

e.en: The old instrument recorded force in {millines}.
e.zh: 这台旧仪器用千分之一达因记录力。

e.en: A {milline} is rarely used in modern physics.
e.zh: 现代物理中很少使用毫达因这个单位。

millinormal.t: 毫当量浓度的；千分之一当量

e.en: They prepared a {millinormal} acid solution.
e.zh: 他们配制了一份毫当量浓度的酸溶液。

e.en: The titration used {millinormal} sodium hydroxide.
e.zh: 这次滴定使用了毫当量浓度的氢氧化钠。

millioersted.t: 毫奥斯特，磁场强度单位

e.en: The sensor detected a few {millioersteds}.
e.zh: 传感器检测到几个毫奥斯特的磁场强度。

e.en: Readings below one {millioersted} were ignored.
e.zh: 低于一毫奥斯特的读数被忽略了。

e.en: The cable resistance was two {milliohms}.
e.zh: 这根电缆的电阻是两毫欧。

e.en: A {milliohm} meter checks very small resistances.
e.zh: 毫欧表用于检查很小的电阻。

e.en: Use a {milliohmmeter} to test the joint.
e.zh: 用毫欧表测试这个接头。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {milliohmmeter} before use.
e.zh: 技术员在使用前校准了毫欧表。

e.en: The magazine called her a young {millionette}.
e.zh: 那本杂志称她为年轻的小富豪。

e.en: In the novel, a {millionette} funded the expedition.
e.zh: 在小说里，一位女小富豪资助了探险。

e.en: The signal showed a {millionfold} increase.
e.zh: 信号显示出百万倍的增长。

e.en: Their losses were repaid {millionfold} in legend.
e.zh: 在传说中，他们的损失得到了百万倍的回报。

e.en: The old newspaper spelled millionaire as {millionnaire}.
e.zh: 那份旧报纸把百万富翁拼作millionnaire。

e.en: A {millionnaire} bought the estate in 1890.
e.zh: 一位百万富翁在1890年买下了这处庄园。

e.en: The play features a proud {millionnairess}.
e.zh: 这部戏里有一位骄傲的女百万富翁。

e.en: Reporters described the heiress as a {millionnairess}.
e.zh: 记者把这位女继承人称作女百万富翁。

millionocracy.t: 富豪统治；百万富翁阶层

e.en: He mocked the city as a {millionocracy}.
e.zh: 他嘲讽这座城市是富豪统治的地方。

e.en: The essay warned against a rising {millionocracy}.
e.zh: 这篇文章警告说百万富翁阶层正在崛起。

e.en: The solution measured 300 {milliosmols} per kilogram.
e.zh: 该溶液的测量值为每千克300毫渗摩尔。

e.en: Clinicians track urine concentration in {milliosmols}.
e.zh: 临床医生用毫渗摩尔跟踪尿液浓度。

e.en: The lamp produced only one {milliphot}.
e.zh: 这盏灯只产生了一毫辐透的照度。

e.en: A {milliphot} is an obsolete illumination unit.
e.zh: 毫辐透是一种已过时的照度单位。

e.en: The oil viscosity was measured in {millipoise}.
e.zh: 这种油的黏度用毫泊来测量。

e.en: Water has about ten {millipoise} at room temperature.
e.zh: 室温下水的黏度约为十毫泊。

millirad.t: 毫拉德，吸收辐射剂量单位

e.en: The badge recorded five {millirads}.
e.zh: 剂量牌记录了五毫拉德。

e.en: A {millirad} is a small absorbed radiation dose.
e.zh: 毫拉德是很小的吸收辐射剂量单位。

e.en: The scope was adjusted by one {milliradian}.
e.zh: 瞄准镜调了一毫弧度。

e.en: Engineers express tiny angles in {milliradians}.
e.zh: 工程师用毫弧度表示很小的角度。

millirem.t: 毫雷姆，辐射剂量当量单位

e.en: The annual exposure was under ten {millirem}.
e.zh: 年暴露量低于十毫雷姆。

e.en: Workers wore badges that measured {millirems}.
e.zh: 工人佩戴能测量毫雷姆的剂量牌。

milliroentgen.t: 毫伦琴，辐射照射量单位

e.en: The meter displayed thirty {milliroentgens}.
e.zh: 仪表显示三十毫伦琴。

e.en: A {milliroentgen} is one thousandth of a roentgen.
e.zh: 一毫伦琴等于千分之一伦琴。

millirutherford.t: 毫卢瑟福，放射性活度单位

e.en: The source activity was two {millirutherfords}.
e.zh: 这个源的放射性活度是两毫卢瑟福。

e.en: Few modern labs report activity in {millirutherford}.
e.zh: 如今很少有实验室用毫卢瑟福报告活度。

e.en: The manuscript used {milliscond} instead of millisecond.
e.zh: 手稿把millisecond写成了milliscond。

e.en: A {milliscond} delay was mentioned in the old notes.
e.zh: 旧笔记里提到了一次毫秒级延迟，并写作milliscond。

milliscope.t: 微小范围观察仪；罕用仪器名

e.en: The inventor called his device a {milliscope}.
e.zh: 发明者把他的装置称为milliscope。

e.en: A {milliscope} appears only in specialist catalogues.
e.zh: milliscope只出现在专业目录中。

e.en: The scan gave him two {millisieverts}.
e.zh: 这次扫描让他受到两毫西弗的剂量。

e.en: Radiation limits are often stated in {millisieverts}.
e.zh: 辐射限值通常用毫西弗表示。

e.en: The chamber pressure fell below one {millitorr}.
e.zh: 腔室压力降到一毫托以下。

e.en: Vacuum gauges can read in {millitorr}.
e.zh: 真空计可以用毫托读数。

e.en: The label printed {millitsmol} by mistake.
e.zh: 标签误印成了millitsmol。

e.en: No standard unit called {millitsmol} appears in the table.
e.zh: 表中没有名为millitsmol的标准单位。

e.en: The actor's {mimical} gestures made the audience laugh.
e.zh: 那位演员模仿性的手势逗笑了观众。

e.en: Some insects have {mimical} markings that resemble leaves.
e.zh: 有些昆虫带有拟态斑纹，看起来像叶子。

e.en: She smiled {mimically}, copying his awkward grin.
e.zh: 她模仿地一笑，学着他那尴尬的咧嘴笑。

e.en: The robot moved {mimically} like a tired human.
e.zh: 那个机器人以模仿的方式移动，像个疲惫的人。

e.en: The child learned speech through playful {mimmation}.
e.zh: 那个孩子通过游戏式的模仿学会说话。

e.en: Animal {mimmation} can help a species avoid predators.
e.zh: 动物的拟态行为能帮助物种躲避捕食者。

e.en: High levels of {mimosine} can make the plant toxic to livestock.
e.zh: 高含量的含羞草氨酸会使这种植物对牲畜有毒。

e.en: Researchers measured {mimosine} in the leaves before testing the feed.
e.zh: 研究人员在测试饲料前测量了叶片中的含羞草氨酸。

e.en: The old catalogue described the shrub as a {mimosite}.
e.zh: 那本旧目录把这种灌木描述为类似含羞草的植物。

e.en: A {mimosite} was planted near the greenhouse door.
e.zh: 温室门旁种了一株类似含羞草的植物。

e.en: The survey found several {minable} seams of coal.
e.zh: 勘测发现了几条可开采的煤层。

e.en: Old records may contain {minable} data for the project.
e.zh: 旧记录里可能有这个项目可挖掘的数据。

e.en: A {minacious} silence filled the room after his warning.
e.zh: 他发出警告后，房间里弥漫着一种威胁性的沉默。

e.en: The clouds gathered in a dark, {minacious} mass.
e.zh: 乌云聚成一大片阴沉吓人的云团。

e.en: The letter's {minacity} was clear despite its polite wording.
e.zh: 那封信措辞客气，但威胁意味很明显。

e.en: His quiet voice gave the command a strange {minacity}.
e.zh: 他低沉的声音让这道命令带上了奇怪的恐吓意味。

e.en: The inscription mentions three {minae} of silver.
e.zh: 铭文提到三明那银子。

e.en: Ancient accounts often recorded debts in {minae}.
e.zh: 古代账目常用明那记录债务。

e.en: The village {minar} rose above the flat roofs.
e.zh: 村里的尖塔高出一片平屋顶。

e.en: At sunset, birds circled the old {minar}.
e.zh: 日落时，鸟儿绕着那座古老的清真寺塔飞。

e.en: A {minargent} sheen covered the fish's scales.
e.zh: 鱼鳞上覆着一层银白色的光泽。

e.en: The moon gave the fields a {minargent} glow.
e.zh: 月光给田野染上了似银的光亮。

e.en: He leaned forward {minatorially} across the desk.
e.zh: 他带着威胁姿态越过桌子向前倾身。

e.en: The guard raised his hand {minatorially} but said nothing.
e.zh: 守卫恐吓似的抬起手，却什么也没说。

e.en: The notice was worded {minatorily} to discourage complaints.
e.zh: 通知措辞带有威胁意味，意在阻止投诉。

e.en: She pointed {minatorily} toward the exit.
e.zh: 她威胁似的指向出口。

e.en: The imam stepped onto the {minbar} before the sermon.
e.zh: 伊玛目在讲道前登上清真寺讲坛。

e.en: Carved wood decorated the old mosque's {minbar}.
e.zh: 那座老清真寺的讲坛饰有雕花木板。

e.en: She served a warm {mince-pie} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她端上一个热乎乎的百果馅饼。

e.en: At Christmas, every shop seemed to sell {mince-pie}.
e.zh: 圣诞节时，每家商店似乎都在卖百果馅饼。

e.en: The recipe requires fine {mincement} of the herbs.
e.zh: 这道食谱要求把香草细细切碎。

e.en: There was no {mincement} in her criticism of the plan.
e.zh: 她批评这个计划时毫不委婉。

e.en: The study examined the effects of {mind-altering} drugs.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了改变意识药物的作用。

e.en: He described meditation as a mildly {mind-altering} practice.
e.zh: 他把冥想描述为一种轻微改变意识的练习。

mind-bending.t: 令人费解的；震撼思维的

e.en: The film has a {mind-bending} plot about time travel.
e.zh: 这部电影有一个关于时间旅行的烧脑情节。

e.en: Quantum theory can feel {mind-bending} at first.
e.zh: 量子理论一开始会让人觉得非常费解。

e.en: The final twist was a real {mind-blower}.
e.zh: 最后的反转真是令人震惊。

e.en: For new students, the first lecture can be a {mind-blower}.
e.zh: 对新生来说，第一堂课可能会非常震撼。

e.en: The view from the summit was {mind-blowing}.
e.zh: 从山顶看到的景色令人惊叹。

e.en: She gave a {mind-blowing} performance on stage.
e.zh: 她在舞台上的表演非常震撼。

e.en: The view was {mind-blowingly} beautiful at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时的景色美得令人震撼。

e.en: The app is {mind-blowingly} fast for such a small team.
e.zh: 对这么小的团队来说，这个应用快得惊人。

mind-boggling.t: 令人难以置信的；费解的

e.en: The scale of the project is {mind-boggling}.
e.zh: 这个项目的规模令人难以置信。

e.en: She explained the {mind-boggling} math in simple terms.
e.zh: 她用简单的话解释了那套费解的数学。

mind-bogglingly.t: 令人难以置信地；费解地

e.en: The hotel was {mind-bogglingly} expensive during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间那家酒店贵得令人难以置信。

e.en: The rules are {mind-bogglingly} complex for beginners.
e.zh: 这些规则对初学者来说复杂得费解。

mind-expanding.t: 开阔眼界的；拓展思维的

e.en: Travel can be a {mind-expanding} experience.
e.zh: 旅行可能是一种开阔眼界的经历。

e.en: The seminar offered a {mind-expanding} look at climate science.
e.zh: 这场研讨会让人以拓展思维的方式了解气候科学。

e.en: The novel imagines a {mind-machine} that records dreams.
e.zh: 这部小说设想了一台能记录梦境的心智机器。

e.en: Researchers tested a {mind-machine} interface for patients.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了一种面向患者的脑机装置。

e.en: I drew a {mind-map} before writing the essay.
e.zh: 写文章前，我画了一张思维导图。

e.en: The teacher used a {mind-map} to organize the lesson.
e.zh: 老师用思维导图来组织这节课的内容。

mind-numbing.t: 枯燥得麻木的；令人麻木的

e.en: Filling out the forms was {mind-numbing} work.
e.zh: 填写这些表格是一件枯燥得让人麻木的工作。

e.en: The factory noise was loud and {mind-numbing}.
e.zh: 工厂的噪声很大，听得人麻木。

e.en: I am not a {mind-reader}, so please tell me what you want.
e.zh: 我不是读心者，所以请告诉我你想要什么。

e.en: The magician pretended to be a {mind-reader}.
e.zh: 那位魔术师假装自己会读心。

e.en: A positive {mind-set} helps during difficult projects.
e.zh: 在困难项目中，积极的心态很有帮助。

e.en: The course changed her {mind-set} about money.
e.zh: 这门课改变了她对金钱的思维方式。

e.en: Different teams often have different {mind-sets}.
e.zh: 不同团队常常有不同的思维方式。

e.en: The book compares Eastern and Western {mind-sets}.
e.zh: 这本书比较了东西方的心态。

e.en: That final scene was a real {mindblower}.
e.zh: 最后那一幕真是令人震撼。

e.en: For new students, quantum physics can be a {mindblower}.
e.zh: 对新生来说，量子物理可能会让人震惊不已。

e.en: That documentary was a real {mindexpander}.
e.zh: 那部纪录片真是拓展思维的佳作。

e.en: She called the philosophy course a {mindexpander}.
e.zh: 她说那门哲学课很能开阔思路。

e.en: The film's ending was a total {mindfuck}.
e.zh: 这部电影的结尾完全让人混乱又震撼。

e.en: Losing the case on a technicality was a {mindfuck}.
e.zh: 因为技术性细节输掉官司，让人非常崩溃。

e.en: A {mindminded} parent notices what a child may be feeling.
e.zh: 关注内心状态的父母会注意孩子可能在感受什么。

e.en: The therapist used a {mindminded} approach in family sessions.
e.zh: 治疗师在家庭会谈中采用了关注心理状态的方法。

e.en: The poem explores the lonely {mindscape} of grief.
e.zh: 这首诗探索了悲伤中孤独的内心景观。

e.en: Dreams can turn a familiar city into a strange {mindscape}.
e.zh: 梦境能把熟悉的城市变成奇异的精神世界。

e.en: The startup gained {mindshare} among young developers.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在年轻开发者中赢得了关注。

e.en: Big brands compete for customer {mindshare} every day.
e.zh: 大品牌每天都在争夺顾客的心智占有率。

e.en: The team held a quick {mindstorm} before the launch.
e.zh: 发布前，团队快速做了一次头脑风暴。

e.en: An anxious {mindstorm} kept him awake all night.
e.zh: 焦虑的思绪风暴让他整夜没睡。

e.en: The {mine-captain} inspected the tunnels before dawn.
e.zh: 矿山负责人在黎明前检查了矿道。

e.en: A good {mine-captain} understood both safety and production.
e.zh: 优秀的矿长既懂安全，也懂生产。

e.en: The {mine-worker} wore a helmet and lamp underground.
e.zh: 那名矿工在地下戴着头盔和矿灯。

e.en: Her grandfather was a {mine-worker} for thirty years.
e.zh: 她的祖父当了三十年矿工。

e.en: The survey found a large {mineable} coal reserve.
e.zh: 勘测发现了一处大型可开采煤储量。

e.en: Some asteroids may contain {mineable} metals.
e.zh: 一些小行星可能含有可开采的金属。

e.en: The navy sent a {minelayer} into the narrow channel.
e.zh: 海军派出一艘布雷舰进入狭窄水道。

e.en: Engineers tested a remote {minelayer} on the training field.
e.zh: 工程师在训练场测试了一台遥控布雷装置。

e.en: The treaty banned {minelaying} near civilian ports.
e.zh: 该条约禁止在民用港口附近布雷。

e.en: The army practiced {minelaying} during the night exercise.
e.zh: 军队在夜间演习中练习布设地雷。

e.en: The laboratory used {mineragraphy} to identify tiny ore minerals.
e.zh: 实验室用矿石显微研究来识别微小的矿石矿物。

e.en: Her thesis in {mineragraphy} focused on polished rock sections.
e.zh: 她的矿石显微研究论文重点研究抛光岩石薄片。

e.en: She chose a {mineral-based} sunscreen for sensitive skin.
e.zh: 她为敏感肌选择了一款以矿物为基础的防晒霜。

e.en: The factory developed {mineral-based} insulation materials.

e.en: Astronomers once called Pluto a {miniplanet}.
e.zh: 天文学家曾把冥王星称作小行星。

e.en: The shop sells {miniprints} of famous paintings.
e.zh: 这家店出售名画的小幅印刷品。

e.en: She pinned several {miniprints} above her desk.
e.zh: 她把几张迷你照片钉在书桌上方。

e.en: A {minipump} pushes water through the aquarium filter.
e.zh: 一个小型泵把水推过水族箱过滤器。

e.en: The device includes a {minipump} for precise drug delivery.
e.zh: 这台设备内置微型泵，用于精确输送药物。

minirecession.t: 小幅衰退；短暂经济下滑

e.en: Analysts called the slowdown a {minirecession}, not a crisis.
e.zh: 分析师称这次放缓只是小幅衰退，不是危机。

e.en: A {minirecession} hit the region after exports fell.
e.zh: 出口下降后，该地区经历了一次短暂经济下滑。

e.en: The village opened a {minischool} for younger children.
e.zh: 村里为年幼儿童开办了一所小型学校。

e.en: The museum runs a weekend {minischool} on photography.
e.zh: 博物馆周末开设一个摄影迷你课程班。

e.en: The new phone is {minish}, but it still feels powerful.
e.zh: 这款新手机略小，但用起来仍然很强大。

e.en: Her apartment has a {minish} kitchen with clever storage.
e.zh: 她的公寓有个迷你风格的厨房，收纳设计很巧妙。

e.en: Monaco is often described as a European {ministate}.
e.zh: 摩纳哥常被描述为欧洲的微型国家。

e.en: The treaty protected the independence of the {ministate}.
e.zh: 这项条约保护了这个小邦国的独立。

e.en: The newspaper was openly {ministerialist} during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间，这家报纸公开站在部长派一边。

e.en: A loyal {ministerialist} defended the cabinet's policy.
e.zh: 一名忠实的内阁支持者为内阁政策辩护。

ministrable.t: 可任部长的；适合入阁的

e.en: Commentators saw her as highly {ministrable} after the election.
e.zh: 选举后，评论员认为她非常适合入阁。

e.en: The party lacked enough {ministrable} figures for a coalition government.
e.zh: 该党缺少足够可任部长的人物来组建联合政府。

e.en: The young {ministrant} carried candles during the service.
e.zh: 那名年轻辅祭人员在礼拜中手持蜡烛。

e.en: She worked as a {ministrant} to the sick and elderly.
e.zh: 她作为服侍者照顾病人和老人。

e.en: The clinic added {ministrative} support for patients' families.
e.zh: 诊所为患者家属增加了辅助照料支持。

e.en: His role was mainly {ministrative}, not managerial.
e.zh: 他的职责主要是服务性的，而不是管理性的。

e.en: The researchers used a {minisub} to inspect the wreck.
e.zh: 研究人员用一艘小型潜艇检查沉船。

e.en: A private company built the {minisub} for deep-sea tourism.
e.zh: 一家私人公司为深海旅游制造了这台微型潜水器。

e.en: The lab bought several {minisupercomputers} for climate modeling.
e.zh: 实验室购买了几台小型超级计算机用于气候建模。

e.en: Modern {minisupercomputers} can fit into a single rack.
e.zh: 现代小型超级计算机可以装进一个机架。

e.en: The army tested a remote-controlled {minitank}.
e.zh: 军方测试了一辆遥控小型坦克。

e.en: The printer uses a {minitank} for refillable ink.
e.zh: 这台打印机使用可补充墨水的迷你水箱。

e.en: A {minitanker} delivered fuel to the island.
e.zh: 一艘小型油轮向岛上运送燃料。

e.en: The company uses a {minitanker} for local chemical transport.
e.zh: 这家公司使用小型液罐车进行本地化学品运输。

e.en: The toy train runs on a {minitrack} around the room.
e.zh: 玩具火车沿着房间里的微型轨道运行。

e.en: They built a {minitrack} for indoor bike practice.
e.zh: 他们搭了一条小型赛道供室内自行车练习。

e.en: The team ran a {minitrial} before the full study.
e.zh: 团队在正式研究前先做了一次小型试验。

e.en: The judge allowed a {minitrial} on the narrow evidence issue.
e.zh: 法官允许就这个有限的证据问题进行小规模审理。

e.en: Place the sample in a sterile {minitube}.
e.zh: 把样本放进一个无菌小试管里。

e.en: The radio used a {minitube} instead of a full-size valve.
e.zh: 这台收音机用了微型电子管，而不是全尺寸真空管。

e.en: The contract footnotes were printed in {minitype}.
e.zh: 合同脚注是用小型字体印的。

e.en: Old printers kept boxes of {minitype} for tiny labels.
e.zh: 老印刷工会备着微型铅字，用来印很小的标签。

e.en: Medieval artists sometimes painted initials with {minium}.
e.zh: 中世纪画师有时用铅丹给首字母上色。

e.en: The old primer contained {minium} as a red pigment.
e.zh: 这种旧底漆含有铅丹，作为红色颜料。

e.en: The robe was trimmed with {miniver} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 典礼长袍用白鼬皮镶边装饰。

e.en: In the poem, the queen wears {miniver} and gold.
e.zh: 在那首诗里，王后穿着白鼬皮与金饰。

e.en: Use a {miniwasher} to secure the tiny screw.
e.zh: 用一个小垫圈来固定这颗小螺丝。

e.en: A portable {miniwasher} fits under the bathroom sink.
e.zh: 便携式迷你洗衣机可以放在浴室水槽下面。

e.en: A narrow {miniway} led between the garden beds.
e.zh: 一条小路从花圃之间穿过。

e.en: The cable tray includes a {miniway} for control wires.
e.zh: 电缆槽里设有一条小型通道，用来走控制线。

e.en: A {minnesinger} performed songs of courtly love.
e.zh: 一位中世纪德国恋歌诗人演唱宫廷爱情歌曲。

e.en: The manuscript preserves verses by an anonymous {minnesinger}.
e.zh: 这份手稿保存了一位佚名恋歌诗人的诗句。

e.en: The farmer wore a straw {mino} in the rain.
e.zh: 农夫下雨时穿着一件日本蓑衣。

e.en: The print was made on fine {mino} paper.
e.zh: 这幅版画印在优质美浓纸上。

e.en: He signed with a {minor-league} baseball team.
e.zh: 他和一支小联盟棒球队签了约。

e.en: The scandal was only {minor-league} compared with the bigger fraud.
e.zh: 与那场更大的欺诈相比，这个丑闻只是次要事件。

e.en: The {minor-leaguer} hoped to reach the majors next season.
e.zh: 这名小联盟球员希望下赛季升入大联盟。

e.en: In national politics, he remained a {minor-leaguer}.
e.zh: 在全国政治中，他始终只是个次要人物。

minorine.t: 未成年人身份；少数派状态

e.en: The law treated her {minorine} status as a limit on consent.
e.zh: 法律把她的未成年人身份视为同意能力的限制。

e.en: The essay discusses political {minorine} within the empire.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论帝国内部的少数派状态。

e.en: The report examined their {minoriry} in local schools.
e.zh: 报告考察了他们在当地学校中的少数地位。

e.en: Her sense of {minoriry} shaped much of the memoir.
e.zh: 她对少数派身份的感受塑造了这本回忆录的大部分内容。

e.en: Set the {minsize} so the panel cannot collapse.
e.zh: 设置最小尺寸，防止面板完全收起。

e.en: The label printer uses {minsize} text for serial numbers.
e.zh: 标签打印机用最小字号打印序列号。

e.en: The rare coin had a very low {mintage}.
e.zh: 这枚稀有硬币的铸币量很低。

e.en: Silver {mintage} increased during the king's reign.
e.zh: 国王在位期间，银币铸造量有所增加。

e.en: Check the {mintmark} before pricing the coin.
e.zh: 给硬币估价前先查看铸币厂标记。

e.en: A small {mintmark} appears below the date.
e.zh: 日期下方有一个小小的铸币厂标记。

e.en: The {mintmaster} approved the new coin design.
e.zh: 铸币厂主管批准了新硬币设计。

e.en: Records show the {mintmaster} was accused of debasing silver.
e.zh: 记录显示，这名铸币厂主管被指控降低银币成色。

e.en: In 9 minus 4, 9 is the {minuend}.
e.zh: 在九减四中，九是被减数。

e.en: Write the {minuend} above the subtrahend in this exercise.
e.zh: 在这道练习里，把被减数写在减数上方。

e.en: The antique pistol had a {miquelet} lock.
e.zh: 那把古董手枪装有米克莱特式枪机。

e.en: Collectors prize Spanish {miquelet} firearms.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视西班牙米克莱特式火器。

e.en: She made jam from ripe {mirabelles}.
e.zh: 她用熟透的米拉贝尔李做果酱。

e.en: A {mirabelle} tart was served warm.
e.zh: 一份米拉贝尔李挞被趁热端上来。

e.en: The medieval book described many {mirabilia}.
e.zh: 那本中世纪书籍描述了许多奇观。

e.en: Travelers collected tales of distant {mirabilia}.
e.zh: 旅行者收集远方珍奇事物的传闻。

e.en: The geologist identified {mirabilite} in the deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家在矿床中鉴定出芒硝石。

e.en: Cold conditions helped {mirabilite} crystals form.
e.zh: 寒冷条件促使芒硝石晶体形成。

e.en: The poet praised her {mirable} patience.
e.zh: 诗人赞美她令人惊奇的耐心。

e.en: It was a {mirable} tale of survival.
e.zh: 那是一个奇妙的生还故事。

e.en: The lab observed {miracidial} movement under the microscope.
e.zh: 实验室在显微镜下观察到毛蚴的运动。

e.en: Temperature affected the {miracidial} stage of the parasite.
e.zh: 温度影响了这种寄生虫的毛蚴阶段。

e.en: A {miracidium} swims to find a snail host.
e.zh: 毛蚴会游动以寻找螺类宿主。

e.en: The parasite hatches as a {miracidium}.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫孵化后成为毛蚴。

miraculin.t: 神秘果蛋白；味觉改变蛋白

e.en: {Miraculin} makes sour foods taste sweet.
e.zh: 神秘果蛋白会让酸味食物尝起来变甜。

e.en: Researchers studied {miraculin} as a sugar substitute.
e.zh: 研究人员把神秘果蛋白作为代糖来研究。

e.en: We climbed to the {mirador} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时我们登上了观景台。

e.en: The old {mirador} overlooked the valley.
e.zh: 那座旧眺望楼俯瞰着山谷。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {mirapilite}.
e.zh: 样品中含有少量水芒硝。

e.en: Miners recorded {mirapilite} near the salt beds.
e.zh: 矿工记录到盐层附近有水芒硝。

e.en: The spectacle filled the crowd with {miration}.
e.zh: 这场奇观让人群充满惊叹。

e.en: His {miration} was plain in his silence.
e.zh: 他的沉默清楚显露出惊奇。

e.en: Oil of {mirbane} was once used in perfumery.
e.zh: 米尔班油曾用于香水制造。

e.en: The chemist handled {mirbane} with caution.
e.zh: 化学师小心处理硝基苯。

e.en: Start the soup with a {mirepoix}.
e.zh: 先用法式香味蔬菜丁给汤打底。

e.en: The chef browned the {mirepoix} slowly.
e.zh: 厨师慢慢炒香那份法式蔬菜丁。

e.en: A {miresnipe} rose from the wet grass.
e.zh: 一只沼泽鹬从湿草丛中飞起。

e.en: Hunters once searched the marsh for {miresnipe}.
e.zh: 猎人过去会在沼泽里寻找泥地鹬鸟。

e.en: {Mirex} was banned because it persists in soil.
e.zh: 灭蚁灵因会在土壤中长期残留而被禁用。

e.en: The report measured {mirex} in river sediment.
e.zh: 报告测量了河流沉积物中的灭蚁灵。

e.en: The fisherman caught a {mirgil} near the rocks.
e.zh: 渔民在岩石附近捕到一条地中海鲻鱼。

e.en: A grilled {mirgil} was served with lemon.
e.zh: 烤地中海鲻鱼配着柠檬端上桌。

e.en: The {miriness} of the field slowed every runner.
e.zh: 田地的泥泞让每个跑者都慢了下来。

e.en: She disliked the {miriness} after days of rain.
e.zh: 连日下雨后的湿软泥泞让她很不喜欢。

e.en: The path vanished into the {mirk} of the forest.
e.zh: 小路消失在森林的昏暗之中。

e.en: His thoughts sank into a heavy {mirk}.
e.zh: 他的思绪陷入沉重的阴郁黑暗。

e.en: A {mirky} sky hung over the harbor.
e.zh: 阴沉昏暗的天空笼罩着港口。

e.en: The old story has a {mirky} moral center.
e.zh: 这个旧故事的道德核心显得阴沉而模糊。

e.en: The child played a paper {mirliton} at the fair.
e.zh: 孩子在集市上吹着一个纸制米利顿笛。

e.en: She added sliced {mirliton} to the stew.
e.zh: 她把切片的佛手瓜加进了炖菜里。

mirror-image.t: 镜像；完全相反的对应物

e.en: The left design is a {mirror-image} of the right.
e.zh: 左边的设计是右边的镜像。

e.en: Her childhood was a {mirror-image} of his privileged life.
e.zh: 她的童年与他优渥的生活形成完全相反的对应。

e.en: A silver {mirrorball} spun above the dance floor.
e.zh: 一个银色迪斯科镜球在舞池上方旋转。

e.en: The stage lights hit the {mirrorball} and scattered everywhere.
e.zh: 舞台灯光打在反光球上，光点四处散开。

e.en: The diary used {mirrow} where modern writers use mirror.
e.zh: 这本日记把现代人写作mirror的地方写成了mirrow。

e.en: She noticed {mirrow} was probably a spelling mistake.
e.zh: 她注意到mirrow很可能是一个拼写错误。

e.en: His joke caused a {mirthquake} around the table.
e.zh: 他的笑话让桌边的人爆发出一阵大笑。

e.en: The room shook with a sudden {mirthquake}.
e.zh: 房间里突然响起震动般的哄笑。

e.en: Their boots sank into the {miry} road.
e.zh: 他们的靴子陷进了泥泞的道路里。

e.en: He described politics as a {miry} struggle.
e.zh: 他把政治形容成一场泥潭般的斗争。

e.en: The program {mis-classifies} some spam as normal mail.
e.zh: 这个程序会把一些垃圾邮件误归类为普通邮件。

e.en: She {mis-classifies} the poem as a modern work.
e.zh: 她把这首诗错误地归为现代作品。

e.en: Do not {mis-classify} these records as duplicates.
e.zh: 不要把这些记录错误归类为重复项。

e.en: A rushed reviewer may {mis-classify} the disease.
e.zh: 匆忙的审查者可能会误判这种疾病的类别。

e.en: Please do not {mis-file} the tax forms again.
e.zh: 请不要再把这些税务表格归错档了。

e.en: The clerk managed to {mis-file} the complaint under invoices.
e.zh: 职员竟把投诉文件错归到了发票类别下。

e.en: The old rifle may {mis-fire} in cold weather.
e.zh: 这支旧步枪在寒冷天气里可能会哑火。

e.en: His attempt at humor began to {mis-fire}.
e.zh: 他想幽默一下，结果开始弄巧成拙。

e.en: They continued to {mis-manage} the public funds.
e.zh: 他们继续对公共资金管理不善。

e.en: If you {mis-manage} stress, it can harm your health.
e.zh: 如果你处理压力不当，可能会损害健康。

e.en: The colors {mis-match} in this outfit.
e.zh: 这套衣服的颜色搭配不协调。

e.en: Do not {mis-match} the cables and sockets.
e.zh: 不要把电缆和插口配错。

e.en: Reporters often {mis-name} the small village.
e.zh: 记者经常把这个小村子的名字叫错。

e.en: To {mis-name} the problem is to misunderstand it.
e.zh: 误称这个问题，就等于误解了它。

e.en: The system logged several {mis-recognitions} during the test.
e.zh: 系统在测试期间记录了几次误识别。

e.en: Her memoir explores painful {mis-recognitions} of family loyalty.
e.zh: 她的回忆录探讨了对家庭忠诚的痛苦误认。

e.en: Do not {mis-represent} the study's results.
e.zh: 不要歪曲这项研究的结果。

e.en: The ad seemed to {mis-represent} the product's benefits.
e.zh: 这则广告似乎夸大并误导了产品的好处。

e.en: Banks must not {mis-sell} risky investments to retirees.
e.zh: 银行不得向退休人士误导销售高风险投资。

e.en: The agent tried to {mis-sell} insurance as a savings plan.
e.zh: 代理人试图把保险不当推销成储蓄计划。

e.en: In subtraction, the {minuent} is the number from which another number is taken.
e.zh: 在减法中，被减数是被另一个数减去的那个数。

e.en: The teacher asked students to identify the {minuent} before solving the problem.
e.zh: 老师让学生先找出被减数，再解这道题。

e.en: The old score marks this note as a {minum}.
e.zh: 这份旧乐谱把这个音标成二分音符。

e.en: She held the {minum} for two beats in the exercise.
e.zh: 她在练习中把这个二分音符保持了两拍。

e.en: The secretary entered the decision in the {minute-book}.
e.zh: 秘书把这项决定记入会议记录簿。

e.en: The old {minute-book} preserved every vote of the committee.
e.zh: 那本旧会议记录簿保存了委员会的每次表决。

e.en: She noticed the {minutest} crack in the glass.
e.zh: 她注意到玻璃上最细微的一道裂纹。

e.en: The contract was checked in the {minutest} detail.
e.zh: 这份合同被逐项检查到最细微的程度。

e.en: The report became lost in {minutial} questions of wording.
e.zh: 这份报告陷入了措辞上的细枝末节问题。

e.en: He had a {minutial} concern about the placement of one comma.
e.zh: 他对一个逗号的位置有个细枝末节的担心。

e.en: His {minutiose} notes covered every scratch on the vase.
e.zh: 他过分细致的笔记记录了花瓶上的每一道划痕。

e.en: The editor rejected the {minutiose} revision as unnecessary.
e.zh: 编辑认为那种琐碎的修改没有必要，便拒绝了。

e.en: The scholar made a {minutious} comparison of the two manuscripts.
e.zh: 那位学者对两份手稿作了细致入微的比较。

e.en: A {minutious} inspection revealed dust inside the lens.
e.zh: 一次细致检查发现镜头内部有灰尘。

e.en: The sample was later identified as {minverite} by the mineralogist.
e.zh: 矿物学家后来把这个样本鉴定为明矾石类矿物。

e.en: Small crystals of {minverite} appeared in the altered rock.
e.zh: 蚀变岩中出现了细小的明矾石类矿物晶体。

e.en: The museum label described the pale mineral as {minyulite}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签把这种浅色矿物标为明尤利石。

e.en: Collectors value fine needles of {minyulite} from the old quarry.
e.zh: 收藏者看重旧采石场出产的优质针状明尤利石。

e.en: The pressure change was measured in {miobar} units.
e.zh: 这次压力变化用百万分之一巴为单位测量。

e.en: Older papers sometimes report tiny atmospheric differences in {miobar}.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时用百万分之一巴表示微小的大气差异。

e.en: The cliff contains several {miocenic} fossil beds.
e.zh: 这处峭壁含有几层中新世化石层。

e.en: Researchers compared the {miocenic} climate with later cooling periods.
e.zh: 研究人员把中新世气候与后来的降温时期作比较。

e.en: The geologist described the rock as {miocrystalline}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种岩石描述为微晶质。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {miocrystalline} texture became clear.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，微晶质结构变得很清楚。

e.en: The basin developed along a {miogeoclinal} margin.
e.zh: 这个盆地沿近陆地槽边缘发育。

e.en: They mapped the {miogeoclinal} sequence across the mountain front.
e.zh: 他们绘制了山前一带的近陆地槽地层序列。

e.en: Sediments accumulated slowly within the ancient {miogeocline}.
e.zh: 沉积物在古近陆地槽内缓慢堆积。

e.en: The {miogeocline} later became part of the folded mountain belt.
e.zh: 这个近陆地槽后来成为褶皱山带的一部分。

e.en: The team studied a {miogeosynclinal} belt of shallow-water rocks.
e.zh: 团队研究了一条由浅水岩石组成的近陆地向斜带。

e.en: Several {miogeosynclinal} deposits were rich in carbonate layers.
e.zh: 几处近陆地向斜沉积富含碳酸盐岩层。

e.en: The old sea floor formed a broad {miogeosyncline}.
e.zh: 古老海底形成了一个宽阔的近陆地向斜。

e.en: Oil exploration focused on the margins of the {miogeosyncline}.
e.zh: 石油勘探集中在这个近陆地向斜的边缘。

e.en: The paper mentions {miokinine} as a substance affecting muscle activity.
e.zh: 论文提到肌激肽是一种影响肌肉活动的物质。

e.en: Early physiologists tried to isolate {miokinine} from tissue extracts.
e.zh: 早期生理学家曾试图从组织提取物中分离肌激肽。

e.en: Elephants moved through the dry {miombo} woodland at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，大象穿过干燥的米翁博林地。

e.en: Many rural families collect fuelwood from the surrounding {miombo}.
e.zh: 许多农村家庭从周围的米翁博林地采集柴火。

e.en: Bright light can cause {miosis} within seconds.
e.zh: 强光可在几秒内引起瞳孔缩小。

e.en: The doctor noted marked {miosis} after the eye drops were applied.
e.zh: 滴眼药后，医生注意到明显的瞳孔缩小。

e.en: The laboratory used {miostagmin} in an old diagnostic test.
e.zh: 实验室在一种旧式诊断试验中使用了表面张力测定物质。

e.en: References to {miostagmin} are rare in modern medical texts.
e.zh: 现代医学文献中很少提到这种表面张力测定物质。

e.en: The flower is described as {miostemonous} in the botanical key.
e.zh: 植物检索表把这种花描述为少雄蕊的。

e.en: A {miostemonous} species may have fewer stamens than related plants.
e.zh: 少雄蕊的物种可能比近缘植物拥有更少雄蕊。

e.en: The experiment required a {miothermic} environment for the cells.
e.zh: 这项实验需要为细胞提供低温环境。

e.en: Some organisms survive better under {miothermic} conditions.
e.zh: 有些生物在低温条件下存活得更好。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {miotic} drop to reduce eye pressure.
e.zh: 医生开了一种缩瞳滴眼液来降低眼压。

e.en: A strong {miotic} response made the pupil very small.
e.zh: 强烈的缩瞳反应使瞳孔变得很小。

e.en: Researchers handled {mipafox} only under strict safety controls.
e.zh: 研究人员只在严格安全管控下处理米帕福克斯毒剂。

e.en: Exposure to {mipafox} can damage the nervous system.
e.zh: 接触米帕福克斯毒剂可能损害神经系统。
