e.en: The antibody was designed to be {monospecific}.
e.zh: 这种抗体被设计为只针对一种目标。

e.en: The study questioned the {monospecificity} of the parasite.
e.zh: 这项研究质疑该寄生虫是否只寄生一种物种。

e.en: High {monospecificity} made the test more reliable.
e.zh: 较高的单特异性使检测更加可靠。

e.en: The experiment confirmed {monospermal} fertilization in the sample.
e.zh: 实验确认该样本发生了单精受精。

e.en: A {monospermal} egg receives only one sperm.
e.zh: 单精受精的卵子只接受一个精子。

e.en: The botanist described the fruit as {monospermous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种果实描述为单种子的。

e.en: In this species, fertilization is normally {monospermous}.
e.zh: 在这个物种中，受精通常是单精受精。

e.en: Successful development often depends on {monospermy}.
e.zh: 正常发育往往依赖单精受精。

e.en: The membrane changes help ensure {monospermy}.
e.zh: 细胞膜的变化有助于确保单精入卵。

e.en: The statistician used {monosplines} to fit the curve.
e.zh: 统计学家使用单调样条函数来拟合曲线。

e.en: These {monosplines} preserve the increasing trend in the data.
e.zh: 这些单调样条函数保留了数据中的递增趋势。

e.en: The timer uses a {monostable} circuit.
e.zh: 这个定时器使用单稳态电路。

e.en: A {monostable} system returns to one stable state.
e.zh: 单稳态系统会回到一个稳定状态。

e.en: The stem contains a simple {monostele}.
e.zh: 这根茎含有一个简单的单中柱。

e.en: A {monostele} is common in some primitive plants.
e.zh: 单中柱常见于一些原始植物。

e.en: The inscription was written as a {monostich}.
e.zh: 这段铭文以单行文字写成。

e.en: Her poem ends with a sharp {monostich}.
e.zh: 她的诗以一句有力的单行诗收尾。

e.en: The leaves are {monostichate} along the stem.
e.zh: 叶片沿茎呈单列排列。

e.en: A {monostichate} pattern made the specimen easy to identify.
e.zh: 单列排列的形态使这个标本容易辨认。

e.en: The grass has {monostichous} leaves near the base.
e.zh: 这种草在基部附近有单列排列的叶片。

e.en: The shells formed a {monostichous} row on the rock.
e.zh: 贝壳在岩石上形成了一行排列。

e.en: The specimen was classified as a {monostome}.
e.zh: 这个标本被归为单口生物。

e.en: A {monostome} has only one visible mouth opening.
e.zh: 单口结构只有一个可见的口孔。

monostomous.t: 单口的；只有一个口孔的

e.en: The organism is {monostomous} in its adult stage.
e.zh: 这种生物在成体阶段只有一个口孔。

e.en: A {monostomous} opening appears at the front end.
e.zh: 前端出现一个单口开口。

e.en: The hymn is arranged as a {monostrophe}.
e.zh: 这首赞美诗被写成单节诗。

e.en: A {monostrophe} can make the poem feel compressed.
e.zh: 单段诗体会让诗显得更凝练。

e.en: The song follows a {monostrophic} structure.
e.zh: 这首歌采用单节诗式结构。

e.en: His {monostrophic} verse avoids repeated stanzas.
e.zh: 他的单段诗体诗句避免了重复诗节。

e.en: The flower is {monostylous}, with one central style.
e.zh: 这朵花是单花柱的，中央只有一根花柱。

e.en: A {monostylous} column supports the small canopy.
e.zh: 一根单柱式立柱支撑着小顶棚。

e.en: He answered {monosyllabically} throughout the interview.
e.zh: 整个采访中他都用单音节似的简短话回答。

e.en: The child read the words {monosyllabically} at first.
e.zh: 孩子一开始按单音节方式读这些词。

e.en: The paper examines {monosyllabicity} in early English words.
e.zh: 这篇论文研究早期英语词汇的单音节性。

e.en: Its {monosyllabicity} gives the phrase a blunt rhythm.
e.zh: 它的单音节特征让这个短语节奏显得生硬。

monosyllabism.t: 单音节现象；单音节用法

e.en: Chinese is often discussed in terms of {monosyllabism}.
e.zh: 人们常从单音节现象的角度讨论汉语。

e.en: His {monosyllabism} made the conversation painfully brief.
e.zh: 他说话总是单音节式的，让谈话短得尴尬。

e.en: The orchid has a {monosymmetric} flower.
e.zh: 这种兰花具有单对称花形。

e.en: A {monosymmetric} design has only one plane of symmetry.
e.zh: 单对称设计只有一个对称平面。

monosymmetrical.t: 单对称的；只有一面对称的

e.en: The fossil shows a {monosymmetrical} body plan.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出单对称的身体结构。

e.en: Her pattern is deliberately {monosymmetrical}.
e.zh: 她的图案有意设计成只有一面对称。

monosymptomatic.t: 单一症状的；仅有一种症状的

e.en: The patient presented a {monosymptomatic} form of the disorder.
e.zh: 患者表现出这种疾病的单一症状形式。

e.en: A {monosymptomatic} case may be harder to diagnose.
e.zh: 只有一种症状的病例可能更难诊断。

e.en: This oil contains a healthy {monounsaturate}.
e.zh: 这种油含有一种有益健康的单不饱和物质。

e.en: Nutrition labels may list each {monounsaturate} separately.
e.zh: 营养标签可能会分别列出每种单不饱和物质。

e.en: Olive oil is rich in {monounsaturates}.
e.zh: 橄榄油富含单不饱和脂肪。

e.en: Doctors often recommend replacing saturated fat with {monounsaturates}.
e.zh: 医生常建议用单不饱和脂肪替代饱和脂肪。

e.en: Sodium is a {monovalent} ion in this reaction.
e.zh: 在这个反应中，钠是一价离子。

e.en: The vaccine was designed as a {monovalent} formulation.
e.zh: 这种疫苗被设计成单价配方。

e.en: The model assumes a {monovariant} system.
e.zh: 该模型假定这是一个单变量系统。

e.en: A {monovariant} phase diagram is easier to interpret.
e.zh: 单变相图更容易解读。

e.en: The circuit uses a {monovibrator} to shape the pulse.
e.zh: 该电路使用单稳态触发器来整形脉冲。

e.en: A faulty {monovibrator} caused the timing error.
e.zh: 一个故障的单稳态触发器导致了定时错误。

e.en: The study compared {monovular} twins with fraternal twins.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了同卵双胞胎和异卵双胞胎。

e.en: A {monovular} pregnancy begins from one fertilized egg.
e.zh: 单卵妊娠始于一个受精卵。

e.en: Each {monozygote} developed from one fertilized egg.
e.zh: 每个单合子个体都由一个受精卵发育而来。

e.en: The researcher identified the embryo as a {monozygote}.
e.zh: 研究人员将该胚胎鉴定为单合子。

e.en: The twins are {monozygous} and share identical genes.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎是同卵的，拥有相同基因。

e.en: A {monozygous} embryo comes from a single zygote.
e.zh: 单合子胚胎来自同一个受精卵。

e.en: The priest addressed him as {monseigneur} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式中，神父称他为阁下。

e.en: In the old letter, {monseigneur} appeared before the bishop's name.
e.zh: 在那封旧信里，主教姓名前写着阁下。

e.en: He entered with a {monsignorial} air of authority.
e.zh: 他带着教长般的威严走了进来。

e.en: The robe had a distinctly {monsignorial} style.
e.zh: 那件长袍有明显的教长风格。

e.en: The surgeon marked the {monspubis} before the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前标记了耻丘部位。

e.en: Swelling around the {monspubis} should be examined by a doctor.
e.zh: 耻丘周围肿胀应由医生检查。

e.en: She joked that her {monster-in-law} inspected every corner.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说，她那难缠的婆婆检查了每个角落。

e.en: The comedy turns a strict mother-in-law into a {monster-in-law}.
e.zh: 这部喜剧把严厉的岳母塑造成了难缠的长辈。

e.en: A large {monstera} filled the sunny corner.
e.zh: 一株高大的龟背竹占满了阳光充足的角落。

e.en: She wiped each {monstera} leaf with a damp cloth.
e.zh: 她用湿布擦拭每片龟背竹叶子。

e.en: The old anatomist described a {monstrometer} in his notes.
e.zh: 那位老解剖学家在笔记中描述了一种怪形测量器。

e.en: No modern clinic would use a {monstrometer} for diagnosis.
e.zh: 现代诊所不会用怪形测量器来诊断。

e.en: The medical text used {monsveneris} for the pubic mound.
e.zh: 这本医学文本用monsveneris指称耻丘。

e.en: Pain near the {monsveneris} can have several causes.
e.zh: 阴阜附近疼痛可能有多种原因。

e.en: The farmer bought a {montadale} for breeding.
e.zh: 农民买了一只蒙塔代尔羊用于繁殖。

e.en: A {montadale} is valued for both meat and wool.
e.zh: 蒙塔代尔羊因肉和羊毛都不错而受重视。

e.en: The botanist studied {montan} plants above the valley.
e.zh: 植物学家研究山谷上方的山地植物。

e.en: The polish contains {montan} wax from lignite.
e.zh: 这种抛光剂含有来自褐煤的蒙旦蜡。

e.en: The report described a {montanic} climate zone.
e.zh: 报告描述了一个山地气候带。

e.en: The chemist measured the {montanic} acid content.
e.zh: 化学家测量了蒙旦酸的含量。

e.en: The architect specified a {montant} between the panels.
e.zh: 建筑师指定在面板之间设置一根立柱。

e.en: The heraldic drawing showed a lion {montant}.
e.zh: 这幅纹章图画着一头向上跃起的狮子。

e.en: The traveler chose a sturdy {montaria} for the mountain path.
e.zh: 旅人挑了一匹结实的坐骑走山路。

e.en: In the old tale, each knight guarded his {montaria}.
e.zh: 在这个古老故事里，每位骑士都守护自己的坐骑。

monosynaptic.t: 单突触的，涉及一个突触的

e.en: The reflex follows a {monosynaptic} pathway in the spinal cord.
e.zh: 这种反射沿着脊髓中的单突触通路进行。

e.en: Researchers measured {monosynaptic} connections between the two neurons.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这两个神经元之间的单突触连接。

e.en: The crystals showed a {monotactic} arrangement under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这些晶体呈现单一排列。

e.en: A {monotactic} pattern can make the structure easier to model.
e.zh: 单序模式能让这种结构更容易建模。

monotechnic.t: 单一技术的；只用一种技艺的

e.en: The workshop took a {monotechnic} approach to metal casting.
e.zh: 这个工作坊采用单一技术的方法进行金属铸造。

e.en: His {monotechnic} training left him unprepared for broader design work.
e.zh: 他只受过一种技艺训练，难以胜任更广泛的设计工作。

e.en: The alloy undergoes a {monotectic} reaction at this temperature.
e.zh: 这种合金在这个温度下发生偏晶反应。

e.en: A {monotectic} system separates into two liquid phases.
e.zh: 偏晶体系会分离成两个液相。

e.en: The steel displayed a rare {monotectoid} transformation during cooling.
e.zh: 这种钢在冷却过程中出现了罕见的单变固态转变。

e.en: Engineers studied the {monotectoid} phase change in the sample.
e.zh: 工程师研究了样品中的单变固态相变。

monoterpene.t: 单萜，一类植物挥发性化合物

e.en: Limonene is a common {monoterpene} found in citrus oils.
e.zh: 柠檬烯是柑橘油中常见的一种单萜。

e.en: The herb releases a fragrant {monoterpene} when crushed.
e.zh: 这种草药被压碎时会释放出芳香的单萜化合物。

monotheistical.t: 一神论的，信奉唯一神的

e.en: The text reflects a strongly {monotheistical} view of creation.
e.zh: 这篇文本体现出强烈的一神论创世观。

e.en: Some scholars prefer monotheistic to the rarer word {monotheistical}.
e.zh: 有些学者更喜欢用monotheistic，而不用较少见的monotheistical。

monotheistically.t: 以一神论方式，按唯一神信仰

e.en: The tribe's traditions were later interpreted {monotheistically}.
e.zh: 这个部族的传统后来被按一神论方式解释。

e.en: He described the religion {monotheistically}, though its practices were diverse.
e.zh: 他以一神论方式描述这种宗教，尽管其实践很多样。

monothematic.t: 单一主题的；单主题妄想的

e.en: The album is deliberately {monothematic}, returning to exile again and again.
e.zh: 这张专辑有意保持单一主题，反复回到流亡这一题材。

e.en: The patient showed a {monothematic} delusion about being followed.
e.zh: 这名患者表现出一种关于被跟踪的单主题妄想。

monothetic.t: 单特征定义的，单一标准的

e.en: The classification used a {monothetic} rule for every specimen.
e.zh: 这种分类对每个标本都采用单一标准规则。

e.en: A {monothetic} group is defined by one shared property.
e.zh: 单特征定义的群组由一个共同属性来界定。

e.en: Cattle are usually {monotocous}, though twins sometimes occur.
e.zh: 牛通常每胎产一子，尽管有时也会生双胞胎。

e.en: The biologist compared {monotocous} mammals with species that bear litters.
e.zh: 生物学家把每胎产一子的哺乳动物与多胎物种作比较。

monotonicity.t: 单调性；单调不变的性质

e.en: The proof depends on the {monotonicity} of the function.
e.zh: 这个证明依赖于该函数的单调性。

e.en: Her speech had a dull {monotonicity} that made listeners restless.
e.zh: 她的讲话有一种沉闷的单调感，让听众坐立不安。

monotonist.t: 说话单调的人；单调风格者

e.en: The critic called him a {monotonist} with little emotional range.
e.zh: 评论家称他是个表达单调、情感幅度很小的人。

e.en: A skilled reader need not sound like a {monotonist}.
e.zh: 熟练的朗读者不必听起来像个语调单一的人。

e.en: The strict template can {monotonize} every report.
e.zh: 这种严格模板可能会让每份报告都变得单调。

e.en: Do not {monotonize} the melody by removing all variation.
e.zh: 不要去掉所有变化，把旋律弄得单调乏味。

monotopism.t: 单一地点性；局限一处的状态

e.en: The paper discussed {monotopism} in a small population of insects.
e.zh: 论文讨论了一个小型昆虫种群的单一地点性。

e.en: Extreme {monotopism} can make a species vulnerable to habitat loss.
e.zh: 极端局限一处会使物种容易受到栖息地丧失的威胁。

monotractor.t: 单牵引机；单动力牵引装置

e.en: The farm tested a compact {monotractor} for narrow rows.
e.zh: 农场测试了一台适合窄行作业的小型单牵引机。

e.en: A {monotractor} design reduces the number of powered units.
e.zh: 单牵引装置设计减少了动力单元的数量。

monotrematous.t: 单孔类的，似单孔目动物的

e.en: The fossil had several {monotrematous} features.
e.zh: 这块化石具有若干单孔类动物特征。

e.en: Scientists debated whether the jaw was truly {monotrematous}.
e.zh: 科学家争论这块颌骨是否真正属于单孔类特征。

monotreme.t: 单孔目哺乳动物，如鸭嘴兽

e.en: The platypus is a famous {monotreme} from Australia.
e.zh: 鸭嘴兽是澳大利亚著名的单孔目哺乳动物。

e.en: A {monotreme} lays eggs but still feeds its young with milk.
e.zh: 单孔目动物会产卵，但仍用乳汁哺育幼崽。

e.en: The bacterium was described as {monotrichate} in the lab report.
e.zh: 实验报告把这种细菌描述为具单根鞭毛。

e.en: A {monotrichate} cell moves using one flagellum.
e.zh: 具单根鞭毛的细胞依靠一根鞭毛运动。

e.en: The culture contained mostly {monotrichic} bacteria.
e.zh: 培养物中主要是具单根鞭毛的细菌。

e.en: Its {monotrichic} form helped distinguish it from related species.
e.zh: 它的单毛形态有助于将其同近缘物种区分开来。

e.en: A {monotrichous} bacterium has one flagellum at one end.
e.zh: 单鞭毛细菌在一端有一根鞭毛。

e.en: The microscope image showed a {monotrichous} organism clearly.
e.zh: 显微镜图像清楚显示出一个具单毛的生物体。

monotron.t: 单腔电子管；单音电子乐器

e.en: The old radio used a {monotron} in its circuit.
e.zh: 这台老收音机的电路中使用了单腔电子管。

e.en: She recorded a bass line on a small {monotron}.
e.zh: 她用一台小型单音电子乐器录制了低音线。

monotrophic.t: 单一营养来源的；单食性的

e.en: The parasite is {monotrophic} and depends on one host species.
e.zh: 这种寄生物是单食性的，依赖一种宿主物种。

e.en: A {monotrophic} diet can make the insect vulnerable when that plant declines.
e.zh: 单一食源会让这种昆虫在那种植物减少时变得脆弱。

e.en: The chemist explained {monotropy} in the crystal forms.
e.zh: 化学家解释了这些晶型中的单变性。

e.en: Early attachment theory used {monotropy} to describe one primary bond.
e.zh: 早期依恋理论用单一取向性来描述一种主要情感纽带。

e.en: The car uses a {monotube} shock absorber for better cooling.
e.zh: 这辆车使用单筒减震器以获得更好的散热效果。

e.en: A {monotube} boiler design has one main tube.
e.zh: 单管式锅炉设计只有一根主管。

montbretia.t: 檐子花；姬唐菖蒲属植物色

e.en: The gardener planted {montbretia} along the sunny wall.
e.zh: 园丁沿着向阳的墙边种下了檐子花。

e.en: Orange {montbretia} brightened the late summer border.
e.zh: 橙色的檐子花让夏末的花境明亮起来。

e.en: He wore a black {montera} at the festival.
e.zh: 他在节日上戴着一顶黑色西班牙猎帽。

e.en: The matador adjusted his {montera} before entering the ring.
e.zh: 斗牛士进场前整理了一下自己的斗牛士帽。

e.en: They began a {monthlong} renovation of the old library.
e.zh: 他们开始对那座旧图书馆进行为期一个月的翻修。

e.en: The scandal led to a {monthlong} investigation.
e.zh: 这起丑闻引发了一场持续一个月的调查。

e.en: A small {monticle} rose beside the path.
e.zh: 小路旁隆起了一座小山丘。

e.en: The ants built a sandy {monticle} near the roots.
e.zh: 蚂蚁在树根附近筑起一个沙质小土堆。

e.en: The shell had a {monticulate} surface under the lens.
e.zh: 在镜头下，那枚贝壳表面呈小丘状隆起。

e.en: Geologists described the lava field as {monticulate}.
e.zh: 地质学家把那片熔岩地描述为布满小丘状隆起。

e.en: The ruined wall ended at a grassy {monticule}.
e.zh: 残破的墙在一个长满草的小丘处终止。

e.en: A {monticule} of ash remained after the fire.
e.zh: 火熄灭后只剩下一小堆灰烬。

e.en: They crossed a {monticulous} stretch of countryside.
e.zh: 他们穿过一片多小丘的乡间地带。

e.en: The map showed a {monticulous} island coastline.
e.zh: 地图显示那座岛的海岸遍布小山。

e.en: The sample contained swelling {montmorillonite} clay.
e.zh: 这个样本含有会膨胀的蒙脱石黏土。

e.en: Engineers tested the soil for {montmorillonite} before construction.
e.zh: 工程师在施工前检测土壤中是否含有蒙脱石。

montmorillonitic.t: 含蒙脱石的；蒙脱石质的

e.en: The drilling team found {montmorillonitic} clay below the sand.
e.zh: 钻探队在沙层下发现了含蒙脱石的黏土。

e.en: A {montmorillonitic} soil can expand after heavy rain.
e.zh: 蒙脱石质土壤在大雨后可能会膨胀。

e.en: The report classified the mineral as a {montmorillonoid}.
e.zh: 报告把这种矿物归为蒙脱石类黏土矿物。

e.en: Water changes the structure of many {montmorillonoid} clays.
e.zh: 水会改变许多蒙脱石类黏土的结构。

montrealite.t: 蒙特利尔人；蒙特利尔矿物

e.en: As a {montrealite}, she knew the winter routes well.
e.zh: 作为蒙特利尔人，她很熟悉冬季出行路线。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare sample of {montrealite}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块罕见的蒙特利尔矿物标本。

montuno.t: 古巴音乐反复段；乡村风的

e.en: The pianist locked into a bright {montuno} pattern.
e.zh: 钢琴手弹出一段明亮的古巴音乐反复节奏。

e.en: The song shifted into a lively {montuno} near the end.
e.zh: 歌曲接近尾声时转入了活泼的蒙图诺段落。

e.en: The jeweler repaired the gold {monture} around the stone.
e.zh: 珠宝匠修好了宝石周围的金质镶嵌框架。

e.en: A delicate {monture} held the old porcelain miniature.
e.zh: 一个精巧的托座固定着那件旧瓷质微型饰物。

monumentalism.t: 纪念碑主义；宏伟建筑风格

e.en: The capital's squares reflect a taste for {monumentalism}.
e.zh: 首都的广场体现出一种偏爱纪念碑主义的审美。

e.en: Critics saw cold {monumentalism} in the new government complex.
e.zh: 批评者认为新的政府建筑群带有冷峻的宏伟建筑风格。

moon-faced.t: 脸圆得像满月的；圆脸的

e.en: The {moon-faced} child smiled from the doorway.
e.zh: 那个圆脸孩子在门口笑了。

e.en: A {moon-faced} clown appeared in the old poster.
e.zh: 旧海报上出现了一个满月脸的小丑。

e.en: The first {moon-landing} changed space history.
e.zh: 首次登月改变了太空史。

e.en: They watched a film about the {moon-landing}.
e.zh: 他们看了一部关于月球着陆的电影。

e.en: The astronaut checked his {moon-suit} before launch.
e.zh: 宇航员在发射前检查了登月服。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {moon-suit}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件旧月球宇航服。

moonball.t: 高弧线球；月亮般的球体

e.en: She hit a deep {moonball} over the baseline.
e.zh: 她打出一个越过底线的高弧线球。

e.en: The lamp looked like a glowing {moonball}.
e.zh: 那盏灯看起来像一颗发光的月亮球。

moonballing.t: 打高弧线球；连续吊高球

e.en: He kept {moonballing} until his opponent lost patience.
e.zh: 他一直打高弧线球，直到对手失去耐心。

e.en: Her {moonballing} slowed the match to a crawl.
e.zh: 她连续吊高球，让比赛节奏慢得厉害。

e.en: The novel imagines a crowded {moonbase}.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了一个拥挤的月球基地。

e.en: Engineers tested supplies for a future {moonbase}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了未来月球基地所需的补给。

e.en: A pale {moonbow} formed above the waterfall.
e.zh: 一道淡淡的月虹出现在瀑布上方。

e.en: We waited at night to photograph the {moonbow}.
e.zh: 我们夜里等待拍摄月光彩虹。

e.en: She brought a box of {mooncakes} to work.
e.zh: 她带了一盒月饼去上班。

e.en: This {mooncake} has a sweet lotus filling.
e.zh: 这个月饼有甜甜的莲蓉馅。

e.en: Don't stand there like a {mooncalf}.
e.zh: 别像个呆子一样站在那里。

e.en: Old farmers used {mooncalf} for a malformed birth.
e.zh: 老农曾用mooncalf指畸形出生的胎儿。

e.en: The {mooncraft} descended toward the dusty plain.
e.zh: 月球飞船向尘土覆盖的平原下降。

e.en: Children built a cardboard {mooncraft} for the play.
e.zh: 孩子们为演出做了一艘纸板登月飞船。

moondoggle.t: 耗资巨大却无用的登月项目

e.en: Critics called the program a costly {moondoggle}.
e.zh: 批评者称这个计划是耗资巨大的无用登月项目。

e.en: The senator attacked the mission as a {moondoggle}.
e.zh: 那位参议员抨击这次任务是浪费钱的登月工程。

e.en: We reached camp just before {moondown}.
e.zh: 我们在月落前刚好到达营地。

e.en: The beach grew darker after {moondown}.
e.zh: 月亮落下后，海滩变得更暗了。

e.en: The angler released a small {mooneye}.
e.zh: 钓鱼的人放走了一条小月眼鱼。

e.en: A {mooneye} flashed silver in the river.
e.zh: 一条月眼鱼在河里闪着银光。

e.en: A {moonfaced} baby stared at the camera.
e.zh: 一个圆脸婴儿盯着相机看。

e.en: The actor played a shy, {moonfaced} clerk.
e.zh: 那名演员饰演一个害羞的圆脸店员。

e.en: They walked home under the quiet {moonfall}.
e.zh: 他们在静静洒下的月光中走回家。

e.en: The poem describes {moonfall} over the fields.
e.zh: 这首诗描写月落时田野上的景象。

e.en: The market sold fresh {moonfish} that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上市集卖新鲜月鱼。

e.en: A large {moonfish} drifted near the reef.
e.zh: 一条大月鱼在礁石附近缓缓游动。

e.en: The book follows a dangerous {moonflight}.
e.zh: 这本书讲述了一次危险的登月飞行。

e.en: Her lecture covered the first crewed {moonflight}.
e.zh: 她的讲座讲到了首次载人飞往月球。

moonhead.t: 圆头的人；笨头笨脑的人

e.en: The cartoon gave every guard a huge {moonhead}.
e.zh: 那部漫画把每个守卫都画成大圆头。

e.en: He called himself a {moonhead} after the mistake.
e.zh: 犯错后，他自嘲是个笨头笨脑的人。

e.en: She stared {moonily} at the singer on stage.
e.zh: 她痴痴地望着台上的歌手。

e.en: He smiled {moonily} and forgot the question.
e.zh: 他恍惚地笑了笑，忘了那个问题。

e.en: The lake had a cold, {moonish} glow.
e.zh: 湖面泛着一种清冷似月的光。

e.en: He wrote her a {moonish} little poem.
e.zh: 他给她写了一首多情恍惚的小诗。

e.en: The room shone {moonishly} in the blue light.
e.zh: 房间在蓝光中像月色般发亮。

e.en: He gazed {moonishly} at her photograph.
e.zh: 他痴痴地望着她的照片。

e.en: Her face looked pale and {moonlike}.
e.zh: 她的脸显得苍白，像月亮一样。

e.en: The stone gave off a soft, {moonlike} shine.
e.zh: 那块石头散发出柔和的月亮般光泽。

moonpath.t: 水面月光路；月光映成的带

e.en: A silver {moonpath} crossed the dark sea.
e.zh: 一道银色月光路横过黑暗的海面。

e.en: They followed the {moonpath} along the river.
e.zh: 他们沿着河面月光映出的光带前行。

e.en: The story begins in a busy {moonport}.
e.zh: 故事从一个繁忙的月球港开始。

e.en: Engineers designed a {moonport} for reusable rockets.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一座供可重复使用火箭使用的登月航天港。

e.en: The path crossed a {moory} stretch of open land.
e.zh: 小路穿过一片沼泽般的开阔地。

e.en: Mist hung over the {moory} hills at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时薄雾笼罩着多沼泽的山丘。

e.en: A {moosebird} landed near the campfire looking for crumbs.
e.zh: 一只灰噪鸦落在篝火旁寻找碎屑。

e.en: The guide called the bold jay a {moosebird}.
e.zh: 向导把那只大胆的松鸦叫作加拿大松鸦。

e.en: Young {moosewood} grew along the shaded stream.
e.zh: 阴凉的小溪边长着年轻的条纹槭。

e.en: The handle was carved from pale {moosewood}.
e.zh: 这个把手是用浅色条纹槭木雕成的。

e.en: The overcooked vegetables turned into {moosh}.
e.zh: 煮过头的蔬菜变成了一团软糊。

e.en: After the rain, the path was all {moosh} underfoot.
e.zh: 雨后小路踩上去全是泥糊糊的。

e.en: Whether the rule applies here is {mootable}.
e.zh: 这条规则是否适用于这里是可以争论的。

e.en: The proposal remains {mootable} until the board votes.
e.zh: 在董事会投票前，这项提议仍可讨论。

e.en: A {mop-headed} boy answered the door in pajamas.
e.zh: 一个头发像拖把般蓬乱的男孩穿着睡衣来开门。

e.en: The guitarist looked proudly {mop-headed} on stage.
e.zh: 那名吉他手在台上顶着一头蓬乱长发，显得很得意。

e.en: Crews began the {mop-up} after the storm passed.
e.zh: 风暴过去后，工作人员开始收尾清理。

e.en: The army launched a final {mop-up} operation.
e.zh: 军队发动了最后一次扫尾行动。

e.en: Dust collected along the old wooden {mopboard}.
e.zh: 灰尘积在旧木质踢脚板边上。

e.en: She painted the {mopboard} white to match the trim.
e.zh: 她把墙脚板刷成白色，以配合装饰线条。

e.en: His weekend {mopery} worried his friends.
e.zh: 他周末那副没精打采的样子让朋友们担心。

e.en: The charge was vague, something like public {mopery}.
e.zh: 指控很含糊，大概像是在公共场所游荡闲混。

mopey.t: 闷闷不乐的；无精打采的

e.en: She felt {mopey} after the long rainy week.
e.zh: 连着下了一周雨后，她感到闷闷不乐。

e.en: Don't sit there looking {mopey}; come join us.
e.zh: 别坐在那里一副无精打采的样子，过来加入我们吧。

e.en: Replace the dirty {mophead} before cleaning the kitchen.
e.zh: 打扫厨房前先换掉脏拖把头。

e.en: The little {mophead} grinned through his curls.
e.zh: 那个满头乱发的小家伙从卷发间咧嘴笑了。

e.en: He grew {mopish} during the dark winter months.
e.zh: 在阴暗的冬季里，他变得忧郁没精神。

e.en: Her {mopish} reply made the room feel colder.
e.zh: 她那句有气无力的回答让房间显得更冷清。

e.en: He stared {mopishly} out of the window.
e.zh: 他忧郁地望着窗外。

e.en: She answered {mopishly}, barely lifting her head.
e.zh: 她没精打采地回答，几乎没有抬头。

e.en: A {mopoke} called from the gum trees at night.
e.zh: 夜里，一只澳洲鹰鸮在桉树间鸣叫。

e.en: The lonely {mopoke} sounded across the paddock.
e.zh: 那声孤零零的鹰鸮叫声传过牧场。

e.en: The choir ended with a lively {moppie}.
e.zh: 合唱团最后唱了一首活泼的南非荷兰语民歌。

e.en: He learned a comic {moppie} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里学会了一首滑稽的南非民歌。

e.en: The {mopping-up} work continued late into the night.
e.zh: 收尾清理工作一直持续到深夜。

e.en: Several {mopping-up} patrols searched the area.
e.zh: 几支扫尾巡逻队搜查了这个地区。

e.en: His {moppy} hair covered half his eyes.
e.zh: 他乱蓬蓬的头发遮住了半只眼睛。

e.en: The dog shook its {moppy} coat after the bath.
e.zh: 洗完澡后，那只狗甩了甩像拖把一样的毛。

e.en: The old {mopstick} snapped under pressure.
e.zh: 那根旧拖把柄受力后断了。

e.en: She leaned the {mopstick} against the back door.
e.zh: 她把拖把杆靠在后门旁。

e.en: He felt like a {mopus} after dropping the tray.
e.zh: 他把托盘掉了以后，觉得自己像个笨蛋。

e.en: The comic played a lovable {mopus} in the film.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员在片中扮演了一个可爱的迟钝人物。

e.en: The child became {mopy} when the party ended.
e.zh: 派对结束时，孩子变得闷闷不乐。

e.en: A {mopy} silence settled over the table.
e.zh: 一种消沉的沉默笼罩了整张餐桌。

e.en: The train seats were covered in red {moquette}.
e.zh: 火车座椅包着红色厚绒织物。

e.en: Vintage buses often used patterned {moquette} inside.
e.zh: 老式公交车内部常使用带图案的绒面座椅布。

e.en: The botanist described the tree as {moraceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这棵树描述为桑科植物。

e.en: Its {moraceous} fruit resembled a small mulberry.
e.zh: 它那似桑的果实像一颗小桑葚。

e.en: Scientists recorded a small {moonquake} during the mission.
e.zh: 科学家在任务期间记录到一次小型月震。

e.en: A strong {moonquake} could damage equipment on the lunar surface.
e.zh: 强烈的月震可能会损坏月球表面的设备。

e.en: The villagers laughed at the old {moonraker} by the pond.
e.zh: 村民们嘲笑池塘边那个老糊涂虫。

e.en: He called himself a proud {moonraker} from Wiltshire.
e.zh: 他自称是来自威尔特郡的骄傲本地人。

e.en: Their plan sounded like pure {moonraking} to the investors.
e.zh: 在投资者听来，他们的计划完全像荒唐空想。

e.en: The children were {moonraking} in the pond with long sticks.
e.zh: 孩子们拿着长棍在池塘里像捞月一样玩。

e.en: A {moonrat} looks more like a hedgehog than a rat.
e.zh: 月鼠看起来更像刺猬，而不像老鼠。

e.en: The zoo kept a shy {moonrat} in a quiet enclosure.
e.zh: 动物园把一只胆小的月鼠养在安静的围栏里。

e.en: The museum displayed a tiny piece of {moonrock}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一小块月岩。

e.en: The dealer claimed the {moonrock} was extremely strong cannabis.
e.zh: 卖家声称这种月岩是药效很强的大麻制品。

e.en: The designer sketched a silver {moonsail} for the spacecraft.
e.zh: 设计师为航天器画了一张银色的月光帆草图。

e.en: Their poem imagined a {moonsail} crossing the night sky.
e.zh: 他们的诗想象一面月帆划过夜空。

e.en: He adjusted the {moonscope} to study the crater.
e.zh: 他调好观月镜来观察那座环形山。

e.en: The old {moonscope} stood beside the attic window.
e.zh: 那架旧月球望远镜立在阁楼窗边。

e.en: The vine was identified as {moonseed} by the botanist.
e.zh: 植物学家认出那条藤是月籽藤。

e.en: Never eat {moonseed} berries from the wild garden.
e.zh: 千万不要吃野花园里的月籽藤果实。

e.en: We reached the ridge just before {moonset}.
e.zh: 我们在月落前刚好到达山脊。

e.en: The fishermen waited for {moonset} before leaving shore.
e.zh: 渔民等到月亮落下后才离岸出发。

e.en: The lake looked {moonshiny} after the clouds moved away.
e.zh: 云散以后，湖面显得月光般明亮。

e.en: She wore a {moonshiny} dress to the midnight party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条闪着月光般光泽的裙子去午夜派对。

e.en: The novel begins with a {moonship} leaving Earth.
e.zh: 这部小说以一艘月球飞船离开地球开篇。

e.en: Engineers tested the {moonship} in a desert facility.
e.zh: 工程师在沙漠设施中测试登月船。

e.en: He became {moonstruck} after one evening with her.
e.zh: 和她共度一晚后，他就变得痴情得不行。

e.en: The crowd seemed {moonstruck} under the bright full moon.
e.zh: 在人群明亮的满月下，大家似乎都恍惚入迷。

e.en: The rocket began its {moonward} journey at dawn.
e.zh: 火箭在黎明时开始了奔向月球的旅程。

e.en: She lifted her face {moonward} and closed her eyes.
e.zh: 她把脸朝向月亮，闭上了眼睛。

e.en: The probe drifted {moonwards} after the final engine burn.
e.zh: 最后一次发动机点火后，探测器向月球漂去。

e.en: The child pointed {moonwards} from the dark balcony.
e.zh: 孩子从黑暗的阳台上指向月亮。

e.en: Every serious {moonwatcher} knew the eclipse schedule.
e.zh: 每个认真的观月者都知道月食的时间表。

e.en: The young {moonwatcher} kept notes on each lunar phase.
e.zh: 那位年轻的月相观察员记录每一个月相。

e.en: The marina charges extra for winter {moorage}.
e.zh: 码头会额外收取冬季停泊费。

e.en: We found safe {moorage} behind the breakwater.
e.zh: 我们在防波堤后找到了安全的停泊处。

e.en: A lonely {moorbird} called across the heather.
e.zh: 一只孤零零的荒原鸟在石南丛间鸣叫。

e.en: The guide identified the dark {moorbird} near the marsh.
e.zh: 向导认出了沼泽旁那只深色的荒原鸟。

e.en: A {moorcock} burst from the heather with a sharp cry.
e.zh: 一只雄赤松鸡尖叫着从石南丛中冲出。

e.en: Hunters once prized the {moorcock} on northern estates.
e.zh: 过去猎人很看重北方庄园里的雄赤松鸡。

e.en: The chef prepared {moorfowl} with herbs and berries.
e.zh: 厨师用香草和浆果烹制荒原猎鸟。

e.en: Several {moorfowl} scattered when the dogs approached.
e.zh: 狗靠近时，几只松鸡四散飞开。

e.en: The estate was famous for its abundant {moorgame}.
e.zh: 这座庄园因荒原猎禽丰富而出名。

e.en: Strict rules limited the shooting of {moorgame}.
e.zh: 严格规定限制了对荒原猎禽的射猎。

e.en: The sailor tightened the {mooring-rope} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前，水手拉紧了系泊绳。

e.en: A frayed {mooring-rope} snapped during the night.
e.zh: 一根磨损的缆绳在夜里断了。

e.en: They rested beside a weathered {moorstone} on the hill.
e.zh: 他们在山上一块风化的荒原石旁休息。

e.en: The path was marked by a single {moorstone}.
e.zh: 小路由一块孤零零的荒原石作标记。

e.en: The botanist found {moorwort} growing in the wet hollow.
e.zh: 植物学家发现沼泽草本植物长在潮湿的洼地里。

e.en: Old guides list {moorwort} among common bog plants.
e.zh: 旧指南把moorwort列为常见沼泽植物之一。

e.en: The coach gave a {morale-boosting} speech before the final.
e.zh: 决赛前，教练发表了一场鼓舞士气的讲话。

e.en: Small bonuses can be {morale-boosting} during a difficult project.
e.zh: 在艰难项目期间，小额奖金也能起到鼓舞士气的作用。

e.en: The novel resists easy {moralisation} of its characters.
e.zh: 这部小说避免对人物作简单的道德化阐释。

e.en: His speech turned into a long {moralisation} about modern youth.
e.zh: 他的演讲变成了一大段关于现代青年的说教。

moralistically.t: 以说教口吻；道德主义地

e.en: She spoke {moralistically} about other people's choices.
e.zh: 她以说教的口吻谈论别人的选择。

e.en: The article treats poverty {moralistically}, not politically.
e.zh: 这篇文章用道德主义方式看待贫困，而不是从政治角度分析。

e.en: The debate suffered from too much {moralization} and too little evidence.
e.zh: 这场辩论说教太多，证据太少。

e.en: Her analysis avoided the simple {moralization} of economic failure.
e.zh: 她的分析避免了对经济失败作简单的道德化解释。

e.en: The villain is portrayed as a {moralless} opportunist.
e.zh: 这个反派被描写成一个毫无道德观念的投机者。

e.en: They feared a {moralless} market ruled only by profit.
e.zh: 他们担心市场会变得只受利润支配、毫无道德约束。

e.en: The horses struggled through the {morassy} field.
e.zh: 马群艰难地穿过那片泥泞的田地。

e.en: The case became a {morassy} tangle of claims and counterclaims.
e.zh: 这个案子变成了一团沼泽般复杂的索赔与反诉。

e.en: The old recipe describes {morat} made with mulberries and honey.
e.zh: 这份老食谱记载了用桑葚和蜂蜜酿成的桑葚蜜酒。

e.en: They served a small cup of {morat} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，他们端上了一小杯桑葚蜜酒。

e.en: Several countries announced {moratoria} on deep-sea mining.
e.zh: 几个国家宣布暂停深海采矿。

e.en: The bank offered debt {moratoria} after the disaster.
e.zh: 灾后，银行提供了债务延期偿付安排。

e.en: The court approved a {moratory} period for the bankrupt firm.
e.zh: 法院批准这家破产公司进入延期偿付期。

e.en: A {moratory} law temporarily stopped new evictions.
e.zh: 一项暂停性法律暂时停止了新的驱逐行动。

e.en: Her research focuses on {Moravianism} in eighteenth-century Europe.
e.zh: 她的研究集中于十八世纪欧洲的摩拉维亚派教义。

e.en: The diary shows how {Moravianism} shaped his daily worship.
e.zh: 这本日记显示摩拉维亚派信仰如何影响他的日常礼拜。

e.en: They believed the swamp air had a {morbific} influence.
e.zh: 他们认为沼泽空气有致病作用。

e.en: The doctor rejected the old theory of {morbific} vapors.
e.zh: 医生否定了那种关于致病蒸气的旧理论。

e.en: The text describes a {morbifical} agent spreading through the town.
e.zh: 文本描述了一种致病因素在镇上扩散。

e.en: Such {morbifical} conditions were common in crowded prisons.
e.zh: 这种致病环境在拥挤的监狱里很常见。

e.en: Older medical books often call measles {morbilli}.
e.zh: 较旧的医学书籍常把麻疹称为morbilli。

e.en: The physician noted symptoms consistent with {morbilli}.
e.zh: 医生记录了与麻疹相符的症状。

e.en: The patient developed a {morbilliform} rash after taking the drug.
e.zh: 患者服药后出现了麻疹样皮疹。

e.en: Doctors described the eruption as {morbilliform} rather than blistering.
e.zh: 医生把这种疹子描述为麻疹样，而不是起水疱。

e.en: In Latin diagnoses, {morbus} simply means disease.
e.zh: 在拉丁文诊断中，morbus只是表示疾病。

e.en: The old chart listed {morbus} cordis as the cause of death.
e.zh: 旧病历把心脏病列为死因。

e.en: The pianist ended with a delicate {morceau} by Fauré.
e.zh: 钢琴家最后演奏了一首福雷的精致短曲。

e.en: The essay is a charming literary {morceau}.
e.zh: 这篇文章是一篇迷人的文学小品。

e.en: The program included three graceful {morceaux} for violin.
e.zh: 节目包括三首优雅的小提琴短曲。

e.en: Her book collects brief {morceaux} on travel and memory.
e.zh: 她的书收录了关于旅行与记忆的短篇小品。

e.en: He saved every {morcel} of bread from the meal.
e.zh: 他把饭后剩下的每一小块面包都留了下来。

e.en: The archive preserves each {morcel} of the damaged manuscript.
e.zh: 档案馆保存了受损手稿的每一个片段。

e.en: Surgeons may {morcellate} tissue before removing it laparoscopically.
e.zh: 外科医生可能会先把组织切成小块，再通过腹腔镜取出。

e.en: The machine can {morcellate} large samples for analysis.
e.zh: 这台机器可以把大样本切成小块以便分析。

e.en: The tapas bar served grilled {morcilla} with peppers.
e.zh: 这家小吃酒吧供应配辣椒的烤西班牙血肠。

e.en: She added slices of {morcilla} to the bean stew.
e.zh: 她把几片西班牙血肠加进豆子炖菜里。

e.en: Her {mordacious} review wounded the young poet deeply.
e.zh: 她那篇尖酸的评论深深刺痛了这位年轻诗人。

e.en: The essay kept a {mordacious} tone throughout.
e.zh: 这篇文章从头到尾都带着讥刺的语气。

e.en: He smiled and answered {mordaciously} during the debate.
e.zh: 辩论中他笑着尖酸地作答。

e.en: The critic wrote {mordaciously} about the failed production.
e.zh: 那位评论家以讥刺的笔调写了这场失败的演出。

e.en: The speech was remembered for its unusual {mordacity}.
e.zh: 那场演讲因罕见的尖酸刻薄而被人记住。

e.en: His jokes had a {mordacity} that made guests uneasy.
e.zh: 他的笑话带着辛辣讥刺，让客人们不自在。

e.en: The novel treats politics with dry {mordancy}.
e.zh: 这部小说以冷峻的辛辣讽刺描写政治。

e.en: There was real {mordancy} in her quiet reply.
e.zh: 她平静的回答里确实有一种尖刻意味。

e.en: The pianist played the {mordent} with crisp precision.
e.zh: 钢琴家把这个波音弹得清晰而准确。

e.en: A small sign above the note marks a {mordent}.
e.zh: 音符上方的小记号表示一个装饰音。

e.en: The old curtains were made of green {moreen}.
e.zh: 那些旧窗帘是用绿色波纹呢做的。

e.en: She found a bolt of {moreen} in the storeroom.
e.zh: 她在储藏室里找到一卷厚毛织物。

e.en: The plan was costly and, {moreever}, poorly explained.
e.zh: 这个计划成本高，而且解释得也不清楚。

e.en: He was tired; {moreever}, the road was unsafe.
e.zh: 他已经很累了，此外那条路也不安全。

e.en: These roasted nuts are dangerously {moreish}.
e.zh: 这些烤坚果好吃得让人停不下来。

e.en: The sauce is rich, salty, and very {moreish}.
e.zh: 这种酱味道浓郁偏咸，很让人想再吃。

e.en: The baker filled the tart with {morello} cherries.
e.zh: 烘焙师在果挞里填满了酸樱桃。

e.en: A spoonful of {morello} jam brightened the dessert.
e.zh: 一勺黑樱桃果酱让这道甜点更出彩。

e.en: The final phrase should fade {morendo} into silence.
e.zh: 最后一个乐句应渐弱渐慢，融入寂静。

e.en: The conductor marked the ending {morendo} in red pencil.
e.zh: 指挥用红铅笔把结尾标成渐弱渐慢。

e.en: We heard a {morepork} calling after dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏后我们听见一只新西兰鹰鸮在叫。

e.en: The {morepork} is a small native owl of New Zealand.
e.zh: 新西兰鹰鸮是新西兰本土的一种小型猫头鹰。

morganatic.t: 贵贱通婚的；不传爵位的

e.en: The prince entered a {morganatic} marriage with a commoner.
e.zh: 王子与一名平民缔结了贵贱通婚。

e.en: Children from a {morganatic} union could not inherit the throne.
e.zh: 贵贱通婚所生的子女不能继承王位。

e.en: He married {morganatically}, forfeiting claims for his heirs.
e.zh: 他以贵贱通婚方式成婚，使继承人失去相关权利。

e.en: The duke was said to have wed {morganatically} abroad.
e.zh: 据说那位公爵在国外以贵贱通婚方式结婚。

e.en: Her ring held a pale pink {morganite}.
e.zh: 她的戒指上镶着一颗浅粉色摩根石。

e.en: The jeweler compared {morganite} with rose quartz.
e.zh: 珠宝商把摩根石和粉晶作了比较。

monumentalize.t: 使具有纪念碑般意义或规模

e.en: The museum tried to {monumentalize} the poet's modest desk.
e.zh: 博物馆试图把诗人那张朴素的书桌赋予纪念碑般的意义。

e.en: His speech seemed to {monumentalize} a routine policy change.
e.zh: 他的演讲像是在把一项普通政策变动说成重大历史事件。

monumentalized.t: 被赋予纪念碑般意义的

e.en: The battle was {monumentalized} in stone and bronze.
e.zh: 那场战役被用石头和青铜塑造成纪念碑式的记忆。

e.en: A simple family story became {monumentalized} in the film.
e.zh: 一个简单的家族故事在电影中被赋予了宏大的意义。

e.en: The statue {monumentalizes} a moment of public grief.
e.zh: 这座雕像把一个公众悲痛的时刻纪念碑化了。

e.en: The novel {monumentalizes} ordinary labor without making it sentimental.
e.zh: 这部小说把普通劳动写得庄重宏大，却没有流于煽情。

monumentalizing.t: 正在赋予纪念碑般意义

e.en: The documentary is {monumentalizing} a forgotten strike.
e.zh: 这部纪录片正在把一场被遗忘的罢工塑造成重要历史记忆。

e.en: Critics accused him of {monumentalizing} his own career.
e.zh: 批评者指责他把自己的职业生涯过度神圣化。

e.en: The old report listed {monuron} among the tested herbicides.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把灭草隆列入受测试的除草剂之中。

e.en: Farmers later stopped using {monuron} on that field.
e.zh: 农民后来停止在那块田里使用灭草隆。

e.en: The ridge contains coarse-grained {monzonite}.
e.zh: 那道山脊含有粗粒二长岩。

e.en: Geologists identified the sample as {monzonite} rather than granite.
e.zh: 地质学家认定这个样本是二长岩，而不是花岗岩。

e.en: The toddler pointed at the {moo-cow} in the field.
e.zh: 那个幼儿指着田里的哞哞牛。

e.en: Grandma bought a soft {moo-cow} toy for the baby.
e.zh: 奶奶给宝宝买了一个软软的哞哞牛玩具。

e.en: The child laughed at the cow's {moo-moo}.
e.zh: 孩子听到牛的哞哞叫声笑了起来。

e.en: She wore a bright {moo-moo} around the house.
e.zh: 她在家里穿着一件鲜艳的宽松长袍。

e.en: He joked nervously about his {moobs} at the gym.
e.zh: 他在健身房紧张地拿自己的男胸开玩笑。

e.en: The article discussed surgery for severe {moobs}.
e.zh: 那篇文章讨论了严重男性胸部赘肉的手术治疗。

moochin.t: 闲逛；蹭吃蹭喝的非正式写法

e.en: He was {moochin} around town all afternoon.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在城里闲逛。

e.en: She said her cousin was {moochin} meals again.
e.zh: 她说她表亲又在蹭饭了。

e.en: The doctor warned him about {mood-altering} drugs.
e.zh: 医生提醒他注意会改变情绪的药物。

e.en: Music can be a powerful {mood-altering} force.
e.zh: 音乐可能是一种强大的情绪调节力量。

e.en: The toy made a soft {mooey} sound.
e.zh: 那个玩具发出柔和的哞哞声。

e.en: Her silly {mooey} voice made the baby smile.
e.zh: 她那种傻乎乎的哞哞腔逗得宝宝笑了。

e.en: The hero knocked out a nameless {mook}.
e.zh: 英雄打倒了一个无名小喽啰。

e.en: Don't be such a {mook} about money.
e.zh: 别在钱的事上这么蠢。

e.en: They need more {moola} to finish the project.
e.zh: 他们需要更多钱才能完成这个项目。

e.en: He spent all his {moola} on concert tickets.
e.zh: 他把所有钞票都花在演唱会门票上了。

e.en: She grated fresh {mooli} into the salad.
e.zh: 她把新鲜白萝卜擦丝拌进沙拉里。

e.en: The curry came with pickled {mooli} on the side.
e.zh: 这道咖喱旁边配了腌白萝卜。

e.en: We spent every bit of {moollah} on repairs.
e.zh: 我们把所有钱都花在维修上了。

e.en: The deal could bring serious {moollah} next year.
e.zh: 这笔交易明年可能带来一大笔钱。

moon-explorer.t: 月球探测器；月球探索者

e.en: The {moon-explorer} sent back clear images of craters.
e.zh: 这台月球探测器传回了清晰的陨石坑图像。

e.en: As a child, she dreamed of becoming a {moon-explorer}.
e.zh: 她小时候梦想成为一名月球探索者。

moon-eyed.t: 痴情恍惚的；大眼呆看的

e.en: He followed her around with a {moon-eyed} smile.
e.zh: 他带着痴情恍惚的笑容跟在她身边。

e.en: The puppy gave us a {moon-eyed} stare.
e.zh: 那只小狗睁着大眼呆呆地望着我们。

morganize.t: 摩尔根单位测定法；基因定位测定法

e.en: The students learned to {morganize} linkage data from fruit-fly crosses.
e.zh: 学生们学习用摩尔根单位处理果蝇杂交的连锁数据。

e.en: Researchers can {morganize} a chromosome map from recombination frequencies.
e.zh: 研究人员可以根据重组频率绘制染色体图谱。

e.en: The jeweler set a polished {morian} into the silver ring.
e.zh: 珠宝匠把一块抛光的黑水晶镶进银戒指里。

e.en: A shard of {morian} caught the candlelight on the shelf.
e.zh: 架子上一片深色石英映出了烛光。

e.en: The report described the factory's {moribundity} after years of losses.
e.zh: 报告描述了那家工厂多年亏损后的衰败状态。

e.en: Signs of {moribundity} appeared in the language as fewer children learned it.
e.zh: 随着学习这种语言的儿童越来越少，它显露出濒临消亡的迹象。

e.en: His constant {morigeration} annoyed colleagues who wanted honest advice.
e.zh: 他一味顺从让想听真话的同事很反感。

e.en: The court rewarded {morigeration} more than independent judgment.
e.zh: 宫廷奖励逢迎，而不是独立判断。

e.en: The vintner planted {morillon} on the cooler slope.
e.zh: 酿酒师在较凉的坡地种下莫里永葡萄。

e.en: An old cabinet displayed a dark {morillon} crystal.
e.zh: 旧柜子里陈列着一块深色烟晶。

morinite.t: 莫林石；稀有磷酸盐矿物

e.en: The museum acquired a small specimen of {morinite} from the mine.
e.zh: 博物馆从矿区获得了一小块莫林石标本。

e.en: Collectors value {morinite} for its rarity and pale color.
e.zh: 收藏者因莫林石稀有且颜色淡雅而看重它。

e.en: The guard wore a crested {morion} during the parade.
e.zh: 卫兵在游行时戴着带脊饰的西班牙式头盔。

e.en: The pendant held a piece of smoky {morion}.
e.zh: 吊坠里嵌着一块烟色黑水晶。

morioplasty.t: 愚钝矫治术；旧称智力矫治

e.en: The obsolete text mentioned {morioplasty} as a proposed treatment.
e.zh: 那本过时的书提到所谓愚钝矫治术是一种治疗方案。

e.en: Modern doctors no longer use the term {morioplasty}.
e.zh: 现代医生已经不再使用“愚钝矫治术”这个术语。

mormonism.t: 摩门教信仰；摩门教体系

e.en: The course examined {Mormonism} in nineteenth-century America.
e.zh: 这门课程研究了十九世纪美国的摩门教。

e.en: She wrote about family life within {Mormonism}.
e.zh: 她写了摩门教信仰中的家庭生活。

e.en: The pamphlet used {Mormonite} for followers of the new movement.
e.zh: 那本小册子用“摩门教徒”称呼这个新运动的追随者。

e.en: A few old newspapers printed {Mormonite} accusations in harsh language.
e.zh: 一些旧报纸用尖刻语言刊登了针对摩门教徒的指控。

e.en: The chef poured {Mornay} over the baked cauliflower.
e.zh: 厨师把奶酪白酱浇在烤花椰菜上。

e.en: She served eggs with a rich {Mornay} sauce.
e.zh: 她端上了配浓郁奶酪白酱的鸡蛋。

e.en: A green {morne} rose behind the village.
e.zh: 村庄后面耸起一座绿色的圆顶小山。

e.en: The trail climbed the volcanic {morne} before sunset.
e.zh: 日落前，小径一直爬上那座火山孤丘。

e.en: She bought a {morning-after} pill from the pharmacy.
e.zh: 她从药店买了一颗事后避孕药。

e.en: He faced the {morning-after} guilt of a foolish argument.
e.zh: 一场愚蠢争吵之后，第二天他满心懊悔。

e.en: Blue {morning-glory} flowers opened along the fence.
e.zh: 蓝色牵牛花沿着篱笆绽开。

e.en: The gardener trained {morning-glory} vines up the trellis.
e.zh: 园丁引导牵牛花藤爬上格架。

e.en: A purple {morningglory} climbed the old gate.
e.zh: 一株紫色牵牛花爬上了旧大门。

e.en: She planted {morningglory} to cover the bare wall.
e.zh: 她种了牵牛花来遮住那面光秃的墙。

e.en: The fishermen launched their boats at {morningtide}.
e.zh: 渔民们在清晨涨潮时把船推下水。

e.en: Mist lay over the fields in the quiet {morningtide}.
e.zh: 宁静的清晨，雾气笼罩着田野。

e.en: The surveyor added a {morograph} to the regional atlas.
e.zh: 测量员把一幅地貌记录图加入了地区地图集。

e.en: A careful {morograph} showed the ridges around the valley.
e.zh: 一幅细致的山形图显示了山谷周围的山脊。

e.en: He {moronically} deleted the only backup file.
e.zh: 他愚蠢地删掉了唯一的备份文件。

e.en: The villain laughed {moronically} at his own plan.
e.zh: 那个反派对着自己的计划傻乎乎地大笑。

e.en: The essay attacked the {moronism} of the policy.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击了那项政策的愚蠢。

e.en: Older medical books used {moronism} as a diagnostic label.
e.zh: 较早的医学书曾把“低能状态”用作诊断标签。

e.en: The essay mocked the politician's {moronity} with unusual cruelty.
e.zh: 那篇文章以异乎寻常的刻薄嘲笑那位政客的愚蠢。

e.en: He used {moronity} as an outdated medical label.
e.zh: 他把moronity当作一种过时的医学称谓来用。

morphactin.t: 形态调节素；植物生长抑制剂

e.en: The lab tested {morphactin} on young bean plants.
e.zh: 实验室在幼豆苗上测试了形态调节素。

e.en: A small dose of {morphactin} altered root growth.
e.zh: 少量形态调节素改变了根部生长。

e.en: Hydra can regenerate by {morphallaxis} after injury.
e.zh: 水螅受伤后可以通过形态重建式再生恢复。

e.en: The lecture compared {morphallaxis} with epimorphic regeneration.
e.zh: 讲座把形态重建式再生与增生式再生作了比较。

morphean.t: 睡梦般的；与睡眠有关的

e.en: A {morphean} silence settled over the room.
e.zh: 一种睡梦般的寂静笼罩了房间。

e.en: The poem's {morphean} images suggest deep sleep.
e.zh: 这首诗中与睡眠有关的意象暗示了沉睡。

e.en: The teacher showed the word's {morphemic} structure.
e.zh: 老师展示了这个词的语素结构。

e.en: Children often gain {morphemic} awareness through reading.
e.zh: 儿童常常通过阅读形成语素意识。

morphemically.t: 从语素角度；按语素方式

e.en: The word is {morphemically} complex but easy to pronounce.
e.zh: 这个词从语素角度看很复杂，但发音容易。

e.en: Students learned to analyze sentences {morphemically}.
e.zh: 学生学会了按语素方式分析句子。

e.en: She specialized in {morphemics} during graduate school.
e.zh: 她读研究生时专攻语素学。

e.en: The article treats {morphemics} as part of morphology.
e.zh: 这篇文章把语素分析视为形态学的一部分。

e.en: The disease caused visible {morphic} changes in the cells.
e.zh: 这种疾病使细胞出现了明显的形态变化。

e.en: Artists explored {morphic} patterns in natural shells.
e.zh: 艺术家研究了天然贝壳中与形状有关的图案。

morphinan.t: 吗啡烷；吗啡类骨架化合物

e.en: The drug contains a {morphinan} chemical skeleton.
e.zh: 这种药物含有吗啡烷化学骨架。

e.en: Researchers synthesized several {morphinan} derivatives.
e.zh: 研究人员合成了几种吗啡烷衍生物。

e.en: Doctors once used {morphinism} for chronic morphine addiction.
e.zh: 医生过去用吗啡成瘾来指长期的吗啡依赖。

e.en: The report described symptoms of severe {morphinism}.
e.zh: 报告描述了严重吗啡中毒的症状。

e.en: The physician chose not to {morphinize} the patient immediately.
e.zh: 医生决定不立刻给病人使用吗啡。

e.en: Old texts sometimes say drugs can {morphinize} pain treatment.
e.zh: 旧文献有时说药物会使疼痛治疗吗啡化。

e.en: The {morphinized} patient slept through the night.
e.zh: 用了吗啡的病人整夜都睡着了。

e.en: The study involved {morphinized} laboratory animals.
e.zh: 这项研究涉及已给用吗啡的实验动物。

e.en: Nineteenth-century doctors wrote anxiously about {morphinomania}.
e.zh: 十九世纪的医生曾忧心忡忡地写到吗啡成瘾癖。

e.en: The novel treats {morphinomania} as both illness and scandal.
e.zh: 这部小说把吗啡狂既写成疾病，也写成丑闻。

e.en: The character is portrayed as a desperate {morphinomaniac}.
e.zh: 这个人物被描写成一个绝望的吗啡成瘾者。

e.en: Old hospital records called him a {morphinomaniac}.
e.zh: 旧医院记录称他为吗啡成瘾者。

e.en: The pamphlet warned families about the {morphiomaniac}.
e.zh: 这本小册子提醒家庭注意吗啡成瘾者。

e.en: He appears in the case notes as a {morphiomaniac}.
e.zh: 他在病例记录中被记为吗啡成瘾者。

e.en: In category theory, a {morphism} connects two objects.
e.zh: 在范畴论中，态射连接两个对象。

e.en: The paper describes a {morphism} between crystal forms.
e.zh: 论文描述了晶体形态之间的一种关系。

morphodite.t: 畸形人；雌雄同体者的旧称

e.en: The insult {morphodite} appears in some dialect writing.
e.zh: morphodite这个侮辱性词语见于一些方言作品。

e.en: Older texts used {morphodite} for a person with mixed sex traits.
e.zh: 旧文本用morphodite指具有混合性征的人。

e.en: A {morphogen} can guide cell development across tissue.
e.zh: 形态发生素能引导组织中细胞的发育。

e.en: The embryo responded to the {morphogen} gradient.
e.zh: 胚胎对形态发生素梯度产生了反应。

morphogenetically.t: 从形态发生角度；形态发生地

e.en: The two embryos differ {morphogenetically} at early stages.
e.zh: 这两个胚胎在早期从形态发生角度看已有差异。

e.en: The cells were {morphogenetically} active during repair.
e.zh: 这些细胞在修复过程中具有形态发生活性。

e.en: The protein has a strong {morphogenic} effect.
e.zh: 这种蛋白具有很强的促形态发生作用。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {morphogenic} signals in the limb bud.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了肢芽中的成形信号图。

e.en: English spelling often reflects {morphographemic} patterns.
e.zh: 英语拼写常常反映语素与字素的对应模式。

e.en: The course introduced {morphographemic} analysis of written words.
e.zh: 这门课介绍了书面词的语素字素对应分析。

e.en: The chemist used {morpholine} as a solvent.
e.zh: 化学家使用吗啉作为溶剂。

e.en: Pure {morpholine} has a sharp amine smell.
e.zh: 纯吗啉有刺鼻的胺类气味。

e.en: The compound includes a {morpholinyl} side chain.
e.zh: 该化合物包含一个吗啉基侧链。

e.en: They compared several {morpholinyl} analogues in the assay.
e.zh: 他们在测定中比较了几种吗啉基类似物。

morphomatics.t: 形态数学；形态学数学方法

e.en: The paper applies {morphomatics} to model shell growth.
e.zh: 这篇论文运用形态数学来模拟贝壳生长。

e.en: Few students encounter {morphomatics} outside specialist biology courses.
e.zh: 很少有学生会在专业生物课程之外接触形态数学。

e.en: The fossils were compared {morphometrically} across several sites.
e.zh: 研究人员按形态测量方法比较了几个地点的化石。

e.en: Two species may look similar but differ {morphometrically}.
e.zh: 两个物种看起来可能相似，但在形态测量上不同。

e.en: Researchers used {morphometrics} to study skull variation.
e.zh: 研究人员用形态测量学研究头骨差异。

e.en: Modern {morphometrics} often relies on digital landmarks.
e.zh: 现代形态测量学常依赖数字化标志点。

e.en: A {morphoneme} can represent alternating sounds in related forms.
e.zh: 形态音位可以表示相关词形中交替出现的语音。

e.en: The analyst proposed one {morphoneme} behind the two pronunciations.
e.zh: 分析者认为这两种发音背后有同一个形态音位。

e.en: The course includes a brief unit on {morphonology}.
e.zh: 这门课包含一个简短的形态音系学单元。

e.en: Historical {morphonology} explains several irregular verb patterns.
e.zh: 历史形态音系学解释了几种不规则动词模式。

e.en: The symbol marks a {morphophoneme} rather than a fixed sound.
e.zh: 这个符号标记的是形态音位，而不是固定语音。

e.en: A single {morphophoneme} may surface differently before vowels.
e.zh: 同一个形态音位在元音前可能有不同表现。

e.en: The dictionary gives a {morphophonemic} transcription of each stem.
e.zh: 这本词典给出每个词干的形态音位转写。

e.en: Children gradually learn {morphophonemic} alternations in plurals.
e.zh: 儿童会逐渐学会复数中的形态音位交替。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on Turkish {morphophonemics}.
e.zh: 她的论文研究土耳其语的形态音位学。

e.en: English spelling sometimes preserves old {morphophonemics}.
e.zh: 英语拼写有时保留了旧的形态音位规律。

e.en: The lecturer treated {morphophonics} as part of word formation.
e.zh: 讲师把形态语音学作为构词研究的一部分。

e.en: Early grammars discussed {morphophonics} under several different names.
e.zh: 早期语法书用几个不同名称讨论形态语音学。

e.en: Russian {morphophonology} includes many consonant alternations.
e.zh: 俄语形态音系学包含许多辅音交替。

e.en: The article links {morphophonology} with patterns of stress.
e.zh: 这篇文章把形态音系学同重音模式联系起来。

e.en: Plant {morphophysiology} examines form together with function.
e.zh: 植物形态生理学把形态和功能结合起来研究。

e.en: The experiment measured {morphophysiology} under drought stress.
e.zh: 实验测量了干旱胁迫下的形态生理特征。

e.en: The larvae undergo several {morphoses} before maturity.
e.zh: 幼虫成熟前会经历几次形态变化。

e.en: The poem describes strange {morphoses} of memory and desire.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了记忆和欲望的奇异变形。

e.en: Cell {morphosis} was visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 在显微镜下可以看到细胞的形态变化。

e.en: The novel traces the {morphosis} of a village into a city.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了村庄变成城市的变化过程。

e.en: Case endings carry important {morphosyntactic} information.
e.zh: 格词尾承载着重要的形态句法信息。

e.en: The parser failed on a rare {morphosyntactic} construction.
e.zh: 解析器在一种罕见的形态句法结构上失败了。

e.en: The book compares the {morphosyntax} of several dialects.
e.zh: 这本书比较了几种方言的形态句法。

e.en: Agreement is a central topic in {morphosyntax}.
e.zh: 一致关系是形态句法学中的核心话题。

e.en: The language has strict {morphotactics} for suffix order.
e.zh: 这种语言对后缀顺序有严格的词素排列规则。

e.en: Learners often master sounds before they grasp {morphotactics}.
e.zh: 学习者通常先掌握语音，再理解词素排列规则。

e.en: The geologist used {morphotectonics} to interpret the valley.
e.zh: 地质学家用形态构造学解释这个山谷。

e.en: River terraces can reveal regional {morphotectonics}.
e.zh: 河流阶地能揭示区域形态构造特征。

e.en: The study examined {morphotropism} in developing plant tissues.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了发育中植物组织的形态趋向性。

e.en: Chemical cues may influence cellular {morphotropism}.
e.zh: 化学信号可能影响细胞的形态趋向性。

e.en: The crystals showed {morphotropy} under changing conditions.
e.zh: 这些晶体在条件变化下表现出形态趋向性。

e.en: Older mineralogy texts discuss {morphotropy} in related compounds.
e.zh: 较早的矿物学著作讨论相关化合物的形态亲和。

e.en: The sailors played {morra} in the tavern.
e.zh: 水手们在酒馆里玩莫拉猜拳游戏。

e.en: In {morra}, players shout numbers while showing fingers.
e.zh: 在莫拉游戏中，玩家一边伸手指一边喊数字。

e.en: He carried bread and cheese in a leather {morral}.
e.zh: 他把面包和奶酪装在皮背袋里。

e.en: The mule's {morral} was filled with grain.
e.zh: 骡子的饲料袋里装满了谷物。

e.en: The physician injected sodium {morrhuate} into the vein.
e.zh: 医生把鳕肝油酸钠注入静脉。

e.en: Older treatments sometimes used {morrhuate} as a sclerosing agent.
e.zh: 旧疗法有时使用鳕肝油酸盐作为硬化剂。

e.en: The {mortarman} adjusted the angle before firing.
e.zh: 迫击炮手在开火前调整了角度。

e.en: A trained {mortarman} must judge distance quickly.
e.zh: 受过训练的迫击炮手必须迅速判断距离。

e.en: The old text described the poison as {mortiferous}.
e.zh: 那本古书把这种毒药描述为致命之物。

e.en: They feared the {mortiferous} air in the sealed chamber.
e.zh: 他们害怕密闭房间里那种会致人死亡的空气。

e.en: The public apology became a painful {mortifier} for the proud mayor.
e.zh: 那次公开道歉成了让这位骄傲市长痛苦受辱的事。

e.en: A medieval {mortifier} might fast for many days.
e.zh: 中世纪的苦修者可能会连续禁食许多天。

e.en: The poem calls every soldier a {mortling} under the moon.
e.zh: 诗中把月光下的每个士兵都称作终将赴死的人。

e.en: In that old dialect, a {mortling} meant a dead body.
e.zh: 在那种古老方言里，mortling指的是一具尸体。

mortmain.t: 永久保有土地；死手占有

e.en: The estate passed into {mortmain} under church control.
e.zh: 这处地产落入教会永久持有之下。

e.en: Reformers attacked {mortmain} because it kept land out of commerce.
e.zh: 改革者抨击永久保有土地制度，因为它使土地脱离交易。

e.en: The embryo reached the {morula} stage after several divisions.
e.zh: 胚胎经过数次分裂后到达桑椹胚阶段。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {morula} looked like a tiny berry.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，桑椹胚看起来像一颗小浆果。

e.en: The lab compared several {morulae} from the same treatment group.
e.zh: 实验室比较了同一处理组中的几个桑椹胚。

e.en: Healthy {morulae} were selected for further observation.
e.zh: 研究人员挑选健康的桑椹胚继续观察。

e.en: The chef grilled a fresh {morwong} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草烤了一条新鲜的澳洲海鱼。

e.en: Divers often see {morwong} near rocky reefs.
e.zh: 潜水者常在岩礁附近看到这种澳洲海鱼。

e.en: The wall was {mosaically} covered with blue and green tiles.
e.zh: 那面墙像马赛克一样铺满了蓝绿瓷砖。

e.en: Her memory returned {mosaically}, in scattered scenes and voices.
e.zh: 她的记忆以拼嵌般的方式恢复，只剩零散场景和声音。

e.en: Genetic {mosaicism} can make diagnosis more difficult.
e.zh: 遗传嵌合现象会让诊断变得更困难。

e.en: The doctor explained that {mosaicism} meant not all cells were affected.
e.zh: 医生解释说，嵌合现象意味着并非所有细胞都受影响。

e.en: The software is {mosaicking} satellite photos into one map.
e.zh: 软件正在把卫星照片拼接成一张地图。

e.en: She learned {mosaicking} to decorate the garden path.
e.zh: 她学会了马赛克拼贴，用来装饰花园小路。

e.en: A huge {mosasaur} once hunted in ancient seas.
e.zh: 一条巨大的沧龙曾在远古海洋中捕猎。

e.en: The museum displayed a {mosasaur} jaw with sharp teeth.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一副长着利齿的沧龙颌骨。

e.en: The fossil showed typical {mosasaurian} features in the skull.
e.zh: 这块化石的头骨显示出典型的沧龙类特征。

e.en: A {mosasaurian} could dominate many marine food chains.
e.zh: 沧龙类动物可能主宰许多海洋食物链。

e.en: The child pointed at the {Mosasaurus} skeleton in the hall.
e.zh: 孩子指着大厅里的沧龙骨架。

e.en: Scientists named {Mosasaurus} from fossils found near the Meuse River.
e.zh: 科学家根据默兹河附近发现的化石命名了沧龙属。

e.en: The old perfume had a warm, {moschate} scent.
e.zh: 那瓶老香水带有温暖的麝香气味。

e.en: A {moschate} note lingered after the flowers were crushed.
e.zh: 花被压碎后，一丝麝香般的气息仍然 lingered。

e.en: We found {moschatel} blooming in the damp woodland.
e.zh: 我们在潮湿林地里发现五福花正在开放。

e.en: The tiny {moschatel} flowers smelled faintly of musk.
e.zh: 小小的五福花散发着淡淡的麝香味。

e.en: A young {Moscovite} guided us through the metro.
e.zh: 一位年轻的莫斯科人带我们穿过地铁。

e.en: The novel captures {Moscovite} life during a harsh winter.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了严冬中的莫斯科生活。

e.en: We watched him {mose} down the lane after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后，我们看着他沿小巷慢吞吞地走。

e.en: Do not {mose} around when the train is about to leave.
e.zh: 火车快开时别还在磨磨蹭蹭。

e.en: The old {moskeneer} knew every current in the northern sea.
e.zh: 那位老捕鲸水手熟悉北方海域的每一道洋流。

e.en: A {moskeneer} wrote the account in rough but vivid English.
e.zh: 一名捕鲸船员用粗糙却生动的英语写下了这段记述。

mosker.t: 沼泽地居民；泥炭地居民

e.en: The old {mosker} knew every safe path across the bog.
e.zh: 那位老沼泽地居民熟悉穿过泥沼的每一条安全小路。

e.en: In the tale, a lonely {mosker} sells peat in winter.
e.zh: 在这个故事里，一个孤独的泥炭地居民冬天卖泥炭。

e.en: The smugglers crossed the inlet in a {mosquito-craft}.
e.zh: 走私者乘一艘小型快艇穿过海湾。

e.en: Several {mosquito-craft} harassed the larger warship at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，几艘蚊式小艇不断骚扰那艘较大的军舰。

e.en: She lowered the {mosquito-curtain} before lighting the lamp.
e.zh: 她点灯前先放下了防蚊帘。

e.en: A torn {mosquito-curtain} left the sleepers covered in bites.
e.zh: 破了的蚊帐帘让睡觉的人被叮得满身是包。

e.en: The village sprayed {mosquitocide} after the heavy rains.
e.zh: 大雨过后，村里喷洒了灭蚊剂。

e.en: Public health officers planned a summer {mosquitocide} campaign.
e.zh: 公共卫生官员计划开展夏季灭蚊行动。

e.en: The campsite was too {mosquitoey} for a comfortable night.
e.zh: 营地蚊子太多，晚上很难睡得舒服。

e.en: A thin, {mosquitoey} whine came from the old speaker.
e.zh: 旧扬声器里传出一种细细的、像蚊子叫的嗡声。

e.en: They released {mosquitofish} into the pond to eat larvae.
e.zh: 他们把食蚊鱼放进池塘里，让它们吃蚊子幼虫。

e.en: The tiny {mosquitofish} can survive in warm shallow water.
e.zh: 这种小小的食蚊鱼能在温暖的浅水中存活。

e.en: We rested beside a {moss-grown} stone wall.
e.zh: 我们在一堵长满苔藓的石墙旁休息。

e.en: He rejected the {moss-grown} rules of the old club.
e.zh: 他拒绝接受那个老俱乐部陈旧过时的规矩。

e.en: A {moss-like} carpet covered the damp forest floor.
e.zh: 一层像苔藓的地毯覆盖着潮湿的林地。

e.en: The dessert had a green, {moss-like} crumble on top.
e.zh: 那道甜点上面撒着绿色的、像苔藓一样的碎屑。

e.en: The ballad tells of a {moss-trooper} riding at night.
e.zh: 这首民谣讲述一个边境劫掠者夜里骑马出没。

e.en: Villagers feared the {moss-trooper} more than the tax collector.
e.zh: 村民害怕那个盗马贼，甚于害怕收税人。

e.en: The senator was dismissed as a {mossback} by younger voters.
e.zh: 年轻选民把那位参议员看作守旧的老顽固。

e.en: Do not be a {mossback} about every new tool.
e.zh: 不要对每一种新工具都摆出老顽固的态度。

e.en: A {mossbacked} turtle slid from the log into the pond.
e.zh: 一只背上长着苔藓的乌龟从木头上滑进池塘。

e.en: The committee kept its {mossbacked} view of office work.
e.zh: 委员会仍抱着对办公室工作的守旧看法。

e.en: Fishermen once used {mossbanker} as bait along the coast.
e.zh: 渔民过去常在海岸边用油鲱作鱼饵。

e.en: A school of {mossbanker} darkened the water near the boat.
e.zh: 一群鲱鱼使船边的海水显得发暗。

e.en: The factory processed {mossbunker} into oil and meal.
e.zh: 工厂把油鲱加工成鱼油和鱼粉。

e.en: Striped bass followed the {mossbunker} into the bay.
e.zh: 条纹鲈追着鲱鱼游进海湾。

e.en: The wall's {mossiness} showed how damp the garden was.
e.zh: 墙上长满苔藓的样子说明花园有多潮湿。

e.en: The essay had a certain {mossiness} in its language.
e.zh: 这篇文章的语言带着某种陈旧感。

e.en: The cushion had a soft, {mosslike} texture.
e.zh: 这个垫子有一种柔软、像苔藓一样的质感。

e.en: A {mosslike} growth spread over the shaded bricks.
e.zh: 一种像苔藓的生长物蔓延在阴处的砖面上。

e.en: The {mosstrooper} vanished into the hills before dawn.
e.zh: 那个边境劫掠者在黎明前消失在山里。

e.en: Old records accused him of sheltering a {mosstrooper}.
e.zh: 旧档案指控他窝藏过一名盗马贼。

e.en: She baked {mostaccioli} with tomato sauce and cheese.
e.zh: 她用番茄酱和奶酪烤了斜管通心粉。

e.en: The buffet served {mostaccioli} beside meatballs and salad.
e.zh: 自助餐把斜管通心粉和肉丸、沙拉放在一起供应。

e.en: A young {motard} leaned hard into the mountain bend.
e.zh: 一个年轻摩托车手在山路弯道里大幅压弯。

e.en: The {motard} bike used street tires on a dirt-bike frame.
e.zh: 那辆超摩车在越野车架上装了公路胎。

e.en: He found a {moth-eaten} coat in the attic.
e.zh: 他在阁楼里找到一件被虫蛀的外套。

e.en: The policy sounded {moth-eaten} and out of touch.
e.zh: 这项政策听起来陈旧过时，脱离现实。

e.en: Store the {moth-proofed} blankets in the cedar chest.
e.zh: 把经过防蛀处理的毯子放进雪松木箱里。

e.en: Her winter suits were cleaned and {moth-proofed} before storage.
e.zh: 她的冬季套装在收起来前已经清洗并做了防蛀处理。

e.en: The tailor recommended {moth-proofing} the wool coat before storage.
e.zh: 裁缝建议在收纳前给羊毛大衣做防蛀处理。

e.en: Good {moth-proofing} can save old sweaters from damage.
e.zh: 做好防蛀措施可以让旧毛衣免受损坏。

e.en: She {moth-proofs} every blanket before winter ends.
e.zh: 冬天结束前，她会给每条毯子做防蛀处理。

e.en: This spray {moth-proofs} wool without leaving a strong smell.
e.zh: 这种喷剂能给羊毛防蛀，而且不会留下刺鼻气味。

e.en: The child ran {mother-naked} from the bath to his room.
e.zh: 孩子洗完澡后一丝不挂地从浴室跑回房间。

e.en: He stood there {mother-naked}, too shocked to move.
e.zh: 他赤裸地站在那里，震惊得动弹不得。

e.en: The box was decorated with {mother-of-pearl} inlay.
e.zh: 这个盒子镶着珍珠母装饰。

e.en: Her buttons shone like {mother-of-pearl} in the light.
e.zh: 她的纽扣在光下像贝壳内层的珠光一样闪亮。

e.en: The artisan sorted several {mother-of-pearls} for the necklace.
e.zh: 工匠挑选了几块珍珠母贝材料来做项链。

e.en: Different {mother-of-pearls} can vary in color and shine.
e.zh: 不同的珍珠母贝材料在颜色和光泽上会有差别。

e.en: The clinic offers classes for every {mother-to-be}.
e.zh: 这家诊所为每位准妈妈提供课程。

e.en: Friends threw a small party for the {mother-to-be}.
e.zh: 朋友们为这位孕妇办了一个小聚会。

e.en: Spanish is her {mother-tongue}, but she speaks English well.
e.zh: 西班牙语是她的母语，但她英语也说得很好。

e.en: Children learn best first in their {mother-tongue}.
e.zh: 孩子最先用本族语学习时效果最好。

mothercraft.t: 育儿知识；母亲育儿技能

e.en: The course taught basic {mothercraft} to new parents.
e.zh: 这门课程向新手父母教授基本育儿知识。

e.en: Her calm {mothercraft} helped the baby settle quickly.
e.zh: 她娴熟沉稳的育儿技能让宝宝很快安静下来。

motherese.t: 妈妈语；对婴儿说话方式

e.en: Linguists study {motherese} to understand early language learning.
e.zh: 语言学家研究妈妈语，以了解早期语言学习。

e.en: Her soft {motherese} made the baby smile.
e.zh: 她轻柔的对婴儿说话方式让宝宝笑了。

e.en: The sisters returned to the {motherhouse} for the annual meeting.
e.zh: 修女们回到修会总院参加年度会议。

e.en: Records from the old {motherhouse} were carefully preserved.
e.zh: 旧母院的档案被仔细保存了下来。

e.en: She gave him a {motherlike} look of concern.
e.zh: 她用慈母般关切的眼神看着他。

e.en: His aunt was {motherlike} without being controlling.
e.zh: 他的姨母像母亲一样照顾他，却并不控制他。

e.en: Her {motherliness} showed in the way she comforted everyone.
e.zh: 她安慰每个人的方式体现出慈母般的温柔。

e.en: The novel treats {motherliness} as both strength and burden.
e.zh: 这部小说把母性既写成力量，也写成负担。

e.en: Both {mothers-in-law} helped plan the wedding dinner.
e.zh: 双方的婆婆和岳母都帮忙筹备婚宴。

e.en: Jokes about {mothers-in-law} are common in old sitcoms.
e.zh: 关于婆婆或岳母的笑话在老情景喜剧里很常见。

e.en: The hospital runs weekend classes for {mothers-to-be}.
e.zh: 医院为准妈妈们开设周末课程。

e.en: Several {mothers-to-be} waited outside the ultrasound room.
e.zh: 几位孕妇在超声检查室外等候。

e.en: Some herbalists use {motherwort} in traditional remedies.
e.zh: 一些草药师会在传统方剂中使用益母草。

e.en: The garden had mint, sage, and {motherwort} near the wall.
e.zh: 花园靠墙处种着薄荷、鼠尾草和益母草。

mothery.t: 母亲般的；过分慈母式的

e.en: She became rather {mothery} when he looked ill.
e.zh: 他看起来不舒服时，她变得很有母亲般的关怀。

e.en: His {mothery} tone annoyed the younger volunteers.
e.zh: 他那种过分慈母式的语气惹恼了年轻志愿者。

e.en: A {mothlike} insect circled the porch light.
e.zh: 一只像飞蛾的昆虫绕着门廊灯飞。

e.zh: 他感到一种扑火般的吸引，把他拉向那座危险的城市。

e.en: Store the sweater in a {mothproof} bag.
e.zh: 把这件毛衣放进防蛀袋里保存。

e.en: They {mothproof} the costumes after every performance season.
e.zh: 每个演出季结束后，他们都会给戏服做防蛀处理。

e.en: The museum kept the uniforms in {mothproofed} cases.
e.zh: 博物馆把制服保存在已做防蛀处理的箱柜里。

e.en: She {mothproofed} the blankets before putting them away.
e.zh: 她把毯子收起来前先做了防蛀处理。

e.en: The cleaner offers {mothproofing} for wool suits.
e.zh: 这家洗衣店提供羊毛西装防蛀处理。

e.zh: 没有适当的防蛀措施，那块旧地毯被蛀坏了。

e.zh: 那个旧箱子有一股像被蛀过的气味。

e.zh: 一个像蛾子的影子在窗边扑动。

e.zh: 博物馆展出了早期电影摄影机。

e.en: She studied {motion-picture} history at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里学习电影史。

e.zh: 物理学家讨论了该系统中的运动能量。

e.en: Engineers measured the {motional} resistance of the sensor.
e.zh: 工程师测量了传感器的运动相关阻抗。

e.zh: 恐惧在政治中可能成为一种促动性力量。

e.en: The coach used praise as a {motivative} tool.
e.zh: 教练把表扬当作激励工具来用。

e.en: The disease gradually reduced the patient's {motivity}.
e.zh: 这种疾病逐渐削弱了病人的运动能力。

e.zh: 这篇文章讨论社会变革背后的推动力。

e.zh: 一只鲜艳的翠鴗停在林间小路上方。

e.en: The guide identified the bird as a {motmot}.
e.zh: 向导认出那只鸟是一种翠鴗。

e.zh: 博物馆展出了一辆1905年的稀有早期汽车。

e.en: Villagers gathered to see the new {motocar}.
e.zh: 村民们聚在一起看那辆新的机动车。

e.en: A {motocrane} lifted the beams into place.
e.zh: 一台汽车吊把横梁吊装到位。

e.en: The site rented a {motocrane} for heavy loads.
e.zh: 工地租了一台机动起重机搬运重物。

e.en: A {motoneuron} sends signals to a muscle fiber.
e.zh: 运动神经元会向肌肉纤维发送信号。

e.en: Damage to a {motoneuron} can weaken movement.
e.zh: 运动神经元受损可能会削弱运动能力。

e.en: She rode a {motor-assisted} bicycle uphill.
e.zh: 她骑着一辆电机助力自行车上坡。

e.en: The clinic uses {motor-assisted} therapy equipment.
e.zh: 这家诊所使用电机辅助治疗设备。

e.zh: 他上周买了一辆二手摩托车。

e.en: The {motor-bike} was parked outside the cafe.
e.zh: 那辆摩托车停在咖啡馆外面。

e.en: The old {motor-car} struggled up the hill.
e.zh: 那辆老汽车艰难地爬上山坡。

e.en: Early laws treated the {motor-car} as a novelty.
e.zh: 早期法律把机动车视为新奇事物。

e.en: The factory installed a {motor-driven} pump.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一台由电机驱动的泵。

e.en: A {motor-driven} wheelchair gave him more independence.
e.zh: 一辆电动轮椅让他更加独立。

e.en: The mechanic repaired the {motor-engine} before noon.
e.zh: 机械师在中午前修好了发动机。

e.en: A small {motor-engine} powered the boat.
e.zh: 一台小型发动机为这艘船提供动力。

e.zh: 一辆机动卡车把煤送到磨坊。

e.en: The army used every {motor-lorry} it could find.
e.zh: 军队动用了能找到的每一辆货车。

e.en: Every {motor-vehicle} must be registered here.
e.zh: 这里每辆机动车都必须登记。

e.en: The law defines a scooter as a {motor-vehicle}.
e.zh: 法律把踏板车定义为机动车辆。

e.en: Traffic slowed on the {motor-way} after rain.
e.zh: 下雨后高速公路上的车流慢了下来。

e.en: They joined the {motor-way} near Birmingham.
e.zh: 他们在伯明翰附近驶上了高速公路。

e.zh: 暴风雨后这条小路几乎无法通车。

e.en: Engineers made the mountain pass {motorable}.
e.zh: 工程师把这处山口修到车辆可以通行。

e.en: The lab used a {motoralternator} for testing.
e.zh: 实验室用一台电动交流发电机组进行测试。

e.en: A noisy {motoralternator} supplied emergency power.
e.zh: 一台嘈杂的电动交流发电机组提供应急电力。

e.en: He rode a {motorbicycle} through the village.
e.zh: 他骑着一辆机动自行车穿过村子。

e.en: The catalog advertised a cheap {motorbicycle}.
e.zh: 目录上刊登了一款便宜的轻便摩托。

e.en: The resort offered {motorboation} on the lake.
e.zh: 度假村提供在湖上乘汽艇的活动。

e.en: Weekend {motorboation} disturbed the quiet harbor.
e.zh: 周末的汽艇航行扰乱了安静的港湾。

e.en: The {motorbus} replaced the old horse tram.
e.zh: 公共汽车取代了旧式马拉有轨车。

e.en: Passengers waited for the last {motorbus}.
e.zh: 乘客们等着最后一班公共汽车。

e.zh: 这项新规定激怒了汽车界许多人。

e.en: Early {motordom} celebrated speed and freedom.
e.zh: 早期驾车族群推崇速度和自由。

e.en: Crowds filled the {motordrome} for the race.
e.zh: 人群挤满摩托车赛车场观看比赛。

e.en: The old {motordrome} closed after several accidents.
e.zh: 几起事故后，那座旧摩托车赛车场关闭了。

e.zh: 车间修好了一台有故障的电动发电机。

e.en: A {motordynamo} converted the current for the tram.
e.zh: 一台电动机发电机组为有轨电车转换电流。

e.zh: 我哥哥是个汽车迷，喜欢重装发动机。

e.en: The mechanic removed the {motorhead} carefully.
e.zh: 机械师小心地拆下了发动机缸盖。

e.en: The therapist assessed his {motorial} development after surgery.
e.zh: 治疗师评估了他手术后的运动机能发育。

e.en: The study focused on {motorial} responses in young children.
e.zh: 这项研究关注幼儿的运动反应。

e.zh: 经过数月治疗，这个孩子在运动机能方面有所改善。

e.en: Patients were tested {motorically} before taking the new medicine.
e.zh: 患者服用新药前接受了运动机能方面的测试。

e.en: The company planned to {motorise} the old delivery carts.
e.zh: 公司计划给旧送货车装上发动机。

e.en: The army tried to {motorise} more units before winter.
e.zh: 军队试图在冬季前让更多部队实现机械化。

e.en: Rapid {motorization} changed the shape of the city.
e.zh: 快速的汽车普及改变了这座城市的面貌。

e.en: The army's {motorization} improved its ability to move quickly.
e.zh: 军队的机动化提升了快速调动能力。

e.en: They decided to {motorize} the small fishing boat.
e.zh: 他们决定给那艘小渔船装上发动机。

e.en: The government wanted to {motorize} rural transport services.
e.zh: 政府希望让农村交通服务实现机动化。

e.zh: 这套工具能在一小时内给普通自行车装上动力装置。

e.zh: 新政策使部分应急车队实现机动化。

e.zh: 他们正在给大门加装电机，以节省员工时间。

e.zh: 战后该地区开始让农机设备机动化。

e.zh: 他们乘一艘无发动机的小船穿过湖面。

e.zh: 她骑着一辆小型踏板摩托穿过狭窄街道。

e.zh: 这家酒店按天出租每辆小型摩托车。

e.zh: 那艘旧机动船沿海岸运送货物。

e.en: A {motorship} replaced the sailing vessel on the route.
e.zh: 一艘内燃机船取代了这条航线上的帆船。

e.en: A {motortruck} delivered supplies to the remote camp.
e.zh: 一辆载货汽车把补给送到偏远营地。

e.en: The farmer bought a used {motortruck} for market days.
e.zh: 农民买了一辆二手卡车，赶集时使用。

e.zh: 矿工在旧铜矿巷道中认出了钒铅铜矿。

e.en: He would {mouch} around the market for hours.
e.zh: 他会在市场里闲逛好几个小时。

e.en: The boys tried to {mouch} apples from the cart.
e.zh: 那些男孩想从车上偷摸拿几个苹果。

e.en: A {moufflon} stood on the rocky slope.
e.zh: 一只欧洲盘羊站在岩石斜坡上。

e.en: The reserve protects the rare {moufflon} population.
e.zh: 保护区保护着稀有的欧洲盘羊种群。

e.en: We saw a {mouflon} high above the trail.
e.zh: 我们在小路上方很高处看见一只欧洲盘羊。

e.en: The {mouflon} is known for its curved horns.
e.zh: 欧洲盘羊以弯曲的角而闻名。

e.en: He said she {mought} come before noon.
e.zh: 他说她可能会在中午前来。

e.en: In old dialect, one {mought} hear that form often.
e.zh: 在旧方言中，人们也许常能听到这种说法。

e.en: The teacher marked the consonant as {mouille} in the notes.
e.zh: 老师在笔记中把这个辅音标为腭化音。

e.en: The chef served the fish with a {mouille} sauce.
e.zh: 厨师给鱼配了一种湿润柔滑的酱汁。

e.en: The novel describes a poor {moujik} walking through the snow.
e.zh: 小说描写了一个贫苦的俄国农民在雪地里行走。

e.en: He used {moujik} as an old word for a Russian peasant.
e.zh: 他用这个旧词来指俄国农民。

e.en: The trainees practiced first aid on a victim with realistic {moulage}.
e.zh: 学员们在带有逼真伤口化妆的模拟伤者身上练习急救。

e.en: The museum used {moulage} to copy the ancient inscription.
e.zh: 博物馆用制模方法复制了那段古代铭文。

e.en: The farmer replaced the cracked {mould-board} before spring plowing.
e.zh: 春耕前，农民换掉了裂开的犁壁。

e.en: Wet soil stuck to the {mould-board} after every pass.
e.zh: 每犁过一趟，湿土都会粘在翻土板上。

e.en: A shiny {mouldboard} turns the soil cleanly.
e.zh: 光滑的犁壁能把土整齐地翻过来。

e.en: He adjusted the {mouldboard} to cut a deeper furrow.
e.zh: 他调整翻土板，好犁出更深的沟。

e.en: This bread is {mouldier} than the loaf in the cupboard.
e.zh: 这块面包比柜子里的那条更发霉。

e.en: His second excuse sounded even {mouldier} than the first.
e.zh: 他的第二个借口听起来比第一个还陈腐。

e.en: In the old poem, a {mouldwarp} digs beneath the field.
e.zh: 在那首古诗里，一只鼹鼠在田地下打洞。

e.en: The dialect word {mouldwarp} means a mole.
e.zh: 方言词mouldwarp的意思是鼹鼠。

e.en: She chose {mouline} thread for the embroidered flowers.
e.zh: 她选了混色线来绣那些花。

e.en: The scarf was woven from soft {mouline} yarn.
e.zh: 这条围巾是用柔软的混色纱织成的。

e.en: The fencer practiced a fast {moulinet} before the bout.
e.zh: 击剑手在比赛前练习了一个快速绕剑动作。

e.en: His {moulinet} looked elegant but left him exposed.
e.zh: 他的绕剑动作看着优雅，却让自己露出了破绽。

e.en: The village {moulvi} taught children to read Arabic.
e.zh: 村里的伊斯兰教法学者教孩子们读阿拉伯语。

e.en: They asked a respected {moulvi} for guidance.
e.zh: 他们向一位受尊敬的伊斯兰学者请教。

e.en: In the ballad, the rider says he {moun} leave before dawn.
e.zh: 在那首民谣中，骑手说他必须在黎明前离开。

e.en: The old phrase {moun} go means must go.
e.zh: 古语moun go的意思是必须走。

e.en: The veteran {moundsman} struck out three batters.
e.zh: 那名老练的投手三振了三名击球手。

e.en: Reporters praised the young {moundsman} after the shutout.
e.zh: 完封比赛后，记者们称赞了这位年轻投手。

e.en: The camera comes with a {mountable} bracket for helmets.
e.zh: 这台相机配有可安装在头盔上的支架。

e.en: Only calm horses are {mountable} by beginners.
e.zh: 只有温顺的马才适合初学者骑乘。

e.en: She took a {mountain-climbing} course before visiting Nepal.
e.zh: 去尼泊尔前，她参加了一门登山课程。

e.en: Good boots are essential for serious {mountain-climbing}.
e.zh: 认真登山时，一双好靴子必不可少。

e.en: A {mountain-high} wave crashed over the pier.
e.zh: 一道高如山的巨浪拍过码头。

e.en: They faced a {mountain-high} pile of paperwork.
e.zh: 他们面对着堆积如山的文书工作。

e.en: The hikers reached the {mountain-top} at sunrise.
e.zh: 徒步者们在日出时到达了山顶。

e.en: A small temple stood on the {mountain-top}.
e.zh: 山顶上有一座小庙。

e.en: He rode a {mountainboard} down the grassy slope.
e.zh: 他踩着山地滑板从草坡上滑下来。

e.en: A {mountainboard} has large wheels for rough ground.
e.zh: 山地滑板有大轮子，适合崎岖地面。

e.en: The road bends {mountainward} after the bridge.
e.zh: 过桥后，道路转向山地方向。

e.en: Cold air drifted {mountainward} in the evening.
e.zh: 傍晚时，冷空气朝山那边流去。

e.en: They drove through a {mountainy} region all afternoon.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都开车穿过一片多山地区。

e.en: The child drew a {mountainy} shape in the sand.
e.zh: 孩子在沙地上画了一个像山的形状。

e.en: The crowd laughed at the loud {mounte-bank} in the square.
e.zh: 人群嘲笑广场上那个喧闹的江湖骗子。

e.en: He exposed the {mounte-bank} who sold useless cures.
e.zh: 他揭穿了那个售卖无效药方的骗子。

e.en: The pamphlet accused the doctor of {mountebankery}.
e.zh: 那本小册子指控这名医生招摇撞骗。

e.en: His financial advice was pure {mountebankery}.
e.zh: 他的理财建议完全是江湖骗术。

e.en: The salesman gave a {mountebankish} speech about miracle pills.
e.zh: 推销员发表了一通像江湖骗子般的神药演说。

e.en: Her costume had a deliberately {mountebankish} flair.
e.zh: 她的服装故意带着一种江湖艺人的夸张味道。

e.en: The journal condemned medical {mountebankism} in harsh terms.
e.zh: 那份期刊严厉谴责医学上的江湖骗子作风。

e.en: Voters grew tired of his theatrical {mountebankism}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了他那套戏剧化的骗子作风。

e.en: A {Mountie} helped the tourists find their hotel.
e.zh: 一名加拿大骑警帮游客找到了旅馆。

e.en: The film shows a brave {Mountie} on horseback.
e.zh: 电影里出现了一名骑在马上的勇敢加拿大骑警。

e.en: The officers wore a black {mourning-band} on each sleeve.
e.zh: 警官们每只袖子上都戴着黑色哀悼臂章。

e.en: She tied a {mourning-band} around the old flag.
e.zh: 她在那面旧旗上系了一条丧章。

e.en: The old print shows a {mourning-coach} outside the church.
e.zh: 那幅旧版画中，教堂外停着一辆丧礼马车。

e.en: A black {mourning-coach} followed the procession slowly.
e.zh: 一辆黑色灵车马车缓缓跟在送葬队伍后面。

e.en: She ordered {mousaka} at the Greek restaurant.
e.zh: 她在那家希腊餐馆点了穆萨卡。

e.en: The homemade {mousaka} was rich with eggplant and lamb.
e.zh: 自制的穆萨卡有茄子和羊肉，味道很浓郁。

e.en: He wore a plain {mouse-colored} wool coat.
e.zh: 他穿着一件朴素的鼠灰色羊毛大衣。

e.en: The bird had a {mouse-colored} back and pale wings.
e.zh: 那只鸟背部灰褐，翅膀颜色较浅。

e.zh: 她那件鼠灰色连衣裙在雨中看起来近乎银色。

e.en: A {mouse-coloured} moth rested on the window frame.
e.zh: 一只灰褐色的蛾子停在窗框上。

e.en: The gardener planted {mouse-ear} along the stone path.
e.zh: 园丁在石径旁种了鼠耳草。

e.en: Each {mouse-ear} leaf was small, soft, and rounded.
e.zh: 每片鼠耳形叶子都小巧柔软而圆润。

mouse-eared.t: 有鼠耳状叶的；耳朵小圆的

e.en: The {mouse-eared} plant spread quickly between the rocks.
e.zh: 这种有鼠耳状叶的植物很快在岩石间蔓延开来。

e.en: A {mouse-eared} kitten peered from under the chair.
e.zh: 一只小圆耳朵的猫崽从椅子下面探出头来。

e.en: A {mousebird} clung to the branch with its long tail hanging down.
e.zh: 一只鼠鸟攀在树枝上，长尾巴垂了下来。

e.en: We saw a gray {mousebird} feeding on berries.
e.zh: 我们看见一只灰色鼠鸟在吃浆果。

mouseburger.t: 不起眼的人；平庸小人物

e.en: The novel treats him as a shy {mouseburger} at first.
e.zh: 小说一开始把他写成一个害羞不起眼的小人物。

e.en: She refused to play the office {mouseburger} any longer.
e.zh: 她不愿再在办公室里扮演那个平庸受气的人。

e.en: The cat waited beside the {mousehole} all morning.
e.zh: 那只猫整个上午都守在鼠洞旁边。

e.en: Light came through a {mousehole} in the old wall.
e.zh: 光从旧墙上一个很小的洞口透了进来。

e.en: The child imagined a tiny {mouselet} living in the cupboard.
e.zh: 孩子想象橱柜里住着一只小小的幼鼠。

e.zh: 一只受惊的小鼠飞快钻到叶子下面。

e.zh: 那只动物在黑暗中发出像老鼠一样的吱叫声。

e.zh: 他用胆小而轻微的声音回答。

e.en: The menu appears on {mouseover} in the browser.
e.zh: 在浏览器里，菜单会在鼠标悬停时出现。

e.en: Add a {mouseover} effect to highlight each button.
e.zh: 给每个按钮添加鼠标悬停高亮效果。

e.en: I bought a new {mousepad} for my desk.
e.zh: 我给书桌买了一个新的鼠标垫。

e.en: Use the {mousepad} to move the cursor on the laptop.
e.zh: 用笔记本的触控板移动光标。

e.en: Store the grain in a {mouseproof} container.
e.zh: 把谷物存放在防鼠容器里。

e.en: They made the cellar {mouseproof} before winter.
e.zh: 入冬前他们把地窖处理成能防老鼠的样子。

e.en: The botanist identified the plant as {mousetail}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种植物认定为鼠尾草。

e.en: A thin {mousetail} of smoke rose from the candle.
e.zh: 一缕像鼠尾般细的烟从蜡烛上升起。

e.en: She seemed {mousey} at meetings but wrote brilliant reports.
e.zh: 她开会时显得胆小安静，但报告写得很出色。

e.en: His {mousey} hair was cut very short.
e.zh: 他的灰褐色头发剪得很短。

e.en: The toddler called the toy a little {mousie}.
e.zh: 那个蹒跚学步的孩子把玩具叫作小老鼠。

e.en: Come here, {mousie}, she whispered to the pet.
e.zh: 她对宠物轻声说，过来吧，小老鼠。

e.en: The second sketch made the character look {mousier}.
e.zh: 第二张草图让这个角色看起来更像老鼠。

e.en: He grew {mousier} whenever the manager entered.
e.zh: 经理一进来，他就变得更加胆小畏缩。

e.en: The {mousiest} child in class surprised everyone by singing loudly.
e.zh: 班上最怯懦的孩子大声唱歌，让所有人都很惊讶。

e.en: This is the {mousiest} shade of brown in the palette.
e.zh: 这是调色板里最像鼠灰色的棕色。

e.en: He smiled {mousily} and avoided eye contact.
e.zh: 他胆怯地笑了笑，避开了目光接触。

e.en: The thief moved {mousily} along the hallway.
e.zh: 小偷像老鼠般悄悄沿着走廊移动。

e.en: Her apparent {mousiness} hid a sharp political mind.
e.zh: 她表面上的怯懦掩盖了敏锐的政治头脑。

e.en: The stylist disliked the {mousiness} of the hair color.
e.zh: 发型师不喜欢这种发色的鼠灰感。

e.en: The gown was made from pale silk {mousseline}.
e.zh: 那件礼服是用浅色丝质慕斯林薄纱做成的。

e.en: The chef served the fish with a lemon {mousseline}.
e.zh: 厨师给鱼配了一种柠檬轻柔酱汁。

e.en: The actor wore a curled {moustachio} for the comic role.
e.zh: 那名演员为喜剧角色留了卷曲夸张的小胡子。

e.en: His dark {moustachio} made him look severe.
e.zh: 他那撮深色大胡子让他显得很严厉。

e.en: A {moustachioed} guard checked our tickets at the gate.
e.zh: 一名留着小胡子的警卫在门口检查我们的票。

e.en: The portrait shows a stern, {moustachioed} officer.
e.zh: 这幅画像里是一位神情严厉、留着髭须的军官。

e.en: The old garden had a blooming {moutan} near the wall.
e.zh: 老花园靠墙处有一株正在开花的牡丹。

e.en: She painted a pale {moutan} on the silk fan.
e.zh: 她在丝扇上画了一朵淡色牡丹。

e.en: The stew had a rich, {mouth-filling} flavor.
e.zh: 这道炖菜味道浓郁，入口十分饱满。

e.en: He liked the {mouth-filling} sound of the old family name.
e.zh: 他喜欢那个古老姓氏念起来满口有力的感觉。

e.en: He played a cheerful tune on his {mouth-organ}.
e.zh: 他用口琴吹了一支欢快的曲子。

e.en: A small {mouth-organ} fit easily in her coat pocket.
e.zh: 一只小口琴可以轻松放进她的外套口袋。

e.en: The lifeguard gave the swimmer {mouth-to-mouth} resuscitation.
e.zh: 救生员给那名游泳者做了口对口人工呼吸。

e.en: They practiced {mouth-to-mouth} technique during first-aid training.
e.zh: 他们在急救培训中练习口对口呼吸技巧。

e.en: The bakery window was full of {mouth-watering} pastries.
e.zh: 面包店橱窗里摆满了令人垂涎的点心。

e.en: The company made a {mouth-watering} offer to the young engineer.
e.zh: 公司给那位年轻工程师开出了极具诱惑力的条件。

e.en: The {mouthbreeder} carries its eggs safely in its mouth.
e.zh: 这种用口孵卵的鱼会把卵安全地含在嘴里。

e.en: Aquarists watched the female {mouthbreeder} protect her young.
e.zh: 水族爱好者观察那条雌性口孵鱼保护幼鱼。

e.en: A {mouthbrooder} may stop eating while guarding its eggs.
e.zh: 口孵动物在守护卵时可能会停止进食。

e.en: The cichlid is a well-known {mouthbrooder} among aquarium keepers.
e.zh: 这种慈鲷在水族玩家中是很有名的口育鱼。

e.en: The yogurt has a smooth, creamy {mouthfeel}.
e.zh: 这种酸奶口感顺滑，带有奶油般的质地。

e.en: Brewers adjust carbonation to improve the beer's {mouthfeel}.
e.zh: 酿酒师会调整气泡感来改善啤酒的入口口感。

e.en: The teacher disliked the student's constant {mouthiness}.
e.zh: 老师不喜欢那个学生总是多嘴顶撞。

e.en: Puppy {mouthiness} can be reduced with patient training.
e.zh: 幼犬爱咬东西的习惯可以通过耐心训练减少。

e.en: The drawing showed a strange, {mouthless} face.
e.zh: 那幅画呈现出一张奇怪的无嘴面孔。

e.en: Some simple organisms appear almost {mouthless} under the microscope.
e.zh: 有些简单生物在显微镜下看起来几乎没有口部。

e.en: A dark, {mouthlike} opening led into the cave.
e.zh: 一个像嘴一样的黑洞口通向洞穴深处。

e.en: The flower has a {mouthlike} shape that attracts insects.
e.zh: 这种花有口状的外形，会吸引昆虫。

e.en: Grandfather kept a battered {mouthorgan} in his drawer.
e.zh: 祖父把一只破旧的口琴放在抽屉里。

e.en: She learned folk songs on a cheap {mouthorgan}.
e.zh: 她用一只便宜的口琴学会了几首民歌。

e.en: The chair's light frame improves its {movability}.
e.zh: 这把椅子的轻便框架提高了它的可移动性。

e.en: Doctors checked the {movability} of his injured shoulder.
e.zh: 医生检查了他受伤肩膀的活动能力。

e.en: The shelves are {movably} attached to the metal rails.
e.zh: 这些架子以可移动的方式固定在金属导轨上。

e.en: The lamp was {movably} mounted above the desk.
e.zh: 那盏灯活动式地安装在书桌上方。

e.en: Our {move-in} date is set for Friday.
e.zh: 我们的搬入日期定在星期五。

e.en: The building prepared a {move-in} checklist for new tenants.
e.zh: 大楼为新租户准备了一份入住清单。

e.zh: 经历那次失去后，她努力放下往事继续生活。

e.zh: 警方命令人群离开现场继续前行。

e.zh: 鹿走近时，他一动不动地站着。

e.zh: 月光下，湖面显得幽暗而静止。

e.zh: 整个漫长仪式中，她一动不动地坐着。

e.zh: 猫在草丛里一动不动地盯着那只鸟。

e.zh: 房东把最后的搬出检查安排在星期一。

e.zh: 他们搬出去所花的时间比预想更长。

e.zh: 那位年轻电影制作人在冬天拍摄了她的第一部电影。

e.zh: 优秀的电影制作人既懂画面，也懂节奏。

e.zh: 这桩丑闻震惊了整个电影界。

e.zh: 她成了影坛最耀眼的明星之一。

e.en: Streaming has changed many people's {moviegoing} habits.
e.zh: 流媒体改变了许多人的观影习惯。

e.en: The festival attracted a serious {moviegoing} crowd.
e.zh: 这个电影节吸引了一批热衷观影的观众。

e.zh: 那位演员来到电影圈时身上几乎没什么钱。

e.zh: 数码摄影机永远改变了现代电影制作。

e.zh: 她在一所小型艺术学院学习电影制作。

e.zh: 治疗师用燃烧的艾绒温热那个穴位。
