e.zh: 干艾草常被制成艾灸用的艾绒。

e.en: Some patients use {moxibustion} for chronic pain.
e.zh: 有些患者用艾灸疗法缓解慢性疼痛。

e.en: The clinic offers acupuncture and {moxibustion}.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供针灸和艾灸疗法。

e.en: It took real {moxy} to challenge the boss.
e.zh: 敢挑战老板确实需要很大的勇气。

e.en: Her speech had humor, confidence, and {moxy}.
e.zh: 她的演讲有幽默感、自信和魄力。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the child with {moyamoya} disease.
e.zh: 医生诊断这个孩子患有烟雾病。

e.en: Surgery can improve blood flow in {moyamoya}.
e.zh: 手术可以改善烟雾病患者的血流。

mozarabic.t: 莫扎拉布的；莫扎拉布语

e.en: The manuscript preserves several {Mozarabic} prayers.
e.zh: 这份手稿保存了几篇莫扎拉布祈祷文。

e.en: Scholars study {Mozarabic} as a Romance variety.
e.zh: 学者把莫扎拉布语作为一种罗曼语变体来研究。

e.en: The pizza was covered with melted {mozarella}.
e.zh: 披萨上铺满了融化的马苏里拉奶酪。

e.en: Fresh {mozarella} tastes mild and creamy.
e.zh: 新鲜马苏里拉奶酪味道温和而有奶香。

e.en: The finale has a light, {Mozartian} elegance.
e.zh: 终曲带有轻盈的莫扎特式优雅。

e.en: Critics praised the opera's {Mozartian} balance.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部歌剧具有莫扎特风格的平衡感。

e.en: The bishop wore a red {mozetta} over his cassock.
e.zh: 主教在法衣外披着一件红色短肩披。

e.en: A silk {mozetta} hung in the church museum.
e.zh: 一件丝质教士披肩挂在教堂博物馆里。

e.en: The pope's white {mozzetta} was trimmed with fur.
e.zh: 教宗的白色短肩披镶着毛边。

e.en: The portrait shows a cardinal in a scarlet {mozzetta}.
e.zh: 画像中一位枢机主教穿着猩红色教士披肩。

e.en: The typo changed {mqorality} into a strange-looking word.
e.zh: 这个拼写错误把道德这个词变成了一个奇怪的样子。

e.en: In the old text, {mqorality} clearly meant morality.
e.zh: 在那段旧文本里，mqorality显然指的是道德。

e.en: The dancer moved to the beat of the {mridang}.
e.zh: 舞者随着印度双面鼓的节拍起舞。

e.en: He learned the {mridang} from a temple musician.
e.zh: 他向一位寺庙乐师学习印度双面鼓。

e.en: A {mridanga} accompanied the devotional singing.
e.zh: 一只印度双面鼓为 devotional 歌唱伴奏。

e.en: The old {mridanga} had a deep, resonant tone.
e.zh: 那只旧印度双面鼓声音低沉而洪亮。

e.en: The concert began with a solo on the {mridangam}.
e.zh: 音乐会以一段南印度双面鼓独奏开场。

e.en: She practices {mridangam} for two hours daily.
e.zh: 她每天练习南印度双面鼓两个小时。

e.en: The old bread had a {mucedinous} smell.
e.zh: 那块旧面包有一股发霉的气味。

e.en: A {mucedinous} growth covered the damp wall.
e.zh: 潮湿的墙上覆盖着霉菌状的生长物。

e.en: The {much-derided} plan finally began to work.
e.zh: 那个饱受嘲笑的计划终于开始奏效。

e.en: She defended the {much-derided} policy in public.
e.zh: 她公开为那项备受讥讽的政策辩护。

e.en: The {much-hyped} phone disappointed many reviewers.
e.zh: 那款被大肆宣传的手机让许多评测者失望。

e.en: Investors rushed into the {much-hyped} startup.
e.zh: 投资者纷纷涌向那家被热炒的初创公司。

e.en: The {much-maligned} manager quietly improved the team.
e.zh: 那位备受诋毁的经理悄悄改善了团队。

e.en: This {much-maligned} vegetable is actually very nutritious.
e.zh: 这种常被嫌弃的蔬菜其实很有营养。

much-travelled.t: 游历广泛的；常被行经的

e.en: Her {much-travelled} uncle knew every major port.
e.zh: 她那位游历广泛的叔叔熟悉每个主要港口。

e.en: The {much-travelled} road was full of deep ruts.
e.zh: 这条常有人走的路布满了深深的车辙。

e.en: The chemist identified {mucic} acid in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家在样品中鉴定出黏液酸。

e.en: A {mucic} compound formed during the reaction.
e.zh: 反应过程中形成了一种黏酸化合物。

e.en: The pond had a {mucid} film on its surface.
e.zh: 池塘表面有一层黏滑的薄膜。

e.en: A {mucid} odor rose from the cellar.
e.zh: 地窖里冒出一股发霉的气味。

e.en: The doctor examined the {muciferous} tissue carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了那处会分泌黏液的组织。

e.en: Some plants have {muciferous} cells near the roots.
e.zh: 有些植物的根部附近有分泌黏液的细胞。

e.en: The glands showed strong {mucific} activity.
e.zh: 这些腺体表现出很强的形成黏液活动。

e.en: A {mucific} change appeared in the damaged tissue.
e.zh: 受损组织中出现了黏液形成性的变化。

e.en: The root was covered with {mucigel}.
e.zh: 根部覆盖着一层根表黏胶。

e.en: Soil particles adhered to the plant's {mucigel}.
e.zh: 土壤颗粒黏附在植物的根表黏胶层上。

e.en: Okra becomes {mucilaginous} when it is cooked.
e.zh: 秋葵煮熟后会变得黏滑。

e.en: The seed released a {mucilaginous} coating in water.
e.zh: 种子在水中释放出一层胶黏的外膜。

e.en: The paste spread {mucilaginously} across the paper.
e.zh: 糊状物黏黏地在纸上铺开。

e.en: The algae clung {mucilaginously} to the rocks.
e.zh: 藻类以黏滑的方式附着在岩石上。

e.en: The report mentioned possible {mucinemia} after the test.
e.zh: 报告提到检测后可能存在血中黏蛋白增多。

e.en: Severe {mucinemia} can complicate the diagnosis.
e.zh: 严重的血中黏蛋白增多会使诊断更复杂。

e.en: The cell stored {mucinogen} before releasing mucus.
e.zh: 细胞在释放黏液前储存黏蛋白原。

e.en: Researchers stained the {mucinogen} in the gland.
e.zh: 研究人员对腺体中的黏蛋白原进行了染色。

e.en: The patient received a {mucinolytic} treatment.
e.zh: 患者接受了溶解黏蛋白的治疗。

e.en: A {mucinolytic} enzyme helped clear the secretion.
e.zh: 一种溶解黏蛋白的酶帮助清除了分泌物。

e.en: Some local {muck-a-muck} tried to block the project.
e.zh: 某个当地自命不凡的大人物试图阻止这个项目。

e.en: He acted like a {muck-a-muck} at the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会上摆出一副大人物的架子。

e.en: The new {muckamuck} demanded a larger office.
e.zh: 那位新来的大人物要求一间更大的办公室。

e.en: Nobody wanted another {muckamuck} giving orders.
e.zh: 没人想再来一个摆架子的人发号施令。

e.en: The miners repaired the {muckbar} before dawn.
e.zh: 矿工们在天亮前修好了废石堆挡墙。

e.en: A cracked {muckbar} made the tunnel unsafe.
e.zh: 开裂的废石堆挡墙让隧道变得不安全。

e.en: The stable hired a {muckerer} for the stalls.
e.zh: 马厩雇了一个清理粪污的人来打扫隔间。

e.en: He was known as a {muckerer} of careful plans.
e.zh: 他以破坏周密计划的人而出名。

muckety-muck.t: 大人物；自命不凡的要人

e.en: Some {muckety-muck} from headquarters canceled the project.
e.zh: 总部来的某个大人物取消了这个项目。

e.en: He acts like a {muckety-muck} at every meeting.
e.zh: 他在每次会议上都摆出一副要人的架子。

e.en: The hens scratched beside the old {muckheap}.
e.zh: 母鸡在旧粪堆旁边刨土。

e.en: A {muckheap} stood behind the stable all winter.
e.zh: 马厩后面整个冬天都堆着一堆污物。

e.en: Steam rose from the {muckhill} after rain.
e.zh: 雨后粪丘上升起了热气。

e.en: The farmer moved the {muckhill} away from the gate.
e.zh: 农夫把那堆粪土从大门旁移开了。

e.en: These are the {muckiest} boots in the hallway.
e.zh: 这些是走廊里最脏的靴子。

e.en: That was the {muckiest} political fight of the year.
e.zh: 那是今年最肮脏的一场政治斗争。

e.en: The {muckiness} of the yard annoyed the tenants.
e.zh: 院子的泥泞肮脏让住户很烦。

e.en: The film captured the moral {muckiness} of the scandal.
e.zh: 这部电影表现出丑闻中道德上的污浊感。

e.en: They spent a {muckle} of money on the roof.
e.zh: 他们在屋顶上花了一大笔钱。

e.en: It was a {muckle} stone for one man to lift.
e.zh: 那块石头很大，一个人很难搬起来。

e.en: The reporter refused to {muckrake} without evidence.
e.zh: 那名记者拒绝在没有证据的情况下挖丑闻。

e.en: Politicians accused the paper of trying to {muckrake}.
e.zh: 政客指责那家报纸企图搜挖丑闻。

e.en: The magazine {muckraked} through years of city contracts.
e.zh: 那本杂志翻查多年市政合同来揭丑。

e.en: He {muckraked} aggressively during the campaign.
e.zh: 他在竞选期间大肆挖掘丑闻。

e.en: She {muckrakes} for a hard-hitting weekly newspaper.
e.zh: 她为一家犀利的周报挖掘丑闻。

e.en: The column {muckrakes} when officials hide public records.
e.zh: 官员隐瞒公共记录时，这个专栏就会揭丑。

e.en: He broke into a {mucksweat} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前他紧张得浑身冒汗。

e.en: The sudden noise left her in a {mucksweat}.
e.zh: 突如其来的响声吓得她出了一身冷汗。

e.en: The old miser was mocked as a {muckworm}.
e.zh: 那个老吝啬鬼被人嘲笑成守财奴。

e.en: A {muckworm} twisted under the damp straw.
e.zh: 一条粪土里的虫在潮湿稻草下扭动。

e.en: The doctor noted a {mucocutaneous} rash around the mouth.
e.zh: 医生注意到口周有黏膜皮肤性皮疹。

e.en: Some infections cause {mucocutaneous} lesions in children.
e.zh: 有些感染会在儿童身上引起黏膜皮肤病损。

e.en: The sample contained a thick {mucoid} discharge.
e.zh: 样本中含有浓稠的黏液样分泌物。

e.en: Bacteria formed {mucoid} colonies on the plate.
e.zh: 细菌在培养皿上形成了黏液样菌落。

e.en: The lab described the growth as {mucoidal}.
e.zh: 实验室把这种生长形态描述为黏液样。

e.en: A {mucoidal} layer coated the damaged tissue.
e.zh: 受损组织表面覆盖着一层黏液样物质。

e.en: Early chemists studied {mucoitin} in connective tissue.
e.zh: 早期化学家研究结缔组织中的黏多糖成分。

e.en: The paper mentions {mucoitin} as an old biochemical term.
e.zh: 这篇论文把mucoitin作为一个旧生化术语提到。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with {mucolipidosis} after genetic testing.
e.zh: 基因检测后，这名儿童被诊断为黏脂质贮积症。

e.en: Researchers compared several forms of {mucolipidosis}.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种类型的黏脂质贮积症。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {mucolytic} to loosen the phlegm.
e.zh: 医生开了一种化痰药来稀释痰液。

e.en: This {mucolytic} treatment helps clear thick airway mucus.
e.zh: 这种黏液溶解治疗有助于清除气道中的浓稠黏液。

e.en: The old study tested {mucomycin} against several bacteria.
e.zh: 那项旧研究测试了mucomycin对几种细菌的作用。

e.en: Few modern formularies list {mucomycin} as a standard drug.
e.zh: 现代药品目录很少把mucomycin列为标准药物。

e.en: The reaction produced {muconate} under mild conditions.
e.zh: 该反应在温和条件下生成了黏康酸盐。

e.en: Engineered microbes can convert aromatics into {muconate}.
e.zh: 工程微生物能把芳香族化合物转化为黏康酸盐。

e.en: The antibiotic blocks {mucopeptide} synthesis in bacteria.
e.zh: 这种抗生素会阻断细菌的黏肽合成。

e.en: Older textbooks often call peptidoglycan {mucopeptide}.
e.zh: 旧教材常把肽聚糖称为黏肽。

e.en: Hyaluronic acid is a common {mucopolysaccharide}.
e.zh: 透明质酸是一种常见的黏多糖。

e.en: The stain highlights {mucopolysaccharide} deposits in tissue.
e.zh: 这种染色能显示组织中的黏多糖沉积。

e.en: Cartilage contains many {mucopolysaccharides}.
e.zh: 软骨中含有许多黏多糖。

e.en: The test measures {mucopolysaccharides} in the urine.
e.zh: 这项检测会测量尿液中的黏多糖。

e.en: Early treatment can slow some forms of {mucopolysaccharidosis}.
e.zh: 早期治疗可以减缓某些类型的黏多糖贮积症。

e.en: The clinic screens infants for {mucopolysaccharidosis}.
e.zh: 这家诊所会筛查婴儿是否患有黏多糖贮积症。

e.en: Saliva contains {mucoprotein} that helps lubricate food.
e.zh: 唾液中含有帮助润滑食物的黏蛋白。

e.en: The assay detected elevated {mucoprotein} levels.
e.zh: 这项测定发现黏蛋白水平升高。

e.en: The novel portrays a poor {mujik} struggling through winter.
e.zh: 这部小说描写一个贫苦俄国农民在冬天艰难度日。

e.en: He used {mujik} as an old-fashioned insult for a rough peasant.
e.zh: 他把“mujik”当作过时的骂人话，指粗鲁的乡下人。

e.en: The villagers asked the {mukhtar} to settle the dispute.
e.zh: 村民们请村长来调解这场纠纷。

e.en: In the report, the {mukhtar} represented the neighborhood council.
e.zh: 在报告中，这位地方首领代表了社区委员会。

e.en: She wore warm {mukluks} during the Arctic trip.
e.zh: 她在北极旅行时穿着保暖的因纽特软皮靴。

e.en: A handmade {mukluk} hung beside the old snowshoes.
e.zh: 一只手工软皮靴挂在那副旧雪鞋旁边。

e.en: He learned to read Arabic at the village {muktab}.
e.zh: 他在村里的伊斯兰小学学会了读阿拉伯文。

e.en: The old {muktab} also served as a community classroom.
e.zh: 那所旧宗教学校也被用作社区教室。

muktuk.t: 鲸皮脂；因纽特鲸肉食品

e.en: The family shared {muktuk} after the successful hunt.
e.zh: 捕猎成功后，一家人分食鲸皮脂。

e.en: Visitors were offered {muktuk}, a traditional Arctic food.
e.zh: 来访者被招待品尝鲸皮脂，这是一种传统北极食物。

mulatta.t: 混血女性；旧时冒犯称呼

e.en: The archive described her as a {mulatta}, using the language of that era.
e.zh: 档案用那个时代的说法称她为混血女性。

e.en: Today, calling someone a {mulatta} is usually considered offensive.
e.zh: 如今称某人为这个词通常被认为带有冒犯性。

mulattress.t: 混血女性；古旧冒犯称呼

e.en: The legal document used {mulattress}, an archaic racial term.
e.zh: 那份法律文件用了“mulattress”这个古旧的种族称呼。

e.en: She noted that {mulattress} appears mostly in historical texts.
e.zh: 她指出这个词大多出现在历史文本中。

e.en: The {mule-driver} led the animals up the rocky path.
e.zh: 赶骡人带着那些牲口沿着多石的小路上山。

e.en: A tired {mule-driver} waited outside the market gate.
e.zh: 一个疲惫的骡夫在市场门外等着。

e.en: The {muleteer} guided the pack animals across the pass.
e.zh: 赶骡人引着驮畜穿过山口。

e.en: In the travel diary, a local {muleteer} knew every mountain trail.
e.zh: 在那本旅行日记里，当地骡夫熟悉每一条山路。

e.en: The critic praised the poem's {muliebral} tenderness.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这首诗具有女性般的温柔。

e.en: Her essay explored {muliebral} power in medieval literature.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了中世纪文学中的女性力量。

e.en: The medical manuscript referred to the {muliebria} in Latinized terms.
e.zh: 那份医学手稿用拉丁化词语指称女性生殖器。

e.en: Victorian writers often avoided direct mention of the {muliebria}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时期作家常避免直接提到女性私处。

e.en: The portrait emphasizes her {muliebrity} without making her passive.
e.zh: 这幅肖像突出她的女性气质，却没有把她表现得被动。

e.en: The essay questions old ideas of {muliebrity} and virtue.
e.zh: 这篇文章质疑关于女性气质与美德的旧观念。

e.en: The court considered his {mulierty} when deciding the inheritance.
e.zh: 法院在判定继承权时考虑了他的婚生身份。

e.en: In old law, {mulierty} could affect a child's claim to land.
e.zh: 在旧法律中，婚生身份可能影响孩子对土地的主张。

e.en: The village {mulla} led the evening prayers.
e.zh: 村里的毛拉主持了晚间祈祷。

e.en: A respected {mulla} advised the family on religious matters.
e.zh: 一位受尊敬的伊斯兰教士就宗教事务给这家人建议。

e.en: The article criticized {mullahism} as a barrier to reform.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评毛拉制度阻碍改革。

e.en: They used {mullahism} to describe rule by conservative clerics.
e.zh: 他们用这个词来描述保守教士的统治。

e.en: Don't believe that {mullarkey} about instant riches.
e.zh: 别相信那套一夜暴富的胡说八道。

e.en: His excuse sounded like pure {mullarkey} to everyone.
e.zh: 他的借口在大家听来完全是废话。

e.en: The butterflies showed {Mullerian} mimicry in their warning colors.
e.zh: 这些蝴蝶在警戒色上表现出缪勒式拟态。

e.en: The lecture compared {Mullerian} and Batesian mimicry.
e.zh: 讲座比较了缪勒式拟态和贝茨式拟态。

mucopurulent.t: 含黏液和脓的分泌物或症状

e.en: The doctor noted a {mucopurulent} discharge from the wound.
e.zh: 医生注意到伤口有黏液脓性分泌物。

e.en: A {mucopurulent} cough may suggest a bacterial infection.
e.zh: 黏液脓性咳嗽可能提示细菌感染。

e.en: The nurse recorded a {mucosanguineous} fluid in the drainage bag.
e.zh: 护士记录引流袋里有带黏液和血的液体。

e.en: A {mucosanguineous} stool alarmed the patient's family.
e.zh: 带黏液和血的大便让病人的家属很担心。

e.en: The lab described the sample as {mucoserous} material.
e.zh: 实验室把样本描述为黏液浆液性物质。

e.en: A thin {mucoserous} discharge appeared after the procedure.
e.zh: 手术后出现了稀薄的黏液浆液性分泌物。

e.en: The sauce had an unpleasant {mucosity} after cooling.
e.zh: 酱汁冷却后出现了令人不适的黏稠感。

e.en: Doctors measured the {mucosity} of the airway secretions.
e.zh: 医生测量了气道分泌物的黏液性。

e.en: The botanist pointed out the tiny {mucro} at the leaf tip.
e.zh: 植物学家指出叶尖上的微小尖突。

e.en: Each seed ended in a sharp {mucro}.
e.zh: 每粒种子的末端都有一个尖锐的小尖头。

e.en: The plant has {mucronate} leaves with stiff tips.
e.zh: 这种植物有带硬尖突的叶子。

e.en: A {mucronate} shell can feel slightly prickly.
e.zh: 有小尖突的壳摸起来会有点扎手。

e.en: The specimen showed a {mucronated} edge under the lens.
e.zh: 标本在镜头下显示出带小尖突的边缘。

e.en: Several {mucronated} scales covered the insect's body.
e.zh: 昆虫身体上覆盖着几片带小尖突的鳞片。

e.en: The grass seeds carry tiny {mucrones} at their ends.
e.zh: 这些草籽末端带有细小尖突。

e.en: Under magnification, the {mucrones} looked like minute hooks.
e.zh: 放大后，这些小尖突看起来像极小的钩子。

e.en: The leaf margin is finely {mucronulate}.
e.zh: 叶缘带有非常细小的尖突。

e.en: A {mucronulate} surface helped identify the species.
e.zh: 具极小尖突的表面帮助辨认了这个物种。

e.en: The old house was built from {mud-brick} walls.
e.zh: 那座老房子是用土坯砖墙建成的。

e.en: They repaired the oven with handmade {mud-brick}.
e.zh: 他们用手工泥砖修补了炉子。

e.en: Birds gathered on the {mud-flat} at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时，鸟群聚集在泥滩上。

e.en: The boat was stranded beside a wide {mud-flat}.
e.zh: 船搁浅在一大片潮泥滩旁边。

e.en: She applied a {mud-pack} before the massage.
e.zh: 按摩前她敷了一层泥膜。

e.en: The spa sells a mineral {mud-pack} for sore muscles.
e.zh: 这家水疗中心出售用于缓解肌肉酸痛的矿物泥敷产品。

e.en: The campaign collapsed into ugly {mud-slinging}.
e.zh: 竞选陷入了难看的相互抹黑。

e.en: She refused to join the online {mud-slinging}.
e.zh: 她拒绝参与网上的恶意诽谤。

e.en: A low {mud-wall} surrounded the courtyard.
e.zh: 院子周围有一堵低矮的土墙。

e.en: Rain slowly weakened the village {mud-wall}.
e.zh: 雨水慢慢削弱了村里的泥墙。

e.en: The manager called the extra paperwork {muda}.
e.zh: 经理把多余的文书工作称为浪费。

e.en: Lean teams try to remove {muda} from daily operations.
e.zh: 精益团队会努力消除日常运营中的无价值作业。

e.en: The child threw a {mudball} at the fence.
e.zh: 孩子朝篱笆扔了一个泥球。

e.en: A {mudball} stuck to the tire after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，一个泥团粘在轮胎上。

e.en: Tourists booked a warm {mudbath} at the resort.
e.zh: 游客在度假村预订了温热泥浴。

e.en: After the race, the field looked like a giant {mudbath}.
e.zh: 比赛结束后，场地看起来像一个巨大的泥浆浴池。

e.en: Geologists found a hard {mudcap} above the deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家在矿床上方发现了一层坚硬的泥质覆盖层。

e.en: The drilling team monitored pressure under the {mudcap}.
e.zh: 钻井队监测泥帽下方的压力。

e.en: He caught a heavy {mudcat} in the river.
e.zh: 他在河里钓到一条很重的鲶鱼。

e.en: A {mudcat} can survive in cloudy, shallow water.
e.zh: 鲶鱼能在浑浊的浅水中生存。

e.en: The water flowed {muddily} through the ditch.
e.zh: 水浑浊地流过沟渠。

e.en: He answered {muddily} and avoided the main point.
e.zh: 他回答得含糊不清，避开了要点。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {mugearite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这块样品鉴定为粗面玄武岩。

e.en: Layers of {mugearite} marked an old volcanic flow.
e.zh: 多层粗面玄武岩显示那里曾有古老的火山流。

e.en: She drank a {mugful} of hot tea.
e.zh: 她喝了一大杯热茶。

e.en: Add one {mugful} of stock to the pan.
e.zh: 往锅里加一大杯高汤。

e.en: A {muggar} rested near the riverbank.
e.zh: 一条沼泽鳄在河岸附近休息。

e.en: Villagers avoid the pool where the {muggar} hunts.
e.zh: 村民避开那片沼泽鳄出没捕食的水潭。

e.en: The {muggee} reported the attack immediately.
e.zh: 那名被抢劫者立即报了案。

e.en: A shaken {muggee} described the thief to police.
e.zh: 一名受惊的被抢劫者向警方描述了小偷。

e.en: Stop {muggin} around and finish your work.
e.zh: 别再瞎胡闹了，把你的活干完。

e.en: He was {muggin} for the camera again.
e.zh: 他又在镜头前装傻逗乐。

e.en: The {mugginess} made the room feel airless.
e.zh: 闷热潮湿让房间显得不透气。

e.en: By noon, the {mugginess} had become exhausting.
e.zh: 到中午时，那种闷热潮湿已经让人疲惫不堪。

e.en: Some {muggins} forgot to lock the door.
e.zh: 某个傻瓜忘了锁门。

e.en: I was the {muggins} who paid for everyone.
e.zh: 我就是那个倒霉蛋，替所有人付了钱。

e.en: In the story, a {muggle} has no magic.
e.zh: 在这个故事里，麻瓜没有魔法。

e.en: To programmers, I felt like a complete {muggle}.
e.zh: 在程序员面前，我觉得自己完全是个外行。

e.en: The {muggler} ran down a side street.
e.zh: 那名抢劫者沿着一条小街跑走了。

e.en: Police caught the {muggler} near the station.
e.zh: 警方在车站附近抓住了那名抢劫者。

e.en: The wizard hid his wand from the {muggles}.
e.zh: 巫师把魔杖藏起来，不让麻瓜们看见。

e.en: This guide explains coding for {muggles}.
e.zh: 这本指南是给编程外行人看的。

e.en: The old book calls the crocodile a {muggur}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把这种鳄鱼称为沼泽鳄。

e.en: A {muggur} can lie almost hidden in muddy water.
e.zh: 沼泽鳄能几乎完全隐在浑水里。

e.en: Sailors crowded the {mughouse} after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后，水手们挤满了那家小酒馆。

e.en: The old {mughouse} served cheap ale.
e.zh: 那家老啤酒店供应便宜的麦芽酒。

e.en: A {mugient} sound rose from the field.
e.zh: 田野里传来一阵像牛叫的声音。

e.en: The poet described the storm as {mugient}.
e.zh: 诗人把那场风暴描写得如牛吼一般。

e.en: The {mugman} demanded his wallet at knifepoint.
e.zh: 那名抢劫犯持刀逼他交出钱包。

e.en: A suspected {mugman} was arrested downtown.
e.zh: 一名疑似抢劫犯在市中心被捕。

e.en: She dried {mugwort} for herbal tea.
e.zh: 她把艾草晒干，用来泡草药茶。

e.en: Wild {mugwort} grew beside the path.
e.zh: 路边长着野生艾草。

e.en: The senator ran as a {mugwump} reformer.
e.zh: 那位参议员以独立改革派的身份参选。

e.en: Critics called him a {mugwump} with no loyalty.
e.zh: 批评者说他是没有忠诚立场的骑墙派。

e.en: His {mugwumpery} annoyed both political camps.
e.zh: 他的骑墙态度惹恼了两个政治阵营。

e.en: The editorial mocked the candidate's cautious {mugwumpery}.
e.zh: 社论嘲讽了那名候选人谨慎的独立派作风。

e.en: Early reformers defended {mugwumpism} as honest politics.
e.zh: 早期改革者把独立派思想辩护为诚实的政治。

e.en: Party leaders disliked his open {mugwumpism}.
e.zh: 党内领袖不喜欢他公开的骑墙主义。

e.en: Older writers sometimes used {Muhammadanism} for Islam.
e.zh: 早期作者有时用“穆罕默德教”这个旧称来指伊斯兰教。

e.en: The term {Muhammadanism} is now considered outdated.
e.zh: “穆罕默德教”这个说法如今被认为已经过时。

e.en: The {muhtar} signed the village certificate.
e.zh: 村长在村里的证明文件上签了字。

e.en: Residents brought their complaint to the {muhtar}.
e.zh: 居民把投诉提交给了地方长官。

e.en: The river's {muddiness} made swimming unsafe.
e.zh: 河水浑浊，游泳不安全。

e.en: The {muddiness} of his argument confused everyone.
e.zh: 他的论点含混不清，让大家都困惑了。

e.en: His {muddle-headed} plan ignored the budget completely.
e.zh: 他那糊涂的计划完全没考虑预算。

e.en: She felt {muddle-headed} after the long night shift.
e.zh: 上完漫长的夜班后，她觉得脑子发蒙。

e.en: The office descended into {muddledom} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并之后，办公室陷入一片混乱。

e.en: His notes were a private kingdom of {muddledom}.
e.zh: 他的笔记简直是他个人的糊涂王国。

e.en: A {muddleheaded} answer will not satisfy the committee.
e.zh: 一个思路混乱的回答无法让委员会满意。

e.en: He became {muddleheaded} whenever numbers were discussed.
e.zh: 一讨论数字，他就变得糊里糊涂。

e.en: She {muddleheadedly} agreed to two meetings at once.
e.zh: 她糊里糊涂地同时答应了两个会议。

e.en: He explained the rule {muddleheadedly} and lost the class.
e.zh: 他把规则讲得乱七八糟，全班都听不懂。

e.en: His {muddleheadedness} caused several costly mistakes.
e.zh: 他的糊涂造成了几次代价高昂的错误。

e.en: Fatigue can bring on surprising {muddleheadedness}.
e.zh: 疲劳会让人出现意想不到的头脑混乱。

e.en: The word {muderer} appears to be a misspelling of murderer.
e.zh: muderer 这个词似乎是 murderer 的拼写错误。

e.en: The old pamphlet printed {muderer} instead of murderer.
e.zh: 那本旧小册子把 murderer 印成了 muderer。

e.en: The boat stuck fast on the {mudfat}.
e.zh: 小船牢牢搁浅在泥滩上。

e.en: Birds searched the {mudfat} for worms at low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时，鸟儿在泥滩上寻找虫子。

mudfish.t: 泥鱼；能在泥中生存的鱼

e.en: A {mudfish} can survive in shallow, muddy water.
e.zh: 泥鱼能在又浅又浑的水里生存。

e.en: The children watched a {mudfish} wriggle near the bank.
e.zh: 孩子们看着一条泥鱼在岸边扭动。

e.en: The truck lost a {mudflap} on the highway.
e.zh: 那辆卡车在高速路上掉了一块挡泥板。

e.en: A loose {mudflap} rattled behind the rear wheel.
e.zh: 一块松动的挡泥板在后轮后面咔嗒作响。

e.en: The {mudir} collected taxes for the district.
e.zh: 那位地方长官为该地区征税。

e.en: Villagers brought their complaint to the {mudir}.
e.zh: 村民把申诉带到行政主管那里。

mudlark.t: 泰晤士河拾荒者；泥滩寻物者

e.en: The {mudlark} searched the riverbank for old coins.
e.zh: 那名泥滩寻物者在河岸寻找旧硬币。

e.en: In Victorian London, a {mudlark} often lived in poverty.
e.zh: 在维多利亚时代的伦敦，河边拾荒者常常生活贫困。

mudlarks.t: 泥滩寻物者；河边拾荒者

e.en: Modern {mudlarks} often need permits to search the Thames.
e.zh: 现代泥滩寻物者通常需要许可证才能在泰晤士河边搜寻。

e.en: The book describes poor {mudlarks} working at low tide.
e.zh: 这本书描写了退潮时劳作的贫苦河边拾荒者。

e.en: The dancer formed a graceful {mudra} with her fingers.
e.zh: 舞者用手指做出一个优雅的手印。

e.en: This {mudra} is used during meditation practice.
e.zh: 这个手势用于冥想练习中。

e.en: The statue's {mudras} carry religious meaning.
e.zh: 雕像的手印带有宗教含义。

e.en: She learned several {mudras} in her yoga class.
e.zh: 她在瑜伽课上学了几种手势。

e.en: The carpenter replaced the rotten {mudsill}.
e.zh: 木匠更换了腐烂的基础横木。

e.en: The speech treated workers as the nation's {mudsill}.
e.zh: 那场演说把工人称作国家的社会底层。

mudskipper.t: 弹涂鱼；会爬上泥滩的鱼

e.en: A {mudskipper} hopped across the wet mud.
e.zh: 一条弹涂鱼在湿泥上跳动。

e.en: The {mudskipper} can breathe through its skin for a time.
e.zh: 弹涂鱼能在一段时间内通过皮肤呼吸。

e.en: The candidate called his rival a {mudslinger}.
e.zh: 那名候选人称对手是抹黑者。

e.en: A professional {mudslinger} fed rumors to the press.
e.zh: 一个职业造谣中伤者向媒体散布谣言。

e.en: The debate turned into ugly {mudslinging}.
e.zh: 那场辩论变成了难看的相互抹黑。

e.en: Voters were tired of the campaign's {mudslinging}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了竞选中的造谣中伤。

e.en: She melted {muenster} over the sandwich.
e.zh: 她把明斯特奶酪融在三明治上。

e.en: The deli sells mild {muenster} by the slice.
e.zh: 那家熟食店按片出售味道温和的明斯特奶酪。

e.en: She knitted a {muffetee} for each wrist.
e.zh: 她给每只手腕都织了一个护腕。

e.en: The museum displayed a lace {muffetee} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件十九世纪的蕾丝暖袖。

e.en: The {muffin-man} rang a bell in the street.
e.zh: 卖松饼的人在街上摇铃叫卖。

e.en: Children sang about the {muffin-man} from Drury Lane.
e.zh: 孩子们唱着关于德鲁里巷松饼小贩的歌。

e.en: A cheerful {muffineer} served breakfast near the station.
e.zh: 一位开朗的松饼商贩在车站附近供应早餐。

e.en: The old story follows a poor {muffineer} through London.
e.zh: 那个老故事讲述一名贫穷的松饼小贩在伦敦的经历。

e.en: His {mullet-headed} plan failed within an hour.
e.zh: 他那个愚蠢的计划不到一小时就失败了。

e.en: She ignored the {mullet-headed} remarks from the crowd.
e.zh: 她没有理会人群中那些笨头笨脑的评论。

e.en: The farmer kept a gentle {mulley} in the lower field.
e.zh: 农夫在低处的田里养了一头温顺的无角牛。

e.en: A {mulley} cow is easier to handle in a narrow stall.
e.zh: 无角奶牛在狭窄的牛栏里更容易照看。

e.en: She ordered {mulligatawny} before the roast chicken arrived.
e.zh: 烤鸡上桌前，她点了一份咖喱肉汤。

e.en: The hotel served a mild {mulligatawny} with rice.
e.zh: 酒店供应了一道配米饭的温和印度辣汤。

e.en: After losing the match, Tom had the {mulligrubs} all evening.
e.zh: 输掉比赛后，汤姆整个晚上都闷闷不乐。

e.en: Too much cider gave him the {mulligrubs} before dawn.
e.zh: 苹果酒喝太多让他天亮前就肚子不舒服。

mullite.t: 莫来石；耐火铝硅酸盐矿物

e.en: The furnace lining contains {mullite} for heat resistance.
e.zh: 炉衬含有莫来石，以提高耐热性。

e.en: Engineers tested the {mullite} ceramic under extreme temperatures.
e.zh: 工程师在极端高温下测试了这种莫来石陶瓷。

e.en: The miners dumped {mullock} beside the old shaft.
e.zh: 矿工把废石倒在旧矿井旁边。

e.en: Rain washed loose {mullock} down the hillside.
e.zh: 雨水把松散的矿渣冲下山坡。

mulloway.t: 澳洲石首鱼；大型食用鱼

e.en: They caught a large {mulloway} near the river mouth.
e.zh: 他们在河口附近钓到一条很大的澳洲石首鱼。

e.en: Fresh {mulloway} is popular in many coastal restaurants.
e.zh: 新鲜的澳洲石首鱼在许多海边餐馆很受欢迎。

e.en: The baby was wrapped in soft {mulmul} cloth.
e.zh: 婴儿被裹在柔软的细棉布里。

e.en: Her summer dress was made from white {mulmul}.
e.zh: 她的夏裙是用白色细软薄棉布做的。

e.en: The meter uses a {mulplier-resistor} to extend its range.
e.zh: 这个仪表使用倍增电阻器来扩大量程。

e.en: A faulty {mulplier-resistor} caused the voltage reading to drift.
e.zh: 一个故障的倍增电阻器导致电压读数发生漂移。

e.en: The report contained {mulriple} spelling errors.
e.zh: 这份报告里有多处拼写错误。

e.en: She checked {mulriple} sources before publishing the article.
e.zh: 她在发表文章前查核了多个来源。

e.en: The banquet ended with cups of warm {mulse}.
e.zh: 宴会以几杯温热的蜂蜜酒收尾。

e.en: Ancient writers often mentioned {mulse} as a sweet drink.
e.zh: 古代作者常把蜂蜜酒称作一种甜饮。

e.en: The architect designed a {multangular} tower for the plaza.
e.zh: 建筑师为广场设计了一座多角形塔楼。

e.en: A {multangular} crystal caught the light beautifully.
e.zh: 一块多角晶体漂亮地折射着光线。

e.en: The essay celebrates the {multeity} of modern city life.
e.zh: 这篇文章赞美现代城市生活的多样性。

e.en: He struggled to describe the {multeity} of voices in the debate.
e.zh: 他很难描述辩论中众多声音并存的状态。

multi-access.t: 多用户访问的；多路接入的

e.en: The database supports {multi-access} editing by several teams.
e.zh: 这个数据库支持多个团队同时访问和编辑。

e.en: Engineers improved the {multi-access} channel for mobile users.
e.zh: 工程师改进了面向移动用户的多路接入信道。

multi-address.t: 多地址的；含多个地址的

e.en: The processor handled a {multi-address} instruction in one cycle.
e.zh: 处理器在一个周期内处理了一条多地址指令。

e.en: She created a {multi-address} mailing label for the shipment.
e.zh: 她为这批货制作了含多个地址的邮寄标签。

e.en: The package includes {multi-arch} builds for Linux servers.
e.zh: 这个软件包包含适用于 Linux 服务器的多架构构建。

e.en: They tested the {multi-arch} image on both ARM and x86 machines.
e.zh: 他们在 ARM 和 x86 机器上测试了这个多架构镜像。

e.en: The company announced a {multi-billion-dollar} merger yesterday.
e.zh: 那家公司昨天宣布了一项数十亿美元的并购。

e.en: They are building a {multi-billion-dollar} rail project.
e.zh: 他们正在建设一个耗资数十亿美元的铁路项目。

e.en: The lens has a {multi-coating} to reduce glare.
e.zh: 这枚镜头有多层镀膜，可以减少眩光。

e.en: A durable {multi-coating} protects the metal from corrosion.
e.zh: 耐用的多层涂层能保护金属免受腐蚀。

e.en: The printer can produce {multi-color} labels quickly.
e.zh: 这台打印机能快速制作多色标签。

e.en: She chose a {multi-color} pattern for the festival banner.
e.zh: 她为节日横幅选了一个多色图案。

e.en: Children carried {multi-colored} balloons through the park.
e.zh: 孩子们拿着五颜六色的气球穿过公园。

e.en: The map used {multi-colored} lines for different routes.
e.zh: 这张地图用多种颜色的线条表示不同路线。

e.en: The garden was full of {multi-coloured} lights.

e.zh: 宪法把这个国家描述为多民族国家。

e.en: A {multination} force was sent to monitor the ceasefire.
e.zh: 一支多国联合部队被派去监督停火。

multinationalism.t: 多民族主义；跨国经营理念

e.en: The lecture examined {multinationalism} in modern empires.
e.zh: 讲座考察了现代帝国中的多民族主义。

e.en: Corporate {multinationalism} changed how products were designed and sold.
e.zh: 企业跨国经营理念改变了产品的设计和销售方式。

e.en: The function is {multiple-valued} at that point.
e.zh: 这个函数在那一点是多值的。

e.en: A {multiple-valued} field can store several phone numbers.
e.zh: 多值字段可以存储多个电话号码。

e.en: The old statute mentioned {multiplepoinding} in property disputes.
e.zh: 这部旧法规在财产纠纷中提到重复扣押索赔。

e.en: The lawyer found a rare case of {multiplepoinding}.
e.zh: 律师找到了一起罕见的重复扣押财物索赔案。

e.en: The lab ordered a {multiplestand} for the microscopes.
e.zh: 实验室订购了一个显微镜多工位支架。

e.en: A {multiplestand} kept several instruments within reach.
e.zh: 多座架让几件仪器都放在手边。

e.en: The spectrum showed a clear {multiplet} near the center.
e.zh: 光谱中央附近显示出清晰的多线谱。

e.en: Physicists described the particles as a {multiplet}.
e.zh: 物理学家把这些粒子描述为一个多重态。

e.en: Only compatible matrices are {multipliable} in this order.
e.zh: 只有相容矩阵才能按这个顺序相乘。

e.en: The strain proved {multipliable} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 在受控条件下，这种菌株证明可以增殖。

e.en: The two quantities are {multiplicable} without changing units.
e.zh: 这两个量可以相乘而不必改变单位。

e.en: The process is {multiplicable} across several factories.
e.zh: 这个流程可以在几家工厂中复制扩展。

e.en: In 6 x 7, 6 is the {multiplicand}.
e.zh: 在六乘以七中，六是被乘数。

e.en: The teacher asked students to identify the {multiplicand}.
e.zh: 老师让学生指出被乘数。

e.en: The formula will {multiplicate} the two values.
e.zh: 这个公式会把两个数值相乘。

e.en: Small errors can {multiplicate} across the system.
e.zh: 小错误可能在整个系统中倍增。

e.en: The {multiplicated} result appeared in the final column.
e.zh: 相乘后的结果显示在最后一列。

e.en: Their troubles were {multiplicated} by poor planning.
e.zh: 计划不周使他们的麻烦成倍增加。

e.en: The device acted as a signal {multiplicator}.
e.zh: 这个装置起到了信号倍增器的作用。

e.en: Enter the {multiplicator} before running the calculation.
e.zh: 运行计算前先输入乘数。

e.en: The region saw gradual {multipolarization} after the alliance weakened.
e.zh: 联盟削弱后，该地区逐渐出现多极化。

e.en: Market {multipolarization} created several competing centers.
e.zh: 市场多极分化形成了几个竞争中心。

e.en: The antenna used a compact {multipole} design.
e.zh: 这根天线采用了紧凑的多极设计。

e.en: The equation includes a magnetic {multipole}.
e.zh: 这个方程包含一个磁多极子。

e.en: Stem-cell {multipotency} declines as tissues mature.
e.zh: 随着组织成熟，干细胞的多能性会下降。

e.en: The study measured {multipotency} in cultured cells.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了培养细胞的多向分化能力。

e.en: Bone marrow contains {multipotent} stem cells.
e.zh: 骨髓中含有多能干细胞。

e.en: These {multipotent} cells can form several blood-cell types.
e.zh: 这些多向分化细胞能形成多种血细胞。

e.en: The counselor called her a {multipotential} learner.
e.zh: 顾问称她是一个多潜能学习者。

e.en: A {multipotential} cell may follow different developmental paths.
e.zh: 多潜能细胞可能走向不同的发育路径。

e.en: The controller is {multiprogrammable} for different machines.
e.zh: 这个控制器可针对不同机器进行多重编程。

e.en: A {multiprogrammable} chip reduced the need for separate boards.
e.zh: 可多重编程芯片减少了对独立电路板的需求。

e.en: The city launched a {multipronged} plan to reduce traffic.
e.zh: 这座城市推出了多管齐下的减堵计划。

e.en: Their {multipronged} attack combined legal and media pressure.
e.zh: 他们的多方面攻势结合法律和媒体压力。

e.en: The operator used a {multipunch} to prepare the cards.
e.zh: 操作员用多孔打孔机准备卡片。

e.en: A {multipunch} process made the metal plate faster.
e.zh: 多孔冲压工艺让金属板加工更快。

e.en: The party promoted {multiracialism} in its constitution.
e.zh: 该党在章程中倡导多种族共存主义。

e.en: Public schools became symbols of {multiracialism}.
e.zh: 公立学校成了多种族共存理念的象征。

e.en: The technician selected a {multirange} meter for the job.
e.zh: 技术员为这项工作选择了多量程仪表。

e.en: A {multirange} sensor can read both low and high pressure.
e.zh: 多范围传感器能读取低压和高压。

e.en: Doctors isolated a {multiresistant} strain of bacteria.
e.zh: 医生分离出一种多重耐药菌株。

e.en: The farm reported {multiresistant} weeds after years of spraying.
e.zh: 多年喷药后，农场报告出现了多抗性杂草。

e.en: The air force bought a {multirole} fighter jet.
e.zh: 空军购买了一种多用途战斗机。

e.en: She prefers a {multirole} position in a small company.
e.zh: 她更喜欢在小公司担任多角色职位。

e.en: The drill supports {multirotation} during complex cuts.
e.zh: 这台钻机在复杂切削时支持多重旋转。

e.en: The program uses {multirotation} to train staff in several departments.
e.zh: 该项目通过多次轮换让员工在多个部门受训。

e.en: The table has a {multirow} header for each category.
e.zh: 这张表为每个类别设置了多行表头。

e.en: Use a {multirow} layout when labels are long.
e.zh: 标签较长时使用多行布局。

e.en: The team performed a {multirun} test overnight.
e.zh: 团队连夜进行了多次运行测试。

e.en: A {multirun} strategy averaged the simulation results.
e.zh: 多轮策略对模拟结果取了平均值。

multinuclear.t: 多核的；多原子核的；多细胞核的

e.en: The physicist studied a {multinuclear} metal complex.
e.zh: 这位物理学家研究了一种多核金属配合物。

e.en: Some diseased cells become {multinuclear} under the microscope.
e.zh: 有些病变细胞在显微镜下会呈现多细胞核。

multinucleate.t: 多核的；有多个细胞核的

e.en: The fungus forms {multinucleate} filaments during growth.
e.zh: 这种真菌在生长时会形成多核丝状结构。

e.en: A {multinucleate} cell contains more than one nucleus.
e.zh: 多核细胞含有不止一个细胞核。

multinucleated.t: 多核的；具有多个细胞核的

e.en: The biopsy showed several {multinucleated} giant cells.
e.zh: 活检显示有几个多核巨细胞。

e.en: Researchers observed {multinucleated} muscle fibers in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员在样本中观察到多核肌纤维。

e.en: She bought a {multipack} of yogurt for the week.
e.zh: 她买了一组酸奶，准备这一周喝。

e.en: The batteries are cheaper in a {multipack}.
e.zh: 这些电池买多件装更便宜。

e.en: Engineers tested the antenna for {multipactor} discharge.
e.zh: 工程师测试天线是否会发生多重电子倍增放电。

e.en: A strong microwave field can trigger {multipactor} in a vacuum device.
e.zh: 强微波场可能在真空器件中触发多重电子倍增效应。

e.en: The doctor classified her as a {multipara}.
e.zh: 医生把她归为经产妇。

e.en: A {multipara} may have different labor patterns than a first-time mother.
e.zh: 经产妇的分娩过程可能与初产妇不同。

e.en: The study examined {multiparasitism} in infected insects.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了受感染昆虫中的多重寄生现象。

e.en: Heavy {multiparasitism} can weaken the host animal quickly.
e.zh: 严重的多重寄生会很快削弱宿主动物。

e.en: The clinic tracks outcomes for {multiparous} women.
e.zh: 诊所会跟踪经产妇的妊娠结果。

e.en: A {multiparous} ewe often delivers twins.
e.zh: 多产的母羊常常产下双胞胎。

e.en: The journal published a {multipart} investigation.
e.zh: 这家期刊发表了一篇分多部分的调查报道。

e.en: Email software can handle a {multipart} message with attachments.
e.zh: 电子邮件软件可以处理带附件的多部分邮件。

multipartial.t: 多偏的；涉及多方偏向的

e.en: The critic called the report {multipartial} rather than neutral.
e.zh: 评论者称这份报告有多方偏向，而不是中立。

e.en: A {multipartial} approach may favor several groups at once.
e.zh: 多偏的做法可能同时偏向几个群体。

multipartite.t: 多部分组成的；多方参与的

e.en: They signed a {multipartite} treaty after months of talks.
e.zh: 经过数月谈判，他们签署了一项多方条约。

e.en: The plant has a {multipartite} leaf structure.
e.zh: 这种植物具有多部分组成的叶片结构。

multipass.t: 多遍处理的；多次通过的

e.en: The editor used a {multipass} encoding process.
e.zh: 编辑使用了多遍编码流程。

e.en: A {multipass} filter can improve the final image.
e.zh: 多次通过的滤镜可以改善最终图像。

e.en: Tall buildings caused {multipath} interference with the signal.
e.zh: 高楼造成了信号的多径干扰。

e.en: The storage system supports {multipath} access to disks.
e.zh: 这个存储系统支持对磁盘的多路径访问。

e.en: The child drew a strange {multiped} creature.
e.zh: 孩子画了一个奇怪的多足生物。

e.en: A centipede is a familiar {multiped} animal.
e.zh: 蜈蚣是一种常见的多足动物。

e.en: The circuit uses a {multipexer} to select one input.
e.zh: 该电路使用复用器来选择一个输入。

e.en: A faulty {multipexer} can corrupt several data channels.
e.zh: 有故障的复用器可能破坏多个数据通道。

e.en: The company launched a {multiphase} expansion plan.
e.zh: 公司启动了一项多阶段扩张计划。

e.en: Engineers modeled {multiphase} flow in the pipeline.
e.zh: 工程师对管道中的多相流进行了建模。

e.en: The board includes a {multiphotocoupler} for signal isolation.
e.zh: 这块电路板包含一个用于信号隔离的多路光耦合器。

e.en: A {multiphotocoupler} can connect several optical channels.
e.zh: 多路光耦合器可以连接多个光通道。

e.en: The lab uses {multiphoton} microscopy to image tissue.
e.zh: 实验室使用多光子显微技术来成像组织。

e.en: A {multiphoton} process requires several photons at once.
e.zh: 多光子过程需要多个光子同时参与。

e.en: The hospital installed a {multiplane} imaging system.
e.zh: 医院安装了一套多平面成像系统。

e.en: Animators once used a {multiplane} camera for depth.
e.zh: 动画师过去曾用多平面摄影机来表现纵深感。

multiplayer.t: 多人游戏的；多人玩家模式

e.en: We played a {multiplayer} game after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后我们玩了一款多人游戏。

e.en: The update added a new {multiplayer} mode.
e.zh: 这次更新增加了新的多人玩家模式。

e.en: The chip supports {multiple-address} instruction formats.
e.zh: 这款芯片支持多地址指令格式。

e.en: A {multiple-address} system can reference several locations at once.
e.zh: 多地址系统可以同时引用多个位置。

multiple-choice.t: 多项选择的；选择题式的

e.en: The exam has twenty {multiple-choice} questions.
e.zh: 这场考试有二十道选择题。

e.en: She prefers {multiple-choice} tests to essays.
e.zh: 比起论文题，她更喜欢多项选择题考试。

e.en: The factory uses a {multiple-effect} evaporator.
e.zh: 这家工厂使用多效蒸发器。

e.en: A {multiple-effect} process saves heat and energy.
e.zh: 多效工艺可以节省热量和能源。

e.en: The printer has a {multiple-nozzle} ink head.
e.zh: 这台打印机有一个多喷嘴墨头。

e.en: A {multiple-nozzle} sprayer covers the field faster.
e.zh: 多喷嘴喷洒器能更快覆盖整片田地。

e.en: They reached a {multiple-party} agreement on trade.
e.zh: 他们就贸易达成了一项多方协议。

e.en: The country moved toward a {multiple-party} political system.
e.zh: 该国开始走向多党派政治制度。

e.en: The team built a {multiscale} model of the climate system.
e.zh: 团队建立了一个气候系统的多尺度模型。

e.en: Her research uses {multiscale} imaging to study bone structure.
e.zh: 她的研究用多尺度成像来观察骨骼结构。

e.en: The conference room has a {multiscreen} presentation setup.
e.zh: 会议室配有多屏演示设备。

e.en: Viewers now expect {multiscreen} access to live sports.
e.zh: 观众现在期待能通过多屏观看体育直播。

e.en: They rented a {multiseater} van for the family trip.
e.zh: 他们为家庭旅行租了一辆多人座面包车。

e.en: The company tested a compact {multiseater} aircraft design.
e.zh: 公司测试了一款紧凑型多座飞机设计。

e.en: The dictionary marks each {multisense} word with separate meanings.
e.zh: 这本词典会把每个多义词的不同含义分开标注。

e.en: The exhibit offered a {multisense} experience with sound and touch.
e.zh: 这个展览通过声音和触摸提供了多感官体验。

e.en: The archive contains {multiserial} data from several experiments.
e.zh: 档案中包含来自多项实验的多序列数据。

e.en: A {multiserial} novel can follow several linked storylines.
e.zh: 多系列小说可以展开几条相互关联的故事线。

e.en: The therapist recommended a {multisession} treatment plan.
e.zh: 治疗师建议采用多次会话的治疗方案。

e.en: This is a {multisession} course, so attendance matters.
e.zh: 这是一门多场次课程，因此出勤很重要。

e.en: The factory runs a {multishift} schedule during peak season.
e.zh: 旺季时工厂实行多班次排班。

e.en: A {multishift} gearbox helped the machine handle varied loads.
e.zh: 多档变速箱帮助机器应对不同负载。

e.en: The manual describes a {multishotfiring} mechanism for the device.
e.zh: 手册说明了该装置的多次射击发火机制。

e.en: Engineers tested the {multishotfiring} sequence under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 工程师在受控条件下测试了多次射击发火序列。

e.en: The bridge uses a {multislab} deck to spread heavy loads.
e.zh: 这座桥采用多板块桥面来分散重载。

e.en: A {multislab} concrete wall improved the building's insulation.
e.zh: 多层板混凝土墙提升了建筑的隔热性能。

multistandard.t: 支持多标准的；多规范的

e.en: The phone includes a {multistandard} radio for different networks.
e.zh: 这部手机内置支持多标准的无线电模块，可连接不同网络。

e.en: A {multistandard} policy must satisfy several industry rules.
e.zh: 多规范政策必须满足多个行业规则。

e.en: Police coordinated a {multistate} search for the missing truck.
e.zh: 警方协调了跨多州的失踪卡车搜寻行动。

e.en: The circuit uses a {multistate} switch to store more information.
e.zh: 该电路使用多状态开关来存储更多信息。

e.en: They moved into a {multistoried} apartment building downtown.
e.zh: 他们搬进了市中心一栋多层公寓楼。

e.en: The {multistoried} library has study rooms on every floor.
e.zh: 这座多层图书馆每层都有自习室。

e.en: Children often find {multisyllabic} words harder to spell.
e.zh: 孩子们常觉得多音节词更难拼写。

e.en: The poem is full of long, {multisyllabic} adjectives.
e.zh: 这首诗里充满了冗长的多音节形容词。

e.en: The monitor supports {multisync} display modes for older computers.
e.zh: 这台显示器支持面向旧电脑的多同步显示模式。

e.en: A {multisync} system keeps several devices aligned in time.
e.zh: 多同步系统能让多台设备在时间上保持一致。

multitap.t: 多接口转接器；多次按键输入

e.en: We used a {multitap} to connect four controllers to the console.
e.zh: 我们用多接口转接器把四个手柄接到游戏机上。

e.en: Old mobile phones relied on {multitap} typing for text messages.
e.zh: 旧手机发短信依靠多次按键输入。

e.en: She can {multitask} well during busy clinic hours.
e.zh: 门诊繁忙时，她能很好地同时处理多项任务。

e.en: Trying to {multitask} while driving is dangerous.
e.zh: 开车时试图一心多用很危险。

e.en: The lab installed a {multiterminal} system for student access.
e.zh: 实验室安装了一个供学生使用的多终端系统。

e.en: A {multiterminal} battery can support several circuit connections.
e.zh: 多端口电池可以支持多个电路连接。

e.en: Use a {multitester} to check the battery voltage.
e.zh: 用万用表检查电池电压。

e.en: The electrician carried a small {multitester} in his tool bag.
e.zh: 电工在工具包里带着一个小型多功能测试仪。

e.en: He kept a {multitool} in his backpack for emergencies.
e.zh: 他在背包里放了一把多功能工具以备急用。

e.en: A good {multitool} can replace several small camping tools.
e.zh: 一把好的多功能工具能替代好几件露营小工具。

e.en: The song was {multitracked} in a small home studio.
e.zh: 这首歌是在小型家庭录音室里多轨录制的。

e.en: The project followed a {multitracked} approval process.
e.zh: 这个项目走的是多路径审批流程。

multitracker.t: 多轨录音机；多目标追踪器

e.en: The band bought a used {multitracker} for demo recordings.
e.zh: 乐队买了一台二手多轨录音机来录样带。

e.en: The software acts as a {multitracker} for delivery vehicles.
e.zh: 这款软件可作为配送车辆的多目标追踪器。

e.en: Digital {multitracking} made the album easier to edit.
e.zh: 数字多轨录音让这张专辑更容易编辑。

e.en: The radar system performs {multitracking} in crowded airspace.
e.zh: 该雷达系统在繁忙空域中执行多目标跟踪。

multitron.t: 多电子管装置；专用多元电子设备

e.en: The old manual refers to a {multitron} used in signal control.
e.zh: 旧手册提到一种用于信号控制的多电子管装置。

e.en: Only specialists could repair the laboratory's rare {multitron}.
e.zh: 只有专家才能修理实验室那台罕见的专用多元电子设备。

e.en: The report described the {multitudinal} effects of the policy.
e.zh: 报告描述了这项政策对大众产生的多方面影响。

e.en: His speech appealed to a {multitudinal} desire for change.
e.zh: 他的演讲呼应了民众广泛的求变愿望。

multitudinism.t: 大众主义；重视多数人的观念

e.en: The essay criticizes {multitudinism} as a shallow political fashion.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评大众主义是一种浅薄的政治风尚。

e.en: Her theory of {multitudinism} treats crowds as creative forces.
e.zh: 她的大众主义理论把群体视为创造性力量。

e.en: The lab installed a {multiunit} testing system.
e.zh: 实验室安装了一套多单元测试系统。

e.en: A {multiunit} building shares one heating plant.
e.zh: 一栋多住户建筑共用一个供暖设备。

e.en: The poem's {multivalence} invites several readings.

e.zh: 综合性大学服务于许多学科和社群。

e.zh: 学生们在课堂上制作了非稳态多谐振荡器。

e.zh: 这种蛾在温暖气候中一年繁殖多代。

e.zh: 农民整季监测一年多代的害虫。

e.zh: 这位学者引用了一部多卷本传记。

e.zh: 这个贝壳有多带状花纹。

e.zh: 这栋楼使用多分区供暖系统。

e.en: A {multizone} policy may suit the park better.
e.zh: 多区域政策可能更适合这个公园。

e.en: The myth describes a {multocular} guardian.
e.zh: 这个神话描写了一位多眼守卫。

e.en: The microscope revealed a {multocular} surface pattern.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出多眼状的表面图案。

e.en: The miller collected {multure} from each farmer.
e.zh: 磨坊主向每位农民收取磨谷费。

e.en: Old records list {multure} as a local duty.
e.zh: 旧记录把磨坊收费列为地方义务。

e.en: The grain was {multured} before it left the mill.
e.zh: 谷物离开磨坊前已被收取磨谷费。

e.en: Tenants complained about {multured} meal prices.
e.zh: 佃户抱怨被收过磨谷费的谷粉价格。

e.en: The boys played {mumblety-peg} behind the barn.
e.zh: 男孩们在谷仓后面玩掷刀游戏。

e.en: He learned {mumblety-peg} from an old camp counselor.
e.zh: 他从一位老营地辅导员那里学会了这种掷刀游戏。

e.en: The diary mentions {mumbletypeg} as a schoolyard game.
e.zh: 日记里把mumbletypeg称作一种校园游戏。

e.en: Few children today know the rules of {mumbletypeg}.
e.zh: 如今很少有孩子知道这种掷刀游戏的规则。

e.en: The contract was full of legal {mumbo-jumbo}.
e.zh: 合同里满是让人摸不着头脑的法律套话。

e.en: Stop the {mumbo-jumbo} and explain it clearly.
e.zh: 别再胡扯了，把事情说清楚。

e.en: He stood {mumchance} while the judge spoke.
e.zh: 法官讲话时，他一声不吭地站着。

e.en: The villagers grew {mumchance} after the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息后，村民们都沉默了。

e.en: A {mummichog} can survive in polluted marsh water.
e.zh: 鳉鱼能在受污染的沼泽水中存活。

e.en: The biologist caught a {mummichog} near the tide pool.
e.zh: 生物学家在潮池附近捉到了一条小鳉鱼。

e.en: The museum displayed a {mummied} hand in glass.
e.zh: 博物馆在玻璃柜里展出一只木乃伊化的手。

e.en: The dry desert air {mummied} the animal naturally.
e.zh: 干燥的沙漠空气让那只动物自然变成了木乃伊。

e.en: The statue had a stiff, {mummiform} pose.
e.zh: 那尊雕像姿态僵硬，像木乃伊一样。

e.en: She sketched the {mummiform} figure in the tomb painting.
e.zh: 她临摹了墓室壁画中木乃伊状的人像。

e.en: He would {mump} complaints under his breath.
e.zh: 他会压低声音嘟囔抱怨。

e.en: The rogue tried to {mump} a meal from travelers.
e.zh: 那个无赖想从旅人那里骗一顿饭吃。

e.en: She {mumped} a reply and looked away.
e.zh: 她嘟囔着回答了一句，然后移开视线。

e.en: The beggar {mumped} coins outside the inn.
e.zh: 乞丐在旅店外讨了些硬币。

e.en: The old {mumper} waited by the market gate.
e.zh: 那个老乞丐在市场门口等着。

e.en: He became a nervous {mumper} during interviews.
e.zh: 面试时他变成了一个紧张得嘟嘟囔囔的人。

e.en: His constant {mumping} annoyed everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他吃饭时不停嘟囔，让大家都很烦。

e.en: She saw men {mumping} for bread near the bridge.
e.zh: 她看见有人在桥边讨面包。

e.en: He gave a {mumpish} answer and shut the door.
e.zh: 他别别扭扭地回了一句，然后关上门。

e.en: Her {mumpish} mood lasted through breakfast.
e.zh: 她整个早餐时间都闷闷不乐。

e.en: She wore a {mumsy} cardigan to the party.
e.zh: 她穿着一件很有妈妈味的开衫去参加聚会。

e.en: The cafe had a {mumsy} charm that tourists loved.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有种老派温馨的气息，游客很喜欢。

e.en: She wore a bright {mumu} on the beach.
e.zh: 她在海滩上穿着一件鲜艳的宽松长袍。

e.en: The cotton {mumu} felt cool in the heat.
e.zh: 这件棉质穆穆裙在炎热天气里穿着很凉快。

e.en: The doctor suspected {munchausenism} after repeated false symptoms.
e.zh: 反复出现虚假症状后，医生怀疑是孟乔森症倾向。

e.en: Her essay examined {munchausenism} in clinical records.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了临床记录中的假病症现象。

e.en: I got the {munchies} after the movie.
e.zh: 看完电影后我突然很想吃零食。

e.en: The kitchen was stocked for late-night {munchies}.
e.zh: 厨房备好了东西，方便半夜嘴馋时吃。

e.en: The old mine produced worthless {mundic}.
e.zh: 那座老矿产出的只是无用的黄铁矿。

e.en: Builders later found {mundic} in the stone walls.
e.zh: 建筑工人后来在石墙里发现了含硫矿石。

e.en: The nurse used a mild wash to {mundify} the wound.
e.zh: 护士用温和的清洗液来清洁伤口。

e.en: Old medical texts advised herbs to {mundify} ulcers.
e.zh: 旧医学书建议用草药来净化溃疡处。

e.en: He stirred the mash with a wooden {mundle}.
e.zh: 他用一根木制搅拌棒搅动麦芽浆。

e.en: The brewer kept an old {mundle} by the vat.
e.zh: 酿酒师把一根旧木棒放在桶边。

e.en: He folded the white {mundu} before entering the temple.
e.zh: 进寺庙前，他把白色的印度腰布整理好。

e.en: The groom wore a silk {mundu} for the ceremony.
e.zh: 新郎在仪式上穿着一条丝质腰布。

mundungus.t: 恶臭烟草；臭味烟草渣滓

e.zh: 那只旧烟斗闻起来有恶臭烟草和灰烬的味道。

e.zh: 他开玩笑说那支廉价雪茄简直就是臭烟草渣。

e.zh: 地方自治派政纲在几个城镇获得了支持。

e.zh: 电力市有化降低了家庭账单。

e.zh: 黎明时，一只胆小的麂穿过森林小路。

e.zh: 园丁把玫瑰被吃掉的事怪在麂身上。

e.zh: 较旧的书有时把muntjac拼作muntjak。

e.zh: μ子信号能揭示这种材料的细节。

e.zh: μ素的寿命极其短暂。

e.zh: 工程师注意到液晶面板上有色差不匀。

e.zh: 仔细校准减少了显示屏上的斑驳缺陷。

e.zh: 家属同意后，报告才公布被谋杀者的姓名。

e.zh: 在旧式法律文书中，受害者被称为murderee。

e.zh: 修士们选择把自己封闭在修道院里。

e.zh: 古老的石墙似乎把花园同道路隔开。

e.zh: 囚犯被关在一间狭窄的牢房里。

e.zh: 礼拜堂后面有一个被墙围住的庭院。

e.zh: 抗生素可以阻断细菌中的胞壁质合成。

e.en: The cell wall contains a strong layer of {murein}.
e.zh: 细胞壁含有一层坚韧的胞壁质。

e.zh: 恐惧把他封闭在自己的沉默之中。

e.zh: 海滩上有一个破碎的骨螺壳。

e.en: Ancient dyers used {murex} to make purple pigment.
e.zh: 古代染匠用骨螺制作紫色染料。

e.zh: 化学家加入紫脲酸铵来指示钙离子。

e.zh: 滴定过程中，紫脲酸铵溶液发生了变色。
